title: A functional and light step stool that takes up a lot of space folded and raises me 14 inches off the floor when needed
text:
I have been wanting this for a while and finally purchased this at Harbor Freight with a coupon for $22.49 plus tax. This is easy to set up with two clips that fold in place and easy to break down with those same clips. I like the carrying handle and how light yet sturdy this is when standing on it. It raises me 14 inches off the floor. The box claims it holds up to 350 pounds.

Of course, I would prefer that this collapsed into a smaller package. When collapsed the legs sit away from the base so that the step stool is around 9 inches at its widest point (meaning the legs fold on top of the step and not into it). Overall, it's functional and light but does take up a lot of space folded.

title: Holds up small, light, or thin books for reading but it is very flimsy
text:
My boyfriend purchased two of these by accident from Amazon, so even though I already had a large cookbook stand I decided to purchase the extra one from him.

This stand is all plastic and very cheaply made. A plastic lever in the back allows me to lock and unlock the angle of the book when reading. The levers on the front hold the pages nicely but for many books, I have to remove the book from the stand to turn the pages.

Besides the cheap quality and the potential possiblity of the foot lever lock breaking easily, this is really only for light, short, or relatively thin books. For example, I was reading a tall thin cookbook with this and since the pages were not evenly distributed, the stand wobbled.

Had my boyfriend not purchased two of these by mistake, I would not have bought this as I prefer paying more for a much higher quality item. Nevertheless, this does the job it is supposed to do which is hold up a book for reading.

title: This would have been a five-star desk calendar if it weren't for the cheap edge savers; would not re-purchase this
text:
I normally buy the no-frills "at-a-glance" desk calendar and this year I accidentally purchased one that was an academic calendar which ended in June of the following year. Therefore, I decided to buy this calendar to replace the partial one. After having used this, I would not purchase this again.

The calendar is pretty and the flowers are all pink. The one major disappointment are the edge savers on the bottom. Mine arrived totally cut on both sides. Even if they were sealed, they are flimsy and weak. Since I use this on my desk, it is important for me to be able to tuck items along the bottom edges as I do with the cheaper at-a-glance calendars. If the edge savers were sturdier and not sliced, I would have given this calendar 5 stars. However, because these edge guards are extremely important to me and on this calendar they are useless, this is not one I would re-purchase in the future.

title: Sturdy rolling "no-frills" book cart but not flawless; I was able to get between 75-80 cookbooks on each cart
text:
I purchased two of these in the "Tropic Sand" color because I wanted the ability to roll them out of the way when I needed to get to the stationary bookcases I positioned behind them. These are sturdy and roll pretty easily on carpet. When full with books, it takes a bit of effort to move but not too much. The casters are big and were the only part that had to be installed.

The quality is okay. After reading all the other reviews, I was a bit nervous that I was going to get a defective cart. One cart had a chip in it and the Sandusky label was pasted haphazardly on the side of the unit. Other than this, they appear to be fine. I was able to get 75 to 80 cookbooks of various sizes on each cart (about 25-27 books on each shelf), which works perfectly for me. See attached pictures.

If I were in the market for more of these, I probably would purchase the SmithSystem Booktruck or one of the other SmithSystem carts. I saw them in the library today and they appear to be better made and flawless in its finish. In fact, had I known about that brand I probably would have purchased them instead. Nevertheless, these carts are a "no-frills option, are sturdy, and hold a lot of books on three shelves.

PS I put the URL to the SmithSystem brand in the comments section of this review.

text:

title: Never knew tape could make me so happy.. but, read to avoid pitfalls
text:
Does what it says... it’s like witchcraft!! This definitely should be a staple in every house as, it’s helpful uses are still being discovered!

Ordered originally to hold our area rug in place.. you know, the corners that like to curl up..?!! Well, it tackled the problem and then some! Truly, I haven’t found a place I wanted to use.. that this 2 sided tape hasn’t stepped up to the task- Boom, mic. drop and goodnight Salt Lake City!!! That should be endorsement enough- In fact, It is a must for all MacGyver toolboxes!!

Facts:
•Adhesion is fantastic. Sticking an item to carpet of all things, just screams all sorts of issues.. but, this adhesion tape can do it!! Of course, this can adhere with ease to ANY flat surface.. as if, it just belongs there. BUT, the true test is in the ability to hold tight where it shouldn’t.. like on carpet!! Using apprx 1.5” on all 4 corners, keeps rug from curling up- **NOO, you don’t have to run tape the entire length of the carpet edge to get this to work!! I have found this will stay put by just taping corners- as long as, no one catches and/or, pulls it up prematurely! ie, a tread from a grippy shoe can flip the edge up if caught just so.. or, the vacuum pulled the wrong direction can cause it to undo- **when this loosens- just discard used tape and replace. Personally, mine can go months without moving.. and if/when it does, ha! It’s less than 2” of new tape to fix!! (I tried once the rinse and reuse method- but, not even worth the time when using on carpet.)

•Flat surface adhesion: Duh, of course it works! FYI- Less is more people!! I suggest using small amount .25” when sticking to a wall/flat surface. If weight of item is heavier- use small pieces and just more of them vs. one big piece! Keep in mind if this is used to hang poster or, similar type material- this will rip poster item upon removal. ** its the equivalent of sticking tape to a piece of paper. So, know that going in. **Hack: I placed clear 2” clear packing tape to the back side corners of my sons beloved poster. Then, placed double-sided tape on top of the taped surface- that way when removing, the poster itself is protected from ripping.. you’re welcome!
•Reusing: I found this is not the cards with carpet. Think silly putty with “Fufies” in it! Yes, that is the scientific term for carpet fuzz!! I’ve tried washing, pulling and manipulating but.. this doesn’t like to work after it has carpet fuzz stuck to it. Reusing technique is doable… It’s if, removing from a flat, clean surface. Yet, Trust me, it’s totally worth discarding and using new- after all the trouble, it will not hold again on carpet like virginal piece will!! (Since It takes so little to do the trick- why not put fresh piece down!!?)

•Removing: Easy-peasy! Because of the thickness this is a simple task to takeoff- just start at a corner and roll backwards.. that’s it!! Careful, I’ve not had success using on paint. Sure it will stick. But, in my one trial.. when removing from painted wall- it took the paint off with it. For that reason, i personally do not use nor, recommend on painted walls. (FYI, I have same problem with “removable“ non damaging wall tabs by 3M made NOT to peak off paint.. so- expect this will work the same as those on your painted walls. I realize, not all wall paints are created equal!)

Overall- this is a must have for any households.. I can’t believe the amount of problems it can solve! Every toolbox should have a roll of duct tape and this double sided wizardry- this gives on MacGyver fixes a run for it’s money!! Using common sense- and maybe a little trial/error, you will know where and how this can benefit your world.. I promise, it’s worth its weight in gold!! This would be a great gift for newlyweds, house warming or, college kids off to decorate a dorm- it will be put to great use, not a doubt in my mind!!
I hope this info helps… Feel free to let me know!

Especially, if working over carpet or- at a higher counter level! These tiny pieces of hardware love to bounce and hide-
Tbh, I didn’t know this item existed and thought I had revolutionized the world with my million $ making idea- plan was to Patton a magnetized placemat… and retire! However, when I popped that brilliance into Google a “how to” search engine- I was kicked in the gut to find, I could already buy this item of mine on Amazon! Of course, I could! At least I felt smart for a tiny hot second.. thinking it up on my own- and along with the someone else who, was a step ahead and had earned my money maker.. dammit! As for the product, it works just as one would expect. It is simply just that, a placemat to do ones task on and one with impressive powers- this has a good amount of grab to keep items from falling off if dropped or set down on top of it. And it’s easy to remove… It’s a nice amount of give/take.
If small eyeglass type/size screw is placed on the mat- you could pick it up horizontally without items falling off. On the flipside, one rough shake will release (not that you’re wanting to do that! Just giving the idea of the holding power!!) trust me, the small items and wheel bearings my son is working with, would make the back of an earring look massive.. so, this mat has saved many of hours on hands/knees combing floor with a magnet- so, for any who work with tiny object such as this.. it’s worth it’s weight in gold!
This also comes with a magnetic pen to pick up small items as well… he uses that more like a novelty item. This would be helpful for those who have trouble seeing some of the smaller parts.
This also has a grid system for any specific parts needing to be placed together.. in specific boxes marked on the magnet board, you can arrange your items keeping them compartmentalized… Amazing!
This comes in a slide in/out plastic cover and if you open appropriately… You can use cover to store item when not in use- we did this and love that it’s easy to keep together or take on the go.
For any who work with smaller objects at just over $5, this is a great item to have.. Definitely satisfied and glad I thought of it and purchased it!!

title: Perfect timesaver for a move from Point A to B..!!!
text:
Great wardrobe boxes and very straightforward in what their used for. These are easy to assemble and for the best results- **for sure: I cant stress to you enough, use a STRONG quality tape to build and seal these boxes! Stating the obvious- these boxes are bigger in size..and by default, they will hold more, be heavier and therefore, need to be reinforced with a stronger tape to assemble/close and give you the piece of mind you want!! So, get and use quality tape!
These came in 2 sizes and I didn’t quite understand why...Ha, Now, I do!! I chose the smaller version thinking it would make things easier to lift/move/ store and it does. This fits childrens, teens, and most adult (female) size shirts/jackets- However, the part I figured out..!!! IF, you want to keep the clothing packed in the hanging formation- without getting bunched/smashed/wrinkled at the bottom of box, get the BiGgEr SiZe- at least for adult mens and some women’s LoNgEr clothing!!! The larger box has more height and will fit the longer items without all the excess being smashed in at the bottom of the box. (so, different size of box can fit a longer lengths of items- size the box accordingly.)

We used these boxes to purge our winter coat closet and move the excess we don’t use all the time. (You know, when you need room for the daily coat use- but, things like a leather bomber jacket you got when the Movie top gun debuted and- hasn’t been worn since that year in 88’.. But, for some reason-its taking up prime real estate. Why?!) Ha..!! We thought it might be best to move our “occasional coats” to storage- creating more room in closet and wardrobe boxes are an awesome way to keep them hung up with easy access in our storage room.. the idea worked really well.

The box is not the most heavy duty cardboard I’ve ever seen and a tad on thinner side (better for the environment!) To help this we reinforced box with tape by making a complete circle around the girth of the box.. adding just an extra bit of support and sturdiness. Doing this, the box felt strong and was easy to move without issue.
These boxes are a great service for moving from point A to B... if moving houses/apartments, you can move all hanging items without taking items off hangers (saving so much time) then, unpacking goes just as fast/smooth. These work fantastic!!
Side note: we also wrangled multiple boxes into one of these!! to keep xmas decor/smaller items together, we used a wardrobe box without the bar and put all smaller boxes inside one large box- this will make storing/finding these items again.. sooo much easier next xmas!!
For a set of three boxes the price seemed fair- although I hate buying boxes at all!

title: Command strip mentality w/o the cost. Reusable..
text:
Magic tape!! This is a thick and rubbery concoction that is about 1/8” thick.. comes stuck to itself with a covered film on one side you’ll need to remove. It’s in a large 10ft. roll making it perfectly easy to cut size piece needed for said job..

I wasted no time and put it to the test right away! I have a 5 x 7‘ area rug that has been laying flat in living room since July. Recently the corners have began to roll up causing tripping hazards and is also SO ugly to look at. I never realized my pet peeve seeing rolled carpet corners on a daily basis!

I guesstimated size needed and cut 2” strips. The first corner I attached to bottom of rug and firmly placed down on carpet. Being OCD- not trusting it was working.. I lifted it up, causing the stick to lessen.. not smart! So, I used included instruction and followed steps to reuse the tape which is to wet (I added a dot of soap and rinsed it off..) then, patted it dry- it was instant sticky right after drying completely and that piece has kept the rolled carpet down ever since. So far, it’s been x4 days!?

My biggest concern is leaving a sticky glue residue on the carpet… But, from everything I can tell- this does not use glue? Its described as being designed with nanotechnology.. not sure what that is- but, it works fantastically!
One more trial!! we used tape to hang a tapestry- It was a light nylon, size 4x6..and weight Is practically nothing but, i felt it didnt need holes to ruin the material nor, did I want holes in my wall for this temporary decor! So, we followed same process as before (w/on moving tape once set!) it went on 1st try using approx. 1.5” sz. tape in x4 corners.. and small strip in top middle- Im feel I could use a smaller strip.. but, keep doubting and then, I’m shocked how it holds- so, play with amount used in hanging.. I’m sure you could make the roll last longer!
This products along the lines of command strips and hopefully much better- it states you can wash
and reuse x600 applications.. I’m not sure if I see that in the future? But, it’s certainly NOT x1 and done!! Cost compared to command strips- is hands down better.. So, if using the same philosophy of not damaging walls while hanging items/fastening objects… This surpasses a great deal by far!

title: Best college notetaking spiral ever!!!
text:
Love, love, love these note taking one subject binders!! If they were priced better, I would buy cases of them… Having two kids in college and one in high school, everything is about notetaking! Getting past these sturdy and durable issues –all the things we’ve all come to expect with spiral notebooks.. These have great features to make up for their shortcomings in durability! The space to write/flag/add/sticker/doodle/draw/note/add date for future use- all in the side note column and highlighted spots perfectly put throughout the pages… is truly, nothing less then- AmAziNg! Again, my college kids live and die by these these great features and for all this the notebook offers, it does go a long way to make up for the shortcomings!

If you make a package that is consistent and price marked at a decent amount for a full-time student – i.e. five pack at fair price point… I firmly believe you would have college converts worldwide using these notebooks!! text: Follow the instructions to get the easiest way to construct! That said, one of the panel didn’t sit completely flat on one of the notches..but not too noticeable and still functional.  I like the lightness and strength as I laid it on the back side on my music bookshelf!  It’s great in supporting the large music books: easy to grab one book without collapsing all the other music scores!  I didn’t use the front panel: didn’t affect the functionality of the organizer.

title: Perfect for similar key board!
text: Huge upgrade of a foam based wrist rest and we have a similar key board as depicted in the picture, and it provides nice firm support at just the right level - not raising my wrist in an awkward position.  The design looks like it will not fall apart at the seam.  Sleek looking too, and will be curious to see if there will be some fading after continuous use.

title: Quality card and quite big!
text: Huge, it is a thank you card, and not anything else.  It’s significant in size and hence will hold up as a nice ‘bouquet’ effect.  Great value.  The card is quite thick to stand up.

title: Deliciously smooth
text: Writes really smoothly and negligible smudging.  Love the colors and the white you can use on those black labels - in fact the best thin nib pen for that.  I love the colors and can use these color range for my annotating my music notes. So much fun even for adults!  I love pens.

title: Works great for an activity that you need to do regularly
text: I am using this planner for piano practice: there is so much from scales, arpeggios, theory, rhythm, practice pieces, etc.  I have a hard cover planner, but it’s not working.  I wanted something simple and non fancy: this fits the bill and that said, the quality of the paper is thick if you use ink, no bleed. Although there is nothing on other side.  Perfect for planning and little daily targets.

title: Surprisingly light.
text: Amazingly light and lovely construction,  the front of the card could be more festive looking, but matters little as the pop up display is lovely.  Cant wait to send recipients.

title: Light and well constructed.
text: The front of the card is cheerful red, very festive, and opens up to fun display. Remarkably thin and light.  Cant wait to send to recipient.

title: Solid cardboard. Lovely design.
text: Solid cardboard, which is what I prefer.  I love that this is horizontal as I do so much d in and the turning of paperwork works so more efficiently for me.  Love the cheerful oranges, especially with doing non fun admin.

title: Great for marking bread and baking recipes
text: I love the quality of the cards: very thick and if you use a marker, it shouldn’t bleed through.  Totally great with pencil.  The box is also solid and well designed.  I am actually using this box to store my go to bread and baking recipes that I make a lot of, and its such a neat and tidy little box that it slots right in with the flour containers.  I love it, I can throw up my scrappy cards that are so bent and worn out and lying all over the kitchen counter.

title: like the reaction as I place a lot of downward pressure when I take notes
text: i love mechanical pencils and this is a new brand for me.  I like that the pencil retracts to absorb some of the pressure i usually place when I am writing fast.  I use pencils a lot and hence the lead it also important.; as expected the lead is strong and did not break as I took notes in a class.  only think I wish it had was a soft grip - and hence i had to add my own.  Otherwise, I like this pencil.

title: light and yet strong leads!  greta value
text: i have had a few mechanical pencils from this brand: for the value they are great - with the soft grip and light.  the leads are strong as i do a lot of writing with pencil.  Hence, they hold up to intensive use and i can apply a lot of pressure when writing fast.  love the ;title plastic case to keep everything tidy!

title: strong lead!  hope the mechanism will last for a while
text: love this brand as it is light, has plastic rubber to make writing comfortable, and the leads are strong and do not break when in use.  I use pencils all the time and i dont know, yet, how long the mechanism will hold and not break.  for value and useable leads are a plus for me right now.  Hope it last for long time as I am cognizant of mother earth and too much use of disposable products.

title: Strong lead.
text: Nice rubber to support long use. The leads are good too, do not break in mid flow.  I like this new brand I’d mechanical pencils.  Like the little box it comes with: keeping everything tidy.  I write a lot and need something reliable , works and strong lead.

title: Nice pastel color, but few improvements needed.
text: I like this brand, have had a few of their mechanical pencils.  Whilst I love the pastel color, a little disappointed with the small barrel to hold the leads, 2 maximum otherwise the mechanic jams, too much plastic for holding too few leads, rather wished the leads were held in fewer containers.  Otherwise, the lead is more a B than HB.  Most of the leads were strong, but did break sooner than other leads of same brand.

title: trusted brand for making lovely celebration cards
text: such a pretty and simple design.  quality card.

title: Love the double clip.
text: Love the double clip!  Very sturdy and love these folders to help me with managing the forever mounting paperwork projects.

title: Reusable, open slots, and durable for many paper projects ahead.
text: We are in the midst of organizing all the bank statements, which years to spread, which years to keep..love that these ones are open to easily slot the papers in, a slot to put the year [removable so it is is reusable], clear and very durable for future projects.  Love the colors if you find organization via color is more useful for you.

title: Love these refillable rollers.
text: We have another similar protection roller, but this one comes with 3 refills.  Love this as it makes disposing of personal paperwork so easy.  Goes a long way as we did a big clean out and still no refill required!  Not that tiny as it covers addresses, key information with one roll.  Dries quickly and does not rub off.

title: Natural material. Solid.
text: Love it that it is recyclable natural material.  I love that it is A4 size, much longer than letter size paper [although the product came with incorrect label of letter when it arrived].  Love the design.  I am using it to attach extra music page for my recital.  Very solid and well made.

title: works with a hot iron.
text: I used a hot iron with towel on top of the pouch for 30 seconds and it works.  I didnt want to have another appliance in the home.  these pouches are fab for kids and learning, and I use it for noting my kitchen cans/pantry inventory.  great brand.

title: Classy look. Does the job.
text: I just wanted something with small foot print to hold some files..this fits the bill whist it has a classy look [especially with the navy color].  Very easy to put together, intuitive really as there are no instructions.  Easy to dust as well.

title: Ready to use right out the box.  Ergonomically comfortable.
text: Ready to use right out of the box.  I can’t comment right now on refills, which you need to buy separately.  Used it over critical information and with just one swipe..you couldn’t read anything.  Ink dried super fast and hence you can’t rub it off.  Highly recommend at this price point.  I will still shred, but mind will be very at ease.  Very comfortable to use in 5 minutes of admin I was working on inspire this is small.

title: Does the job 10 folds: holds up my piano music books.
text: Solid, well made and love the value of AmazonBasics.  It is strong enough to hold a number of my piano music books and with the soft pads at the bottom, it sits securely on my ebony piano top.  Perfect for filing and not just mail.

title: Good value , but not sure it will last as long as a major brand.
text: Decent pen, but shake it a bit for ink to flow better to the nib.  Use it to cover name and address to packages or sensitive information before throwing out.  Nib is medium and decently thick.  Not sure how long they will last versus a major brand..as mentioned earlier, initially, ink flows slow and looks dry.

title: Light and solid -great that it’s made of wood material.
text: Love that this is made from wood/hardboard and not plastic.  Very solid!  Works as expected and like the pen slot.  We use it to hold all bills and receipts.  All in one place.  Light to hold as well.

title: Works as expected, but needed to clean some rust like powder on some pieces.
text: Whilst easy to assemble.  I wasn’t happy to see ‘rust’ like powder on some of the pieces, which prompted me to clean all the pieces before hand.  Once removed, I didn’t notice any major rusted areas.  The organizer works great to manage all the folders and files - no more panic attacked looking for the correct folder.  It fits anywhere, but do measure your area if not placing on a desk or counter space.

title: Fun and solid quality
text: Quality he thick envelope and larger in size.  Fun pictures and great to use for New Year, weddings, birthdays.

title: Perfect and nicely made.  Very happy.
text: I got the clear book ends and I love the quality.  Very nicely made, thick and the little pads at the bottom will avoid any scratching on the surface.  I was looking for something non intrusive to hold my ‘active’ music books: this delivered my wishes 100%: clear and nice design, my music books are nicely stacked and easy access, looks lovely on my lively piano.  Great value at 2x pairs.

title: Very strong magnets.  Little chance of falling on the floor if used for intended items.
text: The magnets are strong!  We have a metal front door and the inside face have easy wipe white board..and now the large 3 compartment tray now houses the pens and board wiper.  The other smaller pen holders snapped on a metal computer table..and now easy access to pens!  I live anything that helps me that lift items off the floor or off the table.  Less clutter and hence easier to clean surfaces..these magnet backed trays are perfect.  You don’t have a metal base- get some magnetized tapes.

title: Easy to use, quieter than older models. HIPAA compliant and P4 security for most personal uses.
text: Quieter than our current shredder and the ‘engine’/ top part is lighter too; but be aware of clipping your skin as it was quite easy to cut your fingers as you put the top onto the basket.  Very easy to use. The lock is quite basic/manual and won’t work if the central slider is not in the neural position.  I tested it with 11 sheets of normal paper [ie not the thick fancy paper] and it works with no hiccup.  This is P4 security, which after some research should cover majority of personal uses.  We were seeking an upgrade from p3 to p4 to be HIPAA a compliant.  Nice and compact.  I hope this lasts as long as our current one of over 10 years!  Only upgrading for the ‘added’ security.

title: This is my favorite planner. Hands down.
text: 100% love this brand and I prefer the vertical version, as it offers more space to list [even with all the mundane stuff].  The design is slightly smaller than last year’s lovely vertical version:  I love the new compact design.  The paper quality is excellent.  There is a 2 page section at beginning if the month that gives anyone a reflection of gratitude, health, what to start, to keep up, to quit and how the month went.  I have this really useful to provide a short journal.  Great planner for managing anxiety and those who are struggling: helped me to do the essential on this bad days and yet enjoy the higher level of productivity on better days.  Highly recommend to those who like to work with lists..manage their day to day, the cooking menu, events, tv shows to watch.

title: no more punching holes; solid hold onto paperwork until you are ready to tackle the admin.
text: Great way to organize work-in-process paperwork.  i got fed up with punching holes to file paper on a temporary basis  -  seems a lot of effort and decided to invest in 'punchless' folders.  This is the second version that I am trying and what I love about it:  very sturdy and will unlikely to crack [as with plastic], easy to snap onto the paper and whilst it technically holds 100 sheets - I would say it is more like 50 sheets.  I am using it to hold a bunch of paperwork that I need to see through at a later time, make sure the paper does not fly around or get lost in the rumble of life; for paying the bills.  I much prefer this to paper folder as you can kindly cram a lot of paper in and then forget about it.  I now line up these folders and each paper admin session, I will pick up on these folders and work on it.  yeah, for those who cant work in a messy environment  and really dont want to be punching holes: highly recommend.

title: this has become my favorite brand to manage my life and mind.
text:
meh last 2 planners are with Southworth and it is my favorite brand. for the first time, I am downsizing from the vertical and larger planner - lets see how it works as I have found these planners essential to manage my anxiety and depression. I LOVE there is a 2 pager air the beginning of the month that covers: catch up from last month, gratitude, health, things to keep up, to start, to quit and note. I have this 2 pager really helpful to check in on myself and to be grateful even at the most difficult period - that too does pass. I couldn't start 2022 without this planner and yes, a little familiarity really helps.
I have tried a number of other brands, they are great too, but this one is the best for me. interesting to see if a horizontal day will work for my current vertical format. the smaller size might help with me holding balance in my life and not to over do a day.

title: Quality remains with this brand.
text: I am a huge believer of planners.  I have been using one for past 4 years for managing my anxiety and Depression.  I have been trying a number of different brands and they change the style every year - lol, not great for those with anxiety issues.  This one has a huge section for ‘note it’.  At first, I wasn’t a fan as I prefer more space on each day to mange stuff.  Then I realize that change isn’t bad and I can repurpose the note section.  I have used this brand a few years back and the quality remains great.  I use pencils a lot and the paper strength wouldn’t tear with many iterations I may do if I am heading into an anxiety period.

title: Beautifully made and robust for someone who uses pencils pretty much for everything.
text: I love 0.7 pencils, and these pencils are beautiful. The textured barrel means I can grip comfortably.  The mechanical top is solid and not flimsy.  There is a little rubber underneath the pump top.  There are no additional leads taht come with the pencils.  The grip is quite ‘tight’, struggled to use it.

title: Multiple uses!
text: Thin and durable material.  Two compartments to senate items.  Has multiple functions other than just pencils: needlework, make up, music tools, travel pill bag!  Just thrown in cold wash to clean when needed.

title: Beautiful card
text: Solid card that stays open as in the picture.  Great card for creating a 3-d flowers … really lovely design and well put together

title: Best planner.  I hope to make this brand my go to.
text: I have the 2021 organizer planner and I love it.  For the same reasons I love the academic year version:  a daily column to list all my tasks/appointments; the 2 page monthly overview and the 2 page look back, gratitude, health, and some encouraging boxes for carry on, stop and start.  The annual planner has provided a calm for my hyper anxiety disposition and helps you to create rituals and assess your habit you want to drop.  The academic planner is laid out the same , which I will use it for documenting my piano/music journey.  I have tried so many planners and this format, esthetic brings me so much joy. I can see when I have had a bad week, and then the recovery week.

title: Letter sized:  organizer must get!
text: Letter sized and perfect for throwing in bunch of paperwork to deal with later.  I am falling in love with these folder…no more hole punching.  Great to organize your paperwork.  Nice thickness.  Works like a dream.

title: great to keep bunch of paperwork together before sorting them out.
text: love that it is A4 size, longer than letter size.  I have moved towards these folders as I cant be bothered with hole punching everything.  And something I just want something to hold onto a bump of paperwork before I sort them out.  I noticed there are couple of tiny prongs sticking out - haven't scratched myself yet - but wished they had smoothed them out.  nice durable plastic.

title: A few mm short for letter size.
text: Just fits letter sized paper, a few mm short imho.  Otherwise love the concept and thinness, just what I need for my piano related paperwork.  Plastic is thin enough and yet strong enough to write on. Live the clip concept without a hole puncher.

title: Fab phone,  no drop call
text: We have Ooma for over a decade, one of the early adopters.  This is first time we bought the handset with the ooma wifi model, which we upgraded.  Love it, super clear and had no drop calls.  Love that it interacts well with your account and updating telephone list.  Highly recommend with ooma homeset.

title: great non permanent maulers at a good price point
text: Another great product from AmazonBasics: the pen are large and sturdy, yet the tip is pointed that writing is legible.  Easy to wash off the white board.  Simplicity and effective.

title: thin card but fans out for a  nice display
text: For the price point - the card is thin, but a nice design.  Allows the recipient to fan out the card for a nice display.  The wordings in the card were positive and in line with Chinese's requirements.

title: Great quality for any home use.
text: 4th grade or for adults needing a Scribble pad for jotting down bread recipes!  I would use a pencil, as paper seems thin and a pen would heels through.  The quality is great and multiple uses is what we look for in any products.

title: Excellent quality.
text: Great quality card. Perfect size for gifting money to our building’s staff.

title: Great unit, but knowledge is thinly spread amongst level 1 of service team.
text:
We were early adopters and our 2nd gen ooma unit just broke down, in fact it happened gradually over a period of 12 months. The unit lasted 7-8 years. As a user : you ahve to call into customer service 1st before you power up the unit. Then you use the setup app to do the rest of the set up long with a quick refresh of the account on website.
If you are a new user: follow the instructions on the unit.

What should be improved is better training for their customer service: I was given 3 different ways to transfer to the new unit, none of which was correct. Sales were awful - as we needed to cancel an order we made with them [ended up buying the unit on Amazon] and the unit still arrived from ooma. Sales dept, too, had different answers and some were rude and unhelpful.

That said, we still love the promises, and whilst you need to escalate to the senior engineers if you are not getting the expertise you need. Thankfully, it is once in a blue moon that we need that level of assistance.

title: Multiple u
text: Great for home goods/food/flour bags.  I am also using these for administration paperwork -keeping the piles tidy!  Very sturdy and well made.  Love the colors.

title: Transparent and great highlighters.
text: Perfectly sized.  It is sized like a normal pen. Colors are great - transparent and yet stands out. Love the variation of colors.  Nice job amazon- another great product.  Does not leak onto other side.

title: Not enough space to write a personal message
text: Very sturdy.  Cant wait to send them to family. Only down side is very small area to write anything personal.  The card is well protected in an additional cardboard envelope.

title: Little space to sign or wrote greetings
text: Fun pop up Christmas cards - very sturdy.  Can wait to send them to family.  However, very small space to write any good wishes or sign it though.

title: Shame the lead was brittle in some pencils.

title: Great strong lead.  Comfortable,
text: Love the design and the rubber is very comfortable for using the pencil for along time. I use pencils a lot so it is important to feel comfortable.  The lead is strong and did not break every time I used it.  Love the colors.  The pencil enables you to use refills- so great to reuse these pencils for long time to come.

title: Cardboard with sheen on outer side. Light.  Organization.
text: Binder is made of cardboard. Not too thick aNd not too thin.  The outer side has a slight sheen to allow easy clean.  I like it as I recognize my anxiety/depression requires ‘organization’ and with 3/4 inch ring, each folder will have a function without overwhelming me.  I tried larger rings with dividers...it didn’t work for me, as I was getting over whelmed.  Each folder has a specific function.  Be it bills, annual related documents.  I really like it, as it also keeps the weight down as people with arthritis- you are creating a filing system too heavy.  This binder will last a long time.  The other one I am using to keep recipes to try and determine if they are keepers.  I keep no more than 20 recipes to try in the month.

title: 0.7 lead- like a H hardness, terrific value
text: What great value. The 0.7 lead is pretty firm and writes like a H.  The pencil is very light, and I was able to slip on a rubber grip to make it more comfortable to use.  I was able to remove the clip on the pen as I have no use for it.  I love working with pencils so this was a great value pack with so many leads and more rubbers to last a life time.  Really enjoyed using the pencil- quite and easy mechanics to operate.  Whilst not the prettiest in design with a rubber grip - it is super comfortable and functional.

title: Delicious journal and lovely layout to support an anxious mind.
text:
I wasn’t sure if I wanted an organizer for 2021...but glad I relented, as this one is as nice as another brand I buy. I love the monthly intention double page that gives you a chance to reflect back, set intentions, and mini goals. The holidays are ample including Chinese and Jewish holidays. Each week is represented by double page, and enough to jot down intention lists. I have adapted a philosophy of 3 big goals to choice in the year, 3 per month, and 3 per day: it’s a way to manage anxiety- has helped me a lot and these journals are great to manage the workload. The paper thickness is delicious that I can use my ink pen without bleeding to the other side. I am excited to use this to focus on 2021 intentions and interesting during the pandemic.
The weight of the journal is pretty light and helpful if you have arthritic hands.

title: Reusable, easy to apply.
text: This is fun.  I needed a blackboard to write down all my baking recipes.  So easy to use, does not damage the surface you place it on [critical].  Love that you can cut it to fit any purpose you have.  Easy to clean as well, reusable.  Ticking all my ‘keep it green as possible’.  Repurposing is critical.

title: Great for HB and softer leads
text: I scribble and make lots of notes during my sourdough, bread, baking journey.  And pencils are my go to, which is always my preferred writing tools.  This rubber works great, especially for HB, B and below, a tad less effective for the harder lead pencils -requiring a little more effort.  Handy shape.

title: Notes, to do, no more calendars/planners for me

Now I have something I can carry with me to jot down to do lists, bread recipes, music homework...it comes with an A5 notebook.  I like the various pockets as I am always scribbling notes down.  The phone just doesn’t do it for me.  Slim, small, and functional.

title: love the colors, tad thin

title: For bread ingredients

Very good value for the material.

They are pretty .thick - not flimsy.  Love how organized my front door is!  I love the colors, cheerful.  Cute, I love them.

title: Great value for ink tanks, super easy to use

title: Great product

title: fabulous layout for anxiety sufferers
text:
I started using Inkwell weekly and monthly planner for the first time in 2019 - and I love the format as it fits in the rule of 3 that I now apply to annual, monthly and daily projects. the rule of 3 is a great way to manage anxiety and depression - it helps to reduce the feeling of being overwhelmed with life. title: good upgrade from epson home and wish there were more improvements
text:
We have a number of Epson home printers and this is the first one that has ink tank and geared towards small businesses.
This is an upgrade from our Epson home printer and the upgrades that we liked included:
1. the scanning is now just one button [not 2!], no longer need a CD to load the software - access via internet;
2. the print quality is noticeably better and faster;
3. the print from the ipads, android, IOS was easy and seamless! you do need to leave the printer in 'sleep' mode, otherwise you would need to switch the printer on;
4. the scanning [above 250 bpi] is good, but i preferred the 600 bpi option as it gave the cleanest scan, and it did not take a long time to scan the page. I also liked the fact the scan options can be saved for different purposes. I have one for my recipes saved from magazine and it can be in color/black and white and various paper sizes that cover Us, UK, mexico!;
5. very easy to empty the ink into the tank, and the connections are different for each color so there is no possibility of putting the wrong ink color in the tank! good design. the tank is easy to see the level of each ink color. We haven't see the ink being sold yet, and curious to see the price and whether the back ink will be sold separately as week, as we print more in black&white; and
6. set up was easy and straight forward.

what we dont like:
1. even in the older home model the paper tray would come out automatically and retract after printing. The print tray is manual, and we ended up leaving it 50% pulled out and it worked to keep the paper from falling onto the floor;
2, the screen went smaller! not that you can't still use the touch screen, but still - not that expensive to have a larger screen to make the touch more comfortable.
3, for a small business focused printer - it would be good to see a double sided scanner feed option. the feeder only allowed one sided scanning and printing. despite there is option for two sided printing option - only possible if you are using the manual scanning screen option.

we didnt try the fax option, but we look forward to see the ink saving. This is a good upgrade for home use as well as fro small business use. The price of this printer is really covering the ink cost, whilst a nice upgrade from our Epson home printer. Funny, this printer is super light versus our home printer.
