title: Two Sided and Easy to Clean
text:
White boards come in different shapes and sizes and among my favorite variations are those that come with a stand because you can place them on a table or counter, for all to see. What is even better is when they come with added accessories like you get with this AWELUX Dry Erase White Board.

Taking this from the package reveals a 12 by 16 inch whiteboard, 12 markers, an eraser, and four magnets. The markers come in an assortment of colors. Three of them are black, but that is okay because black is the color you use most when you have a whiteboard. The eraser is small, but so is the whiteboard so it should be fine.

I wasn’t expecting magnets but these are useful when there is a piece of paper or something light that you want to attach to the board. I find that the board and markers are what get used the most. Another cool feature is that the board is two sided. You can have one message written on one side and a different message on the other. To go back and forth, just rotate.

One of my greatest problems with dry erase boards is that they don’t always erase easily. With some boards, traces of the ink remain on the board and require special cleaning to remove. There is no such problem with this board. The marks wipe away completely, ready for your next message. These qualities make this AWELUX Dry Erase Board a winner overall.

title: Keep Organized the Old Fashioned Way
text:
I still like to keep track of things the old fashioned way, at least some of the time. Electronic calendars are nice for some purposes, but I prefer using a traditional planner to keep track of important dates in the future and that is why I decided to get this 2022 Weekly-Monthly Planner & Calendar, made by Early Care Evolution.

Large in size, this planner offers all the space you need to write down important appointments and take important notes. I tend to avoid the smaller size planners for that reason. They don’t have enough room to write everything you need to write. With this planner, each month has a two- page spread and each individual week has a page of its own about five lines to write things down, day by day. There is a budget page for each month, too.

Another cool fact about this planner is the tabs. You can quickly turn to the month of your choosing by grabbing the appropriate tab. The Holiday listing is extensive, too- much more so than the listings you find in other planners. This one even has minor religious holidays listed, some of which I have never heard of before.

One unusual thing about this planner is that the weekly pages are labeled from Saturday through Friday. Other planners either begin with Monday or Sunday. It treats Saturday like it’s the first day of the week. The budget sheet isn’t organized the way I would prefer, but it still works and again, there is lots of space to write down what you like. These are among the few issues I have with this planner. It satisfies in most other ways.

I will continue to use electronic calendars for certain uses. But no matter how far technology advances, I still like my traditional planners and this one from Early Care Evolution is a good one. It helps you stay organized with more than enough room to track important dates, reminders, and more.

title: Quality Means to Better Planning
text:
Most organizing options rely on electronic means. There are, indeed, many good ways to stay organized using apps and the like, but I still like the old- fashioned book style organizer and a good choice for anyone who needs an annual organizer is this 2022 Weekly and Monthly Planner from InkWELL Press for Blue Sky.

Larger in size than most others, this planner sports 8.5 by 11- inch pages, which is the same size as a standard sheet of paper. The larger pages mean there is more space upon which to write. I also like the tabs on the edges because it makes it easy to turn to the month you need. And, like other planners, there are several sections besides the actual calendars, among them a place to jot down goals, keep track of important dates, and more.

Another quality of an above average planner is the way the pages turn. They should be easy to turn and should be capable of lying flat. To accomplish this, a planner usually needs to be spiral bound and this one is just that. The spiral is a thicker wire, too, so it is durable and unlikely to bend. And yes, the pages lie completely flat as you turn them.

Organization matters and this 2022 Weekly and Monthly Planner from InkWell Press for Blue Sky is a useful, practical way to keep track of tasks, plans, duties, appointments, and much more. It has all the earmarks of a quality planner and thus earns the highest rating.

title: Basic Check Transaction Registers for a Low Price
text:
People don’t write checks as much as they once did. But we still have checking accounts and still have transactions, which makes the need for a check register as relevant as ever. The registers that are included when you order checks are far too few, and that is why a set of registers like these from Easy Read Register are a good idea to have.

With this set, you get ten registers. There are 26 pages and a total of 416 lines on each, which is enough to last a long time. The individual pages have the usual headers for date, description, payment, deposit, balance, etc. One extra on these registers is a column for Fee. This is not something I have seen on most checkbook registers.

The calendars on the back of each registers shows 2021, 2022, and 2023. That means, with normal usage, you should have the necessary calendars as you use these registers. If you have very few checking account transactions, it is possible that 2024 might roll around and you will still be using these registers, and that means you won’t have the correct calendar. With normal usage, you should be fine.

These check registers fit into a standard checkbook. They are staple bound and made for the basic function for which they are designed. They are exactly what you expect, and the price is low, which earns this product a high rating from me.

title: Helps Kids Stretch their Vocabulary
text:
Young people often get stuck in a rut with words. They tend to keep using the same words over and over and the habit is often difficult to break. Sometimes, all it takes is the introduction of different, similar words and this is exactly the encouragement your students will get with these synonym posters from Gethelud.

This set includes two posters loaded with words and synonym alternatives. Each poster has eighteen different words with eight synonym alternatives for each. The bright colors on each board make them attractive to young viewers and the alternative word options will hopefully get them thinking about new, and often more creative ways to say the same thing.

As for the posters, they are laminated, which is nice, and they do have educational value. My only concern is that the posters are not very large. A kid will have to stand close to be able to read the words. Therefore it’s best to place these in a part of a room where kids are likely to get close to them and read them, like a bulletin board that already includes other popular stuff that kids like to see and read.

We could all benefit from a broader vocabulary. This pair of posters from Gethelud is a nice addition to an elementary school classroom and it does serve a purpose: Helping kids learn alternative ways to say things. Adults can benefit from it, too, so don’t be surprised if you learn a few new words as well.

title: Motivational Sayings Can Make a Difference
text:
Children can benefit from receiving reminders when they do well and from receiving encouraging words when they have doubts. In a classroom setting, one easy way to achieve this is with posters and a possible choice for encouragement is this Growth Mindset Posters Bulletin Board Set from Tenare.

This set contains small, individual sayings intended to motivate kids. They are made from carboard and can be placed on walls, chalkboards, or any place else where kids can view them and, hopefully, be encouraged by what they read. There are two pieces shaped like halves of a human brain, a rectangular piece, plus individual words and short sayings, separated into two subgroups: Fixed and Growth. The Fixed have to do with fixed mindsets; the growth have to do with ways to change or improve.

One issue I have with this set is that some of the statements are negative. I understand that the whole idea is to get kids to realize that these negative thoughts can be changed through growth. But if you’re working with kids who are under performing, they may already be thinking those things and certainly don’t need to hear it or see it permanently displayed on a wall. If they’re not thinking these negative thoughts, then I think it is best not to plant the seed.

So, to make the set best, I recommend using only the positive ones. The colors on both definitely brighten up the room and if you stick with the positive statements of encouragement, the desired outcome will be achieved. Yes, these are just sayings but sometimes, this is all you need to get children to do better.

Statements of encouragement can motivate children and this Growth Mindset Posters Bulletin Board Set is generally good overall. I don’t like the negative sayings, but the positive ones are nice and they do look good on the classroom walls.

title: Adds a Colorful Touch to Any Classroom
text:
Classrooms need something to make them a little more snazzy and this is especially true when said classroom is occupied by young children. They like things that are colorful and most of them will love this Self Adhesive Bulletin Board Border Confetti Border Classroom Decoration from Miayon.

You get two sets of border in this package: One with a straight, squared off edge; one with a wavy edge. It is self- stick, so you don’t need any adhesive, tacks, or staples. Just unroll, cut to the size you wish, and place it on the walls of your classroom or any other room where a little color is needed.

Certainly the best feature of this border decoration is its color. It has all o the primary and secondary colors and it sports a festive look, like it was intended for parties. The kids like the wavy one best, but the straight one is better when you want to create a frame around other wall stickers. And while it is self- stick, you can still go ahead and use it on a bulletin board, but you will need staples, since the adhesive doesn’t stick very well to this type of board.

Adding color makes a difference. This border classroom décor is a great choice for those who want to turn a boring wall space into something more eye- catching. It’s a good choice for classrooms and other places where a colorful wall border is needed.

title: See Through Acrylic Looks Cool
text:
Staplers are an office essential. Even though electronic means of communication have reduced the need for paper, it still hasn’t gone away and a stapler is necessary to keep sheets of paper attached. If you want a stapler that looks different from the usual, a good option is this Acrylic Desktop Stapler from Noger.

The most interesting feature of this stapler is the fact that is acrylic. You can see right through the casing and that means it matches well with my computer monitor stand, which also happens to be acrylic. The springs and other internal parts are in open view and the novelty alone will make this stapler appealing to many. It even comes with a set of 1000 staples, paper clips, and binder clips. Mine are all in rose gold color, which is cute and interesting.

This stapler works as expected and it has no trouble attaching paper and even cardboard, as long as you don’t have too many sheets. It’s a little smaller than others I have used, but not so small that you can’t use it with ease. The one problem I have with this stapler, that prevents me from giving it the highest rating, is that it offers no way to use it for tacking. With most staplers, you can press a tab on the bottom and release the top part of the stapler, which means you can then use to tack paper to a bulletin board. There is no way to do that with this stapler, which is a problem.

Staplers are important for any office, whether work or school. I like the acrylic design of this stapler and its mechanical functionality works well. No, you can’t use it to attach paper to a bulletin board and thus I can’t award it five stars. But it does have enough other positive qualities to earn a four star rating and a recommendation.

title: Keeps Desktops Organized and Looks Sharp
text:
I like to keep my workspace organized. This is true whether I am at work or at home and the best way to keep pens, pencils, etc organized and within quick reach is with a desktop container of some sort. Most of these are simple, round holders intended for writing utensils and little else, but if you want something more, a good choice is this supply organizer from PATILWON.

This organizer looks sharp on any desktop. The black mesh design matches with most any décor and I like that I can see through, because it makes it easy to spot what you want without having to dig around. If something is short, for example, it wouldn’t otherwise be visible but with this design, I can see at a glance what items are in which compartment, so I know where to reach.

Another reason to like this organizer is the different size compartments. There are wide compartments for, say, storing notepads, and tall narrower compartments designed for pens and pencils. There are shallow compartments, too, and even a small, pull- out draw for placing tacks, paper clips, etc.

With its non- skid base, this organizer is designed to stay in place and not slide around the desktop. Its metal construction is also good because that makes it durable. In summary, PATILWON has created something beyond the basic that is quite excellent with this desktop organizer, which earns an easy five stars from me.

title: Keep Track of Things the Old Fashioned Way
text:
Everything seems to have gone the way of digitization. Calendars and planning are no exception, but I still like traditional planners and I still use them regularly. My other family members feel the same way and I was happy to add this Wisefine Weekly and Monthly Planner to our collection.

I got this planner for my teenager since she told me she wanted a planner for tracking classes, appointments, assignments due, and the like. She likes the layout of the planner and likes that it is double- spiral bound because it makes the pages easy to turn. The fact that it covers 17 months is nice, too, because it is good all the way through the end of next year.

The pages in this planner are thick and with the double spiral binding, they won’t easily get frayed or torn. You can tear out pages if you like, but it takes a good yank. And the added stickers are fun, too. They let you personalize different days of the week/month. And my teenager likes the blank note pages because they are useful for journaling and other miscellaneous needs.

Electronics have taken over our lives. With calendars and planning, I still prefer the paper version and this planner from Wisefine is an excellent one for most any individual. It helps you track events, dates, assignments, your budget and much more and with 17 months of pages, it will keep you covered for a good long time.

title: Helps Keep the Family Organized
text:
Staying organized is important but it gets increasingly difficult when you have a family with different activities and engagements from day to day. The best way to keep track of who is doing what is with a calendar positioned where everyone can see it, every day. And this is why the AFAN Dry Erase Magnetic Calendar set works so well for me.

Included in this package are five different magnetic calendars. They are small in size, but large enough to jot down a few quick notes with the dry erase markers. The set has six such markers, each with a small magnet so that you can attach them directly to the refrigerator. There is a small, magnetic eraser, too.

Most people won’t have any need or space on the fridge for all five of these. I normally use two of them: One of the monthly calendars and the weekly calendar. By utilizing these two, we can make notes of upcoming events for the month, and then track weekly events with greater detail. Every week, I erase the weekly calendar and update it for the week ahead.

These boards do not all remain flat against the refrigerator. They arrived a little wrinkled and I cannot get them to stay flat. It’s a minor issue- they are still good enough and the fact that they don’t lie flush doesn’t impact writing on them.

It’s good to have a way to keep track of family activities. It’s important to keep such a system in a place that is highly visible, and the outside of a refrigerator is the ideal place. This set of magnetic calendars from AFAN is highly useful for this purpose and other than a few cosmetic issues, it is a good set and one I will continue to use.

title: Not a Monthly Calendar, Too Small
text:
With so many things to keep track of, I like having calendars and planners nearby. It’s also useful when there is a central calendar that everyone in the family can see and my desire for such a calendar led me to get this magnetic dry erase calendar for my refrigerator.

When I first received this and looked at the calendar, I wasn’t pleased because it wasn’t what I was expecting to get. The page shows an actual calendar, complete with squares for each day of the month. This calendar is really a weekly calendar so I don’t know why they refer to it as a monthly calendar. Another issue is that the package contained only one marker when there are supposed to be three.

Moving right along, I thought I would try this out anyway, even though it isn’t what I wanted. But I quickly discovered that it doesn’t hold itself flat against my refrigerator. Parts of it curl/buckle up, which doesn’t look good and makes it more difficult to write on the board. It’s too small, too!

I still like being organized and alert to what is going on and I still like the idea of a refrigerator calendar. But this one isn’t the answer to my needs and its various flaws make it a product to avoid.

title: Can Barely See the Marks, Hard to Wipe Off
text:
With whiteboards in classrooms, business spaces, and homes across the nation and the world, you need a good set of colorful markers to write words, draw objects, etc. There are many fine options out there, but one that is less than satisfactory is Green Piece Safe Expressions Chalk Markers.

These markers come complete with a set of eight different colors, which includes all the primary and secondary colors, plus white and pink. The colors you need, for basic use, are all here. The problem is that the colors don’t appear very well on a whiteboard. Even with added pressure and effort, there is almost nothing you can visibly see.

Another issue I have with these markers is that the marks are not easy to wipe off completely. With other, dry erase markers, a whiteboard eraser does the trick. With these, I had to use spray cleaner and a paper towel to remove the marks.

I did find that these worked better on a blackboard. However, they don’t work well on a whiteboard which is primarily the reason I got them. The limited usefulness and problem with cleaning earn these chalk markers a below average rating and non- recommendation.

title: Keep Your Hardwood Floor Looking its Best
text:
When you have an office chair that rolls, you need something underneath it to protect it from damaging the surface on which it moves. This is especially the case when that surface happens to be a hardwood floor and recognizing the damage my office chair was doing, I was happy to add the Teamkio Office Chair Mat to my home office.

Measuring about 3 feet by 4 feet, this rectangular mat is flat on both sides. It provides a smooth surface to roll your office chair and not worry about floor damage from the constant pressure and contact with the wheels of your chair. The surface is free from bumps and thus my chair glades across it with ease. I have a hardwood floor and I find that my chair glides almost as well across this surface as it does on my actual floor. And you don’t need to worry as much about slipping- the surface of this mat has just the slightest amount of friction so that you chair doesn’t slide too quickly.

Mats generally aren’t something we think of as decorative, but this mat does have a pattern of small, checkered squares. It isn’t much, but it does look better than a plain, clear plastic mat with no patterns. One thing you will need to work with is the tendency of the mat to roll up on the edges. When you remove it from its long, narrow box, be sure to unroll it the opposite way, release, then do this again. That should be enough to flatten it out, but I found that I needed to use it a little bit and moll may chair over the edges before it laid completely flat.

Hardwood floors and other surfaces need protection from office chairs and Teamkio Office Chair Mat protects as promised. My floor was already starting to show signs of wear. I wish I had invested in a mat such as this much sooner, but I can feel comforted knowing that my floor is protected, and protected well, from this point forward.

title: Helps Keep Things Organized
text:
Organization is a must. Anything that can help make it easier to keep track of things through sorting or better display is a plus. And this folder magazine rack from Fazapor is ready to help you organize better.

Plastic in construction, this rack has three sections and it comes unassembled. It takes no time at all to put the pieces together and it can be figured out just by looking at it. You slide together the front, base, back, and dividers and you’re ready to go.

This magazine rack is quite sturdy and made to hold and organize magazines, folders, or pretty much anything else that is shaped like these items. The three sections mean you can sort different items and keep them grouped. For example, one section could be used for folders, one for magazines, and the other for legal pads or something of similar shape.

This rack is easy enough to clean and the off- white color makes it neutral to most office spaces. I’m not so sure I like the way it looks, with the hole design. I can think of other, more attractive ways to construct something like this. But besides that, this magazine/folder rack from Fazapor is a good, convenient way to keep items organized and it will help clean up desk clutter.

title: Helps You Keep Track of Your Yearly Schedule
text:
I’m all for modern technology, but there are some things that I prefer to use in the traditional way. One is a planner. I don’t really like electronic planners- I still prefer the book variety that you can hold in your hand and write inside, with a pen or pencil. My new, traditional planner for this new year is this 2021 planner by D DMaxia.

Most modern planners are much more than places to track what happens each day and this planner certainly follows these trends. It has extras like a place to write down useful phone numbers; account passwords; thoughts and plans; etc. Between each month, there are pages to track your budget, income, and cash outflow. Plus, there are several blank pages at the end of the planner to write anything you like.

The section of this planner- or any planner- that I use most is the actual days. You get a full month calendar for each month, which covers two pages, along with nine or ten pages per month with additional space to write down what you need to do on each day. With this much space, you should have all the room you need to write down appointments, events, meetings, and what not. I am confident that I will not run out of space with this planner. There is more than enough paper to write down everything I need to track. Oh, and I like the box it comes in- it makes this a nice gift idea.

This planner comes with a pen and an attached loop to hold it in place. There is even a magnetic strap to keep it closed. The floral design on the front may not be to everyone’s liking and I do wish the print on each page was a little darker. But overall, this is a good planner and it should suit my needs well over the coming 2021 year.

title: Helps you Keep Organized
text:
I like to jot down the things I need to do. I make a to- do list almost every single day and I do this because I often have too many things to do to remember them all. My desire to have a more organized to do list led me to get this Daily To Do List Notepad, from Oneirom.

This to do list is larger than the usual post- it- note that I use to list out my activities, necessities, etc. It has sections for To Do, Today’s Priorities, Schedule by the hour, Notes and Ideas, and Do Some Things to Enjoy Life. There is even a section to check off boxes each time you drink a glass of water and a few lines to write down what you eat for each meal. This goes above and beyond the typical to do list and I like that there is space to write down so many things.

The hourly schedule on this list includes only 6am to 9pm, so you may need to adjust things a little if you need to plan for the hours before or after. There is no date at the top of this list- only a blank space to write in the date and a place to the right where you can circle which day of the week you are scheduling for. There is even a large magnet on the back so that you can place this on the fridge, where you can easily see it.

I like keeping my schedule organized and this To Do list is good for that reason. If I could change anything, it would be the actual to do list: It only has 8 lines, which, depending on the day of the week, isn’t nearly enough to list all of the things I need to do. I find myself using the Notes and Ideas section as an extension of my to do list, because I need more space. Another thing I wish was different is the number of pages- only 52 per pad. If you use a fresh sheet each day, it won’t even last two months. I find that I use it only when I really need it, to make it last.

I’m a list maker, without question. I like keeping track of things, so I don’t forget and the Daily To Do List Notepad from Oneirom is good for this purpose. It’s not perfect, but it is more than good enough to suit most needs and it certainly beats the post- it- note I normally use.

title: Easy to Use Tape Dispenser
text:
Tape is one of those things that every household needs. It’s essential for a home or work office, but it is also useful for other people/places and uses. You could go with the ready- made dispenser with a small roll of tape that you discard after a single use, or you could get a permanent desktop dispenser, like the Scotch Desktop Tape Dispenser, 3 pack.

What I like best about a desktop tape dispenser is that it can hold more tape and this dispenser from Scotch can hold quite a bit- up to 1500 inches of tape, to be exact. That’s a lot of tape, and it will last a long time. You need to buy individual rolls of tape for this purpose, but that’s okay. The tape lasts longer and since you’re not purchasing a disposable dispenser, you create less waste.

The other quality that I like about this dispenser is its weight. It is heavy enough to remain in place, on a desktop, so that you can pull off a piece of tape and tear it with one hand. The base is also made not to skid and since you get three dispensers per package, you can add this to different desktops or countertops throughout your house.

Tape is a household essential and will likely never go out of style or get replaced by technology. It makes sense to make tape dispensing as convenient as possible and the Scotch Desktop Tape Dispenser 3 pack does exactly that. It works as promised and with the Scotch name on the package, you really can’t go wrong.

title: Great Organizers for Students of All Ages
text:
Among the most basic supply items for school- age and college- age people are folders. There isn’t as much paper as in the past, but there is still some and there needs to be a way to organize by subject. And a good way to accomplish this is with SPON Plastic Pocket Folders with Metal Prongs Fastener Clasps.

With this set of folders, you get a total of six in assorted colors. Different colors are nice because it makes it easy to distinguish one subject from the next- you will know just by reaching for the color you chose for that subject. Red, green, orange, pink, blue, and purple folders comprise the set and since there are six, it should be enough for most students, as they can handle 6 different subjects.

The center of each folder has three metal clasps for holding loose- leaf paper. This is good for taking notes- you just load the paper in this section and treat it like the pages of a book. It’s a little more trouble to remove the paper because, of course, you have to unfasten each clasp and then refasten, which takes time. But that is what you expect with this type of paper holding mechanism, which is why it is best to use it for taking notes or other tasks that don’t require removing any paper. And for paper that you need to store and grab quickly, you have the two pocket folders for storage.

The best quality of these folders is that they are made with plastic as opposed to cardboard. Since they are plastic, you don’t need to worry about having them tear. This is an issue with the cheaper, cardboard pocket folders. There is no such problem here. Young kids will also like that they can decorate the folders with stickers and, depending on the quality of the sticker, they can easily remove them. So, when all factors are considered, SPON Plastic Pocket Folders with Metal Prongs Fastener Clasps are an exceptionally good product and great for students of all ages.

title: Keeps Papers Organized
text:
If you have work that needs to be stored in a three- ring style binder and organized, then you likely need a way to keep the paper separated into sections. This is where binder dividers are handy and a good choice for the task is AmazonBasics 5 tab Plastic Binder Dividers.

These plastic dividers are typical of this type of item. They are made for use in 3- ring binders and are good for separating sheets of paper into specific sections. They are multi- colored, which makes it easier to distinguish one from the other.

Speaking of the colors, one small issue I have is the choice of hues. There are two blue tabs and they are a little too similar in shade. It would have been better to have a different color for one of the blue tabs. Making one of them red would do the trick. With colored tabs, more contrast is better.

I use three ring binders and having a simple way to sort/organize items is valuable. The AmazonBasics 5 tab Plastic Binder Dividers is a sufficient item for the task at hand. They work as intended and are good enough for most needs.

title: Helps Motivate Kids
text:
When you teach a classroom full of young people, you need to do what you can to motivate them. Rewards and direct recognition are best, but it also helps to remind the students to achieve their best. And one good way is by using this set of 11 Motivational Classroom Banner Poster Decorations.

These posters are large in size, but not too large. They measure about 40 inches wide and 14 inches tall. Each one contains an inspirational, motivational message on one side and the name of a month of the year on the other. With the months, you just need to flip the appropriate poster around when its time comes around, display it for the duration, then flip it back the other way to display the message when it’s time to move on to the next month. There are 11 months- the only one without a display is July, and that is because the typical school isn’t in session in July.

The month side of each of these posters is colorful while the message side is like that of a blackboard. The posters look nice on the walls or boards of a classroom. It’s best to display the messages at an angle, as they seem to get attention better that way and students are more apt to look at them. My wife says that the kiddos do look at these posters and make comments on them, so they do have an effect.

Young people need motivation and sometimes, a simple message is all it takes. This set of 11 posters from Global Printed Products is high in quality and achieves its intended goal, which is to encourage kids to be the best they can be. It’s an excellent set of posters that belongs in every elementary school classroom.

title: Keeps Young People Motivated
text:
If you teach young people, you are likely in need of some type of reward system. I have only taught adults, but my wife teaches elementary school age kids and she needs to track and reward students. This was the perfect excuse to get my hands on ONEDONE Punch Cards 100 Pack.

Round in shape and ten centimeters in diameter, these cute cards have simple sayings and illustrations plus a total of 21 places to punch. They encourage kids to ‘don’t stop believing’ as they strive to reach goals. On the back, there is a place to write the students name and the reward they are going to receive. Oh, and the set comes complete with a hole punch, so you have everything you need to get started.

With 21 places for punching, you need to make sure to use these cards only for appropriate situations. I say that because 21 is a lot, especially for often impatient youngsters. They will likely not want to wait that long. But if there are things that happen relatively quickly, these cards will work fine. My wife likes to use them for assignment completions- there are usually multiple assignments due each day so reaching 21 punches won’t take much longer than a week.

It’s important to give kids incentives to complete chores, assignments, etc. ONEDONE Punch Cards 100 Pack are a cute way to keep young people motivated. It would be nice of the inspirational messages were more varied, but this is still an especially useful set of punch cards and an invaluable aid for the dedicated teacher.

title: Organize Your Business or Home Office
text:
No matter how advanced your use of technology may be, you still need to use paper from time to time. You also need a way to keep this paper organized and an organizational tool found in most any company is hanging folders. AmazonBasics Hanging File Folders, Letter Size, Standard Green are prefect for the job.

These folders are just like most hanging folders. They are letter size and are intended to hold standard 8.5 by 11- inch sheets. The green color reminds me of the hanging folders I first used when I entered the work force three decades ago. They make me feel a little nostalgic.

With 75 folders per package, you have what you need to organize lots of paper. You also have plastic tabs and small, rectangular pieces on which to write titles, for organizational purposes. You have all the tools you need to better organization, short of the file cabinet in which to hold them.

Technology keeps advancing but no matter how far it moves along, we still need to use paper from time to time. We still need ways to organize all those sheets and AmazonBasics Hanging File Folders are an excellent means to an end. You have everything you need and with 75 folders, you should be able to organize your entire business office or home with a single package.

title: Magnetic, Build in Erasers, and More
text:
Making quick notes on an erasable board almost always involves dry erase markers and a white board. The days of chalk are pretty much over and the need for dry erase markers of different sizes and colors led me to get this 10 pack of dry erase markers from ZSCM Quality Decides the Future.

With this set of markers, you get a pack of 10 with lots of color options for different needs/uses. The tips of the markers are thin, so they are good for making narrow lines. There is little odor, too, which is always a plus.

Two qualities that make these dry erase makers better than most are the magnetic feature and the eraser. The magnet is small and thus doesn’t have much pulling power, but the marker is light and therefore it doesn’t take much to hold them in place. They stay on my white board with no issues. The other thing I like is that each marker has an eraser on the cap. This makes it easy to quickly erase because the eraser is right there. You don’t need to go looking for one.

These markers have a fine tip and while you can hold them at an angle and get a wider line, they are really intended for narrow lines. And that is fine by me, since I already have thicker, broad- tipped dry erase markers. Add up everything and you have a set of dry erase markers that make a great addition to your home or school.

title: Handles Lots of Paper
text:
I’ve been going through a good number of office supplies lately, writing reviews on a few more luxury- oriented supplies but writing mostly about office supplies that almost all of us use on a regular basis. One of the necessities for anyone who works with paper is a stapler and a good choice if you need a one is the AmazonBasics Heavy Duty Stapler.

This stapler is larger than most and it features a push- down handle/lever for greater force. Probably the feature that sets it apart from the typical desktop stapler is the fact that it can handle so much paper at once. With most staplers, there simply isn’t enough clearance between the handle and base to cram a large number of sheets. With this stapler, you can easily fit a thick wad of paper for stapling purposes.

Staples are loaded in this stapler through the front. You just push a button and it pops open in front, waiting for you to load the staples. It comes with staples, which is cool because you have everything you need to get started.

Another thing I like about the AmazonBasics Heavy Duty Stapler is the weight and non- skid construction. You can load up the paper, press the lever, and not worry that the stapler will slide. It holds its own, so you can easily use it with one hand on the lever and the other loading the paper.

The one issue I have with this stapler is that there is no release mechanism for tacking. With traditional desktop staplers, you can press a button- usually underneath- to release the handle. You can then use the stapler to staple on a bulletin board. This stapler doesn’t have this feature.

Almost everyone needs a stapler and if you are looking for one that can handle a good deal of paper, staple with strong force, and hold itself in place while you use it, then you will like the AmazonBasics Heavy Duty Stapler. It can’t be used for bulletin board tacking, but it has everything else you need to attach sheets of paper together with ease.

title: Good for School or Office Use
text:
There are certain office supplies that are so basic, most anyone will find them useful and often necessary. The category of index cards is certainly one of them and therefore I was happy to get my hands on a package of AmazonBasics Ruled Index Cards.

These cards are blank on one side and ruled on the other side. The ruled side is the one most people will use- the lines make it easy to jot down recipes or other things, for easy reading and reference. You could also use the blank side to create your own flash cards, with the answers written on the opposite, ruled side. The cards are light and with a package of 1000, you should have enough to last a long time.

These cards are 4 x 6 in size, so be sure you have an appropriately- sized container to hold them. Many index card boxes are smaller and intended for 3x5 cards. I prefer the larger 4 x 6 cards because they are easier to handle and provide more space on which to write.

No matter what your need, for school or professional use, index cards are almost always a good item to have. This set of AmazonBasics Ruled Index Cards are as good as any and will easily fulfill your index, note- taking needs.

title: Great for Desktops and Cool Color
text:
Staying organized is important when you have a desk job. Yes, electronic documentation has changed the face of things, but paper still exists and always will so you need a way to keep things organized and within quick reach. A good way to do this is with the Rose Gold Desk Organizer, ProAid Desktop File Tray Organizer.

Taken from the box, this organizer requires a small amount of assembly. It can be completed in about five minutes and while there are instructions, it is easy to figure out. Once assembled, you will find that this organizer is durable and attractive. Its rose gold color makes it look different from other, similar organizers, most of which are either silver colored, black, or white.

This organizer is great for sorting many different things. It has three shelves and a vertical compartment in the back, perfect for folders and other things that are best stored upright. The back is about 9.5 inches tall, so a standard letter size document can be placed here with no problem.

Most people who purchase this will get it for paper and folders, but you can also place books on the shelves and small office aides like staplers and other things. If you have something that is thick, like a large book, you can remove the middle shelf, creating a larger space.

Desk work is a part of life for many of us and we need ways to keep things organized. With 4 Independent Compartments, the ProAid Desktop File Organizer is perfect for your home or office. It helps keep things sorted on your desktop and the rose gold color is attractive and looks better than others.

title: Vibrant Colors and a Metal Storage Box
text:
Colored pencils are good for multiple uses, but they are especially handy for those who teach young people because they can be used for art and for marking papers with different hues that make it easy to distinguish one thing from another. A highly useful set of colored pencils is LOBKIN Colored Pencils.

There is a total of 24 pencils included in this set and they are all different colors. This is more variety than most and it is easily one of the standouts of this set. You can select among so many different shades for just the right accent. The pencils are soft tipped and sharpened with a standard hand or electric sharpener.

Another reason to like this set of colored pencils is the storage. With other pencil sets, you often get nothing more than a simple plastic sleeve in which to store. This set comes complete with a metal container, which is more durable and better overall. Pencils can easily have their tips break off when stored in plastic but there are no such worries with a metal box.

Colored pencils are useful for those who work with young people. My teacher wife needs and uses them regularly and she loves this set of colored pencils from LOBKIN. Twenty- four vibrant colors and a metal storage container earn this pencil set a top recommendation.

title: Keeps Pencils Sharp and Stores Them, Too
text:
Do you still use pencils? You know, the type that require grinding the tip from time to time to keep it sharp? Many people think traditional pencils are obsolete, but I still like them and therefore I need a way to keep them sharpened. And one very good tool for the job is the TGHCP Large Pencil Sharpener with Pencil Storage Holder.

Most electric pencil sharpeners I have owned have been compact and usually battery operated. This one is larger than average in size and it plugs in. The fact that it uses an electrical outlet is good for those who hate purchasing batteries, but it also means you need to have a convenient place to plug it in. Many people, sitting at a desk, won’t have an outlet that can be reached without the cord getting in the way. If you have easy access, then this sharpener is a good idea because there is no need to replace batteries.

One cool feature with this pencil sharpener is that it sharpens different size pencils. With lots of electric sharpeners, the opening is too small for anything larger than a standard number 2 pencil. But this sharpener can take on large pencils, which is a definite plus. The other cool feature is that it has a compartment to store your pencils. You can thus keep your sharpened, ready to use pencils right there, just a short reach away.

I still use pencils from time to time and I’m one of the few people I know who prefers traditional pencils to mechanical pencils. I need to keep my pencils sharp and the TGHCP Large Pencil Sharpener with Pencil Storage Holder takes care of my pencil sharpening needs. As long as you have a convenient electrical outlet nearby, you will find this pencil sharpener more than adequate.

title: Display your Badge in Style
text:
If you’re a student or employee of a company who needs to use an identity badge, you might go ahead and place it in your pocket. But if your badge needs to be openly on display, then you need a means to keep it out in the open and this is where a display/lanyard like the imeetu PU Leather Badge Holder, Vertical ID Card Case with Neck Lanyard can help.

Most cardholders and lanyards are simplistic and are really nothing more than a plastic case with a place for a single card/badge, with a light strap to attach and place around your neck. This card case/lanyard combo is much more. It is made with leather- like material for better durability and style and rather than a single slot, it has 2 front card slots, 3 back card slots, and a zippered compartment. You can store several IDs and even a few dollars in the zippered pocket if you like.

The clasp on this lanyard is more heavy duty than others and it is simple enough to attach and place around your neck. One slight issue I have noticed is that cards are a little more difficult to remove from the slots than they are from, say, my wallet compartments. But this is a minor issue, really, as it doesn’t distract from use and most people who get this will likely place only a couple of items in the slots anyway.

If you have to display a badge, you need a good means to meet this requirement and this Imeetu badge holder is very good for the task. It is much more multi- functional than other badge holders/lanyards and its leather construction and other factors make it stand out from other items in its product class.

title: Good Means to Thin Black Lines
text:
Technology has changed the way we write, but regardless of this progress, we still need writing utensils. If you’re looking for a fine- tipped ink pen in a convenient package with plenty of pens to go around, then you might like this set of Japanese Technical Gel Ink Pens.

Utilizing black, gel ink, this pack of 12 pens have a tiny, .35 millimeter tip, which means they produce very fine lines. The gel ink dries quickly and because so little ink is dispersed, it doesn’t smear. I would also assume that each pen lasts a while, but I haven’t had these long enough to know for certain.

The tube of these pens is clear and I like that fact because it means I can see the ink on the inside of the pen, thus I can monitor how much is left. The thin lines are good for multiple uses and while I use them for ordinary writing, they are also useful for artwork and other situations where thin, narrow lines are desired.

We still need ways to write the old-fashioned way and we likely always will need them. Japanese Technical Gel Ink Pens are a very good means to write thin, black lines and while I prefer a little thicker pen body for more comfortable gripping, these are still good pens overall.

title: Good for Open Organization of Paper and Mail
text:
Among the most basic of office supplies is office trays. If you deal with paper documents or receive mail, it’s handy to have trays to keep everything organized and one possible option is Newfield Studio Premium Front Load Tray, with Supports.

With this set, you get a pair of stackable trays with the opening in front for easy access. The trays are black and nicely polished, for a pleasing, stylish appearance that matches any décor. The rounded edges are nice because there are no pointy corners, thus no chance for the annoyance of hitting your skin against the point where the sides converge.

These trays come with four supports for stacking, but this is where the set of trays loses points in my book. The four supports are not attached. They merely rest between the trays. That means a good bump is all that is necessary to knock the top tray down. I am not sure why they made it this way, as this is definitely a design flaw.

Because of the problem with the supports, we have decided to use the trays unstacked and, in this way, they are fine. You could apply adhesive of some sort to hold them together, but that could be a permanent fix, which means they would be permanently stacked.

Paper and mail are still present in my office and a set of paper trays is good for open organization. Newfield Studio Premium Front Load Tray are okay for the task, but the issue with the supports convinces me to lower my overall rating.

title: Useful for Displaying Short Messages
text:
When you need to write down temporary messages, what do you use? Some people have chalkboards for this purpose and some people simply write the message on a small piece of paper and then tape it to a specific place. A better option is a dry erase board and a small solution to these types of situations is the Grope Magnetic Small Dry Erase White Board.

This dry erase board is foldable and is 16 by 12 inches in size. It comes complete with 8 different colored markers and 6 magnets. The magnetic board is useful for when you have a piece of paper or other marked documents that you want to display. The magnets aren’t super- strong, but they don’t need to be. They can easily hold a small note in place.

I like that this board is foldable because that means you can set it up on a table or any other flat surface. It can be used in the home to convey simple messages and it is also useful for teachers, to place on their desk. You will need to supply your own eraser or paper towel, but you will find that it does wipe clean with little effort. It has a handle on top, too, for easy transport and for hanging.

The Grope Magnetic Small Dry Erase White Board is promoted as something for kids and while young people will find it useful, it is useful for anyone who needs a space to write short messages. I like it and recommend it for teachers and households who want/need a way to write messages that change periodically.

title: Handy Means for Office Storage
text:
When you have things that need filed and no easy access to a file cabinet, you need something portable. You could try to use boxes, but there are better, affordable options out there and one is this Mesh File Folders Organizer Box.

This box is black, made from metal, and letter size. All you need to do when you remove it from the package is attach a few screws. You can’t use your fingers for this- you will need a Phillips screwdriver. But once assembled, it is ready to use and it takes little time.

The durability of this wire mesh box is its strongest plus, at least for me. It is made from metal so it is made to last. I also like the handles. It makes it easy to pick up the box and move it from place to place. And I like the mesh design because there are times when it is helpful to see through and see the contents of the box without lifting each item out of the box.

My office space has lots of things that need storage and my wife is an educator, so she has plenty to store. We need places to organize and store manila folders filled with documents and the Mesh File Folders Organizer Box is a useful tool for this task. It’s tough, attractive, and easy to carry, making it ideal for my needs.

title: Practical and Lots of Colors
text:
Post it notes are still necessary and practical for many uses. They can help bring something to a person’s attention and are good for organizing and other purposes. An excellent set of notes for these uses is Early Buy Sticky Notes.

These sticky notes are three inches square, so they are a good size for writing quick notes. I’m not a fan of the small sticky notes because they are too tiny to hold much text and they are often a challenge to grip and hold while you write. The 3 x 3 size is just right.

Probably my favorite quality of these sticky notes is the assorted colors. You get six bright colors and six more subtle colors. The different shades are useful for sorting things and they are great for young kids, many of whom often love having different color options. They are easy to peel off, too, and they have enough stickiness to stay in place as long as you need them to.

Sticky notes are a necessity in any office setting and Early Buy Sticky Notes are an excellent choice. The assorted colors, practical size, and other qualities make this a set of sticky notes perfect for school or family use.

title: Excellent Means to Organize Paper
text:
Teachers and other professionals need an assortment of organizational tools. Many documents are now delivered and stored electronically, but there are still plenty of important documents that are on paper and thus the need for traditional organizational tools still exists. This need was enough to convince me to get my hands on Dunwell Two Pocket Poly Folders.

These folders are the type that are used primarily for storing paper that has been pre- punched with a three- hole punch. You place the holes on the edge of your paper on the prongs, then you fasten. The paper in the center is thus like a book. The folders also have two side pockets for additional paper storage. The package comes with labels, too, so that you can easily identify what is what.

There are lots of folders that serve the same function as this Dunwell set, but I like these better than most for two big reasons: The durability and the storage capacity. The folders are made from plastic, so that means they won’t tear like paper/cardboard folders do. And the pockets and center have expansions, which means they can hold more paper than others. The official numbers are 50+ pages for each of the side pockets and 50+ pages for the center. That’s a lot more paper than you can fit into other, similar folders.

Most documents are stored electronically but the need for traditional storage and the usage of ordinary paper will likely never go away completely. We need ways to organize and Dunwell Two Pocket Poly Folders are excellent tools for this purpose. They hold lots of paper, don’t tear, and come with three labels that you can easily peel off without leaving any residue behind. I can’t really think of any way to improve this product, so it earns an easy 5 stars from me.

title: Plan Your School Year
text:
Electronic planners are commonplace now that we live in the information age. But there is still something to be said for a traditional planner; one that is physical with pages for writing appointments, tasks, deadlines, etc. For teachers, these traditional planners are valuable for organizing and a good one to own and use is the Teacher Planner 2020-2021.

With this planner, you get an organizational tool that covers a full 12 month span, but rather than a calendar year, it covers 12 months that are more in line with the school year: July 2020 through June 2021. Each month has a two- page spread with the days of the month presented in squares, with five lines on each for writing things down. In addition, since this is intended for teachers, there is also a weekly calendar that covers Monday through Friday, with a larger amount of space to write down more detailed descriptions of tasks. Flip through the pages a little more and you will find a 12- month calendar for 2020 and 2021, plus a list of holidays.

This planner is quite useful for teachers. My wife happens to be one, so I knew she would like this planner and find it helpful. She likes that each week of the school year has its own, two- page spread where she can write down appointments and organize due dates. This is cool, and since this does cover a school year, it can also be utilized by students.

Possibly the best feature of this planner is the fact that it is spiral bound. Too many planners I come across are constructed more like an actual book. And that means you can’t turn to a set of pages and have the planner lie open, with pages in easy view. These planners tend to want to close shut, just a like a book. But this planner is spiral bound and remains open to wherever you turn.

I use electronic calendars, but I still like traditional planners. They are great for taking with you wherever you go and it’s nice to write things down using a pen or pencil rather than typing things on a keyboard. It’s a handy, practical planner for teachers and students and it earns an easy recommendation.

title: Good for Small Hands
text:
Office supplies are a necessity and even though we don’t use as much paper as we once did, paper still hasn’t gone away completely and we still need a way to attach pieces of paper together. A stapler is the best and easiest means for this task and one possible option is the Staplers Office Small One Touch Stapler.

Compact in size, this stapler fits into small spaces so it’s easy to store. It uses standard staplers, so you don’t need to shop for anything special. It doesn’t hold as many staples as other, larger staples and that means it runs out more quickly and must be refilled more frequently.

The best feature of this stapler is that it requires less effort to use. You don’t need to push down hard with your hand- a softer touch is all it takes. Don’t get the wrong idea- it still requires pushing, just not as much effort as conventional staplers. I’ve used electronic staplers that truly are touch- activated, but this one isn’t quite like that. You still need to push.

Due to its small size, this stapler is best suited for young people. I like that it can hold up to 25 sheets of paper but the small size makes its use limited overall. I still think it has some good points to offer, but I can’t give it more than an average rating for the reasons stated above.

title: Helps Keep Track of Important Things to Do and Events
text:
With the busy lifestyles that many of us live, we need something to help us keep track of what needs to be done and when. There are electronic systems available, but I still like the paper variety and that was enough to convince me to get the Day Designer 2020 Planner.

Made for the 2020 year, Day Designer Planner is spiral bound and it starts off each month with a full calendar, showing all of the days on two pages. Next, there is a weekly calendar, with Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday on one side and Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday on the other. This is where you can jot down specific things that are on your schedule. There is a place at the top of the page where you can list the Top Three items of the week. And there are eight lines for each day of the week, which should be enough to list everything important. The planner even has a checkbox on each line where you can mark off as each item is finished.

I like planners that offer extras that go beyond the usual calendar and this planner does have extras. There is a section in the front where you can write down your goals for the year, design your mornings and evenings, etc, plus a few blank pages in the back to write down general notes. The planner wraps up with a listing of holidays for 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.

This planner is a little smaller and more compact than other planners, some of which are 8.5 by 11, which is the size of a regular notebook. But it’s not compact enough to fit into your pocket. It’s that middle size, which will be suitable for some people but not others. I like this size best. The larger planners take too much space and the smaller planners, while convenient in size, are too small to write down everything you need to write.

With its practical style, the Day Designer 2020 planner is good for someone like me who needs to track basic tasks and to- do items, but who doesn’t need anything extensive or sophisticated. It includes a bonus section for July through December 2019, so it can be utilized right away. I am using it right now and I like the results that I am seeing. It’s a good choice if you like traditional paper planners and don’t need anything fancy.

title: Helps You Stay Organized with a Personal Touch
text:
Do you like to keep your busy life organized? We certainly do in our house, or at least we try to. This desire for order has made planners essential and while there are some good online planners available, there is something that is still appealing about physical planners and this preference led me to get the Day Designer for Blue Sky 2019 Planner.

With this planner, you get a few extras up front. There is a place in the very front to put your personal information, a story about the planner and how it came to be, and blank pages where you can define your overall plan for the coming year; your specific goals to meet; a checklist for the year ahead; a and multi- page calendars for the last six months of 2018. These all lead into the actual planner and they help to make it more personalized.

Once you get past these introductory pages, the planner then launches into the 2019 year. Each section here contains a full calendar of the month on two pages, followed by a weekly planner for each week, which includes a large amount of space to write down appointments, events, etc. The end of the planner has several blank pages for note taking and a full calendar of holidays, both major and minor, showing the dates for each for 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022. The planner is spiral bound, with a plastic- coated front page to help prevent water damage. And each month has a small tab so that you can quickly go to that month with ease.

There are many things to like about this planner that go beyond the fact that it helps you plan and stay organized. The large size of the planner is nice because there is more space to write things. The floral pattern is cool and my wife loves the look. I also like the extra touches, like the place on the bottom of each of the weekly sections to summarize the “Top 3” of the week; a space for general weekly notes; and even a place to write down a weekly gratitude. There is an inspirational quote, too, and I like the small boxes next to each of the lines on the daily planner because it is perfect for checking things off as completed. These extras set this planner apart from others and make it attractive on multiple fronts. They help add to the planner’s personalization, which makes it more appealing.

Staying organized is important when you lead a busy, active life. The Day Designer for Blue Sky 2019 Planner is here to help you plan and organize your entire year and also keep track of important goals. It has everything I could ask for in a planner and easily earns my highest rating.

title: Canon Comes Through Again
text:
As much as technology has advanced, there are still some seemingly old- fashioned things we need and continue to use and one of them is printers. I still find that printing items, at least certain items, is preferable to viewing them on a screen and thus I still rely on ink printers to fulfill this need. And one printer up to the task is the Canon ImageClass.

I have owned many canon products in my day and I have found most them reliable and high quality. This printer continues my positive winning streak. Out of the box, it takes little time to set it up and once it gets going, it prints at a rapid pace, which makes it ideal for small businesses who need to print quickly. The paper tray holds up to 250 sheets, which is also a plus and more than other printers of this size.

This printer also functions as a scanner and copier. I have used the scanner function would good success, as the document came through clear and readable. I haven’t used the copy function yet, but there is no reason to suspect that it isn’t efficient and trouble- free. Most of what I print is word documents with words and no images. The printer seems to work fine for this task.

Canon ImageClass is reasonably compact in size, but if you need a printer to fit into a small space, this printer not work. Mine sits an open space on my desktop and it does fit, but there isn’t much remaining space on either side of it.

Canon ImageClass MF264dw is a quiet printer so don’t worry if you have dozens of sheets to print. You likely won’t even notice. It’s a good printer overall and one I’m glad to have in my home.

title: No More Ink Cartridges!
text:
Printers are still a household necessity. We don’t use them as much as in the past, but we still use them in my house, to print children’s homework and hard copies of personal documents for filing. And the Epson Workforce Printer is our new tool for this purpose.

We have one printer in our house already, but it’s hooked up in our home office and is used mainly by me and my wife. When the opportunity arose to get a new printer, it was not me but rather one of my daughters who quickly said she wanted one. It makes sense because she and her sister have assignments to print and they work mainly from their upstairs bedrooms. So, I went ahead and got myself this Epson printer and waited for its arrival.

Setting this printer up takes a little bit of time. You have to set up the software and fill the ink tanks. The cartridge- free ink is the main feature that attracted me to this printer, as I get tired of constantly replacing ink cartridges. I like that Epson includes the ink, with your purchase. You have everything you need to get up and running. The printer is lightweight and the set up will be over sooner than you know it.

Putting this printer to the test, we sent a few different documents and waited to see how it would perform. The sheets printed nicely, easy to read and with good colors. The paper compartment can hold about 150 sheets, so it should hold its own for a good amount of time, especially if you use your printer mainly in the home, like we do. Best of all, the ink lasts a LOT longer than that of ink cartridge printers. According to the manufacturer, the included ink is enough to print 14,000 black or 11,200 color sheets! Given our modest usage, this should last many years- hopefully, all the way to the day my kids finish high school. And you can see how much ink remains in the tanks by looking at the front of the printer- the ink level is visible at a glance, so there is no need to open the unit and check the levels.

Looking at the print quality and other aspects of this printer, I can find only one area where this Epson lags my other household printer, and that is with speed. If you have a large amount of printing to do- for example if you use this in your place of business- the printer could take longer than acceptable to complete a large batch. But the speed is fine for those with minimal printing needs.

Printing isn’t as necessary as it once was. Now, there are many things that can be read directly from a screen or barcodes than can be scanned directly from your cell phone, eliminating the need to print a hardcopy. But printing hasn’t gone out of style and since we still need to print, the Epson Workforce Printer is a good choice for the task. The long- lasting ink and elimination of cartridge purchases make this a printer everyone should consider.

title: Landline Phones Still Have Their Use
text:
Desk phones seem like they’re on the way toward obsolescence. With the popularity of cell phones and the convenience of wireless technology, why would anyone bother with a traditional desk phone? We felt like that in my house, but since our bundled phone/cable/internet service doesn’t charge any extra for a landline phone, we went ahead and accepted the fact that a landline phone could still have some usefulness. All we needed was an actual phone and that is when I decided to get the RCA U1000 Handset Telephone.

This phone has the capability to handle four lines and is really intended as a business office phone. I decided it was good for our needs and so far, it has worked out okay. There is little to do as far as setting it up. You just insert a few AAA batteries and you’re on your way.

The sound offered with this phone is clear and static- free and if you do decide to use it as a business office phone, you will like that it has its own built- in digital answering system with a separate mailbox for each extension. We don’t have any need for this feature, but it could be useful for those who need it.

Most aspects of this phone seem fine to me, even if it is a little more complicated than necessary for our needs. In retrospect, about the only issue I have with this phone is that it’s not cordless. However, this in no way affects my rating because I already knew that when I got the phone. Besides, we still don’t use the phone enough to matter. Our main reason for getting a landline phone is to have something the kids can use in case of an emergency.

Landline phones are not as common as they once were but I don’t think they will ever completely disappear. If your bundled service already includes a landline phone and phone number, then you might as well get yourself a landline phone. The RCA U1000 is a good phone for this purpose, there when you need it and ready to remind you what old- fashioned corded phones used to be like before wireless technology took over the world.

title: Make Your Mark with Inkjoy
text:
Writing utensils are a necessary component of every home or office. Yes, many things we used to write have been replaced with electronic versions but the need for old fashioned writing is still present. And Paper Mate InkJoy Retractable Ballpoint pens are a good, practical answer to this basic need.

These pens are narrow and comfortable to hold, with a gripping area so they don’t slip from your hands. There are more comfortable pens out there, but these are still good especially for the price. The clear middle section lets you see through, making the ink level visible. And the pens come with a tiny red cap on the tip that has to be removed for use.

Paper Mate Inkjoy pens are fine, 0.7 millimeter tipped pens. I actually prefer a little bit thicker lines when I write, but this is still sufficient for most needs. The ink runs smoothly, doesn’t leak, and doesn’t skip. So, again, it fits basic needs. And what I like most is that the pens feature a retractable design. I do NOT like pens that feature a pull off cap because it’s too easy to misplace the caps. Retractable are much better and the small, additional price you pay for this type of pen is easily worth it.

All pens are not created equally. Paper Mate InkJoy Retractable Ballpoint pens are not outstanding, but they do get the job done and there is no way anyone could possibly argue with the low price. Paper Mate sells these in multiple colors, too, so you can make the mark you want in the shade you desire. It’s all possible with Inkjoy, a good writing utensil from one of the most trusted names in penmanship.

title: Say Goodbye to Ink Cartridges!
text:
Printers are still a necessity. I don’t use them as much as I used to, and that’s mainly due to so many things that can now be done electronically and don’t require hard copies. But a printer is still needed at least some of the time and Epson Expression ET-2550 is a good one for the job.

What sets this printer apart from others I have owned and used is its ink. The system utilized here doesn’t need ink cartridges- you know, those things that always seem to run dry far too quickly and cost far too much to replace. Yes, here there are no cartridges, but rather an ink tank system that is filled with liquid ink. And you know if/when the ink is close to dry because you can visibly see the ink levels from the printer’s side. I think this feature alone is enough to convince potential buyers to take a look at this printer and I would bet Epson is thinking the same thing. Supposedly, a single ink fill- up is enough to print thousands of pages, which means it should last someone like me for the next five years or longer.

Looking at other features of this printer, it prints quickly and the pages look nice. I don’t have anything with extreme detail to put it to the test, but it seems like it would print just about anything well. It can’t print double sided, which is a shame because it would save paper. But it can do about anything else and the printing is quiet.

So, analyzing for something wrong, did I find anything? Well, I found the size of this printer a little larger than I prefer and I wasn’t able to set it up on my original choice of tables because of this. Then again, I don’t know if there would be a way to make it any more compact and still maintain its functionality. Oh, and potential buyers need to keep in mind that this printer has no fax capabilities. I have another machine I can use for faxing, so it doesn’t matter to me but those looking for a good all- in- one might rank the lack of fax as a deal breaker.

Printers aren’t needed as much as in the old days. Even for students, it’s common nowadays to send completed papers to teachers electronically, without the need for a printer. But printers are still not obsolete and every household needs at least one. This Epson printer is a good one for the job and while I would be a little hesitant to purchase a printer with this large of a price tag, it still makes economic sense for those who do an exceptionally large amount of printing and go through tons of ink.

title: Disney Characters Featured on a Quality Mechanical Pencil
text:
Do your kids love anything Disney? My girls are Disney fanatics and anything with popular Disney characters on the package makes it an instant hit with them. Naturally, they like the Paper Mate Mates Mechanical Pencil Disney and they were happy when the package arrived in the mail. They opened it quickly, divided the pencils between the two of them, and proceeded to write.

The Disney characters on these mechanical pencils add a degree of cuteness and likeability, but what about the actual quality of the pencils themselves? My girls told me they were good but knowing their bias, I had to find out for myself. And I have to agree with the kiddos- these are good mechanical pencils and are better than most. The first quality I like is the triangular body of the pencils. This is not only more comfortable between the fingers, it’s also nice because it prevents rolling. Round pencils tend to roll off of a table or whatever surface they are placed. These don’t roll so easily, and that keeps them from falling on the floor.

This set of pencils comes with a pack of replacement pencil leads and speaking of the lead, it is a little thicker than others. The added thickness means the leads are less likely to break and that means the refill package should last for a while. I like the two spare erasers also because, again, you are given what you need to make the pencils last longer than expected, without needing to make a special trip to the store for replacements/refills.

title: Updated: Just Need a Simple Mousepad with Some Wrist Support
text:
Very nice mouse pad, especially for the price. You can't really go wrong with this pad- it helps relieve pressure from your wrist so you're less likely to get hand cramps or have your hand fall asleep. It's a convenient size too so that it'll nicely fit on your desk without forcing you to make more room for it. The little bump out on the left of the pad aids in the natural movements of the mouse so you will be able to use your mouse without falling off of the pad. The bottom has a slightly sticky rubber to keep the pad in place on your desk but will not leave any residue. If you need a mousepad with some gel wrist support for a good cost, you won't be disappointed with this one. JETech has always come through with simple and cost effective products for people who need something and don't have specific demands- great for offices.

UPDATE: I've had this mousepad for longer than a year but with less than average use. Like other reviewers' pads it has come undone at the bottom with the gel coming out. I can no longer recommend this mousepad. It was really nice while it lasted, but I can't say it was for as long as I expected.

Luckily, all the pieces are labelled, so putting it together is a breeze and all you need is an Allen wrench which is included. It took me 15-20 minutes to get it put together.

The wheels lock, so the desk doesn't move and it's adjustable making it easy to use anywhere. The table has a bit of a wobble, but nothing egregious. The reason I docked a star is it looks like the sides fold down and they don't. It wasn't a deal breaker for me, but I did think it would be nicer if the sides did fold down. The top is big enough to fit my laptop and iPad side by side or a laptop and mouse.

title: Nice Little and I do mean Little Cart.
text:
I was looking for a cart for my bathroom that didn't have large spaces in the baskets/shelves so that I could actually store just about anything on any shelf. This fit the bill. I like the silver color and the baskets are mesh, so you can store anything from in the shelves. If you have a small or slim space, this will likely be a great solution.

Here's the thing, all the pictures make it look much taller than it really is, this is a relatively short cart - I'm not even sure my picture is really getting the true scale of how short it is. I encourage you to measure and make sure what you want to store and how you want to use it isn't decreased by the petite size of this cart.

Other than that, quite nice. It requires some assembly, it's not quite snap together, but it's not 2000 ikea pieces either, it was rather manageable.

title: Replacement ordered
text:
I ordered this shredder and have requested a replacement due to a slight problem with the basket. It does not align perfectly inside the case.

I have owned several Amazon shredders and like them very much. Unfortunately, my puppy chewed off the cord of my old shredder, so I needed to buy a new shredder.

When this item arrived, I noticed that it was hard to keep the basket inside the casing of the shredder. It was possible but just not as well made as the shredder that I was replacing, which was, I think, about three years old.

I like to use a basket because the mechanism of the shredder is fused inside the lid, so it is heavy and awkward to lift the lid to empty the shredder.

I could have kept the shredder and just taped the basket because the problem was not severe. However, I felt that a new item should be in mint condition at the time of purchase.

title: Good for storage of breakable items
text: I needed to box-up "all of my worldly goods" while the flooring, walls, ceiling, and cabinets on the first floor were repaired.  The items were moved to the second floor while the first floor was repaired -- about 2 mos.  I found that this bubble wrap was reasonably priced and perfect for the job.  I didn't ship any items and so can't comment on the effectiveness of this bubble wrap for shipping.  For storing china, dishes, glassware, and other fragile items, however, I found this item to be clean, easy to cut and shape, and affordable.  I wrapped everything downstairs and carried the boxes upstairs.  I depended heavily on this bubble wrap for the protection of fragile items and, so far, have been very pleased. Again, I did not wrap for shipping.  I wrapped lightly for storage.

Cards are cute but if you're looking for a set of 100% cats/kittens, this is NOT the holiday card set to buy.
