I had some problems getting a good barcode on my shipping label but you can google how to adjust the settings if need be. If you have the same issue, adjust the settings (I don't remember which ones) but adjust them and you'll get a clearer label that's very usable! I'm very happy with this label printer! No more printing shipping labels, cutting them out, and taping them to packages only to have the packages look ghetto afterward. This makes my packages look very professional!

title: Great value, work just fine
text: Tested a few of these and they all work great! For the quantity you get and the price point- you can't beat it! I've written a lot with these pens and had no problems at all!

title: Work flawlessly, great colors!
text: These work perfectly and the colors that come out of them are beautiful! I absolutely love these liquid highlighters as you can see when they're about empty and they're also fun to tilt back and forth if you're a person who loves to fidget with things at the desk as I do!  Great quality!

title: Very fancy printer! Easy to use!
text: This has way more settings and features than I ever needed but I absolutely love it for it's paper capacity and the fact that it has all of the features for if I ever do need them. We've tested it's many functions and everything on this has worked flawlessly! Very classy looking printer and it's extremely well built- definitely the best printer I've ever had! Prints flawlessly and doesn't take up too much space.

title: Nice pen set
text: The glass pens don't hold much ink on them is my only complaint. They look nice though and it's a fun little set. For what it is I think I'll use these for fun or put them on display or something. As calligraphy pens, they're kind of awful seeing as they hold so little ink. So if you want a really nice calligraphy pen, don't get this. If you want pens that are prettier and just go on a shelf then go with these.

title: Bags and bags for days! Great value.
text: Great value and lots and lots of bags for what you pay! They aren't paper thin either, they have a bit of thickness to them! For the price point I think these are fantastic.

title: This thing is amazing!
text:
SO first impressions are that it's kind of tall and big but we DID order a pro school sharpener so that's on us! I love this one for the fact it sharpens many different sizes. The one thing I wished we'd known was that it says not to use it with some of your more expensive colored pencils as it isn't made for them.

But that being said we LOVE this thing. It sharpens a pencil in like 2 seconds and makes it sharp! The best part? It's REALLY quiet! So if you're in a quiet office or in a classroom and don't want to have to yell over a loud sharpener then I would definitely say to get this!

I really can't think of anything bad to say about this, we really like it! They definitely did good on this and it has a very large capacity for pencil shavings.

title: Get this one!!
text:
We've gone thru several pencil sharpeners including others from Prismacolor and they kept breaking my Prismacolor pencil leads and eating up the pencils! But I got this one and used the side that sharpens them to make a smaller end and that was the trick! MUCH better now and not breaking all of our leads!!
**I've included a stock photo to show the kind of end I am talking about that you can get from this sharpener.

title: But the calendar layout is great.
text: The markers show up a lot lighter than in the pic.  They are almost indiscernible.  But the calendar layout is great.

title: Great Cards
text: Nice cards - larger than a lot of thank you cards.

title: Do NOT waste your money.
text: I put 2 on a small plastic LED light to mount inside my toolbox.  The light weighs maybe 8oz and even 2 magnets didn't even come close to holding the light to 2 magnets I adhered to my tool box lid.  Ridiculous.

title: Love this tape!
text: Best tape out there as you can easily pull it apart if it becomes tangled.

title: Cute stamp
text: Very cute little stamp.  It's about the size of a dime. Clear impressions so far.

title: Mediocre Quality - Good Concept
text: This could be an awesome book, except it is not traditionally bound. The inside contains several independent "books" , it is not like a regular book. The cover is separate from the pages, and the pages are contained within their own individual books. If I had known that, I would have found something else.

title: Good Gun
text: Works well, a tad smaller than expected. Loves to grab string, wire and other stuff which can be frustrating. I'd buy again if needed.

title: Good Folder
text: Worked well for our 10 year old daughter who beat this thing up really bad and still held together.

title: It's Ok
text: This is good double sided tape, however, it refuses to stick to new and clean outdoor paint on the side of a house. I am trying to attach a small dummy camera to the wood siding with fresh new paint, but it will only stick for about an hour then peel off. It sticks to the thin metal of the dummy cam, but not the fresh dry and warm paint facing the sun. It should stick really well, but does not. Have to nail the dummy camera now which I was trying to avoid.

title: Not Worth The Price
text: Got this and was shocked how cheap and flimsy the wood is. If it was any cheaper, it'd be balsa wood. This should be sold at a dollar store.

title: Ok but has issues
text: It's a decent printer. Was easy to set up. It likes to time out and disconnect from the wifi constantly, so have issues printing on the fly, which is not fun at all. Not too convenient, gets less stars because of that issue.

title: Nice Card
text: Great card!

title: Good
text: Great sharpener with sturdy construction.

title: Meh
text: These are ok. Write just OK and have a flimsy small feel to them.

title: Not Quality
text: Not good, leads break really easy. Won't buy again.

title: Good Stuff
text: Love these pens and how they roll/feel. Of course everyone is different but I think these are good.

title: Not so good
text: The pencil leads on these break much easier than other brands. I would not recommend these.

title: Good Stuff
text: Great for the whiteboard and works well with no smelliness.

title: Not the best
text: These do not work as well as hoped. The tip tends to clot and bleed over a little, especially when first using it at the start of your day.

title: Nice Chips
text: Not sure how to rate plastic chips but hey, they are nice and vibrant colors.Slightly smaller than I anticipated, about the size of a penny.  Choking hazard for smaller kids so be sure they get put away.

title: Won't Buy Any Other
text: These are great for the thin pages of a Bible. However, be careful with the darker colors, they will bleed a little bit but not enough to blot out the opposite page.

title: Great Clipboard
text: At first site and use, the door and hinge appear a tad weak and flimsy. Was skeptical for a while but it has been very durable and reliable. The last clipboard I had was purchased over 10 years ago, was heavy and bulky. I've come to appreciate the light weight and durability of this clipboard. A+

title: As advertised: helpful, easy to use
text:
This product is exactly as advertised, it is an address book with a small section of the back for website and password information. The cover isa nice material, it feels soft to the touch and there is a ribbon page holder to mark important pages. I do feel the proportion of address pages to password pages is a little skewed but I got it specifically for passwords over addresses. I doubt I’ll ever use all of the address pages in my lifetime.

The company logo/letters are embossed in the front, which is a nice touch, but also kind of funny because the letters feel really random.

title: Beautiful card
text: The photos don’t do this card justice. It is beautifully made and the paper feels thick and soft. It has lovely details with the stars that make this feel special. I gave this to my husband for our third wedding anniversary and he loved it.

title: Great for kids
text:
I want to preface my review, by pointing out that I use these for our clinic waiting room for pediatric therapy. Looking at these for that use I found these to be a great option, there are a lot of different colors and many of them are quite legible and vibrant and show up really really well. Some of the others don’t show up that great mostly the lighter ones in the yellowish greenish range and while that wasn’t a problem for us I can see where it could be a problem for somebody else.

So far these of held up well to almost daily use with toddlers through tweens and they haven’t fallen apart or dried out yet despite a couple having had a cap off for who knows how long. These are race just as well as our expo markers and they are easy to use you don’t have to spend a ton of time scrubbing. Overall we are happy with these!

title: Excellent quality with online software available
text:
We got this so we could use it for telehealth practice when helping children work at home with their parents and we are incredibly happy with the picture quality and camera quality of this scanner. The unit itself looks impressive and feels durable and sturdy. It was relatively easy to set up though my MacBook does not have a CD input so I was very happy to see that you can download the software directly from their website.

You do need to make sure things are relatively flat and legible if you are trying to scan photocopies of photocopies it might come out a little bit difficult to read. I did notice that it helps flatten some things scanned from books which is very helpful for scanning workbook pages from therapy books for families and clients.

This has a ton of practically uses from schooling and homework to scanning documents for business and commercial use. It is an excellent scanner that I think will hold up for a long time with consistent quality.

title: Small but work well
text: These are very light weight and easy to put up. They feel a little flimsy and are small. The size works well for cubicles and small home offices. If you put all four together then it would be nice for organizing brainstorming sessions or other visual idea activities.

title: Great for so many things
text:
These are an affordable option for brainstorming activities and meetings! I got these to help organize meeting ideas and points in a way that was little more exciting than the standard white ones.

We also use these with pediatric clients for different occupational therapy activities and obstacle courses and for speech sounds and games.

These are versatile and hold up well to almost daily use. They clean easily and are an excellent value for the price.

title: Nice colors, a little floppy
text: These are a nice set of dividers and I love the colors. They have a few edges that are a little sharp and they are a little floppy. They aren't as thick as others I have but I am happy with them for the price.

title: Beautiful card for anniversary, valentines, or just because
text:
This is a beautiful card. I have this to my husband as a “just because” thing and he loved it. The stars are lovely and this is such a sweet and well made card.

He loved it and keeps it in his nightstand drawer.

This card has nice detailing and feels expensive. Very good value for a sweet card.

title: Easy to install
text:
This was really easy to put up and helps us organize our incoming mail. It feels sturdy and has a cute little slot for a label. The hooks are small but work for keys or other smaller things easily.

So far it is holding up well to daily use for our household.

title: Easy to stay organized
text:
This is a great little organizer and planner. I like that it is fairly small so it doesn't take up a ton of room on my desk and it also includes a habit tracker on each page which I love!

The paper and print quality is nice and it is pleasant to look at at my workspace. I initially felt like it was too small as I was having to write much smaller than my last planner but after two weeks of use, I got accustomed to it and think I honestly prefer the smaller size so I'm not wasting as much paper or space at work.

title: Fantastic value.
text:
This is a fantastic value for SO MANY crayons. My 20 month old is obsessed with crayons and coloring so keeping a pack of these in my purse is required.

They color pretty smooth, though aren’t as vibrant as our Crayolas, they are much much more affordable. They also feel sturdier. My kiddo usually breaks crayons really quickly but these have held up well!

title: Easy to clean
text:
We have another one like this in our office that I like but this one I love. It comes with a bunch of extras like the letters and it erases easier and cleaner than the other one I have.

It feels sturdy and substantial. We use these with kids do having something that isn’t going to break immediately is a must. This fits the bill.

title: Cute and easy to use
text:
These are a fun alternative to a metal letter opener. Our pediatric office is forest themed so these fir right in and the shape is safer feeling than some of the dagger looking ones.

These feel sturdy and have worked great so far on envelopes and Amazon boxes. Good value for a 2 pack. Easy to hold and use.

title: Good size and easy to use
text:
I got this for my therapy office as maintaining a growth mindset is so important for my clients. This chart is a quick way to break it down. It is a type of reframing but these terms are used frequently in schools now so a lot of parents and kids are more familiar with it.

It doesn’t exactly fit in with my office’s decor so I don’t keep it up all the time, I just have it on hand to pull out and reference/go over with clients.

Overall, I’m pleased with it and isn’t has saved me from having to make our own resource for this.

title: Good document folder
text: This is a great document folder. I used it for office policies and it held everything nicely. The materials feel decent, though it is a little thinner than I expected it to be. I like the ivory coloring, it isn't too yellow, which some can be. The documents feel safe and secure in it. It is easy to use and add more pages in, if needed.

title: Quality glass dry erase board
text:
Overall, This is a great black dry erase board for neon markers and a black light!

It was not the greatest thing to mount as one of the anchors was collapsed upon arrival and it took us ages to find a match. Then one of the brackets went in crooked. The template they give you to mount it is just a large blank sheet of thin paper with nothing printed on it. We didn’t even use it, instead we held it up where we wanted it to go, made sure it was level, and used a marker in the four holes to mark where to drill in for the anchors.

It comes with anchors and screws, three tiny magnets, and caps to cover the screws.

We used this with neon Expo markers and a strip LED black light and it makes a great addition to the multi sensory room in our pediatric therapy practice!

title: Great idea and execution
text:
These are decent dividers for the price. We use these for clients PECs boards that we keep in binders. We flip to each child’s section and let them decorate it with how they are feeling each day and put notes on it for the parents to take a picture of and include in the daily notes.

I love the colors as they fit our company’s branding and look quite professional.

They feel durable and erase cleanly and easily without staining (we use the EXPO brand markers with great results)

These would also be great for use in a school as you could re use them for different subjects or classes.

title: Excellent pencil set
text: These are very fun and colorful! They work great and are a fantastic value for the price. You get a lot of pencils with lead in them for less than the big name brands. They work perfectly and are comfortable to use and hold. We haven’t had any issues with them jamming.

title: Sharp edges
text:
These look look cute and fit in well on my desk, though the wedges are pokey and sharp. Any time I try to move them I get jabbed. We have kids in our office daily and I had to move these up high so they are out of reach just in case.

I like the finish on them and the color. The lines are straight and none of the metal was bent or warped. I just wish they weren’t so dang sharp!

title: Decent but muted colors
text:
These are a great value for the number in this set and thickness of these cards. The colors are a little muted and not as nice looking as I had hoped but these do the job around our office.

These feel thick and sturdy and they are easy to write on. Overall pleased with them

title: Flimsy and won’t hold shape
text:
These went together okay though I had to fight one of them. It seems to have arrived warped and won’t sit flat.

I’ve put some heavy books in the bottom to try and straighten it out but so far it’s only helped a little (see picture to compare). One also appears to be bigger than the other which I hadn’t expected.

Overall, these are OK. They will go together and will physically hold something as long as nothing leans on the side. Not really a fan unfortunately.

title: Easy to install
text:
This is a pretty convenient chalkboard roll. I much prefer this to painting a wall if you’re in a rental.

Please note: as per the directions, it will not stick to a textured wall. It must be a smooth surface.

Knowing this, I still tried and it did not stick, fair enough. We then put it on a smooth surface and it stuck great! Almost too well!

It was a little tricky to get all of the bubbles out, I used a cricut tool to smooth it straight. It did peel off fine as I was readjusting it with no damage to the surface underneath.

Our chalk pens worked great on it! Overall pleased with this!

title: Nice set with bonuses
text:
I got these for our art room to hang kids artwork up to dry. They look nice but I had to hang them up with screws. These do come with several hook options to hang them up with but one of mine arrived broken. We have textured walls so I couldn’t use the sticky ones without damaging the walls. So screws it is. It doesn’t phase me that much to be honest and they feel sturdy up as is.

This set comes with two wall hangings PLUS fairy lights and two packs of wooden clothespins. I do wish they came with the metal clips as pictures but the clothespins are functional.

Overall happy with these and they work for what we needed them for.

title: Thin and inconsistent
text:
These are an okay set of “pin boards”. As described, they are a brown felt with adhesive, though they are much smaller than I had initially expected and quite thin. The pins don’t always stay in all of them and I had to be careful to make sure no pins fell out and were lying in wait on the ground.

I have since retired them as pin boards and instead use them for hanging kids artwork and decorations with Velcro which works much better.

title: Solid clear holders
text: These are lovely card holders! Getting a two pack is a nice value for the price. These feel substantial and the acrylic is nice and thick. They came right out of the box nice and shiny and very professional looking.

title: Nice quality sharpener
text:
This is a nice, slim little pencil sharpener. It has worked great daily for our colored pencils in our clinic’s art room! It is exactly as described and it looks pretty nice. It doesn’t take up much room and is surprisingly quiet.

It is easy to use and was a breeze to set up. It’s a pretty good price for the power and quality. You do have to be gentle with it, like any electric sharpener, you can’t just jam it in, let it do the work!

title: Beautiful chalkboard organizer
text:
This went up in less than 5 minutes with no assembly! We put it in our office reception area to store new client intake paperwork and questionnaires and it is the perfect size!

I think I would have preferred the antique finish over the warmer wood, but that is just my personal preference.

The chalkboard signs work great with our chalk markers and the hooks are ideal for extra key sets.

Really great little mail sorter or organizer!

title: Adorable and comfortable
text:
I got these for my office as I have a succulent theme and these are so cute and so comfortable. Following an ergonomic assessment I had, I found that I needed extra write support and this has made such a difference when I am on desk work all day.

They are also easy to clean thankfully if you spill a little tea on them.

They feel neat to press on and I often find myself fidgeting with them when on the phone because it’s sort of like a flat stress ball.

Very pleased!

title: Not actually mesh
text:
This is a nice value for the sheer number of pouches you get. They don’t feel all that durable so I’m a little worried about them holding up well over time. For now they are doing a great job storing art and craft supplies.

These are labeled as “mesh” but they are solid clear plastic with a mesh inside of it. You can see what is in it but I was initially wanting to use these to clean toys easier but there are no holes in these. Just solid plastic.

title: Adorable doorstop
text:
This is an adorable door stop! It isn’t super heavy so it doesn’t work for the front door of our office but it works great for individual offices with standard interior doors. Because it is weighed it is also great as a weighted fidget for some of our kids who have sensory needs.

The kids we work with love it and often give it little pats when they come in. Much cuter than a rubber wedge or commercial doorstop!

title: Bright dry erase marker set
text:
This is a great pack of colored dry erase markers! For the price, I was expecting some to be dried out or not have much pigment but I was wrong! These are quite vibrant and have a great range of colors. I’ve included a swatch of each color in my photos. There are 11 colors but two trays of them (22 markers in total). This is plenty of color options for us and having a “spare” of each color is nice.

These markers come with an attached eraser on them that works perfectly. It doesn’t smear the pigment and cleans our white boards in one swipe. There are also decently strong magnets on the caps for storing them. Overall we are really impressed with these and highly recommend them for your white board marking needs.

title: Adorable feeling poster!
text:
This is an incredibly high quality print on nice weight poster paper. I’m a family and play therapist and having a chart like this is not only a cute addition to my office space but it is a great tool for talking about different feelings and what they look like. Kids connect well with it so far.

It did take me a little hunting to find a frame that fit it well and looked nice in my office but this is a great poster and it is incredibly useful for teaching children how to imagine different emotions.

title: A beautiful, effort free take on guided journaling
text: These are an adorable option for guided journaling! The color and patterns on them are beautiful and look great on my nightstand. I tried using a bullet journal but I felt so overwhelmed by the formatting options and being sort of on my own with it. This is a great fit because it leads you through activities and exercises to track your fitness, mindfulness, and gratitude entries. I am also a family therapy graduate student and I highly recommend these for beginning journalers or those who wants some more structure. Journaling is a great way to process feelings, track patterns of behavior, and have something tangible to reflect back on.

title: "Magnetic" only with magnets that come with the board
text: I purchased this board for our pediatric clinic's sensory cave to use with our blacklight reactive dry erase markers and a set of magnetic blacklight gears. The markers worked well and glow decently under the light as other reviewers have mentioned, however, this board is hardly magnetic. None of the magnetic gears will stay on this board despite sticking to filing cabinets, baking sheets, etc. Thinking that maybe other magnets would work I tried it with our magnetic letters and words (the type you would place on a fridge), tiny magnetic stuffed animals, and a magnetic mirror (like the type used in kid's lockers) and none of them stick. Literally, the only magnets in our entire clinic that work are the ones that came with it. This greatly reduces its use for us and while it is a board and can be written on, a huge purpose of this purchase was the fact that it is described as magnetic. We would have been better off painting the wall with black colored whiteboard paint and saving the $50.

title: A great speech therapy tool
text: I bought this whisper phone for my husband (a speech pathologist) for use in our private practice. I really like the color though it is very, very light weight. While this is nice for small children, it almost felt too light weight. We will have to wait and see how sturdy it is.

title: Would buy again. Worked perfect for my sticker storage.
text: I got these to use as a divider for my ready to ship planner stickers. They work perfectly.

title: Amazing.
text:
My package arrived a day later than excepted but of course it has nothing to do with the shop. I quickly opened it and fell in love. It’s the perfect size. It feels amazing. I will be setting it up starting tomorrow to use as my work bullet journal. I will be ordering again.

11/16 Update:
- I started filling this bullet journal in for December. I must say I was shocked to see how thick the pages are compared to my usual planners and bullet journals. I used an erasable pen (heavenly pen I might add) and there is no ghosting, it erases well in this journal.

The pages are not white as you can clearly see. I’m using it for my planner sticker shop so I’m using my stickers in the journal. My handwriting is terrible so I like to utilize stickers to make it look decent.

The cover is soft for sturdy. My daughter says it feels so nice. (She’s 7). This would make a great gift for someone. It’s definitely affordable. I will be making a purchase again for it when I need it. :)

title: Super cute
text: This is super cute. Perfect for my daughters virtual learning this year. She is going to love it.

title: Transparent sides, Generous length
text:
This case has a couple of advantages over similar models. First, it is longer than most. It holds unsharpened pencils. I'm keeping my drawing pencils in it, and it even holds a set in a cardboard box (a long narrow box.) Second, the transparent textured plastic sides let me see what's inside quickly.

Made for students, it would hold everything from pencils and pens to protractors and even a calculator or a phone. The sides and bottom are a water-resistant synthetic canvas-like material and the nylon zipper is sturdy. It has loops on either end, so you could attach a strap, if desired.

This is a versatile, handy, generously sized case.

title: A beautiful set for draughtsmen, artists, and illustrators
text: This is a gorgeous set of professional mechanical drawing pencils. It includes a wide variety of graphite hardnesses in beautifully crafted metal holders. A generous supply of refills is also included, as is an eraser holder. The plastic case is sturdy and compact. This would make a much-appreciated gift for a designer, draughtsman, architect, illustrator, or fine artist.

title: Great erasers!
text:
These erasers pick up graphite without marring the surface of the support. The different shapes included in this set were obviously chosen by working draughtsmen, illustrators, and artists. They allow for broad or precision mark removal. There are enough in this set to use with a class, so it would be good for teachers too.

A thoughtful gift for anyone who works with pencils.

title: A well-made, practical file folder
text:
This file folder is an excellent way to file and store receipts, invoices, and other personal tax documents, if your finances are relatively simple. If you have a home business, it's probably not big enough.

It is also great for organizing research for a particular project, sketches, and other specific sets of papers. It's well-made, lightweight, and easy to store in a bookcase for ready access.

A handy addition to my home office.

title: A great deal!
text: These labels are just as easy to use as any others I've used in the past. The print quality from my aging inkjet is perfect and the adhesive is fine. If you use a lot of labels you'll appreciate the quantity. By the way, while they are great for envelopes, they are also good for marking boxes in your cupboards, closets, or fridge.

title: A great deal on photo mailers
text: These padded mailers are elegant in black. They are well-made and easy to use. Insert your photo print or another small item, add address labels, and seal. They are padded and relatively rigid without being heavy. You can add stiffening cardboard if you want, but most of the time, you won't need it. Nice!

title: For yourself or your boss, an elegant business card holder
text:
These business card holders are crafted to fit in with an elegant professional desk set. They are beautifully finished and well-designed.

They present cards in a very impressive way. Great for your new office, or as a gift for your boss.

title: this stuff is amazing
text: If you want to stick something smooth (not foam) to something hard (not painted) this is what you want. It really sticks and when you need to remove the object, it comes off. You can even use it again. Keep the roll in a plastic bag when not in use. It will stick to whatever you put it down on, like a shelf. You can get it off, but it's not easy. I attached sponge racks to the tile backsplash in my kitchen. Nothing else worked, but this did the trick! (Don't hang pictures on painted walls with this--they warn you--it will pull the paint off.)

title: A great way to send 5 x 7 or 4 x 6 photos
text: These sturdy specialized photo mailers have an easy-to-use adhesive flap. They are lightweight, yet strong enough to protect your prints en route. The bulk quantity makes them especially useful for mass submissions or commercial work.

title: Very Classy, Compact, and Sturdy
text:
Nice for any professional, this business card holder is designed to last a lifetime. It's simple, elegant, and practical. Thin enough for a pocket, sturdy enough for a purse, and easy to slip into a briefcase or backpack compartment.

A nice gift for a friend or boss.

title: VERY powerful!
text:
I used this to mount two sponge holders to a tile backsplash in my kitchen Nothing else had held before, but after I used pieces of this tape, the metal holders are still there, secure! (These are NOT for painted walls--they will pull the paint right off) Used as directed, this "tape" is amazing.
Note--keep the roll in the bag it comes in. If you put it down on a table the sides are sticky too and it will stick. You can get it up, but it won't be easy. (Learned the hard way.)

title: A generous roll of mounting tape
text:
Great for scrapbooking, cardmaking, poster making, and paper crafts, this generous roll of double stick tape goes a long way. I'm using it to mount original drawings on the faces of blank greeting cards. It would also hold photographs in place. It really holds, and the item isn't really removable.

It takes a little effort at first to figure out how to get the backing off, but every one of these tapes is a little different and that's always the case, at least for me. It does what I wanted it to do!

title: Simple, effective sign holder for a table or shelf
text: These are beautiful sign holders. Each holds one sheet of standard copy paper, so you can design your sign on your computer, print it with your inkjet or laser printer, and then slip it into the holder. The clear acrylic will make it look amazing. The only problem I had was removing the protective film from all of the plastic surfaces. Maybe there's an easy way, but I couldn't find it. It took a while. Great product though!

title: A beautifully made portable file
text:
This portable file is just about perfect. I needed something to sort and store my in-progress manuscripts and sketches. I have to many for most accordion files. A flat rigid bottom and foldover latched top allows this one to hold much more than the others I have tried. It is nicely finished with a handsome water-resistent exterior. It also has a sturdy plastic handle for easy carrying.

It's very versatile. I'm using it for writing and art, but it would also be good for keeping tax records together and sorted. Some files aren't big enough for everything you have to keep. This one is, and you can store it on a bookshelf, then carry it with you to the accountant's office.

I like it!

title: These are great table signs. Both sides show, but the bases are brittle
text:
I love these handsome sign-holders. Unlike similar models, they are two-sided making them perfect for tables in the middle of a room. One of them will show off my social media info at an upcoming art show in a local coffee house.
These sign-holders are nicely made and easy to use. A regular sheet of copy paper fits in them, so you can use any word processor to create your message.
I only have one caution. (This is the reason I subtracted a star.) Be careful with them when transporting. Though carefully packed, the black base of one of them broke in one corner. It is still usable and the package includes several, but I thought I should mention it. The base is substantial. It will not tip over, but the black plastic must be more brittle than it looks, either that, or it took an unfortunate blow en route.

title: Beautiful clean erasing
text: This is a wonderful electric eraser for artists and designers. It's easy to hold, easy to charge, and does a beautiful, clean job of erasing with little or no damage to the support. I love it.

title: Designed for junior and senior high school math students, but  useful for drawing
text:
Each of these handy heavy plastic guides comes in its own reusable clear plastic reclosable case. Cut out guides make it easy to draw cylinders and prisms of various sizes as well as triangles, rectangles and circles. If you want to use the turning circular section to draw anything, you will need a very sharp pencil because the openings are small. All the measurements are metric.

The clear sturdy plastic makes these guides easy to see through and stable to use. Great to toss into a kit with a sketchbook.

title: Read the directions before installing
text:
Once installed, this little label printer works like a dream. It uses many sizes and brands of labels. The software that comes with the machine makes it easy to design your own labels. (Many of the templates provided require an upgrade, but the design-your-own option was better for my purposes anyway.) The printing is clear and readable. It is very fast and quiet.

I made the mistake of trying to install the software and driver (Windows 11 works fine) before reading the directions. I had to uninstall both and start from scratch. Be sure to do everything in the exact order they tell you to in the directions and it should work fine.

This is a great buy for a small business, but also has many uses around the house. The design is attractive, and it has a compact footprint. Fits easily on a desk.

title: Large calendar with lots of writing space, tabs, reinforced hanging holes and a pocket
text: The calendar's designer has included so many thoughtful features missing in others. Each day of the month has a full line not just a little square, for appointments and events. Each month has a tab, so it's easy to find future dates in a flash. The last page has a pocket for receipts, tickets, schedules, and other important papers you need to keep handy. Best of all, each month has a reinforced hole. (You know how, halfway through the month the top of the hole tears and the top part flops down? Not with this one! Fantastic!) The only possible downside is the size. Because of all the features, this calendar is big--too big for our fridge door, and maybe yours too. No problem for us. We hung it up in the hall.

title: Write easily and wipe off cleanly
text: These are the best whiteboard markers I've ever used! They make clear, true lines on our home whiteboards (some of the standard whiteboard markers skip or make faded marks on our boards.) When it's time to erase messages or drawings, it's SO easy to wipe everything off with a little clear water. I'm never going to buy ordinary whiteboard markers (alcohol-based?) again.

title: What a gorgeous professional case!
text:
Whether for yourself or for a gift, this gorgeous leather case will take your breath away. It even comes with a cloth storage or presentation bag. There are compartments for a tablet, a laptop, or a presentation portfolio inside. The larger one holds an iPad Pro inside its keyboard case. There's also a compartment for a smartphone and a place for a legal pad. There are smaller zipper pockets and even credit card slots.

The case itself is beautifully finished. Because it's real leather, it will become even more beautiful with age and use. You'll want to work the zipper back and forth at the corners until it slides easily, but that's almost always true with this kind of case. The leather handle is on the back edge. (There is no shoulder strap.)

title: What fun! And practical!
text:
If you are a teacher, or you just use a lot of ballpoint pens in your house, this box of smooth-writing pens will make you gasp with delight. They are good quality pens in different styles. All are retractable. Most have black or blue ink. A plastic seal on each tip keeps the ink fresh until you are ready to start using the pen. There are a few in color in this assortment. A bonus gift pen has six colors in one (an ingenious design.) As advertised in the listing, the ink in most of the pens is black and some are blue.

Keep these for your home office, use them in your classroom, or hand them out instead of candy at Halloween. I'm sure you'll find this grab bag delightful.

title: Six Gorgeous Colors of Sturdy, Long-lasting Folders
text:
I love these handsome, moisture-resistant vinyl folders. Six bright colors in the set make it easy to sort out papers by subject, if you are a student, by month if you are keeping track of expenses at home, or in any other way.

They have pockets inside, but also prongs for three-hole-punched notebook paper. If you want to use them for presentations, there's a place on the right pocket for a business card.

Great for conference packets, high school and college classes, business presentations, home office filing, and more.

title: Great padded envelopes for documents and artwork
text:
These sturdy, lightweight envelopes are generously sized for documents, drawings, photos or small items you need to ship. They are lined with bubble wrap and documents will arrive in great condition.

For extra security, I recommend adding cardboard on either side of photographs or artwork. Shippers can bend anything and an extra stiffener is a good idea. Also, the outer layer is basically a manila envelope, so art should be slipped into a water-resistant plastic sleeve before inserting.

These are smart precautions with any padded shipping envelopes. These very nice ones, and reasonably priced. I plan to use mine for mailing small unframed artworks to collectors.

title: Drawing Pencils You Don't Have to Sharpen
text: What a great idea! I wish I'd known about these a long time ago. These mechanical pencils come in the hardnesses I use the most and I can take them sketching, never having to worry about a lead breaking in the field. They are lightweight, easy to use, and very handy.

title: Clear, a good weight, and archival
text:
As family archivist and "historian" I have a lot of fragile material to sort through, scan, and eventually send off to libraries or local museums in different parts of the country. These sleeves are just what I need for the task. Unlike some other products, they are closed on the bottom so small items like clippings won't fall out. The material is clear and flexible.
It doesn't hurt that they are very reasonably priced, because I need a lot of them.

title: Sturdy, Lightweight, and Moisture-resistant Mailers
text:
These flexible, synthetic (like vinyl) opaque white mailing pouches seal tightly to protect the contents without adding shipping weight.

If you are sending photographs or artwork, you will need to add cardboard, foam-core, or other stiffeners inside (to the front and back) to prevent folding or bending in transit. These envelopes are not stiff at all. Backing boards are included, but they are also very lightweight and might not be protective enough for some contents.(You could also use these pouches to protect work from moisture inside a box or other packaging.)

title: Great Set of Opaque Permanent Pigment Markers
text:
From fine line to chisel points this set includes all of the firm tips you will need (no brush tips).

The ink is black and permanent. You can use it under watercolor or alcohol markers. The fine pen tips are really fine. Great for delicate work. The chisel points work well for lettering and drawings requiring thick and thin lines.

The only problem I have with this set is the difficult-to-read numbers on top of the caps. I may paint the tops with acrylic and write the numbers so I can read them more easily. Right now they are black on black and at first I didn't know they were marked. That's a small problem though, and might not even bother others.

The sample scribble image shows some of the pen lines with alcohol marker on coldpress watercolor paper.

title: Great Laminator
text:
If you need to make paper or card items (up to copy paper size) last, this is what you want. It's easy to use and quiet. It heats up quickly and feeds smoothly. The interface is intuitive. It's handsomely designed and fits on a bookshelf or in a drawer between uses.

Great for making signs, preserving directions, protecting membership cards, and more. Would be a great gift for an elementary school teacher, a small business person, or a home-schooling mother (to make materials, not for use by children.)

Comes with 8.5 x 11 laminating pouches. You will need to buy smaller ones for smaller items. Putting several small items in a large pouch is not recommended.

title: Easy to cut and apply. strong enough for pictures on the fridge
text:
I wanted to mount a picture I made with one of Arteza's new folding frames on the whiteboard in my office. Most of the magnets I had were too thick. The ones I cut from this roll were perfect.

I put one strip at the top and another at the bottom of the picture back. The picture now is almost perfectly flat against the magnetic whiteboard and won't move until I take it off. If you make a mat for your child's drawings and put magnetic strips from one of these rolls, on all four sides, you'll have a splendid changeable show on the fridge door.

title: Beautiful Brilliant Colors, Fine Tips, and an Easy-to-Use Storage Case
text:
It's easy to find just the pen you are looking for in this beautiful set. All of the colors are different. (Bright, but not opaque, they are intended for use on white or light-colored surfaces.)

There are lots of articles online about bullet journalling. Starting out as a planning aid, these journals have evolved into illustrated diaries on gridded paper and in some cases, artists' books. That's where these gorgeous pens come into play. They are fine enough to write and draw with. They can also be used with stencils or combine with stamped designs.

If you travel light and are an artist, pack a few of your favorite colors with a pocket sketchbook for notes or handmade postcards. They are great for sketching, greeting cards, adult coloring books, mandalas, and more. If you need a new hobby, try bullet journalling.

There are online groups where you can make friends. All you need is some grid paper and this set to get started. (If you are buying gifts now for the holidays, this would be great for a favorite friend, relative, or crafty high school student.)

title: Sturdy, Clear Document Holders with Zip Closures
text:
Protect important papers and family records with these clear, heavyweight plastic zipper sleeves.

You can see everything inside, but there is a pocket in the front of each pouch for a labeling card (easy to slip in and out so you can reuse the sleeve.) If you want to keep them in a filing cabinet, the zippers are different colors for easy classification.

I'm in charge of our family's archives and plan to assemble a memory/family history for my daughter, brother, and niece. These will be very helpful. Some of the old papers have silverfish. These easy-to-seal sleeves will make my job much easier.

title: Inspiration in a Box
text:
I'm a writer and I have lots of inspiration cards like this. Each has advantages. This set is very practical. Each of the "Questions" cards has a quotation about care of body, mind, or spirit along with a short sentence guiding the user to apply the idea to his or her own life. They are about, for example, changing habits, listening to intuition, and taking care of your body. They are the kinds of things you can pull out in the morning, focus on during the day, and then reflect upon in the evening.

The affirmation cards have a similar format, each starting with a quotation, but the suggestion at the bottom is framed as something to tell yourself rather than a question to ask yourself. There are more question cards than affirmation cards.

There is a simple instruction folder, but you don't really need it. Just pull out a card and use the idea in the way that best suits your life and schedule.

Very useful for yourself or for a creative friend.

title: A Roll-up Whiteboard!
text:
Okay, this is something you never knew you wanted, but you just might.

If you like to sketch on the fly, do calculations, brainstorm, or do your explaining with a marker in your hand, here's a flexible whiteboard on a rubbery backing that rolls up.

Everything wipes off perfectly clean with the eraser on the back of the provided (excellent) fine-point whiteboard marker. If you need to save your work for some reason, snap a picture of it with your phone.

It's amazing how liberating it is to play with something like this. Take it to meetings in cafes (when we can do that again) or use it the next time you need to come up with new ideas for a story, lyrics, an illustration, or anything creative. Sometimes even paper can intimidate with its permanence.

Granted, it doesn't roll up really small, but it is much easier to carry and use than a rigid whiteboard the same size.

Have fun!

title: Fun set of pens for sketching
text:
I love these pens. There are a range of points from very fine to medium. If you use them for sketching with watercolor, be aware that the ink is water-soluble. I've found that unless you want to create an ink wash with them, it's best to sketch, touch in your watercolor tints, and then add the ink lines (at least with these) last.

They would make a great gift for any artist. You never have too many pens. They all have slightly different characteristics.

title: Easy desktop calculator
text:
This calculator has large keys and a large easy-to-read screen. It's all one piece. The screen is fixed and doesn't tilt as some similar models do. It should last a long time. It has two power sources, sunlight (even indoor light) and/or a single AAA cell (not included, but easy to get),

It has all the functions you will need (unless you are taking an engineering class). In addition to addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, it has a percent key and even finds square roots. There's a 00 key if you're totalling a column of dollars. If you're eyes aren't what they used to be and you don't want to fumble for your glasses to balance your checking account, this is perfect.It's big enough for easy use, but small and light enough to keep on your desk on in a handy drawer.

Would make a thoughtful gift for an older relative or friend who still takes care of business or someone who sells at outdoor events in the summer.

title: This is a professional graphite tool
text: I finally splurged (well, a little) and bought some pencils for people who draw for a living. Why did I wait? These pencils are a delight to hold. The weight and balance are a delight, and the line is amazing. The pencils lay down lines that are fine and even, yet smooth and clear.

title: I Wish it Worked
text:
Okay, I'm revising this review. The machine didn't turn on when I got it. Though it was very carefully packed and undamaged, it just didn't work. That happens sometimes with all machines. I sent an email to the company after trying everything on my end, and, in spite of the quarantine, they got back to me in a couple of days with a customer service number to call. I haven't had a chance to call yet. It isn't their fault. I'll revise again when I get in touch with them.

I wanted this shredder for tax season. You know how it is. You toss statements and receipts in a drawer all year, and then have a ton of paper with sensitive but useless information on it to shred for the dump.

The box arrived, very carefully packed--a smaller box inside a larger one, very sturdy and neat. I eagerly lifted it out, (The shredder top is HEAVY.) I set it on the receptacle (like a wastebasket for holding the shredded paper) and plugged it in.

Nothing. I flipped the switch to forward. Nothing. I flipped it to reverse. Still nothing. (There is no separate power switch.)

I plugged it into a different socket in the house. Nothing. I repeated the process lugging the thing around. I then visited the company website and sent a message to support with my email. I haven't heard anything. Now, to be fair, I am writing this is n the middle of the COVID19 shutdown, so that could be the problem with support. If I hear from them, I will let you know here.

title: Small, Handy Printing Calculator
text:
I don't know about you, but when I try to add a long column of numbers for doing taxes, I lose track of which ones I have entered into the calculator. I know, I could set up a spreadsheet, but I'm not good at Excel.

This little machine isn't much bigger than a large pocket calculator and it prints your entries so you can see what you've already added. It also multiplies, divides, subtracts, and handles percentages.

It would be handy for vendors at summer markets because it gives you a printed ticket and has customizable tax keys.

It comes with the print roller installed, a small starter paper roll, and four Manganese double A batteries. (You have to install the batteries and the paper. The batteries were easy. The paper was a little trickier. There is a button with a little up arrow on the keyboard. When you press that, it pulls the paper through. There are two languages on the instruction sheet explaining that and the pictures go with both of them (duh--it took me a minute to figure that out--rolls eyes.) Once I deciphered the directions, it was easy. You probably won't have any problem.

This is going to make filling out the form for our accountant much easier, and maybe even fun.

title: Keeps Your HP Printer Working Its Best
text:
I usually buy replacement cartridges for my OfficeJet in a two-pack that includes one extra capacity black and one extra-capacity tri-color. unfortunately, they were sold out on my recent shopping trip, so I decided to try Amazon. This tri-color cartridge came quickly and arrived in perfect shape.

I have had HP printers for years and, while the cartridges can be a little tricky to install, they are nowhere near as difficult as other brands with all the separate little color containers. This one squarish hard plastic cartridge contains all the colors except black.

My husband and I share an all-in-one printer. Because neither of us prints as many pages as we used to, a pair of these cartridges lasts us more than six months.

I know there are off-brand replacements. I cannot speak for them. I've only used HP cartridges in my machines.

title: For Recreational Coloring or Creative Expression, a Handy Set of Colors
text: I love colored pencils. They are easy to use to make sketches in the field or to play with at odd moments while waiting for appointments. They are easy to carry and don't make a mess. I have watercolor pencils, designer colored pencils, and other specialty types. This dual-ended set is intended for the adult coloring book craze, but they are great for making landscape notes. There are beautiful browns, yellows, greens, blues, and reds. There's also a black and gray. The leads are soft and lay down rich, or you can use a light touch and overlay them for additional effects; Unlike cheap brands, these sharpen well, without breaking off. I used a small hand sharpener, but you could use a knife. They come sharpened on both ends, so you have 12 pencils with 24 colors. I'm going to enjoy exploring new possibilities with them.

title: Get a jump on tax season--here's a scanner to digitize all your documents in a flash
text: This flatbed scanner is perfect for your tax season needs. you can feed black and white or color documents through it a stack at a time. It will scan one side or both. It comes with fantastic software that converts scanned pages to Word or other office software for editing. You can also save scanned pages as jpg images, tiff images, PDF files, or more. The setup was easy and the software package is great. It's worth the large download. A word of warning--it is a large download. If you have a slow DSL connection, set your computer and do something else for a few hours. You have to download the software and let it update itself before connecting the scanner to the computer. The directions are pretty good, and the scanner is very well packed. That said, be sure you should check not just the top, but also under the document feed lid to make sure you have removed all the blue tape. While primarily a document-feed scanner, it will also scan photos and flat artwork (up to 8.5 x 14") on the flatbed surface. Just lift up the document feeder. If you need to archive personal or office records, this will make your job a lot easier. I may also use it to convert some ancient typed manuscripts into editable files. It will be so much easier than loading one page at a time on a standard flatbed scanner.

title: You Never Knew You Needed This Until You Got It
text: You'll love this desktop gadget. It's designed to keep a sheet of paper, a sketch, or notes handy by your desk. I draw and paint, and it holds reference photos at the perfect angle with no magnets or pins. I also write and am planning to use it to hold handwritten sheets as I dictate them using speech-to-text software. It will also be great for holding character reference cards as I work on my NaNoWriMo novel this year. I'm keeping mine in my office/studio, but it would be perfect in the kitchen to hold recipes or by the phone for memos. It uses 4 ordinary AA batteries, or an AC adapter (sold separately). A light warns you when the batteries need to be replaced. The one I have is note-book paper sized and has an easel back for desk or countertop use, but these boards are available in different sizes.Very handy!

title: Digitize Family Memories in a Flash
text: I have boxes of 4 x 6 drugstore prints (and some 5x7s) from the days before digital cameras. Perhaps you do too. I have a flatbed scanner, and it's great, but scanning these small prints with it is slow and cumbersome. The Epson FastFoto makes this task fast, easy, and fun. You place a stack of prints in the feeder, press the button, and in seconds they are digitized. Easy photo enhancement  software is included. The latest version of ABBYY (version 12) FineReader is also included! It changes scanned print into editable text documents. I use Word and I have loved this software since its early versions. It just keeps getting better. You can scan important documents and save them either as image files (certificates etc. up to 8.5 x11) or as text files. Get rid of all those shoe boxes in your storage locker or garage. Share family photos with all family members. Store your memories digitally either online or on removable media easy to keep safe.

title: but I LOVE it and use it all the time
text: I have an Epson Perfection scanner and was not sure how I would use this relatively simple little machine, but I LOVE it and use it all the time. It's great for scanning receipts and other documents for taxes. It's lightning fast and wireless. I can also save business cards after conferences. There's even a great little program included for this purpose. I save articles from magazines too, and this scanner is a trooper for this purpose. It scans both sides at once in black and white or color. Additionally, it scans and saves text to Word beautifully. This little beauty belongs on your desk, even if you have another scanner.

title: Great for Travel or Learning!
text:
I got this and in 5 minutes I had it online through the wifi and ready to go. The longest part was setting up my wifi, since the password is over 30 characters and the tiny screen can't even have a whole keyboard at one time. There was no learning curve at all.

Pros: It has a camera to recognize written words and translate them. It's not real time or anything, it transcribes the document and prints it out in both languages. This would be great for menus! The voice translation works well (I assume, I just used it from English to a few other languages and it understood me fine and sounded like a reasonable translation).

Cons: The camera feature is not for books. Also, the camera's field of view is limited, so even short documents have to be translated in portions. Also, the downloaded languages feature is a bit of a misnomer. I took off a star for this because they say it has 14 offline languages. Well, it CAN. But first of all, only 4 come installed, you have to download the others. Second, three of them are English in different accents and 2 are versions of Chinese, so I really would call it 10 languages to translate to offline. And why don't they let me choose which ones can be used offline? Some of the ones they offered were good, but I suspect that most people who buy this want to go on a trip and communicate with people outdoors where there is no wifi. So for most people, this is only useful if you happen to be going to certain countries.

Next steps: I've invented a game that I want to try out. First, I'll say a famous phrase in English and play it back in French. I'll record that on my phone. Then I'll play it back and translate that to German. Then Spanish. Then Japanese. Etc, etc, etc. After 10 or 20 languages, you go back to English and ask someone else to guess what the original phrase was!

title: Worked Great, I May Order More
text:
This accessory is perfect. I ordered it thinking that I may end up returning it, there were no instructions online and no good pictures, so I couldn't tell how it attaches and I wasn't sure if I could install it correctly. My board was already mounted, and there was no way I was removing it to install this. Turns out that it has a hole that spils over the bolt in the wall behind the glass. I removed one screw and was able to pull the glass out just enough to slide this in. There's no issue with it being installed after the fact. My board is about 2' by 4', a smaller board may have less play, so YMMV. I was also worried that one sided attachment would make it move around, but that isn't happening. It's in there snugly. And regarding what markers fit, the skinny ones and the fat ones both fit, but I have a set of double sided fat ones with magnets in the caps and those do not.

Two downsides: First, they should offer more sizes. At most I can get 4 of these, which holds 16 markers. And that would be very good because 8 of them would be very high up, this board is mounted such that my eye level is half way up the 4 foot high board. If they had one that held 12 markers, it would easily fit and I could do one or two of those on each side. I'm thinking about buying more now that I know they work, but trying to glue the next one to the wall behind the board to see if I can make my own mount instead of relying on the built in bolts. That may solve my problem.

Second downside is the price, this cost you like 50 cents to make. What ever happened to knock off companies coming along and making cheap copies? $12 each isn't cheap, especially when I would love to get 6 or 8 of them!

But overall it works well. Really I just wrote this review so that other people searching for "install" with the hope of finding out if they can slip it behind an already mounted board won't hit the same black hole that I did!

title: Fun little device that has all sorts of options
text:
Label makers are just fun and satisfying. It's that little sense of accomplishment to be able to print out and stick on a label after you've organized a big mess in your house. Whether it is cables or paperwork. I mean, who doesn't love their P-Touch machine, right?

So the next level up would of course to have a label printer that works with your phone to design custom labels. That's where this Clabel label printer comes in. It is a small bluetooth device with a design that mimics a record player, complete with an on/off button that's a lever rather than a push button.

This label maker is compact and rechargeable. It means that all you need is to provide the label tape, connect it to your phone and with the app, you can design custom labels that reflects your personal tastes.

The included labels are 14x40mm plain white paper stickers but you can find many other varieties ranging from various colors and gradients, to ones with preprinted designs. I searched for the term "thermal label rolls 14x40" and many great options were returned. Unlike the Brother label printers, these labels do not have a plastic housing that are just a waste of plastic. They only have a plastic center. If they can make these center parts from cardboard, that would be even better.

The printer itself is easy to use. To load up the roll, just twist the cover open and pop your roll in. Insert the roll into the output slot and you're ready to go. Just make sure to line up the little indicator on the cover with the lock/unlock symbol on the body and you can easily click the cover back on.

The phone app is a pleasure to work with. I had no trouble pairing the printer at all. Start by making sure the correct label size is selected, create some simple text, customize its size and placement. Decorate the label with a few built-in border designs, and even generate a QR code (which prints very small, but surprisingly, it actually works!). title: Great printing technology (Zink), bad user experience.
text:
Polaroid has been around for a long time, but instant photos are just fascinating to me. There's just something about having a keepsake that one can have immediately. It's why photo booths are still so popular.

Zink is a very very nice technology. Doing a little bit of research, it seems to be a thermal technology, yet it can produce high-quality color photos. Not expecting much from a small 2x3 photo paper, I was quite impressed by the quality that was produced.

With that said, there are many Zink printers out there and the PRT 2x3 Mini Portable Bluetooth Photo Printer MT53 is not one of the better ones. The printer itself comes with a 5-pack of photo paper and not much else. Its directions do not point to the correct app to download and there just isn't much instructions overall.

First, take off the top cover by sliding it off, then take the photo paper out of its package. DO NOT throw away the piece of cardboard that is on top of the deck. Place the entire deck, including the paper card, into the printer. Slide the cover back on. Unfortunately, I had a hard time with the top cover as one of its clips just would not slide back in place and I would have a gap. It took me quite a few tries until I was successful in sliding the cover back on. Even now, there is a gap in the cover (see my picture).

Next, turn on the printer. The paper sheet will be fed through and the printer will be initialized. Now download the app. When searching HPRT, many apps show up with no clue as to which one will actually work with the printer. The correct app is "HeyPhoto". HeyPhoto can be used without signing up for an account, which is good. Select the correct printer (MT53) by swiping to the left. Be careful where you swipe because the sliding action only works if you put your finger on the blank spot under the name of the printer. Anywhere else and you'll end up selecting the printer instead of sliding. It's quite frustrating.

From there, it's fairly easy to choose the picture you want and even do some touchup. When ready, tap on the printer to connect and print.

For those who are on Android, you will notice that there is an icon in the notification tray that tells you the HeyPhoto app is still running in the background. Tapping on it takes you to the app info screen where you can force stop the app. This is just bad programming.

So in the end, the printer works and the photos are of better quality than a classic polaroid, but the PRT printer makes the whole experience a pain to deal with.

title: This is a great inkjet-style printer
text:
Since it's not very clear on the description of the printer, this is an inkjet-style printer and not a laser or led. The Epson EcoTank Pro ET-5150 Wireless Color All-in-One is a great printer/scanner/copier that is easily refillable with eco-friendly bottles of ink. No proprietary chip or a full toner cartridge to buy.

Before this printer, I was using a Dell Multi-Function color laser printer which began to print very badly once the included toner cartridge ran out. Yes, I'm probably to blame for not purchasing the Dell toners, but c'mon, who wants to overpay for ink? Either way, the problems I ran into with the Dell points out the problems with using a laser printer. The toner is simply too expensive and the consumer is always blamed if first-party toners aren't used.

The Epson EcoTank system solves all of that. With a normal inkjet, the ink tank is proprietary and is limited in size because it is part of the print head. The EcoTank allows for a bigger tank, which means that one can go much longer without having to add more ink. Inside the box were two larger bottles of black and a one each of the smaller bottles of cyan, magenta, and yellow. Enough to fill a full tank, rather than the paltry amount usually included with printers.

Set up was not as easy as one would hope; especially if one wishes to set up the wireless connection only. Displayed on the screen is a message to download the setup software but the quick start guide doesn't actually say which specific file to download.

What seems like a stuck screen that tells one to run the setup software can actually be dismissed by tapping on the screen then going through the menu until one gets to the main menu.

To set up the printer on a Windows computer, go to the URL printed in the included letter pages as the glossy quick-start manual seems to be out of date. Download the file labeled "Drivers and Utilities Combo Package Installer" which will walk through detecting and installing the printer via WIFI.

Once the printer driver and software was installed and connected to the printer, I found that I couldn't print out any of the calibration sheets (paper wasn't detected in the tray) until I performed a reboot on the printer.

After that, I was able to print from my Windows and my android phones (download and install the Epson Smart Panel app). The print quality for photos, even on plain copy paper was very good. Not as good of a color laser printer, but inkjets actually work better with card stock and other media such as iron-on transfers, transparencies, etc.
