text: Very durable if you are concerned about things poking through.  I like these to use for certain things that are also wrapped in bubble wrap but can still go first class postage.  Really great for mailing media mail or books.

title: Good For Soap
text: These work nicely for smaller bars of homemade soap to protect for shipping or as gifts.

title: Good Mailers
text: I still having trouble getting used to these plastic mailers when all there used to be available were the paper ones. These don't seem as thick as the old style, but they are a good size for what I need.

title: Pretty Poorly Made
text: I have bought a lot of these over the years. Big ones and small ones. By far the most cheaply made ever. The plastic is so thin that it deforms when you look at it. Be very careful putting on the wheels. I actually popped part of the top lose doing that.

title: Very Colorful
text: Break up your sticky note routine with this batch of notes in wild and crazy colors. I love them!

title: Love These
text: A bit bigger than your average sticky pad. The lines help you to keep things neat and legible.  Many uses!

title: Good Magazine Holder
text: A bit of a different design with the roundy corners and all. Otherwise nothing special. Looks good and works.

title: Very Heavy Duty
text: I got these for making resin shakers. They are thick and a bit hard to cut. Also not sure if there is a protective sheet on them or not. No information on that and they seem to have streaks on them. Not perfectly clear.

title: Good Student Set
text: This is a great set of pencils for children or new art students. The quality is truthfully mediocre if you've been used to professional grade pencils, but they will be grand for someone starting out.  Good color selection. The best part of this deal is the canvas carrier. It is high quality and very well made. Easy to roll up and keeps everything secure.  Great gift!

title: Sweet Notebooks!
text: Great for kids or adults. I have a lot of projects and lists going on. These will allow me to dedicate a book to each issue for keeping things organized. The covers are very nice and heavy paper and the binding is well done.  Very useful on many levels.

title: No More Wonky Washi Tape
text: I just loaded this up and took it for a spin. No more wonky torn edges on my washi tape. The center spindle holds extras or those really wide rolls. The side rollers will hold 2 standard width rolls or 4 o the narrow rolls or any combination of each. It does have a pretty big footprint, but it works great!

title: Lightweight But Functional
text: Good enough for mailing lightweight items that don't need a lot of protection. The adhesive strip could be a little wider and more hardy.

title: Flimsy
text: For some reason I was expecting a fully formed metal mesh item. This needs to be assembled and comes folded flat. Not very sturdy and lining up the little screws is hard to put it together. Nice I suppose if you want to store it and then put it together, but of all the items I've gotten like this this is the most poorly made

title: Interesting Variety
text: This selection ahs some lovely vintage American cards and then some odd Asian anime cards. It seems a bit mismatched to me.  Smooth finish and good paper. Nice enough graphics. Very useful.

title: Pros and Cons
text:
I have used a lot of different gel pens over the years. Some good, some useless. I like these for the most part. A good color selection and lots of options for the variety of gel ink. I like the fact that there are refills for all the pens. The drawing I did has glitter gel for the bodies of the beetles and I could actually achieve some blending in the leaves and bodies.

I dislike the packaging. All the pens are slotted into plastic sleeves which are all attached in a long string. Hard to use so I cut the sections apart. It is also hard to tell what pens are what variety ie. glitter, metallic, etc. There is no indication on the individual pens and it is sometimes hard to tell from the caps or the ink itself. The refills are numbered 1. 2. 3. 4 which I imagine is supposed to correspond to the way the pens are packaged. Unfortunately there isn't corresponding numbering on the pens so matching the refills is going to be interesting.

title: Perfect Size
text: I really like this size of note. Great for tagging things in magazines and for lining up on the bottom of my monitor.  Nice wide sticky strip at the top and they are actually sticking better than the name brand usually does. Lovely colors as well if you want to do some kind of color coding thing.

title: Perfect
text: I realized that my day planner was running out shortly and I went in search of a new one. This is better than the one I had. More space on each day to write events. Heavy cover and a good binding. A good basic layout of the months without a bunch of fru fru stuff no one needs.

title: They Work
text: This is the 4th time I've tried these labels that are supposed to be compatible with my machine. Finally they work. Very large shipping labels if that is what you need. Also work for name tags.

title: Awful
text: I did a trial with this in my art studio. I have some 4 x 4 canvases that I want to hang. They weigh almost nothing. I used a pea sized piece of this according to the instructions and everything was on the floor this morning. I couldn't get the tacky stuff off the paint or the back of the canvas. What a mess.

title: Thin
text: I find this to be a bit of a thin piece of magnet board. Be aware that you need a perfectly flat metal space for this to work to it's full potential. I was hoping to put it on a metal door in my art studio and then remembered that they are raised panel doors and it won't really work. Too big for a filing cabinet. It would be easy to cut and that is what I may do. Cut it to fit the panels in my door. Like the different colored markers. Not the usual colors.

title: Solid
text: I have a fetish for these kinds of organizer things. I love these because they are very well built. They also stack on top of each other fairly well so that you can go up if you have limited space. Easy to wash. I have some like this that I have had for many years. They don't wear out. And you can repaint them if you want!

title: Interesting
text: Once again I didn't get a clear description of this item. They are full 81/2 x 11 sheet labels. Which to me really isn't a label it's an adhesive piece of paper.  They fed fine in the printer. There is no indication of the front and back and looking at them, you can't tell. I had to peel a corner to figure it out. I won't be using these in the office but will send them to the studio to use as a mask for painting.

title: Perfect
text: I needed one of these for a workshop office. It is working very well for keeping track of projects and work that need to happen and be finished.  The little tray is handy for keeping track of the eraser and markers.

title: Fabulous Pencils
text: I prefer mechanical pencils for my office, basically because my sharpener is in another building. These are smooth and easy to write with and the erasers actually erase cleanly.  Very good product in lots of colors for a group setting as well. Everyone can get the color they like!

title: Every Homeowner Needs Some
text: Most of us DIY people can rarely keep track of the pencil. These are big, sturdy and most importantly easy to find when you lay them down in the middle of a project. If you can't find these they must be hidden underneath a pile. Now if someone would invent a sharpener that would be great!

title: Smooth Writing
text: For inexpensive pens these are terrific. They write fine and smooth with a good black ink. Caps help to keep them from drying out.  A box of these allows you to spread them all over the office or house and always have a pen at the ready.

title: Expensive But Fun
text: I have used this product for a long time in artwork. It is a very versatile ink. Fun on Yupo paper. Works great in resin work. Lots of colors in this kit and you can make other combinations with them. Ranger products are among the most expensive ever, but as long as you can keep things from drying out they are good!

title: Classy Cards
text: I love these cards. They come flat, but fold easily. The graphics are fun and they are perfect for any need. I send a lot of art mail and these are just the ticket for that!

title: Very Nice
text: These are super stands for signs and notifications. I plan to use them for art shows on my display table. I think they are a bit overpriced for what they are though.

title: They Worked!
text: This is the third brand of labels I have tried in month. These actually worked. Printed clearly and fed through without jamming. What a deal. A bit bigger than the regular address labels, but I send a lot of international mail and need a little bigger area.  Works like a charm.

title: Jammed My Machine
text: I got one of these to print, but it was a lot lighter than the name brand labels I use. The next one jammed the machine and that was that. I'll find a way to use them somehow, but unfortunately not in the machine as intended.

title: Different But Nice
text:
I have always been a huge fan of Prismacolor. Ever other pencil has fallen way short. I like these though. They are not as vibrant or saturated as Prismacolor. More of a muted , softer color palette. Several of the many colors are identical or similar just with different names. They are not as soft as others, so keep a bench brush handy or be prepared to blow off the "dust" when you use them. Being harder, they seem to be more durable and longer lasting. Blending is best achieved with Gamsol and a stump. I had not great luck blending pencil to pencil at all. Too hard for that.
The packaging is nice although the trays are a bit floppy because they are long and have a lot of pencils in them. Included color chart so you can fill it in yourself as you wish. All in all a pretty good value and I will use these daily when I want a more muted effect.

title: Sturdy
text: File folders that are sturdy. Imagine that. They are kind of slippery when you stack them, but they hold a lot and are going to last forever. I labeled mine with the Brother label machine, but I imagine a sharpie would work If you want it to be permanent.

title: Strong Smell
text: I used this today while I was reviewing some vinyl. I am used to paper transfer paper and I really didn't like this. It worked OK, but I didn't have a very complicated design. I think if you were using this for something with a lot of bits and pieces, it wouldn't work too well. Just didn't seem like it wanted to pick up the vinyl off the backing. And it smells awful.

title: Useful Bubble Wrap
text: This product is not quite as hardy as what I get from Staples. If you just need a  small amount for something it will be fine. Price wise I think it's close to office supply prices, but I can't remember what I pay for a huge box of the good stuff. Seems a little flat and limp to me.

title: Get A Refill
text: Why throw out a perfectly good pen body because the ink ran out. Get a refill!

title: Darling Little Cart
text: I have to admit when I opened the box I wasn't having high hopes for this. It is very small and really suited to use in a small space, or for a child's tea cart.  But, once it got it together, it is a very sturdy little cart that I am going to use in my studio to store drawing supplies on. The only structural thing I would have improved is that the bolts holding this together really could be longer. It's hard to assemble because there isn't much sticking out to put the nut on. Rolls well and will serve my needs.

title: Works For Stencils
text: I got these to use with my cutting machine t make stencils. It is really perfect for that and cheaper then stencil material.

title: Fun For The Holidays
text: These are not the heaviest weight paper stickers I've ever had, but they are still nice. The graphics are good and they do stick where you put them. I do a lot of mail art trades and these are going to be fun on the envelopes.

title: Kind Of Thin
text: These are pretty much your standard page protector, except they are VERY thin. Good enough for something that just gets stored, but never paged through much. I don't think they will hold up really well to repeated use. The seams are kind of iffy.

title: Fun To Color For Everyone
text: I am impressed with these. The artwork is good. They are fun to color. It would have been nice to have a bit of suggestion as to what coloring medium is best. I use alcohol ink markers in my artwork, so I tried them first. They do work, but be prepared for major bleed to the back of the paper. Protect your work surface.  Colored pencils were good too. The paper isn't too thick so I wouldn't use something water based unless you have a very light hand. All in all these are fun!

title: Good Tacks
text: Super well made thumb tacks. I have enough now for the rest of my life. Love them!

title: Great Pack of Flags
text: Love these things. Especially for recipes in magazines. Way better than dog earing a page. These are neon colors which are also easier to find and see.

title: Super Holders
text: These are the bomb! Attractive, and well made. Great for doing art shows. With a three pack you can have cards at various places in your display. Excellent value!

title: Great For Artists!
text: Great for artists too! I love these. Great little shapes to use in abstract artwork and borders. Heavy plastic and well made. Love the different edges on each of the sheets. They are all very useful.

title: Very Pretty Card
text: This is a pretty nifty card. I have handmade cards like this and they are tricky to do. Fabulous quality and good paper. Opens and closes easily.  Very pretty!

title: Functional and Good Quality
text: If you like to be organized, you can never have enough of these. Not just for magazines, but for various papers. recipes, cookbooks etc. They are sturdy and easy to clean. Very useful.

title: Fine Point
text: I use these for writing on Kindness Rocks. They are OK, but hard to use over acrylic paint.

title: The Gold Standard
text: I've been offices that have used these for many years. They are the best file type boxes you will get. When full, they are as sturdy as a rock and can be stacked if you need to. Easy to assemble with some practice. Everything fits together and locks in place if you do it right. Love them!

title: Not Very Sticky
text: This is a nice weight envelope, but the adhesive needs to be better. I sealed an envelope and then opened it right up without damage. Not sure I want to mail anything in these since they can be breached so easily. I have had others like these in the past and the other problem that happens with the adhesive is that it dries out completely if you don't use them fast enough. I have a whole box that won't seal anymore at all without tape.

title: Too Cutesy For An Adult
text: The picture on the front of this is adorable. The planner itself is full of way too cutesy asides and notations to be useful for me. It seems like a quality product with a good binding and a good sturdy cover.  If you need a simple, straightforward date book to be able to write in, this isn't it.

title: Stunning Journal
text: WOW! This is a beautiful handmade journal. The cover is very detailed and well constructed. The clasps that hold this together are anchored through the leather for years of use.  The embossing on the leather is consistent and detailed.  Lovely stone in the center front cover.  Looks like maybe sodalite. The paper in this is textured and looks handmade. I want to use this as an art journal I think, so we will see how drawing on the paper works. I am thrilled to have this. It's a luxury piece in my opinion.

title: Quality Paper
text: I use a lot of paper in greeting cards, and my art studio.  Plain paper like this is great to have on hand if you have littles wandering in and out too. Ran through the printer with no problems and I couldn't tell the difference between this and any other paper I have.  Very pleased to get  this.

title: Special Staples??
text: This seems like a really nice stapler for a woman. Small enough to fit the hand. It did not come with any staples of a size that fit, so I can't review how hard it was to dispense staples into the project. I tried all the regular sized staples I had in the workshop, but apparently these are a much smaller size.  Would have been nice to include just a few so we could really try this out.

title: It's OK
text: For some reason I  thought this was going to be bigger even though the size is plainly stated. In any event, this is not really a document storage device, but more for a receipt book or job book.  Not big enough for letter sized paper at all. I wanted to try one of these in one of the landscaping trucks for the guys to keep papers in, but they way it is made it would last about 2 weeks even if it were the right size.

title: Impressive
text: The printer accepted these with n o difficulty and they seem to be working quite well.

title: Very Sturdy
text: This thing is built! Heavy metal, sturdy construction. Perfect to replace a crappy plastic one that keeps collapsing. Can be wall mounted as well if that's what you need.

title: Excellent Product
text: I've used these markers many times in sign and art projects.  They always work well. Store these nib down for best results. They say they are "fine point", but I suppose that is relative. They aren't detail fine, but not as thick as a chisel point marker.

title: They Work
text: These are just your basic clear divided page protectors for business cards. No bells or whistles. Medium quality. Cards insert from the center instead of the top.

title: Difficult To Use
text: Love hate relationship with this. The glider itself is hard to use and the tape doesn't always peel or spool.

title: Solid Wood
text: This is a wonderful piece for a child's room. Very easy to assemble. Solid pine construction and sturdy and heavy. Smooth surface makes it easy to dust and clean.  Very good product!

title: Great File Box
text: Well constructed and very useful. Snaps shut well and is easy to carry. The little organizer tray in the top is nice, but not deep enough to hold anything but paper clips. Kind of a waste of engineering truthfully.

title: Beautiful Cards, Beautiful Box
text: What's not to like? These cards are great quality. Individually packaged. Great variety for every taste, They truly do look handmade and I know because I've been making greeting cards for a long time. The bonus in this is the box they come in. No wasted packaging here. The box is as nice and useful as the cards. Perfect for smaller special ornaments for storage. I would highly recommend this product.

title: Classy All The Way
text: Simplicity and class from the packaging to the product. Heavy weight envelopes that actually seal when you lick them. The card itself is pure quality. Lightly embossed with gold design and lettering. A must for any household.

title: Fab Erasers
text: Been using these for a long time in my art studio. They work well, erase cleanly and don't tear up the paper. They last a while too. Great products from Tombow.

title: Big Eraser
text: Love this eraser. Easy to hold because it's large. Erases very well and very cleanly.  Should last a long time even in my art studio. Tombow erasers are the best I have used in a very long time.

title: Erases But Doesn't "Catch"
text: I was waiting expectedly for this eraser. My art studio is always buried in eraser dust. Guess it still will be. This erases very well, doesn't damage the paper, but I didn't notice significantly less mess. In fact I always start an eraser on a corner and this one just lost little pieces of the actual eraser until it got down to a larger surface area.  So sad. Was hoping for an eraser miracle.

title: Good For Tight Spaces
text: I use Tombow erasers all the time for my artwork. I love them. They have some great variations of really good erasers that last a long time. This one is thin and easy to get into smaller places. It erases cleanly and is easy to hold. I would buy this again.

title: Kind of Mushy
text: Normally I use Tombow erasers in my art studio every day. This is not one I will use much unless all the others are gone. For some reason it seems to be very soft and jiggly and difficult to control.  Not my favorite eraser for sure.

title: Not 4 x 8
text: These are only 7 inches long. They are 8 inches with the flap that you fold over.

title: Simply Elegant
text: A simple and elegant blank note card on good stock. Nice envelopes. Useful for many things and occasions.

title: Fab Thank You Cards
text: Great cards for a wedding, or shower. Nice amount in the box. Well made.  Simple, straightforward and designed for any occasion.

title: Exceptional Stationary
text: In a digital age like this one it is really nice to hold a fine piece of stationary. These note cards are heavy weight stock with simple elegant script.  Truly a joy to have and use.

title: Beautiful
text: A truly colorful and gorgeous set of note cards with envelopes. Very useful for quick notes. I trade art cards all over the world and these will be perfect for mailing them. Good quality and great colors that you can mix and match!

title: Gotta Have It
text: Necessary, expensive evil. Still seems to last longer than HP products.

title: Quality Paper
text: Nice printer paper. This is standard 20# paper, but somehow feels thicker. For sure has a smoother feel to it than other paper.  Stark white. Runs great in the printer. Overall a good quality paper for home or office!

title: Really Nice Cards
text: Normally I make all my greeting cards, very elaborately by hand. Sometimes though a birthday sneaks up on me and I don't have time. These cards will fill the gap quite nicely. They are really perfect for any birthday across all ages. Good quality, nice size. Very attractive and fun.

title: Work Well
text: These sticky notes seem nice enough. The adhesive doesn't seem quite as hearty as a 3M style, but yet in all my tests they stayed stuck just fine. Nice paper. I like them!

title: Nice Datebook
text: Been getting these for several years now and they suit my needs.

title: Application Learning Curve
text: A little different to use than the dot adhesive, but works well once you get the hang of application.

title: Assembly Nightmare
text:
Oh where to begin with this item. I am conflicted on a lot of levels with this.
Pro's:
Looks nice
Very comfortable seating
Good rollers
Good ability to adjust height

Cons:
The arm pieces that connect the back to the seat are molded plastic. By the time this was assembled they were already scratched and dented.

Difficult to assemble on many levels. Where the arms attached to the back piece 2 screws are used. I could not get them to be tight at all. Even pulled out the drill and an allen bit and still could not get them to go in far enough to contact the chair they way they are supposed to be. Partially inserted screws that stuck out too far had to be attacked with a phillips screw driver.
When trying to screw the arm pieces to the seat to connect the back to the seat, same issues. Screws were very difficult to line up on some of the holes. Best advice I can give you is don't tighten anything until it is all together.

Next problem in assembly was the foot rest ring. There is a spacer in the center that was deformed in my chair. This spacer has to fit down over the pneumatic lifting part of the chair. Impossible to do without a rubber mallet. If that is supposed to be adjustable for height there is no way it moves. Lousy assembly instructions which don't tell you anything verbally.
I'm not what material the base is made of, but it isn't very heavy, so be aware.

Lots of plastic in this chair, but some quality parts as well. As I said, it LOOKS nice and is comfortable, but there are issues to be aware of.

title: Good Pens
text: Buy these all the time. They are the only white pens that work for my artwork.

title: Necessary If You Have Chameleons
text: Speedy shipping. Hate that I have to use so many of these. Wish they were a lot more durable. The whole system is a rip off from that standpoint.

title: Excellent Organizer
text: Large bound notebook. Not a datebook. Each page is the same. I'm hoping this will help me eliminate all the little pieces of paper all over my desk.  Lists and to do's will go in here and this will be a lot easier to find and manage. Also big enough that the dog won't be able to carry it off. Yes, that happens here. Nice cover, fun color and lots of space to organize. A line for the date, and the top 3 things that you need to do or think about for the day. Side notes for looking ahead, right now and "win of the day" if you are into all that rah rah stuff. All in all a useful desktop item.

title: Great Labels
text: I love my Dymo machine and these are a must. Beats printing computer labels and paying for ink.

title: Good Cards
text: Fed into the printer well and worked as advertised.

title: Attractive and Sturdy With Assembly Issues
text:
I give this chair five stars for looks and comfort and take away five stars for ease of assembly. Very sturdy chair. Attractive and comfortable. It ends there.

Cons:

8 screws in a chair like this should take about 5 minutes to assemble 45 minutes later, one rubber mallet and 2 screw drivers and it is complete. Virtually impossible to assemble for one person. I put together a lot of stuff at my house and this was the pits. The washers are way too big and just get in the way. The bottom goes together fairly well, but putting the back on is tough. The screws are almost not long enough to allow for the padding in the chair. The padding has to be really compressed and then if you are lucky you can find the hole and get things together. There is a plastic cover that is supposed to "snap" over the screws on the back to pretty the whole thing up and cover the screws and washers. There is no snapping this thing on. I had to use a rubber mallet and they will probably still fall off. The manufacturer recommends tightening the screws on the chair every 6 months. Not happening if you have to pry off that cover.

Good color and comfortable as I said, but the assembly of this put me off.

title: Great Labels
text: Love these labels and the printer they go into.

title: Good Cards
text: Worked well. Fed into the printer fine and the perforations were easy to separate. Heavy quality paper.

title: Wonderful Coloring Kit
text: I am very impressed with this coloring kit. I get a lot of colored pencils to try out and most of them are chalky, waxy nastiness. These pencils are on a par with Prismacolors. Very smooth and easily blended. I love the triangular shaped double ended  pencils because they are easy to hold on to. The coloring book itself is a little small for my taste, but would be easily portable to carry in your purse or briefcase.  My only dislike was the packaging on this product. It was very hard to get open without damaging the contents.

title: Great For Line Work
text: I use these everyday for illustration type drawings. They never get a chance to dry out before the tips are done in. Consistent quality.

title: Need Better Adhesive
text: I use a lot of these and wish they were better made, but they are affordable. They just need to run the adhesive strip out to the edges better. You will have to tape the ends down on both sides to prevent them getting caught in the postal machines.

title: Great Tip and Esay To Write With
text: Fabulous paint pen for rock painting. This is a lot better then the more expensive pens from Deco Art. Will buy again.

title: Way Too Thin
text: I am somewhat disappointed in these index cards. It has been a long time since I purchased any, but I seem to remember them being a whole lot thicker stock than these are. These are almost paper thin, not even as heavy as cheap card stock. Not going to be very useful for my purposes, so i will end up using them as scrap note paper.

title: Good Quality
text: Good quality envelopes. I like the fact that the adhesive goes almost the entire length of the top flap. Columbia's brand does not and the corners flip up and have to be taped. Very useful envelopes for invitations, but also for art canvases that I mail frequently.

title: Excellent Quality
text: Fabulous quality envelopes. These have some serious adhesive under the pull strip and are every bit as good as any name brand I've ever had. Looking forward to using these to mail art canvases and other artsy material far and wide.

title: Odd Idea
text: The coloring craze has gone one too far now. These are well illustrated, black on white for one side and white on black in the reverse. Thin paper that doesn't hold much hope of durability.  Guaranteed to lower production in your office as everyone sits and colors. Not a great idea.

title: Excellent Paper Foil
text: This is really nice gold adhesive foil. Thick paper. I cut some today using my Silhouette machine and had no problems with it. This will handy for greeting cards and lots of other paper projects that I do.

title: Very Useful For A Variety of Things
text: These are a must have for cabinets new and old. They are sturdy, stick well, stay in place and keep doors from banging on the cabinet. They also work if you have a spot where the cabinet hits a wall. Just place one at the bottom on the wall and you will save your paint.  I sometimes use them on my ceramic and pottery pieces as well to prevent scratching of furniture surfaces. Excellent product!

title: Great For Cardmaking
text: I love this runner. Easy to load and works well.

title: Perfect Desk Organizer
text: Positively love this. Just finished straightening up my desk and getting this populated with supplies. I can now actually see the top of my printer. This is so much better than just the tray kind. The drawers hold more and they keep the dust out. This is pretty large so keep that in mind if you have a smallish desk area. Well made and so useful.

title: Good Product
text: Epson Ink seems to last longer than some of the others and it is very easy to install.

title: Couldn't Get Them To Hold
text: Had to send these back because they didn't work on carpet as advertised.

title: Vibrant True Colors
text: I really want to rate these higher, but they are just so so. I am an artist and I get to use a lot of marker type things in my illustrations. These are very entry level. The pens themselves are kind of thin and light. A little hard to hold on to if you have a larger hand. The color selection is not too bad. There is good gradation for a 20 pen set. The colors are vibrant and pretty true to the cap colors. These have a nice nib that allows for some pretty fine work, but that same nib makes it harder to fill a large area without streaking. All in all for the money, a nice set for a beginning colorist.

title: Works Pretty "Slick"
text: Replaced an old cracked mat with this. Very pleased as it fits my space better than the old one. I advise caution when using it though as the chair really moves around on it. Be sure you have hold of your chair before you sit in it or you could end up on the floor!

title: Excellent Pen For Fine Lines
text: Excellent pen albeit a little fussy to use. This is my second one. The first was never right from the start and finally broke. This one works much better. Be prepared for the tip to dry out so be sure to keep it covered. The fine nib tends to clog, but when it works its the best.

title: Not The Best Markers For Art
text: These are by no means artist quality markers. They are streaky, dry and not blendable even though they are water based. I suppose they would be fine for coloring books in detail areas. If you have to try to fill a larger area, the point isn't really big enough and they streak very badly. Some of the markers are kind of dry on the first use. The colors are nice enough, but the other faults of these markers make them something I wouldn't spend money on.

title: Not Thin
text: Very disappointed in this pen. It is nowhere close to the size they say it is. In Micron pen terms it's the equivalent of a 2.0. Not even close to a .10. The only good thing I can say is it's refillable, but with the size I won't ever be able to use it, so that doesn't matter a bit.

title: Looks Better In The Picture
text: I have to say I am really glad I didn't have to pay for this item. It is way overpriced for compressed board furniture. It does have some weight to it. The handles and the casters are above average quality. Putting the casters and handles on was easy as far as things like this go. The drawers seem to not quite close properly. The extra tapes are nice
Being able to make a large font and stretch it out so it is easier to read
Easier cutter that on the older models

What I Don't Like

The extra picture functions are OK, but I don't think I will use them much if at all. The print is so small and the steps to get there are too many.

I’d pay more for letters that are already loose and, even better, organized alphabetically. Digging through the bag of letters, numbers, and symbols isn’t super convenient and the punctuation pieces are so tiny they just disappear into the bottom.

title: Great Door Stops - Best for Solid Doors
text:
I have utilized this type of hinge pin style door stop for many years and they work well. They allow for more adjustments than any other door stops I’ve used but there are some issues to understand.

These door stops are easily installed. You simply use a hammer and small screwdriver to remove the hinge pin, then place this door stop at the top as you replace the pin.

The distance the door will open is controlled by how far the adjustable screw is extended. The farther the screw is extended out the less the door will be free to move. The door is stopped by the small white rubber pads on the end of the metal end as it meets the door and the extended adjustable screw meets the frame.

Depending on the construction, materials used and how hard the door is opened this can end up causing damage to the door, the jam, the wall or all of them. I’ve found this is the nature of any door stop.

In my experience these definitely work best with solid doors and full size framing. This product in particular is especially high quality. The metal is strong, they are reinforced and have a cool design element to them.

title: Gorgeous Prints, Excellent 2 Sided Scanning & Easy Setup
text:
While I have setup and used laser printers in office settings this is the first laser printer I have had for home use.

Laser printers have many advantages over inkjet, the primary of those being print quality and speed. The disadvantage, and reason they are used less often in home settings, is purchase price and toner cost.

This Lexmark MC3426adw printer is standard size for similar workstation units and comes with everything you’ll need to get it setup and running.

While it came with an installation CD I opted for downloading the app and software which was easily located on the Lexmark website rather than pullout my external CDROM. The iOS app was easy to use and connected the workstation to my network without any issue.

I work on a Windows 10 PC and had no problems whatsoever with setup and using all of the functions.

I have put this workstation through a full battery of testing and I am thoroughly impressed with its capabilities. I have found the Dual Core, 1.0 GHz processor can handle any tasks I throw at it with ease.

In terms of printing - text is printed crisp, clean and flawless. Speed of printing is incredible when compared to inkjet - really there is just no comparison. In addition it prints both sides of the page at the same time! Printing graphics, images and photos was likewise excellent. While I don’t typically print photos and instead upload them to professional photo services, I found the printed image quality far superior to anything I’d ever previously produced at home.

When it comes to scanning, this workstation is a powerhouse of performance. It is able to scan both sides of a page at the same time allowing it to make short work of even large stacks of scanning jobs. The results of my scanning tests were very good and the speed is phenomenal.

This workstation is highly versatile allowing for an expanded media tray to be added and high capacity toner cartridges if you have especially large projects. It is able to print on to envelopes and multiple sizes of media with no problem. It connects to the major cloud platforms and will easily upload and download with them. There is a built in USB port on the front for scanning to flash media and, of course, it’s available via Wifi or Ethernet.

The only flaw I have found with this otherwise great product is the touch screen. On a device this size there is no reason for the touchscreen to be so minuscule. While I don’t find that I have to use the touchscreen often, when I do it’s difficult to key anything in without miskeying.

While toner costs more than it would for an inkjet it is in line with other brands and is readily available. Each color in addition to black is individually packaged so you only change the cartridge that is needed without wasting the others.

This is an outstanding color laser printer, scanner and fax machine that is made to perform. I have been impressed by each of the many features it has and definitely recommend this product.

That means for a $17 cartridge, i'm paying almost 30 cents per page printed. So this "inexpensive" printer WILL COST YOU when it comes to ink.

Let me also add that i've never printed photos until last week. What a racket. It won't let you print on 8.5x11 photo paper. You can ONLY print onto 5x7 or 4x6 photo paper. Well, okay. That's annoying but i'll play your game printer. So when I used a NICE piece of glossy photo paper and I made sure all the settings were correct, I printed a photo and it looked awful. I expected it to at least look decent. But no. It looked like garbage.

I am seriously a cheap person and I will never buy a canon printer ever again. I've learned my lesson. Sometimes cheap is just CHEAP. I'm going back to HP. I got a free printer from HP with my laptop back in college and it lasted me 10 years before it finally died. I can probably recall every time I bought ink for that thing. It was a crazy work horse. This canon printer? I know i've bought ink at least a dozen times. Do yourself a favor and get something better. You will kick yourself for having wasted your time and money on this printer.

title: It wasn't as good as I had hoped
text:
When I bought this, I had read many of the reviews and the entire description and it seemed like a good solution for my needs. One of the selling points for me was that you could use any paper with it and didn't have to buy anything special to go with it. Immediately though upon opening it and reading the pamphlets that come with it, you find out this isn't true. They recommend that you use the special paper their company makes or the device may not work as well as it would otherwise.

That was only problem number one. The app you have to use with it is the only way to make changes and it is a pain to get the documents to go where you want them to go. Sometimes the app wouldn't connect at all and the blue tooth refused to even try to connect. The battery life is not nearly as good as advertised and I was only able to find a mobile app to use, not a pc app, which makes it hard to edit the document, since everything is so small.

The text conversion is a nightmare. You would pretty much have to write all in block letters for it to understand what you wrote, being extremely careful of the pressure you are putting on the pen in order for it to recognise what you have written. Truly, it was worth a laugh, but not much else. I bought this in order to save time, but it ended up just wasting time instead. It was a good idea in theory, but not so much in practise. I was glad Amazon allowed me to return it.

I love the case the pen came in, as it is easy to open even for someone who has arthritis. Overall this would make a nice gift for the person in your life who is busy and on the go. I would buy it as an office gift again.

title: I love these so much!
text: These are so much better for blending than white coloured pencils. They leave the shades of the pencils you are blending as vibrant as they were previously and they work well for blending, sharpening and erasing small mistakes when you go outside the lines. Now that I have used these, I will always keep a supply of them around. A must have for anyone with the prismacolor soft core pencils. Work beautifully.

title: Nice!
text: Very good product and works perfectly with the label printer. I'm happy with them.

title: Sharp!
text: This is a great sharpener and small enough to be convenient when travelling. It is lightweight, but although it is plastic, it seems durable. I haven't had any issues with it cracking or breaking up to this point. The sharpening is perfect for prismacolor coloured pencils and makes a nice, even point. I haven't had any issues with the lead breaking so far in any of the pencils I have sharpened. It is small and has a small shavings depository, so you won't be able to sharpen too many pencils before you have to empty it, but doing so is straightforward and it is easy to put back together. I have been impressed with this sharpener for the price.

title: I am so impressed!
text:
These are the best coloured pencils that I have had the pleasure of using. Not on;y are the colours fantastic and there is a broad array of tones and values to choose from, but they blend wonderfully and easily on all different types of paper. The lead is durable and doesn't break easily and it doesn't require a great deal of pressure to get rich, true colours out of these pencils. I have been using them in a variety of projects and have been thrilled with them. I will definitely order them again.

These work so well with adult colouring books as well, and obviously, when you use pencils there is no concern about them bleeding through, so they are perfect for those books that have double-sided pages. These are wonderful and are worth every penny.

title: So far so good
text: So far these have worked pretty well as an inexpensive lead refill option. They don't seem to break easily and the line they put down on paper is of decent quality and comparable to the more expensive leads. I will continue to use these and update if the opinions changes, but so far, so good.

title: Good product.

title: Wonderful!
text: These are absolutely wonderful. The paper is fine quality and has the ability to hold even the wettest watercolors without wrinkling or tearing. The design on the back for the postcard is simple, clean and elegant and they are easy to tear out from the book. This is by far the best set of watercolor postcards I have found so far. Will happily reorder.

title: Great eraser!
text: This is the best art eraser that I have founds so far. It is tough on the pencil marks but kind to the paper and doesn't leave a huge mess behind like the pink erasers do. I will definitely buy it again.

title: A rainbow of colour for a good price
text:
These are perfect markers for fine details and to add embellishments to many different craft projects. The marker cap really does reflect the colour of the ink and the pens are comfortable to hold and to use for long periods of time, such as with adult colour books. They will bleed through on very thin paper, but work quite well if you are colouring single-sided pages. I liked the variety of colours in this pack and the way the ink lays down on the paper. There is a pull tab at the top of the package to help easily lift the trays of markers out, so they are convenient as well.

With the cost of these markers being as low as they are and for how long they last, I would definitely say they are worth the investment. These would be a great addition to any artist's supply cabinet.

title: not the best at blending, but still good
text:

These are certainly affordable for the price they are going for here on amazon. The colour of the ink matches the pen well, and overall they are pretty good markers. They last for a long time and have plenty of ink. The only issue I have with them is that they do not blend as well as the more expensive prismacolor sets, and that is one of the things I have come to rely on this brand for.

These are decent pens for the cost and would work well in a variety of applications.

title: Perfect!

I have arthritis and this is the first mechanical pencil that I can use for long periods without it making my hand cramp. The design is nice with a twisty eraser on the top instead of one of those standard, annoying ones that fall out all the time. I would definitely recommend this product to other customers. Very well made at an affordable price.

title: Not quite 50...

The paper is wonderful, but the envelopes leave something to be desired, being either way too large or just barely big enough to fit the cards themselves. I like the canvas style on the paper, but these would not work well if you need a guaranteed exact amount of them. As far as inexpensive note cards, they work okay.

title: lovely greens
text:
Finally! A set of markers that have greens that actually match the cap colour. These work great for adult colour books, with very little bleed, even on the darker colours. These are perfect for the colouring books that are heavy in flora and fauna as they have a good variety of greens and a nice variety of petal colours. The pens are sturdy and can handle a lot of use, so they are ideal for someone who colours a lot.

I have also used these in various other craft applications and they have done very well, even on thinner paper. This would make a great gift for the artist in your life, or just as an addition to the marker sets you already have. I will definitely buy these again.

title: good quality, good price
text:
These are great pens to use with single sided pages in adult colouring books. They also work well for fine details in other art projects, such as scrapbooking or greeting cards. They do tend to bleed a little and you want to be sure they are dry before you run your hand across them as they can smear just a touch, however, drying does not take long at all.

The set has a nice array of colours and they are very close to the cap colour. The pens are comfortable to hold and the tips are nice and strong. The other good news, is that the ink lasts for a long time, so they are ideal for heavy use. I'd buy these again.

title: Very sparkly, very affordable
text:
I went and bought a two pack of these, and then went and bought two more six packs within the following week. These are so much fun to use and they make absolutely stunning additions to craft products. They work very well both on black paper and on white (haven't tried them on colour yet.) I am so impressed with the way the ink lays down on paper and how pretty it looks when it dries. I was afraid it would turn silverish and weird like some gel pens do, but they haven't. They retain their sparkle after drying, even if you rub your finger over them.

I definitely recommend these to other customers looking for a way to embellish their art projects. So much easier to use than glitter glue!

title: Consistent and easy to troubleshoot
text: [[VIDEOID:5f1d38443ae1ceb244b4bb6aebc5ee79]] I have gone through 4 printers in 2 years. They suck. And trying to figure out what’s wrong with them when they freeze up or are unresponsive is so frustrating. I didn’t have high hopes for this one. But, I’ve used it hard for 3 months and I have to say, it’s deserving of 5 stars. But just. Set up took a little longer than printers in the past. I had to link my desk top in a slow, methodical way, following prompts. I could only link 1 of my desk tops. I tried with the 2nd. It’s older, so maybe that’s why. I also downloaded the app on my iPhone. Super quick and easy. The printing quality is good. It’s not award winning. But the ink, one filled, lasts FOREVER!! Praise the Lord I can really “set it and forget it”. I don’t print photos from this. Only labels and documents. The top opens wide and the glass plate is clearly marked where papers should go. The touch screen is large and easy to read. It’s not too loud. And you can read on the touch screen that your item has been “captured” and ready to print. Nice!! There is a back and side flap that opens super easy for paper jams. The paper tray fits about 300 sheets easily and it feeds 1 piece at a time without jamming. The prints feed thru upside down so you can’t initially see if your item printed. It hasn’t been a problem. It’s size it massive. Unless you have dedicated desk space, that may bug you. It’s not a problem for me, just something to consider. Overall, I’m still surprised it’s worked so seamlessly for me. I depend on my printer and am quite happy to recommend this Epson.

I think I'd give this 3.5 stars. It's not a very good value in my opinion. Especially with all the canon options for literally half the price that include all the bells and whistles.
Unpacking was fine. The enclosed booklet illustrated how to take all the tape and cardboard out, and how to fill ink and install cartridges. That was no problem. Will I really get 2 years of printing???? I don't know. If it craps out soon, I'll update review.
Downloading the software to my desktop was A TOTAL PAIN IN THE A@@!!
It takes up quite a bit of internal space too, just fyi. After finally getting set up on PC, I printed a few things out. I got 2 error messages and had to start printing process again. Then, I downloaded app to phone, which was a breeze. I printed several items from my photos and my google docs with no problem. The app is laid out clearly and is easy to navigate. Any messages regarding your current print show up on your phone. The color looks crisp and sharp. However, the printing takes FOREVER. I was amazed at how long everything took. That's a bit of a bummer. If this printer was around $150, I'd say it was totally great, but for the price it actually is, it let me down somewhat.

title: Very cute, smart lay-out.
text: What a cute planner! It's shipped in a sturdy pink gift box with a sweet note and looks so cheerful and simple. I like the layout; the 1st section is a month-at-a-glance for 2020 and 2021. The rear section in week-at-a-glance and the very back is for memories or notes. Each section is divided by a tab. If you choose, you can use 1 of the 2 ribbons sewn in as book markers. I am a little concerned the reinforced paper that the rings are bound in won't hold up for 2 years. It's pretty thin. We are only 1 month into 2020 so I haven't used this long enough to give that feedback yet.

title: Room enough for lots of documents!
text:
This bag is AWESOME! (I am giving it 5 stars even though I haven't tested it completely by setting it on fire) Ha!
The fabric has a somewhat sticky quality to it. There is a small, zippered pouch large enough for an external harddrive, or a camera. There is a larger, legal-sized zippered pouch that fits tons of files; all our tax info over last decade and all our families' legal docs fit nicely in it. These both slip comfortably into the briefcase part, I put sentimental items in that. Lots of room! The best part for me was that it stays sitting up, so it's easy to store and is nice and tidy. A very cool way to start the new year. Organized and safe!

title: Cuter than I expected!
text: Super cute wall rack! It's looks nicer in person than in pictures. Easy to hang with included hardware. Had a slight peppery smell to it upon unpacking. Maybe the stain? The angled shelves hold a normal size book.

title: Excellent product!
text: For such a tiny sharpener, this packs a punch. Sharpens to a super fine and sharp tip. Easy to use, easy to clean. The 4 pack means I get to put in several locations thru house!

title: Wish I would have gotten one of these years ago
text: Every house hold needs one of these, imo! The calendar sticks tight and flush to fridge. The pens (4 included. A variety of colors) mark legibly and the point stays pointy after use. The erasers erase COMPLETELY. All the family members can easily see the upcoming weeks events and there is a space for a list.

title: Rad little invention!
text: My kids use this thing non-stop. I have it out in our living area. They twist on it, try and do a 360* with it while jumping, rock and walk with it, and just simply balance on it. It is such an effective way for all of us to engage our core while just hanging out. It is also really durable. The bottom has a thick plastic cover, adhered super tight, to prevent your floors from getting messed up. It's made from 1 solid piece of wood. The curve is pretty gentle, so even my 6 yr old can use it successfully. It's been a lot of fun to have around.

title: Very cute!
text: Cute picture and message, good size, nice card stock.

title: Solid door stop.
text: Heavier than some but not heavy duty. Super easy to mount. Nice that a template is included. 1 of the screws stripped out upon installing so I ended up using my own hardware. The foot latch works great every single time.

title: Super classy holiday cards.
text: These are the standard Hallmark "gotcha covered" Holiday cards. They mention no specific holiday but look christmassy and festive. There's no logo or writing anywhere on the beige envelope, only a simple and small embossed 'hallmark'. There are 16 cards in the box, with 17 envelopes.

title: Solid feeling pen
text: Nice heavy fountain pen. Feels balanced in my hand. Comes with 3 ink cartridges (1 in housed inside pen upon shipping). Would make a nice gift.

title: Petite cards, very casual.
text: Smaller than I had thought they'd be which gives a very casual, relaxed vibe to the Christmas Card. The Unicorn is darling and the horn and stars above it are glittery. Very cute. Wish the envelope didn't have a big Hallmark logo on it. 6 cards per package.

title: Nice job Hallmark! These are good!
text: Very pretty Christmas cards. These have a sort of country charm to them. The background looks like weathered shiplap. And the cute turquoise snowflakes are a little distressed. I thought the cards were bigger. These are 6.5" long and 4.5" wide. Not too hokey of a message inside, either. The card fits snug in the envelope that is also embellished with white snowflakes.

title: A very lovely blank book.
text: This is a very special handmade journal. It arrives in a soft cloth bag with a signed thank you card. The leather feels soft and nubby and smells rich. The little felt puppy bookmark is a darling, personalized touch. The heavy clasp is magnetic. So there is no fumbling around with a strap and latch. The pages are cream in color and pretty thick. So you can draw or write on the blank pages without fear of your markings bleeding thru to other side.  The book is handbound. It looks like the pages could rip or tear really easy. Mine had stress marks at the stitching.  For that reason, I think this would be best for an adult or a mature older kid who can respect the book for what it is. There's something very special and genuine about this book. It feels solid and heavy and like it would be worthy of holding your secrets, thoughts, observations and drawings.

title: Easy to install!
text: Very easy to assemble and install. The base has to be taken off the coil first because that's where the installation hardware is tucked away. Screw the base plate on, them twist the coil into place and you're done. The plastic gray piece would not come off, no matter how hard I pulled. I wish the coil piece wasn't so thick and chunky looking. I prefer a more slender look. But maybe  that means these will hold up better to the dogs thinking they are a toy.

title: WHAT A GREAT WAY TO STAY ORGANIZED!
text: Nice little plastic trays! For years, our piano books slid all over the top of our piano. I've been meaning to do something about it, and came across these. They are modular,  in that they will stack up together. Pretty securely too! They have little tongue and groove notches on the back and front of each tray. They are low profile, which is also what I wanted. It always makes me very happy each time another zone in my house achieves organization!

title: Cute cart. Nice vibrant color!
text: I like this cart! It came in 7 pieces with 4 wheels/casters. Super easy to assemble. The side click together (see pic) then the baskets are secured with included hardware. They even give you a couple extra screws. Which was good because one of mine was defective. Then, you turn it over and attach casters. **trick to good assembly is to only loosely tighten all hardware till completely assembled. Then, go back and tighten everything completely. No matter what I did though, mine still had a wobble to it.  Bummer. So I took off 1 star for that.

title: Super easy to use. And it works great.
text: My daughter just used this tape to create a picture wall. She's 13. I verbally gave her instructions, and off she went. So, it's literally easy enough for a kid to use. And use well! Her photo wall looks professional! With no nail holes!

title: Such a pretty little pencil holder.
text: This pretty little leather pencil holder is so simple and classy. I like not using plastic products that have to be replaced year after year. This bag looks like it will hold up beautifully and just get softer after using. It will hold dozens of pencils and pens with ample room. The zipper is dyed to match the leather. The zipper end is brass and a simple fish-tail braided leather piece is fitted onto it.

title: Great planner for student
text: My daughter is using this 5x8 planner for the next 12 months. This planner starts July 2019 and goes thru June 2020. She likes the magnetic clasp closure. She can look at the month-at-a-glance easily. There's tons of space for lists and contacts. And in the front there is a place for yearly goals. She likes how thick the paper is and that the hardcover will be durable in her book bag. The material is faux leather and has a soft feel to it. A very well thought out planner!

title: These keychains are so precious!
text: I just gave these to my husband for his Birthday. Are you kidding me with how dang cute they are? They actually fit together and are super shiney. The wording is stamped into the puzzle piece, it's not a decal. They make me smile everytime I look at them!

title: 12 month planner for 7/2019 thru 6/2020
text:
I prefer planner layouts like this. You can plan your week- spread over 2 pages with ample room for all your events. And then a month-at-a-glance spread over 2 pages for quick scanning. This planner does a great job with that. The months are all tabbed for easy access and there's a spot for contacts and important dates right up front. The spiral binding looks like it will be sturdy and hold up and the plastic front and back are very thick. I took 1 star off because I felt the paper could be just a smidge thicker. I put a few pix in review. You can see the lines from other side in one of them.
**This planner is for 12 months only- starting in July 2019 and going thru June of 2020**

title: Really good basic poly folder
text: Basic medium strength 3 prong folder. 2 reinforced interior pockets. Will hold over 50 sheets of paper. Should hold up thru the kids' school year. They always need so many of these- it's nice that it comes in a 3 pack.

title: Great quality, very big
text: Great quality. Just massive. On a normal desk or surface,  there simply isn't enough room for pad. You can see in above pic my mouse in lower left corner for size reference.

title: Easy to use, is holding my sagging door gasket pretty well not as tacky as I thought it would be
text: I used this double-sided tape to try to fix the sagging door gasket on my old truck. I have tried 2 different types of glue on it over the years & so far this is holding a lot better. It was easy to unroll & apply & I used a knife to start peeling off the outside seal. It's not quite as tacky as I thought it would be. Not surprisingly, it stuck to the metal & paint a lot better than the rubber seal. It's mostly holding but one spot has fallen. I'm going to try doubling up the tape in that area because I think a little more thickness would help.

title: Smooth writing & very fine lines, seem smaller than .5mm, pens are slightly smaller than usual
text:
My daughter loves these pens for the colors & the smoothness. These are small pens, smaller than usual, They write smooth & with a very fine line. We double checked the packaging to make sure they are .5mm because the lines look smaller than normal.
There is no yellow in the package but there are 3 pinks. The colors are very close to the cap color except for one of the pinks where the ink is distinct but the caps look very similar. My daughter loves these pens but is still disappointed about the lack of yellow. She says they are very smooth but not the smoothest that she has. I can't speak to the long lasting since we just got them & my daughter is careful to cap them.

title: Fits a lot of stuff, perfect for pencils & erasers but flat doesn't fit thick things
text:
My daughter is a connoisseur of pencil bags because she has hundreds of pencils, pens & markers & tries her best to keep them organized in these bags. She sent me the pictures & the following;
"5 stars it serves its purpose well and I like it has a pocket at the front and a zipper in the back.
Even though it was very flat it still fit quite a lot of stuff in it is perfect for pencils & erasers. It should be noted it is very flat and it doesn't fit thick things in it well."

title: Nice piece, nice price.
text: I had no issues with delamination or being too tightly rolled.  I hung it in my office with pins and started writing on it immediately.  I appreciate that the price is half of what last year's cost since I paid for this one myself.

title: Makes beautiful photos
text: Essential ink for my Epson 3880 photo printer. I’m able to print beautiful photos at home.

title: Best pens ever
text: My most favourite pens! Perfect for writing in my Happy Planner! Love love love.

title: LOVE THEM
text:
Colors are bright with good coverage, Excellent for flat painting--does not leave a thick layer of paint so dries very quickly. Blending is easy if you have the colors you want to blend handy. Of course it depends on what your painting. Paper absorbs quickly and dries even quicker, glass or rocks give you more time to blend. Works on fabric, too, but bear in mind fabric can suck up a lot of paint the longer the nib is in contact with it.

Great control, good for kids because there is no spillage.

title: lots of pages
text: Unlined pages so you can scribble as much or little as you desire. theses are so durable and extremely useful for just about anything--lecture notes, addresses, doodling, sketching and lots more. Great deal for the price.

title: This is NOT easy to set up
text:
Unless you are a computer tech guru, this printer is not easy to set up... I've been trying to set it up for 2 hours now and still no go. My computer has no CD/CDR so I had to download the driver from the website. I have NEVER had a problem downloading drivers for printers--until now. There are no instructions as to which driver to download. You have a choice of 100mb or hpb30mb ?????

I downloaded both and hoped the printer would choose the correct one. NOT. So I hooked up my computer to the printer with a printer cable. Yea! They recognized each other, but it won't print because there is a problem with the network setup. I don't have a network except for the wifi,the computer, the printer. How hard could this be? Apparently, it's too hard for me to fathom.

Even if you think you know what you are doing, get someone who really does know and get them to hook your printer up. This is frustrating beyond belief.

title: Smooth glide
text: No streaking, smooth glide, easy and comfortable to hold, very nice blue color. I think this pen is the best on the market for the price. Love it!

title: Beautiful
text:
Just love these cards. Quite beautiful and love the sentiment. I'm delighted with them.

Hallmark has the best products, and always worth the money. I need to go to the Hallmark store and get another box of these to send to friends and family.

title: Adorable and very nice
text:
These are the cutest cards. I can't wait to send them to my grandchildren, I know they will love them!

Excellent Hallmark product with the kind of sentiment you expect from Hallmark.

title: A little slow to print
text:
While this doesn't print as fast as my old HP, it certainly prints the most beautiful photos I've ever seen an ink jet do. Looks incredibly professional.

The document printing is a little faster. Clear, precise, and the wi-fi printing works like a charm. Love it! Absolutely love it. No more getting up to hook up my laptop to the printer. I just print and go. Printing photos from my phone is a dream now.

The set up is so easy. Just plug in, load the ink cartridges in their correct color slot, download the driver, and print. Super easy.

title: This is an amazing machine. It gobbles up paper so quick by ...
text:
This is an amazing machine. It gobbles up paper so quick by the time you've let go of one handful and get another it's ready for the next handful. The 19 sheet capacity is 19 sheets of 20# bond paper. Much less of cardboard and heavy stock. However, it takes it like a trooper. It even takes the occasional staple or two. The instructions don't say "no staples" but when one went in, the machine stuttered (didn't stop, just stuttered). I wouldn't give it a continual diet of staples especially if you want to keep the blades sharp.

It came with a pad of soy oil, but no instructions how to use it. I figure you use it to oil the blades like you do hair shears.

This thing is really quiet. My old one was so loud you had to quit talking while it was going. This one is really quiet. It's black, and it is compact, fits in a small space by my door. We shredded hundreds of sheets of paper without it overheating. The instructions say if it ever does overheat, let it sit for a while and when the light turns green, it's good to go again. But we shredded paper for more than half an hour and no problems.

title: Great product, and it is a LOT of protective ...
text: Great product, and it is a LOT of protective film. Perfect for posters and other projects, but I use it to protect my grandchildren's artwork. It is easy to use (not as easy as lamination). It's really clear so no color distortions. Worth the money.

title: Very nice gift for Star Wars fan
text:
I am reviewing Sheaffer Fine Writing Instrument Fountain Pen (E0920851S) NOT Cross Men's Reader Glasses.

Well, it doesn't have the Star Wars logo on it, but, it does have Darth Vader's name on it with his helmet.

It is sleek and writes like a dream. I really prefer blue ink, but this black gel ink is very striking on white paper. It doesn't smudge. The pen glides so smoothly across the page you hardly realize you are writing. I really love this pen! Another great thing about the pen is it's weight. A lot of the really expensive pens are fat and very heavy. This one is just the right weight so that you can maneuver it easily, but not so heavy your finger get tired holding it. It's heavier than a Bic or Papermate, but lighter than a Montblanc.

The gift box is very neat with Star Wars logo, and all black. Very nice gift

title: Not Hallmark quality!
text: I thought that with this being a Hallmark product it would be gorgeous. It is no different than a $1 card I can get at the dollar store. I love Hallmark products, and this one was a huge disappointment. I've had this for a month and still have not mailed it to my sister because I wanted it to be so special. It is not. Most of the products I get from the Vine Program are top notch, and I give very favorable reviews. I'm sorry that I cannot do this for this one.

title: Broke after 2 days, DO NOT BUY!
text: DO NOT BUY! First of all, with regular pencils, you have to force the pencil down to get it sharpened. The first day, its easy, but after a day, the sharpener gets annoyed. Looks like some other people had the same problem.

title: Good Large Envelopes
text: I bought these for a specific mailing this time but it is always good to have these around for all kinds of things. Great buy and happy with my purchase.

title: Freezer System By Color Dot
text: I bought these to make a freezer system storage for my freezer bags. Instead of writing out what is in the bags or TV Dinner Trays I now have a system of colors and a coding ...IE: Yellow = Chicken Thighs, Red = Ground Chuck, etc. I then tape it onto the lid of my chest freezer and the outside side of my big upright freezer. Now I or anyone in my family can tell at a glance what is what in the freezers. I will need to get some different colors since I make a lot of different TV Dinners but these are a good start.

title: Sharpies Are Always The Best!
text: I bought these to use on my labels for the herbal/homeopathic/Flower Remedies I make for family and friends. You can never go wrong with Sharpies! I like the fine point as it is perfect for writing on the labels and I don't have to worry about it getting rubbed off in time.

title: Good Adherence

text: I make Micro Macrame jewelry and use these for holding the cords when I'm working on a project. They are also used for holding a wig on a head stand if that is what you need.

title: Got My Moneys Worth
text: Made well and good price.

title: Wonderful For The Adult Colorist
text: I bought these for my hubby who is a new colorist. He loves them and I will be buying them again.

title: Fantastic As Always!
text: What can I say...Sharpies are always great! I have been using them ever since they came out eons ago. My hubby recently got into the grownup coloring books and I bought this pack for him to do backgrounds as he wanted one with a wider tip. He loves them!

title: Great Markers For Artists
text: My retired hubby has gotten into coloring books so I've  been slowly buying him supplies. He loves these markers to give his "works of art" a pop here and there. Already being an artist, he knows how to use them to advantage.

title: Good magnetic erasers, if oddly patriotic?
text:
As far as erasers go, they seem to work well on dry erase boards, or at least as well as any other I've tried. I like the magnetic part, they can stick to most metal-backed white boards or the front of my fridge (where we used to have a little magnetic whiteboard for family notes).

My son loves it, he's got a whiteboard setup where he plays office at home, and the fact that there are six in a box means my other kids can share them too. I have to be honest though, the USA logo on it seems a bit superfluous, I don't understand why I'd need that on my erasers. I don't think they add much value to the product but hey, maybe you're into patriotic themed erasers. If you are, these definitely do the trick!

title: 8 Basic notebooks with fun colors
text: This is exactly what I expected it to be: 8 basic notebooks. You get 4 colors, and 2 of each color. They aren't particularly fancy or anything, but they serve the intended purpose. My kids needed some additional paper notebooks for school, and thanks to the colors they could each pick individual ones for classes and we still have some more in reserve for the next set of classes.

title: Cool printer, disappointing app
text:
This comes with enough paper for 100 prints, which can have the backs removed to become stickers! The color coming out out is not incredibly vivid, but I've used similar insta-print cameras and this is pretty much standard par for the course. This is more for retro-looking novelty printing, which it does very well. The printer is relatively quick and easy to use too. The only issue I have with it is the app.
The app is kind of slow to respond, and very limited in use. I did not like how many permissions it needed or that it required to make an account with my email (I used a throwaway email address). Feels like all that is so unnecessary, I'm not looking to save anything to the cloud or anything like that, why do I need to make an account? Just let me connect to the printer and print locally! Removing a star for the app experience, but at least 4 stars for the fun novelty printer.

title: Good for encouraging journaling
text:
This is perfect for my daughter who wanted something to keep her thoughts and personal notes in. It's adorable, and the cover material is more soft and plush than we originally expected. Very squishy.
The pen comes with a replacement insert, this is really designed to last. The lock was a little bit difficult for my daughter to use- changing the code was a bit of a challenge, and the problem is that when it is open, anyone else in the room can see the code while the flap isn't closed. She tried to change it frequently for that reason, and found it rather delicate and difficult to change often. But otherwise, a really solid journal and a great gift!

title: Great for teachers or office
text: This is a very respectable set for all your staple related needs. Don't be misled by the title, there are only 10 staplers included here, the other 2 items are the staple puller/removers. The staplers are pretty decent, not too cheap feeling and there's plenty in the kit to go around if you work in an office environment. My wife works in a school so there is no shortage of needs, not to mention 2 of them went to my kids to bring for their own school supplies. For what you get, it seems like a good value.

title: Great for back to school
text:
I have kids who wanted correction tape instead of white out in their school supplies. I was looking at some of the store brand alternatives when I got a chance to try this product out. And I'm so glad I did! These are actually pretty great, and you get plenty in the package (so my kids each got enough in colored dispensers of their choosing).
It seems to work as well as any others I have tried, feels like a good value on a decent product!

title: Quality durable notebook
text: I love journals like these, I use them for personal notes on classes I'm taking via audiobooks. They look classy, have a strap to hold it closed as well as a bookmark which makes it great to carry around or throw in a bag. And honestly it just feels really fancy to use. This is not my first one in this style, and I can honestly say it holds up just as well as the others I've tried. Great product!

title: Mini sized journals!
text: These are adorable and super high quality little journals. I've been using a more full-sized version of this for my own notes, and my kids wanted something similar for their own journaling. Honestly, I kind of love these. Pictured here is my full sized book next to these two side-by-side. As you can see, they are literally half sized, as both together make up the size of a full height notebook. The bookmark thread and elastic band to hold it closed is exactly as expected from their larger counterpart. And the etched tree embossed on the cover adds just the right amount of class. Really solid product.

title: Excellent for labels and stickers!
text:
I have used similar products in the past to print labels to place on my equipment when used at jobs- light stands, cameras, microphones... I love having custom sizes and shapes with my logo and contact info in case anything gets misplaced, and doubles as a little advertisement for my business when people see it. I fill a full sized page with different sizes and varieties, and cut them out as needed.
My kids love this too, we can print faces and characters for them to put on their notebooks and school supplies.
One thing I noticed is that unlike some other vinyl sticker paper, this was actually much easier on the loading mechanism. These things are usually notorious for getting jammed when loading, but so far this has gone pretty well without any hangups. The back is still a little bit hard to peel at first, but that's par for the course. I think for what it is, this is an excellent product that I'd highly recommend for customization.

title: Great value on your pocket and the environment!
text:
What's better than a genuine Bic pen made out of recycled materials? How about a seemingly life time supply of them!
Let's face it, nobody enjoys throwing away plastic, but it's necessary sometimes. With this, I'm pretty sure my household won't need pens for a long time, and they seem to be all the quality of material and function that I expect from standard Bic pens! No compromises made, just solid pens and the knowledge that it supports less plastic waste, no matter how small of a dent. And the bulk packaging here means more green on your wallet too!
I actually really prefer the look of the body of these pens as well - they are a clear body with green etched markings. Very cool looking, and write just as well as any other standard Bic. I'm impressed and would recommend this product!

title: Perfect, and exactly what I wanted and needed it to be
text: These are exactly what you'd expect- 4x6 blank index cards, wrapped in 5 packs of 100 each. I love that they are separated so you don't end up with a loose pile of 499 cards when you take out the first one, and the quality of the paper is spot on. title: Exactly what we wanted
text:
