They are not as sticky as post its or other name brand sticky notes, so perhaps it would not stick so well to a monitor or dry erase board, but for school note taking, they work.

title: Ok magnet, terrible adhesion
text:
The good: The magnets work, you know... magnetically. They can stick to metal like your fridge, and you can use several of them for heavier items if needed. Pretty simple.

The bad: While the magnet part sticks, the sticky adhesive back part is awful. The adhesive barely holds on to anything heavier than a paper. If you want to hold up a small dry erase board, for example, you can use as many magnets as you want, and the board will fall after a day or so. The magnets still on the fridge, just the board on the floor. They won't stay on. I even have a small light plastic name tag that fell down.

The package itself, in fact, came with almost half the magnets off the backing paper and just floating around the the bag. I was going to ignore it as a fluke of shipping, but I see that other reviews are complaining of the same thing. And now that I've seen it fall off of things with my own eyes that aren't that heavy, I can attest to the fact that the adhesive side is utter trash. Its the product that is faulty.

I was able to get around this by using super glue to attach the tiles to my whiteboard and plastic tag and it has been fine ever since. So you CAN make use of these by using your own glue/adhesive, but sadly I can't recommend them knowing you can buy similar products that will work out of the package. If you get this very very inexpensively, you can "fix it" using glue like I did. Hence 2 stars. Otherwise, I'd recommend looking elsewhere.

title: Great set for home phones
text:
Sure, we live in a mostly cell phone age, but we've got multiple kids at home and having a home landline phone is still a necessity. This is an EXCELLENT set to cover your home. Our previous set was also a Panasonic but it was over a decade old and only a single handset (used to be 2 but one had been long broken). Going to a brand new 4-handset system is quite the upgrade!
I particularly like the intercom function, so if I'm working late in my home office with headphones on, I can be paged from the kitchen handset using the intercom function like a walkie talkie (better than yelling across the house!). These also have Bluetooth which seems to work both to connect to a headset as well as acting AS a headset (for those of us who don't want to hold a cell phone to our ears all day!). They look really sleek and have excellent range around our home. I couldn't be more pleased with it, it's exactly what I wanted it to be.

text: These are exactly what I wanted them to be: No frills dry-erase markers. They go on easy, don't make a mess all over my fingers and clothing, and wipe away with a board eraser as expected. title: Good value on a lot of large binders
text:

The ONLY caveat I could find is that a sticker label does come on the spine which you'll need to remove in order to put a label in the pocket. It is an unfortunate choice to put a sticker there, however it is not unique to this product. I've had to peel off adhesive price tags and other labels which required some product like Goo B Gone or similar adhesive dissolver. Thankfully, with some careful fingernail picking, I was able to get the sticker off this without any additional product, so I guess I can't complain too much. I still wish the manufacturer did not do that, but at the end of the day you have a very functional thick binder that works as expected.

text:

The box sort of implies you can also turn it upside and use it as an adult-size bouncy sit toy. I tried that, it's a little too large to do that comfortably so I wouldn't buy it for that. But as a large exercise ball with optional legs, it's pretty good. Just have realistic expectations about what the legs are.

title: Cute but the side decorations are odd... Where is mum on Friday night?!
text:
I like the idea behind this planner, especially as my family is quarantined together currently due to the Coronavirus and we are trying to keep everyone to a schedule to stay sane. It's a nice large size and easy for everyone to read and write on.
It works well for organizing and planning and the kids are really into it, but the design is a little bit... odd. Around the border it has decoratory messages like "Who is taking me to school" and "What will dad do on Sunday morning?" and my personal favorite "Where is mum on Friday night?". Seriously, what kind of specific and possibly chauvinistic questions are they trying to imply on this thing? Also, as an American, no one I know calls their mother "mum". This is one of those situations in which less is more, I think. They should have left the border blank, this feels odd and strangely out of place in our home, it makes me wonder who this was really designed for. The description says great for a family or student house, etc... what student house wants to know what mum is doing on Friday night, and then why have a spot that says "the _ family" on top? I have so many questions about the motivation behind this thing. I think I'll be replacing this with a more vanilla and less bizarre planner when I get a chance.

title: Needs instructions.
text:

It took me a while to figure out how it works, and this whole experience could have been greatly improved with a simple printout that shows how to remove the spring from the base.
Basically, the spring twists out of the base and reveals a plate with a screw inside. Screw that plate into the wall, and then the spring screws back in similar to how keys go on a keychain (fish the edge of the spiral in and twist). Now that I know, it would be really easy to install another one. Maybe others already know this from experience, but personally I found it difficult for a newbie to figure out.

title: High end, does everything well!
text:
[[VIDEOID:5b44d012d91d354afa4071c22e72f0b]] This machine is impressive. I own other all-in-one devices and usually feel like there is a compromise somewhere, but I really don't with this one.
I've also owned other WiFi printers, but this one is hands down the easiest and fastest to set up. It helps a lot that there is a touch screen display to set up your wireless info and control a lot of the functions without a computer connected to it at all. You honestly only need to plug in the power cable and install the ink cartridges - no USB or anything else necessary.
One thing to note before I go further- if you get one of these and are trying to figure out how to install the ink, it has visual instructions on a card (shows a picture of the printer and arrows for each step to get into where the ink goes). The visual instructions are easy, but without words there was actually one step I didn't understand. Apparently, you need to get underneath the scanning bed, which lifts by a hinge. That part is clear, and in order to get that open you need to lift the feeder part to pull the panel in front of the printer towards you. But with that panel open, I couldn't get the scanning bed to lift... the right side seemed willing, but the left felt like it was held down by something I was going to break by pulling too hard. Turns out, you're supposed to PUT THE FEEDER BACK DOWN after opening the front panel, only THEN can the entire scanning bed and feeder lift up to reveal the print head area. I feel like I was moments away from breaking the plastic before I realized that, and really wish HP would explain that better in the instructions (maybe even have some words to make it clearer). I'm including a video to illustrate, this probably sounds strange if you can't see what I'm talking about.
But aside from that, this is the best printer I've ever used so it still deserves 5 stars. The mobile phone app is excellent, and I was able to print directly from my camera roll without going to the computer first. I was also able to scan documents to a laptop wirelessly (great that I got this in time for tax season!), and I feel like I've only skimmed the surface of what I can do with the Smart Tasks and customizable shortcuts features.
I also really like that is uses individual ink cartridges for each color. I have an older color printer that used only 2 carts: one black one and one color one, so if I printed a lot of one color I needed to buy a new color cartridge, even if the others still had 90% of their ink left. Not with this model! I also really like that the black ink is MUCH larger than the color ones, since they know it will be used more often. It feels like the ink system has been designed with a lot of thought for efficiency. I haven't set up the automatic refill order thing because I don't like automatic payments and would rather be in control of when I buy more ink personally, but I know a lot of people who would really appreciate this feature. You can pay monthly depending on how many pages you want to guarantee, and HP will send you as many cartridges as you need to hit that goal. This is useful for those who want to run their office expenses as a monthly increment and avoid any downtime to find and order more ink after you run out.
All in all, I'm really pleased with this product.

title: Solid storage option
text:
The box is lightweight, but sturdy aluminum casing I believe. It looks great, and will be able to take some drops/knocks.
As advertised, it will hold at least 80 slabbed coins. It has 4 rows that you could probably fit 21 in each, although it would be tight. I was not aware when I ordered it, but the rows do NOT have notches for each coin, so the amount of space between coins is up to you. I am using this to house my slabbed silver State Quarter collection, which is about 60 coins. I have ~ 15 per row, and it gives them plenty of room to have some space between each coin, and year.
After storing them for a bit and moving it around and coming back to it, my coins were in exactly the same place I put them. They are staying securely.
This is a nice big box, which is hard to find for 50+ slabs, the only knock being that the foam is not individually slotted.

title: Does the job!!!
text:
My kids are being home schooled this fall because our schools are closed due to Covid. My youngest isn't old enough to use the laptop for many activities and she does most of her work old school (with paper and a pencil). I would also consider her a perfectionist and she is constantly insisting on erasing even the smallest of mistakes. So I can't tell you how excited she was to get this eraser!
It works really well at erasing both heavy and light marks alike. And doesn't tear the paper at all. And it's far quicker than a traditional eraser. I know that sounds like a silly point to make, but when your 6 year old insists on erasing three dozen times over twenty minutes you get kinda desperate to for anything that speeds up the process. The pencil sharpener that comes with it is great, she also loves it. We'd both highly recommend this set.

title: Feels durable!
text:
This is one heavy duty pencil sharpener! It really is "heavy" too; which is great because it doesn't wobble around while the motor is running. I recently had to sharpen 96 pencils(!!!) for our kid's back to school season and this was a life saver. It did a great job and my hands didn't hurt when it was all over. It was quick, worked great and is super efficient. It's easy to see when the tray is full and just as easy to dump the shavings.
But school restarted a month ago and they've already been re-closed due to covid. We're back to homeschooling. So this sharpener has earned a temporary spot on a living room book shelf. My kids are having a little too much fun sharpening their pencils with it every day. We'd all highly recommend it!

title: These are great!
text: It's fall of 2020, and our schools have only reopened part time (due to Covid). Some of the new changes include "everything must be labeled, including food" and "no more water fountains". And they're big and colorful, making them easy to spot on a variety of packaging. I even have room to write a little extra message like "I love you" under their names. And they're plenty sticky. I highly recommend the labels!!!

title: Completely inaccurate when measuring small packages that weight only a few ounces
text:
Absolutely terrible for small packages!
I resell on ebay and the majority of my packages are very small.... weighting between 1oz and 8oz.
I've tested this exact model THREE different times. Yes, three!, My mom also bought herself one and my sister one for Xmas based on the reviews.
Depending on where the package is set on the tray, I can get a reading difference of up to .5 ounces off!! And I'm not talking that far left of the tray vs the center of the tray. Even dead center verses half an inch to any side will result in a different reading.
Sometimes my profit margins are small on the auctions, and I can't afford to "guess" or "round up" on every package. I'd loose a ton of money. I recently figured out that after "rounded up about 25% of the time (because I didn't trust this scale), I was probably giving the post office another $20 a month . Completely inexcusable.
Oh, and the battery cover has fallen off of all three of ours already!!!!!!!!!

title: Third time buying this!
text:
This is the third time I've bought this mousepad from Innovera. When I first saw it online, I thought its biggest selling point would be its price. At $12, or thereabouts, it really is a steal.
Then I actually got it and was blown away by all the other qualities. First of all, it doesn't need to be adjusted to. I got it and my wrist just automatically found the best ergonomic position. The most important factor is the gel wrist pad. Its amazingly comfortable and soft without being too plush and provides great stability. Despite the material, it doesn't stick to your hand. And it's contoured in such a way as to provide a very natural resting position for your wrist and hand. I use it all day for work and gaming and have never ever had any complaints.
Second is the lightly textured surface of the actual mouse pad. I like the physical responsiveness I feel through this texture. It provides a great gliding surface for my mouse without sending it flying away.
Finally the sticky back (the underside) of the pad keeps anchored firmly in whatever position you decide for it.
All of this makes this my favorite mouse pad. I'll keep buying them whenever their lifespan reaches their natural course.

title: Love this laptop table!
text:
PROS: Large enough to hold 17" laptop, mouse, cell phone, small notebook & pen. "Leather" surface keeps devices from sliding off when slightly tilted, and sliding stopper keeps laptop in place even at max tilt. I do wish there was a stopper to keep the mouse from sliding off when tilted. Height adjustment goes higher than most competitors and the base is wider and deeper. Sled legs are stable and slide easily on table or bed, and fold down for storage. Tablet holder at the back of the tray is wide enough to hold an iPad, and there's a separate tablet holder which can be placed anywhere on the tray and will fit next to my 17" laptop and still leave room for my mouse in front of it.

CONS: The pros far outweigh the cons. I do wish there was a stopper to keep the mouse from sliding off when tilted. The storage drawer is super tight and difficult to open; I have to use both hands to do so. I'm sure a little WD-40 or silicone lubricant would help. I have a heavier laptop (5 pounds) and when the tray is at medium tilt or greater on the bed, the tray falls forward. I think that's a function of the sled feet, which are less stable on a bed than traditional X-shaped sides/feet. However, the sled feet are so much easier to move around a bed that I gladly accept the slight instability as a trade-off.

I would definitely buy this again, and I highly recommend it!

title: unsatisfactory-ness of life, book holders
text:
Four stars is probably the highest rating available for a book holder until consumer priorities change and it makes sense for companies to dump money into R&D.

This one is clever and offers a lot that others don't. It is by far the best i've used for small paperbacks, but book holders are really more handy for things that are unwieldy to hand hold - art books, anthologies, etc.

So, yeah - this is the best of its kind, which isn't saying much. It feels cheap and slightly fragile, though less so than any other I've tried, excepting a stainless steel holder my wife found at a kitchen store (not that it's a good holder - just _sturdy_).

For me the best combo available in 2021 is this book stand, plus any of the big, wooden ones with rubber-tipped, spring steel arms to hold the book open. That duo covers my needs closer to satisfactorily than anything else I've tried.

Maybe it would be useful to say something about why am I still messing with paper codices when I have extremely convenient alternatives in the digital realm, e.g. Zotero + PDF.

I haven't reasoned it all out, but I can say for sure that paper is durable in a way that digital stuff won't be any time soon - maybe they will invent durable digital media, maybe if Wall Street or the military wants it? Anyway, if someone 100 years from now is in the right place - a used bookstore, an estate sale, a thrift store - they might find the very books that I'm reading today. The Kindle books I "bought" 2 years ago have already evaporated and it would take some work on my end to find them again.

So that's a big part of it. I like to think I'm making a teensy contribution to the preservation of the printed word during a time when the idea of its unimportance is spreading like a gasoline fire - the way bad ideas do...

Also my experience of reading a physical book is different. Aesthetically, sure, but there's more to it than that. Like I said, I haven't thought this through, but there's something there. Nostalgia, sure. Maybe just that it's not a video screen, which maybe is permanently tainted ignoble in my mind - by association with entertainment and "social" media?

IDK the text is never the dream, and the medium is never the text. I just feel like more of it remains on a beautifully set paper page than on an imperceptibly flickering screen.

title: Base AND exalted.
text:
This is my favorite roller pen of all time. I have tried MUCH more expensive pens and refills - I still hold onto my LAMY's because I love the design - but nothing can touch the G2 0.5mm - the refill AND the pen.

I scrape the logos off with a razor blade. That's enough to make me feel okay about using this pen.

I used to use fountain pens for everything, but I got back into cycling this year and that shakes up the pen in my pocket like a paint mixer at a hardware store. So I had to go back to roller pens for when I'm mobile. I tried really hard to find a "nice" pen but the closest I came was LAMY pens that can be made to take the G2 0.5mm refills. And I still like the G2 pen better. I kinda hate the fact that my taste gravitated to the cheapest, most popular thing on the planet, but I have to either be honest and use the best thing for me, or risk becoming a hipster LOL.

I settled on the 0.5mm refill pretty early on. It writes a great line and has the best feel for me on the paper I use. I gernally buy just the refills and keep using the same pen, but I lost my last G2 on vacation and figured a 12-pack is probably a lifetime supply for me. I feel really gross about buying disposable things, but I appeal to the case that I tried everything else before I resorted to this.

I would recommend anyone to visit the local pen store and really try to find an elegant, suitable pen that will last for a lifetime - generations. If that fails, don't feel too bad about using G2 0.5mm; it really is a great - all time great - pen.

text:
This seemed expensive, but now that I have it, I see it is very well made and well worth the money! It is very well designed and easy to use. It has little stickers on it at all the right places to tell you how it works. I got the large version and I am glad I did because it gives me more space to fit my Surface Pro keyboard and monitor and also a portable external monitor in the book holder using the slot at the top and there is till room for and 8 1/2 x 11 page of notes.

Some examples of the thoughtful design are that the book holder has a place for it to be stored on the underside of the lap desk. There was a sticker there forcing you to read the instructions about which direction to pull the book holder out from where it clips in to be stored. The book holder fits into the slot at the top and it also has fold out arms, so if you want to use it on any surface without putting it in the slot, you can do that also. The surface of the lap desk is a little bit textured. It is enough that I can lay my phone on it when I have the lap desk at an angle and it does not slide down. It is not always enough though to keep my mouse from sliding down (depends on how much tilt I put on the desk), however, there is a tiny lip just above the slot at the bottom (the one that holds the laptop stopper) that keeps the mouse from sliding off the lap desk. The fold out legs are simple to use and seem very sturdy. The "slide" design of the legs work very well to be able to slide the desk across the mattress (if you're working while sitting in bed) and the legs are spaced well so that the lap desk is pretty steady even though on a soft surface. The little drawer is perfect to store some pens, so they are easily accessible. The little slot at the bottom can also hold two pens end to end and is deep enough that you can rest your wrists over top of that slot while you're typing on a laptop and can't feel the pens. I don't have a light clipped to my lap desk yet, but it is designed so that one would be easy to clip on. The slot at the top works well to hold an iPhone.

This is a great addition to my COVID-19 mandated work from home situation and even though I have a good home office set up, I'm not sure I'm going to want to go back to sitting at the desk all day now that I have this option!

title: Love this Laptop bed tray/table
text: My husband surprised me with this in June and I still love it!  It gets used daily in a variety of ways.  I use it level to put on make-up in or do bills.  Then I change the angle, put my laptop on it ready to work!  Could also be used to hold a book. Because it is also adjustible height and angle positions I have used in bed and on recliner couch.  It has a place at bottom and top where I put pen, pencil or even paper clips.  It also has a small side drawer on left that holds an attachment  that slips in lower pen holder slot so laptop or other does not slide off when at angle. Drawer could also hold other small items.  Bottomline... hubby did good!!

title: Great buy
text: Super easy to use, love the adjustable heights and the tilt of the table. I also love how wide it is to be able to fit a laptop and a book/phone/mouse. The book holder is great feature to have as well.

title: Super smooth writing
text: I bought these because they were described as being as “smooth as Kristi Yamaguchi on ice” and they were not wrong.

title: Heavy duty and we'll made with little extras
text: Really handy but just oversized for some places like the couch.  I like all the little extras like the multiple ways the legs adjust and the tray.  Looking forward to using it in the car and in our UV.

title: Good for lots of things
text: We use as a coin and pen keeper for our cars.  The clear window makes it easy to find things easily.

title: Very nice!
text: Great little printer scanner!  Works very well and is fast enough for its size.  Wireless works flawlessly.

title: Trust me -- don't buy cheap staples.  These are worth the money.
text: Great staple.  It's worth the money to buy the more expensive ones.  Cheap ones tend to break off or get stuck in the stapler but these work great.

title: Good folders and good value.
text: Very crisp, well-made folders.  They are a good value.

title: Great toner and best price I have found.
text: Great toner and this is the best price I can find.  I have two Canon printers for my home business and this is great toner and very reasonable priced.  I can't tell you how many pages I get from a cartridge but I do feel it is a great value because I have owned other brands of printers before and I feel like I am always buying cartridges.  These give a clean print and are easy to install.

title: Works great - worth the money
text: Works great!  Gives a clean stamp each time and is a good size.

title: Great for working in bed or on a recliner.
text: This is exactly what I had in my when I went searching for a solution to do some work in bed. I’m 6’1 with hips that don’t lie and I had plenty of room.

title: Great product!!
text: It’s the best quality multipurpose tray table I found. Wasted money on cheaper alternatives and finally found this one that will last and meet all my needs. Best purchase! I bought the extra large but I think the smaller size will be sufficient for me.

title: Comprehensive planner
text: A little bit of everything, from daily, weekly, monthly, to budgeting and goal setting, this planner has it all.  I like that it is undated, because I go through phases of using a planner so I can put it down and pick it up and track the days out of order.  Love it.

title: Weird
text: These are a little weird.  They seem really cheap and I am not 100% sure how they work.  They don't seem to work they way the pictures show.

title: Easy to use
text: These provide a great way to identify contents of baskets or bins.  They easily clip on and you can easily write on them, erase and change the label.

title: Didn't receive clear ones
text: Although I did not receive the clear ones - I actually received ones that are more opaque, it doesn't seem to make a difference when displaying information in the stand.  They work fine.

title: Looks good, works ok
text: The printer looks like a high end printer and looks impressive.  It works pretty well and does the job.

title: Cute and effective
text: Reward stickers from little ones.  Brings smiles when they receive a sticker on their chart.  It is really important though that they earn the stickers or they will lose their meaning.  Would also be good for sticker activities which kids really love.  good quality and lots of variety.

title: Nice pack of receipt books
text: I like being able to write up the order and then hand it off to the cashier.  Helps me track sales and rather than just emailing a receipt (which I still do), the customer also has a physical receipt.  These are useful for business.  If I had little kids at this point, would be great for play too.

title: Not doing the trick
text: Having some issues with sitting so much and I hoped this would give me some pain relief, but it isn't working for me.  I couldn't give it less than 4 stars because it is well made an comfortable, just not addressing my specific issues.

title: These are fun!
text: I needed something for my retail display and these are almost perfect.  I feel like they are a little flimsy, but they do the trick.  I wish they were able to go a little lower, but all in all they will do the trick.

title: Nice adult party favors
text: These are cute little inspiration pocket size notepads.  Would be great as a party favor for a party.  The quality of them is just ok but its a great idea.

title: Flimsy
text: It may have been my misunderstanding, but I thought these were cardstock weight.  The paper is super flimsy and definitely smaller than I anticipated.  Overall, not what I expected.

title: Great labels
text: Great price on these labels.  Plenty of room for writing the what and the when to keep track and use items first in first out.  No issues with writing or clarity of the labels.  They may be the perfect size.

title: Nice cutter
text: Nice to have a paper cutter - the arm is lightweight and has a good safety feature holder.  The blade is sharp and cuts through paper easily.  I haven't tried with multiple sheets but I don't really need it for that.  Solid product.

title: Arrived damaged
text: Unfortunately this was a bent mess when it arrived.  Just thrown in a box with no cushion around it.  The brass plated metal must be very cheap.  Super disappointed.

title: Disappointed
text: I like the idea of these and for more than just money wraps.  Unfortunately, the adhesion is just not sufficient.  The paper quality is good, lightweight but just not usable without using scotch tape.  A little disappointed on these.

title: Nice little printer
text: Small compact printer - great for on the go when I am away from my computer.  The print quality is what you would expect - just ok but does the job for quick labels to print.

title: Nice pocket printer
text: Great for printing labels for products or even helpful when labeling storage bins etc.  Printer sets up easily and works reasonably well.  Not professional print quality but pretty good for small projects.

title: Very farmy!
text: Nice setup for keys and mail.  Not sure about the chalkboard.  I had a little trouble with the install but made it work.  Looks great with my black and white decor.

title: Great storage
text: Love the black and white colors of this organizer.  It has multiple slots for organizing incoming mail and segregating items for filing.  This is really helpful in keeping me organized with incoming mail, processing payments due and filing.

title: Great for small spaces
text: This is a sturdy frame and nice, smooth movement.  I was able to order a top from Ikea to put on the frame and its works perfectly.  If you have multiple monitors, this desk would be too small but great for small spaces.  I keep this just inside the door and take outside when the weather is nice, grab my laptop and enjoy the outdoors while working.

title: HIstory lessons in a calendar
text: I love this calendar.  I don’t have the greatest memory and I am not sure I really paid attention in history class way back when.  This calendar is a great way to remember our history and really see how far we have come and how far we still need to go.  Looking forward to all of the things that I will re-learn this year by using this daily calendar.  Great gift.

title: Where’s the packing tape when you need it?
text: I have enough packing tape now and should not have to wonder where it is any more.  Great set of 6 rolls.  Nice big rolls and fit a standard tape gun.  Great adhesion and clear.  Great buy.

title: We love these.
text: We’re a lavender farm, and had been looking for something “farmy” to use for thank you notes for our customers.  These are really cute and are large enough for a nice handwritten note inside.  These are perfect for us.

title: Read the fine print!
text: When I chose these, I saw Legal and I thought they were legal size but they are much smaller than expected.  They will still come in handy for note-taking and I like the narrow rule.  I like that they come in a pack - I am always looking for something to write on, so these smaller notepads will be perfect for that and I can put them where I need them whenever I am looking for something to write on - one of the benefits of being a smaller notepad

title: Lavender rubber bands for bundling lavender!
text: This is a great pack of rubberbands and very useful for our farm.  We are cutting and bundling flowers and these are very sturdy and we love the color too.  Its great to find rubber band packs that are cost effective and come in large quantities like this.

title: Essential
text: Three generations under one roof  - hard to keep track of everyone’s activities without a calendar.  This is a good one - room to write the where and whens to help us keep up.  Now it’s just a matter of everybody filling in their events!  Nice calendar.

title: Two-way rest
text: Love that this can just be used as a foot rest - a very comfortable one - or can be turned over and rocked for a little leg exercise!  Great shape - looks nice under the desk, and flips over quickly to become an exerciser!  Great idea!  Good covering, easy to clean (or vacuum).  Love it!

title: Easy to use
text: This works great for labeling things you are organizing.  It produces a very presentable label quickly.  I wish it had come with more than one roll of paper, as it’s easy to get carried away!  Good choice!

title: All important papers
text: We live in fire country, so it’s important to be able to grab everything that will be needed to start over if the worst happens.  This is a very sturdy document storage bag - it holds a lot, and is fireproof and waterproof.  Just what we needed.  Very pleased.

title: We’ll be doing some shipping...
text: Just gearing up to be able to ship some of our lavender products, and we’re pleased to find these very sturdy boxes which will really work well.  We can apply our stickers and priority mail a very respectable package.  The size is perfect for us so it’s good to have found this source when we’re ready to order more.  Good choice!

title: Great gift
text: This  is a great gift for the teenager who is decorating their room - these picture boards are very popular with the younger group.  This board is also good for the kitchen, where you want to put up pictures and mementoes.  Fun to fix up - and a good activity for everyone!  A good quality board with stuff to help you get started.

title: Great for shipping labels
text: This does a perfect job on shipping labels - we just wonder why it was made to do shipping labels only.  We should have read the fine print, as we have all kinds of labels we want to print, and like the job this does, but it isn’t set up to print anything else.  Great for the people who do a lot of shipping.

title: Lots of colors!
text: One problem, as highlighters, if you are highlighting something you just wrote with a pen, these highlighters may smear a bit.  If you are using them to highlight writing in a book, no problem, so the caveat is, let your writing dry completely before highlighting!  We love all the colors - one of the widest ranges we’ve seen.  Good choice!

title: We love these!
text: So easy to just attach these to our bags that hold bundles, candles, oils, sachets, etc. - we grow lavender and love being able to say “thank you” for a purchase with these cute stickers.  We like all eight designs - what a great idea!  They stick on easily and stay on.  Great!

title: What a find for us!
text: This roll of paper is exactly what we needed to wrap our lavender this summer.  We installed it on the wall above one of our work tables and it is going to work great!. It would have been great if it had a “tearstrip”, but it’s not a total necessity.  Great quantity of quality paper - we’ll be ordering more of these.

title: Good kit
text: My granddaughter is taking online courses to get a teaching credential, so getting this teacher planner kit was something she knew she could use.  It has helped her a lot with understanding a teacher’s life, and has helped her confirm her plan.  This is a “must have” for anyone thinking of being a teacher.

title: Not easy to find..
text: It was a great surprise to find this keyboard which could be attached to an existing desk so that typing can be done from a comfortable position.  Amazing how much faster my daughter can type!  This was easy to attach, and she is thrilled with the increase in her productivity and the ease for her arms, shoulders and back!  Who knew a keyboard position would make such a difference!  Great choice!

title: Versatile
text: Presentation books can be used for so many different things - by the student for reports, by offices needing to segregate receipts, etc., and grandmothers, to store photos of grandchildren - just to name a few. These are so well-made, they promise to be secure for whatever use.  Good-looking and easy to use.  Many pages is a plus.  Good choice.

title: Perfect for the new year!
text: This is great for keeping track of what’s coming and going from the farm.  We have a big sign board for a calendar, but we are forever forgetting to write things on it.  This lies open on a table with a pen, so we can all make notes, write in appointments, etc. and so far so good.  It’s a great size to carry around, too. Good quality and setup for a planner.  Good choice.

title: Good quality labels.
text: These labels are heavy enough to run through the printer and attach to our bottles and jars.  We had trouble with jam-ups with others.  Good quantity and the easy peel adhesive is appreciated, as mistakes are made!  Good choice!

title: Just the right size.
text: Perfect to allow the office chair to move around without harming the tile floor.  The large black and white tiles show through so this does not disrupt the decor.  Good thickness for continuing to look good despite heavy use.  Very pleased with this.

title: Perfect for card-making
text: Cards are expensive and don’t always say what you want, so we decided to make our own.  We’ve ordered some quaint postcards we love, and plan to adhere them to the “card” - and the envelope will fit just fine.  We can write our own message, which will be so much more personal.  Love the “brown bag” paper as it lends itself to any kind of card. These are good quality, and will make our cards unique!

title: Good array of pictures
text: All with a sepia background, these postcards feature places we’ve visited - bringing back great memories.  We’ve decided to frame some of them, as it’s a great opportunity to have a good picture of a location we care about.

title: Substantial - not a toy!
text:
This is what we need for farmer’s markets. It’s heavy, has compartments for cash and change, and even has a nice “ding” when the drawer closes! The days of using a shoebox are over! Other cashboxes are made of plastic and
don ‘t seem secure. This cashbox means business! We’re very pleased with this cash drawer which can be locked, too!

title: You can hang them up!
text: These clipboards are just what we needed for many projects going on the farm.  Best of all, they come with a “clip” to hang them up.  We can hang them on one wall, making the projects easy to find to add progress reports.  Makes us feel so organized.  These are really good quality, sturdy and promise to last.  The clip holding paperwork is very strong.  We love that there are twelve of these in a pack - just perfect to hand out to workers or to hang them in one place.  Good choice.

title: The easy way to do labels...
text: When we have a mailing list of folks, these labels and the computer do the job for us.  Good strong labels - the sheets are good - no problems getting stuck in the printer.  The labels have a really strong adhesive, so no problems with them coming off the packages.  These are good quality labels - and perfect for our needs.

title: Good sturdy labels..
text: We recently set up a storage area with bins for all the various items for camping, cooking, lighting, etc. and needed a way to label the bins.  These are perfect for the job.  We look so well organized now - and the beauty of it is that we can find everything now. With no labels, we were still searching.  Great product!

title: Our Schedule!
text: We grow lavender, and it’s on a schedule for watering, transplanting and doing a final planting.  We keep track of what’s what and when with this white board.  We also keep track of appointments and we have a column for needs.  We are so used to using it now that we can’t get along without it!  Very sturdy - was easy to put up - is easy to clean and makes us look organized!  Good choice.

title: Good organizers
text: These Pendaflex file folders are great for so many purposes - with two dividers, they’re perfect for bills due and bills paid - copies of all things for a car, insurance - just about anything you want to keep a record of.  These are very sturdy - they’re made to last for decades - and they make organizing important things much easier.

title: Comfortable on the feet
text: Easy to install and easy to clean.  This covers the area of our farm office, where we pick up tools, weigh the plants - we’re always going in and out across concrete floors, and it’s a pleasure to feel the difference in the office.  It makes a real difference in how the office looks, too.  If necessary, we can move this to another area where we may be on our feet - the squares lock together and form a seamless floor wherever it is.  Good choice!

title: Wonderful gift for the young artist
text: This is how to get young folks interested in the art they aren’t getting in school!  Great set of watercolor pens - just dip in water and see the effects.  Great for getting kids started experimenting with techniques and color.  Very nice set and good clear case to keep the pens in.  Good choice.

title: Multi-purpose oganizer!
text: My daughter works from home, and we are on a never-ending quest for items that will help her keep everything organized.  This may start out as a mail sorter and end up as something entirely different, but it does offer flexibility.  I like the hooks for keys, as we have keys for everything!  Not only does this provide bins for mail, it adds to the decor of her “farmhouse” office.  Very pleased with this sturdy organizer.

title: Conversation starters - great gift!
text: So nice to talk about something other than politics! These are a great “tool” for finding out what your grandchildren are thinking and planning - and what they like and don’t like - and how their lives are going.  Great chance to discuss some life issues and offer advice when it is asked for!  The affirmations are very appropriate.  This would make a great gift for the graduate, or just anyone who is a deep thinker!

title: Great idea for reading in bed!
text: After coming to the conclusion that the neck and shoulders were aching due to holding a book to read in bed, this seemed like a perfect solution.  It surely would be for someone bedridden, too - it’s adjustable and a good size to hold a lot of “stuff”.  If you decide to work at home in bed, this is a necessary tool!  Meanwhile, I am feeling much more comfortable reading - I review books, so it keeps me more alert and certainly less achy!  This is a very nice, quality bed table.

title: How to keep track of what happens when...
text: We’ve got a lot going on this winter on the farm, planning for new plants to arrive, watering systems to be installed, a new generator - and the list goes on.  Best way to keep track and inform everybody is a calendar like this one, where we can use colored dry erase pens to indicate who is to do what and by what deadlines.  This calendar is working really well for everybody, up on the wall of the lavender barn.

title: Wrist comfort...
text: You don’t realize that your wrist is in need of a soft place until you have a soft place.  We love this mouse pad with the wrist support - it does make a difference.  My daughter works from home with a bank of computers and monitors - and she sits in front of them working all day.  This wrist support has made a good difference for her, and saved her some aches and pains.

title: Paper-shufflers’ dream..
text: I love binder clips and these are beautiful!  They work so much better than paper clips - paper clips hold papers well but they use up space and sometimes make them hard to read.  Binder clips hold on to a small edge, and make it easy to read the pages.  So, I’m happy to have this supply!

title: File folders for organizing...
text: Nice to have the different colors - nice,  strong, file folders for all purposes - easy to categorize by color, too.  Very pleased with these file folders.

title: Time to get organized!
text: As I age, I see the wisdom in getting things organized for the younger generation!  So, these file folders can be for three different things- one for Will and  legal documents, a second for things like insurance, car information, bills - and a third one for medical situations.  I like the three different colors - and these are well-made to last!

title: All-important markers
text: They write on glass, wood, metal and plastic - and are permanent.  they have extra-large ink supplies and last longer than the usual markers.  Can make broad strokes for addressing large packages.  Great markers!

title: Every farm needs a sign
text: In our case, this sign will direct folks to the farm office, where business is conducted.  We will not be open to the public, but we will have suppliers and delivery people arriving - and this sign will keep business away from the house and in the barn office.  Very happy to have found this good-sized, well-made sandwich sign!

title: We needed a big mouse pad - this is it!
text: When you’re a photographer editing photos, dealing with multiple monitors and have your “stuff”all around you, you need a really large mouse pad to work with.  We saw that my grandson was hampered by the old, small one he was using, so this came as a surprise and great improvement for his work.  It isn’t always easy to find these big ones - and they’re not just for gaming!  My grandson makes his living with his!

title: A total convenience for us...
text: With our farm property, we have a number of gates which have been secured with locks that require keys.  When we moved in, the previous owner handed us a box of unlabeled keys!  When various problems have arisen in our pastures, we were frantically going through numerous keys trying to find the right one.  Since we’ve switched our gates to locks that all have the same code, life has become so much more convenient!  These locks are great, were easy to set up.  Great choice for anyone who is tired with struggling with keys!

title: Very strong tape!
text: This  arrived just in time to tape up some late Christmas presents - and, wow, is it strong!  It fits a tape dispenser we have, so we were able to test this on =small and very large boxes!  Very happy to have 6 rolls - before the holidays, we drove all over trying to find good tape (we live out in the country), and we ended up using the post office tape - which is great on small boxes, but not so good on large, heavy ones.  Very happy with this tape.

title: Yes, it’s “over the top”
text: A sparkling gold stapler?  Why not!  For those of us who labor at a desk day in and out, a gold stapler is just the “lift” we need!  We took a little flak for it, but it brought lots of smiles., too!  Works great - looks great on the desk, and nobody has one like it!

title: Sturdy and durable!
text: On the farm, we categorize everything to be well organized, so we can’t have too many binders.  These are easy to label, sit well on shelving, and last.  The binder rings work well nd we haven’t had a failure yet.  Good choice!

title: Looks great - lots of room for notes
text: A lot of folks need a back-up - sure you can put work necessities on your internet calendar but it isn’t always as accessible when it needs to be charged, etc.  Having a back-up is just good sense - and Blue Sky makes some of the best planners.  Good-looking, lots of area to write notes = place to keep phone numbers and reminders.  Get organized!

title: Essential for keeping track!
text: On a farm, there is a schedule for everything, and sometimes you’re planning months ahead.  Now we have a wall-mounted calendar that keeps us all advised about what’s happening when and with whom.  Pretty important when you’re planting thousands of plants and need a lot of backup to be ready.  So, it’s all on the schedule now, which is a relief!  The calendar is a dry erase board for changing dates - very important - and it looks great!

title: Very farmy for our farm office!
text: Looks like old barn  wood - very attractive!  Might need to upgrade the hardware for hanging heavier stuff.  Wish there had been a shelf at the top to look  more finished.  We love the look of it, and it definitely will give us much more organization of the many reports, receipts, bills, we handle.  Very pleased with this organizer and will look for more office  “stuff” made of barn wood!

title: Nightstand organizer
text: Not really a “charging station” - no place to plug in a device.  This is really just a nightstand organizer - place to put devices while they’re charging.  Disappointing not to find some electronic stuff involved.  Nice organizer, well-made and very presentable - but disappointing!

title: Great mat - but won’t lie flat!
text: This came all rolled up, and despite our best efforts, we could never get it to lie flat. It’s a quality mat and was the right size, but it became more of a trip hazard then a help. We put it in the sun to see if warming it up would caused it to lay flat, but no luck.  We moved it to the barn where our ride around mower is sitting on it to see if that will flatten it out.  It would be better not to roll them up - or, at least include instructions on how to get it to lie flat!

title: How to stay up to date and organized!
text: this board is attached to the wall by the phone, charging stations, computer and printer.  It’s the place for call back phone calls, notes to each other - reminders, orders for the store - everything that isn’t farm chores!  It’s amazing how quickly this board gets filled up - but it’s great to take care of things and see it nearly blank!  What did we do without it?  Many little slips of paper.  Yikes!

title: Works for our farm - multi-purpose!
text: This whiteboard is installed in our white barn, giving the watering schedules, planting schedules - appointments for arborists, etc. - just about everything that’s going on at the farm.  With three of us working on things, we get our chores mixed up, so the board has all the info to keep things straight.  It’s also easy to erase things that change.  Before we had this, we had chaos!  Thank goodness for this movable board - we’re feeling much more organized!

title: Stray from the norm with rose gold paper clips!
text: My daughter asked, “Why rose gold?”  I answered, “Why not?”  I paper clip a lot of things, and straying from the industrial norm of silver paper clips is like a walk in the park!  They’re pretty, well-made and make me smile!  So why not rose gold paper clips?

title: It’s the best - the perfect printer...
text: This is my second Epson Eco-Tank.  Since we moved to the farm, we have a need of two - one in the farm office and one in  my work-at-home daughter’s office.  Since the farm office is in the barn -‘way over yonder, running back and forth to make copies of receipts, etc. was time-consuming.  This printer is, by far, the best printer we have ever had - the large quantity paper tray, and the copy speed are perfect.  Best of all is the print quality and the fact that you will never have to buy another expensive cartridge.  The printer comes with ink to fill the tanks - and those tanks are good for 2000 copies - we know because our older one has lived up to every claim and works as well a year later as the day we received it.  Love this printer - it’s the best!

title: They work for dogs, too!
text: They work well for dogs, too!  We have a large kennel for our four dogs - which is largely concrete floor.  These mats give our dogs a soft, cool place to nap in the shade.  They look great - they’re easy to clean - just take them out and hose them off!  And when the mats come out, the dogs know it’s time for the afternoon snooze!  Very happy with these.

title: Perfect, inexpensive gift!
text: Perfect gift for school teachers - anyone that you want to let know that you are thinking about them.  The notepads are in different sizes and are very pretty - and we love the gold pen that comes with it - for a special touch.

title: Every office needs one!
text: This is a good-sized cork board - and perfect for our farm office - watering schedules, appointments, priorities, etc. - everything that everybody needs to know goes on the board.  We put this to good use right away!  Well-made - obviously a quality cork board.  Very pleased with this useful tool.

title: Great gift for the budding photographer!
text: This is no toy!  This is a great camera for a young person who likes to experiment with the pictures he takes - wants to see them right away, and enjoys the special effects through the app.  We are having so much fun with this camera - what a great idea for a family reunion - getting personal pics of all the relatives.  We’ll have it ready for our 4th off July gathering - and everyone will be so surprised to see themselves right away.  Very pleased with this great camera/printer!

title: Good gift for the HS grad going on to college...
text: This will be perfect for my granddaughter who starts college this fall - lots of college planning to do starting in July - and she will love that storage envelope for pictures and special items.  It’s a cover that anyone would like and the size allows ample writing room on each date.  Very pleased to add this to her graduation gifts.

title: Love the wire binding...
text: I love these Blue Sky planner because of the wire binding - enabling me to open it flat when writing in it.  The area allowed for each day is ample and the pages for notes and contacts will help.  I have a 2019 planner, but the new one starting in July will be welcome - with farm business to keep track of, things will be particularly busy during the summer.  Very pretty - and useful!

title: Perfect size, pretty and lays flat!
text: I love a planner with a wire-binding so it lays flat for easy writing.  This has been our “service” planner - we have scheduled appointments to remodel the new farmhouse, and it’s nice to have this separate from the rest of the every day things.  It has ample room to make notes and lists as well.  It looks great, too - and it’s easy to find amidst all the other “stuff”!

title: A planner for men or women - or students!
text: This is a great daily and monthly planner - the best part is the wire binding that allows it to lie flat - making writing easy!  This is a good planner for men or women - no flowers - just good-looking stripes.  Planners are perfect for backups - easier to carry with you than most computers - and keep your records safe when the computer crashes!

title: Everybody needs a backup planner!
text: Everybody needs a planner - they may think their important info is secure on their computer or tablet, but they become believers when the internet or WiFi goes off - or worse, their computer crashes.  This planner has a great - and good-looking - cover, and lies flat - which means it is so easy to make notes on - so easy to find your info.  The perfect size, it’s easy to take along to meetings and events.

title: Good-looking, strong project binders...
text: Great-looking binders to hold all the paperwork for the several projects we’ve got going. People say they don’t deal with paper anymore - “it’s all in their computer.”  We’ve found out the hard way that it’s just good business to keep a running file on what’s going on - there are power outages and crashes that disrupt business - we’re not taking a chance on that.  These are good-looking, strong, ample binders that are doing the job for us.

title: You need back-up with a planner!
text: The  girls all fought over this planner.  There was one who claimed that she kept all her plans and appointments on her phone - until she lost her phone and it was never found. So, she was the winner - and a happy one, after her experience!  Everybody needs back-up with a planner!  Because you can write so much more in a planner than you would on your phone - it just makes good sense.

title: Looks and works great!
text: This is a good-looking, well-divided drawer organizer.  Instead of the desk, we’re using it for our collection of small cooking tools - which is working well.  The drawer looks totally organized - and now we’re thinking of getting more!

title: Perfect card!
text: This is a very cute Valentine’s card - I’m always looking for one card I can send to twins, so here’s the answer!  I’ve already heard that they love it and are playing with the finger puppets.  Great choice.

title: Everyone should use one!
text: This is a powerful shredder.  It works quickly and does a great job.  We accumulate a wealth of paper - many containing names, addresses and sometimes sensitive personal information.  It’s satisfying to see these papers reduced to shreds and totally unreadable.  Great safety and privacy tool which everyone should have these days,

title: The faithful desk calendar!
text: After watching my daughter, who works from home, searching her desk for her planner to schedule a meeting while on the phone, I presented her with this desk calendar - which was well-received!  Even with all the high-tech stuff for keeping track of activities, the good old calendar still lends a lot of convenience, especially when it’s always right in front of you and under your arm!  Let’s hear it for desk calendars - and especially this one because it is so pretty!

title: Coil binding allows it to lie flat - perfect!
text: I chose this planner for three reasons - it was the right size to fit in my purse, and the daily pages had enough room to write a grocery list - second, because it lies completely flat, so if you’re dealing one-handedly, it stays put while you write - and third, because it is so pretty!  It’s got everything I need but I guess the feature I like best is the coil binding which allows it to open up completely and lie flat.  It isn’t easy to find a planner in this size that does that!

title: Fun for the grandkids - useful for the adults, too.
text: This is more fun for the grandkids - playing school was their first idea - and they played for hours!  Took turns being teacher - it was fun to watch them!  They left each other notes - played tic, tac, toe - found all kinds of uses for it.  The letters and symbols stick to the felt well, but pull off easily.  Lots of letters. At the end of the latest visit, they left a sweet “thank you” note.  Nice!

title: Perfect planner!
text: This is perfect for keeping track of special events and appointments.  It’s a bit big - and very red, so it’s impossible to lose it!  At a Glance knows what all the most needed features are, so this is set up perfectly.  Great choice with plenty of room to write what’s necessary.

title: An extra table for so many purposes - always welcome!
text: A grandmother can always use an activity table like this one - east to set up and easy to store.  This one housed a puzzle over the holidays - and whenever the mood struck anyone, they sat down and worked on it.  We covered it when we used it for games.  It was great to finally have a variety of available surfaces for various purposes!

title: Great, all-purpose table.
text: We had a house-ful over the holidays, so this table was in almost constant use - for eating, crafts, games, you name it.  Easy to set up and easty to store. Perfect for a big family get-together!  They had a ball with the dry erase feature of this one - some of the pictures and messages were hysterical.  Great table!

title: Not just for business anymore!
text: The quality you expect from At-a-Glance - this is the perfect planner - giving you both the months and weeks with plenty of space to write in appointments, events, etc.  Perfect for keeping track of birthdays - especially when you have a huge family!  Planners aren’t just for business - with the way the world works these days, a planner is essential.  A lot of people keep their information on their computers or devices - but there isn’t the room to write that this planner provides.  So easy to keep track of things!

title: Carries everything you need!
text: This has a place for everything!  Place for your cell phone, credit cards, identification - pocket for storing messages, holds a letter-size legal pad, and it also will hold a couple file folders - and the magnetic closing will keep everything safe.  You could just carry this and leave the purse at home.  This works for me for a workshop I conduct.  I used to to carry an open portfolio and spend half my time retrieving things that had fallen out, so I appreciate this portfolio!

title: Faulty - no action or sounds.
text: This is a cute figure, but he came missing one screw to hold the batteries in (it needs three AA).  Even with the batteries secure, when I pressed the hand to get some action it just croaked and stopped.  It would give out with a noise and then stop right away.  Waited, thinking it needed to warm up - but it’s still croaking.  Cute enough to sit on a shelf, but there’s no action or sounds.

title: For sharp colored pencils!
text: I love to color and this is just what I needed to keep those pencils sharp!  I love, too, that I don’t have to plug this in - it’s rechargeable!  No added cords on my desk!  This really works well for all size pencils and it’s easy to empty.  Very pleased with this pencil sharpener!

title: Good quality, rolls easily.
text: Most of my friends have carts - not nearly as nice as this one.  This cart rolls easily - it was easy to assemble, and the amount it will carry is great.  Being black, it looks sharp, too,.  One great feature is the padded, foam-covered handle.  This is a good quality cart and it should last for a good, long time.  It makes almost no noise compared to the others.  Very pleased with this cart.

title: Perfect for the very busy person!
text: This is the perfect planner for someone who has a lot going on!  It’s a great size - with colorful tabs for the months, and lots of room to cover all the appointments and events.  Good quality paper and very colorful!

title: Nothing special.
text: The pop-up appeals to young children.  They don’t look expensive - the quality could be improved.  The little animals are sweet - but, again, they don’t look like Hallmark-quality cards. The phrase is okay - could be a bit more dramatic and enthusiastic!  Just a blah card.

title: Not funny - maybe for a younger crowd.
text: I’m not crazy about sending out cartoon Christmas cards - particularly ones that really aren’t funny.  These may appeal to millennials, but they sure don’t appeal to good, old traditional me!  I have sent humorous cards - but, sweetly humorous...

title: Cute and efficient - 5 X 8
text: This is a really cute and efficient planner - and it fits in my purse.  Colorful, attractive cover.  Plenty of room to record whatever is happening every day of the week.  Every month starts with a full month, then progresses to a week after week.  Colorful tabs for turning to a particular month.  Very attractive and useful.

title: How to drive your sister crazy!
text: This is more fun for my twin grandson, who drives his sister crazy writing things she can’t see!  What a great idea!  The timing of this was perfect for a boy who was just getting hooked on Harry Potter!  Good choice!  We do spend some time losing and finding the wand - wish it were attached by something.

title: Notes from Grandma and Snoopy!
text: I’m partial to Snoopy, so the cards are welcome.  I also like them blank so I can say what I want without writing around some sentiment that doesn't say it all for me!  Love these cards - good paper, bright colors - the grandchildren will love getting notes from Grandma!

title: Just okay...
text: I wouldn’t call these “gorgeous” - they’re rather bland colors and those colors don’t do much to inspire enthusiasm!  Nothing wrong with the sentiments or the paper - but these aren’t top-of-the-line Hallmark quality.

title: Lots of fun!
text: This is a favorite of my granddaughter - she loves anything that allows her to create something.  This kept her busy for hours, and she was very pleased with her creations.  Good choice for the creative kid!

title: Not using as intended!
text: When I ordered these little books, I envisioned something that could be used for various projects - and that’s what they are but they are for a particular project - surveying!  However, I’ve found a use - I love the size - they fit in a purse easily, and they’re great for note-taking, picture-drawing, lists, etc.

title: Perfect for the person working at home...
text: This is the answer for those of us working from home, who are parked in front of multiple computers screens hour after hour.  Ready to go and easy to set up, this makes a huge difference - particularly when you’re on the phone - get up, raise the desk, do your pacing - your screens are right at the level you need - get some exercise, and sit down refreshed!  So easy to raise and lower - this is a gift to prevent chronic leg cramps, back ache, etc.

title: Special folders at grandma’s house.
text: Very popular with the young grandchildren for organizing school papers and pictures at grandma’s house..  Special folders kept in a special place - we hide surprises in them, too.  Despicable Me remains popular, and these are very colorful and fun.

title: Useful for so many things!
text: This is getting a workout.  It’s useful for so many things,  We’ve rolled it into the family room laden with snacks to watch a game together - it’s great to keep stuff all together for projects - great for the artist to have this nearby,  It has a beautiful top, so for messy things, we’ve covered it with a cloth or plastic to prevent stains.  Easy to assemble, and very sturdy.  The wood is really good quality.  Now that we have one of these, I don’t know how we did without it.  It’s going to get a lot of patio time this summer - a rolling bar!

title: Good for storage of most used files.
text: Tucked in a bookcase, this has a presentable side.  For me, it’s being used as the most readily needed files - for car insurance, bills, - things I go to monthly or at least several times a year.  With colorful file folders, I’m finding everything easily.  Good choice.  Also collapses up if you want to move the location.

title: Great storage for important papers.
text: Good, strong ring binder for organizing important papers.  Filled with plastic sleeves, this is much more efficient than a file folder in a file cabinet.  Red color stands out - so here’s the answer to putting everything important in one, easy to find place!

title: Fantastic Eco-Tank printer!
text: This printer sounded too good to be true - never having to buy another expensive ink cartridge?  In setting it up, I asked for help from our resident IT guy, as I was a bit leery about filling the ink tanks, etc.  The set up was a breeze, and so was the filling of the tanks.  The printer comes supplied with  two sets of ink bottles - enough for two years, or in my case, perhaps more.  I'm a writer, so make multiple copies of what I write.  The printing is crisp and clear, there are no streaks or, strange lines - just perfect copies.  It holds a good volume of paper and prints quickly.  I am 100% pleased with this printer, and salute Epson for coming out with the "Eco-Tank" - what an improvement!  The size is also perfect - not taking up any more room than my old laser printer.  If anything changes with time, I'll amend this review.

title: More copies than ever expected!
text: I've got this cartridge replacement on "standby" as the one that keeps reporting that it is "low", continues to put out clear, sharp copies.  I keep waiting for a sign that I should definitely replace it, but, so far, I'm just enjoying more copies than I thought possible.  I write, so am constantly making multiple copies, and this cartridge seems to be going on forever!  So, I'll review the new one once it's installed - so far, just loving the present one!

title: Different from the usual, but very upbeat - nice quality, too...
text: These are five cute cards for different occasions.  Very different from the usual Hallmark variety.  I'm sure they designed them for a young audience, but this 82 year old likes them, too - love the dog with the tennis ball, as we have a chocolate lab!  It's nice to just have a little supply of cards at the ready when the occasions appear - saves those long times of scouring the card section to find the right card.  Never thought you could order them from Amazon!  I like all five cards and am sure they will be well-received.

title: Very popular - smooth, comfortable writing...
text: Can you ever have too many pens?  I'm the constant source at the book club, writing class, etc. for those who have forgotten to bring one!  This one is a particular favorite, as it's a comfortable pen for a couple hours of writing - and moves smoothly.  There's been one problem - and that's getting the pen back from the borrower.  Thank goodness for 36 of them!  Family members are always searching for a pen, too, so this is a good purchase for every household!

title: Great for the aspiring young gymnast!
text: This is great for the aspiring young gymnast, whose first wish is just to do a great cartwheel!  My only wish is that the pad were a foot or so longer.  My tall grandchild (6) finds the pad a bit short.  The other side, the "balance beam" is great and is a wonderful tool to teach balance.  It took tries over several days to get this right, and now, she realizes what she has to do not to "fall off".  Since one of her traits is always to "get things right", she spends a lot of time with this pad.  It's a great idea, requiring concentration, patience and diligence!

title: Great pens - better than all the rest!
text: Arrived in the nick of time.  I ordered these pens, first because I like the way they write, and second, because  there is always someone at the writing club and book club who has forgotten to bring a pen.  I lose a lot this way, as the folks like the way these write, too, and conveniently forget to return them to me!  I like this pen in particular for it's cool "racing stripe", so the younger generation also borrows them with no return!  Best of all, is that it's a gel pen - the writing does not smear - and for the very young, that's a real plus.  Great pens!

title: Very professional and classy-looking!
text: This is a very sharp-looking notebook - very professional appearing, and it fits neatly in most handbags.  The cover is a midnite blue, very smooth to the touch.  The inside pages are ruled.  In this fast-moving age, a notebook beside the phone or computer is a necessity.  An excellent event planner, list repository or just plain note taker.  This is a notebook that makes a good impression.

title: Great "back desk" for our home office.
text: Why would we need a conference table in our house?  In organizing our home office and putting it to the test, it became apparent that there was a need for a lot more desk top space.  Our desk is pretty much taken up with the computer, two large screens and keyboard - leaving little room for shuffling papers and housing standup files for easy access.  So, the table has become a back desk, which really works out well.  The color matches the desk, so, the whole thing looks like it was meant to be!  Setting the table up took minutes and it looks great.  Thank goodness we have a big area for the home office.  I think this table will always find a use in our home, long after the need for a home office.  The table top finish is not only attractive, but it looks like it will stand up under heavy use.  Very pleased with our decision about this table.

title: A great choice for a writer!
text:
I'd forgotten how sharp and crisp the laser printer output is. Until now, I've used an inkjet. I'm a writer, and it's important that my manuscripts look professional - and it's also important that I get more copies per cartridge. I was forever buying inkjet cartridges, and not always being satisfied with the copies I got. I haven't had to buy a toner cartridge yet, but I'm very hopeful that I'll go a long way before I do.
The wireless printer is fairly easy to set up making use of the disc included. My techno-nerd daughter launched into the set up without instructions (why do they think they know everything?) and quickly backtracked to the written word and disc. We were set up in no time! I immediately started copying my current writing, which is really impressive (the copies - hopefully, the writing!)
I have always been a HP fan - this is my third printer in 20 years - and this is the first laser printer. I feel it was a great choice!

title: Light, and looks great!
text: I love this shopping cart!  I haven't been used to using one, but after being loaned a rickety metal one, and I  saw that despite it's heavy weight, it would be a convenience to have one - I researched and found this one.  Made my first trip with it - it's much lighter - and it holds four larger grocery bags and more.  I was stopped several times in the parking lot by those who wanted to know where I got it.  It's easy to fold up, put in the trunk, and then, when empty, refolds easily to fit in a cramped closet.  I'm VERY pleased with this cart!

title: Great innovation - no excuse now for wavy lines!
text: What an improvement over the old paper cutter - big clumsy board and a blade that came down catty-wompus and often left the last couple of inches of paper either uncut or frayed.  I use this to cut photographs mostly - and the timing is right, because I've begun the trimming to put photos in Christmas cards.  As I trim, I'm thinking about how great it would have been when we were planning that baby shower, spending hours cutting and trimming items for games, placecards, etc.  Back in the day, I was a realtor, and this would have been perfect to cut photographs for flyers.  Now, they'd look professional!  Yep, this is a marketing person-crafty-hobbyist's perfect gift!  LIke many, I can't cut a straight line with scissors, so this is going to get a lot of use.

title: The best pens, hands down!
text: I love these InkJoy pens - smooth-writing with no skips every time!  At our writing workshop, there's always someone who forgets a pen, so this pack of 12 will come in handy.  Only problem is that they fall in love with the pen, and I don't get it back!  I like these for editing as the ink is super-fast drying, and let's me move along at a good speed.  Altogether, these InkJoy pens are far superior to anything else I've used, so to have a stash of them is good!

title: A step up for us...more convenience and savings.
text: This printer arrived yesterday and was immediately set up and put to use.  I write, so make multiple copies of chapters for review, and editing - for my readers and writing group.  The saving in ink is going to be a big one for me, and the convenience of 250 sheets of paper in each of two trays will save a lot of back forth to load more paper.  The print quality is excellent, so I'm pleased all the way around.  What's relevent, too, in our household is that there are now three of us using the printer - so, again, going to use the printer and finding it out of paper or ink, hopefully, is a thing of the past!  I feel like we have moved from a good small office printer to an industrial strength one!  This seems to be a really good value for the price. If anything changes, I'll amend this review.

title: The answer for the home workstation.
text: Oh, my gosh, we have been trying forever to get the computer screen at the right level - we put the workspace on top of the desk, and we reached perfection.  There is abolutely no assembly - you just take it out of the box, put it on the desk top, raise the levers and it slides easily and noiselessly to what you need to work standing;  lower the levers and it lowers to the perfect position for working seated.  It looks good and works like a charm.  I just wish we had thought to get a home workspace years ago.  As a writer, this will add hours to what I'm able to produce in a day.  Well-constructed, looks like quality - I recommend it highly!

title: Great pencil sharpener!
text: Wow, a modern-day pencil sharpener that really produces a finely sharpened pencil point!  I've succumbed to the new fun of coloring adult coloring books, postcards, etc. with color pencils, and until I received this sharpener, I had to take my pencils to the local library (where they had an old, inconsistent electric sharpener).  Now, I have the perfect sharpener!  Just having it gives me faith that the faithful old #2 pencil will still be around for a while!  This should be a real boon to those who draw with pencils.

text: You get 2 binders for under $10 in this pack. The binders actually look very cool with this geometric design on it. I really like the design and the colors. They are smaller binders which is nice since you don’t always need big binders for everything. It comes with 1 pocket divider that also allows you to put papers in it that do not have holes punctured into them, however those papers need to be smaller than the standard 8.5 by 11 or whatever the regular papers are these days. I wish they had the little flap in the front or back that you can put loose papers into but they don’t. That really is my only major complaint with these.

title: Great little wrist coils that are of a very nice quality

title: Smearing shows decline in quality
text:
Purchasing art pens and markers is something of a regular occurrence for me and PIGMA is a brand I trust for what I expect the Sakura pens to do. I use these from writing on photos because they are non smearing and archival, I use them for art projects, and I use them to label gifts I've made.

My expectations are that they do not smear as all of the PIGMA Sakura Micron pens I have used have never smeared even when coming into contact with moisture.

In the photos, I wrote on a yellow post it and on a piece of paper I use for my art work. Neither type of paper has allowed the PIGMA Micron pens to smear prior to this set. The photo I first wrote on to include in a Christmas card smeared badly, as you can see.

The smaller pens might dry quickly because the nib is smaller, so there's less ink, however each size pen had some smearing.

This is disappointing because I count on these pens for work and for hobbies, but it's obvious the quality of this ink has declined over the last few years.

Bought these to label photos for Christmas cards and now I'm researching pens when I thought I found my go to pens years ago.

At the top, I'm using one strip per hexagon but I may add another to the bottom: I'm not removing the white sheet that over their sticky stuff (just leaving it on).  I love the color ... love the fact that I can space them how I want (I've got two vertical stacks of three surrounding a single horizontal line of six) and there are so many tiles that I have extras for somewhere else!  These are great and I love that they are functional 'art' in my room.  Great because I can place them where I need them ... really a neat product.  Be aware: the individual tiles, while a 32nd inch below 1/2 in thick, they are only 5-1/2" wide ... the pictures make them look bigger.
