title: A novel idea!
text:
I wish I knew about these 5 year journals a decade or so ago. I’ve always kept a journal from when I was a kid, to a teen and into my adult years. I stopped in my mid 30’s because I just lost my love for it and felt like a chore. When I found this journal I was so excited to use it. The idea of having 5 years on one page is so clever and only having 6 lines per day doesn’t make it feel like a chore.
As far as the actual journal itself it feels very sturdy. I have faith that it will stay together for 5 years. I have the periwinkle blue color and it’s beautiful. The paper is nice. It could be a little bit better but it’s adequate for my needs. I use a Uni-Ball Signo 153 broad tip gel pen and there’s a little bit of ghosting on the opposite side. It’s got a handy bookmark to keep your place. There is a page for February 29. There are several pages in the back that is for important events. The only things missing to make this journal absolutely perfect are higher quality paper, a pocket in the back and a dedicated pen holder. I just clip my pen to the front cover. I’m very happy with my journal and I will continue to keep doing this as long as I’m able. I keep a regular journal for when I have more thoughts to express than I can fit in my 5 year one. This 5 year journal is perfect for everyday writing! You won’t be disappointed!

title: Love the point it makes for Polychromos
text:

I like that you can adjust to different kinds of points. I prefer the 3 setting for my colored pencils. My complaints are that the close setting doesn’t close anymore and that they don’t last a super long time. I’ve already thrown one away as it didn’t sharpen to that pin point anymore and that was after several drawings. If I find a sharpener that sharpens as well as this and lasts for years then I would switch but for now this is the one that works best for my needs. It is a bit pricey to me (about $6 at the time of this review) considering how often it will need to be replaced. I have been buying the 2-packs for that reason.
UPDATE:

title: A wonderful bookmark! 4.5 stars
text: This is a lovely bookmark. It is a combination of embroidered felt (with flowers and your initial) and a cardboard back. The rectangular shape slips onto the page easily. I received the winter version and accidentally ordered one with the initial “S,” which is not my initial but that doesn’t take away from its many uses. The only thing I would have changed is the cardboard back. I wonder why they didn’t just make it felt too? I give it 4 stars.

title: Cute greeting card!!
text:
This card by Ecloverlife is super cute.  
This card is Luau inspired.
Super fun and colorful.  
The card itself is bright green card, with pink, yellow, orange and blue.  
The graphic, on the front, is a lovable gorilla.  
The inside of the card pops up to reveal a large gorilla with a hula skirt and a lei.  
There is a happy, joyful song playing with a small light show.  
Included with the large greeting card is a small notecard, a sticker and envelope.
I will also warn you that since the card is oversized, it might require additional postage.
 And finally, the only thing that is a little weird is that the smaller note card did not come with an envelope.

title: A great 12 pack of pens!! 4.5 stars
text:
These Radius O-Second gel pens are perfect for students.
Twelve (12) come in the pack.
They are easy to write with and feel great in my hand, while writing.
The ink is blue.
The point is medium (.7mm).
The pen glides across the paper.
The ink doesn't bleed.
These retractable pens are reasonably priced (less than $11 on Amazon).
My only suggestion is to add a rubber grip. Since the shaft of the pen is smooth, your hand may slide.
Overall, 4.5 stars. They would have been perfect if they had rubber grips.

title: Let the organizing begin!
text: I love getting organized…in my mind that is - while not always in reality.  Hence why I selected this 2023 planner and it is perfect for me. It isn’t large (a little larger than 5x7) and fits inside my tote, purse or backpack. You have the option of using it by the week or month. There is an area for notes/comments, contacts and a list of the holidays. There is a rear pocket and stickers (which I probably won’t use). The tabs help you find the month(s) quickly. And there is an elastic cord that keeps everything inside. Overall, this is a great little spiral planner, perfect for ensuring that you are organized. I recommend it.

title: I think I am ready for 2023!!
text: In an effort to help my son be more organized this upcoming year, I ordered this monthly calendar. There are nice accent photos. He can put it up on the wall or place on his desk. Now he can keep up with all of his assignments, tasks, holidays, appointments and birthdays. There are stickers (which I don’t think he will use) and a rope that can be used if you decide to hang the calendar. Overall, perfect for work or home. I’d recommend it. Now I just have to make sure he uses it.

title: Perfecto!! Just what I needed!!
text: Keeping up with the remotes, in a house of four, can be difficult….really hard to do. But not now that I have the Jasenna (round leather) remote holder. It is large enough to hold several remotes. My Xfinity, Fire TV Stick and Samsung remotes fit inside. I even placed a pair of readers and a pen inside (you always need those). It is compact and keeps everything in a nice tidy area. My remotes are different sizes, lengths and widths.  This holder is round (has the ability to turn) and is covered in gray leather embossed with a faint flower design. Overall, this accessory is perfect if you want to get organized.

title: I wouldn't normally purchase/pick or select this card BUT.....4.5-5 stars
text: My son is a fan of Donald Trump and while I wouldn’t normally select this card, it is his 24th birthday and I knew he loved it. He DOES! He was delighted! The card is very formal looking. It  is oversized, so you might need extra postage. The card is navy blue. The outside has a gold seal with “Making Your Birthday Great Again.”  When you open this card, you hear DT’s voice - tone and inflection. He is sitting in the oval office. There is a cake and candle (that glows). There is an area to write a message besides another gold seal. This card is well made and durable. This card comes with a thank you letter from the owner of the company. Overall, if you are a Donald Trump lover, you will love this card.

title: For home, office or school!
text: These are a great set of pens (Linbsunne). You get 12 in a set, 2 in each color (gray, black, soft blue, pink, white and orange. They are accented with gold. They are retractable and have a soft grip at the base of each. These look expensive but are inexpensive (under $10 on Amazon). The black ink writes more like a gel, although these are ballpoint pens. They write smoothly, no skipping or jumping. The point is medium and a provides a nice thick finish. These are perfect for an office, school or home. They are very comfortable to write with and are aesthetically pleasing to the eye.

title: Back to School!
text:
It is that time of the year again - Back to School!
 And on every middle and high school supply lists are pens!
Even college students can use these.  
You could also use these for work or at home.  
Everyone needs or could use a great ballpoint pen.  
These pens by Linbsunne are perfect.  They are inexpensive (under $10 on Amazon).
They write well. No skipping or smearing.
 You get 12 pens in nice pastel colors. You get 2 of each color: lavender, seafoam green, cream, teal, gray and peach.  
They are retractable, have a soft grip and are comfortable to write with.  
The ink is black and the set includes a few refills.  
Overall, these are some nice pens that I definitely recommend.

title: A little smaller than I anticipated but still great!
text: Like an English professor told my husband years ago - it helps if you can read. He didn’t mean for it to be condescending but wanted to stress the need to read things carefully. And to be honest, if I had done so (read carefully), I would have noticed that these journals were not large, but small (a little bigger than pocket sized). Don’t get me wrong, they are still nice.  This is a two pack that comes with two beautiful  journals. They are very attractive, a neutral mossy green leather (perfect for women and men) with a tree emblazoned on the front. The journal can fit into your book bag or purse. It has a built-in pen holder, bookmark,  and elastic band for closure. The pages are decent quality and lined. I plan to give these to some law students/interns that I know. I think they will appreciate them and find them to be useful in preparing them for the upcoming semester. I’d recommend these.

title: Prepare for back to school.
text: It’s almost back-to-school time and my college aged son can never have too many spiral notebooks. I ordered this one by Better Office Products and am satisfied with the quality. The paper, which is perforated, is a decent grade with college ruled (thin) lines. It accommodates 5 subjects and has pockets which can hold a syllabus or other assignments. The black cover is poly - slightly slick plastic and flexible. It fits securely into the average sized backpack or messenger bag. It is also comparably priced to other 5 subject, high-end notebooks. In conclusion, I think it is perfect for students of all ages, or people who like to take notes. I recommend it.

title: The perfect lanyard!
text:
This lanyard is perfect for my needs.
It is pretty - green beads with gold accents. (They are deeper than they appear in my photos).
Oddly enough, it matches everything that I wear. Or is a nice complement.
It hangs mid-chest.
It is sturdy and appears to be durable.
There is an attachment to add keys as well as your ID.
And finally, it is affordable.
I'd recommend this.

title: Perfect for students!
text: This 5 subject spiral notebook is perfect for students (middle through college, even post graduate). Each section (5) is divided by a moveable divider with a pocket. The college ruled sheets are 3-hole punched and perforated. Each sheet is clearly lined and seems of decent quality.  In the front is a calendar (2021-2023) and a plastic ruler. I definitely would recommend it.

title: Keep it closed and fresh!
text: These are eight (8) stainless steel clips that can be used for any and everything. You can use these to close potatoes chips bags, cookie bags, and bags of dog food, etc.. They are easy to use and durable. They definitely seem more sturdy than the plastic ones I use. These clips can be used anywhere but definitely in the kitchen.

title: Gorgeous bookmarks!
text: I really love these cute bookmarks by Mornajina. I am one of those people who still enjoys holding a book versus reading them on my Kindle. There is something about holding a book and flipping the pages to chart your progress that I really love. It gives me that feeling of accomplished as I move from page 1 to 400. The feeling of accomplishment every time I complete a book. Just thinking about it makes me smile. So, while I think they work better on smaller, paper-back novels, I can get it to fit some of my hardback books. These bookmarks are black elastic cords with a large Tree of Life Chakra pendant made of crystals and twisted gold wire. They are very pretty and inexpensive. Overall, these are cute bookmarks worth having especially if you still love the old fashioned feel of holding a book in your hand. I’d recommend them. 5 stars

title: A card anyone can give or receive!
text: Although this Valentine’s Day card is geared towards the LGBTQ community, I think it is perfect for any couple. The message is sweet (generic enough) and will appeal to all, no matter the gender. This card is very cute. It is red, accented with hearts, and two button down shirts (with a love bird) on the front, and two pairs of socks (hanging on a clothes line) on the inside. I plan to give to it my husband on the big day and know that he will like it. I’d recommend it.

title: Who can’t use a nice thank you card? 4.5 to 5 stars
text: I know what you are thinking, no one writes handwritten thank-you notes anymore. It seems to be a lost art. Instead, people like sending e-cards and texts, but I love nothing more than giving or receiving a handwritten message. I guess I’m old fashioned that way. These cards are very pretty. They are written on an off-white (nice card stock) with black lettering. Written on the outside of the card, in fancy script, is the message - “Beyond grateful. Thank you so very much.” I really like the small heart shape used for the “o” in the word “Beyond.” The 120 cards come with matching kraft (paper bag brown) envelopes and stickers (for closure). They are reasonably priced, 120 for under $30 (on Amazon). These work for any occasion: birthday, anniversary, baby shower, graduation, and wedding. You can write your own personalized message in each. I’d highly recommend them.

title: Perfect.
text: These 6 dry erase boards are perfect for my upcoming event, my 25th wedding anniversary. We are going to play the Newlywed Game! These are easy to hold and come with erasers. All I needed to do was purchased dry erase markers. These are also perfect for young kids (elementary and middle school), especially if they are remote learning.  And finally, teachers can appreciate these as well.

title: Decent writing pens.
text: These Wy Wenyuan writing pens are fun and colorful. They write decently – no skipping or hesitation. They have a medium point. I love that the stainless-steel barrels are easy to hold and comfortable in your hand. They are colorful, the color gradually changing as it moves down the pen. The main colors are green, orange, blue, and yellow. These would be nice to give as a gift for an event (birthday party, family reunion), or place in your office waiting room. And finally, these pens have a bonus stylus on the top. They are also perfect for office meetings or school.

title: MengRan ballpoint pens.
text: These are super cute pens. The barrels are rose gold with clear tops (filled with rose gold glitter and gel). These are very feminine and attractive.  They are easy/comfortable to hold and write with. To write, just twist the bottom to extend the pen. They write smoothly and do not skip. The ink is black. These are perfect to use at the office or in school. This 12 pack is reasonably priced.

title: Functional metal feather bookmarks.
text: These bookmarks are functional, yet unique. You receive 6. These are shaped and appear to be feathers.  Two are silver, two are gold, one rose gold and one is bronze. They are about 4 to 5in long. They aren’t super thick but they do the trick-they mark your spot in a book. And you can’t beat the price. I am in several book clubs and plan to pass these out with some other token gifts. I’d recommend them.

title: Nice writing pens. The perfect back to school supply. 4.5-5 stars
text: These pens by Writech write smoothly. The black ink doesn’t smear when writing. The point is about .7 inches thick, medium to large point.  They are inexpensive when you consider you get 8 for about $13 (which is a little under $2 each). You get 8 pens, 2 in each (the barrels) of the following colors: black, blue, white and gold.  They are easy to hold and comfortable to write with. Each pen is attractive, with a modern removable top. In other words, they are stylish. Overall, I would recommend these pens for office use or as a school supply.

title: Cute lanyard or ID holder.
text: This ID holder by Memeyou is perfect for me. It is whimsical (cute owl with large, jeweled eyes). It extends, retracts and connects to my pants or shirt easily. Too cute!

title: A dragonfly can mark your spot. 4 stars
text: I love dragonflies and these Qyhsmgs bookmarks are very pretty. They are pewter with feathers on one side and a dainty dragonfly, attached by a thin chain, on the other. You get two for the price of one. These work better, to me on thinner books than thicker ones. But I still love and cherish them.

title: Marks your spot.
text: These floral, magnetic bookmarks are beautiful. Each one is a soft pastel color (pink family) with a nice flower/floral design. You get 12, which is great because it means that I can give them out to book club members during the holidays. These are easy to use and stay secured once applied. I’d highly recommend them.

title: It sparkles and shines.
text: This paperweight is super cute. It comes with a (silver) pedestal and cleaning cloth. It is about the size of a small tangerine (Halo) or can fit in the palm of my hand. It is a great gift for a colleague or (female) boss. I find it to be more fanciful (an accent piece) than practical (an actual paperweight). I think it really looks nice on my desk and will appeal to most. My only real complaint, and it really isn’t a firm one, is that I would have rather it had a wooden base. The silver/plastic one (maybe it should have been metal) looks a little cheap close up.

title: Nice writing, inexpensive pens.
text: I really like pens. There is nothing like a great writing pen to make work easier. This Zebra pen fits the bill. It has a metal body with a rubber grip at the bottom. It is comfortable to write with. I like that the barrel is thick, a little larger than a pencil. It has a medium point and writes smoothly. It did not skip. The ink is black. Only warning, DO NOT be that person who repeatedly clicks the tops of pens in meetings, in class or at work. That is annoying. I would recommend these pens to anyone, especially if they own a small business or work somewhere that requires people to use pens. I’d recommend these.

title: A little taste of nostalgia.
text: I can’t for the life of me figure out why I wanted this little pencil holder so bad, but boy-oh-boy, does it make me happy. It is so darn cute - little blue boot with two small (yellow and red) birds perched on the toes. The shoes are untied and the boot looks well worn/well loved.  This ceramic piece reminds me of a fairy tale – Snow White or Cinderella. She happy and fun. I plan to put it on my desk. You can do a lot with this little piece of nostalgia. You could place a small arrangement of artificial flowers in it or a few stalks of lucky bamboo.  You could place it in a kid’s room, filling it with crayons, colored pencils or markers. I can even see using this for a centerpiece at a summer BBQ, filling it with silverware. It will definitely make you smile. And finally, it is safe for all surfaces. There are felt circles on the bottom to protect your furniture. Overall, I give this 5 stars because it is such a happy little item.

title: Much needed. 4.5
text: I am sure that I am not the only one who has trouble finding a lanyard that is fashionable and durable. Well, the MNF ID case seems to be one that is. It is black, so stands out on my desk or in my purse. There is a section for your ID and a place to place a debit card or money. This is really convenient if you don't want to take your entire purse with you to lunch. Your valuables will be secured in the zippered portion, which frees up your hands, and the strap is removable if you just want to use the wallet portion. This ID case won't look dirty because of the color. So in my opinion, this is a traditional lanyard with a slight twist. I would recommend it.

title: Storage made simple.
text: These decorative storage boxes, by Trizo, are attractive and practical. They are dark gray with cream pinstripes. These boxes are easy to assemble and come with handy lids. I’m doing a lot of renovations in my home and these are perfect for getting organized. They can store files (i.e., bills), photos and other documents. They look great stacked or on shelves/bookshelves.  I’d definitely recommend these.

title: Badge on.
text: My husband was recently promoted and needed a name tag for his uniform. The company that supplies his department is running behind due to Covid. These arrived as ordered. I was pleased with the quality. Unfortunately, they aren’t the right shade of gold. They are more brass colored than bright gold, but they will work until his others come in. Besides, there is nothing wrong with having a spare pair. Finally, we both liked how easy it was to order and receive these name tags. They even arrived early than expected. We are pleased with this purchase.

title: Organizing your workspace.
text: Perfect for organizing my workspace. I like that this sits evenly on my desk. It is reasonably priced, under $23. It is easy to assemble. It has a functional design - shelves with sections on the top. I love that you can place items like post-its, pens and gem/binder clips. The mesh design is attractive. It is perfect for the home office, cubicle or workspace.

title: Functional and beautiful.
text: This two-set of mouse/wrist pads by EkuaBot are pretty and functional. One is a wrist pad and the other is a mouse pad. Both have an ergonomic design with padding that is comfortable. The mandala pattern is beautiful. I love the colors some of which include purple, green, black, orange, yellow and white. These are perfect for your home office or workspace. Both pieces are affordable, under $20 on Amazon. I’d recommend these.

title: The perfect hiding spot.
text: When I was in college (which was a long time ago), my father gave me a portable safe book. Initially, I thought it was a dumb gift, but he insisted that I keep my valuables in it and away from prying eyes.  Needless to say, he was right, and I still use it to this day to hide valuables (i.e., money and jewelry). So, when offered, I ordered the Real Pages Portable Safe book since it had a new feature that my older one didn’t, a combination lock (directions for resetting the lock) are included. The secret space inside is large enough to hide jewelry and or cash. This is a nice feature, even though if someone locates it, I doubt a combination lock will deter then. They can just take the book and destroy it once they have it. On the other hand, what I do like about this portable safe is that you can use it to hide stuff in plain sight. I don’t think the average burglar is going to come into your house and grab a book, especially at my house which has several large bookcases. I do think that anyone who looks closely will think the book looks odd (spine and title), but at a glance it is innocuous. There are a few loose pages that make it look authentic before you get to the bound section with the hidden compartment. It easily blends in with other books. Overall, I’d recommend it. It is the perfect hiding spot and even came with a bonus lanyard. Definitely a must have and cheaper than a safe.

title: Useful and practical. Definitely worth it.
text: Saiji’s Bed Tray is perfect to use it while sitting in bed, on the sofa or while sitting on the floor. It is practical, useful and easy to assemble. This is the perfect tool for people who work from home or for students. The table itself is light grey and white. The legs unfold from the bottom of the tray are adjustable. There is a cool bookstand that slides out from the bottom and can be placed on top in the appropriate slot. There are other features that make it worth considering too. There is a small slide-out drawer that can hold a remote, glasses or anything you’d like. If you are an artist, you can place your colored/sketch pencils in there while sketching your latest masterpiece. There is another plastic piece of plastic that prevents either the laptop or whatever you’re using from slipping. This same area can hold a pen or pencil. And finally, the top is wide enough (it holds my old school laptop) to hold a laptop book or pad. When it is not in use, you can collapse it and hide wherever you’d like, for example under a bed or against a wall. Overall, this is definitely worth purchasing especially if you want something comfortable to use while working in bed.

title: A cute yet well writing pen.
text: The Morningrising Crystal Heart pens are perfect to give away on Valentine’s Day. They are pretty and fun. This set of pens (12) come in cute colors: silver, pink, red, blue, silver, gold, white, white w/polka dots, green, rose gold, purple and burgundy - each with a cute crystal heart suspended on top. Each pen comes with a refill and a black drawstring bag (perfect for gift giving). These would not only be nice to give away on Valentine’s Day, but you could give them away to bridesmaids, as wedding gifts, at a graduation party, for a Sweet 16 party, to give to teachers or really any occasion. These write well – easily gliding across the paper. They don’t skip. They are comfortable in your hand and easy to hold. And finally, these are reasonably priced (under $17 on Amazon). In conclusion there is nothing like a cute, well writing pen. I’d recommend these.

title: Finally I’m organized.
text: Believe it or not, I spent this holiday weekend getting my kitchen organized. Specifically, my drawers have been a mess for a while. So I ordered the Growsun Bamboo Drawer Utensil with high hopes. Guess what? This drawer organizer exceeded my hopes! It is very pretty and my drawer definitely looks clean. Extremely clean! You can also wipe out the sections if they get dirty with a damp cloth. And finally, I like that it can be expanded to fit my entire drawer.

title: Meow! 4.5 stars
text: The My Yearly (2020-2021) Planner, which is covered in varying cats, is nice but a little pricey. There are several features in addition to the traditional calendar: (a) monthly planning,  (b) weekly journal section (to capture goals, thoughts, to do lists, etc.), and (c) a storage pocket. The entire book is enclosed with an elastic band. An added bonus is the box it comes in. If you have kids, you can use it to keep colored pencils, pens, pencils or crayons. You can also keep index cards, scissors or other school supplies in it. I can think of a lot of things to keep in it. Overall, you get some cool features in this planner (18 months withstanding) but at $30, I think it is a little pricey (hence the deduction of a half a star). But in the end, I would recommend it.

title: A space saver.
text: I really like the concept of this AmazonBasics shelving unit. The mesh design is modern and sleek. There are three shelves/trays that can be suspended from the wall. I wouldn’t suggest placing heavy items on them, but it is can accommodate for files and other papers (i.e., in and out box).  It is great for organizing and perfect for a home office or traditional office. I’d definitely recommend it since it will free up space on your desk.

title: Encouraging.
text: This gold foiled Hallmark card embedded on a seafoam green card is pretty. The message is encouraging. The price is comparable to purchasing one in the store. The quality of the card stock is great and the size (5.5 x 5.5) is great for mailing.  I recommend it.

title: Celtic pride.
text: The Ruzloon Leather Journal (w/turquoise jewel) is super cute. It is Celtic inspired. The color of the binding is a beautiful brown and ties with a long, thin strap of leather. The detailing on the cover is pretty. Etched on the cover is a tree with leaves and some scroll work along the top.  Nestled in the center is a turquoise colored stone. I would estimate this book is about 5x7, but the whitish, slightly textured pages are a little smaller (maybe 4x6ish). I plan to give this to my niece, who recently at the age of 10 ½ decided to start a cupcake/cookie business. I think this journal is perfect because she can write out her recipes and even sketch pictures of her designs. She can keep this journal in a drawer, your purse, bookbag/messenger bag or just in your hand. I think artists will love this, or really anyone who likes to journal or keep a diary. Another use for this journal is to give as a gift for someone going through a health scare. For example, when my aunt was undergoing breast cancer treatments, I gave her a journal so that she could write down her thoughts, as kind of a therapy. She enjoyed that. So, I would even suggest giving this one to someone going thru a similar experience.

title: The perfect size.
text: I like the Blue Sky 2020 desk calendar. It is smaller (17x11) than the traditional desk calendar. The theme is garden flower, so each page is accented by a colorful floral design, with pink being the predominate color. The boxes are big enough to capture the information that I need. And the actual calendar is small enough to sit on my desk while not taking up too much space.  And if you’d prefer, it is small enough to hang on your wall.  Overall, I really like this desk calendar and would recommend it.

title: An inexpensive alternative.
text: This replacement cartridge did just what it was suppose to do. It was easy to install and was less expensive than in the store. I have had no issues with bleeding or smearing. I'd recommend it.

title: Smelly but beautiful.
text: The mPelle Handmade Leather Journal is very pretty. The thick leather binding (while smelly out of the box) is decorated with Celtic knots, a tree and some additional symbols. It is very artsy and cool. The pages are plain, white and thick. You can use this journal as a diary or sketch pad (if you don’t need to make large scale drawings). It is affordable (under $20).  The journal folds over and closes with a thin leather string that ties.  This is definitely a must have for budding artists.

title: Cheerful and colorful.
text: These two Yoobi spiral notebooks are cheerful. One has a colorful rainbow, and the other has a large avocado on the cover. Each notebook has 60 sheets of college ruled/lined notebook paper. They can be removed easily. You can use these notebooks for lab notes, or as a diary or journal. On the cover of each is a pencil pouch that you can hold small things (like ID cards, money, crayons, small colored pencils, etc.).  These are perfect for young girls in elementary (5th grade), middle or high school. I’d recommend them. They will definitely make young girls smile. 4.5 stars

title: Pretty and functional.
text: The Orange Circle Zip-Around folio is wonderful. It is perfect for the executive and business professional. It is aesthetically pretty…a greenish/brown leather like material with a rose gold zipper. There are rose gold foiled cones and rose shaped flowers with leaves and vines on the cover. There is a rear pocket that you can slip things into it. Inside there is a large and small pocket, with slits that hold business cards or an ID. The faux leather folio zips around the calendar and keeps everything inside secure. The calendar itself is monthly and/or daily. The monthly section has a note section. There is a large area that can be used to write down upcoming events. The holidays are pre-marked. And finally, there is also a place to keep a pen or stylus secure. Once zippered, your items are secure. And finally, this folio will make you look smart and organized when attending a meeting or attending class.

title: Cute and functional.
text:
The Orange Circle Studio 2020 Planner is cute. It includes:
-A spending log.
-A goals section.
-Prefilled funny things/words on the monthly calendar.
-There are cute sayings (hashtags) on the note pages: #seize the day, #dream big, #have more fun and stay focused.
-The calendar can be used monthly and/or daily.
-On the day option, you can rate your day, from one to five stars. It includes a goal tracker, task list and even a water tracker for those who are trying to get healthy.
-The holidays are pre-marked.
-It also includes several pages for notes in the rear.
-There are stickers that can be used to add fun to help organize yourself.
AND FINALLY, how cute is Claire Giraffe.
This is the perfect planner to give to a rising senior or college student. They can have fun while organizing upcoming events. I’d recommend it.

title: Perfect for a (dorm) room.
text: This 11x14 Amazon Basics dry erase/magnetic board is perfect for the traditional (dorm) room. You can hang it on your front door, for people to leave messages/notes. Or you can place it inside your room to keep you organized. I have a son who will be a freshman in college this fall and I think he will benefit from having this board. It comes with a dry erase marker and two magnets (to hold photos/notes). It isn’t too big or too small. You can hang it vertically or horizontally. It is the standard dry eraser board surrounded by a metal frame. In the end, this is perfect for organizing your thoughts and keeping your schedule. This is a tool that can help with any student’s success. 4 stars

title: Perfect for the novice.
text: The HP Laserjet 179fhw is perfect for my household. It scans, prints and copies. It is a decent size. It is easy to set up. It is a color printer if needed. The toner is pretty pricey, so use it sparingly. For my household, this printer works out well. My kids just print off their papers, or some research. And I just print out recipes, so it is fine. I keep it in my home office, so the size isn’t a big issue.  It prints well from a tablet, phone or computer. Overall, for my purposes this printer is perfect.

title: It is after all Graduation season.
text: This is the perfect box of Hallmark cards especially during graduation season. It contains 24 cards that have 6 different designs, 6 cards per design. The card stock is thick and easy to write on. The inside of the cards are blank while the outside are festive and fun.  The cards have the following (six) themes: Hooray for You, Bravo, Congrats, Yay You, Look Out World and Woo Hoo. The fronts of the cards nicely illustrated and colored black, white and gold foil. These are perfect for a lot of occasions – graduations (i.e., middle school, high school or college), retirement, promotions, or really any celebration. They are a great size and will only require the traditional stamp when mailing. Overall, I think for the price (under $15) you can’t beat it. I’d highly recommend them.

title: Write on.
text: The Sunrise Yellow Pearlescent Lacquered Cross Pen is sheer perfection. The color is bold and dramatic. The weight of the pen is wonderful. It glides across the paper. The ink is black and shows up well on various pieces of paper stock. I think this is perfect as a graduation, new job or treat for yourself. I’d recommend it.

title: Makes me laugh every time I think about it.
text: I am the first to admit that I am a little corny, which explains why I like this Byairls’ pet tag so much.  When I read it for the first time, I literally laughed out loud at the sentence on the front (“I’m an ** and ran away”). We are a two dog household, but I selected Joey, our 18-month-old rescue, to wear this witty tag even though he is chipped. Between the two, he is more likely to escape than my 13-year-old, diabetic and blind pooch. So while I honestly don’t think he would ever wonder off, at least I know this tag will help bring him home, especially after I have my phone number engraved on the back. You could also add another tag with your personal information. The stainless steel tag is well made and the perfect size (about the size of a nickel). Overall, I like this tag A LOT and would recommend it.

title: So pretty it inspires you to be organized.
text: Blue Sky has come up with a lovely, rather beautiful premium planner. It is very feminine. It is a nice size (7x9) and is thin enough to fit inside your purse, especially if you are like me and carry a large one. Or you can easily slip it into your backpack or laptop bag. The cover is white with red, yellow and pink flowers. In the front, on the first page is a yearly (2019 & 2020) overview. Followed by a pocketed section that can be used for storing receipts or other loose papers. Next, there is a quick reference and contacts section. At the beginning of each month is a monthly calendar, followed by a weekly breakdown along with Personal/Weekly to do Lists, as well as a place to write down your goals.  There is also a large “Note It” section in the rear. With everything that this planner has to offer, you have no excuse but to be organized. I’d recommend it especially for students and those who just want to be organized!

title: Get organized at a glance.
text: The At-A-Glance 2019 Weekly Planner is nice. The color (bright red) pops and is easy to keep up with. It isn’t too big. The pages are the standard 8.5 x 11 size. This calendar is in a weekly format. And although I would have liked it more had it included a month at a glance sheet following ever month. Regardless, you can keep up with appointments daily every 15 minutes. So you can schedule stuff every 15 minutes from 7am until 9pm. You can also view a week at a glance on two pages. There is a map with time zones, with states and their capitals. There is also a page for names, addresses and phone numbers. I think that busy moms or busy students could definitely benefit from using this book since it is so regimented. I’d recommend it.

title: Nostalgic.
text: What’s cuter than a token gift or stocking stuffer that makes you remember your childhood? Well, this Hallmark Signature Disney Notepad with a Mickey Mouse Silhouette does just that. The heavy ivory pages, trimmed in gold with the iconic/signature Mickey Mouse in the corner is super cute. I like that the paper is good quality and thick. I know that those people who believe in magic and love this iconic character will devour this. I’d recommend them especially for those who enjoy writing personalized notes and or cards.

title: You know it’s Christmas when you see Snoopy and Woodstock!
text: Am I the only person who remembers watching Charlie Brown during the Holiday season? And just looking at these six cards brings back fond memories.  In my head, I hear the music, the legendary theme song (accompanying piano) and smile. In a few words, Charlie Brown and the gang symbolize the holidays.  How many of us has cups of coco while watching it the special on tv.  These cards bring back that nostalgia. That feeling of home and friends. Of course I snatched these cards up when offered and guess what? I received six pretty cute cards with accompanying red envelopes. This set include two cheerful designs (Snoopy & Woodstock with a Christmas Tree or his iconic dog house). The illustrations (with iridescent glitter accents) are cute and the accompanying wording is festive. These cards are perfect for the holiday season and will definitely bring a smile to the receiver’s face.

title: Four colorful, fun pens!
text: These four Parker Jotter Originals Pens are quite the find. I love these medium point pens and their colorful outer shells. These pens write well. The ink is black and doesn’t smear. I kind of wish that the ink did match their outside colorful shells, but you can’t have everything you want. Teens and adults will love these because you will quickly be able to identify your pens and they make you look a little smarter. The only drawback is that these pens are kind of pricey. They cost around $28, which equals about $7 each. This set of pens would make a great that anyone will adore and appreciate.

title: Sophisticated and pretty.
text: I love these thank you cards. The illustration is breathtaking (soft pink blooms with green leaves). It is a watercolor. In person, these cards are more muted than they appear in the picture.  The writing (Thank You) on the front is embellished in gold. These cards are beautifully made. They are about a 4x6 or a little smaller. The paper is quality and easy to write on. The envelopes are a soft pinkish/peach. The inside is blank, so there is plenty of room to write a personalized message. You get 10 cards for around $10, which means that you pay about $1 each.

title: At a Glance.
text: This 2019 Weekly/Monthly Planner (January 2019-January 2020) is perfect for your home or office. You can write detailed notes in the daily section and summarize events on the monthly summary pages. You can see everything scheduled for the month at a glance. In the front of the calendar/planner, there is a convenient plastic sheet with pockets. It is thin enough to slip in your briefcase or messenger bag. The color is neutral…peacock green, and will work for a man or woman.

title: A little larger than I expected.
text: When I selected this At-A-Glance DayMinder Daily Appointment Calendar (January-December 2019), I had high hopes. Personally, I prefer paper calendars over electronic ones. I am one of those people who do not like setting reminders on my telephone, but rather write them down. I never pay attention to those reminders that pop up on my phone or are shared with my husband or kids. Basically, I thought this daily calendar would be perfect. I probably should have read the description better or at least have gotten one that included a weekly or monthly summary page, versus a daily, by the hour one. I found this one to be a little bulky or cumbersome. However, if you have to keep up with something daily (by the hour), or have multiple events/children to schedule for, this is perfect. However, I will warn you if you are a person that prefers to carry your calendar with you, this planner is thick, bulky and large.

title: How can you go wrong?
text: It’s back to school time and who doesn’t need a decent spiral notebook. This 1 subject notebook is trendy. It is black with a blue football outlined on the front. There are 100 sheets of pretty decent paper. When I use my gel pens, it doesn’t bleed or run. Only warning is that this notebook is wide ruled. So, if you are looking for school supplies and have a student (elementary, middle and high), this notebook may be worth a look.

title: Large and in charge.
text: The AmazonBasics Hard Gaming Mouse Pad is pretty great. My family loves it. With FortNite all the rage, a gaming mouse pad is just the thing to improve your gaming experience on a laptop.  This mouse pad is super large (13.9 x 10 inches). There are LED lights along the border. With a push of a button (which is located on the top, center) you can control the color change. You can also set the colors to cycle constantly. The surface is smooth and flat. The rubberized bottom is non-skid and does not move. There is no set-up, all you have to do is connect the mouse pad via USB port. Essentially, there are two things that make this pad standout from others on the market: the size and the LED lights. Overall, for the price, you get a pretty sweet gaming mouse pad. I’d recommend it.

title: The perfect card for the Star Wars fan.
text: My husband is a Sci Fi fan (specifically Star Wars and Star Trek) so this Father’s Day Hans Solo card is perfect. It is cute and has the perfect message for a wonderful husband and father. The colors are great (gold/yellow, black and white) and there is even a cool 3D image of the Millennium Falcon.  Cool card. 5 stars

title: Happy Father’s Day.
text: This is one of the cutest Father’s Day cards that I have seen. It is especially cute if that special father (grandfather, uncle, brother, etc) that you are giving it to, is a true fisherman. This card can be given to any father of any age. This card is: (1) unlike a lot of cards affordable (under $5); (2) it is funny and (3) the graphics and pictures are vivid and cheery. This Hallmark fish themed Father’s Day card is a delight! I would highly recommend it. 5 stars

title: This makes organizing your desk FUN!
text:
This black, faux leather caddy is perfect for organizing your desk. The side compartments are perfect for pens, pencils, letter openers and scissors. The larger areas are perfect for post-it notes, a message pad or various other items that you use daily. It’s very modern and attractive. It’s affordable and I believe will match most office/home décor.

Note: I would even consider this caddy to be versatile. You can not only use it in your office (home or work), but you could use it to store remotes and other family room essentials. 5 stars

title: A beautifully crafted card.
text: Hallmark is a company known for designing beautiful cards that fit every occasion. This is no exception, while it has very few words, the front of the card invokes strong feelings of family and nostalgia. This wonderful Mother’s Day card (part of the Signature Collection) is no exception.  The card is simple and yet has some fantastic, artistic features. The card uses pastel watercolors and intricately designed cut-outs that make it special. It is ivory colored and textured, and depicts a family swinging in a park, beneath a huge flowering tree. The tree has small three-dimensional flowers that simply leap from the cover. The message inside is simple and will be perfect for any mother. I’d highly recommend it.

title: Functional and cute.
text: This organizer/calendar is colorful. The cover is made from a durable heavy paper and is covered with flowers and succulents. The binding is a spiral ring, so if you need to tear out pages, you can. The dates are from August 2017 to December 2018. It is probably the size of a paperback novel. It can fit into your purse or backpack without taking too much space. It is easy to use. There are inspirational quotes before each month. You can see a month at a glance, the holidays and moon phases included. Behind each month, is a daily calendar where there is plenty of space to write or make notations. In the rear of the organizer, there is an area titled: Things to Do, Things NOT to do and Goals 2019.  Overall, if you are looking for a functional and attractive organizer, this is the one for you. I’d highly recommend it.

title: Old school perfection.
text: My mother is old school....literally and figuratively. She is in her late 60s and not necessarily interested in keeping up with things via modern technology. One thing that she asked for for Christmas was a new address book. Of course I tried to explain how she could keep her contacts on her computer or on her cell phone, but she was insistent, she wanted an old fashioned address book. I found this one on Amazon and she loves it. I even decided to get one for myself. I purchased the "Making Connections" version for her and the "Celestial" one for me. Making Connections is black with embellishments and the Celestial is a nice shade of blue with gold embellishments. The pages are the perfect size and easy to write on with ink or pencil. They are both easy to hold and store. Definitely for those who prefer to put pen to paper; who simply want to keep everything old school; or for those who want have a paper option as backup - this book is a must have.

title: A "joy" to write with!
text:
In a few short sentences...Paper Mate Ink Joy 300ST pens are:
Affordable.
Comfortable and easy to hold (rubber grip and long barrel/shaft).
Smooth writing...no skipping.
Bold color (I received these in blue).
Warning: if you don't like pens with removable tops, this one isn't for you. It isn't retractable. However, the top remains securely on the top.
This is a fantastic, inexpensive pen....perfect for students, the office or at home.
I highly recommend them.

title: For an artist at heart.
text:
Smead Supertab Coloring folders are perfect for middle schoolers or a budding artist. These 12 folders will not only keep you organized, but they allow you to be creative. You can color various patterns and be as daring as you want. You can use colored pencils, pens, markers or even crayons. The folders are made of traditional heavy cardstock, and are the same size of an average file folder. The 12 folders are divided into 4 very interesting/fun patterns (3 files of each pattern), so you can play with the color schemes and have lots of fun.

Only issue I see with these folders is the market for them. And trust me, I double checked with my two teenage sons to see what they thought of this product. It is there opinion that younger kids (i.e., elementary or middle schoolers), would like these folders more so than the high schoolers. However, they both think that there may be a market for these in the performing art schools, with art teachers, regular teachers, over-achieving parents (of young kids) or overachiever organizers. But to my teenage boys their response when asked was “coloring anything in high school isn’t cool”, and for those who want to color, they think they would rather enjoy doodling on their notebooks where they can design their own designs, graffiti or cover art.

In conclusion for under $12, these folders end up costing about $1 each, which isn’t overly expensive if you enjoy having something different to express your inner artist. I give this product 3.5 to 4 stars.

title: These Papermate Ink Joy gel pens rock!
text:
Believe it or not, there is nothing like using a smooth, colorful pen to take notes or jot a quick card. While some think writing is a lost art, it really isn’t. It is something that with the right instruments, can be fun and enjoyable.
These pens are no exception.
For a little less than $7, you get a convenient 2 pack. This equates to a little over $3 each.
An Ink Joy is a retractable pen, with a medium point. It comes in bold, vivid colors. This two pack contains a teal blue and neon red pen.
These pens write smoothly and glide across the page easily.
The rubber body is comfortable, and easy to grip/hold. And it doesn’t slip while you are writing.
What really sold me on these pens is the fact that the ink doesn’t smear. **Note: I only used my pens on traditional paper (notebook and printer), a composition pad, envelopes and regular card stock. I didn’t try to write on photo paper or anything exotic or unique. I didn’t have any problems with bleeding or smearing.
In conclusion, I would definitely recommend these pens…especially to teenage girls who enjoy writing in diaries, jotting notes, writing cards, or poems. With an added bonus being that the colors will make it fun and entertaining.

title: A notebook that everyone can enjoy.
text:
This Mead Red Notebook is attractive. It has a thick, red textured cover with a black elastic band.
You can use the black band to mark your page or keep the book secured.
This notebook is the perfect size (8 1/4 x 5 3/4) for notes. Or it can be used as a diary or journal.
It is neutral.....not masculine or feminine. It can be enjoyed by men or women.
Teenage girls and mothers will love it.
Teenagers can use it for a diary and moms can use it to make grocery lists, to do lists etc.
The book fits well in your purse, messenger bag or backpack.
The pages are good quality and lined (college ruled). The bottom of each page is marked with a capital R.
While I give this notebook 5 stars, I do find that it is a tad bit expensive. I understand that office supplies, especially high-in office products are costly, but $22 for a journal this size is a bit much.

title: You'll either LOVE IT or HATE IT! 3.5-4
text:
This "At A Glance 2016 Monthly Planner" is decent...it isn't fabulous or one of those planners that you can't live without, but it isn't horrible either.
You will either love it or hate it. For me, it's fine.
The cover is attractive. It is textured and reminds me of a heavy duty stationary...in terms of the look and feel. There is a coating or plastic on the inside of the cover and rear.
When opened, I have the entire month at a glance.
The pages are 8.5 x 11. The calendar layout (pages) is in black, but the names of the months are in red. Under each month, there is small area (on the left side of the pages) where you can jot notes or messages. Writing in the boxes is simple enough. But if you prefer those planners that offer a ton of detail (i.e., times or lines), this planner isn't for you. It is basic, pretty simple.
There are tabs that help you navigate thru the months pretty easily.
There is an elastic band that you can use either to secure the planner or mark your page.
There are no pockets on the inside, which means that whatever you put inside the planner will only be secured by the elastic band.
I was a little surprised by how thin it is. For some reason I thought it was going to be a little like some of the planners I have purchased in the past, but it isn't. I would venture to say that if I have to compare, it is as thin as a Time or People magazine. You can slip it in your purse, backpack or tote.
There are pages in the back for you to write down contacts or notes.
There is also a page that lists important dates and holidays.
AND finally, there is a US map that includes area codes and time zones.
In conclusion, this planner is decent, but nothing too special. I like it but think that the average consumer will have an issue spending $18 for it. I have seen some a lot nicer for less.

title: An average tool meant to organize students. 3 to 3.5 stars
text:
The benefits of purchasing the Mead Five Star 2015-2016 (August to July) planner are:

1. The size is perfect. It fits well in a large purse or backpack.
2. The thick plastic cover is attractive and seems to be durable.
3. This is the perfect tool for a student (or non-student) to get organized.
4. It covers a school year….August 2015 thru July 2016. It is divided by the month, which is on two facing pages. Following each month is a daily option with bullets for you to write events or tasks.
5. Scattered throughout the planner are other items that are beneficial for students: proofreading symbols; conversions; the states and their capitals; spelling tips; maps; dates to remember and holidays.

The cons of purchasing this planner:
1. It is kind of expensive ($18) for what you get. I think someone in the market for a planner can find one that has more features (i.e., times, scratch paper, etc.) or that is just as good, if not better for less.
2. This planner would have been superior if there had been times that corresponded with the daily section. That is a feature that I normally look for in a planner, and is a feature that I think would appeal to some consumers…although you can write in the times of the events by the bullets.

In conclusion, while this planner is aesthetically pleasing to the eye, it is nothing special and in my humble opinion does not warrant the $18 asking price. Therefore, I can only give it 3 to 3.5 stars.

title: Slippery, Clunky to adjust, Way too tall for a lap desk
text:
I am 5'7" tall. This is not made for humans my size (or shorter) for use as a lap desk.

The photos show items sitting on the desk on full tilt, such as the phone and the ipad, staying in place. They had to glue those down, or those are photoshopped images, because this is so slippery, that even on the lowest tilt my mouse and laptop fly all over the place. Using a wireless magic mouse, so my mouse on the screen goes all over. This is also way way too tall to use as a lapdesk - unless you like carpel tunnel and shoulder/arm pain, it's the complete opposite of ergonomic. I didn't expect it would be, but I also didn't expect it to be so bad. I thought because of those photos, it would be possible to actually sit on the couch. I have deep seating, so figured it would be fine - it's not. Even with deep seats, the tips of the legs don't sit on the couch at all - about 4 inches stick out - and it's so high up, tilt doesn't help. You do NOT want to keep your arms up so high when working, and with this on the lowest height, my arms were raised up very high, maybe 11 inches higher than they should be for proper posture. Use at your own risk!!

I think this would be useful for kids to color or have a snack while sitting on the floor - this is NOT for professionals using it to work on, and I wouldn't even be able to use this for a few minutes on a laptop for any reason. It's not comfortable, it's not possible to keep your laptop and mouse from sliding all over the desk unless it's completely flat with no tilt - which is impossible to use.

However, after a few months I noticed that one of the legs would fold with the slightest pressure. I thought I might just need to tighten the screw because it had come loose over time. Instead I saw that the screw was fine, but the plastic was cracking. After looking closer I saw that the plastic was cracking on both sides of the plastic fitting on the left leg and was starting to crack on the right leg. This was a Christmas present and lasted less than 5 months. This isn’t a cheap lap desk either. The plastic is obviously not durable enough to withstand regular useless. I understand that in order for the legs to lock in place and fold the joint needs to have some give, but apparently this plastic does not have that capability in the long run. Perhaps a metal joint with a rubber bumper would be a better more durable option.
I’m really disappointed that this table was so easily broken with just normal use. I’d like to keep using it and just replace the broken plastic joints, but I don’t know where I would find them.

title: Make sure you have time to set up
text: I have always had HP Product, they have served me well.  My last printer purchase was not HP, I went for a lower cost item and have hated it since day one.  Three years of aggrivation and it is out in the shed.  Now for this new model HP OfficeJet Pro 9015e - newer model of what I owned years ago.  Set up should be simple.  Make sure you have at least one hour if not more, and that it is a good day for patience.  You will have to set up through the HP Smart app.  That was easy to download on my phone.  Make sure you have your printer on, ink installed, let it run through the test page - then you have to scan that for accuracy.  Then set up your wifi. Then go to the app and start.  You will have to do several things before you can move forward.  Set up bluetooth on phone so it can talk to the printer.  Add shipping info for ink program, add credit card info for same.  Add or change settings of what HP plans to track on your phone.  Literally, most every thing done on the phone app, is to set you up for the free ink program.  Basically it is going to charge you (free for 6 months) to print on a machine that you own.  And bill you monthly based on the plan you choose, and then send ink as needed.  Now - I don't plan to pay anyone to print from something I already own.  I own the paper and the ink as well.  The cartridges that will be sent must be returned to them because if you cancel after you have received some ink, they will not end program until you ship the cartridges back, completely used or not although you have paid for them.  All of this is done for your convience of having them monitor your printer, and have proof that you are not using knock off ink.  I suppose if you wanted to use the warranty for a faulty printer - this plan is similar to an insurance policy.  I have found no other real use for it.  That being said I did note someone else in these reviews state that they got rid of thiers after installation.  And so that is what I did - I went through all of the bologna to get my printer to love me as its owner.  I then went into my own computer and found I had to completely set it up on my own - which is not difficult but come on, all the HP Smart app was about was them, not the buyer by any means.  Once set up and settings placed where i wanted them (I always use Draft printing unless I am printing photos, which saves a lot of ink), I turned around and logged out of my phone app and uninstalled it, since it will be no use to me.  I won't send things from my phone to the printer to print.  Then I went online to the HP Smart site and cancelled my free subscription.  I had to go through several 'are you sure' but finally got it to cancel, in 30 days.  I cannot seem to remove my credit card info, etc., and I will keep a watch.  As for the printer itself, it spools and prints quickly.  The scanner is very quick which is a welcomed blessing after my other printer.  Adding multiple pages for copy or scanning is wonderfully easy as well.  Only cons to this point is that the cord is not long enough for me to sit the printer facing me and so it is in the way of other things.  And it is the nosiest thing ever!  I can make it "less noisey" but have to commit to a slower printer which won't shake or make as much noise to print.  I will have to check it out.  With this review I am now at 2 hours but I am confident my printer will work as expected.  Just have patience, make sure to arrange the time with no interruptions.

title: Decent, but not always at the price....
text:
I've used this now for a few months. I have severe health problems and am unable to sit up in a chair for long, so using this in my adjustable bed with my laptop has made me able to use my laptop a little more. I bought several lap desks in the $15-$25 range that did not have legs and they were all just kinda meh and not really helpful enough. So I snagged this on sale.
I'll start by saying that this list price is absolutely ridiculous. And anywhere near it is ridiculous. I would not even pay anywhere near the price it currently is at the time of this review, and if I had, I would be very dissatisfied upon trying it out. It is not a bad lapdesk, but it has major flaws. I find that the legs do not lock properly. They will easily fold. It randomly goes up/down in height every day. I am constantly adjusting it. The locks just do not stay - none of them. And honestly, I wish it could adjust a tiny bit lower. I am not hugely skinny - I'm not super large, and I am short, but I am a little on the chubby side - still, it sits a little higher than is comfortable for my arms, so I often prop my arms up with pillows. Also, the removable little laptop stopper is not nearly long enough....especially if you have a mouse too. I wish it came with a second one for a mouse, or was longer, or something. I'm often playing video games, so the trackpad is just not feasible...and annoying to me even when browsing....I want an external mouse. But it slides off a lot.
This may seem strange, but I also wish it had a cup holder, lol.
However, the up sides is it is strong material. While it folds up randomly and won't lock properly, the material itself is solid and I feel like it won't break easily. There's also no need for a mouse pad, my mouse tracks well on the slightly grippy material. The little cell phone/tablet slot up top is nice. Not quite deep enough for my cell phone a lot of the time, and I have a smaller smartphone for today's phone - a Galaxy s21 5g, not a + or note, but still the phone tends to fall out easily. But I also can use it for pens or misc things I need to put there.

All in all, I'm semi-satisfied. If I paid even half of the list price, I don't know that I would be - I'd probably have returned it. But it seems difficult to find the perfect lapdesk - and everyone has different needs and is different body shape, etc, so fit may be different. I don't know if -none- of the locks really working is a defect in only mine, or a consistent design problem, but the fact that there are multiple locks and none of them stay leads me to believe it is a design issue.

I'm not quite sure what I'll use this for but I think this would make a nice gift for someone who'd like this for journaling or sketching in ink.

title: Awesome drafting chair
text:
I actually bought a Modway chair for my boyfriend a month or two before I received this one for myself through vine.

We switched to mesh chairs because our apartment gets pretty warm in the summer and our newly set up office area is especially warm. We had faux leather desk chairs at the time and boy oh boy, do those chairs not let your butt breathe haha I'm kind of a naturally sweaty person, while my boyfriend likes to play computer games and he can get quite hot while playing. So it was definitely time for a change to something more breathable.

Since getting this mesh chair I've been very cool and comfortable while working at my desk. I don't have a particularly high desk but it is higher than normal so it's nice to have a chair that accommodates that. This chair works amazing for standing type desks though.

I set up these chairs myself and while it can seem a bit intimidating at first, it's actually pretty easy and straight forward. I did it alone and probably spent about 15 minutes or so doing it.

As far as back support goes, it's pretty comfy. I wish it could lean back a bit more but I realize that could easily be a safety issue in a high chair.

Overall I'm very satisfied with these chairs, and I've been using mine everyday for about a month or two. Awesome chairs, I would recommend just choosing a back that suits your preferences and getting it.

Hope this review is helpful!:)

title: Great for working on the road
text: Great for working on the road, perfect for an RV or small camper. The rechargeable battery is awesome when you're somewhere off grid, like vending at a flea market or craft show without power and you get that one person who really really really wants a paper receipt. Or you want to print an agenda or something else of the sort. Or you're doing something at the airport and can't get to an outlet. This is my first battery powered printer and I really love the concept.  Setup was painless, it hooked up to the wifi right away. The cartridges are small and light so I'm guessing they're not going to last long. It's a little bigger heavier than I expected, and it's NOT the battery as that's removable and surprisingly small.  If you're a true road warrior I guess you could pick up a spare. It feels like it will stand up to portable usage, unlike a few other mini printers I've looked at. You're not tossing this in your briefcase, however.  So in my mind, it's a compromise device. If I was carrying it around in carry-on luggage every other day, I'd go for the really small ones. But for other mobile uses, I think it's great.

title: Wireless setup was a breeze.
text: Wow. Setup does not get any easier. Well, at least it gets easier after you manhandle this heavy and large printer into place. If you're looking at that description and wondering if that shipping weight is correct, it is.  It weighs a ton.  I pulled off all the tape, plugged it in and turned it on.  Clicked through the language and location screens on the touchscreen then went right to network setup. It found my wifi immediately, I entered the password, picked up my iPad and printed a page from iBooks immediately.  I went online to see if I could print from my laptop without installing any software (I usually hate that bloatware) but before I could I heard the printer spooling up. My 68 year old Mom had beaten me to it on her Win 8 laptop and was printing coupons. Yeah, it was that easy.  The box does say it comes with introductory toner cartridges good for 1300 pages. Wish it was full toner.  I will update the review when it runs out.

text:
Updated Review (Original Below):
The new printer works great with my Mac and the auto duplexer is a nice touch. I struggled a bit at first, but a functional one is pretty damn easy to setup and use. The HP software is clean and well designed. Despite there being a bit of a snag on the first go around, overall I'm very pleased.

This printer was simply broken upon arrival. The paper try would not adjust to fit 8.5x11 paper. I was able to finagle it to print the alignment page, but after that, it simply would not go.

Pros:
1. Unboxing and printer set-up documentation is clear and easy to understand.
2. Guided set-up is easy.

Cons:
1. Well, it's broken out of the box.
2. Support was basically not helpful in the situation because it was a physical problem that was difficult to explain over the phone. Eventually they gave up and said they would just mail me a new one.

While I appreciate the offer, I have no interest in swapping a printer that was broken to begin with. I'll simply use the touchless return from Amazon and order from a different manufacturer.

I had previously sworn off HP printing products for lack of quality and support. I had decided to gamble on this one and take on chance hoping things have improved. There are a number of high quality reviews for this printer, so your milage may vary.
