title: Sturdier Than Many Other Carts I Have Built
text:
They call me the cart queen. That's right. The cart queen. Why, you might ask? It is because in order to deal with the fall out from a flood inspired remodel, I have found that using carts with many shelves is superior to stacking endless boxes everywhere. I can move them quickly and store just as much or more in the floor space without straining my back. I have a LOT of other carts to compare this one to.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box, well wrapped in plastic and cushioned from damage. All of the parts are in great bags and the instructions are clear.

DOES IT COME WITH TOOLS?
This does come with tools, but the Allen Key is a bit flimsy, so you might want to bring out your own if you have them and get better results. It strips easily.

ASSEMBLY
The assembly of this cart is not difficult. It took a bit of pressure to get a few holes lined up, but that was not a big issue. The shelves are descending in size so you have to be sure to use them in order. They are clearly marked with numbers again- excellent feature.

STURDY
This is one of the more sturdy carts I have built. The shelves are metal and the design is not wobbly like so many of them are when you load them up with semi substantial items.

WHEELS
The wheels of this cart are again smoother and better made than many of the other carts I have used. they are metal and rubberized material so they are not cheap plastic.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a really nice cart. The space between shelves make it easy to store just about anything I need to store. The sturdy way that this holds items is much better than others.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this cart a lot. It took me a while to build it because I had to clear a spot for it, but I am glad I did. I saved one of the best for last. This one is a winner for me so far.

title: Assembly A Little Frustrating, But I Got It To Work
text:
I was assembling this cart and about to take a photo when an emergency caused us to have to quickly evacuate some shelves of canned goods due to mouse infestation. I did not get to take a photo yet, but I will say that this did help a lot in this emergency.

ASSEMBLY
The assembly was a bit frustrating. The holes did not all line up well. Some of the screws did not go through the holes well and had to be worked on quite a bit to get the metal artifacts off of the screws to get them to work. Once I worked it out, I got the cart to go together, but it took two of us at one point to force the pieces to line up.

STURDY SHELVES?
The shelves are sturdy enough to hold things, but they are kind of bendable plastic. That means if you have heavy items on there for very long, it will cause warping.

MOVEABLE?
These are moveable shelves and did ease up over a ridge on the floor with careful guidance and lifting.

HANDLE
The handle is not ultra sturdy, but good enough to push this around as long as the cart is not overloaded.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a bit frustrating to assemble and the sturdy factor on the shelves just a bit less than I would like, but all in all this still helped a lot during my emergency so I am glad to have it.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I took a star off for the assembly issues and shelves being a bit less thick than I would like. The rest of the cart is decent and I recommend it just not for really heavy loads.

title: Well Packed, Great Instructions, Wheels Could Be Better
text:
I have been putting together many carts to help with a remodel we have been doing. This is one in a long line.

HOW THIS COMES
This came VERY well wrapped. There are excellent instructions, everything was put into great packaging and separated well.

ASSEMBLY
The instructions were great. This went together pretty well although there were a few spots where I had to push and coax parts together. The cart is pretty sturdy and holds together pretty well. I had some issues with the handle, but after working at it, it went together okay.

STURDY?
The individual baskets are decent plastic, but they can not hold really heavy weight If you use this for a supply cart or medium weight items it is good.

WHEELS
The wheels work well, but they are pretty cheap plastic. Again, another reason not to overload this cart with heavy items.

TOOLS
This came with the tools that you need to assemble this. The screwdriver that came with it was actually a pretty good quality.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a decent cart for light to medium weight items. Instructions were great, and great care was taken to package and make this a pleasant experience.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. Even though I wish the wheels were a bit more sturdy, this cart is excellent and moves well as long as it it not overloaded.

title: Graphite Pencils It Is Okay, But Art Pencils It Seems To Waste
text:
I have a lot of use for pencil sharpeners. I use a lot of wood graphite pencils but I also use a lot of colored pencils too. That creates a need for a sharpener that is not only good for regular pencils but art pencils as well. I got this because it does sharpen larger pencils which most do not.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box well cushioned with basic instructions.

INSTRUCTIONS
The instructions are confusing because on the one hand, this is advertised as being for art and regular pencils but in the sheet inside it says to avoid waxy leads. Some colored pencils have wax in them, so this is confusing. It also lists crayons as being able to be used in here, but again, wax..

PERFORMANCE
This sharpener is good for regular pencils, although I feel it does waste some of the wood. When it comes to art pencils, however, I just feel it is a bit too wasteful and blows through not only the wood, but the leads too. Some of my pencils are far too expensive to blow away in a sharpener.

PHOTO
I posted a photo for you. This sharpener did sharpen my LYRA Color Giants Pencils in this sharpener. They are a larger colored pencil I had a hard time finding a sharpener for. The darker pencil was NOT sharpened in the sharpener, and the lighter pencil was sharpened in the sharpener, but I pulled it out before it was done- it was wasting too much pencil for my liking.

The other pencils are graphite. The first two graphite pencils on the inside of the three were sharpened in other graphite sharpeners. The blue and white pencil was sharpened in this one from Arteza. They are pretty similar.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This sharpener is fine for my regular graphite pencils. For art pencils, I feel it is a bit too wasteful for my taste.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. I got this for my art pencils since they are larger and I will use it, but I have to pull the pencil out before too much is wasted when I sharpen them. I use a different sharpener for my other colored pencils. I don't waste as much with that one.

title: On Floors, Moderately Good, Otherwise I Do Not Like This At All
text:
I originally got this because sometimes I have a hard time sitting on the floor. This seemed like a great support to have around for those days I can not avoid it. I also thought I could use it on my desk chair.

HOW TO USE THIS
The instructions say only to use this for a short time and then get up. That means it is not meant to sit in for really long periods of time. I guess I don't really understand that concept as most people at a desk that need things for support need to sit for long periods.

COMFORT
OMG On the floor I can tolerate this for a while and it does help. When I try to use this in any chair- the pain is HORRIBLE. It pokes every area of my body and makes it hurt so badly I have to get rid of it and sit on my chair support cushions again.

SUPPORT
On the floor I can use this for about 20 minutes and it does support. In a chair it is horrible- almost like a torture device for me.

STORAGE
Since I only want this for the floor now, it is very difficult to store. Putting it on a chair when not in use on the floor was my intent, but that is silly. I just end up not using it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is acceptable at times on the floor for me, but other than that, it causes so much pain all over I can not use it.

MY RATING
TWO STARS. I am giving this two stars because it does somewhat work for short periods on the floor for me. Other than that it is horrible. I had pain where I did not have pain when I sat down when using this thing. I am not a huge woman- about a size 14-16 US size misses at the time of this review. I tried this on several chairs with the same result- PAIN

title: Test Run Good, Very Pretty Paper
text:
I have plans to use these cards for. They are the size of post cards. There are not too many that come with this package, so I have to be cautious when I use them not to waste them.

HOW THESE COME
These come in a package. There are four cards on a sheet with perforated lines to break them apart once printed. There is a template paper inside with info on how to access the software template online.

HOW TO USE
First I made a template on plain printer paper with the lines penciled in. Then I design what I want and then I print samples on the regular paper until it is as I want it. Once it is, then I use the glitter paper.

COLORS
The surface is smooth, yet there are beautiful iridescent colors pressed into the surface.

DOES IT WORK?
I ran a quick test to see how the ink would print and it worked, but I have not done the big project run yet. So far it works well. I had to adjust the online template a bit, but then I decided to do my own personal template using a graphics program.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is really pretty paper. It has a beautiful iridescent glitter surface and so far has worked on my experiment. I will update when I have a complex project run on this.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. 24 sheets is not a lot so you have to plan your projects allowing for errors by buying more than you need. It is a pretty paper with a nice appearance so far when printed. I will post photos when I get a more complex project done.

title: Great To Keep Rug In Place In Bathroom
text:
I have some issues with rugs for bathrooms which claim to have a slip free backing only to find out it is terrible. I have had other double sided tape in the past, but it sticks to other things around it and it is annoying. This comes in a bag inside a box and that is perfect.

HOW TO USE
I cut the piece I need and stick it on the back of the rug. Once I have it where I want, I remove the backing on the pieces and press it into place on a CLEAN SMOOTH FLOOR

DOES IT WORK?
So far, if you are sure to make the surfaces clean and not uneven, this works well. It peels off easily when done and does not leave residue at this point.

OTHER USES
I use this for other things like holding a glass panel into place on an end table. It stays put very well so far.

THE BOTTOM LINE
As long as I keep this in the bag and in the box, it seems to keep the tape from problems. Once I use it, it works well in the applications so far.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. So far I am happy with this tape and the fact that I have a bag and box to keep it in. My last rolls stuck together and are almost impossible to get apart.

title: Beautiful Inspirational Artwork For A Journal
text:
[[VIDEOID:f91719e07a1234d7b4b7fbbec14621dd]] I have been wanting to have a special journal to jot down my inspirational thoughts and ideas on- something that makes me happy to look at. This is PERFECT.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a beautiful box with an outerspace design on it.

COVER
The cover is hard cover and it has elastic on it to mark your place or keep the book shut so you can keep this in a carry bag on the go. It has a beautiful design on it from one of the pages.

PAPER QUALITY
Not only are the pages beautiful colors with attractive artwork on them, but the quality of the pages is pretty good too. They are reasonably thick to withstand a fine point marker, but I would not use juicy markers on them unless you want it to soak through.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a beautiful journal. The pages are a pleasure to look at and I look forward to filling it with some creative thoughts.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a perfect gift for you or someone else that you know that loves beauty and colors. The journal makes me want to write in it often- a great inspiration. I would buy it again.

VIDEO
My video kept coming out too dark, and my software won't brighten it. I hope you can still see the colors well enough although in real life they are much more intense and attractive.

title: Fantastic Design, No Shift, A Bit Rough On Arms
text:
I have an issue with arm rests on my computer chair. They tear up my skin terribly. I got a set of furry ones, but they drove me nuts. They shifted, fell off, and were hard to hold on to when I would do my stationary bike in my chair from time to time.

HOW THESE WORK
These are really ingenious. They strap with velcro around the arms of the chair in two places. They can be tight so they do stay put.

THICKNESS
The thickness of the pads is perfect. I love the way they tilt back. They are much more comfortable to use this way. They don't shift and are not frustrating even when doing my bike pedaling.

SURFACE
This is the only problem with these. The surface of these is a little abrasive to my sensitive arms. It does not tear up my arms as badly as the chair did, but I still have to be sure to have on long sleeves much of the time just to help.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These are great. They stay put, are in the right thickness and design, and they help a lot. I only wish the top surface was a bit less abrasive.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. These pads are just what I was looking for. Hopefully I will get used to the surface.

title: I Wish I Had A Dispenser To Fit, But Still Like The Tape
text:
I send out a lot of packages now and having a wider tape seemed like a good idea.

HOW THIS COMES
This came all loose in a box, however, it is supposed to come in a package plastic wrapped with a sticker on it.

THICKNESS
This is in between the nicest brand name tape and the cheapest packaging tape I have used in thickness.

STICKING
This does stick well to packages and seems to stay put well.

EASE OF USE
If I get a dispenser for this wide tape, it would be easier to use, but as it is, I just am sure to have scissors handy to cut it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice set of packaging tape. It stays put, covers wider areas, and seems to hold the packages I am sending out better than the thinner tape I was using.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am glad I got this. It helps me secure packages more quickly and without using as much tape.

title: Perfect For My Coin Collection
text:
My grandfather used to work with a bakery truck. As a result, he kept a lot of odd coins he found. My mom gave me some of those coins, but I never had a really good place to keep them. Now I do.

HOW THIS IS SET UP
This 3 ring binder has a lot of room in it. It has quite a few pages, but room for a few more.

PAGES
The pages are kind of flimsy, but they do hold coins well. They have a flap on them so the coins stay in which I appreciate. They are also a bit tacky which helps hold the coins in as well.

HANDLE
There is a handle on the binding so you can carry it that way if you like.

ZIPPER
Sometimes the zipper is a bit difficult to use if you unzip it too far, but with some coaxing, it works pretty well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a coin collection you want to either display or keep in a place that allows you to see your coins at a glance, this is a nice storage book.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is helpful to me, although the zipper can be frustrating once in a while. I am thankful to get my coins into a place where I can see them in pages instead of an old plastic jar.

title: Mostly Great Performance- Batteries Don't Last As Long As Last Set
text:
WARNING- This is an in depth review for those who are serious about making a purchase decision with this phone system. If you prefer a quick summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
---------------------------------------
I have had several Panasonic sets in my house over time and have liked them. One of the things I loved about my last set is that the hand set would keep its charge for days, and I could talk for five hours and the handset would still be charged way up. I didn't have call block, so I thought I would try this one.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes with the base unit, three extensions, and all four handsets as well as rechargeable batteries in the box. It is well packed in the box and came in good shape.

YOU NEED CALLER ID TO MAKE USE OF FEATURES
If you want to use this phone system to its best, you need to have caller ID. That will allow you to know who has called, have a phone book identify who is calling, and also block calls.

SET UP
Setting this up is not difficult. I put in the main base near the phone line and plugged it in. Once that was set up including the message on the message machine, I then plugged in the extensions. You have to set up the phones to have labels on them so you will know where each phone goes. That is handy if you have the ringer blocked in a bedroom.

MESSAGE
I did have a good amount of time to leave a message for the answering machine.

CAPACITY
I let this get up to 22 messages as you can see in the photo and this still had some room for a few more. Long winded messages will limit it more, but the average messages gave me at least 22.

HOW TO SET UP THE EXTENSIONS
You don't have to have phone connections in the rooms you want to put the extensions. All you need is a plug that will fit a small transformer (see photo).

HEARING
This is easy to hear on and people hear me just fine.

HANDSETS
One issue I have with this is that the shape and lack of clips on the back of these handsets make it difficult to put the phone between your shoulder and ear if you have to use your hands for a bit.
My last phone set was very easy to hold and I liked it better.

DOES DIAL LIGHT UP?
The dial does light up and is easy to read and use, even if you were older and concerned about that.

IS SCREEN EASY TO READ?
I found the screen very easy to read and no one in the family has an issue with it.

CALL ANNOUNCING
When the phone rings, the phone announces who it is calling so you know even if you can not read the screen right away. The handsets all do this.

PHONEBOOK
The phone book and list of calls you got work great.

BLOCKING
If you block a call, what will happen is that the phone will ring once and then stop ringing. It does work, but be aware that many solicitors have multiple numbers.

CHARGING
The one issue I have with this system is that the batteries wear down WAY faster than the last system I had which is not that old. If I talk more than two or three hours, I will have the phone suddenly beep and be out of power and I have to grab an extension to keep talking. Being unable to go places and be around loved ones has meant longer phone calls.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This system is nice. It works well and for the most part, I like it, but the batteries run down WAY too fast compared to my last Panasonic system.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I like this system but a few changes would make it better- longer lasting batteries, and clips to hold the phone under the ear more easily when you can't hold with hands for a moment.

title: Got This To Wrap Melt and Pour Bars Of Soap- Works Great
text:
I make melt and pour soap for friends, family, and maybe to sell eventually. Finding a good wrap for the bars of soap which have to be wrapped to cure isn't always easy. This is perfect.

HOW THIS COMES
This come as shown in a roll. You unwrap the roll and the plastic sticks to itself so no problems keeping it on the roll once unwrapped.

PERFORMANCE
This is quite clingy, but when I unroll it, I slip a cut in with sharp shears and then I use the piece to wrap the bar of soap a few layers and then cut it. It stays put well and keeps the soap from moisture while it continues to cure.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I got this for soap, but it would also be good to wrap baskets, pallets, and other larger items too with multiple layers.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This will last me a long time as I continue to have fun making soaps.

title: Great Little Cart With Lots Of Storage- Someone Thought This Out Well
text:
In our endless remodel, having carts and shelves all over is the only way we can keep going and still have room for everyone to live while we slowly conquer the renovation. This cart, is especially nice for some things.

ASSEMBLY
This cart is one of the few that actually SNAPS into place. The first shelf on the bottom can be a bit tricky, but once you put the 2nd one on, it SNAPS into place. I have put a number of this style together. This is one of the few that actually snaps and holds into place that well.

WHEELS
The wheels on this are good and work well enough not to give me issues. This is not designed to carry heavy weight, so it should not be a problem.

STURDY?
This cart is sturdy enough for cosmetic and hair supplies. That is what I intend to use this for. I plan to have this to store the extra curling irons, hair dryers, and extra stuff used for makeup and beauty on it. It is accessible, yet it is all stored in one place. I don't feel that this is rickety like some other carts of this size I have assembled.

END CARRIER
This end carrier is fantastic. It allows me to put odds and ends on the cart that are longer or won't fit in the cart yet will be accessible when needed.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This cart is very handy for beauty supplies, craft supplies (home or classroom) and goes together better than others I have used.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This cart is one of the better ones. It is small, but it holds quite a bit. I really like the end carrier panel. It is secure and helpful. This cart was well thought out.

title: This Has Been A Lifesaver For Me Right Now
text:
I have had some issues from extreme stress in my life that have given me some temporary mobility issues. That means I can not carry things long distances and walking a lot is difficult some days. This cart has been a life saver.

HOW THIS COMES
You will have to snap the wheels on and the axles once you get this. Assembly beyond that is easy.

AS A DOLLY
As a dolly/hand cart, this is invaluable. I had to get some large heavy boxes into my car and I could not carry them and go up the stairs. This cart allowed me to get them there with less struggle.

AS A GROCERY CART
This as a grocery cart is fantastic. I fit a lot of items in here. I fit a 24 pack of unsweetened juice soda cans in the bottom and then was able to put another bag of groceries on top.

POCKETS
If you have smaller items you don't want to get lost in the big area, you can put them inside in several places. There is also an outside pocket where I keep the bungee cord so it is always available.

GOING UP STAIRS
This goes up stairs very well except if there is a HEAVY load in the bag. I had four large sized laundry detergents in the bottom and a grocery bag of items on top and I could not get this up the stairs. I had to carry it up. Otherwise, if it is not SUPER heavy, it goes up the stairs pretty well.

DOWN STAIRS
THAT is where this does not do well. I tried to bring this into the basement where my storage shelves are for canned goods. This was clumsy and I had to basically treat it like a papoose on my back to get it down the stairs. Once at the bottom, it was fine. Going back up again no problem.

QUALITY
This is made well, but I would not abuse it. It will last a while, but let's face it. Plastic wheels don't last for a really long time usually, so be careful not to overload this if you plan to go up stairs.

HANDLE
The handle has a foam on it which makes it nice to use when it is really cold out. At least you are not touching really cold metal.

BAG
The bag fabric is strong and somewhat water repellant. A soaking rain would seep in, but it should do well in most cases.

WHEELS
The wheels do well on mown grass, on moderate gravel (heavy gravel, not so much) sidewalks, driveways, and even light snow. Heavy snow or mud, forget it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I have used this many times since I got it. I love how it is easy to put together, easy to pack, and easy to use except if it has super heavy things in it- stairs are not so good.

MY RATING
I am rating this FIVE STARS, but with the comment that I really wish the wheels were stronger and better made to last long term. This unit is handy and fits in my trunk very well. I plan to use it a lot for many things.

title: Great Cart, Sturdy- Just Wish Wheels Were Better Made
text:
I have a few spots in my house that needed more narrow carts. It has been difficult to find narrow carts that are still sturdy, don't tip, and hold enough stuff.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in pieces. The instructions are clear and well written. The parts all come with it- including tools.

HOW TO ASSEMBLE
This is not difficult to assemble. It even comes with a push tool to press down the metal pipes into the trays. Once assembled, the cart is sturdy, and the wheels push in.

WHEELS
The wheels are cheaply made. I am dissapointed because I was hoping they would be a bit more sturdy than they are, but they are working for now. I don't plan to wheel it around a lot, so I guess it should be okay.

DOES IT TIP?
This does not tip as easily as I had thought it might. It stays put pretty well.

DOES IT HOLD A LOT?
I got all that I needed from a much wider 3 shelf cart into this one. Now it fits into my corner PERFECTLY.

TRAYS
The trays are plastic, but they are pretty sturdy. If you put really heavy stuff in them, they probably will eventually warp a bit, but they do hold a lot.

DIVIDERS
If you plan to use extras and small pieces, the dividers are easy to assemble and move if you need to.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This cart is well made, has a sturdier build than I expected. If the wheels were made a bit better, I would say it would be almost perfect for my needs.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. The wheels need to be a bit nicer, but other than that, this cart is sturdy, well made, and fits what I need it to.

title: Great Printer Stand- For Minnie Mouse, Or Micro Desk Situations Etc
text:
I was looking for a small set of shelves in cart form to slide underneath our laundry table. The point is that I wanted to have a cart to put the folded laundry on for underwear, socks, etc. I was not expecting this..

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in pieces. You have to assemble it. It was well packed and protected.

DOES IT COME WITH TOOLS?
This comes with all of the tools needed to put this together.

ASSEMBLY TIME
This only took me about 15 minutes to assemble.

STURDY?
This is sturdy. It is not big, like at all, so it won't fit much that would be heavy.

SIZE
This baby is TINY. There is no way I can make this work for my laundry area. It is WAY too small. However, I will adapt it for another area, perhaps on top of my folding table so I can have it up high and still be able to use it.

WHEELS
The wheels that come with this work pretty well and are not quite as cheap as others I have assembled.

STAND
You can put stands on the bottom instead of wheels and they come with this too.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great little cart. The key word is LITTLE. This will fit under a computer desk, for sure. It will work as a side table. It will also work as a set of small shelves on top of a large table top.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I wish this was just a little bigger. It does not even fit my office jet printer very well, so it is pretty small. For what it is it is nice, but if you are expecting something a bit larger, I just wanted to warn you, Look at how small that cart is next to the outdoor chair I photographed it next to.

title: One Of The Most Frustrating Experiences Yet (I WANT This To Work)
text:
EDIT- I KNEW as soon as I wrote this review, I would find a work around. It is not thrilling, but it works. I had to do some extensive research to find anything with N41 in the title that fits the HPRT printer. I ended up finding another driver dated from 2018 in Chinese which works. The caveat is that this driver only has millimeters and not inches at all.

BUT, I did finally find a driver that would work. I forgot to add in my original review that the flash drive that came with this had a malfunctioning video which only played music on any player I tried it on. I also wanted to say that all links in the manuals led to things that did not work.

I am putting my review to 2 stars because honestly, unless you do what I did to get this thing to work, if you end up with a malfunctioning set of driver links, flash drive videos, etc, I just don't think that is acceptable for a unit of this price.
-----------------
ORIGINAL REVIEW

I have been around tech for quite some time. I am not a novice. I no longer have the time to troubleshoot for days on end to make equipment work. I was hoping for a better label experience than I had with another printer. This one, unfortunately so far, has been WORSE.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box very well cushioned. It is wrapped in plastic so if your box arrives soggy like ours did, you will have a chance of this being protected.

INSTRUCTIONS
There is a flash drive included in this with instruction manual (that you have to print if you hate reading on devices), sample print out, and driver installation instructions.

CORD
The cord with this is RIDICULOUSLY SHORT. If you are going to use this at a desk that does not have an outlet really close to where you want to put this, get ready to get a suitable extension cord or power strip. That frustrated me right off the bat.

INSTALLATION OF DRIVER
I would love to tell you that this installed easily and I was on my way to try this printer. Instead what I got was two hours of intense frustration that made me want to throw this away. I am THAT frustrated.

No matter what I tried to do, I could not get this driver to install. I tried EVERYTHING I knew how, other than intense tech level investigation. Most of you buying this would not be doing that. I am reviewing this with you in mind.

WHAT HAPPENED?
I got the software to unload in my system. It says that the device is installed. I have it show up as unknown. I go in by hand to install the driver (which was unpacked already) and it still shows up as not installed. I have tried automatic via windows, automatic via the printer company web site, and manual installation of the driver.

PRINTING
I can not get this to work. I would love to get it to work. I would love to have a label printer I can use. This, however, is not installing and I can not get it to install. My parameters are Windows 10 down to 7 (tested on two devices) which are both included in the compatibility list.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If I am able to get this to install and work, I will update this review. I was putting off reviewing this for a while planning to be the hero and have the fix to get this to work if you are having issues like I have.

MY RATING
ONE STAR. I can not give any more for a device that will not install so I can not go any farther with it. This device comes with the promise in the listing that it will be simple and easy to set up and use. My experience has been the opposite.

UPDATES
I will update if I finally am able to work with this and get it to install correctly. I feel that I have done everything that the average person would do to install this, so until I have a work around, I will leave this as it is for now.

title: Screws and Screw Driver Were Easily Stripped, But Nice Unit
text:
I have been looking for a two shelf stand for a living room table so that I can put a matching lamp on the other side of my couch. This looked perfect.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a nice sturdy box and well packed to keep it from damage.

IS IT EASY TO ASSEMBLE?
This is not too hard to assemble, except it comes with an Allen Key which is white metal. That and the cheap metal screw heads makes it difficult to tighten the screws once they are almost in completely. I had a lot of problems with this. I would suggest you look for another allen key if you have one that fits. It might be less frustrating.

Other than that, the unit was not hard to assemble.

STURDY?
This is plenty sturdy for what I want it for. I plan to put my lamp on top, with some other items next to it and some fish food containers under it because it will be near my fish tanks.

WOULD IT HOLD A PRINTER?
Yes, this is plenty strong enough to hold a good sized printer for home use.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice unit, but there were some issues with assembly due to the cheap metal stripping out easily.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. If they had better screws and a tool included, it would have been five stars.

title: A Little Thinner Than Scotch Heavy Duty, But Just About As Nice
text:
I send a lot of packages so I need a lot of packing tape.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a package shrinkwrapped in plastic. The rolls of tape are all packed in there pretty tightly.

DOES THIS FIT TAPE DISPENSER?
This fits my tape dispenser that I got to go with my Scotch heavy duty packing tape.

DOES IT STICK?
This sticks well so far and I have not had any issues with it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This packing tape is not quite as thick and nice as Scotch, but not much worse either. I am using it quite a bit and will continue to use it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is pretty nice stuff. I use this a lot so having all of these rolls is helpful for me for business and personal use.

title: Great to Hold My Art Supplies- Not Difficult To Assemble
text:
As we are embarking on a major overhaul in our house, I have discovered that cards rival boxes in convenience when it comes to working around the stuff I eventually have to sort through.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box well padded. It has decent instructions and all that I needed to assemble this cart.

WAS ASSEMBLY HARD?
I had no issues putting this cart together. It took me about a half hour or so, but I took my time.

STURDY?
This cart is sturdy enough to keep my art supplies in. It is helpful to have my pads and paints all able to be accessible on each shelf.

PORTABLE?
This moves nicely as long as all of the wheels are unblocked.

DOES IT HELP?
I love how I am able to use carts to take up less floor space and make all of the things accessible to either go through or use without having to shuffle through boxes constantly.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This pretty mint green cart is handy to have. It holds my art supplies. It was not hard to put together and is reasonably sturdy for my needs. The raised handles part of the side supports is nice to use, but does not take up too much room either.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is really pretty and does not take up too much room while storing quite a bit. I like the mesh floor of the shelves allowing air flow.

title: Nice Cart, Holds A Lot, Went Together Well

title: Goes Together Pretty Well Once You Get The Hang of It

title: Perfect Harvest Cart For Preserving, But Assembly Was Awful
text:
Harvest time at my house has been a trial for several months. As the harvest comes in, we have boxes and bushel baskets all over my small kitchen floor. It is frustrating and we end up not using half of our kitchen because it is too hard to move boxes constantly. Then I thought of this!

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box with a lot of foam and cushioning. There are instructions. Any tools are included.

HOW HARD WAS ASSEMBLY
I am going to be brutally honest here. This cart frustrated me more than most of the 15 carts I have assembled in the last year or two. At one point, I almost threw it in the trash, I was so mad.

WHAT WAS THE PROBLEM?
The problem I think is that the bottom basket area which is supposed to press down onto the sides never locks. That means if you reach over to get the 2nd shelf, the unit collapses in the meanwhile. You would think it would be easy to deal with, but trust me, I am not stupid in assembling things. This was a bear. I am thinking perhaps a defective attachment loop led to this..

HOW I WORKED AROUND IT
I got a spool of that custom twist tie wire and I tied the shelf to the frame in all four corners. 2 does not do it. It still managed to collapse despite being tied with two. After tying all four corners to the frame, I still had to work a few times, but got the unit to stay together. This whole process took me about an hour. There is no way this should have taken that long.

IS IT STURDY?
Once I got the other shelves in place, I was able to press the bottom one enough to get it to stay. The others stayed okay, but the first shelf, well lets just say it is the wire holding it there.

WHAT I USE IT FOR
I use this for peaches, pears, or whatever produce we are currently harvesting. This allows me to put the fruits or veggies on the shelves in single or double layers and then I can easily see what needs to be used as they ripen. It has saved a LOT of time and a lot of frustration.

When we want to reach other parts of the kitchen, we wheel it out of the way and then wheel it back. This has been life changing for us. I am very happy with it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If it were not for the bottom shelf frustration, I would rave about this cart. It is small footprint yet holds almost a bushel of peaches. It is easy to move when necessary and does not hog the whole kitchen like we used to have happen every harvest season.

MY RATING
THREE STARS for the frustrating bottom shelf, but honestly it could be a defective rail. I tried to switch out baskets, but they all did it. If it were not for the frustration, I would give this a higher rating.

title: I Must Have Gotten A Defective Unit- I HATE This Thing I WANTED To Like It
text:
I have worked with computers a lot, I used to build them, in fact. I am not THAT bad with technology for the most part unless it is something very foreign to me. This is a simple printer. It should work simply. Unfortunately, this has been one of the most frustrating experiences I have had with any electronics.

HOW THIS IS SUPPOSED TO WORK
You plug in the unit both electrically and to the computer. Then you download and unpack the driver and install the driver. It is not difficult, although the instructions could be better.

Once you download and install the driver, you should be good to go.

GETTING PRINTER USED TO LABEL
It is easy, you get the label in the unit, turn it on, and then hold down the feeding button until it beeps once. The unit reads the paper back and forth and is good to go- well in a perfect world, that is. After that, you should be able to feed labels into the back of the printer, and as it needs to print it will print.

PRINTING
Once the printer has read your label, then it can easily print out labels that you send to it. Easy peasy, right?

NOT!

THE REAL EXPERIENCE
From the time I installed this printer until now, I have had nothing but problems with it. The unit itself is crazy. It will read the paper then the red light will flash. Okay, so I press the right light button and it will spit out a label. Suddenly the green light is on and the label is in place- so you try to print out a test label.

The test label spits out and then the red light comes on. Try reading the label again- it might spit it out and then turn red and be inoperable. It might suck in label after label until you go through a whole stack. It might randomly print something you tried to print an hour ago despite it being wiped from the printer queue.

I have yet to have consistent performance of any type with this printer. It is erratic, frustrating, and annoying at best. Out of 15 attempts to print a label, I got two labels. The rest would not print because the unit refused to feed labels correctly no matter what. Out of about 60 attempts total, I got 5 labels not counting the ones that printed on top of each other twice randomly despite being wiped from the printer queue. I didn't include those in the tally- that would make it officially 64 attempts with two double printed labels showing up.

THE ONLY WORK AROUND IS NOT BUSINESS FRIENDLY
The ONLY work around I can come up with (so this unit is not a TOTAL loss) is turning off the printer after every single attempt. I put the label in from the top singly. Then I turn it on and hopefully the green light shows up. I send the label I want to print to the printer.. THEN..

WHAT HAPPENS THEN..
Once I do the work around about 70% of the time I get a label to print out. It is ridiculous, clumsy, and not at all business friendly. I wanted this unit so I could have an easier time of things printing labels for my business. As it is now, just to print out some labels for some friends was so frustrating I just put the printer away and did not want to deal with it. It is too erratic and frustrating.

The work around does work, however, most of the time, so if I am desperate I will use it. That only is practical if I want a few labels and even then there are misses that happen.

PRINT QUALITY
I was able to post a picture of one of the test labels I made to test the unit. When it printed, the quality was excellent. It is adjustable in the software too. I LONG to use this thing. I really do. I am just so frustrated with how horribly it works. My only work around I could come up with is so laborious and slow, but it gives me labels most of the time.

DIFFERENT LABELS
I even tried different labels from another company thinking that might help. It didn't.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I feel ripped off with this. Despite the indications on our titles we still have to claim full value of these devices whether they work or not as if we got paid that money. This is almost useless to me and I don't like using it. I feel envious of all of the people who got a good one. I really wanted to use this for my business but I would be better off getting a marker and coloring in everything by hand including bar codes- it is THAT BAD at times.

MY RATING
ONE STAR. I wanted so badly to have this work. When it does print, it looks nice. Otherwise the hours wasted on this nightmare have left me very unhappy and sorry I ever decided to try this thing. I would love to have one that works as it should. What a treat.

title: EXCEPTIONAL Quality- Company Deserves Recognition For Extra Efforts
text:

HOW THIS COMES

TOOLS?

QUALITY OF UNIT
The quality of the unit is very good. The shelf/buckets are plastic, but the metal poles are thick and supportive. You don't want to put really heavy stuff in this, however. the only thing holding the shelves in place are a plastic ridge and a screw on each side. It will hold a decent amount of stuff, but really heavy stuff is not a good idea (like cast iron cookware piled high for instance).

WHEELS
The wheels on this are pretty nice. There are two locking wheels- be sure to put these on the side with the handle so you can lock them from moving.

CAPS
I know some of you might not think this is a big deal, but carts come with end caps which are often popping out and it is annoying. This cart - THEY SCREW IN! I am thrilled about this. Small detail, but thrilling to me, nonetheless.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a fantastic product. The packing was exceptional as is the quality and instructions. They overall sturdiness of the cart is good as long as you don't overload it with weight.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I have to say that working with this cart was a treat. This company went out of their way to make it a professional and high quality experience. I don't come across this kind of service too often. It is refreshing when I do.

title: Fantastic For Erasing Tiny Places- Charcoal, Pencil and SOME Colored Pencils
text:
One thing that is tough for me when doing artwork is when I get into a place and I need a tiny bit of a space erased. The gray kneaded eraser will work sometimes, but there are situations where I need a little abrasion.

HOW THESE COME
these come in a card with a plastic bubble on the front. They are presharpened.

DO THEY WORK?
These work great for pencil, charcoal, and it is hit and miss with colored pencil. It depends on the pencil color, brand, and also the paper used and how many layers are involved of pencil.

DO THEY SHARPEN?
These will sharpen, but I found that my crank sharpener which is non-electric is better than the kind I turn by hand. It is a matter of going slowly and then checking constantly to see how the eraser part is doing. Too fine of a point won't work on the paper anyway, so it is best to not sharpen TOO much.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This set of erasers is just what I was looking for. It works well for charcoal, pencil and some colored pencils.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. They do what they say, and as long as you are careful you can sharpen then without issue.

title: Fantastically Handy For Many Things Including Finished Artwork And Diamond Painting Canvas
text:

title: Absolutely Stunning Handmade Leather Journal- KEEPSAKE
text:
I have a very old family cookbook that I have kept over time which houses all of the recipes that I have either adapted or developed for my family. I wanted to do a handmade book with illustrations for each recipe that I hold dear. This book came along at the perfect time.

This book comes in a woven fabric bag to protect it. Inside the book is wrapped with a leather strand that wraps around it to close it. That means if you want to put it on a shelf, you will need the bag to keep it from sticking to the other books.

FIVE STARS. This book is really special. I am still deciding if I will store my recipes in here or not because cookbooks tend to get messy. I might use it as storage and copy the pages for my personal use when I need them. Regardless, I will use this for something that I want to keep as an heirloom.

I have a few hand vacs from companies who have some great ideas, but storage is non-existent. Each part and attachment sits in a pile near a wall and it is annoying. When I saw this, I knew it was perfect.

This is a perfect set up for hand vacuum systems where there are floor pieces wands, top units that have to be recharged, and a shoe dryer. It is a nice recharging/storage center for me and finally my stuff is out of the pile on the floor and more organized.

FIVE STARS. I like this and am glad to have it for my hand vac parts and shoe dryer.

PHOTO

title: Seem To Work As Well As Canon Ink Cartridges

title: FINALLY Something To Help Us When We Need To Dispose of Paper
text:
Certain times of year our paper ridding capacity is at a halt by new regulations. That means we have to throw away paper if we want to clean. Our shredder broke, so we had to keep it stuffed in plastic bags. Now we got this!

This is a really cool item. It has helped us get rid of important papers we don't need anymore and not compromise privacy. So far it has worked for a few weeks of use without a refill.

title: Beautiful Leather Book- Feels Very Special

title: Ink Smears Badly, Book Not Full Grain Leather But Nice Set Otherwise
text:
I love the idea of having a journal that is leather bound, and has old looking pages, with a quill pen and nibs. It is fun to use at times when I just want to step away from our crazy world for a while. This set almost did that, but not quite.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a really nice gift box. You can definitely give this as a gift. All items are packaged nicely and there is even a ribbon around the feather pen.

FEATHER PEN
The quill pen that this comes with has great nibs with it. It works well and is easy to write with.

HOLDER
The pen holder could be a bit sturdier. It is not quite as easy to stay put as I would like, but it does fold away easily for storage.

BOOK
The book is said to be leather. This has a faux flocked back on it so from the appearance and the way the leather behaves, at best it is bonded leather which is a hybrid of synthetic binders and leather ground up and repressed. It is okay looking. It does not stay open well at all, however.

On the book there is a nice leather cord that has a metal leaf on it for decoration that makes it look nice.

PAGES
The pages in the book are in a ring binder which means you can get more to refill when you are done. That is a nice feather, although I am not sure you would find the same aged color pages that come with this.

INK
The ink with this set is a bit disappointing. It really is smeary and is not at all impervious to water. I did a test page for you in the photos I included with this review. When I filled the pen, I wrote all that I did on that page with one dip of the pen which is nice- it was a shallow dip too.

When the ink was dry, I put a drop of water on it and let it sit. The results are what you see in the photo.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great gift for someone who wants to go back in time and have the feeling of being back in the day when things were not as fast paced as they are now. It is a nice set despite the book, ink, and a few minor things.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I would like a more intense ink with this, a sturdier pen holder that stays put when up, and a book that stays open just a bit better and does not feel like synthetic. I still like this set, however and will use it. There are enough good points that I still like about it. The nibs are great and I will find another ink to use.

title: This Is Not Nearly As Good As I Hoped, But It Is Doing Okay
text:
I have a problem in my house. When I put down anti-fatigue mats, the guys all seem to kick it with their feet and every two minutes I have to reset it on the floor. I had only one mat that stayed put, but it was WAY too soft to walk on so I got a better one, but back it was to being all over the floor.

HOW THIS COMES
This tape comes with one side that has firm clear film on it and the other side sticks to the roll. There are two rolls.

HOW TO APPLY IT
I made sure that the floor and the bottom of the mat were completely clean and dry before I applied this tape. I put it on the two long sides of the mat and then when I went to take off the film, the tape kept coming off the one side. I looked ant there was not any sticky left to it. The surface was clean and nothing was on it.

I tried again. The 2nd time the tape was still peeling off and not stay put well. Only the one side of the mat seemed to stay put without peeling.

HOW ABOUT RINSING IT OFF?
I took the piece that had no sticky left on it at all and I rinsed it. It had nothing at all on it until completely dry. I felt it and it had sticky again but considerably less than the first time.

HOW ABOUT LEAVING IT ON THE FLOOR FOR A WHILE?
So far it has been on the floor a few days. The rug is staying put, but the guys are barely home. After tonight they will be home more, so if I need to re-evaluate, I will. For now, it seems to be staying put pretty well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I am not sure about this stuff. I got it specifically for holding the anti-fatigue mat in place on the granite floor we have. It semi works, but I have been a bit frustrated at the tape not wanting to stick well to the mat in some places.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This will probably come in handy for other uses, but I got it for the mat on the floor so it would not leave marks on the floor when removed. It is holding okay so far, but time will tell. At least I have a lot left so I can replenish if I need to.

title: Nice To Have Adjustable Height Choices

The texture of these chalks are perfect. They leave a nice line, but they also stay put long enough to finish the sewing job. Once it is done, the chalk does wash off nicely.

PACKING
The chalks are packed perfectly. They are so packed in foam that they are protected from cracking and smashing. I keep them in there, in case they get dropped in the box.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These chalks are great to work with. They are just what I have been wanting. They mark most fabrics well, stay put long enough to sew the clothing, and come off when washed.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. These will get a lot of use in my house. I am glad to have them.

title: Gorgeous Set- Definitely Worth Getting
text:
I have done calligraphy a lot in the past, but my pens got lost and I never replaced them. Then I saw this set.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
PENS
The pens are DICHROIC GLASS!!! Had I known that I would have gotten this with more enthusiasm than I did. They are gorgeous. I have a photo of them for you.

HOW DO THEY WORK?
The ink that comes with the set is put on the table, the pen is dipped in the ink and the swirls on the tip suck up the ink and then you draw with it until it runs out.

WHAT IS THE LITTLE GLASS?
The little glass is actually for rinsing the pen with ink so you can change colors. Be sure to have a cloth handy to wipe it off before dipping in another ink.

IS THE INK WATERPROOF?
No the ink runs very easily.

IS THIS SET GOOD FOR A GIFT?
This is a perfect gift set. The presentation is very fancy and classy.

HOW LONG DOES AN INK DIP LAST?
I did a sample painting that I had lost twice when I tried to post it with this review (also lost twice when it vanished) so I am not going to put it up again. But I found I could fill up a lot of a small 6x9 page with lines using 1 dip of color. Solid coloring not so much, but lines go a long time.

QUALITY OF LINES?
This is like a quill pen- a fine detail type.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This set is one of my favorite things. I love that it is dichroic glass and that it makes such long lines before I have to re-dip. I only wish the ink was more durable than it is.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love this set and use it often.

title: The Back Is Fabulous, The Seat Not Quite Right For Me So Far- Unless Used Alone
text:
I got this set for my dining room chairs. Let's see what happened..

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
BACK SUPPORT
The back support is made from soft supportive foam. It is rounded and not bigger on one side over another. There are two straps on the back which adjust and there are two perpendicular straps which allow you to hook them onto a bar on a wooden chair back too.

SEAT SUPPORT
The seat support is soft supportive foam. It has a lot of shaping to it. There is a DEEP separation in the back unlike some that I have used. The fabric is soft and plush. The cushioning gives nicely. It is narrower than some cushions so if you are large in the hips, it might not work as well for you.

HOW DO THESE PERFORM TOGETHER?
I got these for the dining room chairs which are wooden and have slats on the back. I find that the back support is perfect. It holds in place both wide and height wise. The back is comfortable and works well.

When I used it with the base, however, it was awful. It just didn't work right at all for the chair together. I felt like I was uncomfortable the entire time I was sitting on it. When I removed the seat and only used the back, it was perfect.

SEAT ALONE
I transferred the seat to my desk chair that I am sitting on right now, and it works out much better than it did with the back rest. It has more room to sit and I don't feel like I am being forced from my chair.

COMFORT?
Alone these are really comfortable. Together for me, they feel like I am coming out of my chair.

DOES THE SEAT STAY IN PLACE?
The seat does stay in place pretty well without shifting around a lot depending on the chair it is on, of course.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I like both of these. Together for me they are not that helpful, but apart they work fine on two different chairs.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. The seat has some molding to it which is not totally comfortable as I was expecting. It is still nicer than some I have tried and the back is very nice- molds the the back nicely.

title: Works Great On Regular Pencils, For Art Pencils, Caution
text:
I do a lot of work with pencils. I use regular pencils for a lot of work that I do with arts and directions, and I also use colored pencils a lot of artwork. Having an electric sharpener that I can bring on location with me has been a desire I have had. Then I saw this. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a box which has a sharpener, a charging USB cord, and a plug which you can use in the outlet to put the USB cord into. I got the red sharpener which is a really pretty candy apple red color.

IS CORD PROPRIETARY?
I highly suggest you mark this cord so you know what it goes to as soon as you get it. This one is proprietary and goes to this sharpener only.

SETTINGS
Inside the unit on the bottom under the blade barrel, there is a switch. When you put it to the left as you look at it, you will get a very shallow tip. The wood will be very narrow, but the lead exposed will be very short but sharp.

If you go in the middle, you will be a bit more lead, but the severe angle of the wood remains the same.

If you move it to the right as you look at it, then you will end up with a lot of lead exposed and a very sharp tip. This is the type of tip some colored pencil artists prefer.

TOP HOLE
The top hole of this sharpener is very small. MOST pencils will fit in there, but if the pencil is just a hair thicker than the others, it won't go in even if you try to force it. That can be frustrating.

HOW TO SHARPEN
When you push the pencil (assuming it fits) into the hole, then the sharpener works and seems like it will never stop, but suddenly it stops and you pull it out.

SHAVINGS CUP
The shavings cup is easy to get out and empty. It holds enough from a few pencils, but any more than that, and it can get clogged. Prepare to empty this OVER a trashcan because it will go all over, even after only a few pencils.

CHARGE
This holes a charge for quite a while. I think it is a few hundred sharpening pencils, and I am nowhere near that, although it is fun to use.

SIZE
This is very narrow and easy to toss into my bag to bring on location with me when I want to do artwork away from power. I would suggest keeping the box for that purpose so no damage happens to the sharpener.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This sharpener is a nice sharpener. I highly suggest you experiment with pencils you don't care much about if you have colored pencils you want to use this for. You will want to be sure it does not take away too much pencil if they are expensive and that it is the type of tip you want.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love it for regular pencils, but some types of colored pencil work I do, I feel it takes away too much pencil each time, so I tend to use a different sharpener. When I want a very sharp tip, however, I use this one.

title: PERFECT For Tiny Bathroom Storage- Just Be Sure To Do A Few Things When Building It
text:
I have been looking for eons for some sort of storage for our incredibly tiny bathroom. It is so small it is ridiculous. Since we can not afford to move or remodel, we had to find a solution . I was in total shock when I realized that this car is the ONLY thing that I have come across that actually fits between the toilet and the sink.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in pieces. You have metal poles and casters and trays as well as hooks.

HOW DO YOU PUT THIS TOGETHER?
Here is where you have to pay attention. If you want this to be sturdy, you have to really press on each tray when you are pushing the poles up into it. I am talking almost full body weight until it snaps into place.

Then when you are putting the poles into the tops of lower trays, again, press heavily with full body weight (almost) until it goes all of the way into the tray. DON'T PUSH TOO FAR TO BREAK THE PLASTIC THOUGH, so take it somewhat easy.

When you put in the casters, you have to also put a lot of weight on the pole to get them to snap into place. It seems like they will never do it, but they will, you just have to work at it and be patient. It is worth the effort.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM WHEN IT IS ASSEMBLED?
If you assemble this the way that I explained, it is a very sturdy cart. It fits between our toilet and sink in the bathroom and gives us a lot of storage room. It is a bit long so we had to remove the toilet paper holder, but put the paper on another small unit in reach from the toilet and it works fine.

DOES IT HOLD MUCH?
I am surprised at how much this holds. It is easy to wheel out and get what we want and then push it back into place. I have the four tray version so it is even in height with our sink so we have like an extended sink top which is nice.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a wonderful little storage unit for our bathroom which is tiny. It has a lot of storage space, moves in and out easily and helps to keep us happy in our tiny bathroom until we can expand some day. Just be sure to put it together as I explained or it might seem rickety to you.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love this and am very glad to have it. The hooks are nice for using to put that hook that comes with those spiral curlers. It keeps it out of sight and is perfect when I need to access it on the side that faces the wall.

title: My Rating For These Is Two Fold Opposite- Please Read To See Why
text:
WARNING: This is a rather in depth review of these pencils. I am reviewing them from two points of view- beginners/kids/coloring book fans and professional level artists. If you prefer a brief summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
-------------------------------------------------------
To start off with, I am an artist. I use a HUGE range of professional top of the line pencils, bottom of the line, and everything in between. If there is a brand of pencils out there in a well known name, I have probably used them and most likely own some or all of them. I would list them all, but I don't want to bore you.

This review will be from the dual perspective of a new artist, kids, and hobbyists and then as a professional level artist.

WHAT ARE THESE PENCILS LIKE?
These pencils are colored on the entire barrel with whatever color the lead is. There are no numbers or color names on the pencils so there is no way to refer to them if you were trying to note which ones you were using to someone else.

BOX
The box is a hinged metal tin box and it closes pretty tightly to keep the pencils protected.

TRAYS
The trays in the box are flimsy. They have grabbing indents in them, but they are just not practical for using so I transferred them to a colored pencil case with elastic bands to hold in all of the pencils for easier use.

PENCIL COLORS
The colors in this set are gorgeous. There is a nice range, although if you are into grays, there are very few so that might be a concern for you. There are quite a few browns, brights, blues, greens, orange, yellow and reds.

QUALITY OF LEAD
Here is where I have to get you to pay attention to my review. The leads in these pencils are bright, strong, and lay down on paper pretty well.

LEAD QUALITY FOR BEGINNERS
For beginners, the leads in these pencils are beautiful, great assortment and will perform beautifully for most coloring books, art projects, or introductory colored pencil use for kids or older beginners.

LEAD QUALITY FOR ARTISTS/PROFESSIONALS
Now the colors in this set are beautiful, BUT there is a heavy waxy in these. That means that you can lay down a layer or two but after that, it becomes very waxy. That means waxy bloom really fast. So, if you are the type of person that likes to layer colors to get a lot of depth, these will not work well for that. In fact, this is probably the most waxy colored pencil set I have yet. The pigments are beautiful, but the waxy tendencies are these are best for few layers and just basic laying down of color.

DO THESE SHARPEN WELL?
These pencils do sharpen well. they don't seem to break easily and the colors do lay down nicely at first.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you are a hobbyist or have kids who really want to do some nice art with colored pencils, this set is a nice set. The colors are beautiful and the range is fantastic. If you are an artist who uses a lot of layers, these are probably not going to be what you want unless you plan to use a solvent with them.

In any case, I highly recommend getting a "book style" colored pencil case to keep these in if you decide to buy them as the trays are too flimsy for use.

MY RATING
For hobbyists and kids, FIVE STARS.
For artists and professionals TWO STARS.

Average rating comes out to be THREE STARS. These are nice for coloring books when I don't want to waste my really good pencils but still want beautiful colors. I will use them a lot for my down time.

PHOTO
In this photo with my review, I have posted the same three similar colors (some are layers of more than one) from some of the sets of colored pencils that I have. I have labeled them accordingly. I have tried to get the photo as accurate as I can, and I think you can see the differences well enough, despite how hard it is to capture on camera.

THE BOTTOM LINE

title: Very Firm, Helpful, And Gel Does Help A Lot In Warm Weather
text:
I have been using another leg pillow for a while and got some help. The problem is it is so HOT in the high temperature weather. Let's take a look at this.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a very firm pillow. It does not get all squished out of shape when you use it. It has a pillow case on it and it comes with a 2nd pillow case so you can wash the first one. There is gel in the crook of this on each side.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
Although a leg band would be helpful with this pillow to keep it attached to my leg while sleeping, this still does a great job with supporting the legs and hips. I will say that it does feel nice, despite a breaking in time of getting used to it at first.

DOES IT STAY COOL?
This is an amazing pillow. It really does not get super hot when using it in hot weather. I have used this on 80 degree nights with no air conditioning and it did not overheat me like my other people was. This one stays a nice temperature and does seem to help a lot.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a thoughtfully designed pillow. It works well, stays cool and even comes with a 2nd pillow case so you can rotate them as you wash them.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS for this one. It is a winner.

title: Finally I Have A Sharpener Which Works For Lyra Skin Toned Giant Pencils
text:
I have a great set of pencils from Lyra which are in Skin Tones. The problem is that they are really thick pencils. I got this sharpener because none of my others would sharpen these pencils well. LEt's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
SIZE
This is a rather larger sharpener. You will need some real estate on your desk. It is 3 inches by 4 inches at the base and then almost 7 inches high.

PLUG?
This plugs in and there is a transformer on the plug side. That means you will need some space on an outlet strip which supports the transformer size. I always make sure to mark all of my plugs with metallic ink as to what they go to so I don't end up with a huge cord orphanage unable to find the right one when I need it.

DOES IT WORK?
I am not going to use this for most pencils as I have a sharpener I prefer for my artwork. This one, however, is the only one I have for larger pencils. Did it work for my Lyra Skin Tones Giant Pencils? YES! I am not fond of the steep sharpening it does to the wood, however. I would prefer to conserve the wood and lead.

EMPTYING?
This has a little cup on the front which has a switch behind it so that it has to be in place for the sharpener to work. AT least that is how mine performs.

ADJUSTMENTS?
That is the only thing I don't like about this sharpener is that I can not adjust the lead shape or the amount of wood that will come off the pencils.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great sharpener if you have larger pencils which you need to sharpen. I like that it works on Lyra Skin Tone Giant Pencils. It does stop automatically but is a bit steel on how much wood it takes off.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I wish there was an adjustment for taking away a bit less of the pencil with each use- especially when using art pencils. Otherwise it is a good sharpener. It works well and is easy to use.

title: EPIC For Using With My Drill Kit- for BITS and Parts
text:
I have a beautiful drill set in a nice carrying case. The problem is that they never came with a small pouch for the bits and pieces to use with the drill. Some of these pieces are small and will be damaged by being loose in the case, but are too sharp for a plastic bag. This case is the PERFECT solution.

WHAT IS THIS CASE LIKE?
This case is definitely made of high quality cow hide. The color is a nice warm orangey bronze color. The zipper is strong and goes from one end to the other tightly so nothing slips out. There is a lining inside so that the items are not right up against the backside of the leather.

HOW DOES IT PERFORM?
This is PERFECT for my parts of my tool set. The bits and other parts for the drill fit in here perfectly. Due to the leather it gives slightly where it is a tight fit. I can see it easily in the dark case so it is easy to find. I am absolutely CRAZY about this pouch. It fits just right in my case without making it too crowded.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I am sure this would be nice for pencils, but I got this for my tool bits and parts in my case and I love it. It is just what I wanted and nothing pokes through it. The shape and size make it fit perfectly in an already tight storage situation.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is EXACTLY what I was looking for. I could not be happier.

title: Great Case For Light Pads But Came Ripped
text:
I have recently dabbled in the art of cartooning. Flip books has been a fun hobby to explore. I also use my light pads for other things. The problem is that I had nowhere to store them that would protect them and make them handy to use when I wanted to. Then came this Organizer.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This organizer is a tough nylon. It has a dark gray outside and black inside.

ZIPPER
It is a 2 way zipper which has covered teeth when it is closed. That keeps weather out a bit.

HANDLE
There is a handle on the spine if you want to use it to carry the bag, but it is not in the way when you don't want to use it.

POCKETS
There are plenty of inside pockets. Some have mesh, and others are solid. There is also one with a flap on it.

LIGHT PADS
I have 2 light pads. One is an A4 and the other is A5. Both of these fit PERFECTLY in this organizer. The larger one is in the back and the smaller one fits in the front. These light pads are in padded pockets and well protected.

WHAT ELSE DO I KEEP IN HERE?
I keep my little packs of flip book papers, closures, cord, extension cord. Everything fits perfectly and this is not overpacked. I also keep a small marker in here for doing the flip books.

ANY PROBLEMS?
There is one problem. The case came to me with a rip in the pocket. I have enclosed a photo of it. It is the flap pocket- it looks like it was not sewn properly. It is frustrating, but the pack is still usable.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This organizer is perfect for my light pads and flip book materials. It fits everything perfectly, protects them nicely and is well made. If the pocket did not come ripped, it would be perfect for me.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS- 1 off for the ripped pocket. That should have been caught by quality control. However, it is still a nice case and I use it often. I hope I can somehow repair it in the future.

title: You Have No Idea How Happy These Make Me- Seriously
text:
I have a problem in this house. Everyone has great eye sight, but they refuse to acknowledge when I give instructions for things that they ever heard me. Then I saw these stickers.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These stickers come on sheets. They are supposed to be for laser, but I am not sure I will get that far. More on that later. They are a very intense neon magenta and I love them.

HOW DO I USE THESE?
I have a variety of sharpie and metallic permanent markers and I put notes on them and stick them everywhere. DON'T TOUCH THIS, or STOP NOW or THINK BEFORE YOU TRY THAT or DO YOU WANT TO DIE?

Okay, that last one was a bit extreme, but you get the idea. I put them on items I want to be left alone, or labels with names on things so people leave them alone and even on packages to label if something has gone wrong with a returned item.

There are TONS of uses for these. I even use them to label roller ball bottles of essential oil blends for the skin.

HOW DO THEY PERFORM?
With the exception of roller ball bottles which I wrap with clear packing tape to protect labels from oil, these have held up reasonably well for all of the other intended uses.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I LOVE THESE STICKERS. They allow me to give the messy heads no excuse in my house that they "didn't know" they were not supposed to touch or do something. Now they DO know and they have no excuse. Oh, they come up with them, but none of them really stick. I win.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. These have made my life nicer and I love the color too. I no longer have to make little stickers out of neon paper and tape them everywhere. Now I just write and stick. If I have enough when I am done with my labeling rampage, I will try them in the laser printer. Something tells me I won't though. I am having too much fun yelling at people via sticker and marker.

title: One Of the Best Cushions I have Used To Date
text:
I have been on a quest for some good cushions. I have had back issues with many couches and chairs so I have been needing to have some good cushions to sit on for support. Let's take a look at this one.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This has memory foam in it. It has a nice plus cover which does come off for washing. There is some fabric on the underside that is supposed to keep it in place, but it is not that good at staying put.

SHAPE SUPPORTIVE?
The shape of this is supportive. It has a nice curve to it and the tail bone area seems to be good for me.

WHERE DO I USE THIS?
I have used this on a computer chair, on the floor, and also on the recliner couch that is very worn. It works well in all of those places.

ANY ISSUES?
I wish this was just a little bit longer than it is. It is just a tiny bit too short for me, so that back cushions slide down behind it.

SOFTNESS
This has more yield to it than some of the others I have tried which were like rocks. This one does support well but it molds to me too.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a decent supportive cushion that molds to me, is comfortable, and seems to be cut well for me, this is a good choice. It is my favorite cushion to this point.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I only wish it was just a bit longer from front to back than it is, but I still like it a lot and use it daily.

title: Great Business And Household Organizing Labels
text:
Not only do I have a new business I have started in, but I also have a household which tends to be chaotic. No one seems to understand how to put things back or what belongs to who. These labels came to the rescue.

WHAT ARE THESE LABELS LIKE?
These labels come on a sheet. There is space between them on the sheet. These labels are made with a sort of plastic feel to them and thin.

DO THEY WORK?
When using the layout on Avery.con with the template presta 61526, these labels will print out well as long as I keep it simple and try not to cram too much onto the labels.

WHAT KIND OF PRINTER DO I USE?
I use an HP M118dw Laserjet Pro printer.

DO THEY STICK?
These have to be applied on CLEAN surfaces which are DRY. I try not to disturb them until they have been in place for a while. So far, when put on plastic, glass, or metal, they will stay if the surface is not to uneven.

ARE THEY WATER RESISTANT
So far these have stayed well and performed fine, although they have not gotten water on them a whole lot at this point.

WHAT ARE THESE USED FOR?
In our house, the uses are two fold.
1. I mark the items that belong to everyone with their name on them such as tools, gadgets, electronics, etc so they are not mixed up. I also use them to label large plugs or accessories that go with vacuums, phones, rechargeable items, etc.

2. I label business items that are to be separated for business use only so that they will not get mixed in with our regular items in the household, since this is run from my home at present. I put labels on the things such as camera equipment, photo aids, boxes of supplies, etc.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I am very happy to have these labels. I will use them a lot and am happy so far with performance for both household and business use.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. So far, these are very helpful and I hope to continue using them over time if they continue to work out well.

title: Very Thin But Strong!  Never Run Out Of Tape Again!
text:
I have a problem in my house. Everyone wants to use my precious packing tape for every stupid thing when they are too lazy to go find the scotch tape. I even caught them trying to wrap presents with it! Talk about frustrating. My favorite source for packing tape closed up, and it is expensive to get some good quality. Let's take a look at this box.

WHAT IS THIS TAPE LIKE?
This tape comes in a large box wrapped in 4 tubes of 6 rolls each. There is a dispenser in it, but it is a cheap plastic one that is not too great.

TAPE TEXTURE
This tape is deceptively thin and bendy, almost like saran wrap but not quite. I was not too keen on the idea as my other tape was very sturdy and thick and stuck very well to things. This unexpectedly sticks to things though. It really does grab well.

DISPENSER
The blue and orange dispenser that comes with this is okay, it cuts, but it is not that great. I just use my more expensive dispenser instead.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Despite it being thin, this does grab very well and seems to hold well too. So far, no complaints from packages I have sent to people. The boxes I have used this tape on have held so far. I am not sure about long term yet, however.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS, but cautious stars. If anything changes over time in the storage boxes I taped, I will try to update.

title: Sticks To Most Packages, Works Well
text:
Before this whole business shut down happened, my family and I started a little jewelry business. We have mailers, everything you need to send things out, but address labels were one thing we wanted to get. Let's take a look.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
WOW, when we got these delivered, I was shocked at how heavy the box is. It is VERY heavy. The labels are lightweight and they fit well on the packing envelopes we have. They are supposed to be used for either ink jet or laser printers.

HOW DO THESE WORK?
So far, these have worked fine on either laser or ink jet printer. I had to mess around with them a bit to get them to print centered, but when lined up they work well.

CAN YOU WRITE ON THEM?
I also have written on these with both permanent marker and pen and they worked fine.

DO THEY STICK WELL?

These labels have to set for a bit when it comes to sticking. They seem to do well when pressed down a bit at first.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These labels have so far been really helpful. Due to business shutdown I have not been able to use them as much as originally planned yet, but I have used them enough to give you a pretty good idea of how well they work.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am glad to have this package of labels. We are set for quite some time. Working on inkjet AND laser printers is great, and I also appreciate being able to write by hand as well.

title: WAY Nicer Than The Other Set I Have- Things Fit Better
text:
I do a lot of art projects. Sometimes these projects require a series of worksheets and practice exercises on art paper. I don't want to throw them in a folder, or they slide out. I prefer them in plastic envelopes but the ones I have are just big enough for a few papers. Let's take a look at these.

This series of plastic sheaths comes in a bigger zipper closure bag. The color assortment is fabulous, especially if you want to color code what papers you keep in which type bag.

SIZE
