FIVE STARS. I HIGHLY recommend this set of sheaths if you have larger projects, sewing patterns, even small quilting project pieces you need to keep protected. I would buy more of these for sure when these are used up.

title: A Bit Rickety, But Does The Job For Lightweight Books
text:
I have a few books that I like to read which are kind of cumbersome to hold on my lap. I was looking for a holder so I could read them on the table and hold them upright to see them better. There are lots of photos and interesting things in the pages that I want to see and looking down on the table is a bad way to see them. Let's see how this worked out.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a very small cheap plastic item. I am not going to beat around the bush. It is rickety and it is not that easy to use for anything beyond a lightweight book.

BACK STAND
The back stand has a button which has a very tiny explanation on it which is hard to see. You press that button in BEFORE you attempt to open the back stand. My button fell apart the first time I tried to use it. I pressed it back on but it does not stay long. It reveals a screw behind it.

FRONT BRACE
The front braces are an L shape and they rotate up to accommodate a larger book. That book better not be too heavy, however, because the stand won't hold it that well.

FRONT PAGE HOLDERS
These are very fragile plastic and clear with knobs on the ends. They hold the pages open, but they can be tricky when it comes time to turn a page.

WHAT IS THIS BEST FOR?
This stand seems to be best for tablets, larger touch screen computers, larger thin books such as cookbooks that you are not going to turn a lot of pages on. I found that the coffee table books that I really wanted this for are a bit too heavy and frustrating to use with this stand.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is not what I had hoped for. It is fragile, was already coming apart when I got it, and it is only for lightweight jobs. This is not for the larger heavier books that I needed to use in it.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. I wish this was a bit more convenient to use and that it would support larger books better. It really is too fragile for most things the size that it seems to be made to hold. I will use it for cookbooks or my table occasionally, but I am not sure how long it will last.

title: REAL BRUSH TIPS!  Great To Use With Colored Pencils Or For Calligraphy
text:
As an artist, I am always looking for new tools to help me create art. This set of markers is different. Let's find out why.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
TIPS
What makes these markers stand out from the rest is that they are actual BRUSH TIPS. They are not fiber cones that dispense the ink that pill up. They are actual clear filaments which make up an actual brush. This is important for precision and the type of art that I want to do with them.

COLORS
The colors are all very pretty and bright, yet coordinate with watercolor effects nicely. They don't look overly like MARKERS.

WHAT DO I USE THEM FOR?
I use these markers not only to do some calligraphy now and then for cards and decorations, but I also use these to lay down a nice base to use under either watercolor pencils or colored pencils. It provides some great color background and looks really nice when making more painterly art instead of pencil looking art.

CAPS
The caps on these are great- THEY ACTUALLY FIT ON THE MARKERS WHILE YOU USE THEM! Many markers do not have that capability and it is annoying to have to put the cap down somewhere to use them. These fit right on the back nicely.

WATER BRUSH
This also comes with a water brush so that you can lay down water, use the marker over top, and create some really nice effects with it. I especially like to do that because it makes for a better base for my pencils.

PROBLEMS?
The only thing to be aware of with these markers is that if you are using them after laying flat, it will take a moment or two for the color to get down to the brush tip so be patient.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These markers are wonderful for doing watercolor work, colored pencil work, and watercolor pencil work. The colors are bright but do not look overbearing so they blend well with those media especially well.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love these markers and am thrilled to have finally found some with an actual BRUSH tip instead of the type which have fibers that eventually pill up and get frustrating to use.

title: Much Nicer Than Last Cushion Which Was Too Narrow
text:
Because I have an old chair that I have to sit in, I need cushions to help make up the difference. My last cushion of this type was nice, but it was so small that any movement made me shift off of it. This one is much nicer. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS CUSHION LIKE?
This cushion comes with a black covering with no slip dots on one side. It has a gel cushion inside.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This is not as thick as my last one, but it is much nicer for a footprint. It allows me to shift in my chair without feeling the edges around. It is a nice feeling. It will slip a little over use, but it is not that difficult to put back into place.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This has been a nice cushion because it is larger and covers more of the chair. When I shift I don't feel the edges and it gives more room which makes it much more comfortable.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I wish it was just a bit thicker, but that is not a deal breaker. The larger size is so wonderful I will overlook the thickness.

title: Very Basic, But Does The Trick For Storage
text:
I have had a need for some storage for some reference books and notebooks that I wanted to keep together for a class that I lead. I didn't want anything fancy, but something rugged that would stand up to being thrown around. Let's take a look at this bag.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This bag is pretty straightforward. It is leather. It has a flap and two levels of snaps on it. One will close it tightly, the other will leave the top open some if you have something tall that you want inside. There are no dividers or pockets. It is just a bag.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This has no handle, but it does keep my reference books and notebooks all together and they are in one place. I really like it. It is rugged and you can use leather balm on it if you want it to be a bit more pliable.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you want a straightforward bag with no handles or frills, this is a great choice. It has thick leather, is decently made and will hold quite a bit.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I just wish it was a little more secure on top so things won't slip out (smaller) but otherwise it is a great bag for what I need it for.

title: Great Basic Bubble Mailer Not Too Heavy For Certain Items
text:
When it comes to sending out packages, sometimes we just want to send something lightweight and not have the package heavier than the items. These mailers seemed perfect. Let's take a look.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These mailers are thin plastic. They are lined with bubble plastic and have a removable strip on them to seal them tightly.

LABELS?
I found that these take sticky labels, but I feel extra secure by taping over them with packing tape that is clear. These also will take permanent marker well which I have used on them too.

SEAL ON BACK
I also reinforce the seal on the back with tape for now until I get more feedback from people that get these in the mail.

ARE THESE FOR HEAVIER THINGS?
These mailers are not for things you want to protect intensely. They are more for things like cards with a cardboard stiffener inserted to prevent bending, or other perhaps jewelry that is small and wrapped with another layer of bubble wrap, etc. I would possibly use these with CDs etc, but again with perhaps a cardboard insert for added protection.

I would not use this for bottles of essential oils, or other products that could break or fall apart easily.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These are a basic lightweight mailer. They are not super protective, but will work with fine small objects that you don't need to have a lot of protection around or things like jewelry that perhaps has a small bubble wrap bag it is in for extra protection.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I wish the bubbles inside were a bit more filled with air, but as they are they are still okay.

title: Works For Some Things I Have Tried It For
text:
We have a little cat toy. It is a laser that does around and it sits on the floor. The problem is that the cat knocks it over all of the time. This helps.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?

This does remove well and you can rinse it off and it will work again.

I would not use this to put up heavy things on the wall like picture frames with glass, or other heavier items.

For mild to moderate security on the floor or wall, this take works pretty well. It can be reused sometimes. It keeps the cat toy in place which is what I wanted it for. IT removes well too.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I like having this and don't have to worry about having enough tape to secure the toy repeatedly. The roll will last me a long time. I have tried a small patch on hang up LED light strips and it works okay but I wouldn't count on it alone long term.

title: PERFECT Journal Size For Production Notes
text:
In my house, we all have a variety of things we do which require notes and documentation. Let's take a look at these books.

title: Is It Weird To Like, LOVE A Cash Box?
text:
I have had a cash box for some years now. I have used it for a variety of different venues where I have held sales. I hate it. It drives me nuts. If I am not cutting my skin on the corners which are SHARP, I am putting it a storage box to carry with me only to find the cash scattered all over the place in the box, and it takes a long time to put it all back. Then I saw this one. Let's talk about it.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
ROUNDED CORNERS
OMG when I saw this had rounded corners, I wanted it. RIGHT AWAY. This is amazing. I am not going to cut myself anymore! I LOVE that feature.

DOUBLE CLASPS ON EACH END OF THE FRONT
The clasps work smoothly and stay shut well.

SEPARATE LOCK
Again, this is a great feature. You don't have to fiddle with it if you don't want to use it like our last one.

STURDY TOP HANDLE
The top handle is nice. A bit small, but still not hard to use. I only wish it was a little but thicker and it can bit into the skin when it is full. I just carry it by the sides at that point.

BIG AND ROOMY
This is bigger than our last box. It has plenty of room for receipts, money, and other odds and ends I never know what to do with in our other cash box.

HINGES AND CLIPS
The hinge on this box works like a dream. Very smooth. The money clips have a very tight spring and snap back into place when they are pushed up. I LOVE THAT.

LOCKS
The locks work. I can lock the clips alone, or just lock the center lock on the box, or all three if I want. There are two keys for each lock.

COLOR
I love the red color too. It is cheerful and easy to keep track of.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This cash box is everything I ever wanted in a cash box. It is easy to use, keeps change and paper money contained until ready to use, has extra spots of receipts or notes, and rounded corners.

MY RATING
FIVE VERY HAPPY STARS. I know it sounds weird, but I totally LOVE this cash box. After suffering with that other horrible one and never finding anything better, this is a dream come true for me. I would buy this again in a minute. It is THAT good.

title: I Have To Cut It Down For My Printers, But Works
text:
When I ordered this, for some reason I did not realize my printer won't take this size. All of my previous ones did. Apparently, somewhere along the line I forgot that my current printers require smaller paper. However, it still works fine. Let's talk about it.

WHAT IS THIS PAPER LIKE?

This paper is also pretty good for markers although you don't want to let the marker sit on it too long because it will soak up a lot of ink. It is great for sketches etc. It really does showcase alcohol marker colors beautifully.

CAN YOU PRINT ON BOTH SIDES?
I found it print well on both sides.

If you have a printer that takes the 11x14 inch paper, this will be perfect for you if you can get your printer to take it. If you don't, it is still a great paper to cut down (using a paper cutter) to the size photo paper you need. It also works for marker sketches too and does not bleed through.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. When I finally got it to work with my printer, I love how it prints. I also plan to use this not only for reference photos for artwork, but for marker sketches as well.

PHOTOS
Photos are disabled at the time of this review, so I can not post any photos for you to see the quality of the print. It is really nice though and the colors and clarity are great.

title: Perfect For Soap Making With Melt And Pour
text:
Besides packing wrap, I needed to get a roll of this because when I make melt and pour soap, it is important to keep it wrapped up so that it does not have problems and stays fresh unlike cured soap which does not need to be wrapped in plastic.

This roll has two handles on it so it is easy to use for a large job. In my case, I lay it down on the floor or table, and I cut it in strips so that I can wrap my melt and pour soap in it once it has hardened and been cut.

I have wrapped a few items in this and it clings very well. On the soap pieces, it also sticks very well.

This wrap sticks well and is easy to use with the handles and all. I especially like it for wrapping my melt and pour soap bars to keep them fresh and away from moisture.

title: i Am SHOCKED- Seriously.  After Several HORRIBLE Experiences, This One WORKS!
text:
I have a HP Deskjet Pro 118dw laser printer. I needed to get a new cartridge. I could have refilled my starter cartridge, but I thought a new one would have more capacity and I thought I could try that. I tried two other brands and the experiences were HORRIBLE. I was ready to give up after that. Three cartridges later and I was beside myself. They were not cheap either! Then this opportunity came along to use these. Let's see what happened..

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
This comes in a set of two cartridges. They are wrapped separately in boxes and with plastic. There is an orange guard on them and a plastic seal which needs to be removed before installing. It has a tab with an arrow on the side. The instructions included are accurate and visual in nature.

PERFORMANCE?
When I first put this in my printer, I heard it go on and on getting ready to use, but I thought perhaps it would reject it but it didn't. At first the printing was full of lines and not too great. There was a terrible smell too.

As I continued to use it, however, it began to print well. I have noticed an improvement in the quality too. It is printing close to the quality of the HP cartridge.

DID I GET COMPATIBILITY PROBLEMS?
I did get a warning a few times that this was not compatible. However, the last few times I used it, there was not any warning. I am not sure if it will come back again, but it is not hard to get the window to close and move on with printing.

So far I have had no problems and I have used this quite a few times since I installed it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
So far, I am thrilled that these cartridges seem to work. I was ready to give up but this one made it worth it. I appreciate that it works after a rough start. So far no problems.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS so far. I am so happy to have a cartridge that works. The printing quality is pretty good and if it still works I would consider purchasing again in the future if the 2nd one in the package works too.

title: I Am CRAZY About These Markers, Let Me Tell You Why..
text:
I have so many things in the house that need to be labeled and having some noticeable ways to do it with different colors is not always easy to do. Let's take a look at these markers.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These markers are six different colors. They are loaded with metallic ink which is thick and beautiful. They have a chiseled edge on them. There is a tight fitting cap. The colors are really pretty- copper, gold, blue, green, red, and silver.

WHAT DID I USE THESE ON?
I have some markers which I use to mark many things, but they are black and navy blue. The problem is that I have a lot of BLACK things which need to be marked. FIVE STARS. These have been a HUGE help for me. Things I could not mark easily I am finally able to mark. All of these dark things are now labeled and I am very happy. I would buy these again in a moment.

title: PERFECT For What I Needed- Better Quality Than Expected
text:
I have to send things through the mail which are packets of paperwork. I have tried to get some envelopes, but they are so thin that they just were not worth buying. Let's take a look at these.

This box of envelopes is perfect for business or if you have to send or compartmentalize a lot of paperwork. They are pretty sturdy, well made, and do what they are made to do- mail or store paperwork.

title: Good But In Bucket Seats Needs Center Support
text:
One of our kids has been having issues with the bucket seat in the car as a driver. I got this cushion to help. Let's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This cushion comes all bound up with elastic and folded in 1/3s it has to be unfolded and allowed to expand prior to use. The bottom has some silicone dots on it to keep it in place, and the top has a center that is somewhat slicker (to slide out from) and the edges are more cushiony.

There is about 1/2 inch of lift in using this cushion so if you are concerned about being too high, it won't be a problem in most cases.

title: Black Ink Worked Well In My Pixma TS8220 Printer
text:
Having ink that is not a fortume for my Canon Pixma 8220 is important to me. I like the printer and want to be sure that I can keep printing as much as I want to without having to constantly be replacing in cartridges with new ones that cost a lot. Let's see about this set..

title: I Use These For Essential Oil Roller Bottle Labels

title: I Am In LOVE With This Desk!!!

title: NOTHING BUT PROBLEMS- Frustrated With This In My HP M118DW Printer- IT SPIT AT ME!
text:
I have been wanting a new cartridge for my HP Laserjet Pro M188dw. This seemed like the perfect opportunity. Yeah, right.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a green and white box. The cartridge inside is wrapped in plastic- black plastic. On the box is a list of instructions on how to replace the cartridge. Seems simple, right? WRONG.

INSTRUCTIONS

title: After Temper Tantrums, Crying, & Threats, I Love It Now (Despite 1 Remaining Issue) iN DEPTH REVIEW
text:
WARNING- IN DEPTH REVIEW for those wanting to make an informed buying decision. For a brief summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
-----------------------------------------------------
Have you ever just wanted to get some work done and you have only a little bit of time, so you figure you can quickly move through the job and get on with other things- only to find out it is going to frustrate you to the edge? Well, THAT was the type of experience I had with this little beauty. Let's talk about it..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This machine has a pretty good footprint. It has a tray that slides on the back to support papers, a USB cord that is proprietary and goes from the scanner to the computer, and a power cord that is in two pieces with a transformer connection halfway between.

CORD PLUG
This is a 3 pronged cord, so be sure you have the correct outlet nearby.

DOES THIS HAVE AN INSTRUCTION MANUAL?
No. You have to PRINT the stupid thing- all 77 pages of it. That alone made me very angry. This type of thoughtfulness including the manual with the unit would have saved me a lot of time had it been complete.

WHAT IS THE MANUAL LIKE?
Once the manual is printed out, I think that the author- or AI that wrote it has an obsession with treasure hunts. Every time I turned a page for info, it was sending me to yet another page. It was ridiculous waste of time, honestly. Eventually, if you are patient (which by then I was not) you can figure it out, but it takes longer than it should.

MY EXPERIENCE
WHAT I WANTED TO USE THIS FOR
I wanted to use this to scan in receipts from a handmade product business that my partner and I just started. I had a lot of receipts that were going to vanish pretty soon due to the nature of thermal ink (store receipts) so I wanted them all in files so I could put them in our book work set up easily accessed.

WHAT HAPPENED WHEN I TRIED TO SCAN THE RECEIPTS?
When I first installed the software, again you have to get it off the internet, so if you have slow internet, be prepared to wait a long time. After waiting to install the software first, I finally got to install it after about 40 minutes of download time and then it was ready to go- or so I thought.

RECEIPT JAMS
The first receipt jammed and was eaten by the machine. I straightened it out and then it went partway through and jammed again. I even put in a piece of stiff paper and it went halfway through and it declared itself a jam, even though it was not jammed.

DID THE HELP FILES HELP ME?
I tried everything in the help files to see how to do this, but the help files were random and very hard to follow. Please understand I have built my own computer systems for years, put together all sorts of devices for computer use and know how to do a lot of things without having to be walked through it. This was a nightmare.

PRINTING THE MANUAL
Finally I had to relent to try to print out the manual as this cat and mouse game of going to one page after another was too annoying on screen. I went to print out the manual and my new cartridge in the printer went nuts and ejected itself from the printer.

After a lot of bad words, throwing things, and threats, the manual was printed, only to find that my industrial stapler had malfunctioned and would not put the pages together right, which caused the pages to go askew.

WHAT WAS THE PROBLEM WITH THE SO CALLED PAPER JAMS? (READ THIS TO SAVE YOU THE HEADACHE)
With my insane "manual" in hand, I finally was able to play treasure hunt quickly and discover that this unit only allows the scanner to scan a short paper. You have to go into the driver software (good luck finding it without the manual) and then find the adjustment to make it scan very long documents.

OPTIONS IN THE DRIVER SOFTWARE
The options in the driver software allow you to choose if you want to print longer papers, and this will slow the process down a bit, so you have the option to have it turn itself off after four hours.

ONCE IT WORKED, WAS IT FAST?
Once I finally got this small detail taken care of, I was able to get the receipts (including very long ones) to print effortlessly. In fact, it was so fun that I did not mind it at all.

CHOICES OF COLOR
You even have a choice of color- high contrast black and white, grays, or full color as in photos- to have your scans saved.

SAVE TO OTHER MEANS
You can send scans to a variety of places from cloud to email, to all sorts of things. It saves it in a PDF format and you can make your own job button to tell it what to do exactly if you don't like the pre-sets.

ARE THE DOCS SEARCHABLE? (My ONE Issue)
That is the issue I have with this at the moment. I spoke with the company prior to opening this and was told that you can scan through the docs (receipts) on this just like any pdf. Well, that is not true at least at this point for my experience. I hope to contact tech support one more time to find out the answer to this and will update.

THE BOTTOM LINE
After getting so frustrated that I threatened (to myself) to write a horrible review and hoped the company went out of business, I got over it once I solved my initial issues and really do love this little machine. My only issue at this point is the claim that the receipts would be searchable and I can not find anywhere how that is possible as it is not at the moment.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS- only because the instructions and help files are just not organized like they should be. It is really more like FOUR AND A HALF stars.

The manual should be included with the scanner, it is ridiculous to put that burden on the consumer. However, that aside (I know most companies are being cheapskates) the lack of ability to search docs has me frustrated still. I will update when I find out the real answer to that.

All in all, once I got over the horrid frustration and time it took to set this up, I really do enjoy the machine, even if the pdfs are not searchable. It is handy to have and I love the ability to have all of my receipts in a business file that I can back up and no longer have to worry about the receipts fading or falling apart.

title: I Nearly Fainted When I Got This (Okay, I Am An Artist, I Can Talk Like That)
text:
Recently, I have had the exciting opportunity to get together a kit to do some amazing things with alcohol inks. I have dabbled with painting, printing, and even resin. Then I said I wished I had some more inks and this showed up. I nearly fainted with the thrill of it all. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
First of all, it is not easy to find an entire collection of Ranger Inks. Usually you are limited to 3 inks at a time, sometimes one less sometimes one or two more, but rarely is it an entire collection like this. It also comes with a brush that is similar to a water brush that contains water for on the go watercolor painting (the water in the brush activates the watercolor pans).

PEN
The idea of the pen is that you put the alcohol solution in there so that you can do designs in the alcohol inks.

OPENINGS
Unlike another brand that I have which had to be snipped or poked with a pin, but these are already open so you can just use them. I am SO glad. The other stuff shot all over the place until I looked like someone tie dyed me. For days. Seriously. The Ranger is so much nicer to just open and use.

HOW DO THESE WORK?
I have three types of alcohol ink. One is a generic brand, the other is Pinata, and then there is this one from Ranger (formerly Adirondack Inks). When it comes to working with them, these act a bit differently than the other two brands. In painting, they tend to spread and move around better than the others.

IN RESIN
I used these in resin to make some earrings, which I am including a photo of so you can see them. The only color in the photo that is NOT a Ranger ink is the white, That is a Pinata ink. These behaved nicely in resin. They did tend to react better with the thickening resin that Pinata did.

ON YUPO
These are pretty on yupo, but I only messed around with them a little. I have not done any intricate designs yet. They tend to move around a bit more than Pinata inks, and that works to the advantage to help the migration without diluting too much.

THE COLORS
There is a full spectrum of color in this collection from pastel type colors to all sorts of amazing combinations. If you love earth tones, you have plenty of them. Fantasy colors? Yes. It is a great mixture of colors.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I plan to use these all up and buy more when they are gone. The brush is a great idea and I love using that in paintings. The colors selection is fabulous and the tips put out just the right amount of ink.

MY RATING
FIVE ENTHUSIASTIC STARS. This is my OMG kit. I love it. If you want to have a wide variety of colors, this is the kit to get.

PHOTO
The photo with this review is a set of earrings in resin that I did using the Ranger Inks. The white is NOT RANGER it is Pinata Blanco. Everything else is from Ranger. I tried to capture the nuances and texture in the resin in the photo, but it was hard to do. I hope you can see at least some of it well.

title: Hold Up My Heavy Larger Books Very Well

title: Pretty Nice Calculator, Why Didn't They Make An Adapter To Go With It?  (Let Me Explain)
text:
There are some things that I wanted to have a calculator for which prints out. When we are doing long lists of calculations, I like to have it on paper so that if there is a big mistake, we can see exactly where the problem is and then fix it quickly rather than a long arduous repeat. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS CALCULATOR LIKE?
This is a BATTERY RUN ONLY CALCULATOR. More on that in a moment. It prints on paper and has red for subtracted figures and black for the other figures. You can do many calculations which I think are covered well in other reviews and in the descriptions. It is a unique product and it does have its uses.

DOES THIS RUN WITH AN ADAPTER
There is so much confusing information about this calculator that I wanted to address this. If you look this up in another country, it comes with an adapter, or it tells you which one to get. If you get it in the US, it says it does not run with one, only batteries.

Being the resourceful type of person who wants to test things completely when I can, I got another adapter to test with this. It is the same settings, voltage, connector, etc. The calculator WILL NOT WORK with it. The adapter works with other similar items so I know that it is not the adapter.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
So far I have not put it through the rigorous calculations for business that I plan to in another month or so, but so far, it has taken what I have thrown at it well. It works quickly and it does seem to do what is asked of it without error or problems.

PAPER
This does not come with much paper, so if you want to buy some right off the bat, it might be a good idea if you plan to use the print function a lot.

PRINTING HEADS
Again, I recommend that you purchase the printer heads while you can if you plan to use this a lot when you get it.

SIZE
The size of this is very handy. It is easy to store, and easy to use.

DOES THIS COME WITH BATTERIES?
This does come with batteries so you can use it right away.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although I think it is completely stupid not to engage the adapter connection that comes on this unit, it does run well on batteries and if you like printing calculations for whatever reason, it does that well so far.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I think this should be made to work with adapter, and it would have been nice to come with more paper too. It does come with batteries and some paper, so it is still a great machine, but I guess I am just annoyed at the lack of adapter ability in this. I took a star off for that. My rating is more like four and a half stars, but since I can only do full stars, I am leaving it at FOUR.

This is a COMPLETE kit to replace ink for my Canon Pixma TS8220. That means I can count on it when I want to print photos and need to replace the photo blue. All ink so far has fit and I am very happy with the quality and instructions.

title: Good Basic Laminator, Wish A Few Things Were Different
text:
I have used laminating machines several times and there are some things which make it easier to use them than others. Let's take a look at this one.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This laminating machine is a very basic one. It is labeled as a "starter kit" which is very accurate. This machine is small in size so easy to store. It is about the size of a box of saran wrap or waxed paper, but a little bigger and flatter. The front is where you put in the paper (sealed side first) and then the back is where it comes out. there is a small guide you can slide into the back.

DOES THIS COME WITH LAMINATING POUCH
This comes with only 5 8x10 inch pouches which is not much. You can cut them down if you are very careful, but with this machine, I am not sure how well that will work.

HOW DOES THIS WORK?
I am not sure I am a fan of the way this is set up. The front is unsupported so when you feed the sheet of paper housed in the plastic sheath that you are sliding in the slot. That means that it is VERY easy to have this end up coming out crooked.

It slides out the back of this machine and at a very slight angle going up. This means that the stiff laminated sheet will now be sliding out the back of this onto the table instead of in the air held up. This calls for a big foot print to operate this. You need to have a lot of table top room.

HOW WELL DOES THIS WORK?
This does laminate well. I did have some issues with crooked sliding as the feeding wheels no matter how hard I tried started to feed this crooked. It turned out okay, but it was frustrating. I have used other laminating machines which fed from the back and came out the front with guides. I liked that a bit better.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a small footprint easy to use laminating machine, this one works. It is simple, has a few design features I would like to see different, but it still works. Just be sure to have enough table top room when you use it.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. If this fed down from the back with better guides I think I might like it a bit better. As it is, I still like it and will use it, but will have to purchase other pouches.

title: Excellent Quality, Great Price  Works As Good As Or Better Than Originals
text:
When I got my Pixma TS8220 printer from Canon, I was not expecting to like it as much as I have. I have always been an HP girl. The colors were truer and the quality better. Well, not anymore. I have often printed something out on my HP 8710 only to have to print it out on my Canon for much better quality when doing reference photos for paintings or drawings. I ran out of ink. PRINT QUALITY

title: Thanks, Mom, You Are Now Wearing My Work Schedule
text:
Being the practical sort, despite our kids always wanting to do a centralized schedule online, I prefer an more tangible schedule that we can access when the internet is down or during power failures. I opted for this weekly schedule calendar. Let's take a look..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This schedule has the five days of the week with another spot simply marked weekend. There is a magnetic eraser and pen that comes with it that stick fairly well to the refrigerator.

FIT
We have a rather small side by side refrigerator and it just fits on the wider side.

PEN
The pen writes pretty well on this but not quite as dark as others have done in the past.

ERASER
The eraser works well and sticks better to the metal refrigerator door than the pen does.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
Although this works really well and has been fantastic to help us organize class, work, and activities schedules, there is one problem we did not forsee

I was standing in the kitchen with one of the kids who said something very funny. I fell over against the fridge and then stood up again. It was so funny!

At which point, my daughter piped up and said, "Great, Mom. Now you are wearing my work schedule." I thought she was exaggerating. She wasn't. Her schedule was on my jacket and no longer on the magnetized written schedule.

SO, that is one problem I did not thing about. If you are not careful, you too could be wearing the schedule without intending to.

ANY OTHER COMMENTS?
The other thing is that we wish it had actual blocks for SATURDAY and SUNDAY as each of these days are filled with work and activities we need to list too.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although it could use a modification, this is a handy board to have as long as you did not accidentally brush against it.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This needs to have Saturday and Sunday on it, and it is a bit easy to brush against this. I wish it had a bit of an edge on it or some way to protect from rubbing against it. All things considered, this is nice to have and we are enjoying it.

title: Attractive And Work For What Intended But Not Overly Sturdy
text:
We have been in the middle of what seems like an endless remodel. In the course of events, we got a new cubby hole style book case. I needed a place to store magazine style books which are for instruction. When I saw these, I thought they were worth a try. Let's see what happened.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These come in an assortment of both designs. There are three of each. They come folded flat and you have to put them together and then tuck the ends into place. They are not heavy cardboard. I would say they are more like mid to lightweight cardboard.

HOW DO THEY PERFORM?
As long as these are left on the shelf to restrict the magazines, they work fine. If you are going to keep pulling them in and out of the bookshelf, then they are not quite sturdy enough for that. They do keep my thin books and magazines I want to keep in order and standing upright in the case.

WHAT IF TOO BIG?
One of my shelves was a half inch too tight for this. The cardboard was easy to trim and I was able to use it fine and it still protected the magazines just fine.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These are attractive and a great way to keep magazines on shelves without slipping all over the place. They are not overly sturdy, so don't plan on moving them around all of the time. Leave them in place on the shelf and they will last just fine.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS I wish these were just a little bit more sturdy, but as they are, I still like them and will use them.

title: Handy To Have For Many Reasons
text:
I love having neon labels for many uses. Let's take a look.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These labels come on sheets. They are laid out to print or use a marker on by hand.

WHAT COLORS
These come in yellow orange and green.

HOW DO I USE THESE?
I use these labels to label:
-canning jars on lids or jars
-cut in small strips to label roller balls for essential oils
-reminders around the house for important times such as conference calls, etc
-vitamin instructions for family members
-bead containers
-bins

These are not the BEST stickers I have used, but if they are pressed into place, they tend to stick well if given time to adhere, but the surface needs to be clean and dry.

ANY PROBLEMS?
Sometimes I find that for labels on things with high use such as rollerballs, I will seal the labels on with wide clear packing tape.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Whether used as they are, in a printer, or cut into smaller labels, these have been VERY useful in our house. I have had no problems with them, although if the surface is not clean and dry, they won't stick as well.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS I like these so far and have used them a lot already.

title: LOTS Of Uses- A Bit Less Sturdy Than I Like, But Still Nice
text:
I like to have clear plastic sleeves to put many things in. When I saw these, I knew that I could use these for some business receipts that I have been wanting to store in my filing cabinet. Let's take a look.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These come in four color strips at the top. There is a ZIPLOC BAG TYPE OF CLOSURE TO THESE. It is not a traditional zipper. The plastic is not as thin as some of the really cheap ones, but it is not quite as thick as I was hoping for. There is a place to slip a business card or label in the front of each sleeve.

USES
-receipts for business purchases
-paperwork for research on topics
-contracts
-important paperwork to carry in briefcase
-knitting instructions
-favorite recipes in particular category

PERFORMANCE
These are nice sheaths, but they are a bit thinner than I was hoping for. The zippers work well for the most part, but once in a while they get off track. I am not sure how long they will last. The outside place to slip in a business card or label could peel of of these too in time. However, it is a handy more polished way to store papers than ziploc style bags.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These are color coded for easy reference, will store some papers to protect them and keep them from wearing, but can be a bit less sturdy than I would have liked. They are still usable and I appreciate having them.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. If these were better reinforced or just a bit thicker, I would like them better. They are just a bit less in the quality department than I would have liked. I will still use them until they stop working, though.

title: One Of The Better Seat Cushions I Have Tried To Date
text:
I have been looking for a seat cushion. Some of the ones I have tried are so thin, they don't do much. Others are great, but they are so small they are built more for tiny people or children with small rear ends. Then there is the cushion that guarantees not to flatten out. Fred Flintstone would have like THAT one. Let's take a look at this cushion.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This cushion literally does have a dark blue covering but there is mesh where the gel part shows through. It is pretty strong mesh, though. The fabric on the outside is pretty tough- not velvety, thankfully. It is like a very thick double knit. The bottom of the cushion is slip resistant and it actually works as compared to others.

CUSHION SHAPING
This cushion has shaping to it which allows for the buttocks to fit on the cushion and it also has a curve cut out so that the tail bone is not having pressure on it. The front is not too high or sloped so that it is comfortable to sit on.

HANDLE
There is a fabric webbed handle that you can carry the cushion with you, so if you plan to move it around, it makes it easier to carry with other things in your hands.

COMFORT
This is way more comfortable than the Fred Flintstone cushion that I most recently got. It gives, but is not so soft that it will be flat in a week. I would say that this would probably stay pretty supportive for up to a year before it might start to flatten too much to use.

GEL
The gel part really does help keep cool compared to some foam cushions. I don't think it is anything miraculous, but it is also winter. When it is summer, I might feel differently about this.

HEIGHT
The height of this is about right. It is not too thick so you can not use it in a car, but it is not so thin that it is not much good. It is about 2 inches at its widest.

WHERE HAVE I USED THIS AT?
I have used this in the car, on a recliner, hard dining room chair, and on a desk chair that is too hard for me. It worked well in all of the locations and I was happy that it did not slide around easily.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For use in the house, car, or even wheelchair, this cushion is a good one so far. It won't last for YEARS, but it will last a good amount of time if you need to use it constantly. It stays put, has just enough give to it, and is shaped well for longer periods of sitting.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this one. I was going to give it to my daughter for her car, but I think I might have to get her another one. This one works better than the others I have tried so far. I hope it lasts quite a while. I like it.

title: Great Tape Dispenser Safety Device Can Be Frustrating
text:
I really needed a new packaging tape dispenser for my office use. Let's take a look at this one.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is pretty typical as far as set up goes for a tape gun. The one part that I have NOT encountered before is the red safety cap. This cap covers the teeth which cut the tape. In order to use the tape, you have to snap the safety cap back. If you are done, you snap it down.

I did notice that the screws that hold it in place are removable so if I still don't want it on, I will remove it. Other than that, this really works well and the tape that comes with it is medium weight, but sticks well.

I have learned to work with the cap and it seems to function well once it is snapped back out of the way.

TAPE
This will use the standard clear packaging tape rolls.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although I was at first frustrated with the red safety blade cover at first, I have learned to use this pretty well. I can remove it if I want though, so I am not that worried about it. This is a good dispenser and the tape is pretty good too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I have learned to appreciate the safety cover on this. It is a good tape dispenser, but if I need to travel with it, at least I know that the blades won't cause any damage.

title: Really Cute Mailers For Businesses With A Fun Side
text:
We have a little creative business where we like to send out things that are cute, colorful, show our fun side of jewelry making. Let's take a look at these mailers.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These mailers are a great assortment. There are lemons, pineapples, and flamingos. The mailers have bubbles incorporated so that they will protect the contents. The inside is clear and the flap has a metallic strip on it when when removed has stick adhesive on it.

HOW DO THESE PERFORM?

title: If Only Each Slot Measured The Same
text:
I was SO excited when I saw this. I have been looking for a shelf on the wall just like this to put my cases of glasses into as I have a rather large collection of eyeglasses. I carefully measured them and went by the measurements of the file holder and they were going to fit fine. Let's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is very lightweight wood. It is finished in an antiqued sort of way like you would get a driftwood or old barn wood finish. There is a shelf on the bottom, angled shelves above that (four compartments) and then a larger slanted shelf on top for thicker things, should you decide to use it for that.

MEASUREMENTS
The problem is that these shelves are very irregular in space. The first and last slanted compartments (not talking top and bottom, but the SLANTED compartments) are perfect, but the other two are very close together.
Top COMPARTMENT (not top shelf) Space- 1 5/8"
2nd from top COMPARTMENT - 1 3/8"
3rd from top COMPARTMENT- 1 1/2"
4th from top COMPARTMENT- 1 5/8"

If the compartments all measured between 1 1/2 and 1 5/8 they would have been perfect. They also are a bit crooked so that the measurement can get a tiny smaller at one end.

WHAT DID I PLAN TO USE THIS FOR?
I planned to use this to put my eyeglass cases into. They measure 1 3/8" each in the widest point. The problem is that they won't slide into anything but the 1 5/8" as they need that little ease to get in the slots. I really wanted it for this as it would have been perfect to get them on the wall and up out of the way of the box I keep them in. I just don't think anything is going to help two of the compartments fit like I planned on happening.

WHAT CAN YOU USE THIS FOR?
This is meant for papers and should I abandon the eyeglasses plan, I will put this next to my computer area for the papers that are sandwiched all around my computer area. Either way it will be helpful.

HANGING
Hanging this up could be a challenge. It comes with two hooks on the back which are recessed holes covered by a metal plate. The plate is screwed into the back of this. For papers, I am going to be putting two screws right through the back of this at the bottom of the file holder as well. Two top holes are not enough to support paper of this weight once full, in my opinion.

DOES IT COME WITH SCREWS?
This comes with two dry wall plastic parts and two screws to put in them.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice looking set of file holders. I planned to use it for my eyeglasses, but irregular sizing makes it not feasible so I will most likely be using this for files/papers.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I wish this was the same width all of the way down. My glasses fit beautifully in two of the compartments, but due to irregular measurements, I won't be able to use it for my original intent. I did have the paper back up plan just in case, and I am glad I did.

title: Okay, You Are Gonna Think I Am Nuts..
text:
My house has a problem. There is a black permanent marker eating monster that lives here. I have one simple request- LEAVE THE BLACK MARKERS ALONE! I use them for marking home canned goods, frozen foods, containers of storage items, and other things. I have tried everything I even got a pack of five for Christmas as a gift, but every time I want them, they are GONE. Of course, nobody knows a THING about it. I would estimate that we are approaching the 100 marker point in the last decade of this ridiculous vanishing trend..

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
I decided enough is enough. I am going to fake this marker eating monster out. I ordered this package of 36 because I intend to hide a marker in every hiding place imaginable in the house. That will fake him out.

ODOR?
There is no big odor with these.

I have had no problems with smearing as long as I give this a minute or so to set properly and the item being marked is not cold or damp.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These markers are a godsend. They are solving my problem of missing markers. I love how they work, they write well, the caps stay on while writing and the color is intense. I am happy with them.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS.
I have already developed a plan to hide these all over the house in MY special places. Since the family members now have moved on from hearing problems to convenient illiteracy when I put up signs made with these clearly visible markers, I assume that the marker monster is illiterate so won't read this review with my plans in it either. I think they are safe.. for now, anyway.

I thought of rigging the markers with electrical shocks so that the thief would easily be identified by the hair standing on end, but I am not that good with electronics.. yet. *grins*

title: Perfect For My Business Notes
text:
When it comes to a cooperative business, sometimes having a written calendar is a non-negotiable. Where I am located, it is a regular occasion to have power outages- sometimes more than we would want to have. Some years are better than others. The problem with power outages is that equipment does not work, sometimes files get messed up, and you can not keep up the pace or even look forward to future events if the power stays off any length of time. Enter a manual paper calendar. Let's see what this one is like.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This calendar has some nice pages in the beginning for those who have lots of time to think, muse, and write down odd and ends for their over all life plan. I do not have that kind of time, so I find these pages to be romantic but not practical in my situation. If you have that kind of time to write down things like- priorities you want to live daily all year, Goals, Daily Reminders to be thankful, etc, and tiny spaces for big events to look forward to, you will like this.

COVERS AND BINDING
This is a spiral bound planner which I love. There is no elastic to move to the current day which is kind of a nice feature to have, but I can make one easily enough. The front cover is clear and thick plastic then there is a plastic coated cover page under that which has the printing on it. The back cover is the same dual cover which is great for longevity.

PRINT
Here is something you might want to consider. If you have difficultly seeing in low light or when print is faint, this might present a problem for you. Some of the holidays and dates are written in a very thin font in a light blue color. I can see it pretty well, but some people with difficult vision might struggle with this a bit. It is not a deal breaker for me, but it might be if you have trouble with that sort of thing like a friend of mine does. I think most people will do fine with it though- it is just something to consider.
MONTHLY CALENDAR
The monthly calendars begin with July 2019 so it is good to go right now. Starting with January, they have plastic covered tabs on them (durable). There is a month at a glance, then weekly pages which allow for more detail like most planners. What I like about this is that the top has a space for "This week top 3 things to pay attention to"
There are little boxes to check off when an item is completed- another nice feature.

HOLIDAYS
All holidays are designated with a little green ribbon emoji on them so that they stand out. This helps visually as you are in a hurry to write things down so you don't have to search so much for the holidays in your planning time. I like this feature as well.

DOES THIS HAVE FULL MOON DESIGNATIONS ON IT?
The one thing I miss on this calendar is the lack of full moon information. I could look it up if I wanted to and put them in by hand, but it is nicer if it is already on the calendar. Not a deal breaker, but I wish they had included that information as it is valuable for many reasons to me.

DAYLIGHT SAVINGS TIME
There are entries for daylight savings time settings.

FIRST DAY OF SEASONS
This does include the first day of seasons.

HOLIDAYS
There are not lots of over the top holidays on here which most people don't concern themselves with in the US anyway, but there is a good amount of listing for holidays that are generally of interest and it does include Kwanzaa, Patriots Day, and Grandparents' Day for those who want to know about that. Christian, Jewish and US holidays are also all included.

THE BOTTOM LINE
In a very convenient size for storing with my business items, this calendar is going to be very helpful for keeping offline records of everything we need to know for our appointments and deadlines. So far, it has held up in my carry case, and I expect it will last all year just fine.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this. It is the perfect size. If it had elastic to mark the current days slightly darker printing and full moon information, it would be just about perfect. Nevertheless, it is still five stars.

title: It WORKS!  I Was Not Really Expecting Much
text:
We go in seasons around here when we get endless annoyance calls despite being on the "no-call" list which we all joke means the ,"Please call me" list. Let's see what happened with this.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
I was having a pretty decent summer with the usual amount of weird calls, but a couple of weeks ago I began to get the same call every 15 minutes from "Apple Inc:" I don't own any apple products and never will, so I knew it was a fake call. I was getting very angry at this unending calling which went on very early in the day to late in the evening. Then I remembered- I had been saving this device for such a time as this to test if it really worked.

I took it out and it was easy to hook up. You just need a plug, a place near your phone base, and it is good to go.

INSTRUCTIONS
The instruction book that comes with it is pretty good. It is not difficult to learn or read, at least it was not for me.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
The idea of this is that it will keep track of every call that is made to you. When you get one that you do not want, you can add it to your block list. You can also add it to your okay call list too. The phone filter has a huge amount of already known about call numbers on it, though, so I was hoping that this Apple Inc was one of them.

CAN IT BE HUNG ON THE WALL?
I did not find a way to hang it on the wall, but it would fit on a small shelf, or I can rig up something if we change our phone to be wall mounted as planned in the near future.

DOES IT WORK?
Let me tell you, within 15 minutes of installing this, the phone rang once and then BAM. Gone. Every other call came through, even those annoyance calls that choose to use local numbers to fool the system, but the Apple Inc was GONE! I know they are still calling, because a friend is still getting them. She does not have this device in her phone. I have not had another call from them since.

BLOCKED CALLS
I have not put a lot of calls into the block list yet, because I just don't have time. If I get annoyed enough about them, I will be doing that soon. It takes some time to program it, but it is worth it. This is a busy month for me, so I will report back as I add more calls to the BLOCK list.

DOES IT BLOCK FRIENDS?
I have not had any problem with it blocking friends that I know of. Everyone has gotten through with no problem.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you are being bugged by annoyance calls- this is the device for you. It really does work, and you can program it to work even better if you can take the time to do it. It is not hard to set up either, it just does not have a wall hanger on it if that is a concern.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am thrilled that this is working for me. It really has freed up the calls during the day quite a bit and once I program it over time, I am sure it will work even better.

title: Frustrated- Sticky Patches Won't Come Off Cartridges
text:
When I got these cartridges, I did not need my ink replaced yet, but knew I would within the year so I figured I would get them and use them ASAP. I do quite a bit of printing, so I figured it would not be too long. Let's see what happened.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These cartridges come in a very thick plastic sheath. It is sealed well. On each cartridge of ink there is a little thin clear sticky piece of plastic that seals the opening so that the ink does not dry out before you have to use it. To use these, you cut open the bag and then you remove the seal and install them into the printer.

WHAT KIND OF PRINTER DO I HAVE?
I have the HP Officejet Pro. I was running low on ink for my yellow and magenta cartridges, so I thought I would try them out of the new pack before I totally ran out of ink. Boy was I glad I did. (also tried a third, see below)

WHAT HAPPENED?
Ideally, when you remove the seal of the cartridge, you install them in the printer and hopefully it will be recognized and work as all of the others. In my case, unfortunately , I never got that far. I was excited to try these and then when I went to remove the seal from the cartridges, they would not come off. The corners of the clear thin plastic seal all came off and no matter what I did, I could not remove the seals from these. I did not want to poke a hole in them because that could cause damage to the printer. So, in essence these are unusable.

ADDENDUM- CARTRIDGE 3
I tried the cyan cartridge and the seal partially came off, but not entirely. Again, I won't take a chance ruining my printer so it is a bust for me.

DO THESE WORK IN MY PRINTER?
I guess I won't know. My other ink cartridge is plenty full so I am not going to remove it just to find out I can not use these anyway. I guess this package of cartridges just are a bust for me. Without being able to remove the seal, I can not use the cartridges to figure out of they will work in my printer. I like my printer too much to ruin it just to test these out.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this sounded good, I could not remove the seal off of the colors I needed to use. That makes them unable to be used. I won't ruin my printer just to test them out.

MY RATING
TWO STARS. I guess it is more like 2 and a half but I can not say if they work or not as the seals won't come off. If I find that by some miracle the remaining cartridge works, I will update, but for now, I am up to 3 of them with seals unable to come off, so this is a bust for me.

title: A Bit Of A Challenge To Set Up, But Worth The Effort
text:
WARNING - This is an in depth review. If you prefer a quick summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
---------------------------
I have had a wide variety of printers over the years. I have never had a laser jet to run in a home business environment, so this was a new experience for me. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This set comes with the laser printer, installed cartridge, a power cord and a USB cord. There is a poster on how to start using this with an online address to connect to find the drivers you will need. There is a basic instruction manual, but I mean SPARSELY BASIC.

HOW EASY IS THIS TO SET UP?
MY SYSTEM
My system is a network which is wi-fi. I have a desktop hardwired to the route and we also use Android devices- both phones and tablets, and laptops. I run Windows 7, 8, and 10 on this network as well as the Android devices.

WHAT WAS I INTENDING TO USE THIS FOR?
This is going to be used for black and white printing of things such as recipes, instructions, inserts, handouts, and other things that we prefer not to be runny if wet.

HOW WAS THIS TO SET UP?
Honestly, I was very frustrated with this printer at first. It is not like most of the newer printers. I wanted to hook it up in the central location of the home, but as it turned out, it has to be connected to the desktop to install in order to use it wirelessly. That is annoying. I had to connect via USB port and due to lack of outlets near my computer, it was a hassle to get an extender to make my USB reach the desktop.

PROCESS
Once you get the USB connected, you go to the site listed on the paperwork, and you can print out a manual, as well as get the drivers and install them. Once they are installed via USB, then you can set up the printer for wireless, and disconnect at that point.

TIME INVOLVED?
All in all due to having a lot of trouble getting this to connect then to download, it took several hours to get this set up and running correctly.

DRIVERS?
There are no drivers included in the package. I am annoyed at this because believe it or not, there are still quite a few people who do not have fast internet or who have frequent outages and to have to have this in order to set it up is ridiculous. They should be including a CD-ROM with the drivers on it for those who do not have the newest of everything.

MANUAL
This is another annoying part of this set- this should be coming with a manual. It should not have to be printed out if you want it. I prefer to have paper printed manuals when working on them, so I had to print out a 60 page (both sides) manual and it is annoying. For items like printers and other accessories, they should be including manuals.

HOW WELL DOES IT WORK?
PRINTING QUALITY
There are settings for 600 dpi printing, fast printing, or more professional level printing. All of them work really well.

SPEED?
This is very fast- even when using the duplex, it is much faster than inkjet- even my fastest ones.

DUPLEX?
This has a duplex feature if you want to print on both sides

PAPER
The paper tray is easy to use and holds quite a bit of paper, but not enormous amounts.

ANY PROBLEMS OTHER THAN INSTALLATION?
I have not had any problems with paper jams, incomplete printing, or any other problems since using this. I have had it for quite a few months now and it has remained a consistent performer.

ANDROID PERFORMANCE?
This performed well with both tablets and phones in our home that use Android using their app.

WHO MIGHT LIKE THIS?
If you have always wanted a laser printer that performs well, is not overly large and has good solid performance, but the price offset you, you might want to take a look at this. I think you would like it. It does not have an LED screen, but if you install with USB port at first, then you can run wirelessly without problem.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For quick black and white printing when you want water resistant printing, this home quality printer is not overly big, works beautifully once set up, and has good choices for duplex and print quality. The set up was a bit challenging for me, but I have given you the steps that will help you set it up without frustration, so you should be fine.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I am irritated that this did not come with manual or drivers on a disk. Not everyone has the best internet or the newest computer equipment and HP should not be putting the burden of these things on the consumer. They should be service oriented enough to provide them. I took a star off for that, but it is really more like FOUR AND A HALF STARS. I do not think it is five, however.

title: Nice Set, Instructions Minimal, Dead Practice Links In Package
text:
NOTE- This set is rated for two different users- Beginners and Advanced. If you don't need instructions, the rating is higher based solely upon the quality of items.
--------------------------------------------
When I saw this set, I could not wait to get it. We love to do artwork in our home, so having sets of lettering markers was a great addition to our collection. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS IN THIS SET?
This set comes with 5 analogous colored markers from the blue-teal-green-purple spectrum. There is a gray marker and a black marker. All of those come with a brush tip. There is a chisel tip black marker and a fine tip marker 05 size. There is a magic rub eraser and a graphite pencil which is unsharpened. A very limited instruction sheet is included.

HOW DO THE MARKERS PERFORM?
These markers are nice quality. They are vivid, yet do layer somewhat nicely so that you can do ombre effects with them. The brush tips are firm enough to allow for finer lines but if you put pressure on them, they will make thicker lines.

PENCIL?
The pencil is a bit harder than usual, allowing for fine light lines to put down the designs you want to make, but then draw over them with the markers. You have to watch the pressure though, because on some paper, it will dig into the paper.

ERASER
The Magic Rub eraser is good. It does lift most of the pencil marks as long as I do not press too hard.

INSTRUCTION SHEET
This is where this set is poorly done. The instruction sheet is very bland. It has a few ideas, but no execution tips on how to emulate much of what you see. There is a link for practice sheets which is a dead link. It is not even on the site anymore.

PRACTICE SHEETS
Thankfully for now, there are some places online where you can download practice sheets for hand lettering (lizoncall is a site at the time of this review if you can not find one easily)

WHAT IF YOU ARE NOT A BEGINNER?
This set is a great quality set- nice collection. If you don't need instructions, then I would highly recommend it. If you are counting on this being a beginners set, expect to have to purchase or look up other instructions.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a good collection of brush tip markers as well as a few gray and black to use for artwork, this is a great set. For specifically how to learn to do lettering, it is lacking as the instructions are minimal and the link for practice pages is not available anymore.

MY RATING
FOR BEGINNERS- THREE STARS (lack of instruction and dead practice link)
FOR ADVANCED USERS- FIVE STARS (based on good quality of tools in kit)
I am making this a FOUR star rating as an average of the two ratings.

title: BEAUTIFUL!  I Am Thrilled These Worked

title: WAY Nicer Than I Expected This To Be (IN DEPTH REVIEW)
text:
My printer was not doing well and I needed a low profile scanner/printer unit to replace it with. I am usually an HP girl, but this time around, I thought I would try this Canon. I was kind of worried I made the wrong choice, but as it turns out.. well, let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This printer is a nice low profile. It fits on the bottom shelf of my computer desk as I have another larger pro printer on the top shelf that is usually pulled out for printers. I needed another scanner, so this goes on the bottom shelf for that purpose.

SET UP?
This printer was easy to set up. It has GREAT documentation that comes with it, and everything you need to set it up is included. The company really seemed to be interested in making customers feel comfortable with the installation

CD INCLUDED?
Yes, this has a set up CD included with the printer. The CD is for Windows Only set up.

HOW DOES IT OPERATE?
This printer is really cool. It just is. What happens is that you put your document into the software (talking about desktop use or laptop here) and then it is time to print. When it starts to print (make sure that that ON button is pressed), the touchscreen tilts forward and pops open and the front tray comes out all on its own. The printer prints the papers, and then it stays that way until you close them by hand.

IS THIS FOR BATCH PRINTING?
This printer is more for personal use. There is not a lot of room to put in large stacks of paper, so it is not for large printing jobs as in business style.

DUPLEX?
Yes, this has duplex printing. I have to remember to check the print on both sides part of the printer software, but it does a great job. I have not taken the time to change the setting so I don't have to do that.

PRINT QUALITY?
Compared to my favorite HP printer, this is not quite as nice, but honestly it is still good quality printing.

PHOTOS?
The photos are great- very nice printing, although, again, I am color sensitive, so they are not always exactly what I want, but they are very close and good quality. It also comes with photo paper so you can test out the printer's photo capabilities.

COPY MACHINE?
Can you use this as a copy machine? Yes. It is great and quick.

SCAN QUALITY
So far, the scan quality has been solid and good.

APP?
The app is really cool. You can scan a paper/doc with your phone, save as PDF and then send it to the printer. You can also set up the printer via phone instead of computer if you like that idea. You can also print right from Twitter, Instagram, Google Drive, Dropbox, and Evernote. So far, I have not done a WHOLE lot of that kind of printing, but it does work quite well so far for me.

MY EXPERIENCES WITH THIS PRINTER
I have to say I am really liking this printer. I have used it for a LONG time prior to writing this review ON PURPOSE. I wanted to check for paper jams, ink replacement times, performance, and longevity of the auto features. So far, I have to say after MONTHS of using this, I love it as much as the day I got it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a printer that is low profile, so easily fits in smaller places, is great red color, does photos and docs not only from laptops and computers, but phones as well, this is a winner in my book. Ink lasts pretty long, and I have not had any problems after MONTHS of us. I love that it has duplex capabilities too, which saves paper.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. Although this is more of a personal printer and has smaller paper holding area, I got this mainly for scanning and photos, although I do use it for every day printing now and then too. The quality is slightly different than HP, but the newer HP printers are more on a par with this so it is a toss up.

FUTURE
I will add some comparison photos in the future when I get a chance so you can see the differences between the output of my HP and the Canon.

title: FANTASTIC For Renaissance Festivals, Period Costumes, Plays, Etc- Authentic Looking
text:
This book is WAY cooler than I expected. Let's take a look at it.

WHAT IS THIS BOOK LIKE?
This book is VERY rustic. It is like something you might find in the Renaissance Times, Colonial Times, or various other times when paper was a premium, and fancy was special. This book is bound in a single piece of what appears to be very thick leather hide, although it does smell more like bonded leather. The front is dyed and has tooling on it for a heart and trim.

The pages are thick and reminiscent of period times. They look hand pressed. The pages are held in place by a complex cording on the binding that you can see on the back of it.

THE CLOSURE
The end is encased in the leather as it folds over and then there is a nice metal closure that looks like aged brass. It slides through a hole and is very ornate. That keeps the pages completely covered except the top and bottom edges.

WHAT IS THIS BEST FOR?
I can totally see this in period acting such as Renaissance Fairs, Civil War battles (maybe not completely accurate, but would fit well), Colonial period acting, Living museum activities such as classes where kids dress the part and bring things around with them to appear part of the village, and plays of all sorts would do well with this too.

I will probably use it for fun because I happen to love the way it looks.

WILL IT LAST?
If this is indeed bonded leather, it will probably have the layers separate over time. If it is a solid piece of thick hide, it will last a lot longer provided it is kept dry and out of the sun for long periods of time.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a gorgeous rustic leather bound journal/book that is right up your alley if you like period costumes, or living in another era, this is a really cool option. I plan to use this often and if I do any participation in period performances or activities, I will bring this with me.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I really love this. It is so cool looking. I am WAY more impressed than I thought I would be.

title: Ridiculous Set Up, Fits Nothing We Can Find

title: Erases Fairly Well- Better On Some Paper Than Others
text:
What an idea- markers that you can ERASE? Let's see how they work..

WHAT ARE THESE MARKERS LIKE?
These markers come in a variety of colors. Each marker has a white cap with a coordinating eraser that indicates the color of the marker on top of the cap. The markers are rather fine tipped. There is no odor and they are clearly marked as ERASABLE on both the cap and the marker base itself.

HOW DO THEY WORK?
The idea is that you write on your paper and then once it is dry, you erase if you want to using the eraser in the cap. The heat friction on the ink will make it disappear.

DOES IT WORK?
Well, it does and doesn't work as well as I expected. Some colors seem to erase better than others. The red, for instance is harder to get to disappear than say lime green. Some of the colors disappear completely, others leave more of a ghost on them.

PAPER
It depends on the paper you use as to whether the marker erases as easily as it should or not too. Some papers which are less porous erase better than more porous papers. For instance, the back of the cardboard packaging that these came in refused to erase much at all. Yet printer paper for inkjet erased much better for the most part.

DOES IT BLEED THROUGH?
I found that these do not bleed through as promised.

DOES THIS RUIN PAPER?
There have been a few times that if I continued to erase too much that the paper would end up with a crinkled or raw spot in it. Most of the time it was not too bad, however. The best thing is to test it on a small part of the paper you plan to use them on FIRST to see.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For markers that can be used to correct papers with, or make notes on or add color or dimension to, these erasable markers are a decent choice. They don't always erase completely, but they do fade enough to be effectively erased for the most part.

MY RATING
Four stars. Great idea, decent execution. Not a WOW for me, but a good performer. I will use these and have quite a bit.

title: For Art Classes (Like Susan Rubin For Example) Just What The Teacher Ordered!
text:
When it comes to art classes, it is important for colored pencil classes to have a nice sharp lead which is longer than usual. This allows the pencil to be held at the proper angle for drawing. WHAT IS THIS SHARPENER LIKE?
This pencil sharpener is sleek in design. The idea is that you plug it on or run by batteries and push the pencil into the top of the sharpener. The sharpener will automatically sharpen until it is done and then turn off.

WHAT KIND OF POWER?
This sharpener comes with a plug for the wall that has a USB connector in it. It also comes with a cord that you put into the unit as well as the USB plug that you put into the wall. There is also the capacity to use FOUR AA batteries if you like.

INSTRUCTIONS
The manual is small and is in Asian on one side and English on the other. It is pretty easy to understand although there is not any mention of the battery capacity.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
I have taken classes with teachers such as Susan Rubin which request that you learn to sharpen your pencils with long leads and sharp tips. This sharpener is perfect for that. The point is perfect. It is not too thin or too long or too sharp. I am very happy with this sharpener.

The sharpener itself does not seem to struggle at all, but sharpens quickly and easily with out any difficulty.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Whether for colored pencil or art classes or for just sharpening pencils to use at home, this sharpener is one of the best I have used. The leads are left sharp and long and the job is quick and you can move on with a sharpened pencil in no time. Multiple power sources are a plus.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love this sharpener and am VERY glad I got it. It has turned my art up a notch from the old sharpener that I used to have.

title: I Was Surprised At How Flimsy This Was
text:
When it comes to planners, I don't know about you, but I want to have it be sturdy, have enough room to write, and be able to be sturdy on the wall until I need to turn the page to the next month. Let's see how this measures up.

THREE STARS. I really am more of the two stars mindset on this, but It is not as bad as it could be.

title: How To Start A Fist Fight

title: I Was SO Hoping This Would Work!
text:
We do a lot of canning, handmade lotions and soaps, and other things in our home. The problem is that sometimes the lids can get a bit oily. I was hoping for a pen that would write on them pretty well. This seemed perfect. Let's see what happened..

WHAT ARE THESE PENS LIKE?
These pens come in a blister pack of four with two black, a red, and a blue. The cap goes on pretty tightly and the point is fine enough to write a word with, but not so fine that it is skinny if that makes sense. There is an odor, but it is not that bad.

HOW DO THESE WORK?
Well, these are supposed to write on oily, dusty, metal, plastic, wood, and concrete. I tested these on plastic, metal lids for jars, plastic containers for lotion, and dusty wood. They wrote okay on the wood, but so do a lot of things. As for the plastic jars, I wrote on them DRY but when a little oil hit the side of the plastic container, the letter smeared so badly it was illegible. Then it came off within a day of use.

The metal lids I wrote on were both dry and oily. The dry wrote okay, but when it got oil on it, it smeared too. The oily lid, forget it. The writing would not even go on well to begin with let alone stay there.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I was hoping these would work, but in the cases I tried them in (except for wood) they just did not perform well at all. I guess I will wait for someone else to come up with something better.

MY RATING
TWO STARS. These are not any better than regular sharpies in the applications it claims to be designed for.

title: A Great Good Quality Intro To The World Of Pen & Ink Calligraphy
text:
I have done callligraphy since I was a young girl. It has been something I have loved and enjoyed so much that I wanted to introduce one of our daughters to this craft, being that she is artistic. Let's see what this set is like..

WHAT IS THIS SET LIKE?
This set comes with three colors of ink CARTRIDGES. There are three different sized nibs and three different colored housings for each pen. There is a purple, green, and black housing for the pens. Each nib is interchangeable with the housings so if you are a color oriented person like me, you can change the nibs and have the housing match the ink that is inside it.

The inks are navy, green, and purple color. These colors allow you to not only do some great lettering, but with the different nibs, you can do some fine illustrating as well.

INSTRUCTIONS
The instruction booklet is perfect for getting you started on your journey into learning calligraphy. It has basic instructions on how to use and hold the pen, insert ink cartridges, and do basic exercises to learn the art. There are basic charts for lettering and some ideas to spark creativity on flourishes too.

CAN YOU USE BOTTLED INK WITH THIS?
If you purchase an ADDITIONAL converter, you can use this pen with bottled inks as well. This kit does not come with it.

CAN YOU GET OTHER COLORED INKS FOR THIS?
The booklet shows other colored inks that you can get for this pen set if you want to expand your inks.

CLEANING
You follow simple instructions every month or two for simple cleaning. We have used it and it works well.

QUALITY
