But this tool is so fast and easy. If Id seen somone using it on one of those latenight paid infomercials I would have rolled my eyes but I was feeling so desperate that I think I would have bought this anyway. Luckily, it is a real product and it works!

My only tip for this is to keep the little protective rubber tip, you are going to need it becuase it has a very sharp pointy fork end and the rubber corner is just so great that you will want to hold onto it for other DIY things.

title: Extra Thick Folders
text:
These hanging files are just what I needed.

They come in a predictable variety of colors with the paper write on tabs and clear divider thingies, they also come with little placeholder things for the bottom of the extra wide file. I think this would work a bit better if you use a tiny bit of scotch tape to hold them into the file folder, in a pantyliner like way, other wise I could see them sliding out when you use the file.

The metal hooks that slide onto the file drawer railings are unbent and usable. I really have no complaints and I think these files should last a long time.

title: 4 hours to put this sucker together!
text:
This is a very nice, sturdy on wheels double drawer file cabinet. Once it was put together my son rolled it from the living room to my desk in the dining room and it rolled along great even across a porcelain tile floor.

The drawers hold letter size files and there is room enough for multiple tabs and color coded notations., in other words, your regular type of American size files.

I have a combination of letter size and legal size file folders, so to truly use this I will need to buy a few more hanging file folders.

Something else I really like, there is a wheel on the bottom of the file cabinet drawer and it rolls open smoothly when you need to get to your files.

This little cabinet comes in a wood tone, a rustic color that I am just so tired of, so the black veneer, to me seemed like a welcome neutral to introduce to my office area.

I was able to use all of my letter size hanging folders in the bottom drawers and it was enough space to clear out most of a file folder box.

title: Nice metal rulers
text:
I got this set of rulers for a tile project I'm working on.

But they've turned out to be super useful for several other things I've been struggling with around the house.

They are rigid metal and very thin, which has been so useful when I was trying to hang pictures, anyway, I think every household should have a set along with a tape measure.

title: Easy to find ways to use this cart
text:
These little plastic, wheeled carts are the organizing solution you've been waiting for.

We just moved and our place has just four closets (including our bedroom clothing closets), the one in the kitchen that is a pantry of sorts, has a large open space at the bottom and this cart fit in it like it had been specially made for this space.

I am using it to store some of the non-food kitchen and home essentials that I couldn't find a place for in the kitchen; dish soap, dish towels, cat treats. But it could easily be used for a bunch of different things.
I like to use these carts for a theme; a snack trolley; filled with bags of chips, cookies, candies and juiceboxes. A craft trolley with boxes of colored pencils, paints, scrapbook stickers, etc. Maybe a tool cart, with all of the most used tools could be on the cart. Anyways, I really like this cart and my pantry has room for one more and its like having a movable shelf that you can pull out and refill easily.

The best part about this little cart is that it was super easy to put together, my husband had it assembled in the time it took me to reheat a couple of slices of pizza.

title: Easy to change out
text:
these couldn't be easier to change out. I did it, with no tools in less than five minutes.

pros of using these wheels;

quieter than the standard issue wheels

They seem smoother on hard surfaces

The floor looks fine and there is no need for the wood floor protecting rug that I got.

Cons;

The chair is taller, by a smidge, if you are a really tall person and need your cair adjusted to its lowest setting to be comfy or maybe a really small person with short legs, this difference in height could prove crucial to your comfort.

title: Works as advertised
text:
My son's chair has wobbly, super fast wheels. We didn't know this because he had his chair on top of some very low pile carpet in his old bedroom, but since the move his chair has rolled around so fast, he was nearly tossed out.

This mat has stopped that from happening. I'm actually pretty surprised at how effective it is, considering it looks like the cheapest most disposable rug you would ever find. But, he is so happy with it and sorta thinks I'm a genius for getting it for him (I got it for myself, all the floors at our new place are wood or tile, so I needed something too).

Anyways, it is the right size for a rolly desk chair and it does seem to protect the wood vinyl floor in his room AND keeps him from sliding at speed around his bedroom. As a bonus, our cat tried to scratch at it, she is so destructive lately, and her claws got stuck and once she'd extricated herself she ran off screeching, she's been giving it a wide berth ever since, so I think the mat will last a while.

Aesthetics; this looks a lot more flimsy and thin in person. In the online photos the mat looks like those heavy duty mats businesses put down in high traffic entrance areas to keep the soupy, dirty snow off of slippery linoleum, but in reality it is thin with a shiny backing. Somewhere between the color of asphalt and navy and it didn't require airing out or offgassing, it was ready to go as soon as I unpacked it.

title: Great chair, lightweight and easily moved around
text:
This chair is super easy to put together, I literally left the room for just a few minutes and when I came back my husband was using it during a zoom call.

It is a basic, old fashioned style of office chair, the mesh back on the seat is the only thing modern about it, I could imagine myself using it in my old keyboarding class in college.

The ball rolly wheels are good, they handled a tile floor and a wood plank floor and they seem fine on the thin office carpet wood floor protection mat we bought for under our desks.

The fact that this chair doesn't have arms seemed really uncomfortable to me, but actually, it has been fine.

title: This is gorgeous
text:
Writing in a journal like this makes me think I should work on my penmanship and maybe use a quill and ink instead of my usual rollerball pen.

First off, this journal has a lovely heft to it, it isn't a picture of a tree, it is a bas relief tree in leathery journal form. The cover is serious and a real work of art, I could see this as a prop in an episode of BTVS.

I really like the feel of the pages and that was the only thing that I was unsure about, the paper isn't lined and it seemed dry and kind of fragile, but in fact it is a thicker paper, not stiff like cardstock or thin like vellum, it has a cottony feel and look to it. Not as nice as some of the pretty japanese paper I bought last year, but not entirely far off from it.

I think that it is a real joy to write in and I can't wait to find or make a pretty, alchemy'ish type of bookmark.

If you are thinking of buying this as a gift for a friend, I think it would be happily received especially if you inlcude a fancy pen of sorts.

title: Perfect way to get organized
text:
This is a really nice planner, the size of the pages is especially helpful.

Each month has a two page spread that let's you plan out an entire month. then there are two pages to cover weeks at a time.

Each day has room for several reminders and appointments.

There are tabs for the months but not the days or weeks which is fine for me, I'm using it for household reminders.

The dogs are cute and the hardback cover makes this useful without a desk. I thought the only drawback was the spiral binding, but as it turns out, this binding has been very convenient, keeping the pages open to notes even on the inner part of the page.

title: Tailbone pain be gone
text:
My son has been having a lot of pain in his tailbone. I think it is from sitting on his old desk chair gaming for hours on end but anyways, I think this could help with some of that.

So far, he says it does make the chair more comfortable but that it seems a bit short for the size of his desk seat. But I think this is a pretty standard size for these seat cushions, they are just buttock sized, not chair seat sized.

Something else to be aware of is that these become flat over time. My husband has already gone through one of these seat cushions because he suffers from computer back (I don't know what else to call it when your back hurts from sitting at a desk for ten to fourteen hours a day).

So I guess I will see how long this cushion lasts, but it would be worth it even if it did need replacing quarterly because of the comfort alone.

title: Wonderful pages of writing for journalers
text:
this is a very nice journal, the pages are large enough to fit words too and the binding is good so that said pages don't fall out when you crack the spine (I'm hard on journals and books and I don't really care if they start to look a bit worn).

I prefer lined paper and it was suprisingly hard to find a journal with lined paper, so many seem a lot more scrapbook'ish with blank pages or even more odd, watermarked or decorated pages that would really limit the amount of writing you can fit on each page.

The other thing I really wanted was an attached bookmark and a way to hold the journal closed, a snap or a button or elastic, but this one has leather tie and I like the old world style of it.

Some other things that weren't necessary, but that I really like, in no particular order are,

The hidden pouch on the inside cover, I'm using that to hold some coupons

The pen holder, I am a bit particular about which pen I use on this journal and this keeps them together without bending the pages (I used to use the pen as a bookmarker in my old journal).

That's about all I can say about this journal, it is super pretty and I really really like it, the color is so much prettier in person, a lot more blue than green and the imprinted words seem sorta fantastical.

title: How to make a cheap chair comfy
text:
I put these armrests on my old $69 office chair and suddenly it is one of the most comfy chairs in the house.

I didn't even realize that one of the most uncomfortable parts of this chair was that the arms had so little padding and were a little low for someone like me who prefers to sit up very straight, no slouching for me, my lower back cant handle it. The pain in my elbows was traveling to my wrists and fingers and curbing my online time.

Another bonus is that now I can rest my elbows when I am just watching videos, it really is pretty nice. My only complaint is that these only seem to come in the one size and as you can tell from my picture the arms on my chair are just a smidge longer than the new padded armrests. But they are long enough and very comfy.

Some other things to know, they are a cinch to install, though another small quibble, why not use velcro, using a belt loopdie thingamajig seems a little more fiddly and probably wont be as fixed as some wide strips of velcro would be.

title: Very lightweight and easy to put together
text:
I get groceries delivered and since I live in an apartment building I go out to meet the deliveries, I don't want the delivery people to have to carry everything up in the elevator.

I think this little cart will help but I am a little concerned about using it for heavy stuff, like a gallon of milk or a bottle of laundry soap.

Each of the trays is thin plastic, with the thickness of a desk organizer for your pens and highlighters. The metal frame is equally thin and hollow.

So I am thinking that I might repurpose this for some bathroom items that I keep in my bedroom closet. My bathroom has no storage at all, so it would be nice to have a place to keep some towels and my waterpik, maybe some extra bottles of moisturizer and my blowdryer, just the odds and ends that wont fit under the sink (the only storage in my tiny bathroom). The cups that hang off the side are the perfect size to hold small tubes; antiseptic ointment, toothpaste, foot gel.

Putting this together took about fifteen minutes. I got my son to put this one together for me, he is so handy with stuff like this.

As you can see in my photo the cart is small enough to fit into the tiny hallway closet that is next to my front door. It has small roller wheels and on the smooth floor of my apartment it glides along like butter on a hot pancake. But I think it wouldn't do great on all but the lowest pile carpets.

The yellow is almost obnoxiously bright, but it kinda grows on you and I think it will make keeping it clean just a little easier because the color will not hide any smudges.

The handle for pushing it is a bit on the short side and I am not a super tall person. So for all the longshanks out there this cart could be a bit awkward if you plan to push it around a bit.

title: Heavy rubber doorstops
text:
I was a bit worried that these doorstops would be kind of bendy and flimsy. I am happy to report that they are the opposite of flimsy. In fact, since we are using this for an interior door, it almost seems like overkill, like we didn't need that much stopping power to keep the bedroom door from swinging closed over and over and over again.

The color is white, as pictured, so pretty subtle and yet entirely visible if you kick it around and need help finding it again (also helps if your carpet or flooring isn't white).

Also, because it is a rubber with a bit of give, I'm not worried about it eating up the bottom of the door. I am still hopeful that I can get my deposit back on my rental apartment (yep, I'm an optimist).

Last, but not least, there are three in the package, all of them white and sturdy.

title: I should have bought this months ago
text:
So this review will take the form of a Before and After pictorial.

The Before picture is of my laundry/pantry closet. The room is small and crowded. In one corner is a shelf for supplies, in the other two corners, a water heater and a stacking washer/dryer combo. The last is the door.

I have a lot of cleaning products, including dishwashing supplies that I keep in this tiny closet sized room and finding a place for it was frustrating and annoying. I ended up using some clear bucket drawer things and just sorta hoped for the best, I won't apologize for how dirty and messy everything looks in the first photo. I'm not the tidiest person and the lockdown has sapped my energy for most everything.

But check out the AFTER photo. Most all of my cleaning supplies fit in the cart and it looks so neat and clean, nothing is on the floor now! It's almost nice enough to get me to be a littler cleaner (I said ALMOST, I am still a messy lady who cleans her oven when it starts to smoke or smell like burnt pizza, that will never change).

A little about the dimensions of the cart; Each shelf can hold up to 30 pounds (I think) and it fit all but the largest bottles, my extra large bottle of cleaning vinegar didn't fit, neither did my extra large bottle of Arm & Hammer Fragrance Free HE Laundry Liquid, not a problem because I use a small bottle that I refill, no wrenching my shoulder every time I start a load of laundry.

The little cups that hang off the side which I thought were pretty silly turned out to be really useful to corral all of the little doodads I use to keep my place from looking like an episode of How Clean is Your House? I have pumice sticks, bleach pens and cheap toothbrushes for cleaning grout in the tiny cups and the feather duster fits perfectly into the slot on the top of the cart.

If you are like me and need a tidy place to keep some supplies, this cart is great and easily moveable, the wheels are not decorative they work and were sturdy enough to roll over the little doorway lip thingy, whatever that thing is called that is on the floor of the doorway.

Now for a little bit about putting the cart together. My son put it together for me, he used a hammer to get some of it to stick. It took him about twenty minutes and it looks great and there wasn't very much grumbling from him so I think it was a beginner level job.

title: Comfort without being hot
text:
It can get pretty warm in the Pacific Northwest, warm enough that having a cushion that retains heat and sweat would be unbearable.

I'm happy to report that isn't the case with this memory foam cushion and matching lumbar support cushion.

My husband has been having tailbone pain so he is using this in his living room chair and I am using the lumbar support in my living room chair.

What I like about these;

1. They are not connected. I remember years ago buying a support like this for my car and thinking that I could just use the lumbar support only to find out that they were connected by some weird stretchy mesh. Not these cushions you could separate them by thousands of miles if you like.

2. Easy to keep clean. I got some toothepaste water on the cushion and it easily wiped off and didn't really leave a mark.

3. Not to hot.

4. Not too sweat inducing.

5. Doesn't smell out of the package. I was a little concerned that I might have covid 19 because I couldn't smell anything from these cushions, but it turns out they just don't have a terrible offgassing aroma. Maybe they offgassed years ago, not sure, but I appreciate it.

6. Blend in colors. They don't stand out colorwise, just plain black so you really can use them anywhere without them looking like a hemorrhoid pillow (I don't have anything against hemorrhoid pillows, hey, we all get old and probably everyone needs one eventually) that you have to use to avoid injuring yourself, it looks a little like a booster seat, but for adults.

Anyways, I am feeling a real benefit to using this cushion. My back is more comfy and my husbands tailbone is unnoticeable again, which is how he likes it.

title: very comfortable to use and the wrist rest is long enough
text:
I was a bit worried that the wrist rest wouldn't be long enough to cover the length of my keyboard and make it so that I can actually rest my wrist. But it is! the pictures are a bit deceiving.

Something else I like about this mouspad and wrist rest is the colors, they really are very pretty and provide a bright spot of color in my otherwise drab work all day desk.

The wrist rest on the mousepad; this isn't something I wanted or thought I needed, but it actually is really comfy and my wrist feels a little better even after playing games.

title: Lovely spot of color and it fits on a small desk
text:
My new mouse works better with a mousepad. This mousepad is lovely and it does the trick.

Some other things to know about it;

It is a little bit blurry and the color isn't as jewellike as it is pictured online.

But, other than this little wrinkle it is a workable mousepad.

title: Finally, some relief
text:
It's a sign that you are getting older that it doesn't matter anymore that you need to squashy cushion on your chair to tame you sciatica, not even my son saying; 'is that a hemorrhoid cushion?' in a horror struck tone could affect my delight with this product.

In a word, it's lovely.

I didn't have a lot of problems with sciatica, just some days were really awful and I didn't want to see a doctor about it and I didn't really want to do anything about it (even though everyone keeps recommending yoga to me).

But this is really working and it requires zero setup or exercise. I guess I am just feeling too stressed right now (pandemic) to do much more than toss a cushion on my chair and call it good. It is also working on my living room chair which has gotten a bit worn out and lumpy.

All in all, this is a valuable cushion and I wish I'd gotten it a few years ago.

title: Works great and its not just for carpet
text:
This is great for projects. I used it put some paper backing in on an old shelf and it was perfection.

Also used it keep a drawer divider dividing.

This tape is fantastic, especially for renters.

It is clear and easy to remove (use some dental floss and be patient).

I think this could work in some cosplay situations too. The uses seem to be endless.

title: Great box!  Good size!
text:
This lockbox is lot sturdier than I thought it would be. For some reason, I thought it would be sorta lightweight not unlike the rubbermaide file box we are currently using for our most important documents.

A couple of things you should know before buying this. It is a smallish file box. It is for 8.5 x 11" papers, not legal papers, unless you want to fold the pleading papers.

Second, this isn't a safe. The lock is small and a bit flimsy, think diary, a girls diary with a pink leather cover and a faux gold lock. This isn't some super secret container that you would see handcuffed to a man with a gun.

I want to use this for important documents, the kind that you would grab if you had to evacuate for a fire or volcanic eruption, so I am going to put a few strips of glow in the dark tape on the box so that it can be easily seen. The black color would make it hard to see in the dark, just a thought.

But other than the blend in color, it's a nice lockable steel box. It fits all of my files.

title: Printer upgrade
text:
I really liked my last printer but it had two major drawbacks of which one is thankfully fixed int this printer.

The price of ink. The ink in this printer is way more affordable than my old printer, it also will last a lot longer. Yay, more pages printed (including the tickets for the Marvel Live show we are going to).

The second problem my old printer had was that when the printer was out of ink, the scan to disk portion would not work. Scanning doesn't take ink, but it still wouldn't work and with the price of ink scary high, it made it a worthless, giant paperweight.

I don't know what will happen when this runs out of ink. Will it stop doing other functions? If it does at the least the ink wont cost me my firstborn child.

title: Great Tape
text:
I saw this tape right after seeing some pretty cute tape crafts on pinterest, coincidence? I think not.

I used some of this tape on clothes pins, they looked super cute afterwards and it was easy and quick. So my next tape craft I wanted to try something a bit harder, so I used some to cover the plain black border of my wipe board wall calendar. Pizazzle!

Then I used some to label the storage boxes in my basement. It made the boring boxes of computer supplies and Christmas decorations look nice. I don't mean Martha Stewart nice, but it was a lovely improvement.

The tape rolls aren't very big and I think I will look for nicer colors next time. These are just too disco for me. But other than that, it is a pretty and useful tape.

title: Useful and sturdy
text:
This is a review for the black, ladder back chair with a vinyl padded seat, not the wooden seat.

Just wanted to make clear which chair I am reviewing.

Okay, here goes, this chair is okay and almost perfect.

Here's what I like about it;

1.Very sturdy design and a bit heavier than I was expecting. My last chair was wood, it had cross beams near the bottom and I liked to rest my feet on them. So would anyone under seven feet tall, which made it so disappointing when the cross beam broke and compromised the chair leg (there was a smallish crack in it and the chair seemed wobbly). With metal frame and overall great construction of this chair, I can rest my legs with peace of mind, no broken chairs for me!!!

2. Looks exactly like the photo. All black and the exact dimensions that were listed here.

Here's what I didn't like;

1. Missing hardware. there was spots for six screws to secure the seat to the base and yet only two screws were included. Sure, it seemed sturdy, but why not have all six points locked down?

2. this is not a seat for lounging. In fact, the butt space is a on the small side, even my skinny teen found the seat to be a bit wee. I will still use it and be glad to have it, but it feels a bit like you will slide right off if you don't sit up straights.

For the price, this is a pretty good chair.

title: Love this planner
text: Love this planner

title: poor manufacturing, poor customer service
text:
Had to call Bonsaii for a warranty replacement, twice. Both times the guides around the shredding mechanism broke off into several pieces. This unit WILL NOT handle shredding 14 sheets of paper at a time more than a few times without causing damage. The 3rd unit already has cracks in the guides after one day of use.
I would not recommend this unit to anyone, ever.
Replacements took 6 weeks +, both times. And, customer service personnel not very friendly.
Spend more money for a better unit. It will save you time and hassle.

title: Press firmly, both when making the label and when adhering it.
text: I imagine this would get tiring on the hand if used for an extended period of time (like labeling your whole kitchen, or packing for a move), but for labeling things here and there it's perfect. The adhesive isn't the best on all surfaces, needs some clear tape over it sometimes, like on cardboard.

title: Easy to use
text: I love the bright blue color. I love that it is easy to open and close

title: People love these
text: I get so many compliments when I give these out with my books to my fans! They are beautiful!

title: Envied by comic con attendees
text: I bought this to hold my convention badge. I wore it in my photo with William Shatner. While waiting in line, other attendees were envious and wanted to know how to get one.

title: Just what I wanted
text: These labels are the perfect size for writing messages and signing for fans of my books.

title: Pins Push Through
text: Push pins push through to the back due to the thinness of this bulletin board. This may shorten the life of this bulletin board if a lot of items are pinned on since holes are created in the back. I recommend stapling items to the board instead of using pins.

title: A humorous card, with the usual NobleWorks quality.
text:
Likes.
Adorable and humorous cards.
NobleWorks produces high quality cards at reasonable prices.

Cons.
Consider whether you need 12 identical cards. These cards will be most appreciated by dog owners.

We love anything dogs. These are cute cards. This is a single design card, so the only problem is getting 12 of the same. Do you plan to send these cards to 12 different people? When next Christmas rolls around, you may wind up sending the same design to the same people.

NobleWorks produces fine quality cards at reasonable prices.

I do recommend these cards, provided you have a need for 12 identical cards.

title: We buy this every year.
text:
This is a wonderful product for staying organized. Whenever we are making an appointment, we open it to make certain there is no conflict. When we subscribe to limited time promotions, we add the ending date to this book, to make certain we cancel in time. Balance transfers at 0% interest. We add the ending date.

This is indispensable for us.

title: Works with Canon TS 8320
text:
Likes.

The ink product works fine with my Canon TS 8320. My printer recognized it as a genuine Canon cartridge.
My cartridge looks exactly like the photos of cartridges on the page description. I can’t find any name on the cartridges. Only the statement that it is not an OEM product.

Cons.

Does not have photo blue. For some reason, not including photo blue is commonplace.

title: Convenient size.  Can replace the need for an ottoman.
text:
Likes.
Small size.
Allows for rocking motion.
Soft and comfortable.

Dislikes.
None.

Summary.

My inseam is 29 inches.
I have been using sleep wedges as ottomans. Those are bulky and awkward, but they make watching TV much more comfortable. This will replace those much larger wedges, and actually do a better job. My feet have always touched the floor. When I watch TV, I like to rest my feet on a soft cushioned object. This is perfect for that. I don’t like high ottomans., I like to have my legs raised at just a slight angle. This is a great ottoman replacement for those that like to have their legs raised slightly. In contrast, my wife likes her legs as high up as her waist. This would not work for her.

It’s not a rocker by design. It’s simply soft enough that the movement of your feet produce a rocking motion. Toes forward, then heels back. That also makes it an excellent device to place by your desk chair.

The genius of this device is its simplicity. For me, this is an easy 5 star rating.

title: Very good comfort on a hard surfaced chair.
text:
We just purchased a new leather sofa and the seat is on the firm size. I thought this would soften it. Instead, it made sitting on the sofa very uncomfortable and I could feel every indentation. I put a bath towel over it and that didn’t help.

I then placed it on my Aeron look alike chair. It is perfect for that purpose. It provides excellent comfort.

The directions mention placing the cushion with one side up and the other side down. I couldn’t tell the difference between the two sides. You will be sitting directly on the gel coils. It is not encased in a cotton or nylon cover. That may be a problem if you are wearing shorts while using it. Placing a towel over it should solve that problem.

I’m not sure why it didn’t work on my sofa. The cushion is made for hard chair seating, and using it on a sofa changes the body contact area. Possibly, it needs a hard chair like surface to spring back firmly. The sofa, although firm, just had too much give.

It is a good cushion and I can recommend it.

title: Nice cards.
text:
These are nice cards for a wide range of friends and acquaintances. No special sizzle.
I think 4 stars is a fair rating.
They are worth buying.

title: Immediate response from dog owners.
text:
We live in a 42 unit condo and have a small white dog. We sent this to all dog owners.
They all loved it.
The card brought holiday cheer to everyone receiving it.

title: Cat owners loved this card.
text:
We live in a 42 unit condo and sent these to everyone that had cats.
The response was immediate.
Highly recommend.

title: Recognized immediately by Canon TS 8320.
text:
Likes.
Recognized immediately by Canon printer. “Genuine canon cartridge.”
Both the extra large black and small black were included. Most cartridge packs do not include the extra large black.
Very good print quality.

Dislikes.
None.

Will be my first choice next time I need new cartridges.

title: Perfect for high school or college graduate.
text:
The message inside the card is absolutely perfect and conveys a true sense of accomplishment.

The front of the card is wonderfully designed with the word Congrats and larger individual letters below hanging in a banner format. Beautifully done.

Our 47 year old son, who has had a fine career, decided he wanted a college degree. He has a hectic work schedule, requiring significant travel and long hours. Without telling us, he has been taking courses at Bowling Green University, and just informed us that he will be graduating in August. The message in this card is perfect to show how proud we are of his accomplishment.

title: Recognized by my Canon TS 8320.
text: When my printer started printing blank pages, I went to my newly received ink cartridge package and realized that my multi cartridge packages didn’t include the large size blank ink.  I ordered these and the cartridge was immediately recognized by my canon printer as “genuine Canon cartridge inserted.”

title: A very useful set.  A great supplement to a larger file system.
text:
We’ve have two rolling file folder containers, each stuffed with quite a few standard size folders. With modern living, and a host of thick instruction booklets, even these are getting overwhelmed. It’s easy to lose track of important information. Papers get put back in the wrong folders.

I am using one of these folders for all bank information. Credit card mail, bank offers for bonus points, balance transfer offers, critical information that I want to be able to locate quickly.

A second is being used for restaurant offers, including gift cards we purchased. It’s easy to forget about good offers and have them expire. The back section is used for active warranty information.

My wife is on the condo board and she uses the third folder to keep track of all condo matters.

title: The best card ever for dog lovers.
text:
Truth is stranger than fiction, and as every dog owner knows, this card is so descriptive of a dogs behavior.
Kudos to whomever came up with card.
I am keeping this card in pristine condition, and displaying it on my mantle.

Hallmark. Please sell these in a multipack.
I will be ordering more of these.
This card actually made me go to the Amazon Hallmark store to see what else was available.

title: Canon printer read these as genuine Canon cartridges.  No PB cartridge.
text:
I have a Canon TS8320.
The cartridges were immediately recognized and the pages printed perfectly.
My PB cartridge is also low, and there was no PB cartridge in the box.
Apparently, not all printers have a PB slot.
After checking, it's not uncommon for PB cartridges to be omitted. The PB, Photo Blue, is for photo printing.
That can be purchased separately for about $ 10.
It is also included in some Amazon listed cartridge packs.
If you do print photos, have one on hand in case you need it

title: We purchase this one every year.
text:
My wife purchases this every year. The size is perfect for keeping organized with a quick glance.
My wife is very organized and this is the best organizer/ planner she has ever used.

title: Fits my Canon TS 8320.
text:
Fits my printer and the printing comes out fine.
These are marked XXL and should last longer than the cartridges that came with my printer.
I have been using generic refills sold by Amazon for years, and have never had a problem.

Of minor note. The cartridges come in a professional looking box, rather than the plain white boxes that I have received in the past. To me, that shows the manufacturer or seller takes some extra pride in their product and is willing to sacrifice some profit in order to provide customers a professionally packaged product.

title: Excellent print quality. Some frustration with setup.
text:
Frustration with setup. I have Apple OS and IOS devices.

I finally found a good setup video on You Tube. A Canon made set up video. Once I finally connected my IPhone, all my other devices were automatically connected. Two I Phones, two macs, three IPads. I used the easy connect method option. Remember to add the printer to each device.

This replaced my older MG 6000 series Canon printer so the increased speed was very noticeable.

Print quality is excellent.

I have had a number of Canon printers, and have had initial set up problems with each one. After the initial set up, no problems.

There is a separate slide out tray with a CD slot. During my initial attempts to connect, I inserted the CD thinking it may automatically set up the printer. It had no effect. I removed it and filed it with my instruction book.

Overall. A nice printer. The red color spruces up the room.

title: Perfect for my Canon MG 6821.
text:
Perfect for my Canon MG 6821.
No quality issues. Great price.

title: This is an hourly planner.  It is in 15 minute increments.  It is not a monthly planner.
text:
We buy At A Glance Planners every year. It is very important to point out this is more of a daily planner. Our other At A Glance purchases have been monthly planners. For our purpose, as retirees, we get the most benefit from monthly planners. We can see the entire month’s appointments at a glance.

This does not have a monthly section, that allows a quick glance of a month’s activities.

It is more of a very detailed daily planner, which is great for a small business person, that needs a detailed hourly schedule. I’m up on the latest technology, yet have always preferred written planners.

You can view a week’s schedule by fully opening it, and viewing the two pages that cover the week, without turning a page.
The day’s activities are shown in 15 minute increments, from 7 AM to 8:45 PM, Monday through Friday. Saturday stops at 5:30 PM. Sunday does not have filled in times. It has a dozen blank lines.

I think this would be perfect for a small business owner that needs to keep track of a busy schedule. A hair dresser, dog groomer, dog walker, or someone having a very busy social life.

The planner has high quality paper, has an attractive well made cover, states numerous holidays, in addition to National Holidays, Daylight Savings Time dates, a section to list phone numbers and names, addresse. I

title: Ergonomically comfortable.  More of a fine point appearance.
text:
Ergonomically perfect for small hands. Very comfortable. Writing quality perfect for a person desiring a fine point style, even though the description reads medium. Given the price and appearance, this pentel would be well suited for a professional.

For the average person, for everyday use, an ordinary gel point would be fine.

Definitely, a cut above and very suitable for Real Estate agents, Accountants, and others desiring a more upscale everyday writing instrument.

title: Excellent overall but with a few flaws.
text:
We get At A Glance planners every year. Good value for the price. This is the first time we have had a two person planner. We are computer driven, yet have stayed with this type of hard copy planner.

It is a large planner. It is an inch thick lying on a table. 3/4 inch compressed.
Too large for most handbags. Okay for a large tote, but heavy.
There is no planner page for Sunday. Four lines, no print.
Saturday is abbreviated, by ending at 6PM. Monday through Friday are 7 AM to 8 PM.
Therefore, if you a planner for Sunday, or outside 7 AM to 8 PM, there may be better alternatives.

This type of planner would be great for a busy two family household, or a small office.

With the layout of both users on the same page, the first user of the day can remind the second user that they have a scheduled event that day. Handy for a less organized second user.

The two user format would also be very useful to keep track of your school age childrens' activities.

The last page of the book shows calendars for 2018, 2019, 2020.

title: A fun pen.  Great for teachers or others needing the occasional red ink.
text:
Much more user friendly than anticipated. Very light in the hand, well balanced and writes very fine, which I prefer.
A fun pen to use, even though that doesn't seem possible. Refills are very easy to change. Impressed with the directions.
However, I can't comment on how much usage each refill will provide.

Very easy to switch between colors. Just retract one, and click the other. Erasers work fine in erasing the ink.

Great for a teacher that uses red ink.

title: Desktop calendar visibility, in a compact easily transportable form.
text: Love it.  It mirrors our large desktop type calendar.  Plenty of writing space for each day.  Since it is in book form, it is easier to fit in a desk drawer.  Very light weight, easily transportable.  All purpose, not just for academic years.

title: Easy to stay organized with this 5 Star book.
text:
I received two appointment books from Amazon as part of the Vine program. This At a Glance, and the Emily Ley book. Both are excellent. I gave each well deserved 5 stars. Each has advantages. This book is very manageable, and travels well. It is very businesslike, and is laid out in a manner that makes it easy to stay organized. It fits nicely, out of the way, in a desk draw. In comparison, the Emily Ley book is a great gift, very attractive on a desk, and decidedly thicker. It would not be my choice for traveling.

The At a Glance is light and great for anyone with a mobile schedule. Overall, accessibility very good.

The “At a Glance,” name really fits this item.

We are very experienced computer users, yet there is something comforting about having these type of hard copy books, with your immediately available history.

You can easily find your appointments at a Glance.

Our daughter travels constantly, and this is perfect for anyone that travels on business.

If you’ve never had this type of book, I would highly recommend giving it a try. Having that 12 month history can come in so handy.

title: Impressive looking. For signing documents. Not as utilitarian as less expensive gel pens.
text:
Looks very attractive. Impressive looking for signing documents.

However:

1. The instructions are microscopic in size. You can guess what It's saying, or use a magnifier to read the instructions. I have outstanding vision, 20/10, and the print was ridiculously tiny, even for me. Inexcusable for a pen of this price. Total disregard for the consumer.

2. This pen is best for larger hands. My wife is petite, with small hands, and found it unbalanced. It threw off her penmanship.

3. The nib is described as fine point. To me it is a medium point, best suited for signing documents. The fine point gel pens have a much finer line than this fountain pen nib. Would not use this as my everyday pen.

title: From Apple Mac to printer. 5 stars.  From IPad tablets and IPhones 0 stars.
text:
If you plan to print from IPads or IPhones, please read reviews for the app in ITunes. You must use this app to print from mobile devices. Good luck.

Printer hardware seems to be good quality. Easy setup as far as filling ink tanks. Getting printer ready.

I am a long time Canon user. This replaced an inexpensive Canon 6820 that printed perfectly from all my devices. Easy to set up.
That inexpensive printer had a screen. This does not.

Angry at wasting hours trying to print from IPad Pro and IPhones. Easy setup on my IMac and MacAir. Downloaded setup directly from Canon for those devices.

Not easy for tablets and IPhones. Had to go to ITunes to download setup app. Followed directions. Found Canon IJ on my network settings. Software told me I was connected on my OSI devices. Told me I was registered. Printer found. Etc. Tried to print emails. No printer found.
Went into the app. I can print photos using the app. I can print a few existing documents. Just a few. No way to print emails.
Went to settings. Went to print to check access. Said printer had access to photos. Did print photos. So I have access to print photos and some docs, but printer can't be found when I try to print emails. That seems crazy to me.

I'll keep trying. I do recommend it for IMacs and Mac Air. As of now, I can't recommend it for tablet and IPhone use. I think it needs a better ITunes App.

title: Very convenient.  Good alternative to a heavy duty dispenser.
text: Very convenient to use.  I do have a heavy duty dispenser that uses a heavier, more professional type tape.  I usually use that on large cartons shipped via UPS.  I purchased this for the convenience.  Good cutting edge on the dispenser.  Works where many tapes fail.

title: Economical way to go.  Work perfectly.

title: Safety for toddlers and pets.

title: Seems expensive, but does the job.  Functional enough for 5 stars.

We replaced our hand towels with these, and this really reduced the washing load.  Seems expensive for this type of item.  We use it on the counter and is sturdy enough for counter use.

title: Great bookmark feature.  Excellent for detailed notes.
text: This is a good item, used in conjunction with a separate monthly calendar.  Any monthly calendar will do.  We use a monthly calendar to make quick notes on appointments.  Easy to see all your appointments at a glance.  We then use this planner to make detailed notes such as phone numbers, extra information. Great bookmark feature.  We order this item every year.

title: Five Stars

title: Excellent design, works like magic
text: I swear it's magic how well this thing holds onto my desk with just suction.  It slides around left and right very easily, but holds on tight when you pull a piece of tape up.  Slide it to the edge of the desk and it comes right off with zero effort.  Very, very well designed.

title: Clips are very hard to use
text: Frustratingly hard to get these clips into place, rips the pages if you let it slip.  Once I figured out the way to get it to work, I've been able to get it right consistently. The 10th time you do it, it will be fine.  The first time, it will be very difficult.

title: Gets the job done. Not even close to actually liking this printer though.
text:
This printer was a good value for everything it peovides.

Overall I am not satisfied with many of the features. Many people who try to connect with the laptop have a hard time installing drivers

It is 20% of the price of OEM ink so im really happy about the cheap prices.

Save yourself the hassle and money.

title: Excellent buy. Really happy about these misprint pens.

This is a great box of quality pens. No one at work cares what’s on a pen and it’s significantly cheaper than buying regular pens.

High quality. I haven’t found one that doesn’t work yet. Way better than the BIC eco pen.

This stuff is the real deal. Tough and let’s you wrap what you need.

Don’t forget to buy a handle/ dispenser for it so you can move quickly.

title: Flexible but Strong and Chair Rolls Easily!
text:
We've gone through a lot of chair mats in the past few years. This time we are trying a new brand and this one seemed to be a better bet. I find this mat is flexible but strong and the office chair rolls easily across it. So far it hasn't cracked or shown any wear. Will see!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Beautiful Nature Scenes - Work Well as Thank You Cards or for Notes to Friends and Family!
text:
The nature scenes on these cards are beautiful. The only thing is these do not arrive in a box, they are just the cards with envelopes in plastic wrapping. So if you just open the top you can slide out the cards one by one for use as thank you cards or to write notes to friends and family. I'm looking forward to using these in the new year to thank a few people who have helped me in life. There are no messages inside the cards so you can adapt them as you need. When getting a card in the mail is so rare these days, you are definitely going to make a good impression with a beautiful card.

~The Rebecca Review

title: >^..^< Encouragement for Trying Times - Cute Kittens Speak From Their Hearts! >^..^<
text:
This is an adorable pack of cards that will fill you with delight each time you see the cute kittens who speak from their hearts to help you overcome anxiety, worry and stress. Sometimes it is enough to be reminded that everything will be OK!

For example, one card says: "You are amazing!" And on the back are instructions to take a break and breathe differently to inspire confidence and trust. These are skills for dealing with anxiety.

Some of the messages include:

You will survive this.
The feeling will pass.
You are stronger than you think.
You can handle it.

One card says on the back: "Let it go. Write down 3 things you can control and 3 things you can't. Focus your efforts on what's in your power."

Most of these cards are about positive thinking.

The only thing I'd say is the card that says: "Trust your heart" - well that is mostly a good idea, but run any decision past your mind too because sometimes the heart wants things that are not always good for the future. I learned this lesson the hard way many times. Doing what I love on the other hand, has brought me success.

So use this pack of cards to make yourself feel better. >^..^< I'm keeping these on my bedside table for viewing the cards when I need a little encouragement in trying times.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Very Funny Christmas Card with Cute Message Inside!
text:
When I first saw this Christmas card I had a good laugh. Then I thought I better get some before they are all gone! Each year I try to send out a funny Christmas card because so many people send serious ones I figure I can be a little different.

These cards are a good quality and the envelopes are nice and sturdy too. The cards arrive in a plastic box container so they survive in the mail and don't get damaged.

The inside message reads: "May Your Christmas Be Unforgettable." Just cute!

I'm happy I have these early as I can get all the cards ready before December! Now all I have to worry about is stamps and thinking about what to say in a holiday letter!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Arrived in Purrfect Condition - The Most Adorable Kittens Ever!
text:
Each month of this calendar has a different kitten, well in November there are two sleeping kittens. The spaces to write appointments are perfect and just the right size. This arrives with a gazillion stickers like ones that say shopping, haircut, vacation, gym, flight, date, dentist, brunch, party, doctor, class, exam, payday, restaurant, celebration and birthday. So a good selection.

This also has all the main holidays and religious days listed on the right days. The colors on the calendar also match the colors in the photos of the kittens. With this calendar you can look forward to smiling each time you see the cute kittens. They do definitely have an awwww factor.

One thing you may appreciate is this calendar has a piece of cardboard in the middle of it to keep it from getting damaged on its way to you. Nice!

~The Rebecca Review

title: An Elegant Card for Friends or Family!
text:
I put this card in a box along with cookies, a book and a bag of coffee beans for one of my best friend's birthdays. Since he is quite the renaissance man I thought he would enjoy this card. It is a very elegant card that you may enjoy giving to friends or family. Hopefully he will like it along with the gifts.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Handy To Have on Hand!
text:
Post-it Pop Up Notes are fun to have on hand for many reasons. Maybe you want to bookmark a recipe page or write a note to yourself about needing to pick up a prescription. Either way these stick to paper, mirrors, doors, wooden cabinets...just about anything you can think of. So if you need a reminder these are great to have on hand for all reasons.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Envelopes are Long Gone!
text:
These envelopes are long gone but I seem to remember they were great and you could not see through them so perfect when sending checks in the mail. They seal well and work as designed. Nice!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Helps Remind You Of Important Things - To Do or to Remember!
text:
I've long been a fan of Avery Sticky Notes and keep stocked up on them because I need to write down important things like doctor's appointments or a phone number I want to remember and keep in my medicine cabinet. These stick to anything really and are good for putting up on a mirror or inside a wood cabinet. Stick one anywhere you'll see it to be reminded of whatever you need to get done. I even have one on my mirror in the bathroom permanently to remind me of certain beauty routines.

~The Rebecca Review

title: A Very Large Roll of Bubble Wrap!
text:
This bubble wrap comes in a very large roll and is very sturdy and protective. Just try snapping one of the bubbles with your fingers. It is a challenge! I'd say this is high-quality bubble wrap. If we ever move, I'm wrapping my china cat cups and dinner plates in this stuff!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Easily Fits a Sheet of Paper!
text:
While these are a half inch smaller lengthwise and wide than they used to be when I first got them, they still work for a full size sheet of paper. I like that these seal easily and are easy to open again. This works great if you are filing away documents and need to access them again. For putting through the mail I'd suggest sealing with packaging tape. These arrive in a nice sturdy box so they remain undamaged while storing them. I'm happy with these and find them useful.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Good Quality Highlighters!
text:
These work well if you want to highlight important points in books you are reading so you don't have to read the whole book again! This works well when studying too. Whether the yellow color bleeds through pages or not depends on the quality and thickness of the paper! I have noticed that using these on dried ink is also fine - no smearing. The pens themselves are easy to hold and highlight very well. You can underline with the tip or fully cover the text depending on how you hold the pen. I'm happy with these and am glad I have a whole box because lately I highlight a lot of books!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Arrived in Perfect Condition - Bright White Paper - Prints Out Great Clear Text!
text:
I've been buying this brand of paper for a few years now and I'm always impressed that it arrives in perfect condition and is a bright white paper that my printer loves. The text prints out clearly and any color of ink looks great. The paper itself is a good quality and perfect for printing off recipes or documents I type up. So happy with this paper and will get it again in the future.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Absolutely Precious and Adorable Cards for Valentine's Day!
text:
If you are looking for the most precious and adorable cards to give this Valentine's Day you can't go wrong with these. I won't be mailing these individually but am thinking about sending a card with cookies, so these cards will go in a box of treats! Two of the cards could be given to friends, but one is a cupid and says "Be Mine Valentine." One has hearts on it that say kiss me, be mine, you and me and hugs. The other cards say:

"Have a Sweet Day"
"Wishing You All The Happiness Your Heart Can Hold!"

and

"Happy Valentine's Day"

These have the charm of homemade cards without all the work! I love them and I know they are going to make the recipients smile. :) I think I'm going to make double chocolate cookies!

~The Rebecca Review

title: High Quality Paper Mailer with Padding In Between the Paper!
text:
If you enjoy sending things in the mail and like padded mailers then these will make you very happy. They are made of high quality brown paper and what feels like some sort of advanced padding in between the paper.

You can fit a book or an item of clothing or maybe even a few bars of chocolate into the bags! The 11 x 13.9 size is generous. You could also fit documents that are 8 1/2 x 11 in these envelopes.

I'm happy with them and will definitely look for more when they run out. I love that they are self-sealing so you don't have to worry about packaging tape! Perfect!!!

~The Rebecca Review

P.S. My cat Fuzz did me the favor of totally ripping up one of these paper mailers so now I know what is inside the padded portion. It is paper cut in a zig zag shape. Very interesting. Thanks Fuzz!

title: Perfectly Cute Holiday Cards!
text:
When I saw this cute set of cards I just had to have them. They looked perfect for the holidays. Hardly anyone in my life sends out Christmas cards so I still do just because I feel it is nice to have a bunch of cards each year. It is part of my holiday decorating to have cards up.

These cards are a fairly good quality, not as glossy as pictured. But the printing is fine and the cards fold easily to go in the envelopes. Sure it is not Hallmark quality but do most people even keep their Christmas cards from year to year? It is more the immediate thought that counts.

I'm happy with these cards and I think they are a good deal for 25! I think everyone I send them to will enjoy the playful mood and I do think these cards are sort of humorous. We all need a good laugh after making it through 2021 and 2020!

And one hint about keeping the cards closed. Just run your fingernails along the edge of the fold and it will be much easier to keep folded.

~The Rebecca Review

title: High-Quality Envelopes with Great Seal and Satiny Finish
text:
These envelopes arrive in a nice strong box and are high-quality with a great seal closure and a satiny finish. They are easy to write on so you can address them without a problem. I closed up an envelope with a recipe folded up inside and held it up to the light. I could not see through it or see any text on the paper inside. The inside of the envelope has a printed pattern on it for security purposes. I'm happy with these envelopes and love the box they are in which will last a long time. I sealed up an envelope and checked it the next day - it was still securely stuck shut and trying to open it back up would have torn up the envelope.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Works in the Expression Home Epson Printer
text:
After a few months my printer finally ran out of black ink so I was happy I had a replacement cartridge in this set. It was easy to install just by following the instructions on the tiny screen. I was ready to print again in about five minutes. I will always get these because they work!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Work Well for Grocery Lists
text:
These index cards are the same quality as ones I've found before. I don't need super thick cards as I'm using them basically for making grocery lists in the kitchen. You could also use these for memorizing verses or quotes. Using a regular pen on them seems fine. They may have improved these since they first started making them. They are definitely thicker than a piece of regular printer paper and hold up well. I would however not say they are as thick as a postcard. I think putting them in an envelope would be advised if you are sending these through the mail.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Beautiful Vivid Colors!
text:
This is the second mouse pad I've bought with this design in ten years. I loved my first one but it was getting a little worn around the edges. This second one is even more vivid and the colors are stunning. The mouse pad itself is very sturdy and the top doesn't peel off like some do. I look forward to many years of use. Beautiful!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Great for Vision Boards!
text:
If you don't want to use glue to make a vision board, this double sided tape works very well to attach your pictures and words. So far so good! Everything is staying attached on my vision board. So now I'm inspired and don't have to worry about pictures and words falling off the board. You can also use this tape for scrapbooking and art projects.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Works Well for Taking Notes and Photographing Them
text:
Rocketbook's reusable notebook is handy for taking notes and photographing them with your phone to send either to yourself or someone who needs to read what you wrote. This saves a lot of typing and the whole system works with an App you simply download per the instructions. The book pages are reusable because you can wipe off the ink with a damp cloth. This comes with a pen and cloth. So if you like writing notes instead of typing them this may be useful to you.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Works Well in Cross Pens
text:
My husband has a few really fancy Cross pens that needed a good refill. These seemed so reasonable and when they arrived they worked well and fit his pens perfectly. I like that these come with little tips on them to prevent any leakage of the ink. The refills write beautifully and we could not be happier.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Cute Cat Cards Even Dog Lovers Will Enjoy!
text:
If you are a cat person and you want to send out a funny card these can't be beat. They are high-quality cards that come boxed in a nice plastic container so they are protected during shipping. Nothing worse than ordering cards that get ruined in the mail! These arrived in perfect condition so this company knows what they are doing.

My husband took a few of these cards to send to his friends and they loved them and they are dog people. Only about four people I know actually still send cards out at Christmas but never the less we got out 24.

I was sick so nearly didn't get the chance to send these out this year. But with a little motivation and the holiday getting closer I mustered the energy and got them out. Very happy with this purchase and will look for more cat cards next year.

I did find a new way of closing the envelopes. You can moisten a dishcloth with a little water and that way you don't have to lick the envelopes! Just use the dishcloth to wipe a little water on the sticky part - then close.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Adorable! Need I say more?
text:
You will adore this precious 16-month calendar which shows kittens at their absolute cutest moments. You will laugh and smile all year long looking at these photos that were obviously very carefully created.

I find this calendar useful to keep track of doctor's appointments and birthdays mostly. But I also like knowing what day it is and with staying home so much it is easy to loose track of the days, months, years! After 50 it all goes so quickly trust me.

The stickers that arrive with this calendar are really colorful and alert you to important days, appointments and game days. But it might be wishful thinking to get a haircut! I hope I get more than one haircut in 2021 or else I'm going to have the longest hair ever in my lifetime. Sorry I got sidetracked!

So I think you will absolutely love this calendar and I'm laughing and smiling already. I just think kittens are the cutest. They make my heart purr!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Looks Very Professional!

title: Super Fun To Use and Easy to Operate
text:
When I saw a picture of this laminator I thought it looked really cute. I especially thought the pink color was very attractive. When it arrived it was all in one box and included the laminator, ruler with paper cutter, corner rounder and 20 small A6 laminating pouches.

As soon as I plugged the laminating machine in I had five minutes until it heated up. So I looked through my photographs that my mother had just given me and decided which ones to laminate. I also found a business card, a postcard and a Chinese fortune cookie fortune.

The whole process of laminating (including heating up the machine) these items took about ten minutes from start to finish. The laminator has rollers in it which slowly and precisely move the item in the laminator pouch through the front of the machine to the back of the machine, where you can easily take it out. The item laminated will stop moving once the rollers have moved it to the back of the machine. I was impressed with the technology that worked so smoothly.

When you get the machine, read the easy-to-understand instructions. Decide if you are going to use hot or cold laminating pouches. This will determine the switch you use to choose hot or cold. The laminating pouches that are included with the machine are for hot laminating. If you use cold laminating pouches you won't have to heat up the machine.

What I loved was that this machine has a green light that tells you when the laminating machine has heated up so you don't need a timer. Also make sure you place the machine on a hard surface like a table or a desk, not a bed or other soft surface as air needs to circulate.

One thing the instructions tell you to do is to insert the closed end of the pouches into the machine. That is exactly what I did and was happy with the results.

The paper trimmer included with the machine makes the edges sharp and so you can use the rounded cutter to smooth the edges into a nice rounded corner. It works a bit like a stapler. You open it up, put the corner in, then press down like a stapler. The little corner cuts off and goes into a compartment underneath the cutter for disposal later. Very convenient.

I'm very happy with this laminator and thought it was super fun and easy to operate. A few days after I used the laminator I ordered the 80 letter size (9 x 11 1/2) laminating pouches and laminated a few of my frequently used 8 1/2 x 11 recipes. Laminating my recipes will save me money in the long run so I don't have to keep printing out full page recipes! The laminating pouches are completely clear when heated! I can easily read my recipes.

~The Rebecca Review

text: Hard to rate this set of nibs. I purchased the 3 pack of EF nibs. The nibs looked okay, looked all similar, size #6 is good, it's what I ordered. The problem was that it's supposed to be an EF. I put the nib on a good pen, good ink, and it was smooth, (not as good as some) but but no scratchiness. The issue is that it wrote like a medium, large and wet. The writing on the nib shows the EF stamp, but definitely not a fine line even. I switched and tried a different EF nib in the pack, it too wrote like a medium. I switched out inks, still wrote like a medium. Very disappointed but after some adjustments to tighten it up, now it writes more as a fine, not great but tolerable. This was was like a fine-medium from Taiwan (like a medium TWSBI), rather than a Japanese/German or even a fine Chinese nib. Their factory needs to adjust these better. If you can adjust them yourself then they might be good for you.

title: Very Interesting
text:
I have a large collection of fountain pens, from low to luxury priced pens. This pen is the Hongdian 920 rose gold. I thought it looked lovely and appeared to be a little more slender which I always lean towards, so thought I would give it a chance. Very glad I did.
I have a medium sized ladies hand, I write with a fountain pen daily, I need one that is more slender and more comfortable for long writing times, that wasn't fat and clunky, this fit that bill.
Everything was packaged good, glaze looks good no flaws, nib looks good. I inked it up and this pen writes beautifully from the start. (I do use a little soapy water on the nib, rinse, dry, first to get off any manufacturers oils before inking up.) A good ink is a must, I use Pilot Iroshizuku bottled inks.
I can write smoothly on plain notebook paper with this fine nib and no bleeding, this nib is buttery smooth.. The nib is probably a #5. This brand Hongdian has replacement nibs (set of 3) you can purchase to have on hand, so I did. (The nibs fit quite a few different model pens of theirs, so worth the purchase).
I am really surprised how smooth this nib is and what a great writer, better than some of my higher end nibs.
I did go and purchase their Hongdian 517D model in an Extra Fine, and it's a great writer too but it is very extra fine, maybe a little too extra fine for my taste, but the nibs I purchased will work on both models so...
This brand may not be a higher end pen with a resale value, but it is well made, a great writer and I would have no problems purchasing more of their pens.

title: Great Writer, Nib Is Good
text:
I am never confident buying a fountain pen on Amazon, you never know what you'll get. I did receive the Pilot Prera, fine just like I ordered. The pen is lightweight as expected, posts well no issues. I really have no complaints, it's a good writer. I had no scratchiness with this nib, cleaned it and it started right up. I believe it's legit, or it's a good writing fake if it is. Everything seems to be the real deal, so glad I purchased this here, some fountain pen stores are over charging for this pen.

The tip for those who don't know, whenever you get a new pen, use a little dish soap and water in the palm of your hand, roll the nib of the pen in the soapy water, rinse and dry well. Often manufacturers have oils left on nibs, so I always clean mine first. Then ink up, (always use a good quality ink, it absolutely makes a big difference, I like the Pilot Iroshizuku bottled inks), blot with soft rag until you get it going, and try it on different papers.
I had no issues with this pen but if you ever have a scratchy nib, try writing a bit with it first, good ink, different papers, sometimes it will become smoother and work itself out. If it still gives you issues, try doing some figure 8's on a brown paper bag, that might be all that's needed to help it. Too much on the nib and your fine turns into a permanent medium, so less is more.

title: This Is The Second One I Purchased
text: I first had purchased a Picasso 916 in the green and chrome, and now the black with red. The first green pen, has a slick chrome area where you hold your fingers to write, was too slick and annoying, so put some washi tape on it for grip. The nib on the green looks more like a hidden nib, the black regular. After I used the green for a while I came back to buy the black and red, with the regular nib, because this really is a good pen. I purchased the EF and I can write on plain notebook paper without heavy bleeding. The black is smaller in size than the green and looks to be possibly a #4 or #5 regular nib, not hidden. The black and red is about 5 3/4" long, posted it's 6". The green is a little shorter in length and posting. No matter which Picasso 916 you get, they are both nice to write with.

title: Quite Long, But Great For Sketching
text: I own quite a few fountain pens, and thought I would try one with a bent nib. Glad I picked a Sailor. It's really a great writing pen too, depending on your angle, fine lines, or wide. This is not a flexible nib for calligraphy style writing, but really great for drawing in ink. You may have to get used to the length, it's long, the longest I own, but it's light weight and the nib is smooth. A tip for those unfamiliar with new fountain pens, before you ink them/put a cartridge in, wet your hand with a little dish soap and wipe over the nib, then rinse clean and dry before inking. Some brands coat their nibs, so you need to wash them off before using. Also store them horizontally and they won't be prone to leaking or have hard starts.

title: This Is My Third Rocketbook
text:
I have 2 other Rocketbooks and have had them a while. An executive size with tasks, dot paper etc..., blank pages for drawing, or tasks. I still use paper occasionally, but it's nice to not waste so much paper. I don't have to have scratch paper or legal pads on my desk, no notebook paper to deal with. And these are so slender, I can slide the notebook between folders, even the smaller ones fit in my portfolio case. You write, leave it for a couple weeks if needed, or scan right away then use a small amount of water (I use a water pen brush to quickly wipe as needed), comes with a cloth, tissue works in a pinch too, clean and done. I also purchased extra Frixion pens with colors, but the black writes nicely too, haven't tried the markers, might be cool for art.
I've left the ink on the pages for a couple of weeks, no ghosting. I think less than 30 days is recommended. You can customize your destinations on where you want it to scan too, GDrive, OneDrive, Email, combine them into pdf's, or save as a jpg. It's really cool to also have the option to send it to multiple places at once if you need to, you just swipe a line through the a bottom icon and when you scan it, it tells it where to send it. I hope the company makes more pens to work with these notebooks, like brush pens for calligraphy would be cool.

title: Great On My Fridge

Like some of the dry erase boards, you need to prime it. Make sure you wipe it with a little soapy water rag first, wipe clean with water and dry, nothing scratchy. title: Love this Very Happy
text: I love this printer! At first it gives you the option to download the setup files from Canon directly or you can just use the CD. First I set it up using my own USB direct cord. No problems. You want to setup the wireless, forget the CD and setup and do it directly from the little window on the printer, way easier! Just do it choosing (LAN Wireless) from the little window on the printer and follow the steps. I then put in MY routers password and done! So much easier than the CD or the download, as these gave me trouble. (It couldn't find my routers security key obviously because it never asked for it). When I very first set it up the printer to a while to get adjusted making some adjustment noises for a bit. Once it was set up it printed no problem and pretty quick. Prints way faster than expected on basic black. I am very happy and very impressed with the ink quality. I have always used HP printers and the ink on big print jobs always looked too saturated. This Canon prints very cleanly. It has a PG Black which is used when you choose text/plain paper printing. Then the colors, plus another black and a grey for colored and black and white photos. The trays on the bottom=2. They pull straight out, put paper on easy slide back in. The other has a space to put an actual CD/DVD to print directly on it (instead of a sticky printed label). Very cool. I purchased one in the Gold, the pictures look like intense gold, mine is more champagne gold in person which I am happy with. I don't how this poor guy is getting bad reviews? I bought mine direct from Canon.

text:

It is not a heavy pen which I thought might be good for everyday and it is. Great for daily writing, note taking etc.. The company is based in China I believe, not well known and pens are inexpensive, but these nibs are Fantastic! You can order additional nibs and switch them out very easily. Some of the other Fission Nemosine pens are heavier but they are all great. I usually use a Private Reserve ink and it does not clog or dry out. The Standard International converter is good, and the Standard international cartridges (that come with Nemosine pens) have really good ink in them, not sure what they use, but no feathering. All their pens are interchangeable nibs, and interchangeable with the Jinhao X450, X750 and Goulet#6 nibs.

It's still a great desk it would just be nice to have a little more room. 2) there is a raised edge around the keyboard tray. Not a problem when standing but when used in the sitting position it rubs on my wrists. Not rough or sharp - just a little annoying pressure. To avoid this I usually pull my keyboard and mouse off when sitting and put it on my regular desk.

Overall this is a great desk. I love the infinite locking system and how sturdy it is. I have two monitors and it is very stable regardless of how high it is set. Also I was pleasantly surprised with how big the upper platform is. Plenty of room for both monitors plus mug, planner, etc. which is very helpful when in the standing position. text: The pencils are all buttery and I love to draw with them. I'm doing birds right now. There is no comparrison to the other kits of colored pencils I have. I originally got smaller prisms sets - the 12 color, then the 36 and the skin tone, but they didn't have a grey in them and only a few blues. This set is everything and I don't want to be without it again. I'l have to keep ordering it as my pencils get used down. Thank you Amazon for the quick delivery. I am very happy with this. I've sharpened over 100 of this 150 set and no breakage. It is August in the Pacific Northwest and wax pencils do much better sharpening in warmer areas because the was melts together. If you have an issue sharpening, do not wear your pencil down. Stop immediately and place the pencils in warm water for at least 15 mins so the wax inside melts together  as sometimes it doesn't stay all together when they're made. I learned this on Prismas site. Never put them in the microswave, it will melt the wax too much. I didn't have to do any of this with my big set. It's perfect.

I think these are intended for photographs or post cards, and I am sure that they will do that job well, but it is nice to find a storage item that is so versatile. And this pad is exactly what I have needed for my desk where I craft. The colors are neutral and muted and will not interfere with even the smallest detail work. Cleaning it is easy, just a wipe with a damp cloth and a short buff with a dry one and we are back in business.

I can see one of these on a kitchen counter on which my most used small appliances can sit. Again, any food spills, drips or drabs will quickly be wiped away. text:

When I saw these document folders, and their dimensions, I wondered it it was possible that these could work, and they do. They hold all of the oversize embroidered fabric pieces, flat and protected from damage or dust. My camera is not working right now, but I will take some photos to show.

I imagine that they work a charm for documents, but it is nice to know how versatile they are and I am happy that I ordered them!

title: This pad is perfect
text:

This is the best mouse pad I have ever seen and I love it. It holds my mouse, of course, but also provides a much greater space on which to move my mouse, the size of two/three regular mouse pads.

Plus, I can place my keyboard on the other 2/3 of the pad, as well as small pieces from a current project and my phone on a sweet stand I ordered from Amazon. The size of the pad is generous and makes my computer desk space look more organized (I am not so organized) and efficient.

The quality is outstanding. The surface is smooth, the rubber backing is non-slip; I cannot even pull it along my desk surface. No more slowly creeping keyboard. It is bound in the strongest and attractive threads.

I never imagined that I would need, much less want such a large mouse pad working surface and I am glad that I did not accurately read the product description. I am in mouse pad heaven.

title: It Hates Me
text:
I use lots of fountain pens, and I've amassed a collection of daily workhorses from Pilot, TWSBI, and Lamy. I also own a couple of Kaweco Sports, and I've never felt really confident writing with them--leaks, blots, scratchiness, whatever. I went ahead and ordered this Kaweco thinking, "I've just had bad luck before. Everybody else LOVES these pens."
Alas--out of the box and cartridge inserted, this Kaweco did nothing to improve the brand's reputation as instituted by its predecessors. It skips like pogo stick on an ice rink, and I constantly have to stop writing and wait for it to catch up. I've written two pages with it, tenderly put its cap back in place, and have laid it to rest in an old cigar box with Kaweco 1 and Kaweco 2. While this revered brand seems to be a favorite of every other writer in the fountain pen empire, it does not want to work with me.
My future fountain pen dollars will be funneled into my Pilot account, I think. No more Kawecos for me.

I use a printer mostly to produce small photos for a "picture-a-day" journal I keep. I also print lots of non-traditionally-sized prints for cards, scrapbooks, and other projects. Even using HP glossy photo paper, this printer managed to deliver streaked, smudged, and generally fuzzy photos; closely examining the print straight out of the tray showed us that the ink was actually beading up on the surface of the photo paper, leading to that misty, soft-edged look sought after by the Impressionists.
