title: Great for a variety of needs
text: Using these as wedding attendence think you cards. The print and designs are very neutral so they are perfect for everything. Weddings, work, and other special occasions. The inside is blank allowing ample space for your messages. Comes with Hallmark branded envelopes. Envelopes are nice and opaque for if you're sending in the mail.

title: Get organized the easy way!
text: Got this for my office space and it has helped me clear my workspace if papers,folders, and notebooks. These are easily stackable and sturdy enough to hold several college ruled notebooks at a time without showing any signs of bowing.

title: Great for new grads!
text: I use this to hand out resumes at interviews. Ones with 50 so they can keep the folder afterwards. Easy to assemble, makes a clean presentation. Fits standard size resume paper.

title: Great to store all the business cards all in one place.
text: This is great for all of the cards you collect and organize all in one place. I personally use this for couponing since I can easily see all the coupons all in one place. He plastic sleeves are very strong and thick. Cover is real leather. Super soft and buttery, inside includes a pocket to keep pen and sticky notes or receipts.

title: Very cute journal!
text: I love leather journals. This one is very well made since the sides are stitched. The leather is very nice a shiny. The wrap could use a bit of leather conditioner though. Paper is a nice off white color, with a unique hand cut element to it. Would make a very nice gift for Harry Potter fans or the creative types in my opinion. I personally use it to keep photo clips/ inspiration throughout the year.

title: Great small card to attach to presents.
text: This is a small Christmas card,a bit taller than a nail polish bottle. Comes in a pack of 6. The front is decorated with glitter that easily gets everywhere. It's cute though, and out be great for adults and kids. Has a nice big blank space to write. Envelopes has a lick and glue seal.

title: Nice big agenda!
text: I am trying to prepare my next year of chaos since I have tons of events coming up in the next year to save for. This helps me get a nice 30 day preview, as well as weekly planning. Only down side is that it doesn't have pockets so I have to take or staple everything to the page intended. Overall, the quality is nice. I have bought several others in the past years and this is on par, with the exception of pockets. Great for students as well of get organized with due dates. Has saved me in college on several occasions, especially when I was taking more than 5 classes a semester.

title: Super cute! Makes a great gift!
text: I love notebooks and this is just exceptional! I live the leather/handmade vibes I get thrown this. The leather is kinda dry, but I'll be using some leather conditioner on this to make it a bit more supple. The quality over all is very nice. Would easily make a great gift for happy Potter fans or that traveler friend.omes with a pen, bit I had to toss it because the beading was coming off and I was afraid my puppy would swallow them. Overall, very well made, and I highly recommend this as a unique gift!

title: Pretty awesome!
text: These some in a pack of two...and if you're like me..very lucky these come with extra stickers in case you mess up. It was super easy to install, and the stickers are 3m brand. I'll be getting more in the future since I feel all my other doors need them now. Great for hose doors in the house that tend to slam from drafts.

title: My office set up is complete!!!!!!
text: When I walked in after a long day of work...I saw 'The Box'. I got a razor and opened up the box immediately. I was so thrilled to see this mat arriving!! I ran to my office and cleared the floor as my puppy followed me around confused. After some pushing and pulling to adjust the mat juuuuust right. Tada! My office set up is now... complete! After spending thousands on new hardwood flooring, this is exactly what I needed for my new office chair. May not seem like much, but I promised myself that after I graduated from college and moved out of my tiny apartment with 5 other roommates, I'd get myself a spiny chair with wheels. Well, I did it! The plastic is very thick and well made. It is heavy enough to weigh itself down and stay flat. I think I'm in love. With a plastic mat. Yep.

title: Surprisingly strong magnets!
text: This is perfect for the fridge to hold coupons or at you desk at work to hold photos, reminders, and other cards. Comes in a pack of 5 and are surprisingly strong.had a self sticking adhesive on the back for easy placement.

title: Great for long periods of computer work.
text: I do tons of research for work, so I am constantly on my computer. I was scared I was starting to get carpal tunnel since my wrist started to ache and sting by the end of the day. I started using rags as a cushion, but this is much less intrusive. It's soft, squishy, and the height of the cushion is just right. I do wish that the fabric was a bit thicker. Can't tell how long this will last, but for now..this will do just fine.

title: This actually works!
text: I was skeptical about the locking mechanism initially, but after following the directions step by step to my surprise it actually works! The faux leather is nice, the print is a bit grainy, but cute. I wish I had this in college for my grocery list and spending. It locks, so only you will know the combination after you reset the password.it is easy to change the combination whenever you would like, just remember what the combo is because it will be close to impossible to open it otherwise without damaging the notebook itself.

title: Great for casual couponers
text: I got this to organize all of my coupons, reward printouts, and receipts. It sadly does not stay open on it's own, and I highly recommend you don't attach it to your cart's handle because it will flip over. The material is alright, it does not rip or run. I highly advise not to over stuff the bag though since the seams are a bit undersewn. Overall,it is worth it for the price. The bag will pay for itself in just a few shopping trips.

title: Worst notebook ever!!
text: Ugh, I HATE this lab notebook!!! I used it for my lab for chemistry, and within 3 weeks it started falling apart already!! It's a disaster to try to fiddle around with the rings and get your work done at the same time!! Save your money, and buy a different one.

title: Prettier in Person
text: It's actually a lot prettier in person than in the picture. The facets shine a lot more. I'm very happy with it and my mom loved it.

title: Great price!
text: Cheapest price I’ve seen for this calculator! I was unsure if it came with a cover and it does! This will be perfect for my 6th grader.

title: Made great gifts!
text: I was looking for some good quality journals I could personalize using heat transfer vinyl and these worked perfectly! The paper was good quality, and they look a lot more expensive than they were. Perfect addition to the gift bags I was putting together!

title: Great Product for the Price!
text: I was looking for some journals to personalize as gifts and these worked out great! I was able to use heat transfer vinyl on them with my cricut heat press. The paper is thicker than normal notebook paper, and they seem to be very good quality!

title: Monthly is neat!
text:
Great organizer... as a virtual worker I have lots of moving parts throughout a month... having a monthly view is great. This view helps minimize conflicts and double booking on a particular day/week! I’ve tried weekly in the pass and struggled with big picture planning. Now I know my schedule at a glance and the large day boxes provide amp room to document.
I highly recommend this product and will order a 2021 when the time arrives!

title: Versatile
text: It’s very versatile. With so many lanyard styles you won’t have trouble using this. Retractable cord very smooth  Use to Cary a proximity card for each member of the family

title: Perfect for big planners
text: I got this to use as my actual planner not an appointment book. It is perfect for people who need to plan out their whole day, set tasks, goals, and have it all laid out. I love it

title: Great product (markers just ok)
text: Some of the marker colors are just meh and very light, but I love the size of the calendar and it is easy to clean and use!

title: Great product
text: I just had my kitchen remodeled and love the wood cabinets I purchased.  Unfortunately there are a couple of corner cabinet doors that bump into walls and it was quickly apparent that the doors would soon be marred by this.  I couldn't think of any way to prevent this bumping that wouldn't involve putting something unsightly on either the cabinet or the wall.  This product has solved the problem.  The soft material gently cushions the cabinet door so it will not be damaged.  The clear pad is barely noticeable even again my plain painted wall (it would probably be even less noticeable against a patterned wallpaper).  It was easy to put the stopper on, and I discovered that it peeled off without damaging the wall and could be repositioned.

title: Great gift for any traveler
text: This is a great way to commemorate trips to National Parks.

title: Works great
text:
The organizer is study and should hold up to years of use. It holds standard sized rolls, even the larger sized foil rolls (although not the extra wide ones). Pulling out the wrapping material, and cutting it are easier from this than the box.

This has helped to corral the clutter of boxes under my sink. Now instead of digging through various tube sized boxes looking for the foil, plastic wrap etc I just pull out this container and have all of them at hand. The cutters work much better than the ones on the original packaging and it takes up much less room than all the loose boxes did. It is especially handy to just set the whole container on my counter top when I'm wrapping up several items such as after a holiday meal or prepping for a picnic.

title: Sleek and sturdy
text:
The first thing I noticed about these door stops was that they are heavy. These are not like the flimsy springy door stops that I've dealt with in the past, these things are solid. And as odd as it seems to talk about style and quality for something as mundane as door stops it is appropriate with these. These are made of brushed brass, with a sturdy black cap on the end. The design is a simple tapered post that screws into the baseboard. Very basic and unobtrusive so it will not detract from any decorating style.

The stops were easy to install, simply unscrew the base, insert the screw, attach it the baseboard and then screw the stopper end into the base. The whole procedure takes less than five minutes a stopper.

title: Pretty pictures and room for notes
text: This is a nicely made calendar.  The pictures of the national parks are lovely and there is enough room to jot down reminders by each date.

title: Sturdy little notebooks
text:
I like these notebooks. They are a perfect size to take on a trip. The pages are large enough to write down travel info (phone #s, hotel names & addresses, flight info etc), as well as notes, journal entries etc during the trip. The size is handy for using in cramped quarters - like airplane seats and the covers are sturdy enough to keep the pages protected even when stashed in a backpack.

When not traveling I'd use these for jotting down notes during meetings or to leave instructions for a sitter etc.

title: Convenient packing material
text: This packing material is easy to use and does a great job of cushioning fragile items.  It also makes a professional appearance to items sold on E-Bay or Etsy.

title: These work great
text: These are great labels.  They have the names of most commonly (and so not so commonly) used spices and herbs already neatly printed.  The labels are a convenient size to fit on containers that would typically be used to store these seasonings and the labels are easy to apply to these containers.  Best of all, once applied they stay put.

title: Great product
text: These sheets of packing paper are great.  They are a good size, and weight to wrap fragile items for moving r long term storage.  The sheets are large enough to wrap two dinner plates securely and unlike the newspapers (remember when news papers came printed on actual paper?) these do not have newsprint that rubs off on your hands or items.

title: Hardworking and good looking
text:
I really like this item. It is very neat and professional looking as well as being quite practical. The slight texture on the leather (and it really is leather) conceals blemishes and makes it easy to grasp. The workmanship is good (stitching is even, zipper is sturdy, edges neatly finished and the overall design is nothing short of brilliant. The size is appropriate for holding up to a 5 1/2" x 8 1/2" notebook which is an easy to find item. There colorful elastic bands for securing a notebook, loose paper, pencils, pens etc that are strong enough to hold these items while still being loose enough to access them without a struggle. There are slots for holding various credit card sized items, and flaps suitable for storing folded loose papers, boarding passes, tickets, passport etc.

This cover would be a great item to take into a business meeting, or a class or, as I have used it, on a trip. It is small enough to carry in a back pack, tote bag or even a large purse. It fits nicely on an airplane or train tray table and securely contains the necessary documents, id's etc for most needs.

title: Sturdy, well made folders
text: This is a good assortment of brightly colored folders.  The plastic is sturdy enough to stand up to some serious use and the bright colors make it simple to locate the desired folder.  The design is good, the pockets are deep enough to keep the contents in place, the slot for a business card or similarly sized item is a nice touch.

title: Colorful and well made
text: These are very nice clips.  The magnets are strong enough stay up even when holding up several sheets of paper and the clips sturdy enough to keep them secure.  These are going on my next cruise to keep my cabin a bit neater.

title: Comfortable, smooth flowing
text: These are nice looking pens that are quite comfortable to hold.  The gel (ink) flows smoothly leaving a medium thick line that is easy to read.  These pens are definitely a good value for the price.

title: Attractive blank note cards
text: This assortment of one hundred blank note cards and envelopes includes five different designs in shades of blue, lined envelopes and coordinating stickers.  The designs are neutral enough to be appropriate for a variety of occasions.  The paper and workmanship are good quality making these a very good value.

title: Clever Christmas cards
text: These are quality Hallmark cards that have cute designs and sentiments which will appeal to those who have pets.

title: Beautiful well balanced pen
text:
This pen is beautiful and feels great when being used. It is just heavy and thick enough to feel comfortable when writing. The nib is thick enough to provide a nice line but thin enough to be easy to write with. The refillable cartridge is easy to fill, although a slight different mechanism than I have used before. Instead of a slide action this one turns and uses a screw mechanism to draw the ink into the cartridge.

The pen comes in an attractive box which makes for an impressive gift presentation.

title: Excellent magnets and clips
text: These are very well made, the magnets are quite strong, and the clips are a good size and sturdy.  I plan on using these when I take my next cruise to hold things up on my cabin walls and door.

title: Good looking coins
text: These coins are cute little novelty items.  Use them for good luck charms, paperweights or gag gifts.  The coins are attractive, made with good attention to detail.

title: Great little notebooks
text: These notebooks are a handy size.  Large enough for plenty of room for notes but small enough to fit easily into a backpack and sturdy enough to survive in one.  There are different covers for each to make grabbing the right one simple.

title: Pretty stationery
text: This stationery is pretty in a retro sort of way.  The colors, turquoise blue, fuchsia pink, beige and flowers with butterflies/dragonflies designs are attractive and printed on both sides.  The paper is a good weight, heavy enough to go through a printer and the designs do not have an obvious top or bottom which makes running these through a printer easier.  There are twice as many sheets of paper as envelopes, so you can get chatty or do so re-writes with no problems.  The envelopes open on the side which is a bit odd.

title: Nice looking, easy to use phones
text:
These phones were simple to set up, and are comfortable to hold. The volume is good and easily adjustable. I particularly like the verbal announcement feature on the caller ID. The only down side to these phones is that there are so many features available that there is a certain amount of experimentation needed to figure out all of them and learn how to operate them.

This set is well worth the modest price.

title: Excellent storage case
text: This is a great case for storing important documents safely and securely.  It is a wonderful place to keep all sorts of difficult to replace documents like:  passports; car titles; insurance policies; deeds; mortgage documents; leases; marriage certificate; birth certificates; divorce decrees; adoption certificates; professional licenses etc and keep them organized.  There are leaves with variously sized pockets and pouches for storing different documents in an organized manner - no digging through a mass of papers etc to find the item you need.  At the bottom of the bag there is an elastic buckled strap like those found in suitcases, for securing bulkier items like electronics. The case is fire and water resistant and can be locked for added security.  The case is sized so it fits easily in a drawer or file cabinet and since it is soft sided it can be squeezed into place a bit to fit into a tight place.  There is a handle to make this easy to grab and go in case of an emergency or while traveling and a sleeve on the outside for slipping over the handle of a roller suitcase.  This sleeve even contains a discretely zippered pocket.

title: Exactly as advertised
text: This sleeve is exactly as described, a sturdy card protector sized to comfortably hold the COVID vaccination card.  The plastic is substantial enough to hold up well, and yet allows both sides of the card to be clearly visible.  The top of the holder seals tightly to protect the card from damage and keep it secure.  Additionally the top is designed to allow the protector to be securely attached to a lanyard which will expedite showing the card to gain entry to planes, businesses etc.

title: Not quite as described
text:
These are three nice notebooks. The vinyl covers are attractive, have a nice leather feel to them and appear to be sturdy. The pages are lined, similar to a standard notebook size, but on a slightly smaller scale, and complete with a left margin. The pages are perforated so sheets can be cleanly removed. The upper corner is also perforated so the corner can be cleanly and easily removed.

Oddly though there is no storage pocket anywhere on any of the notebooks even though it is clearly stated that there would be. Personally I don't care and don't see that one is particularly needed but the description does state that there would be one. That is the only reason I am deducting a star.

title: Great choice for journal or.travel diary or...
text:
writing story ideas, or taking notes for a class or....well, use your imagination.

The notebooks are attractive, the vinyl has a leather like feel and is comfortably heavy. The 7 1/2 x 10 inch size fits comfortably in a backpack, work bag, carryon etc. The pages are not lined, but are marked with light dots to assist in keeping lines straight. The paper is heavier than notebook paper and so has only minimal bleed through or ghosting on the other side. There is a pocket in the back that contains two small sheets of stencils that would appropriate for decorating a journal or writer's notebook. Additionally there are two attached ribbon book marks as well as an attached elastic band for holding the book open.

Overall these notebooks are a good value for the price.

title: Basic two pocket folders
text: These are basic two pocket folders.  They are the usual size, meant for standard sized (8 1/2" x 11")  papers.  There are two pockets only, no center holder to secure punched notebook paper, just the pockets.  The folders are made of the usual weight heavy paper stock.  All the folders are white and there are 25 folders in the box.

title: Comfortable
text: Side sleepers often have discomfort across their lower backs and knees.  This pillow addresses both issues by comfortably cushioning the knees and easing the tension across the lower back.  The pillow comes with two removable and washable covers.

title: Good choice for casual or beginning artists
text: This is a good selection of colors.  The pencils are comfortable to hold, the leads are heavy enough to not break easily.  The description states these are 'medium soft' but in my opinion these are more medium.  Even so these do cover well without undue effort and the colors are vibrant enough to show up well.  These would make a good choice for a hobbyist artist, coloring books or school projects.  The tin case makes a great place to keep the pencils in between projects.

title: HP came through
text:
My original review of this product was not very complimentary because the printer did not work, try as I might I could not even get through the basic set up. To make matters even more frustrating it arrived just as the shut down began so HP customer service was not able to provide any assistance. When their customer service was once again available HP did come through. After determining that the problem was truly machine and not operator error HP sent out a replacement printer. This one arrived in a few days (keep in mind this was still during lock down so all delivery companies were being run off their feet). The replacement unit worked exactly as described, set up went smoothly and everything has been working according to specs ever since. All copies have been clear, printing happens quickly, with no problems.

There was a small communication problem with getting the nonfunctioning printer returned that took a second call to HP to get resolved but after the proper paperwork was received the unit was collected - all at no charge to us.

title: Excellent pen
text: I have some really nice pens that cost a lot of money.  I also lose things pretty often so I do not like to take my nice pens out of the house.  I have been making do with various cheap pens to keep in my purse or car which means that I am often frustrated by an uncomfortable pen that doesn't work well.  This pen solves that problem for me.  The pen is comfortable to use, and the ink flows easily with no blobs or smudges.  It also is retractable so there is no cap to lose....I lose those a lot.  And at a dollar or so a pen even if I do lose one I am not all that upset.  I'll definitely be carrying one of these in my purse, have another in my car and another in my suitcase ready for postcards.

title: Great pens
text: I really like these pens.  They are comfortable to hold - an issue for me as I get older and have some arthritis in my hands.  The gel ink flows out smoothly and in a thick enough line to be easily read.  Additionally I like that this is a retractable pen rather than one with a cap so I can keep this in my purse without being concerned that the cap will come off and mark up other items.

title: Attractive pen, comfortable to use
text:
This pen is quite good looking and fits comfortably in my hand. It is easy to insert the cartridges, and the pen writes smoothly. Like other fountain pens I have used this one does occasionally stop flowing but a few quick shakes restores the flow. The only complaint that I have is that the cap does not fit on the cap of the pen when in use. This issue makes me reluctant to use the pen anywhere outside of my home for fear of misplacing the cap.

This is an attractive pen and arrives in a sizable box packaged with an instruction book, pen wipe, refill cartridges in both black and blue, and a bottle of ink (also black) and required cartridge. Everything needed to get started writing with a fountain pen. This would make a lovely presentation for a gift.

Writing with a fountain pen is an acquired skill, and like writing in cursive in general, is not a skill that is typically nurtured in schools. Those who choose to make the effort to acquire the skill are often frustrated by the differences in writing with a fountain pen as opposed to writing with a typical ball point. It is, in my opinion, worth the time and effort for the experience of watching your words literally flow from the pen. This set makes the learning curve needed to acquire that skill a bit easier.

title: Beautiful pen
text:
This is a really nice pen. Besides being attractive it has a comfortable heft to it that makes controlling the pen easier. The roller ball glides over the paper smoothly resulting in a medium thick stream of ink. It is easy to change out the ink cartridge.

The pen comes in a sturdy box which makes for an impressive gift presentation.

The only concern I have about this pen is the cost. At approximately $80 this is a whole lot pricier than what I usually spend on writing instruments and enough that I would be upset if I lost it. As a result I will be reserving this pen for at home use only. This would make a very nice gift but in some situations, such as a graduation, I would be concerned that the recipient would not realize the value of the item and be careless with it.

title: Colorful, sturdy folders
text:
These are sturdy, colorful folders that work great for organizing all sorts of papers. There is a three hole punch on one side so that the folders can be kept in a three ring binder while still allowing access to loose papers. This feature, coupled with the near indestructibility of these folders making these a great choice to help organize a students schoolwork papers. Additionally the folders come packaged in an assortment of colors, making it easy to sort items into categories either classes or to sort out household papers as I use them.

These are a great organizational aid, well worth the investment.

title: Handy little item
text: This is exactly what it claims to be - an RFID blocking case for ID and credit cards that can be worn on a cord around your neck (and kept tucked out of sight under clothing.  It is well made and so is unlikely to unexpectedly fail at an inopportune time.  Additionally it has a small strap that snaps closed to secure all the ids, cards etc from slipping out accidentally  (or being slipped out quickly by a thief).  This strap could also be used to secure the case to a loop inside a carryon, backpack, purse etc.

title: Lovely, classic Christmas cards
text:
These are beautiful, classic Christmas cards. The simple Christmas tree embellished with colored 'gems' on the ivory colored heavy card stock is an elegant design. The sentiment on the inside follows the simple elegant tone and wishes the recipient and Merry Christmas. There is room on the inside for a brief handwritten note.

The red envelopes are lined in gold foil which are slightly heavier than many envelopes provided with boxed cards and come with a gold seal. The overall effect is elegant and worth the extra postage these cards require.

title: These are pretty, with a nice sentiment
text: These are attractive cards, festive without being overly Christmasly which makes these a great choice fir those who celebrate the season as a secular, rather than religious, holiday.  The cards are quite pretty, an impressive quality and express a very nice sentiment.

title: Excellent planner
text:
This is a well made planner. The cover is a sturdy flexible vinyl with an attractive white on black design. The calendars have room for writing notes in each days' space. There is a calendar for each month on a 2 page spread and a more detailed weekly calendar with spaces for 13 hours' appointments. Additionally there are pages to list contacts, miscellaneous notes and a year at a glance page as well.

This is thoughtfully designed to organize appointments etc and is sturdy enough to handle extensive use, even a daily commute.

title: Great way to stay on top of things
text:
This is the usual large desk calendar that can be found from many sources. As is usual with this type of product it has large squares for writing notes at the appropriate days - this one has lines in each square to keep things a bit tidier. Along the bottom there is a full year calendar in smaller print. There are two holes at the top of the calendar so it can easily be hung on the wall rather than laid on the desk.

Please be aware that unlike some of this type of calendar this one contains only January through December of 2019, rather than a few months of either 2018 or 2020.

title: Attractive, well made organizer for a reasonable price
text: I like this product.  It was easy to put together, holds a reasonable amount of papers and is stable.  I have not had any problems with the trays sliding too far.

title: Good construction, good design and good price
text:
This is a very well made desk set. The items are heavy enough to stay upright while in use and hold up to normal wear and tear. The design is attractive but understated enough to be nonintrusive.

Overall this is a very good product for a reasonable price.

title: This pen might bring back hand written letters
text:
This is a beautiful pen that is a joy to both look at and use. It fits comfortably in my hand, the ink flows well and the nib is thick enough to make a substantial line but not so thick as to make writing difficult to read. The pen arrives in an attractive box and includes a replacement cartridge and a converter (to use bottle ink) and an instruction booklet.

Even though this pen is rather expensive it would make a wonderful gift, something memorable to mark a special occasion.

title: Attractive and functional
text: This is an attractive looking pen, it writes well over a variety of surfaces. It is a bit on the thick and heavy side, which I happen to prefer. I found the stylus easy to use, and regard the heavy weight to be an advantage. I have trouble operating the keyboard/pads on screens so the stylus feature saves me a lot of frustration. I was quite pleased to see that the pen can be refilled so now all I have to do is not lose it!

title: Good concept - mediocre execution
text:
This is a good idea: combining a place to charge and store a variety of electronic gadgets with a place to keep an assortment of more traditional office necessities such as post-it notes, paperclips etc. Unfortunately it does not follow through in the final design.

This unit is powered through a USB port, so it either needs to be plugged into a computer or a separate wall adapter with USB port needs to be used.

The various charging stations need to have individual cords run through this stand and be secured into the selected by one of the included gaskets.

Some types of connecting cables are too thick to fit in the gaskets

Installing the gasket the way it is intended means that a phone (at least an IPhone) must have its case removed for the charger to fit.

Overall I would recommend just sticking with dedicated chargers plugged into a power strip, and keeping the paper clips and post it notes elsewhere, this is just too much trouble for little convenience.

title: Good choice for the home handy person
text:
This is a very nice, reasonably lightweight staple gun. It takes a variety of staples, fasteners etc that are readily available at the local big box home center. It was easy to load, comfortable to use and was easy to maneuver into tight and awkward locations. The only reason I have awarded four rather than five stars was because it did jam a few times.

I would recommend this for the home handy person but it is not appropriate for prolonged or heavy duty use such as a professional construction work.

title: Huge bubble wrap roll
text: Huge roll with perforation so no need a scissors next to you. Bubbles are not easy to break like. Good value.

title: Gave me extra half of the year for free
text: [[VIDEOID:a79d093cc416c2a2e2aedd2a89b63a78]] I ordered this calendar in July thinking that I was going to lose half of the year. But no, the calendar starts at July 2021 and ends at December 2022! What a great surprise. The paper quality is good. I like to write due date/meetings on a physical calendar for my work and it’s easy to write on. Very sturdy to sit on my desk. Good size as well. Totally recommended.

title: Good cushion. Very helpful for my lowerback (and butt) pain from sitting
text:
I have an office job that requires me to sit all day with a computer. My lower back started to hurt badly. After I started using this cushion, I could tell my lowerback pain has been reduced a little bit (no kidding). Of course a cushion cannot fix everything.

It's not soft if you press it by hand but it's very comfortable to sit in. I wouldn't want it to be softer. Its designed to fit with your body line after awhile, and it actually did feel better after I was sitting on for a couple of days. The back side has tiny plastic dots so the cushion doesn't slide off the chair. There is a zipper in the back edge so you can take off the cover for washing if you need.

Overall, verry happy with my purchase.

title: Good tape for light use. Good with the price
text:
I use it to make a paper product using hard papers, like the ones to make Greetings cards. They stick very well when I first applied. Although I've notice it's loose after a couple of days, I need to press the papers together again to make sure they don't fall apart.
The dispenser works well even though it's plastic.
Overall, I was happy with my purchase as I knew that was the best double side tape could do. I wouldn't recommend it if you want to use it to stick very thich papers together or papers with rough surface.

title: Good product
text: I've been using it for a couples of months now. It does what it's supposed to do. My hand was tired before from being on computer and using the mouse all day. This is actually really helpful. Good quality for the price. Comes in a plastic box. It smells funny a little bit for the first week then it goes away. No color shed.

title: it helps
text: This little cushion does help with back issues. It isn't a miracle cure, but definitely relieves pressure on the spine. It inflates itself, which is fun.

title: pretty and useful
text: These floral themed thumbtacks or pushpins are useful and quite pretty. The tacks are glued on to the resin tops firmly. The variety of colors and shapes is pleasing.

title: funny but not useful
text: These sweary affirmation cards are funny for a joke gift but not actually useful.

title: simple yet effective
text: It can be challenging to keep dry erase markers where you need them if you don't have a large whiteboard tray. This little bucket is sized well to hold a good number of markers and keep them at hand where they are needed.

title: magnets stick well
text: These small labels stick well to a dry erase board. They are great for organizing projects, positioning team members, and more. They are superior to sticky notes because they can be erased and rewritten on and can be repositioned over and over.

title: pretty wall calendar
text: This is a pretty wall calendar. It is made of paper heavy enough that writing with felt pens doesn't leak through. The boxes are not large, but have enough space for some writing with a fine tipped pen.

title: very glittery cover
text: This journal has a very glittery cover, but fortunately it is NOT prone to dispensing glittery bits all over the place! The pages are a little thin, so might not work well for felt tipped pens.

title: cute stickers
text: These classroom motivational stickers are fun and a bit different. I think kids will really appreciate them.

title: can be used vertically or horizontally
text: This dry erase calendar can be used either vertically or horizontally. The boxes are about 1" x 1.5". This calendar is shipped rolled up, and it was difficult for me to unfurl and tape up on a door. It's still not lying as flat as I would like after several days. I am hoping that it will flatten further with time. The calendar comes with a black dry erase marker. The marker has a wide, blunt point that makes very thick lines, so is not really good for use writing in these tiny boxes. I recommend that you buy a set of fine tip dry erase markers instead.

title: looks fabulous!
text: This skeleton mouse pad is comfortable and fun. The skeleton looks fabulous! Well made and sure to spark conversation.

title: good plastic envelopes
text: These are good quality plastic mailing envelopes. The color is nice and bright. They are easy to use and the sticky closures seal very well.

title: nice minimalist cards
text: These thank you cards are appropriate for all occasions. They are minimalist, as the cards are just flat cardstock that doesn't open, and the design is quite simple. I like them very much and feel that they have a certain class and gravitas. The cards and envelopes come in four colors: gray, blue-gray, light blue, and dark blue. You can match the cards to the same color envelope or use different colors, as they all look good together.

title: pretty paper
text: This is very pretty "watercolor" paper that has a tie dye look. The colors are muted so it is not at all difficult to read words printed on it with standard black ink.

title: beautiful distressed signboard
text: This is a beautiful distressed signboard. I used it for a graduation party, but it can be written on and displayed for all types of events: weddings, open houses, graduation parties, etc. The chalkboard surface is covered by a plastic veneer, so you do need to be sure to remove before using.

title: large writing surface
text: This whiteboard is pretty easy to assemble. The wheels roll easily and it's not hard to move it across a hard laminated floor. It probably is not as easy to roll over a carpet. The chalk tray is generously sized, but it is quite lightweight and I wonder how it will hold up over time. This board is made to flip so you can expose one side or the other. The writing surface is large and when written on with dry erase markers, it cleans up very nicely. One of the features of this product is that it has a magnetic surface. This is accurate, but the magnetic pull is not terribly strong. You can use a standard refrigerator magnet to hang a small sheet of paper, but nothing with any sort of thickness or weight. Overall, this is a good product and should see a lot of use over the next few years.

title: it's ok
text: My 20+ son assembled this chair for use at his desk. He said that it was more difficult to fit together than other chairs he has assembled. The pieces didn't seem to fit together easily. The chair is fairly comfortable, but nothing special. It also makes  a weird noise after you get off the cushion.

title: tiny notebooks
text: These tiny notebooks are good stocking stuffers, treasure box prizes, party favors, etc. There are a handful of different covers and each notebook is filled with lined pages.

title: a little disappointing
text: These are plastic and not chalkboard material at all. They don't look classic or cute for use at a wedding or celebration. Chalk doesn't appear clearly on them. I found that dry erase works better, but i don't know when or where I will put them to use.

title: you can make your own stickers!
text: This paper allows you to print your own stickers from images on your computer. The sticky paper is a little tricky to peel away from the backing, but once you have a sticker cut out and peeled, it adheres well to most surfaces.

title: beautiful array of colors
text: These dry erase markers write smoothly on a whiteboard. The bright array of colors is a nice alternative to the typical few packaged for office supplies.

title: sitting on this as I type!
text: This cushion adds comfort and relieves stress on my back. I am sitting on it right now! Really delighted with the way it eases my usual discomfort after sitting at the desk for hours.

title: good mouse pad
text: This mouse pad is pretty basic looking but it feels good and is going to be a relief for computer users with wrist issues.

title: exactly what I wanted
text: This large desk calendar is exactly what I wanted. The boxes are big enough to write in and the colorful designs on the borders is attractive without being gaudy.

title: nice size
text: This set of five pocket journals would make nice party favors for young nature lovers. They are roughly the size of a passport, with lined pages. Each cover is a little different. I am planning to use mine to note activity at my bird feeders.

title: nice looking blotter
text: This blotter is a good size and looks very nice. I don't believe it is real leather though, despite it saying it is leather. That caused me to deduct one star, as I don't like companies trying to fool people.

title: doesn't maintain shape
text: This cushion is not at all firm. It doesn't maintain shape and just collapses. It compresses down to absolutely nothing. It's not uncomfortable, but it does not do anything to support.

title: notebook is thin but pens are nice
text: This notebook is pretty thin, but the pens are fun. They write well and are good for making gift tags or placecards  as well as doodling or journaling.

title: wrong size for my printer
text: Unfortunately, I ordered these without noting the size. This paper is very large and will not work with my printer. There are some things I can comment on though, based on the look and feel of the paper. It is relatively thin for photos. The general impression I have is of high quality writing paper. It is very smooth and has a weight to it. That being said, it is rather flimsy for prints.

title: nice colors
text: This set of notebooks comes in a beautiful array of colors. They are thinner than I anticipated though, having only 60 pages if you count both the front and back. That's less than 1/4" thick. The pages are off-white and on the thin side, so I am writing on just one side of each page. These are good notebooks for short term classes or projects.

title: great array of colors!
text: These are standard, college-ruled spiral-bound notebooks. The really cool thing about them is that they arrive in a beautiful rainbow of colors! In addition to the old standards like yellow, red, and black, this set includes a soft baby blue, cerulean, and different shades of pink and purple! It's a nice change and definitely made my daughter smile when she saw them.

title: Would make a beautiful gift for a world traveler!
text: Confession: I originally requested this map from amazon vine with the intention of eventually gifting it to a family member. When I examined it in order to post a review though, I liked it so much that I decided to hang it on my wall instead! The map is printed on an unframed canvas stretched over wood. A small tin of black and white map pins allow you to mark places you have visited or that you aspire to visit. It's a striking piece to hang on your wall. I am planning to order another one for that family member I mentioned.

title: nice little datebook
text: I'm not sure how much use I will get out of this datebook, during a worldwide pandemic, but this is a nice one. The format is user-friendly, with a two page full month view followed by pages with several lines for each date so that a single page has three days on it and a 4 item blank checklist at the bottom. It's compact but functional. At the end of each month's individual date pages, there is a "checking in" page that prompts you to write a summary of the last month and note any special mentions for wellness and gratitude. The book is bound with a wide wire ring so pages lie flat. An elastic cord is secured to the back of the book so you can wrap the cover to keep the book closed.

title: sturdy enough, good sized
text: I thought this foot pillow might help my feet to be less fatigued on days that I have to sit at a desk. It is a sturdy and dense foam pillow that has a zip off washable cover. I feel the product is well made. The issue is that it doesn't really appear to make a difference to my feet.

title: nice large boxes for writing
text: I like this calendar. It is good sized to use for a desk blotter and the boxes are large enough to write in without crowding.

title: different design on the other side!
text: This set of ten motivational posters includes a completely different design on the other side. So you are really getting 20 designs, though of course not all can be displayed at once unless on a window or glass wall. They are sealed in some sort of very thin plastic material so don't tear or fray at the corners. I like the unique color scheme of bright colors on a black background. We all could use a little bolstering during this time and these posters are positive without being too cheesy and insincere.

title: good quality notecards in fun fruity patterns
text: These cards are printed on nice medium weight cardstock. They are smooth except for metallic gold details, which are lightly embossed. The fruit patterns are fun and useful for a wide variety of situations. There are no words printed inside, so they can serve as thank you notes, welcome to the neighborhood cards, birthday cards, etc. This set has a total of 48 cards in six patterns.

title: thick, comfortable wrist support
text: This mouse pad and wrist rest set are attractive and comfortable. The wrist rest offers support for those with carpal tunnel or similar issues. The space theme is interesting and fun.

title: if you want to know where your money is going-
text: This wallet system is a simple way to hold yourself accountable. If you want to know where your money is going, this collection of color coded envelopes is one way to track your cash. It's easy to spend money without thinking if you are using a debit or credit card. If you walk into a store with a red envelope of cash instead, you know that you will need to be careful not to go over your budget. If you have a green envelope put aside for your child's extracurricular activity fees, you won't need to fret when the money is due. It's a different way of doing things for many of us, but it might be just what you need to reign in spending and stick to a budget.

title: nice journal set
text: I am a huge snob when it comes to paper! I appreciate an attractive cover on a journal, but more important to me is the paper inside. This journal has paper that feels good, and every page is covered with tiny dots in a grid formation that makes it easy to write, draw, or use stencils. The tiny stencils included are fun and there are MANY to choose from. If you use the fine-tip markers in the kit, the colors generally don't show through to the other side of the page. If you color something in though, as I did with a small balloon stencil, it does show through. You might want to use colored pencils for any coloring and use the skinny markers only to outline or write.

title: works well, but needs a lot of batteries
text: This is a nice little pencil sharpener that is easy to use. It does require 4 batteries, which seems like a lot for such a tiny motor. But it works as expected and is not overly loud.

title: nice looking and practical
text: This is an attractive box that is easily fixed to the wall. It is easy to open and close the door.

title: powerful little copier!
text: This is a powerful little copier! The print quality is top notch. Colors are bright and clear. It works quickly and we have not had any jams in the weeks it has been in use. It is quieter than some other machines we have had. The Xerox name is one I feel I can trust for quality, and it hasn't let me down in this machine. The one negative is that changing out the toner in this model will be more difficult. Instead of 4 color cartridges, I have to order 8 replacement pieces and take the time to change out each one.

title: cover and spiral binding seem durable
text:
This planner has a large spiral binding and heavy cardboard covers. It looks like it will hold up pretty well over the 18 month lifespan of the planner. The time period intended for use is August 2019 to December 2020.
I'm not sure how I will like using this book, as it is not yet August and I can't tell you how well it meets my needs. It is organized a bit differently. There are two main sections to the book. The first of these consists of a two page calendar view of the whole month, a one page spending log, and a doodle page. All 18 months are included here. The calendar has major holidays marked; it also shows major religious events such as Ramadan, Hanukkah, and Easter. For added fun, it marks offbeat dates such as Talk Like a Pirate Day, Book Lover's Day, and Pretzel Day. The second major area is devoted to a series of weekly views that include seven days per page, a water consumption checklist, a blank task list, and a goal tracker.
My current planner has monthly views spread out with weekly pages in between the months. So if I want to look at possible dates for a vacation, for instance, I can't easily look at July and August. I have to look at July and then hunt through a bunch of pages to look at August. This system, on the other hand, allows me to look at July and turn two pages to see August. I think this format might work better for me.

title: magnets don't stick
text:
This set has two large magnetic display board that come with a set of small flat circular magnets with different icons to symbolize chores and events. The circular magnets DO NOT STICK! We put them on the large boards and they slide down and off! There are dry erase markers as well, but spaces on the boards are so small that you can't write much with these blunt tips. The erasers on the back also started falling out the first time we tried to use them.
A waste of money. Not recommended.

title: very excited about this bag!
text:
I love to craft and sew, and often will bring a bag of whatever I am working on with me if I know there will be time spent waiting. I used to throw everything into a one-compartment tote bag, but that was messy and it was hard to find what I needed. This bag has space for almost anything I want to pack for a day or an hour. There is a padded flap that unzips on three sides and lays flat that is made for you to insert a crafter's cutting board. The main compartment has two large pouches that can swing outward from the center to reveal clear plastic pouches that are held on with velcro, so can be removed and put back. The biggest of the clear pouches is 12 inches long and maybe four inches wide. The four other pouches are all about six inches long and four inches wide. These clear pouches have zippers so you can close them up if you need to keep something contained.
The bag is attractive and has a nice lace print on one side. It has a padded shoulder strap as well as a handgrip. The back of the bag has one of those fabric loops that can go over a rolling suitcase handle to make it easier to transport both bags at once.
This is a well thought out product and it looks durable.

title: Great for gamers, weapon collectors, historians, etc.
text: My husband is an amateur historian and D & D dungeon master.  I gifted him this set of tacks and he absolutely loves them. They have long points are are sharp, so these are better for adults than for use by children.

title: not quite thick enough
text: These tiles seem like a great idea for making a customized bulletin board just the size you need. You peel the backing off each tile and use the pre-glued tacky back to stick it to the wall. The tiles fit together pretty well, though of course lines are visible. I tried sticking and unsticking a tile to see what would happen. It came off easily leaving no residue. The paint on the wall was left intact. This is all good, but there are some issues. The tiles are 1/2 inch thick, or just over half a centimeter. I have both flathead tacks and the kind with the little plastic handle. When I put them in a tile that was not placed on the wall, they went all the way through and protruded from the other side. So these would clearly not be a good option for a dorm or apartment where you are not allowed to put holes in the wall. I'm not really sure if I want to use them as a bulletin board because of this problem.

title: cleans up well
text: This whiteboard cleans up well and is a nice size. Magnets do stick to it, but you need the slightly heavy kind to hold up papers. Mounting is easy and the curved corners are covered with plastic "bumpers" so no sharp edges to avoid.

title: a nice paper planner
text:
I use a calendar on my cell phone but I have missed having a paper planner that I can use in different ways. This planner has each month laid out in a two page spread, plus each week with Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday on the left page and the remaining days on the right page. There are places to write the day's schedule, a to-do list, and at the bottom of the page, small sections are labeled: top three, notes, and gratitude. There is also a short inspirational quote.
The cover of the planner is plastic, so I know it will hold up over the months and keep the pages inside in decent shape. The main colors on the cover and inside are coral and lime. There is plenty of white space too- which I appreciate. I don't want too much visual clutter on the page.
The most special part of this book is the front section. Here, there are four numbered pages that encourage the user to 1: Start with the Big Picture
2: Set Your Goals
3: Design your Days
4: Stay on Course
I like this part and have used it to define some goals. For me, it would be helpful to have a page every couple of months reminding me to go back and review, but that might just be an individual preference. This planner does not have anything like that, or any significant "end" or closing. It goes right from the end of December to blank pages for notes.

title: nice and big
text: This mat arrives rolled up tightly and must warm up and be flattened before use. I had it spread for two days before it was mostly flat. I still had to put heavy objects on the smaller forward portion of the mat as it refused to lie flat. I like the large surface area of the mat and find it useful for rolling smoothly from my desk to the nearby printer. Hundreds of little plastic spikes on the underside keep it in place.

title: small but mighty!
text: This little stapler doesn't take up a lot of space, but it can staple up to 40 sheets of paper. It uses standard size staples.

title: funny cards aimed at adults
text:
These Christmas cards are printed on heavy, smooth paper. They have the Hallmark logo on the back. They are all most definitely CHRISTMAS cards, so don't think you can send one to your friends who celebrate other winter holidays. There are four different designs:
1. Santa saying, "Stupid GPS!" as he guides his sleigh over the moon.
2. One bird, in a plain nest, looks over at another bird in a nest covered in lights and ornaments. The first bird says, "You have GOT to take a break from Pinterest."
3. One wiseman says to the other, "That's a lot of myrrh." The second wiseman replies, "I had a Groupon."
4. Dancer the reindeer is standing with a human woman, clearly his dance partner. They face three judges. The caption reads, "Going home? What do you mean I'm going home? I'm Dancer, dammit!"

I find them amusing, but not really LOL funny. The illustrations are reminiscent of Gary Larson's Far Side cartoons.

title: fun gel pens
text: These pens write smoothly and are fun for doodling. The white does not show up at all on paper that is not colored. The colors are a bit brighter than they appear in my photo. The orange, blue, and pink are quite vivid on white paper as well as dark. The pens have a nice little grip that makes them very comfortable to hold.

title: I like these!
text:
I enjoyed making art with oil pastels, but gave them up years ago because they
A. were messy
B. were too broad and blunt
C. broke easily
These gel pastels eliminate all of these problems. They are considerably thinner in diameter but because they are housed in a plastic pen type dispenser, they do not break. They are much cleaner to work with also. The pastels smudge easily and blend beautifully, and they have a great consistency that provides a very smooth flow onto paper. Colors are vivid and lovely.

title: Not exactly what I expected
text: I thought that a lettering kit would have more instructions on how to use the pen and nibs included to make beautiful words. I was envisioning a step by step tutorial. This kit does have a small booklet with some sample fonts, but it is not what I expected. The pen has two nibs and two colors of ink. It is a good basic starter set but look elsewhere for lettering instruction.

title: I love that it is clean and wrinkle free
text: I have this calendar hanging on the wall of my office. I love that it is clean and wrinkle free, and gives me the entire year at a glance. The calendar has a little curl when it arrives and may take some time to flatten. I actually had mine hung up with pushpins, but they popped out within a minute. I reinforced with duct tape and will probably remove that once some time has passed. The boxes are a bit small to write much in with the dry erase marker included, but I don't really want a lot of detail posted on the wall for everyone to see. It is enough space for me to indicate a day off or special event when I want to.

title: flexible product with myriad uses!
text:
This divider sets up in just a few minutes.Due to the size of the pieces, it is best to have two people for assembly. The unit has three panels which can be attached to function together. The casters allow you to use the center panel alone, with one side panel, or with both side panels. The side panels have only one wheel, so cannot be used alone.
One side of the divider has a white board that is magnetic. I tested mine with standard refrigerator magnets and they attached well. The one thing that I found irritating about this is that the white boards have stickers in the corner that tell the user to peel back the protective plastic film before using, and this did not come off the edges of the panel cleanly. I have little shreds of clear plastic on all of my panels that I will have to trim with a knife.
The opposite side of the panels is a royal blue felt. It can be used for attaching felt pieces for storytelling and also for displaying things with thumbtacks.
The assembled product on casters stands four feet tall. I like the mobility it offers, as well as the flexibility to arrange at different angles. This item is small enough when collapsed ( 4' x 3' x about 14") that it can be transported in a pick up truck or a minivan with seats removed. It is not very heavy, but two people might be better for carrying due to the bulk.
I can imagine this item being useful for all kinds of situations: a science fair or trade show display, classroom, office, or even to provide private space in a shared bedroom. The long feet that the wheels are mounted on provide stability, so you don't have to worry about it tipping over.

title: This cart is super easy to assemble
text:
This cart is super easy to assemble. The wheels are hard plastic that rolls but doesn't spin. Two of the wheels include brakes so that you can prevent the cart from rolling around. I find them a little hard to engage- it took a minute or so of fiddling to lock them into place initially. The hanging file area on top is large enough to accommodate quite a few files. The shelf underneath is great for storing a stapler, file tabs, etc. I do wish the cart was a couple of inches higher, but it is tall enough to reach the files easily from a seated position. If you will not be accessing them from ytour desk chair, the height is more of an issue.
This is lightweight but not at all flimsy. Perfect for organizing paperwork for home or office!

title: this organizer is fine. The shelves slide in and lock into place
text: Once assembled, this organizer is fine. The shelves slide in and lock into place. Assembly was a little frustrating though, which is why I downgraded it from 4 to 3 stars. Here is the issue: the rods that must be screwed together with the sides have plastic bits inside that screws must fit into cleanly. It was difficult to keep the rods from turning as screws were fastened. This should have taken five minutes to put together, but it actually took about 20 minutes.

title: This hanging file system is easy to put together
text: This little rack is exactly what I needed for my desk. The rack I have been using causes my folders to bend and sag. This hanging file system is easy to put together, doesn't take up too much space, and keeps my file folders neat and well organized. The only thing I can think of that would make it better would be for it to be in a nice cerulean blue, my favorite color. :)

title: A great buy for use in the home or with a ...
text:
A great buy for use in the home or with a business with minimal printing needs. This printer is compact and fits on a small tabletop. The wireless feature is wonderful! It was very fast and easy to set up. Noise is not excessive. Copies are very clear and equivalent to those produced on a more expensive machine. HP products are known for being solid performers and this is no exception.
There are some drawbacks to consider: There is no feeder option, so each page must be scanned and printed individually if you are copying documents. The paper tray is shallow and must be refilled often. The touchpad could be a bit larger too, as the buttons are close enough together that it is easy to press the wrong button.

title: INXS is one of my favorite 80's bands and I think this card is perfect
text: INXS is one of my favorite 80's bands and I think this card is perfect! I can hardly wait to give it to my husband for Valentine's Day. For those who remember 45 records, this is a real, solid 45 and not one with a cardboard backing like we used to get on cereal boxes.

title: This looks to be an excellent material for paper modeling
text: These are just what they advertise- large sized sheets of medium weight tagboard- what I grew up knowing as "oaktag". The sheets are thinner than those used for manilla folders, but heavier than construction paper. The color is an even off-white, not heathered. This looks to be an excellent material for paper modeling, lapbooking, and inexpensive decorations.

title: 18" are great for adults!
text: These chairs are attractive and though their minimalist construction makes them lightweight, they are sturdy enough for most adults. The 18" frame is a good height for adults to sit in as well. I love the seafoam color- it is a little brighter than it appears on my monitor. We have only used these for a few days, so I will check back in here after time has passed to let you know how they hold up.

title: This stool was super easy to assemble
text: This stool was super easy to assemble. The wood is attractive and the unit does not feel at all flimsy. The side pocket "saddlebags" are helpful for storing small items, while the storage in the wooden base can be used for books and folders. The casters glide smoothly over low pile carpet or hard flooring- I don't know how they might handle deep pile carpeting. The cushion on top is comfy and attaches with velcro so it won't be slipping off all the time. What would make this better? I'm not sure- maybe a choice of colors for the canvas bags and cushion?

title: You can adjust the resolution of images and they look great. I thought it would be difficult to figure ...
text: This Epson scanner took about half an hour to set up. It runs quietly- quieter than my printer. You can adjust the resolution of images and they look great. I thought it would be difficult to figure out how to use the machi9ne, but it was actually very straightforward. A great tool for home or business use.

title: comfortable and easy to assemble. NOT for larger people.
text: This is a nice looking chair that is comfortable and rolls easily. It took hardly any time at all to assemble. The higher part of the curved arms are a bit high and do not fit under a desk when not in use. That's a little bothersome, but not a big deal. Bigger people, make note: this chair says it has a 250 pound weight limit. My husband is just a tad under that amount, and when he sat in the chair to test it, he rolled back about 6 inches and one of the plastic wheels shattered! Fortunately, he was not hurt and we scavenged a compatible wheel from an older rolling chair. My 96 pound daughter is now using the new chair at her desk. :)

title: Solid performing basic paper for copiers. No discernable difference ...
text: Solid performing basic paper for copiers. No discernable difference between the amazon basics paper and my usual namebrand paper.

title: Great!
text: Great size and colors! I definitely recommend this! I write my (everchanging) work schedule on this board and I haven't had a single issue with erasing!

title: Paper Coated, But Decent
text: This is the perfect size bulletin board for what I needed. The only reason it didn't get 5 stars, is the frame is paper coated and ripped almost immediately. I colored the little rip with sharpie and you can't really even tell, but it's still a little bit of a bummer.

title: Looks great
text: This will work for exactly what I need it to. Looks like it may break if ever dropped.

title: Works great with zebra gx420d
text:
Works great with the zebra GX420D. I originally ordered rolls that were too large for the printer and had been spooling the labels onto a 3/4 irrigation pvc. While that did work, it was more work.

So I ordered these and they work great. They come out of the printer smoothly. They tear cleanly. And most importantly, the print is nice and clear. They come off the backing easily and stick well to packaging.

Overall, I'm happy to get the proper sized labels for the printer. Makes everything easier when it's done right.

title: clear and strong
text:
The description says 1.9 mil. The photo shows 2.7 mil. I've got some brown packing tape that is listed as 2.7 mil and these seem comparable. So who knows. What I do know is that the brown packing tape can't be used for taping on labels. So I needed some more clear rolls.
No issue with these rolls. They work well on cardboard. Printed address labels are clearly legible under the tape. One thing I do like more that my other tape. These came stacked forming a roll. My other tape arrived in a 2 x 3 layout making for odd storage.

title: Beautifully designed and working
text:
[[VIDEOID:88f38f5141441c0b56aa5132968d4e88]] We are a big fan of pop up 3d cards in this house. We love crafts and art that shows quality craftsmanship.
I saw this card and knew that I wanted it for my five years old next birthday.
The design is beautiful and fun. There's so much fine detail, from the little leaves on the cover to the stars and swing on the inside. The girl on the swing can even be moved.
The card opens up smoothly and there's no extra fidgeting to get it the way is supposed to look. And it closes just as effortlessly.
Overall, it's a wonderful card that I look forward to giving future six year old.

Also, there was a bonus card in the pack. Not a pop up, but a nice and simple card with a old style key. A rather elegant looking card.

title: perfect for printing shipping labels
text:
I'm using these for one thing and one thing only. And that is to print some shipping labels. Printing out on regular paper, cutting it up and taping with clear packing tape is time that could be used else where.
In that regard, these work great. The print is clear. The paper drives through the printer without getting caught. They tear easily. And the stick to the boxes way better than using paper and tape.
The only thing for me is that I don't send out nearly as many packages as the amount of labels in this package. This for me is basically a lifetimes worth. I'll be giving three of the rolls away to to some friends.

title: Fun and vibrant
text:
This card took several weeks to arrive, but it came just in time for my child's fifth birthday.

This is a very fun card. It's unfolds easily and is full of vibrant colors. The little details are delicately cut into the paper like the sand bags on the sides of the baskets. The clouds are cut out as well giving the inside texture. The happy birthday banner between the balloons is clear and easy to read.
There was a small crease on the inside left page so we won't write on that side. But like any popup card, there's always a concern for space to write. On the inside of this one, there's plenty of space.
Overall, this is pretty wonderful card for a young child's birthday.

title: Straightforward and functional
text:
Here are some observations from my wife.

This black metal and plastic paper tray is practical and very useful. The trays connect easily and well vertically, though they could be used separately.
The two metal trays can each store a good-sized stack of 8.5” x 11” paper, and the plastic tray on top has three columns to store small items like pens, scissors, post-its, etc. The middle column also has two plastic pieces that can create three smaller compartments if you like.
Overall, this is a straightforward, very functional piece of office organizing equipment.

title: solid and vibrant
text:
I've used the uni oil based paint markers for years. Any time I work on a suspension part, I mark the bolts to so I get a visual confirmation at a glance that they've held in place.
Comparatively, these are just as good. They're just about as vibrant. They applies solid and evenly. And they're fast drying as well.
These did take quite a bit of shaking and priming to get going. Once the tip was saturated, the paint started to move freely.
I plan on using these along side of my uni markers for future automotive upgrades, maintenance and repairs.

title: Accurate as USPS and UPS store scales
text:
Works exactly as expected. Accurate compared to the scales at the post office and UPS store. Not only is it accurate, it's also consistent. Taking off and putting same items on the scale result in consistent readings.
It's also very easy to use. Battery operation is very convenient for when I have packages that are too big to put on the counter.

title: smooth flow with good line weight
text:
Back in the day, pens were used to for writing letters and school work. So the used to run out fairly quick. My favorite disposable pen of all time might have been the papermate flexgrip. I had one that lasted over a decade and a half that I used for just writing checks. Well, that one finally ran out and I have been using odd pens here an there.
I don't write than much nowadays and was not familiar with a gel pen. I had a chance to test these out to see what that was about.
These come with a little protective nib tip that has to be removed before using. I guess this is somewhere between a wet rollerball and a thick ink pen. The ink flows smoothly and does not skip. If you use these for sketching, the line weight is actually pretty easy to control. The blue is a much darker blue and somewhere between blue and black.
Overall, the size and weight feel pretty good. These are comfortable pens. And they write smoothly and consistently.

title: Adds another dimension to card giving
text:
[[VIDEOID:f666ef9956d13bc3501dffbdcf761f46]] There's so many of these fun themed cards coming out. They literally add a whole new dimension of fun to card giving.
My wedding anniversary isn't coming up for another seven months, but I had the opportunity to order this. My wife loves being written to and she loves cards. I'm not sure if I think the design of this card matches an anniversary theme. It looks more like a children's nighttime adventure story. Nevertheless, its a fun card and I know she will love it.
Of all the 3d cards I've looked at, this one is a little on the stiff side. Which is okay. It stands well on its own.
Overall, it's a fun card for those folks that still enjoy some crafts that can still be held.

title: Base sits flat and card stands upright
text:
[[VIDEOID:81d64617350335aa3ef23bb13230e2e3]] No assembly required.
Initial thoughts. The unfolding and folding of the potted flowers sets into place with a firm push/ pull. You'll know when it's in place. It sits flat on its base and stands upright.
The paper is of nice quality.

The card is inscribed on the bottom as a valentines day card so it cannot be used for other occasions. There is a little heart insert that you can write a few words on. It's not a romantic card, so it'd be fine to give to a friend as well.

Overall, the design is lovely and the card operates solidly.

title: These work pretty well and they're forgiving
text: These work pretty well and they're forgiving. They hold to packaging as needed and peel off cleanly if you need to remove them. I wouldn't reapply any one that I took off. I'd just put a new one on. They're on the thin side so you probably will destroy any one you take off. They're 99 percent clear. So no texture or frosting. Overall, they work as well as expected.

title: Takes care of most packing duties
text:
I've been doing a lot of shipping this holiday season. And I'm always a little paranoid about the strength of the packing tape. So having a little more thickness doesn't hurt and gives me a little more peace of mind.
That being said, I still need the clear tape to go over printed shipping labels.
So these take care of package security while the clear tape is still needed for my purposes.

title: intricate and operates flawlessly
text:
[[VIDEOID:de51b0bf873a4066ab104eb185537609]] No assembly required.
Initial thoughts. The unfolding and folding 3D texts works quite smoothly. Nothing gets hung up.
The paper is of nice quality.

The card is inscribed as a valentines day card so it cannot be used for other occasions. I'm saving this for a couple months to give to my wife.

Overall, the design is intricate and the card operates flawlessly.

title: Legs fall out too easily
text:
This was very easy to put together. While they recommended a rubbet mallet for the casters, it's not needed. A good push will get them seated.

Speaking of easy, the legs slide right onto the top and bottom tray. There's nothing to hold them in place but gravity. Which seems like it'd be a concern. And it turns out it is.

I had the bottom loaded and need to got over a small bump. So I had to lift the cart from the bottom to keep it from falling out.

I'm going to have to drill some holes to keep the plastic from cracking and putting some small screws in there.

So yeah, this is a bit of a fail. It can be DIY fixed, but it shouldn't have to be.

title: Great pads for babies and toddlers
text:
These are great. The colors are vibrant and fun. My nine month old took right to them. My four years old loves them too.

They've got that school gym gymnastics cover feel. The bottoms have some anti slip material. At first, I though the stitching was incomplete, but there's a half in and half out seam. The handles are a great idea for little one to use for carrying.

The cushion is firm and substantial. The kids don't sink into them.

The only unfortunate aspect is the giant tag, but you can just tear them off.

Overall, these are a great addition to our play space.

title: Fun and cute card
text:
My wife was concerned that we'd have to put this card together. The good news is that there's no assembly required.

Initial thoughts. The unfolding and folding 3D puppy operates quite smoothly. Nothing gets hung up.
The paper and foil are of nice quality.

The card message is non specific to any event. Perhaps so that it could be used for different occasions.

Overall, a really fun card that's rather cute as well.

title: better than adhesive for automotive weather strips
text:
I had a door seal start to pull away on one of my jeep half door uppers. I originally used 3M Black Super Weatherstrip Adhesive to reattach it. That was not ideal, because it took time to cure and had to be clamped down which pressed the rubber tubing in the weatherstrip.

This one was much easier to apply. There was no wait time and it stayed in place while I made my way around the perimeter. There was no need for clamping with kept the tube from deforming. Even though the surface of the doors has a slight texture, that was not an issue.

Overall, a better direction to go than adhesive that needed to cure.

title: Easy to use
text:
All the warnings in the instructions make it seem a little more complicated than it is. But they are worth taking a quick look to get started.

You can pretty much plug this in and start using it. The start up guide is helpful and useful as a point of reference.

It only take a few moments to warm up. You can get your photos ready while you wait.

My first attempt had a bubble right next to the photo. Not sure why that happened, but the subsequent ones turned out fine.

I had a difficult time using the built in edge trimmer. I would run it along and it just wouldn't catch.

The removable corner cutter is a nice addition. Gives the the laminated photos/ docs a more finished look and of course makes it nice and smooth.

text: Scan quality is below average. Does not always save scans. You should check after every strip. I found out after I went through several rolls. Had to rescan them all and check them as I went. Made the whole process rather slow.
