Sometimes it works fine; sometimes it just ignores what I press and does its own thing. As in, if I do a series of additions and then a subtraction, it clears everything out. I hadn't hit the total yet but okay, pretty calculator, you do you. I don't know. It is interesting but something to keep in mind.

title: Works well
text: Chair mats are easy to overlook until you don't have one and then you wish you did. At least that is how it was for me. That's why I decided to try this Glide Right Vinyl Chair Mat. At 36" x 48", it covers a good amount of area. I like it and it is comfortable to move around on and comfortable on my feet. It is also easy to keep clean. All in all, one of my better selections so far in this new year.

title: Good journal
text:
I've not heard of SULIRUN 1981, but I do like this journal. It lays flat. The pages are a good weight. I haven't been using ruled pages in a while so it is a nice return. The pen/pencil holder is quite convenient. I like it because I get to designate a pen to use with the journal. It has a good amount of pages.

Honestly, I've got nothing bad to say about it. I would definitely consider for future purchase, especially if there is a dot/bullet version.

title: Super cute
text: I am liking this pencil pouch. It is cute and cheery. I used for a few pens and my airpod. I could probably use it for more, but this is enough for me.

title: It is what I expected
text: The kikki.K Woodland Wanders Designer Collection - Paper Lover's Book is what I expected. It has a variety of paper 'projects' like stickers, labels, envelopes (tear and fold) and paper figures. The colors are soft and the designs are the trendy doodle type. It is exactly what I had expected and I am okay with that.

title: Like the concept
text: I like the concept of the Marbrasse Bamboo Rotating Pen Organizer but I ended up taking the bottom part of the item, the pieces that make it rotate, off the main section. The ball bearing circle kept sliding out of position and the top part would tip to side. It is still usable and I am using it, but not with the rotating section.

title: Works as needed
text: There are a few quirks about this QooWare Keyboard Tray Under Desk that can get slightly annoying. By 'slightly', I mean that literally. I'm getting used to the quirks so as the days go by, it becomes less annoying. That said, it is a good functional under-the-desk keyboard. It was easy to put together and install where I needed it. It works as needed and I'm satisfied with it.

title: Good group of themed stickers
text: I selected this set of AVERY Budget Planner Stickers Pack, 1,224 Stickers, Expense Tracker and Finance Planner Sticker Sheets (6788), Assorted to help with budget planning in this new year. It can be a little overwhelming with so many stickers but once I started putting them, it works for me. Given the amount, I think this set will last awhile. Works well with a guided dated planner and with a free-form bullet journal.

title: Nice gel pen
text:
I selected BIC Gel-ocity Smooth Stic Gel Pen, Fine Point because it was the BIC brand. Granted, the last BIC pens that I got wasn't as good I had hoped but I generally like BIC pens. I also already have a 'favorite' gel pen. However, I have to say, I am really impressed with this gel pen. It comes in 4 colors but that's fine because black, blue, green and red is all I needed. If I need yellow, fuschia, lime green, etc, I have another set of pens so I'm good with basic colors from this set.

Besides, the pens are great. They are comfortable to use. I didn't need much pressure for the ink to flow. The ink on paper looks great with vibrant and accurate color. It has a consistency that I like. Just a really great pen.
This box had 36 pens (6 of each color). I'm tempted to hoard them but I should share the good stuff. I will definitely keep in mind for future purchase.

title: A lot of markers to use
text: I wavered between 3 and 4 star for this AmazonBasics Supertip Washable Markers. With 40 colors/markers, I thought that the amount of markers make up for the quality of some of the markers. Some were frayed upon first use and at least one was already dried up.  The percentage of that group was around 10% but that left 90% that were fine. So 30 markers were fine and that seems okay. However, if one gets something new, one expects that all the items will work. I fluctuated with the rating, because I know that probably only use half of the markers will be used so I'm good with 10 not working perfectly, but another person might not be as flexible so it is worth mentioning and probably better to give the 3 star rating.

title: Dispenser is okay but the washi tape is fantastic
text: I have to admit that the wooden tape dispenser is just okay. The design is attractive and the wood looks great but functionally, it is just okay. That said, I still love this set because I love the washi tape design. I have rolledpaint's calendar washi tape and it is such a time saver, I love it. When I realized the washi tape on this set is also rolledpaint, I am now hoping that the tape (or similar designs) start to become available. I love the images and art style. The tape makes the set totally worthwhile for me.

title: Nice starter budget planner
text: This Budget Planner - Undated Monthly Bill Organizer with Pockets is attractive and easy to use. I think if one's budget is fairly compact, it works well. If it is a little more complicated, it may not be enough. For the most part, I like it. My only criticism is the "regular bill tracker" are a little hard to write in with the binder rings in way. I think that could have been designed a little better. Otherwise, it is a nice starter budget planner.

title: Functional and easy to put together
text: It is a little lighter than expected but that said, I am really liking this ELONG HOME 3 Tier Rolling Utility Cart. It looks good. It is super functional with good space for items on cart and nice depth on trays so the stuff doesn't feel like they will fall out. It was very easy to assemble with all needed hardware. I like the matte black color. I also like that there are no sharp edges. Overall, I'm pleased with this selection. It works well for how I want to use it.

title: Convenient
text: I have to admit that I use this Miseyo Dashed Handwriting Lines Practice Roller Stamp so I can practice hand lettering or to use in my journal planner. It is a good size and I imagine that it is good for young children who are learning to write. Admittedly, I gave composition books with the dashed lines to the younger ones in the extended family, but this item, I'm keeping for myself. It can used anywhere as long as there is blank paper. It does bleed through the paper a little bit and that is about the only thing that keeps it from being a 5-star. Otherwise, I like it a lot.

title: Appreciated
text: I had to wait a bit to see how this journal with the cats on the cover by Settini would go over. It went over quite well for the person it was given to. So it is, indeed, giftable and appreciated. This particular family member likes cats and journals with lines. No bullet journaling for her! So this journal was exactly what I had hoped she would like and she did. Even the pen slot was something she liked. All in all, it was a hit. A solid 5-star hit.

title: Nice medium point set
text: I love my Sunshilor calligraphy set which is why I grabbed this Sunshilor Metallic Marker Pens Medium Point Metallic Pens. Generally, I'd hold off because I use this type of pen as much. I like the finer tip, but this has been a surprising set. The color is great. There's only one where the color doesn't quite match the cap but that's okay because the color that comes out is a lovely rose gold. It has good coverage and I like the texture it leaves behind. I honestly selected this product because of the Sunshilor brand name and I'm glad that I did. This is a nice medium point set.

title: Takes a bit more pressure for ink to come out
text: I selected the BIC PrevaGuard Clic Stic Ballpoint Pen Contains Built-in Protection On the Pen To Suppress Bacteria Growth for the '...suppress bacteria growth..." and I'm going to assume that works. However, the thing I note is that it does take a bit more pressure for the ink to come out. It wasn't just one pen; it was quite a few. I'm getting used to it so I'm not throwing out the pens. It just takes some getting used to.

title: Looks good for those who like guidance
text: The Mokani Planner - Weekly & Monthly Life Planner with Leather Hardcover looks good and works well for those who like guidance for their planners. It is undated which means if if a month is missed, no harm, no foul, just go-forward. It is organized in an intuitive way so it is easy to follow through. Well done.

title: Cute
text: I selected this cat organizer box from Ellsang because it looked cute. Once I received it and put it together, it is still cute. It is a little smaller than I had expected, but that may be just as well as it will keep me from overloading it. Overall, I'm satisfied.

title: Like the look of these stickers
text: I have to admit that the seasonal stickers are my favorite of the New Aesthetic Seasonal and Productivity Planner Stickers - Seasonal, Productivity & Decorative Stickers for Women. I'm still trying to figure out the productivity stickers. I feel more pressure from them than productive but at least they are there to use when I feel the need. The stickers look good with a crisp clean graphic. Nothing faded and blurred. I am enjoying using them.

title: Works well for noting taking
text: The Knodel lap desk works well for noting taking. It is a little too small to do much else, but that works for me. I have to take a lot of notes and this works as it provides a stable surface and it is comfortable to keep on the lap due to the cushion. So it works as I had hoped.

title: Nice fitness journal
text: I like the simplicity of the page layout with this Hallmark Fitness and Wellness Journal. It works well on an intuitive level. I wish it had more pages for the main journal by removing or combining the other sections (I have separate journals for those topics) but others may have a different opinion. Otherwise, it is an easy, intuitive health and fitness journal that helps keep me on track.

title: Tried and true format
text: Although it isn't quite 2021, the planner has already begun and that's why I selected "2021 Weekly & Monthly Planner by AT-A-GLANCE". This style of planner is tried and true. What I really like is the size as it makes it easy to write in. I am using this planner for work as I had a similar AT-A-GLANCE calendar/planner a few years back and it worked well for work purposes. I tend to use personal planners in one way (undated, more free-flowing, get creative yen out of the way), but for work, I like simple and streamlined and this planner works perfect for me in that scenario.

title: Definitely for small parts
text: I do like this set of 10 modular, stackable storage drawers. I would say to pay attention to the part of the description that says, "small parts." Why? Because the drawers are small. I can put my mini pens in the drawers but not a regular sized pen. It works for me because I have stickers, washi tape etc that I want to keep corralled so this works well for me. The clear plastic is crisp and clear which is really nice. So I am satisfied with it.

title: Convenient and versatile
text: TTVALLEY Pencil Case is convenient and versatile. It looks good. It has a good amount of storage space without going overboard. That's rather important because the simpler it is, the easier it is to find what I am looking for. In other words, stuff doesn't get lost. I use it to store pens, a small note book and my extra glasses. It fits easily in my purse so it helps keep my purse organized too. I'm liking it a lot.

title: Handles stamp ink and brush pens ink really well
text: I selected Indeme's bullet journal to try out because I liked the succulent cover. It matched my mood of late. I still really like the cover. However, what I like best about the journal is that the paper weight is surprisingly good. I've used stamps where ink bleeds a little with even my best journals and this one has almost untraceable bleed thru. It is the same with my brush pens. I'm quite impressed. The only thing that I'm not keen on is something that I can't knock because while spiral ring binders aren't my favorite, it isn't like it was a surprise to me. I knew it was a spiral ring when I selected it. So overall, I really like this brand's journal. It is a good size, it handles brush pens and stamping which is part of journaling routine. It works well for me.

title: Concept is great
text: BookFactory Secret of 3 Planner was selected because I like following the rule of 3 (Top 3 priorities; top 3 things to remember for tomorrow; top 3 tasks for work; top 3 tasks for home, etc). That's why I selected this planner. I have to admit that the format wasn't quite for me in that it was bit too "guided", was a little too detailed for me; however, it was great for my son who I've been trying to convince that the rule of 3 is more than just a design ethos. He's been using it and the format works well for him. The guiding format helps him stay focused. So I'm still a believer in the rule of 3 concept and with the right format, it can work for the right person.

title: Nice appointment style planner
text: Trees's Daily Planner Non-Dated Hourly Planner is a nice 'appointment style' planner. It is simple and functional which makes it easy to use. It is good for tracking time as well as blocking out time whether it is for appointments or to get tasks done. I like that it is undated so I can use as needed and not have to worry about missing dates.

title: Liking overall
text: Overall, I like this set of sticky notes. I like the look and how I can use them. That said, the 'sticky' isn't as sticky as it probably needs to be. Usually my complaint on these types of set is that when I pull a note from the pad, the next note has sticky residue on the top which I then have to do some work to make the note usable or throw it away. In the case of this Yoobi set, it has no residue left behind (which is good) but there isn't much stickiness on the underside for some notes. I can get around that by using my Tombow semi-permanent adhesive roller but not everyone may have something like that. Anyway, I like it overall and I can find a way to make it work for me.

title: Useful and attractive
text: The stickers in this AVERY Planner Stickers Variety Pack are engaging and attractive which makes me want to use them in my planner(s). At 1,744 Stickers, there is a sticker for practically everything. There are two of each sheet so if I want to duplicate from one planner to another, I can. It covers holidays, inspiration, health, tasking, etc. Almost everything that I want to cover in a planner or journal, this set has a sticker for and again, the stickers look great and in turn, makes planning fun to create and then to follow. I'm impressed and satisfied.

title: Exactly as described
text: I've been looking forward to receiving this Sweetzer & Orange Daily Planner 2020-2021, Undated Planner to Do List Notepad and start using it to help plan my day on a task based format. It is clearly as described in that it is Undated (which I prefer because it makes it flexible) and a notepad (which means I can insert into my main planner. My main planner is a B5 so I've been trimming off a 1/4" from the header and then taping it into the planner as a flip page and it works great. I am a fan of the "rule of 3" so the top priorities, for tomorrow and don't forget sections having 3 task lines fits into my current routine. Overall, this is exactly what I had hoped it would be and it is. I love it.

title: Writes smoothly
text: Catpower's set of Black Ink Gel Pens (6) with the cat caps are quite cute and even better, they write really smooth. I like using them for that reason and that they are easy to hold. I feel like I have good control of the pen so my writing looks legible and neat on the paper. I'm quite satisfied with this product.

title: Surprised at how much I like this sticker set
text: I am surprised at how much I liked this sticker set from IVLWE. I thought I would like the plants and graphic print  stickers, but I like the Snow White and Alice in Wonderland stickers too. The stickers have a vintage vibe which makes them fun to use for journaling. They are easy to use and have good adhesion. I'm glad that I decided to try this product out. They are a little different from the other stickers that I have in terms of print design which is inspiring.

title: A bit bendy but does job
text: I can be a little forgiving with the HOMZ 3 Drawer Medium Storage Cart, Set of 1, White because overall, it does the job. There is minimal assembly in that main unit is already put together. The only thing that I would've had to 'assemble' is putting on the caster wheels. I also like the drawer size as it is how I expect to this storage unit. The plastic is a bit bendy but that's only noticeable if I move the cart around. In my case, I don't even use the caster wheels. I have the unit in a stationary spot. As such, it is a 4 star for me since I use it as a stationary drawer storage. If I used it more as a cart that could be rolled to different parts of my home, I'd probably place it closer to a 3 star.

title: Carry case is the selling point
text: AmazonBasics 10-Piece Math Kit - Includes Compasses, Graphite, Eraser, Sharpener, Protractor, Triangles, Ruler, and Carrying Box is a nice set of useful tools for school. As much as this type of toolbox can be appreciated, it is appreciated by the person who is using it. The favorite part is the carrying case. The young person admits that it helps keep her organized for these items. Normally, she'd put it in her pencil case and then lose the items because she'd need room for other stuff. Because the carrying case is specifically designed for this set, it works well for her. As for the tools, they are fairly good. There are some items she uses more than others but when she does need a protractor, it will be nice to have it on hand. Overall, a solid 4.

title: Works pretty good
text: The colors for this It's Academic Flexi Storage Boxes with Lids, Collapsible Pencil Case for Craft and School Supplies is the eye-catcher. The colors are bright and noticeable. The latch on one of them is a bit finicky but workable. The expandable functionality is a bit soft when the expansion is not needed but that makes sense. If there aren't enough items to warrant expanding, then leave as-is. So overall, it works pretty good. It is also easy to wipe down and clean and if it gets a bit dinged, no one feels guilty.

title: A few things to note but work well enough
text: Cook with Color's 8 piece bag clips work well enough. The magnets in the 2 large clips separated as in, 'when I pulled them off the refrigerator, the clip came off but the magnet stayed." That said, the clips still work as expected and that's the main thing. The magnets on the smaller clips have adhered better but again, the main thing, like the large clips, is that the clips work as expected and they do. They keep items securely closed and they are easy to clean so we're satisfied.

title: Great set of pens
text: I can see now why Zebra/Sarasa pens have become a brand of choice. This Zebra Pen Sarasa Clip Retractable Gel Pen set is a great set of pens. It is a comfortable pen to use. It is consistent in its color. They look great when displayed (important if you are trying to keep the desk area looking neat and tidy). Just a really nice set of pens to use.

title: Good size
text:
I have the smaller A5 Rettacy grid journal that I like, so I wanted to try the RETTACY Dotted Grid Journal 2 Pack at the B5 size. What I like best is the page size. For a daily planner, the page size gives me more room to work with.

There are a few minor things that require some change. I like to put stickers on cover to help me distinguish the journals and I notice the cover surface on this journal is a little different. When I open the journal, the stickers and label on the cover wrinkled and lifted so I've had to tape some of them down. I also noticed that the pages have some bleed through when I use my stamps. It is the same paper weight as the A5 journal which I didn't see the same bleed through so it may just be a one-off thing. Again, both issues are minor and I can work around (ex: use a label to stamp and then put the label on the page) because overall, I like the B5 journal.

title: Love the colors
text: I love the colors of this AmazonBasics Gel Pens with Clip - Vintage Colors set. It says 'vintage' colors but the colors remind me of autumn. Colors aside, the pens are smooth to use. The ink is consistent and it is comfortable to hold. The color on paper looks like what I expected it to be from the casing. Overall, a fantastic set of pens that will get a lot of use.

title: Stiff so it helps with control
text: The pen tips are a bit stiffer than I am used to for this Hethrone Hand Lettering Pen set, but I rather like it. The brush pen is fantastic. It really helps with the brush lettering. The other pens take a bit getting used but again, it does help with practicing control. It is a nice set.

title: Nice layout
text: The strength of this Bliss Collections Essential Daily Planner 6 x 9 with 50 Undated Tear-Off Sheets is that the layout is easy on the eyes with a useful, intuitive flow. I like it a lot.

title: Comfortable to use
text: I selected this package of Paper Mate Mechanical Pencils because it was listed as a #2 which is my preferred lead. It is a little lighter than I expected for a #2 but I do like the way it feels when writing with it. It is comfortable to hold and the lead stays in place and goes down easily as it is used. One of the things that I don't like about mechanical pencils is when the lead snaps off. This mechanical pencil hasn't been doing that on that me and that's a big plus for me. This is a familiar trusted brand to me and overall, I like this set of mechanical pencils.

title: Nice alternative to dot
text: RETTACY's graph journal set is a nice alternative to their dot journal. I am using it as an project book so the graph paper works well for me. The paper is the right thickness with very little bleed through. The A5 size is my preferred journal size in that it helps me stay organized on the page and not overload it. The 2-pack is also great. The price point is reasonable especially if considering the more well-known journals of the same type and quality. I'm still partial to the dot journal for general planner use, but the graph journal has its good points too that I like as well.

title: Nice retro set
text: Nenbic's set of vintage image postcards is good for mailing, framing or using for a journal art page. I've used them for all three. The quality of image is good. The paper quality is solid. All in all, a nice set of cards.

title: Good size when space is limited
text: The way that my home desk is set up, my back is to the wall and the window to the side. That means that I don't see the hanging calendar and the space to my side is limited. That's why I decided to try out this CRANBURY Mini 5.5x8.5" Notepad Calendar 2020-2021 (Impressions). The size is perfect for the open space to my side. The art theme is pleasant. Most importantly, it is easy to read. So, for me, it works well for my work space.

title: Saves time
text: This stencil set from Sunny Streak is quite generous in the amount. I only use a couple of the stencils and they are a big time saver for me. I'll probably use more of them into the next quarter. They are fairly sturdy and easy to clean as well. Definitely worth the time to try it out.

title: Mostly good
text: Given the 50 count, I'm okay with some of the pens in this Linc Pentonic Premium Ball Point set being inconsistent. For the pens that work, the ink looks great on the paper and it is exactly why I like ball points best of all. Again, the 50 count, when I run into a pen that isn't working as well as I'd like, there is another that does so I think it balances it out.

title: Knew what to expect
text: I think it helps that I knew what to expect when I selected Marrywindix's keyboard holder. I knew that it wouldn't be a 'clear' acrylic so I wasn't disappointed. It works as I had hoped which is that I like my keyboard at an angle. I also like that the lip goes all the way across so it keeps the keyboard how I like it. In the end, the function is what I was looking for and this keyboard holder functions as I need so it works for me.

title: Flexible in its use
text: Skeleton Clip's hollow binder clip has a lot of uses. I selected the large size so I can use it to hold a journal page in place. We use it in the kitchen as food clips. I also use a couple clips to keep the window sheer panels up to let the morning breeze into my work area. The hollow design helps 'hide' the clips so they aren't so noticeable. I'm glad that I tried these out and with the price point, I'll definitely keep in mind for future purchase.

title: Key is to use it
text:
Budget planners, or budgeting period, is stressful. At least for me but this Life & Apples Budget Planner is making it more clear, even if it isn't making it less stressful. The main reason to try it out was to help me organize. The pandemic has added a lot of uncertainty so what I got away with in the first quarter of the year is no longer applicable. Winging it, doesn't work. So anyway, I'm trying to buckle down and this planner helps. It is undated so you can start at any month. It has the 'how to use' pages which is worth a look. I haven't done the vision board page because I'm not yet clear on my vision except to get control of my spending and prioritize, but it is there for those who want to use it. There is also a page for Goals. It has 4 blocks for goals if one has goals for the time period of tracking. Then it goes into the Month and it keeps it simple. There's the month page with goals and gratitude and focus and notes. Then there is a monthly overview, a monthly budget, 2 pages for expense tracking and a monthly summary. If one is uncertain of how to use the different pages (overview and budget can seem like an overlap), just go back to the "How to use" section at front of planner for clarity.

All in all, it is simple to use and doesn't have distracting clutter. My personal bullet journal is where I put all my planning and scheduling so if that gets a bit cluttered, I'm fine. However, the budget planner is where I want clarity and simplicity so this works for me.

title: Works okay
text: I followed the directions of the Gorilla Removable Mounting Putty and while it worked in some instances, it didn't work in others . It was pretty even at 50/50. Gorilla generally has a solid product line so I'd say to take my rating with a grain of salt. It does need to be a light item. The instructions mention up to 2 lbs but I'm not sure on that. The surface also makes a difference. It worked great on our fridge, but not so great on our walls. To be fair, I suspect that is due to the texture on the walls as we've had similar issues with Command hooks. So it works okay for us, but for others, it may work better.

title: Great for journaling
text: I like these Hallmark Stickers for my daily journaling. The border stickers are particularly nice. It is a mix of fun and pretty. It is a nice collection.

title: Nicely packaged and presented
text: This set of Gartner Studios Guided Journal 3-Pack of Guided Journals for Fitness, Gratitude and Reflection is great as a set OR it can be broken up and gifted out. The journal that I am keeping is the fitness journal because I really like the food log. I just like how it is set up and the room provided to write stuff down. A lot of food journals really skimp on space to write for food. I do like the gratitude and reflection but I feel like there is a bit of overlap even though the format for each journal is different. I just feel like I would end up repeating myself. I ended up giving one to one family and another to a different family member. They are enjoying it. They like that it is undated so they can skip if they want to, but they are finding that it is easy when they think of it as 'me-time' to get their thoughts down. They look and feel good to use.  Again, it can be kept as a set but in my case, it was nice to give out a couple of the journals and the recipients enjoy using them.

title: Working quite well
text: The S SMARTOMNI Compatible Toner Cartridges Replacement is working quite well for my HP printer. It was packed responsibly. It was easy to install. Instructions were provided although it was fairly intuitive. Then the printer was up and running. I'm satisfied and pleased with the product.

title: Simple and easy
text: I've got some fancy clips for chip bags and such, but sometimes, simple and easy looks and works best. This pack of 12 bag clips in varying sizes works as expected. They look good in a simple and functional way. They aren't fancy, but they do the job and that's enough for me.

title: Works for us
text: The Nnewvante Lap Desk Bed Tray works for our household. It was selected so we had something sturdy to use when we aren't by a desk or table and this fits the bit. It is also good when I'm practicing lettering or watercoloring when I use the angled desk. The only thing that I wasn't so keen on was that some of the small parts didn't quite fit, but I was able to work around it. All in all, it works well and we like it.

title: Fun and humorous
text: This Fred and Friends DAILY SAMPLER, Assorted adds some fun and humor to the day. There are some cards that I wouldn't use at work but most are appropriate for the work place. Size is good for the desk and it is easy to read. It would make a nice gift too.

title: Makes chair seat more comfortable
text: I sit a lot so my tailbone has had pain that comes and goes. If I forget to get up and take breaks, it gets especially bad. I now have reminders to get up but to help reduce the pain, this Coccyx Seat Cushion for my office chair does help. The cushion works well. It fits the seat as hoped. I do wish it was just a bit thicker but overall, it does make the chair a lot more comfortable and that is what I had hoped it would do.

title: Satisfied
text: This set of VITOLER Retractable Erasable Gel Pens (Clicker, Fine Point) work quite well. The "eraser" works well. The ink is even and consistent. It does seem closer to medium point than fine point but that's fine by me since I prefer medium point. So I'm more than satisfied with these pens.

title: Nicely organized
text: The DebtorEdu Budget Planner is a nicely organized planner. It is undated so while it does have separator pages with a month labeled, the month can be written over and again, it is just the separator for one section (monthly budget). It can get overwhelming but one can always focus on what is most needed. For example, weekly spending is my abyss so the monthly tracking is what I focused on after setting my monthly budget. I'm just starting to look at the savings goal section. So what I like about this planner is that it can be used in bites. I do have a few minor quibbles but it is mostly personal preference thing rather than workflow or organization related. It is worth a look for anyone struggling to get their budget under some kind of organization.

title: Nice support and lovely graphic
text: iCasso's Keyboard Wrist Rest and Mouse Wrist Rest Pad set offers nice support with a lovely graphic. The memory foam has enough support to keep the wrists elevated, but not so stiff as to create different set of aches. A bonus is the peony pinks against the black. It makes for a pop of dramatic color on my otherwise boring desk. I am really enjoying this set and it has convinced me to be more mindful of using keyboard and mouse wrist rests.

title: Love the colors
text: I love the colors in this ZEYAR Flexible Tip Highlighter set. The pastel palette does well for highlighting either book or journal. I also like the finer tip. I didn't think I would use the fine tip but I am really liking it. Generally, I don't have much opinion on highlighters (except I don't like if they are too dark) but this set shows when there is a difference, it is worth noting.

title: Writes well
text: I haven't been using ball point pens of late but now that I am using this Paper Mate Write Bros Ballpoint Pens (medium in blue), I wonder why I had stopped. Using this Paper Mate ball point pen is a treat. It is easy to hold and it writes so smoothly. My only wish is that was the click-type instead of having the cap because I lose caps so easily; however, that's a very minor quibble. Writing with this pen is so nice that I want to get more ball point pens.

title: Like the format
text: I like the format overall for this undated planner by Penguin Planner. The cover is sturdy. The paper has a good thickness so I don't worry too much about bleed thru. The undated format gives me flexibility should I miss some days or a month. For the months section, it is 6 undated months so I'm presuming that the daily pages match up to that 6 month count but I haven't checked as yet. I quite like the daily format. It goes to 2 pages and covers quite a bit (to do, water, health, gratitude, etc). I also like that it lays flat which makes it easier to write in. I have one minor quibble that I prefer the month to be separator for the daily (month then daily; then new month and daily) but that's a preference. Otherwise, I really like this planner.

title: Good for writing and sketching ideas
text: This A5 Dot Spiral Notebook (pack of 4) is good for writing, note taking and sketching ideas. The weight is 80 gsm so it doesn't seem meant for dual pen brushes or anything that can bleed through to another page. However, I did need notebooks for note taking, writing, and sketching with ball point pens or pencils and these notebooks fit that need. I like the dot pages because they help me with format and organizing thoughts/ideas. The size is good for desk or travel. I also like the plastic covers for protection. These dot journal/notebooks are modest and functional and just what I needed.

title: Simple and useful
text: With the need for portable pencil sharpeners, I selected this 4 piece set of Manual Pencil Sharpeners. I liked the colors in the picture and the colors look good in fact as well. We like that the unit is self-contained in that the cover to the insert is attached. The shavings are contained and can be dispensed when it gets full. The container section is clear enough to easily see when it is full. I like that there are two pencil insert sizes. This is just a really nice, simple and useful product.

title: Very nice journal
text: The RETTACY Dotted Grid Notebook/Journal looks great and it is a treat to use. I wanted to use it for myself but another family member in my household needed a journal so I offered this journal to use. He really likes it and generally he doesn't have opinions on journals. He uses the journal for a variety of things: art sketching, writing, note taking while out, reminder lists, etc. So it has been getting a lot of use. He doesn't have an opinion on dot journal vs lined, but the weight of the paper is something he noticed and appreciates. He also likes the A5 dimension. This is a brand that I haven't seen much about, but I'll consider for future purchase.

title: Variety is what works for me
text:
There are a few things that I don't like about this Floral Sticky Notes Set. I don't like the adhesive residue that is left on the pieces which is interesting because the adhesion is so-so.

Those two things aside, I like the variety of colors and shapes. It gives me options on how I want to use the notes so it works for me.

title: Functions as needed
text: Rayliad's Black Metal Magnet Board functions as needed. It was easy to install and simple to use. The black color also makes for a nice bit of dramatic color on the wall which is a nice bonus. The board provides a sturdy spot to use magnets which stay put once on the board. This was a nice selection and definitely worth the try for what I needed in my home office area.

title: Good print and adhesion
text: These labels retain a good print and the adhesion is solid too. The amount of sheets in the package will last awhile too. So far, it hasn't caused any jams in the printer and that's usually something I encounter with printing labels. These labels may not be from a familiar brand (for me) but I like them and I'm glad that I gave this brand a try. I will definitely consider for future purchase.

title: Really enjoying setting up the new planner
text: I had another dot journal all ready to go as my new planner for the upcoming quarter but I ended up using it as a journal to practice lettering and sketch out pages for the upcoming quarter. That change was partially because I received this 2 pack set A5 Dotted Bullet Grid Softcover Journals. I like that these journals have index pages. The paper weight is a good weight so there isn't much bleed through. I am learning to have a lighter hand with certain pens so that helps. I like the softcover but mostly, I like that it lays flat which makes it easier to write in. I like the black cover because I like black, but I am really liking the pinkish-rose cover so I am glad they came in two colors. I'm glad that I decided to check this product out. I'm looking forward to using it from index to the last page.

title: Nice desk set
text: This Simple and Neat Set of 5 desk storage organizers is great for home. With light teal color, I wouldn't be comfortable with it in an office setting, but for the home office, it works well. The items are sturdy and a good size for the home office. I like that it also comes with hardware to hang the basket on wall. I do think the letter sorter is a just bit small but otherwise, the set is functions as expected. Again, a nice set for the home office.

title: Clamp was unusable but
text: I've been hesitant on how to review this product. Firstly, I couldn't use it as advertised because two of the clamps were unusable due to the screws not fitting. That said, I love the panels as a desk protector. They are a nice thickness. They are easy to clean. So while I am not using them as originally intended, I did find a practical use for the panels that I'm pleased with.

title: Paper takes it to 5 star
text: This Journal Kit Starter Set - A5 Dotted Spiral Notebook is really nice. The stencils are good. The pen set is also great. I really like the plastic front and back cover for the protection and providing extra stability for writing. Yet it is the paper in the journal that really took it to 5 stars for me. The paper weight is so good. I did a pen test with all my various pens, highlighters, and even some Sharpies and the bleed through was nearly non-existent (Sharpies are sharpies after all). The surface was so smooth to write on as well. I'm currently using it for my 'thoughts on journaling' (aka lessons learned) and also for hand-lettering practice. It works so well. Usually I don't like spiral bound journals/planners but I can overlook for this one because the benefits (lays flat; easy to write in; etc) outweigh the costs (rings snagging) and again, I love the paper in this journal. The paper in this journal really made me notice how good paper can make a difference.  I am so glad that I decided to take a chance on this item.

title: Like the size and print is readable
text: The thing that I like best about this 2020-2021 Desk Calendar - 18 Months Desk Calendar is that the print is easy enough to read (good print weight) that I don't need my glasses to read it. Of course, I need glasses to read my writing but that's on me. But for the calendar itself, I don't need glasses because the print is easy to read. I also like that the border pattern changes from month to month. That's a nice touch. The size of the calendar is good as it gives a good amount of room to write in the date boxes. Paper weight is good too (not too thin and not too thick). Overall, a great desk calendar.

title: Looks great whether stacked or side-by-side
text: This JIARI 2 Tier Letter Tray Metal Stackable File Holder Organizer (in Rose Gold) looks great whether stacked or side-by-side. It is sturdy and stays put. I like this set.

title: Easy to use
text: AmazonBasics Soft Grip Style Correction Tape is a standard style correction tape. It is easy to use. One of the tapes is a bit loose but I was able to fix that. Otherwise, it works as expected.

title: Like the look
text: I love my Clever Fox food and exercise planner so when I saw this Clever Fox Password Book with tabs, I figured to try it out. It looks good and it is simply organized. I like the size of it in that it isn't too small so it is comfortable to write in and read later. It is a simple concept that is helpful and useful.

title: Really nice journal
text: The Wordsworth 2020 Undated Planner-Organizer Business Academic Journal is a really nice journal. I'd even call it a luxury. The packaging is very well done so it is a ready-to-go gift. The size is great for me in that it isn't too big but not too compact either. I am glad that it is undated because I sometimes combine weeks and days if not much is going on. It is a bit pricey which is really the only reason why I can't quite give it a 5-star; but it is worth it if one has a bit of change to spare on it.

title: Feels good when writing
text: This Sharpie S-Gel, Gel Pens, Bold Point (1.0mm), Blue Ink Gel Pen feels good to hold when writing. It is smooth without needing to put pressure on the tip. It is a bit thicker than the regular ball point and I rather like that. Overall, a pretty nice pen.

title: Love these tabs
text: I'm on record already as really liking Avery's re-positionable tabs. I have a preference on size, but these Avery Mini Ultra Tabs at 1" x 1.5" in the Holographic Jewel Tone Colors are also so good that I can't give them anything less than a 5-star. They are re-positionable and they last awhile. I use them in my journals and planners or anywhere I want to mark a page. They don't leave a residue. They are sturdy and easy to remove. The colors/design catches the eye. They look nice too. I love using them. I know regular post-its work too but these have become my standard.

title: Love the functionality and the sparkle
text: I really like the re-positionable tabs like this Avery Margin Ultra Tab, but this particular item makes me feel spoiled. I like the sparkle because it is pretty so it is great for journaling. I like the width because it makes it easy to catch my eye. I like that it is easy to move but it doesn't fall off either. It stays secure until I move it. I know I could use post-its notes but I really like these tabs. It is a nice treat.

title: Fun to use
text: A blank journal can be a food journal, but what I like about this Clever Fox Food Journal - Daily Food Diary is that it is fun to use. I think that is because it is well formatted so I can log all the info that I need to track. For me, carbs and fat is more important than calories but with this food journal, there are columns for all three plus serving size and protein. It has breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks. There is a line for actual total vs target totals. One can track moods, energy, activity, water, etc. I mean, it fits a lot in a page and it does it without looking cluttered. It is a little pricey but as I've been using it, it is well worth the price for me. I've tried another diet journal that I liked a lot and is more affordable, but if I have the extra money, I would prefer to get this journal.

title: Sturdy and functional
text: I like this Kyodoled Locking Security Cable Cash Box with Lid Coin Tray. I don't really use the cable but it does work fine If needed too. Mostly, I like that it keeps the bills secure. In fact, you need to be a little careful about the metal bars that secure the bills. The springs are very lively and when the bar snaps down, it snaps down quickly. I am fine with it but it did take me by surprise at first. The coin lid is also good. The lock is easy to use as well. Overall, it is sturdy and functional.

title: Nice set with good room for expansion
text: HJSMing 6 Pack Expanding File Folders has a nice amount of room in the expansion. I like the colors for organization. The length gives some versatility (ex: not limited to letter size). The snap enclosure works well too. It is easy to wipe clean and it fits in a standard tote bag. All in all, it is a nice set with good room for expansion.

title: Very sturdy
text:
This PAG Wood Desktop Holder/Organizer was easy to put together but what impresses me is how sturdy and substantial it is. It does not move once it is put in the place of choice. It stays put.

I have the retro brown which I really like. I didn't think I would because it is fairly dark but it contrasts nicely with the lighter wood items around it. I like the drawer as it is big enough to be functionally useful. There are 5 slots which can be used for folders, magazines, etc. I could use it for mail but I don't get enough mail so I use it for a mix of magazines and folders. It works quite well.

title: Like the blue fabric
text: I like blue fabric pin board of this BEST BOARD Pin/Bulletin Board. It is very striking. I also liked the size of the board as it gave a lot of room. The aluminum frame, however, was a bit weak so it was dented when received and it is a little bendy. That said, I'm not going to moving this board around a lot. It is on the wall and it'll probably stay there until I get tired of it and/or want to use that part of the wall for something else. So for me, this works fine and again, I like the blue fabric of the board. It is a nice change of pace.

title: More convenient than I had expected and a perfect fit for me
text: I didn't really have expectations of this folio cover. I just really liked the color that was available which is "PInk" but probably closer to a 'denim' purple (if that makes sense). Regardless, I really liked the color but now that I've been using it for almost a month now, I love it. It is way more convenient than I thought it would be. I have a few other folio covers but they are zippered and I like them yet the zipper is a little annoying when it gets stuck. This folio isn't zippered but the cord fastener works great. Much more gentle on my hands. The compartments are good as well as generous. I like the clear compartment. That one does have a zipper but it isn't bad because I don't have to use it if I don't want to because there is also a pen loop. And, of course, the size fits the journal/notebook size that I most prefer. Overall, this folio is a perfect fit for me.

title: Useful and looks great
text:
I am really liking this LIZIMANDU Sturdy Cardboard Magazine Holders, Folder Holders (6 Pack, Assorted). Yes, I could get the plastic folder holders but when those type of folder holders get older, they get dingy but being plastic, it isn't eco-friendly on disposing. So this set as cardboard really piqued my curiosity.

I like the design of the two Van Gogh prints. It makes it visually pleasing. It was super-easy to put together. It is mostly sturdy but the cardboard does have some weight limits. I'm good with that and it works for me so it doesn't affect my overall rating but it is something to keep in mind. I use the holders to help me keep journals and books corraled on my desk so I don't expect the holders to be moved. I just wanted organization, a pleasant visual, and when it is time for the holders to be disposed, it is eco-friendly. These holders meet all 3 requirements so I'm quite pleased. I think if those are another person's considerations, then this set is worth a look.

title: Like the format a lot
text: I like the format a lot for this Bliss Collections Blush Floral Daily Planner Tear-Off Pad. I'm not as sure on the 'tear off pad' design but it isn't deal breaker for me because it is clearly labeled as 'tear-off pad' so I knew what I was getting. The main thing though is that the format of the daily flows well. It is undated so I can use when I want to. Perhaps I only need it for a 2 week stretch to stay on top of a project and I want something enjoyable to fill out. The pretty design makes it enjoyable and a treat to look at. It makes me want to check out if the company has other items for planning.

title: Good quality
text: I like the size of the Taotree Yellow Classic Dotted Bullet Grid Journal Notebook. I like the bright yellow of the cover. It has a good amount of pages for how I use journals as a planner. They have a good quality so they work as a part of a gift bundle and the price point for the pack is fairly reasonable as well.

title: Nicely made
text:
Even though I'm using more of the bullet/dot type journal, the journal with unruled pages is still my preferred type and that is what caught my eye about this Blank Journal Notebook A5 with Unlined/Unruled/Plain Pages. There are so many options on how to use it.

In particular, this journal has good weight on the pages. It advertises that it is non-bleed and so far, that is holding true. I like the dimensions of the journal in that it gives a good amount of space without being too big and unwieldy to tote around. This is a nicely made journal and well worth the look.

title: Like the color
text: File folders are file folders so the thing that I like best about the AmazonBasics File Folders is the burgundy color. It helps it to stand out and it is a nice pop of color in the office. Otherwise, it is good basic file folder and that too is appreciated.

title: Nice and convenient
text: Since I've gotten more into journaling, I've started looking more into items like GoldenSunny Calendar Stickers. These stickers are great for journals and notebooks. It gives more flexibility that planners with printed months. I'm more a daily planner type person so these stickers are great for reference but don't take up much space. I also like that it is designed that it makes a tab for easy page catching. Simple item, but so nice and convenient to use.

title: Great gift idea
text: The EASTHILL Big Capacity Pencil Case is a storage case for multiple uses. It can hold pencils, pens, markers, phone, a bit of make up, etc. It keeps its shape well. I like the light pink colored one that I received because it stands out in the bag. It is easy to grab. I like the versatility of what it can hold in an organized fashion. It is great as something to keep but I think it makes a great gift idea for someone who is still in school or just does planning and journaling (like me).

title: I like this one
text: I like the journal that I received. I like the amount of pages. I like the size of it in that it fits a previous year's planner holder so that holder (which looks really good) doesn't go to waste. I appreciate that. I don't know if I'd use the pockets inside the covers but they are nice to haves. I do like having the pen/pencil holder as that is quite convenient. I look forward to using this journal.

title: Great desk organizer
text: I really like this desk organizer. The compartments are easy to move. The magnet functionality works great in that the compartments remained fixed to the base until moved. Each compartment is used as needed and I just like the way it looks on the desk with its clean and simple design.

title: Works better than expected
text: The PUNCIA Expandable Bookcase Desktop Bookend Stand Holder Adjustable Book Rack seems meant for children but it works great for me and I'm adult. I like to keep an abbreviated collection of books near my desk area, usually reference books and this works great for that grouping with some software and the 'to be read' group that I need to get done sooner rather than later. The accordion functionality is a bit tricky at first when expanded to max length but I think I've got the hang of it now. I rather like it as it works a lot better than I had expected.

title: Good amount of paper
text: This AmazonBasics Engineering Computation Pad has a good amount of paper. I like the dual side. The paper is fairly sturdy. The graph is a bit blurry but not unusually so. All in all, it works as intended.

title: Nice giftable bundle that one may want to keep
text: This plaid and penguin writing bundle with pen is a really nice gift bundle. The small notebook is perfect to tote around. The two notepads are attractive to keep on the desk and have a good amount of paper. Also they are all a good size for note taking. I like the graphic design too of the penguin with a plaid jacket and the plaid border. It is neutral gender, looks pleasing and make for a great gift for the office.

title: Pretty and functional
text: The pendant(s) is/are rather heavy but at least I can always find it. Otherwise, I really like the FEELSO Badge Holder Reel Retractable. The retractable functionality is what made me want to try it and in that sense, it is exactly what I wanted. The clip stays secure. The length is good. The pendant is pretty. All in all, I think it was a worth the try.

title: Nice variety
text: The Yoobi Gel Pens 24-Pack (Pastel, Metallic, Neon, and Glitter Shades) is a great set of pens. They are great for journaling and planners.  It is easy to hold and it is consistent in quality. I also like the packaging because it was easy to open so it is easy to continuing using as a container. Overall, a really nice set with good variety.

title: Makes a great gift
text: The gift box for this Heart LEATHER JOURNAL Handmade Writing Notebook 8x6 Inch Unlined Diary was sturdy. It made the diary/journal look every more appealing. The journal does look good and is a good size with ample amount of paper. I have a couple others like this one and I do like that the one I received wasn't stringy. Overall, it looks good with a bit vintage vibe to it and it would make a great gift.

title: Just right size
text: The Yoobi Blue Journal is just the right size to carry around in a purse. I like the ribbon bookmark and the elastic to hold the journal closed. I also liked that it is lined. Not that I mind dot journals but I prefer lined journals. It isn't too thick or too heavy so it is nice and portable.

title: Practical and useful
text: I am finding these Avery Ultra Tabs Repositionable Mini Tabs very practical and useful. They work great as bookmarks for books and planner(s). I use them a lot for my planners. Because they can be re-positioned, they are re-usable so one packet can last awhile. I haven't noticed this item before but I'll try to keep in mind because I quite like it.

title: Fun and colorful
text: At its core, the "I Adulted! Agenda Undated Calendar: Stickers for Grown-Ups" is a simple weekly planner/calendar. What makes it fun is the different sayings that are on the facing page and the stickers that match them. I think I'm outside the audience target range because there are some sayings that I didn't quite get (ex: "I swiped left") and one that seems a little questionable (the homeless one is peak privilege), but overall, it is fun and colorful.

title: Love the format
text: I have a lot of journals and while I don't consider myself an expert on journaling, I do have some favorite styles. This Blue Sky Undated Weekly & Monthly Thoughtful Journal, Bookbound Cover in Mint is different in format but I love it. At 5.75" x 8.5" in size, it is perfect to tote around in the bag. It isn't a daily planner which is fine because I have daily planners and I like how the weekly pages flow. On one side is guided sections (ex: This Week I Want To Do and there is a "More" and "Less" section) and on the facing page is free text. It is simple yet effective. I like the monthly pages format as well, but it is really the weekly format that sells me on this journal.

title: Pretty and soothing colors
text: I like the size of the Blue Sky 2019-2020 Academic Year Monthly Desk Pad Calendar as in 17" x 11". It has two holes at the top so while it is a 'desk pad' calendar, it can be hung on a wall. That's how I am using it. I like the soothing color combination with the water color flowers. It looks classy and tasteful while also being functional.

title: Holding steady
text: It is nice to have a shredder in the house again and so far, this Fellowes Powershred P-30C Cross-Cut Shredder is holding steady. We've had it about a month now and it is doing the job with good cross-cut shredding. We've used it for paper and credit cards. It says that it can handle staples and paper clips, but I'm so used to taking them off that I can't bring myself to try that out. Based on past experiences, It says that it can go 6 pieces of paper, but I try to limit to 3 pieces of standard paper. If the paper is thicker, then I limit to one at a time. It is a home shredder so I think this is sufficient. It is a bit loud but that's to be expected. It doesn't have a sensor activated and at first, I was disappointed but now that I've had the shredder for awhile, I think I prefer the non-sensor. I don't know how long it can go because I try to keep the shredding limited to short periods. For my household, this type of shredder works for us.

title: Looks good and holding up well
text: I've had this Birch Vintage Leather Pencil Case with Zipper for awhile now. It looks good and is holding up well. I like the color for this particular one (burgundy) because it makes it easy to find. The material is pleasant to touch. It is longer than I expected but upon review, the longer description does mention that it can be used for art supplies too so that makes the length make more sense and given some of the stuff I tote around (brush pens and such), it works out for me. It is one of those nice-to-have items but once you have it, the item is convenient and makes life a little easier.

title: Fun to use
text: Now that it is finally August, I can start using this Orange Circle Studio 2020 Medium Spiral Planner, August 2019 - December 2020 (in Floral Vines Pink). It is a fun and pretty. I like how the pages are organized. I really like the water tracker because I do track my water intake. I do wish the text print was just a bit darker but that's a personal preference. The space in the weekly days is also a bit small but that's due to the tracker, tasks and goals section also on the page so I'm okay with it. I use a journal for expanded daily notes so it works out for me. All in all, this is a really nice planner and I'm glad to be using it now.

title: Folio cover is what makes it
text: This Orange Circle planner and cover hook is the cover which is really nice. The planner itself is fairly basic in that it has the months and then the weeks. I like that the month and weeks are plain and uncluttered so I do like the planner. That said, the zippered cover is what really sells this set. It is soft but durable with an attractive floral design. As long as the planner fits, it can be re-used as well as it isn't limited to the planner that it comes with. I quite like it.

title: Cute and sturdy
text: The llamas on the Studio Oh! Extra Large Hardcover Spiral Notebook are cute and whimsical. This sturdy notebook comes in 6 designs but I have the 3 llamas and I like it. A notebook is a notebook and it functions as expected but cover art is a nice bit of color and humor to look at during the day.

title: Great set
text:
I'm doing more and more DIY projects and that includes sewing. My first quality fabric scissors was a Fiskars and I had it for decades until it disappeared during a move to a new place. Now that I'm back to more crafting, it would make sense to try a Fiskars set if it became available.

Honestly, this set reaffirmed why Fiskars is a quality brand. The scissors is the win for me. It is so smooth, but the item that is the 2nd most used is the seam ripper. I forgot how convenient this little piece is when wanting to take out a hem. Measuring tapes are always good to have and I do like the size of the acrylic ruler. The thread snipper is a luxury for me. I still default-by-habit to using the scissors but I am trying to remember to use the thread snipper, because it makes a nice clean cut so the thread doesn't fray. All in all, this is a fantastic set and it is helping me to stay motivated with my sewing/DIY projects.

title: Working well for me
text: I've been so into planners that are set up for weekly planning, but I really like this Blue Sky 2019-2020 Academic Year Monthly Clutch Planner, Round Flap Cover, Bookbound, 5" x 8" (in Black). I like that it is bookbound because rings can get caught in stuff. I like the magnetic clasp so I don't have to struggle with the clasp to close or open. It is a good size for a purse that is an actual purse rather than a tote bag. Mostly though, I like the design. It is a monthly planner so there are the 12 months for the academic year (starts with July and ends in June). It is then followed by blank pages with lines with checkboxes. I love it. It can be used for notes or as a to-do list or both. I have a little notebook that I use as a daily planner and between the two, I have my on-the-go planning in hand.

title: Like the color combination
text: Now that it is finally July, I feel like I can finally do my review for this Blue Sky 2019-2020 Academic Year Monthly Wall Calendar. I like the soft colors of this monthly calendar. I like the size of the pages and the boxes for the days. I like that it isn't cluttered with distracting images. The hook bar slides a bit loosely but if it really bugs me, I can always take it out. The main thing is that it works for me and it does.

title: Simple and effective
text: I didn't think that this keyboard stand would make a difference but it really does make it more comfortable to type. It is easy to clean and I like the clear look of it. The wireless keyboard that I have fit easily onto the stand. The stand stays in place. Honestly, it works great. So simple and so effective. I'm glad that I got to try it out and now I want one for work.

title: Erases well
text: One of the issues I almost always have with dry erase boards is that erasing isn't always that clean. So far, this BESTBOARD Mini Dry Erase Whiteboard with Stand (10" x 10") has been doing well in that aspect. I like the dimensions and I like the stand. The double-side is also nice although I haven't had need for it yet. But mostly, I like that erases cleanly. I'm very impressed by that.

title: Fun to use
text: I really like this Vintage Large Heart Leather Journal Embossed Travel Diary. I'm not too keen on the lock lever. I thought I would be, but it loses its novelty after awhile. That said, I can't knock that feature too much because you know what you are getting. Other than that, it is a fun journal to use. The paper has a vintage vibe yet at the same time, it isn't precious. In fact, it encourages use and creativity. Another plus is that it has a decent amount of pages while still being a good size for portability. I'm glad that I decided to give it a try.

title: Shelves a little bendy
text: The AmazonBasics 3-Tier Metal Rolling Cart was very easy to put together. I also liked the dimensions of the cart. The color is a basic black which is fine. It really is a basic item and that is okay. The only thing that I was a little concerned with is that the shelves are not as stiff/sturdy as I expected. In the subject line, I wrote " a little bendy" and I used that phrase because when I was inserting the shelf into place, a couple of them bent without much pressure. It was easy to unbend but it also means that I have to keep in mind what I put on the cart. Generally, I don't want a crowded cart so I should think of it as incentive to keep the cart uncluttered.

title: Like the size and paper weight
text: What I like about this Studio Oh! Hardcover Leatheresque Spiral Notebook is (1) size in that it doesn't take up a lot of real estate on the desk yet it is allows a good amount of notes too; and (2) the paper weight is a little thicker than usual so there's no bleeding into the next page. There is a minor quibble is that cover can get a little "stuck" in the rings at first but it loosens up with wear. I do like the linen type feel of the cover so that minor quibble is offset nicely. It is giftable (as in it would make an addition to a gift-pack or basket) or just to have for oneself.

title: Pretty collection for gift
text: Hallmark Notepad Bundle with Pen, Pretty Pinks is a pretty collection for gift. The pen reminds me of the Cross pens that I used to get for Christmas and I loved them. The color coordination is quite feminine so it would make a nice gift for Mother's Day. The bonus is that each item is useful so it is a pretty collection that is useful. I love it.

title: Paper quality is great
text: What I like best about the Hamelin College Ruled Notebook Single Subject Hard Cover Double Spiral is the paper quality. It is thicker than regular spiral notebook; the white is crisp so the writing stands out more; and it just feels good to the touch (smooth and clean). It does take good photos via phone camera although I don't intend to do that. It is a bit pricier than I would normally be willing to pay but I'd consider it now that I've had a chance to use one these notebooks. It really is nice to work with.

title: Like the size and that it is undated
text: Given the rainy weather of late, there is a limit on how 'all weather' protection this Rite in the Rain All-Weather Weekly Planner, Undated can cover. That's okay by me because for the most part, it does what I need. I like that it is undated so I could start at any time. I like the size of the planer (4-5/8" x 7") as it makes it easy to fit on a bag. It has a nice, easy layout of 7 days plus a notes section. It isn't fancy but it does the job.

title: Works well for most part
text: I have a few quibbles about the Pilot Explorer Fountain Pen Gift Box (Medium Nib, Blue Barrel, 1-Pack, Black Ink). I like the style. It was easy to get working. The packaging makes it a quick and classy gift. It writes mostly well. That's probably where the few quibbles are. It is writes well on most surfaces but there's been a few that it isn't as smooth. It also bleeds a bit. I can work with those things and it may just be me. Overall, I like it and it is worth a look.

title: Like the size
text: I like the size of this Summit Tools Dual Storage Aluminum Clipboard. The memo size is perfect for how I wanted to use this clipboard. The storage is decent in that it is just big enough to use but not so big as to overweight it. It is works well for me.

title: Simple to use
text:
What I like about this Blue Sky 2019 Weekly & Monthly Fitness Planner Journal is that it is small enough to carry around and it is simple to use. The month and weeks are together with the month tab for easy access. Each day is meals, water, activity and activity focus. The activity focus is a little hard to read but it is the same for each day so it becomes routine. I like the weekly goals section too.

All in all, it is a nice planner for fitness. I do wish that the print was in a darker color so it is easier to read but again, it is a routine thing so once you know what it says, it is the same thing every day or week.

title: Simple to use and store
text: I use this IM LIVE WT01 Lap Desk for a variety of things: a tray for food and a desk to write and/or read in a place other than a table or desk because sometimes you aren't at a desk or table and you need a flat area. It has a good area; it stays stable (as long as have the levers correctly set). I also like the groove where I can put my Samsung Tab A so I can read or watch something while I'm eating or working. When I'm not using this lap desk, it easily folds up flat and can be stored away under or on side of bed or under/side of couch. I like to keep it where I can see it so I can grab as needed so I appreciate how little space it takes while folded. This is a nice item to have as it is easy and convenient to use and store.

title: Love it
text:
My handwriting skills have gone down to the pits so I was a little worried when I selected the PILOT Kakuno Fountain Pen to try out. I though I'd get frustrated and it would drip all over and I'd give up.

That's not what happened. It was fairly easy to put together with the simple instructions. Once the ink was in, it was easy to write with. Now to make it write nicely took just a little more time because, as mentioned, my handwriting isn't what it used to be but this pen writes so smoothly that it inspires to improve quickly.

I've had the pen for about a month now and I love it. It writes smooth. It is pretty precise too which is surprising and it dries so quickly that it doesn't bleed out. I like the clear casing as it makes it stand out from other pens. Currently, this is my favorite pen. I'm glad that I tried it out.

title: No residue stickiness where I don't want it
text:
I haven't had the best luck with sticky note bundle sets. They've often had a sticky residue on the top area of the notes while not having the right level of stickiness on the expected area. So when I saw this JARLINK Colored Divider Sticky Note bundle Set, I hesitated to try it out.

I'm glad that I selected it in spite of my misgivings. This sticky notes have the right stickiness on the expected area so it sticks to the pages that I place it. It also doesn't have a sticky residue on the top portion of the note so it feels clean to write on.

I like the size of the notes and the tabs. I like that one of the notes sticks has the dotted face like a dot journal while another is blank and the third has lines. It makes for a nice variation in use. The tab placement does make it a little limiting but that's a minor quibble. Overall, I really like this sticky note bundle set.

title: Fun and useful
text: I am addicted to planners and journals so when I saw this, I wanted to try it out. When I received the STMT DIY Agenda Set by Horizon Group USA, I thought it was cute but maybe too cute for me so I gave it to one of the younger family members who is in 7th grade. Her mother, who is also into planners and journaling, was happy to have her daughter try it out to encourage planning her day and such. She's had it for some weeks now and loves it. The agenda book is nice and she likes the stickers, pens and other items to help give each day a bit of pop. It is fun and useful.

title: Quite fun once the letters were pried loose
text: Once I got the letters looks from the plastic that they were fastened to, this Rustic Distressed Felt Letter Board is quite fun and also quite on trend. I've seen this type of bulletin board on DIY and room styling videos. It does bring a bit of fun to the room. I like this particular board's wood frame and the easel that it comes with. It definitely fits a rustic decor but it is plain enough to fit a modern or eclectic decor. It comes with a lot of characters to use and at 12"x16", it is large enough to not fade into the room but not so large as to be overwhelming. I'm quite glad that I got a chance to try this out as I like it a lot.

title: Nice size journal
text: I am a sucker for planners and journals. I like the size of this Hallmark Coral Softcover Journal (Details) as it fits nicely in my bag. I'm generally not a pink person but I like this coral pink shade because it makes it easy to find the journal in my bag. The cover has a nice feel and the paper pages have a good weight to them. I like that it has a place to put a date and also a left margin. All in all, it is a nice journal that is the right size to carry around.

title: Aesthetically pleasing planner
text:
It was the cover of the Blue Sky Noteworthy 2019 Weekly & Monthly Planner and Notebook that caught my eye. It is a pretty floral design. The wire binding isn't too bad either. Sometimes when the wire binding is too big, it can get in way of writing, but this isn't too bad at all. I've realized that I'm not too picky on whether the layout is vertical or horizontal as long as the layout isn't too cluttered. The layout is that there is a tab for the month that is followed by the weeks. I do like having the month closer to the weekly. I had another planner that has the months separated and while I like the weekly layout, that separation was slightly annoying.

The weekly pages are laid out with the Mon to Sun days horizontally laid out on the left page for the weekly and the facing page is for Personal To Do List, a Weekly To Do list and Goals. I like the three sections although I find myself using the Personal To Do List for notes and just using the Weekly To Do list as a to-do list. I'm using the Goals area to track goal(s) from week to week.

This is an aesthetically pleasing planner to me which means I'll use it. It is simple and functional while also being pleasing to look at.

title: Liking these rulers
text: I decided to get these rulers when I saw a youtube on journaling. Given the price, I thought it was worth it to try and I'm really glad that I did because I like these rulers. The size and sturdiness are great. I also like the colors as they stand out from the usual clutter. They are also easy to read when I'm using them for measurement. All in all, it is one of my better impulse buys.

title: Convenient and erases well
text: The Quartet Magnetic Weekly Planner Dry Erase Board (11" x 17") fits perfect on the refrigerator so it encourages meal planning. It isn't too big so we are able to keep it brief and to the point. It erases well too which I appreciate. All in all, it is something that I've always looked at but thought it wasn't needed, but now that I have this item, it is really convenient. It also stays put and doesn't move around while still being easy to take off the fridge for cleaning. We use it for menu planning for the week but it can be used for other activities as well.

title: Very happy with this printer
text:
I was hesitant on selecting this HP Laserjet Pro M148fdw All-in-One Wireless Monochrome Laser Printer with Auto Two-Sided Printing, Mobile Printing, Fax & Built-in Ethernet. It seemed a bit too big and maybe a bit of overkill because who the heck faxes these days? (Answer: More than I thought or so I've been told.)

It is a bigger printer than I have had at home in a while. That said, I have had it up for a month now and I love it. I don't ever expect to use it for faxing, but I feel fairly confident that the faxing functionality is solid because everything is great. Honestly, I love this printer. The WiFi connection was simple. It doesn't keep asking me for the WiFi password which drove me nuts with my last printer. The installation/connection to my PC was easy. It sits in a common area so others in the house can print to it. It prints in really good time. It connected with my phone quickly. I know I'll probably go pale when I have to buy another toner cartridge but I think it'll be worth it because it has made working from home, as well as sharing the printer with others in the home, so much better. A bonus is that it isn't distractingly noisy. I'm sure if I was right next to it, it might seem noisy but from where I work, I can barely hear it and that is really nice.

I haven't had the best luck with HP (mostly PCs) over the last couple rounds, but this printer is really nice. I'm really happy with it.

title: Already plugging in info for new year
text:
I wanted this AT-A-GLANCE 2019 Weekly Planner / Appointment Book because it has a time schedule at every 15 min mark. Since I track how I spend my time through the day, this seemed a good format to try again. In the past few years, I have preferred to use planners that don't have the time schedule printed but I've learned that I need at least one planner with the appointment format for use at work so I could track meetings and appointments as well as mark my activities through the day.

This planner does that for me. I'm already adding my known meetings for the 1st quarter of the year. Visually, it is nice to see how it blocks out and I can start planning projects and activities. This isn't a fancy planner but it is an effective one. A bonus is that the red is energetic and easy to find even if the desk gets cluttered.

I really like this tried and true format and I'm glad I decided to try it once again.

title: Like the mission focus
text:
I've seen a lot of planners of late given that we are heading to the end of the year. I think I do have a bias of late for simplified planners with just a few extras. I give extra points if a planner doesn't include 'contacts' pages because I never use those pages and it ends up a waste.

The good news is that inkWELL Press 2019 Weekly & Monthly Planner doesn't have the 'contacts' pages so that earns a star already. I do like the font (a sort of ArtDeco font). The colors are soothing although the print is on the light side. Still readable, but I prefer the print a bit darker. The layout for weekly and monthly is functional with lots of space.

The monthly spread has room to write for each day and has a Top 5 Goals section and a Notes section. Very simple and useful. It is followed by the mission focus page and notes/daily tracker. After that is the weekly pages which follows the horizontal format. Sometimes, I think I prefer horizontal format and sometimes, I'm into the vertical format but it just depends on what I'm using the particular planner for. This will probably be a to-do planner. The sections are big enough to write some to-dos per day (with notes) but not so large as to over-do it.

There are set up tutorial videos on line at inkwellpress's website but you have to put in your name and email address prior to access so I passed on it for now. It seems pretty instinctive on how to use, but perhaps there are some tips on organization that may be worth looking at in the future.

All in all, it is a nice planner. It has some nice extras but isn't too cluttered. I like the size and that it lays flat with a wire binding that doesn't get in the way of writing. It does have a higher price point than the standard office monthly/weekly planner, but if you like the look and the extras, it may be worth a look.

title: Works for home desk
text:
My home office desk has frame that the top sits on that comes down farther than my previous desk so I couldn't push the keyboard/mouse tray fully under the desk. When I saw this Alloyseed Under Desk Keyboard Tray, Clamp On Removable Ergonomic Keyboard and Mouse Drawer Platform, I thought the design would work for my desk and it does.

It has a decent weight to it which I like because it feels sturdy. It was easy to put together and clamp on to the desk. AND, it slides fully under the desktop so when I am not using the keyboard/mouse, it is out of the way. That is great because it allows me to use the deskspace more efficiently. I can't say much about the ergonomic features because generally, products that purport to be ergonomic are often uncomfortable for me, but I like how this tray works. The desk is a bit high for me and this tray is just the right height for me to comfortable work. Overall, I'm quite pleased with this product.

title: Great for streamlining document sorting
text: As I try to continue organizing and streamlining the documents in the house, this C-Line Rainbow Document Sorter (Letter Size) is a help in that direction.
