I like this tape dispenser. The color is really beautiful and it looks nice on my desk. I bought it to use in flat lays and to hold washi tape. The washi tape roll fit perfectly and it does a good job of cutting it, though you do need to be paying attention since it doesn't tear as easily as regular scotch tape.
Overall, great value for the look and function you're getting

title: Good Quality Gel Pens
text: Nice and glittery and the colors are all beautiful. Ink flows smoothly too

title: Great quality at an affordable price
text: For years i bough small sets of 3 or 5 clups from the store. For some reason i never thought to find a box like this, for lass money than i normally pay i got so many more clips than i normally wouldve gotten!

title: Absolutely love these
text: So many more nibs for a cheaper price than other brands like speedball and so long as you take good care of your nibs and keep them clean they can last years! I did have a bit of an issue as i received stickers or something at first by mistake but it was worked out and fixed really quickly <3

title: Great alternative to the canon brand
text: The one downfall to the printer i love is that the refil packs of ink are so expensive. So glad i found this cheaper alternative!

title: So nice to hold!
text: For years I had a set of speedball brand nibs and holders and honestly didnt like using them because my hand would hurt after a while. When I saw this I hesitated because I didnt want to invest in a supply I rarely used, but I'm so glad I did! The thick barrel and cushion grip are amazing and wonderful and I love how it can fit both standard and crow quill or maru nibs! I've used this with many pieces now and honestly can just sit and draw with my wrist and hand not straining! I wish I bought this sooner and will definitely stick up on a couple more soon!!

title: Smaller than expected
text: Each of the books are smaller than expected, but I'm still very pleased and my toddler absolutely loves the books and the carrying box!

title: Highly recommend!
text: The title claims to be a value set, and its absolutely right. These refills are from Japan and I paid less for this twelve pack than I would have for a 2 pack of refills at my local art store.

title: Wonderful pen!
text:
I've been wanting one of these pens for a couple years now but can never find them locally for less than $20. Alas, I scoured Amazon and found plenty that we're rather affordable! I wondered how this pen would stand up to my Copic Gasenfude (I use it so often it's beginning to dry out) and was surprised to find this is just as good if not better! I still prefer the copics barrel and weight in the hand, but that pen isn't refillable and the Pentel pocket brush pen is!
I was disappointed to find out even though it says "pocket brush pen and two refills" the barrel of the pen is empty so it's actually only one refill. And it's pretty juicy so depending on how often you use it you can potentially burn through a lot of ink. Most of the ink refills I've found are two pricey to even consider. But if you look specifically from Japanese companies, you can find a x12 refill pack for less than this pen costs. Which is amazing.
I've been using brushes and brush pens for years and this may be my new favorite -fingers crossed-

title: The company is great!!
text: I ordered these pens, and honestly upon arrival was disappointed to learn a handful of them were dried out and didn't work. I still have my review 5 stars and pointed out I didn't regret the purchase seeing as the rest of the pens work great. I do a lot of illustration and have been using black fine liners for years, so having a set of colored fineliners was amazing and even though some of them didn't work it was still a great deal and I still had a lot of colors to work with! After my review, I received an email from arteza apologizing for the inconveniences and they sent a full replacement set! Not just the ones that didn't work but all 48! I seriously don't know many companies that would be so generous and they definitely get 5 stars from me and a referral! <3

title: Great Printer!
text: Excellent printer with many features. Prints good quality and quickly. Love the reverse, back side printing.

title: Good Ink!
text: Nice ink quality. Would be nice if it lasted longer for the price.

title: Perfect for Professional Artist Work!
text: Love this tape. Doesn't tear the artists paper when removing. (NOTE: When applying, don't use heavy pressure on the paper itself. The pressure should be applied to the board only and light pressure on the paper to assure the tape doesn't tear or mare the paper.) Works well over medium for blocking. Can be reused if placed used tape on plastic wrap.

title: Saves Time Wrapping Meat Products
text:
This paper cutter works well with the butcher wrap butcher paper purchased. Easy to load and tears clean. Makes handling raw meats easy as paper rolls smoothly from dispenser and is quickly ripped away.

Be sure and insert the paper roll with the paper rolling over the roll. The roller will not cut if the paper is inserted with the paper rolling underneath the roll.

The cutter is not sharp, however, this should not be used by children as the roller is spring loaded and could catch fingers.

Excellent product and worth the money!

title: MICRO ERASER
text: Micro eraser and gets dirty quickly. I would not buy again.

title: Perfect Pinch
text: I bought these to use on my painting easel to hold canvas in place, and as a hook to hang some painting supplies such as the drying cloth. They were also surprisingly useful to clip open the pages in my music books. Then I discovered they were an awesome addition in my sewing kit as well as keeping my embroidery thread separated. Good product with many uses.

title: Strathmore got it so right!!!
text: Until recently, my watercolor hobby art was tucked away in journals, on stretched cotton canvases stacked in my art room, and few set aside as gifts for close family and friends. My “ inventory” had sizes that were perfect for card making, and decided to purchase Strathmore Photo Frame Cards to display and protect my artwork gifts, and I was not disappointed! The cards and envelopes are made from a high quality paper. The frame is very sturdy and ample enough to easily slide your picture into the pocket. I am so proud to offer my artwork, snuggled and protected in this little nest, as a gift to very special people in my life. I also plan on using these photo cards for my 2022 Christmas Card collection and as gifts.  These photo frames are as beautiful as the treasures they hold. You will not be disappointed. Happy crafting!,,,

title: Save your money..
text: They are made of cheap paper and half of the envelopes were glued shut, and the frames are a joke. The “frame” part is glued so close to the opening that you cannot slide a picture in. I trimmed my beautiful watercolor so much that the sides were now showing. Save your money. Now I need to go through the hoops to return this junk.

title: Very poor quality product...makes your great product look inferior and junk- like. Never again.
text: These are very poor quality...the paper they’re printed on is cheesy, the graphics are not consistent, and no matter what pen is used, IT SMEARS. Save your money.f

title: Perfect, just perfect!!!
text: Initially I purchased 1 table to see if I liked it and guess what?.....I bought 5 in all different colors. These tables are amazing. The colors are vibrant and clean. (you didn’t need to try and figure out their color)  They are very sturdy and the 4 foldable legs provide ample room for even an average sized adult can sit comfortably on the floor with their legs under the table. I bought these for myself and 4 grandchildren so we could do arts and crafts on each table...and each with materials suited to their age. We also use them for snacks while watching a movie and for doing homework on while meals are being prepared in the kitchen. This table would be great not only for everything I mentioned, but also for an adult work station, e.,g., laptops, tablets, and ample room for note taking aside your devices. This table has a very generous top area and can be used comfortably for all sorts of projects including coloring your favorite pages, needle felting, hand sewing projects, paper piercing quilt project, sketching, water coloring, painting your fingernails, beading, polymer clay and play dough projects...and the list goes on. It cleans up nicely and has a low profile for storing after the legs are folded in. It feels good in your hands, right out of the box, and not some chintzy item that you are afraid to handle. This versatile table is a gem. I almost want to buy a few more for gifts for my “crafting” friends. They will love it, just like me! 😃

title: Beautiful and Vivid Colors!!!
text: I purchased these markers specifically for my ribbon embrodiery projects. First of all, these colors are FABULOUS!!! Really true to the color they represent. The tip is quite firm, so I wanted to test how it holds up when you write a word on a piece of white cotton.... which is a suggested fabric color as well as a fabric type. It worked beautifully, and you could really use these pens to write elegant script or a comedic font for a more lighthearted purpose.  But for me, and back to the beginning, the silk ribbon, which I will be using for these ribbon projects, did not yet arrive, so I used a polyester ribbon instead. It did not bleed into any area not touched by the marker. And while that is a good thing to expect in most fabric markers, I was hoping it would bleed to some extent so I would be able to merge colors in flowers made of silk ribbon. Perhaps the outcome will change once I try it on the silk ribbon. Keep your fingers crossed!!!

title: Slightly tricky to close/open.
text: The strap gets a bit caught when closing/opening the cap. I have to pay attention to move the strap with the cap. Otherwise it works great. Sturdy hard plastic, unbreakable.

title: Beautiful finish
text: The pearlescent finish is lovely and will make great cards. Mine pack arrived in excellent condition.

title: Postcards, not greeting cards
text: Normally I read the reviews but I saw the pictures and I thought they were nice. I am crafty so I can convert these into folded card.

title: Tribute to the masters
text: This boxed set is so nice that I don't need to buy a separate pencil case. The color are grouped according to the master's dominant color scheme. They lay down color well. The Cezanne box does contain a typo, however. On the inside cover, the colors and numbers are printed. The eighth color is Smyrna blue, but apricot is listed. There is no apricot in this set. Cerulean blue is also misspelled. Cerulean is spelled with an "m" instead of an "n." I swatched the set and some of the pencils had crumbly leads. Overwise, it's a beautifully boxed set.

title: Could be better
text: Whatever happened to the old days when you set up a printer via USB cable and just print? This printer is fine in Windows 10 but horrible in Windows 11. I have to use the print app, which I do not like. It took forever to set up. I cannot print from my computer. I have to store the document in my smartphone first, then print.

title: Love it!
text: I already had one but it was smaller and did not have the drawer. This size fits everything I use - printer paper, pens, markers, ink cartridge, tape dispenser. The round container of paper clips, push pins and two sizes of clips are also the rose gold color. It's perfect on my secretary desk.

title: Nice pens
text: 23 is an odd number to pack in bulk. These 6-in-1 ballpoint pens are really nice for all sorts of projects. They are great to use when tracking different activities and want to color code each one. Each color is vivid and easy to see. They make a nice gift to a child or a project manager.

title: Love it!
text: I love this rose gold color. It's gorgeous! The color is a perfect match for my desk color. The slots are just enough for my pens and pencils, printer paper and other items. This is so useful in reducing the clutter and organizing on my desk. So nice!

title: 12 pencils for good price
text: I got 12 pencils in this pack, so it is a good value for those of us who love to color.

title: Good for home use
text: The first item I shredded was a credit card. It didn't shred in ribbons and I had to run it through a few times. It shreds paper well. I didn't have a CD to shred. The unit is small and fits nicely in a corner by my work area. I don't think it's very noisy compared to office shredders. I will feel better shredding sensitive or personal documents instead of just tearing them up.

title: Good quality cards and envelopes
text: I don't have much to say since there is only one theme in the box. The paper is good quality card stock for the cards and the envelopes. I love the bright deep red! The sentiment is short and generic, so it can be used by many faiths. The color scheme is muted and restful with just the right amount of gold. Very nice!

title: Work well for me
text: This pack is two of each color. I use them on a 11"x14" whiteboard. They write and erase well. Only yellow is a little hard to see, but I do not plan to use it much. If they last long enough, this is a good value for the price.

title: Great learning tool!
text: I am a new piano student and I want to improve my sight reading skills. I can practice drawing my staves and associating them with the two octave keyboard below. I can use this draw my notes and write their key letter without wasting a lot of paper. The board erases nicely with no residue. Great value!

title: Definitely multi purpose
text: The box bills these as multi-purpose. I did not intend to use them as chip clips. They are too nice for that. I will use these as weights when I use my circular knitting machine. They help create more tension which tightens the weave during knitting. Very useful.

title: Interesting color shifts
text: I thought these were different color combinations but they are all the same. Kids would find these a lot of fun.

title: Love this pencil!
text: I love Faber-Castell pencil products. I have the Polychromos and Albrecht Durer colored pencils. Now I have a very nice pencil with a built-in sharpener for either writing or sketching. The pencil already has a very sharp point. I wish I could find refills but we'll see what becomes available.

title: Nice for keeping music sheets
text: This is most useful for keeping music sheets. The spiral binder makes it easy to turn pages and not have to hold them down. The plastic sheets are easy for inserting and removing pages. The full page size means I can store standard size paper on which I have printed music.

title: Beautiful cover
text: The leather cover does not have a strong smell! The leather is soft and the color is gorgeous. The embossed nature is relaxing to look at. I got everything the product description said. However, I am replacing the brown paper with white and a calendar.

title: Attractive and portable
text: I love the color, a deep orange that looks brown. There is a deep pocket in front and a belt loop inside. The binder inside is covered by a soft brown felt-like fabric and it  is secured outside by a stretch band. It's small, so there is a limit to how much I can carry. At first I thought this might be bulky but it fits easily in my purse. This is so nice and I want to carry it with me always.

title: Nice selection
text: The set of four different photos ensure that I won't give the same card to everyone. I can choose based on my recipient's tastes. They are of sturdy card stock and quite colorful. I have enough for two years, so they are economical as well.

title: Great phone foe my mother
text: My mother suffers from hearing loss, so I ordered this one. She is on the phone talking again and can hear everyone. She doesn't care about other functions. She only wants to hear people over the phone and this helps a lot.

title: Soft around my neck
text: I got this pattern to match my Vera Bradley purse. It feels soft and not scratchy against my skin. It has two ways to carry cards, a lobster hook and a ring. If I needed to, I could release the clip in the back if it won't fit over my head. It is a more stylish way of wearing my ID.

title: Beautiful case!
text: I got the one with the parrots. So colorful and so pretty!

title: Vintage look in sturdy leather
text: This bound notebook is of interesting design, more for the Harry Potter fan. The color is a little darker than I like, but it is still a handsome notebook. The pages are stained dark and are blank. I can keep notes, sketch or do other things. My regret is I gave this four stars because I agree with another reviewer. I love lapis lazuli and I believe the cabochon on the front cover is not real. It looks nice, though.

title: Fine writing pen
text: I prefer EF nibs, but this one is just a midgen thicker than my EF nib. The ink cartridge in the pen is definitely violet and the ink flows well with no bleed. Getting five total ink cartridges for this price is a great value. I would like to order more colors.

title: Flows great!
text: These work well in my Platinum Preppy. Started flowing and writing within a minute.

title: Love EF fountain pens!
text: What I received was definitely a EF nib pen. It writes just the way I like.

title: Works well with large pencils
text: I got this to sharpen my Brutfuner 120 square colored pencils. It works well without chewing up or leaving marks on the pencil's body. It was a great value since I got three sets of replacement blades and a manual sharpener that closes so the dust does not leak out.

title: Exactly what I needed
text: After moving into a new house, I needed to file and store so many documents and bills. I feel we will be a paper society for many years to come. Therefore, this type of file folder is necessary. I can file my papers and add document dividers so I may find things later.  I appreciate the ease of storing and organizing.

title: Lovely color
text: This is not an opera rose but more like a purple with a red undertone.

title: Great for colored pencils
text: I got this on the advice of an art instructor. She said it was perfect for Holbein colored pencils. I am pleased with being able to adjust the sharpener's point and save some money by not sharpening too much.

title: Beautiful sheen!
text: The set I received is really awesome, especially on black paper.

title: Reduced wrist pain
text: I have an ergonomic mouse but I had no support for my wrist. After using it for a month I can already a reduction in carpal tunnel pain. Plus, the pad is attractive and comfortable.

title: Nice set
text: A little expensive but very nice. They are just the right size for my journaling needs.

title: Beautiful set!
text: These look so much better than the photo. It is a gorgeous and colorful set of magnetic bookmarks that I am already using. If you wish, you can color coordinate your books because of the variety of backgrounds. Plus, having so many is good value for the price. They would make a wonderful gift.

title: Very pretty!
text: This is a gorgeous case for my PrismaColor pencils.

title: Fits Hongdian Fountain Pens
text: I have three Hongdian pens and these fit all. Good value for the price.

title: Shimmering teal
text: I tried this ink in a Moonman S5 with EF nib. It flows well and I can definitely see the shimmer. It was the best price here for this size bottle.

title: Beautiful pen!
text: Mine is not as colorful as the photo but it is still a beautiful pen. It is value for money because of the extra nibs and the eyedropper for filling the pen.

title: Beautiful gift!
text: This is a great set and not just for beginners. The blue box is nice for presentation and it holds five inks in plastic bags to prevent any staining in case there might be a spill. The colors are green, orange, red, blue and brown. The green is a little dark, not grassy green. The orange is deep and not too bright. The red is more like a cerise or cherry, very pretty. The blue is more like a turquoise. The brown has a tint of red. I like this selection of colors. The glass dip pens are pearlescent colors, one is green and the other is multi-colored. The tips have the expected amount of scratching when writing but not annoying. The ink flows very well from them both. An open ink well and a pen rest are also included. It would make a nice gift to anyone interested in glass dip pen writing.

title: Great pens!
text: I like to swatch my pens so I can have a visual reference of what the colors actually look like on paper. I like that they are numbered on the top of the cap clip. This makes it so much easier to find the refill when needed. The ink does take a while to dry, but the colors are lovely.

title: Convenient size
text: My desk does not have a lot of space, so this mobile printer works fine for me. I watched some videos on how to set it up and decided the wire setup was easier. Installing the print head and cartridges were easy and I was up and running in less than 15 minutes.  I allowed time for calibration. I don't plan on doing much printing, so the small footprint saves room for documents. One reviewer said ink usage was a problem, but I don't think it will be for me. If you go mobile, this would be a great printer. It is very light and should fit in most totes or large briefcases.

title: Most useful!
text: My bathroom door and closet door handles bang against each other in such a way that makes me cringe. These gel pads are perfect for protecting them. They are a little large, so I cut one down to a size just larger than the handles. They still bang against each other but the gel pad prevents any damage.

title: Decent case
text: I bought this case to protect the printer while not using. The printer is not portable, so it will not be carried anywhere.

title: Users outside US may have a problem
text: I so looked forward to getting this printer. However, I am assigned overseas to the Middle East and I cannot access the software for my mobile devices. I will have to wait until I return to the US in a few months. In the meantime I downloaded P-Touch Editor 5.2 to my laptop. It saw three devices instead of one, so I called Support. They were very good about helping me through the process. My helper was familiar with my issue and gave me the best instructions for setting up. For now, I must use my laptop. I was able to print a few things, black&white and color. I must say that I like this printer a lot. I will be glad when I can download the Color Editor app and use that.

title: Not perfect but pretty close
text: This printer is not really tiny but is small enough to fit in a purse or briefcase. It was not difficult to pair with my tablet. I spent some time playing with the app before actually printing. If you want to print address labels, notes or just about anything, this is easy to use. I will try printing on fabric and using a fabric medium to make it permanent and washable. If it works, I will update the review. Overall, it is an expensive gadget, but handy because it does not need paper, only ink. I also got the case for portability.

title: Nice selections for #1 and 2
text: The sets of three are a nice set of backgrounds for the printer graphics. These are great for enhancing anything like journals, art books, cards, etc.

title: Fits my e-Mark perfectly
text: Feels like a sturdy case, padded inside. I wish there was room to carry the charging cord, but still a good case to protect the printer.

title: Not useful to me
text: The product is supposed to have four pieces but I got only three. They do not fit my pens.

title: Nice vintage look
text: There is only one picture for all the cards but it is very nice. It has a vintage look and I tend to like old-fashioned style cards. Inside the sentiment is simple and I can add to it if I wish.

title: Semi-transparent ink to add to set
text: The full set does not come with white. I think it should be included even though there are artists who do not use white. I find it essential for blending pastel and pale colors.

title: Shows up great
text: It seems to work best on tonal or dark paper. You can really see it. I can mark on plastic or craft paper to blend with a color to make a pastel or dusty shade.

title: Great eraser!
text: I have several erasers, batter operated and manual. This performs just as good as the others. However, I do like the rechargeable feature in that I do not have to carry extra batteries and I do not have to worry about their disposal. I got lots of extra erasers in both sizes, so I should not run out any time soon. I like to shave the end to a pencil point to erase finer areas. It is definitely worth keeping in my coloring kit.

title: Perfect for small laptops and tablets
text:
I love the print on this case. It happens to match the print on a summer jacket I have. There are all sorts of storage pockets inside. If stored right, I could fit a small laptop, a tablet, a paper notebook, cords, and accessories so long as they are not bulky. The back has a zipped pouch that runs the long length of the case There is also an outside pouch in the front, but I don't think that would be useful if the case is carried by the handle. Perhaps adding a strip of Velcro inside would keep the contents safe.

Update: I ordered some heavy duty Velcro for fabric and put a strip inside the outside pocket. It holds like a charm, so now this pocket is useful.

title: Best for preserving documents
text: I use these to carry anything I want to preserve while transporting in my purse or briefcase. I am glad they have a matte finish to prevent glare. The sheets are sturdy and should last.

title: Beautiful pen but not reliable
text: There was a price drop on this so I quickly ordered it as I have wanted one for a while. Until now I would have said that you cannot go wrong with owning an elegant black fountain pen. I really like the brushed black body but the writing quality does not measure up. I used quality paper to practice with. The fine nib writes the way I like but it skips, making it unreliable as a daily writer. Perhaps I can train this pen to write better. If I can, I will update this review.

title: Beautiful planner but not the same as the others
text: I believe these planners are different based on their motif. This planner has dashboard monthly dividers. For each month the inside pages have habit trackers, monthly goals, check it off, noted, top priorities and gratitude sections covering two pages. The next four pages are daily tasks divided into six sections per page. The last two pages are notes - full lined pages. The motif fits the vintage botanicals stickers. The rose gold metal discs are lovely. I added Daily Schedule half pages, some rainbow foil note paper and a folder to hold other documents. I feel this planner is more mature and vintage. I also have a more colorful planner which I will keep for its daily calendar pages.

title: Nice pen but no rest enclosed
text: The pen is pretty and mine does not scratch when I write. However, I did not receive a rest, so I gave it a lower score.

title: Awesome collection!
text: The photos do no justice to this stunning collection. There are colorful stickers as well as black&white. This is definitely one of the best collections.

title: Refitted in classic planner and they work!
text: I have the classic size planner with small pink plastic but I wanted to expand the size to fit more paper for note taking. These expander discs are metal and come in two each of gold, magenta, lavender, green and one purple. Since I did not like the gold, the other nine discs fit fine. These will easily hold a whole 18 month planner and extras. It takes a little time to replace the planner discs, but it is worth it. The width of the discs still fit inside my Happy Planner gold tote.

title: Colorful and fun way to plan and time manage
text: I love the splash of color on the cover and the colorful pages throughout the planner. The laminated covers are sturdy and should hold up to a lot of wear. If you do not like this theme, you can order DIY laminated covers to create your own. I see now how addicting this can become with using stickers and accessory tools to accent appointments, holidays and special days. I use mine to plan for both business and personal days. There is plenty of room on both the monthly/daily and dashboard pages to add notes and reminders. I also added a pen tab to the back cover so I will always have one available.

title: These are pretty nice!
text: I like the variety of colors that can match a number of books and covers. I also like the linen-like texture. A good value for the number of tabs in this set.

title: Sleek writer
text: I wanted a slim fountain pen to keep with my checkbook. This pen is much slimmer than the Lamy Logo. The pen's logo is very low key. "Lamy" is written on the top right side of the clip. The pen has a steel nib. The nib is supposed to be interchangeable but mine is not. The black EF nib would go on and I did not want to force it for fear of damaging the pen feed. I filled the cartridge with Diamine Aurora Borealis ink and it writes very well. Another Lamy pen to add to my growing collection.

title: Love this convenient two-pack
text: The two stencils are great for adding a checklist directly onto the date instead of off to the side. It is for when a sticker does not fit or is just not right for the occasion.

title: What what was needed to organize family projects and trips
text: We wanted something to help organize the family trip. This is great to storage our passports, tickets, activity reservations, and anything else we need. There are two pockets, so we can store the cell phones and iPad in one. The D rings let us add sheet protectors, tabbed folders and extra storage pouches for pens, pencils and paper clips. It's large but not heavy or bulky. I can carry this easily by the handle. The diamond weave design is nice and a subtle way to add texture and color. This binder will get a lot of use in my family.

title: Love the slim fit in my hand
text: I was hoping the pen would be the color in the photo. It is actually light brushed silver. The pen comes with a blue-black cartridge that I have been using for over a month. The pen writes smoothly and is reliable after flying, no leaking. I am usually pleased with Lamy fountain pens and this one lives up to my expectations. Highly recommend!

title: Good tool for paper trimming
text: This is a basic paper trimmer that works well. There is an inch/centimeter ruler on the cutting side and an angle ruler opposite. Small rulers are on both ends. The transparent cover lifts for paper to slide under. The blade makes a clean cut effortlessly. A great tool for my office to cut A5 paper to A4 size. The plastic body feels a little flimsy, but this will not get hard use so I expect to last a while.

title: Now this is a beautiful pen!
text: I always wanted a Sailor to add to my collection, so I ordered this after reading reviews on other web sites. I can say that what I received came in a sturdy gift box with two cartridges. The pen is a little smaller than I expected  but the body was without a flaw. It is elegant and the nib is gorgeous. I am still waiting for my ink to arrive, Noodlers Borealis Black. I cannot wait to try this!

title: Lovely shade of a darker rose
text: Lovely shade, just a little darker shade than Black Swan in Australian Roses. Flows well in my Noodlers Konrad Coral Sea.

title: So far, perfect!
text: The pearlescent blue is really lovely and somehow complements the coral. The piston filled on the third try and the nib writes more like a fine rather than a medium. The cap posts fine and helps the balance. At first glance, this is a nice pen.

title: Basic but colorful
text: This is only a monthly calendar with a notes section down the edge of the page. It is enough to note appointments and to jot down short reminders. The cover is a little heavier and durable than lesser quality planners. It is thin, so it should fit easily into most totes and briefcases without the bulk. The back cover has an inside pocket to keep documents. Minimalists should like this.

title: Small, functional and cute, but ...
text:
I wanted a small fine nib fountain pen to use with Noodler's 54th Massachusetts ink. This pen seems perfect to keep with me. The fine point writes fine for me. I ordered a second one. I hope it does well when I fly.

Update 06/06: The nib keeps clogging, even when I use premium ink. I flushed it and refilled the converter. It seemed to work, but it does not write as wet and dark as it first did. I sill like the pen, but I need to work with it to get the best performance from.

title: Surprise color but not surprise in quality
text: How Nathan names his inks is just as interesting as the colors. This ink is either plum or burgundy tone. I got plum and I am happy with it. It is very dark for use in a business setting, but the color still stands out. I used mine on cheap copier paper. It dried fast and there was no feathering. I am happy with what I received.

title: Simple, colorful, functional
text: This planner kit has quite a few details that make it both fun and useful. Lots of stickers, motivational words, paper clips will personalize this pink hardcover planner. I am not crazy about the gold ballpoint pen, but the stamp markers are a plus. The pink one is a heart, the dark blue is a ?, the light blue is either a bird in flight or the man in the moon and the black is a thumb's up sign. It is small enough to fit in a purse or briefcase so you can take it anywhere. The tabs have months but the pages are undated, so this could be used for years or until you run out of room.

title: Compact and functional
text: This book is packed a lot of useful tools.  After the alphabetical tabs comes a monthly calendar, and pages for important information, frequently called numbers and a gift list. The binder is wrapped in cellophane to protect the finish. Can be used on a desktop or carried to appointments. Plus, refills are available.

title: Only one will write
text: I so wanted to like this pen set. The colors are nice and the nibs seem fine. Unfortunately I could get the clear pen to write. These will not work with cartridges and the clear works with the converter.

title: Good pen for the price
text: I ordered both the florescent blue/green and the amber. I prefer using a converter so I can fill with bottle ink. I put Monteverde Horizon Blue in mine. I had to wait about an hour for the ink to flow, but once it did, it wrote very well. The only thing I wished was different was that the cap be the same material as the pen body. The resin is pretty in the gradient colors, but the silver cap makes the pen look a little cheesy. Otherwise, I do like these pens.

title: Interesting collection
text: I particularly like 1-6, 1-10 and 1-11. Large enough to trace on clothing for stitching or blinging.

title: Nice pen pouch
text: It will do what I want it to do which is hold my favorite pens when I travel.

title: Nice product
text: I deducted a star because it does not look like the photo. However, it will do the job it is supposed to do.

title: Gorgeous pen!
text: The photo does absolutely no justice to the amber pen. I do not normally use a medium nib, but I liked the look of this one so much that I got it. It does actually write a little finer than other medium nibs. For ink I am using Monteverde Canyon Rust, another gorgeous color. It took a while for the ink to start flowing. I deducted a star because it does not write reliably on smooth paper. It works well on paper with a stronger tooth. On smooth paper the pen tends to skip. I thought about swapping the nib, but I like the design of the kangaroo on the two-tone. This is so pretty, so it is a keeper!

title: Exactly what I needed
text: I have a growing pen collection and I like to look at my babies all together. This is large enough all of them and it holds all sizes and shapes. Unlike some other reviewers, mine did not have a smell when I opened the bag. It is a fingerprint magnet, but I swipe them off with a soft cloth.

title: Versatile brush pen set
text: I ordered these by mistake as I wanted the EF fountain pens. However, these have come in very useful. I am using one as a highlighter with Noodler's Year of the Pig yellow highlighting ink. I can make a fine line or press harder for a broader line. These are good size pens and I normally do not post the cap. They stand up to cabin pressure when I fly, very important as I am a frequent flier. Sheening and shimmering inks can be used in these for caligraphy. Very nice!

title: So far, writes well
text: I filled mine with Noodler's 54th Massachusetts, bluish black. It is a nice color in the clear pen. I gave this a 4 because the nib is not as fine as I would like. Still, it writes well and does not leak under airplane cabin pressure.

title: Really nice pen!
text: The real thing looks a little different from the photos and videos. It is a dark almost grape color. Under my lighting, the matte finish appears to have a sheen. The resin body makes it lightweight for long writing sessions. I am still waiting for my violet ink cartridges to arrive, so I am using Monteverde Gemstone Amethyst ink. The pen and the ink work well together. I have no scratchy nib and my ink seems to flow well. Overall, I like this pen.

title: Lovely color!
text: I guess I got lucky because I ordered vibrant pink and got it. It matches well with my pen. The color can be confusing because it does look more like a pink-purple rant than a pink. Still, it is a gorgeous color and so different from my other purple. No feathering or bleed-through on better quality paper. If you want a true pink, this may not be for you.

title: Gorgeous color!
text: I ordered this pen and the matching ink cartridges. Mine writes well without scratching. I am using good quality writing paper. Both the pen and the cartridges are a gorgeous shade of pink which is more like a pink-purple. I took it on a flight with me. To my delight it did not leak or bleed. Another great addition to my Lamy collection!

title: Love it!
text:
I fly a lot and have a problem with my fountain pens leaking. I had no problem with this pen, so far. I got the .38 EF because I prefer a thin line in my shorthand writing. The red band is very pretty. I use Noodler's Widowmaker in this one. I wish this was less expensive because I would love to order more.

Update: I flew with this pen today and I am sad to report that cannot become a frequent flier with me. I stored the pen in a pouch with the nib up as suggested. After we landed and had been on the ground for an hour, I pulled it out to test it. The ink flow was completely saturated through the nib. However, it did not leak until I touched it. I really like this pen but it is desk bound.

title: Sturdy protection for documents
text: This is a sturdy plastic binder with seven file slots and a zippered mesh pouch. Tabs are included to organize by month or however you wish. The colored side is semi-transparent and the clear side lets you view everything. There are three rings to carry note paper or addition document sheets if needed. This is a handy document tool and has many uses.

title: Vivid colors and plenty of space for notes
text: This is a very colorful planner laid out in monthly sections. The months are laid out first by month with a To Do list on the left side and subsequent pages are weekly with My Day and more To Do lines. This planner can be used for just about anything like a diet tracker and task list. The paper is bright white and high quality. There are yearly calendars in the rear that go to 2022 and a planning calendar for 2020. Holidays for 2019 and 20220 are listed in the front. The monthly tabs are indigo, mint green, leaf green, yellow, pink and rose. The cover is striped in these colors. This is a great addition to any desk, but it might be thin enough to be portable.

title: Great choices for an anniversary edition
text: I like this selection of new colors. They lay down creamy when dry but are stunning watercolor when wet. Red Lake Safflower, Cobalt Green, Naples Ochre and Terracotta are my favorites. I hope to see more new colors in the future.

title: Nice set of watercolor felt tip pens
text: In this set only the broad tip black is a brush tip. The others are extra fine felt tip but not micro-fine. The colors are vivid and as far as I can see, they do not bleed through good quality paper. Inside the box there is a chart for practicing script writing with these pens. Although these will blend, the color choices in this set do not seem to work as well as if they had included a yellow and a white. One nice feature is that, on the side of the of the pen, I can see the fluid level so I will know when it is running low on ink. Overall, it is a nice set for doodling and primary work.

title: Good but could be better
text: The fine point pens write well on dry erase folders and the erasers do their job very well. However, the colors could be stronger or more vibrant. I can barely see them on dark backgrounds. Otherwise, they write well.

title: Nice but not what I expected
text: I thought these were like document protectors but they are sealed only up one third from the bottom. The top two thirds are open. They hold many sheets of paper. The clear plastic is great for dry erase pens to make notes. The ring at the top is good for office use to hang the files. I would prefer the sides were closed fully or higher up towards the top. I do not know if they are smudge-proof but they definitely resist fingerprints. This leaves a more professional finish to document storage.

title: Nice set and selection
text: Nice selection of color schemes to match a wide variety of planners.

title: Smooth and colorful
text: Very nice set, very creamy and smooth. Dry is good but wet is much better. The colors are blue violet, brown ochre, cold grey I, cold grey II, indian red, light carmine, ochre, olive green, orange yellow, raw umber, vermilion and viridian.

title: Creamy and colorful
text: Very nice set, very creamy and smooth. Dry is good but wet is much better. The colors are apple green, black,dark carmine, lemon, light blue, light orange, pale geranium lake, prussian blue, sap green, van dyke brown, venetian red and white.I have all three chapters.

title: Colorful and a delight to use!
text: Much bigger than I expected, but really colorful. I tend to get bored with ordinary planners. This one makes me want to use it! I hope a smaller size will become available soon.

title: Good idea, but...
text: I thought this would be larger and have a tray to catch the powder. It is a good idea but overpriced for what this is and does.

title: Best value, great quality
text: I got these for my mother who is visually challenged and needs a pen that prints large. Amazon had the best price for a box of 12.

title: Beautiful shade!
text: Beautiful shade of medium-light turquoise. My cartridges are not too light and show up well on white paper.

title: Great set!
text: I have always wanted this color. It is so elegant! The EF nib writes better than most pens I've used. I have other Lamys and I have not been disappointed. My pen came in a round case of matching color and a blue ink cartridge. This is a great set for travel.

title: Slim writer, smooth flow
text: This seems to be a nice pen, but it does not write as fine as I would like. Needs its own cartridges, hard to use other brands. I prefer blue-black ink which the carbon does not provide.

title: Fit my vintage pencil
text: These fit perfectly, but I do think they are overpriced for only 12 leads.

title: Good case for DS-40
text: Delivery was fast and my unit and cord fit inside the case perfectly. There is room for batteries inside the lid.

title: Gorgeous shade of blue with no green
text: I am so hooked on Noodlers colors. Navajo Turquoise is gorgeous!

title: Softer shade of deep blue
text: It is a lovely shade of blue, more for personal use rather than business.

title: Nice colors but too intense for the average coloring book
text: I got these as a warehouse deal. One color, midnight blue, was missing but I got two harvest orange which will probably be used by me more often, anyway. I tested the colors in a coloring book. I applied the color with a very light touch. The ink was pretty intense and the ink bled right through the paper and onto the next page. I will have to consider how to use these with that result.

title: Perfect for any project!
text: I got this project paper to take control and create the shapes and colors of stickers that I want. With a printer or my craft tools, there is nothing I cannot do. I can print, hand color, foil, whatever! I can cut and shape to get the maximum use of each page. Overall, this is a value and perfect for the creative mind.

title: Does not work for me-what a shame
text: Unfortunately I could not get this printer to work with my laptop. I keep getting an error message from Win10 saying the device is too old. I downloaded the most recent drivers but nothing works. I should have done more research before ordering this printer. It is a network printer that requires access to configuring a router. I live overseas and I cannot hook up a personal router to my apt building router. So, I tried using a cable. My laptop recognized the device but would not recognize the connection. Odd. Anyway, it does not work for me although I love the concept of the ink tanks instead of cartridges. If anyone has suggestions about getting my laptop to recognize the cable connection, I would appreciate it.

title: Died too soon-3 weeks
text: It was great for a few weeks. It recharged my devices through the USB connections with no problems. However, the sharpener did not last. When it worked, it sharpened to a nice point. Now it will not sharpen at all. Too bad as it was nice while it lasted.

title: Organize and de-stress at the same time!
text: There really is not much to say about tabbed dividers except that these are a nice distraction from mundane work. The dividers are in a folder, so you can look like you are working when, in fact, you are de-stressing by coloring. There is a black and a white side and the paper is heavy enough to accept different coloring mediums. So, take your favorite along to work and doodle when you can.

title: Adorably distraction for my desk
text: This is much larger than I expected. It  is adorable and a nice distraction on my desk.

title: So far, I love it!
text: I love the dark blue color of the ink. I much prefer to write with blue or blue-black ink. The point is sharp and writes smoothly. The pen feels good in the hand and is not awkward or heavy. I hope it will last a while.

title: Great color shading on a glass dip pen
text:
I heard so much about this ink color that I decided to try it as an addition to my collection. This color is phenomenal when I tried this with a variety of dip pens. Using a glass dip pen won hands down over a metal nib. The ink on the glass tip is a joy to behold. My glass dip pen writes with a fine nib and it looks great. There is bleed-through on the paper but not enough to stain the sheet under the one I wrote on. What I really liked was how the ink became like a two-tone sunset on the flutes (ridges) of my glass nib. The color is way too light to use as a daily writing ink. I would use this for journaling or artsy work for my crafts.

Update 11/22/18:

I used blue ink on a glass dip nib but did not clean it thoroughly before dipping in Apache Sunset. I accidentally made some exciting shades of green. I now have some storage pots to mix colors to get the shades I like.

title: Stunning color on a glass dip pen!
text: My bottle arrived with a broken cap, so it leaked all over the box. Unfortunately that did not affect the quality of the ink. This color is a phenomenal color of deep red. I tried this with dip pens. Using a glass dip pen won hands down over a metal nib. The ink on the glass tip is a joy to behold. My glass dip pen writes with a fine nib and it looks great. There is bleed-through on the paper but not enough to stain the sheet under the one I wrote on. If your best burgundy wine could be turned into an ink, this would be the color.

title: Gorgeous card for Mother's Day
text: This is a really beautiful card to give to my mother. She will love the colors and the little accents that make this card more special.

title: Wrong color but works well
text: I am disappointed with the color because I thought I was ordering the red and got the green, not my favorite color. I did not see the blurb about not getting a choice of color. However, the sharpener works well.

title: Does the job on a hardwood floor
text: I used mine to stop a door on a hardwood floor. There is about 1/2 inch clearance between my door bottom and the floor, so it fit snugly, I have had no problem with slippage. And, it does the job in a cute and colorful way.

title: Interesting ink for more than just writing
text: The name was so cool that I had to buy this. I was hoping to get the red Charlie pen but I got a deep blue with swirls of gold. The ink was a lot lighter than I thought it would be. It is definitely a novelty ink to use for drawing or adding colorful bits of writing to journals or coloring books. The ink dries fairly quickly and does not smear easily. It does not bleed through most paper. I tried this with several different nibs of a dip pen and notebook paper, no problem. It you want an unusual color of red, this is it.

title: Black with hints of green and blue
text: As a US Air Force veteran, I got this one for nostalgic reasons. I was hoping to get a blue black but got a black with hints of blue and green. I used a dip pen to try this and I could see the remnants of green on the nib. The size of the nib somehow affects the color. It will be fun to experiment with this one.

title: A piece of history that proves to be a great color!
text: I am a diehard fan of blue black ink and this one did not disappoint. I tried it with a dip pen with a fine nib. It writes strong but and also lay down as a softer dark blue. I am very happy to have gotten this one.

title: What a lovely burgundy rose color!
text: I got lucky and received a bottle of the old formula, which is more burgundy than purple. Not that purple would have been bad from what I've seen in the YouTube videos. However, this color really does remind me of roses. One thing Noodler's is not - mingy. They really do fill the bottle almost to the brim. I remembered to be careful when opening and not spilling any of the precious fluid. A bottle this size should last for a very long time.

title: Nice color and great value
text: I am using these with the Pilot Ergo with extra fine nib. The cartridges are full size, which is a great value for this price. Two boxes will last a long time but I will keep plenty extra on hand.

title: Love this pen!
text: I prefer to use a fine or extra fine nib for special character writing. This pen is great for such work. Some people tend to use cheap ink and end up blaming the pen for the lack of quality. I use quality cartridges to get the most effective use. I really like the clear body,the sleek design and the screw-on cap so I cannot accidentally lose it inside my purse or backpack. There is no clip on the cap but that is not really a necessity for me. The extra fine nib writes smoothly but is not too thin a line, and does not skip or scratch on the paper. For the price, this is an excellent value. I went to subscribe and save to get more for use with other colors.

title: Good quality paper
text: This is good quality printer paper I use in an inkjet printer. No problems, no smearing or bleeding. Of course, the better the printer, the better the printer. The quality of paper can make a difference. This would be a value purchase in any case.

title: Love the size and colors!
text: I bought these for fun but they can do so much! The black and dark blue inks are for business. The others are for my coloring books or for when I want to doodle. This set is small and easy to carry. I hope to find a suitable traveling case to keep them in. My set wrote perfectly. I removed the cartridge protector and placed inside the pen. I let them set for about a minute. They did not skip or bleed when I used them on cheap paper. I prefer the blue-black for work, but the apricot orange and green really pop out. The red was vivid, and the pink could easily be seen. The nib is fine but not too thin. For work or play, this is a great set.

title: Fine quality fine tip pens
text: These pens are comparable with the Staedtler triplus fineliners. There are only a dozen colors but they are quite vivid. The orange and cherry red are quite bright. The tips are ultrafine and can color into the tightest corners. These would be nice to carry around if you want to color something with only a few color choices.

title: Nice case!
text: I love the rose red color. I use this for my sets of Lyra Rembrandt Aquarell and Polycolor 72 pencil sets. There are more than enough extra slots for more pencils, blender pencils, erasers, etc. Highly recommended to protect your collection.

title: Very good collection for book lovers and artists
text: These are a  nice collection of small rulers and drawing templates that can be used to add artwork to just about anything. I got them primarily to add to coloring books and calendars. Good price for this variety.

title: Definitely a sharp point!
text: I read one review which warned that I might not feel the device when it had sharpened the pencil to its point. I turned the crank only a few times and, OMG, what a long sharp point! This was definitely worth the investment.

title: Finally, a 150 pencil case!
text: It was nice to finally find a case to fit my entire Prismacolor 150 set. Going back and forth between two cases was too cumbersome and too bulky when traveling. I think there was a note in the description that these are cases with their brand of pencils removed, which seemed like a great marketing move. The case fits well inside my backpack leaving room for other supplies. I could fit a 120 set plus another small set with blender pencils, gel pens for accents and eraser pencils. The company logo is on the front and side but that is not a problem for me. It is a canvas case, which feels sturdy, and it should last a long time.

title: Not impressed, lacking quality control
text: Maybe it has been the luck of the draw, but this is my second purchase of this set of 36 and both have been lacking in quality. I have other Prismacolor Premier pencils and they have been great. This set has weak wood casings that do not sharpen well. Each time I sharpened a pencil, the lead would break at a critical point. That made for a lot of waste, before I have started using them. The price here is better than the store but I would not buy these again. I will stick with the polycolors which seems to be of much better quality.

title: Different with each use
text:
These pencils lay down color in an unpredictable pattern. If you like to know what color is going on the paper, these are not for you. I made a swatch page with three squares and none of them was the same. Some colors have little difference except the tone-lighter or darker. Some are quite different with each use depending on what color comes up on the tip. These are probably best with mandalas and patterns.

title: Awesome pen!
text: All I can say is wow! This pen is exactly what I needed to enhance my pencil projects. I tried metallic and glitter paints, but they were too heavy. This is just enough without adding a bulky layer. I am ordering more!

title: Great gel pens
text: I have been using the Pilot G2 gel pens for years. They are very good in all temperatures and climates. These are a novel way of dressing up my notes. They are .07mm medium point and write with a broader stroke than the fine point which I prefer. These can be used for just about any type of writing, journaling and some adult coloring book work. I liked these enough to order the fine point pack.

title: Amazing sharpener!
text: I watched a YouTube video about how to use this sharpener. It did indeed give me the sharpest point of any sharpener I have used. The point is so sharp and pointed to almost a pin point. The angle must make the difference. The extra blade is nice and handy. Highly recommended for sharpening pencils to get the sharpest thinnest point.

title: 131 instead of 132 colors but a nice set

I always make a color chart on paper because, although the tin has a color chart on the bottom, it doesn't accurately show me what the color looks like when laid down on paper. I found the colors to be vibrant and the pencils feel creamy as they move across the paper. One problem is that the core does crumble easily but this is not true of every pencil. It is just that some are better than others. I got two PC0944 terra cotta pencils, which happens to be a color I may use a lot as it is quite pretty. title: Great little eraser!
text: Now that I have used this, I cannot get along without it! It works well with both dry and watercolor pencils. I tried erasing several different colors and it worked well with both light and dark colors. The residue is messy though, but cleans up well with the included brush.

title: Nice change for stamping hobbyists
text: I tend to like all sorts of electronic toys, but this one leaves me skeptical about whether I would have bought this. I have a huge rubber stamp collection. However, if I wanted to make something unique that I know no one else will have, then this would be perfect for that. There are not yet a wide variety of inks available, and it is hard to blend colors outside the bottles. This hobby will get expensive in a hurry if you do a lot of stamping and need to buy additional supplies. It could be a lot of fun and helpful for those who want the ability to create something special. The software was easy to download and install. I was using it within minutes on my Toshiba laptop using an AMD processor and running Windows 10. Overall, this is for the creative mind who wants to make a special stamp.

title: Easy to blend and erase
text: Love the softness of these leads an the colors

title: Bang for the buck
text: Enjoying the pencils and they are a good quality

title: pencils and service
text: The product was better than I expected. it arrived promptly and was of good value. will use them again. thanks to the good service

title: A seriously strong double sided tape!
text: This is a heavy-duty 16 ½ feet  of 1 inch wide double sided tape  for securely mounting on smooth surfaces such as tile, glass, plastic and steel  It is handy for around the office, home or shop for securing or  mounting signs, LED light lines, plaques, or pictures.  Highly moisture resistant.

title: Quality Journal Writing Notebooks
text: This six pack of lined Journal Notebooks are top of the line. The covers are firm and have a very nice feel to them. They have two ribbon bookmarks sewed into the spine. The is also a loop for a pen or pencil. Handy size to carry. These will help the writer or journalist keep their notes in order. Very nice quality.

title: A genius traveling, lockable document box with hanging file storage.
text: This is a two compartmental folding file case with what I would call a briefcase if it had a handle.  The two parts zip together and both have coded locks.  The bottom folds out to hold 12 included file folders complete with plastic tabs.  The top section also is code locked and has compartments for important documents, business cards, passport, and miscellaneous other mesh pockets.  Amazingly the whole case is fireproof and water proof!  This may shock you, but I using this item to store my stamp collection and supplies in my hobby room.  It works perfectly for my use!

title: This an attractive and sturdy 5 section file holder.
text: I have been needing a desk-top file folder for way too long, but the many plastic versions turned me off.  Then I found this 5 section steel file sorter that could organize file folders.  The construction for the sections is a heavy wire perimeter with a steel mesh center so you can see even smaller filed items. Then there is all the filing space contained in a 11 ¼ inch wide by 11 ¼ inch high by 7 ½4 inch deep space on my desk!

title: Love that two different sizes of tape can be used.
text: This tape dispenser is solid and looks great. The white color sets it off as a modern, sleek office supply. The fact that  it can hold two sizes of tape is an additional bonus. It is compact so even when holding the larger roll it will not take up much space. Love it.

title: A complete set of the 4 color H-P 952 replacement cartridges.

title: This has performed beyond expectations, I have to say.
text:
This little adjustable sharpener has out-performed three other sharpeners I purchased around the same time. The adjustable feature, for obtaining the varied sharpened tip shapes from sharply-pointed to almost-flattened works surprisingly well for me.

Another surprise is that I've used this with several graphite pencils from HB to 6B, as well as on some of my Polychromos colored-pencils and - while it might not be my first choice for the polychromos, it performed very well, without gumming up or clogging.

Tip, regarding breakage: I've learned to do about a half-turn of sharpening/cutting motion, backing the pencil out and turning a bit, then back in and another half-turn or so... repeatedly, minimizes breakage. A continuous sharpening motion seems to twist the lead and results in breakage - so smaller, single motions, repositioning between each one, has saved my polychromos leads a lot of waste.

I want a couple more of these to have for those "need a new tip right now" moments. It's fast and easy. I like it alot.

title: I didn't want to like these... but they are an EXCELLENT value, and surprisingly comfortable in use
text:
TL;DR:
Bottom-line, for me, they're a good value for the $. Considering they're very low-fatigue, i.e. seriously comfortable. Despite being very light, the balance is perfect - and the unique "non-slip knurled rubber grip", the only part of the _round_ pencil that has a 3-sided/triangular shape with nicely rounded edges and the rubber coat - just fits _perfectly_. Seriously, these are very nice in the hand and afford complete control. I'm buying a few more and loading them up with oft-used colors in 2mm leads - starting with gray, one 2B and the HB. I have my preferred Pentel Graphgear 1000's in traditional sizes and love them, but these guys for the price give me the 2mm coverage for sketching in a variety of materials/colors. How long they will last remains to be seen - but right now there is ZERO play in either pencil.

Desc: Labeling says "Ecofriends|2.0mm AUTO PENCIL BL-520A BAILE". Perhaps intended to mean "DANCE", as baile is the noun for a Mexican folk-style dance event, as in "Let's go to the baile this weekend!". (¿Pero, quién lo sabe con certeza?)

These are VERY light - at first I thought "definitely too light". The grip area is triangular, with rounded edges, though the tip and barrel of the pencil is ROUND. Only the grip has this soft-edged, triangular form. Pencil has an adjustable indicator for the lead type (B, 2B, 3B, 4B and HB), and IS mostly all plastic. There ARE metal parts, such as a brass-colored metal collar where the lead dispenses in to the tip and the clip. The mechanism is not ratcheting, but it does forward the lead in any orientation, i.e. it is not gravity-fed... it dispenses reliably when held point up. They are easy to advance and set a proper length with, as well as to refill.

Let's be honest - you don't expect Pentel Multi 8 or Staedler features or function for 3.49 per unit, which included refill leads. I expected them to be clunky little spares with which I could swap varying leads and have on hand (like when I want a quick 2B or 4B, or a colored lead, it'd be handy to have one loaded up).

I'm pleasantly surprised that they're very comfortable and feel natural to draw with. I'm a guy with medium-large hands, not huge; these fit my hand well - not really "like a glove" but rather "like a pen" - a very comfy pen. Don't worry, I don't write comedy, obviously, Anyway - despite being so light, the balance is perfect - and the unique "non-slip knurled rubber grip", the grip is the only part of the _round_ body that has a 3-sided/triangular shape, with nicely rounded edges and rubber coat - I wish I were writing this instead of typing - heh... they aren't going to displace my Pentel Graphgear 1000s, but the 2mm pencil is an important sketch tool, and I've been using them more and more -this one just fits the hand _perfectly_. Between the natural grip, balance and light weight - these are very low-fatigue, comfortable pencils. Precisely balanced, obviously by design, and uniquely natural grip - it's a pleasure to use these inexpensive little guys; very easy to control, e.g. switch from end-grip, sweep-shading arcs then back to normal grip for detail & line work. Dig 'em, gonna get a couple more.

Grab a couple of the "Assorted, Colored 2.0 mm Lead Refills", and varied graphite leads. Those oil-based color leads are pretty decent really - bright colors, pretty smooth and mostly consistent laydown of material (nothing like a polychromos' lead of course, but good value for the $ in lead refills).

For a small layout I've replaced several cheap "lead-holders" from an inexpensive color mech-pencil set (they were like 30-cents a piece after all). With a few of these, loaded with an HB, 2B, grey, black and a few of my goto-colors - they feel like much more respectable color mech-pencils now ;-)

Overall - these are a good value for me. They're FAR superior to the individual "lead-holder" which come in the inexpensive, multi-color mech pencil sets... you know, the ones that "noone would buy" but most of us have at least one set of - for "backup", etc.. Replacing a few of those, i.e. having a few of these comfy pencils loaded up with color/utility/special-case leads (2B or 4B, HB, Gray, Black, RGB or whatever you regularly switch to) is a pretty solid value; an inexpensive way to bolster the 2mm "goto" tools for sketch and drawing implements.

If they fall apart - which I don't expect - I will update the review I assure you. Despite being light, they do not feel even _slightly_ flimsy. Rather the contrary.

text:
This small portfolio case presents as very businesslike,neat and orderly, in black cloth, black handles, and a zipper that keeps everything together and closed. I’d estimate the size to be about 10”x13”Once you unzip this case, you find that there is a pocket that runs the entire length of the left side, and also on the left is a calculator and a variety of slots and elastic bands, and pockets to store things. In the middle, there is a ringed binder that contains several clear plastic pouches, or envelopes. The entire ringed binder is removable. On the right side of the portfolio case is a clipboard.

I love this thing, and I use it every day. On the outside, It looks very respectable and efficient, so nobody would even guess that I use it to smuggle some sketching and watercolor paper cut down to size, and placed in the clipboard, place finished pieces in the clear plastic, or keep an extra Masonite board with clip in the large pocket to use as a sketchboard.

That’s just the thing, though. It can be anything you want it to be. It’s very versatile, while also being very respectable and conservative looking.

Or, I suppose, you could also choose to pour a little ink in, and keep on the pen holder tray. There are three pen/ nib holders included. One is a bejeweled green feather quill pen, one is plain, and the third looks like a Venetian glass styled pen ( see image). I tested out a few of the inks and the smallest, most fine pointed nib and the largest. The small nib worked great, but the large one gave me a little difficulty in that there wasn’t a very good ink reservoir in the nib, which means you will have to constantly refill the nib by dipping and re dipping in the ink frequently. text: I love this journal. It has a great deal of rugged character. Reminds me a bit of the journal created and used by the character played by Ralph Fiennes in “The English Patient”. When I first saw the paper, I was a little disappointed, as it sort of reminded me of the paper towels used in big companies restrooms. But, it’s not, it’s just meant to look weathered and well worn and travelled. I’ve only just received it, but I’ve had time to test it with a wide variety of media. Anything with alcohol ink, be it marker, or paint, will bleed through the sheet and stain the sheet behind it. You may want to cut a piece of flat silicone matting to size to use as a backer while you write, draw, or paint with such media, and just keep it there until it dries. Problem solved! As much as I enjoy this journal, I realize that there are those who want pristine and perfect. This would not be for you. This journal, IMO, is for the person who is a dreamer of world travels and accomplishments. I do think this is a wonderful item to ignite creativity, whether you are a writer, artist, or scrapbook/ junk journal enthusiast. It also comes with a suede bookmark, a (single)pen case, a keychain with a tiny little journal attached, and yet another little 2”x2” journal as well.

title: Beautiful, artist grade pencils, sharpen gently
text: Recently, my husband bought me the Prismacolor Premier 36 count colored pencils. He loved the work that I then proceeded to make with them enough where he then went out pricing more Prismacolor sets without my needing to ask! When he gave me this box of 36, my first thoughts were of all the previous reviews that I’ve read about them in the past. Those that concerned me were of how delicate these pencils seemed to be. So, I kept that in mind and handled mine with care from the very beginning. Whereas I might leave some other brand colored or watercolor pencils casually left out in a jar for easy grabbing, I don’t do this with my Prismacolor Premiers. I keep them in their tin at all times so that they don’t accidentally fall and break. I take care to sharpen mine with a handheld sharpener made by Faber Castell.  With special care, I’ve discovered that a few of their pencil tips will still break off, in my set, this has happened with two pencils in the red color family. In each case, it appeared to happen when I was a little too rough in sharpening them up. One tip snapped off when I tried to swatch them out.(However, this has also happened with a few of my Faber Castell Albrecht Durer watercolor pencils). This is the worst thing I can think of to say about either brand, in fact. The Prismacolor Premiers glide on smooth as butter. In that they remind me a little bit of Carandache. The colors are bright and beautiful. When I tested these pencils with water, they did not budge. I happen to appreciate that aspect very much. With other brands,( brands whose tips also break), they move so much with water, it made me wonder why I ever invested in watercolor pencils. The difference, though, is that watercolor pencils actually look good when water disperses the color. They do not look good when they move with water when they’re not supposed to. Moreover, I’d like to know that my artwork will stand up sturdy against a hapless, accidental splash. It’s just an added little feature along with very good lightfastness reviews by reputable agencies, which Prismacolor took the time and effort to gain with their Premier line. One doesn’t need to be a famous artist to paint something really beautiful, sometimes when least expected. I make it my policy to always use the best materials that I can find, just in case. Prismacolor Premier is therefore more laudable in that they offer the artist this advantage at a very reasonable price. I’ve included two drawings that I made with my Prismacolor Premier 36 count colored pencils that I made the same night that my husband gave them to me. I’ve yet attempted to blend them, but I don’t foresee a problem. My ultimate judgement: If you are an artist, or just like to draw, or you’re looking to gift something really nice and substantial for an artist, I think that you should consider these pencils. It will acclimate the inexperienced with high quality at an affordable price, and it will help somebody who is a dedicated artist to continue with the creative flow without wasting their time and effort with poorly made materials. Somewhere, I read a review about high quality art supplies where the reviewer said he had received the same brand as a gift when he was a child, and the memory of their beauty and high quality remained with him throughout adulthood.

title: Very Good notebook with some nitpicks
text:
I stumbled upon the Sulirun 1981 notebook in search for a new bullet journal for 2020. I was previously using a cheap Piccadilly dot grid essential notebook that served well as an alternative to my leuchtturm 1917, but I was looking for a better quality alternative to it that did not cost more than $20

The hardcover is a sort of leather, i dont think this is actual leather but it feels nice. You get two bookmarks, colored differently which i really like. it comes with a rubber band closure and an external pen holder that i really appreciate because it did not add unnecessary bulk to the notebook.

This also has a sleeve in the back for stickers or implements that you would like to keep in your journal, they also provided some Icon stickers.

The paper is like a creamy white or ecru and claims to weigh 120gsm and whether or not that is accurate, it is significantly thicker than the piccadilly notebook pages. I included pictures of pen tests and my actual spreads to show how different pen inks show up on this paper. I have also used metallic watercolor paint on this paper and the paper handled it well.

And while there’s a lot of good things to say about this notebook, I have some nitpicks, that are not necessarily criticisms to the product, but a few points that I’d like to mention in case this helps you make or break a purchase.

This notebook does not have page numbers or an index. So you’ll either have to manually make your own index pages, or in my case I cut off the index that I did not use from an old notebook and glued it in notebook. I also just manually numbered the (160) pages.

And while this notebook is sew bound the first and last page are glued down to the front and back page almost like to support the binding.

Last nitpick, while this says it is an a5, you can see from the picture comparing it to my A5 piccadilly notebook that this one is actually slightly wider. It measures 26 dots horizontal and 40 dots vertical.

title: I needed an electric pencil sharpener... this did the job
text:
I managed to drop a set of colored pencils on the hardwood floor, and around 30 of the points broke off. I usually use a hand sharpener, but I didn't feel like hand-sharpening 30 pencils, so I found this one - the AFMAT Electric Pencil Sharpener Heavy Duty, 6 Holes, Auto Stop Electric Pencil Sharpener . I thought twice, as it had no reviews at the time, but I checked the brand, and they make several other well-like pencil sharpeners, so I went ahead and ordered it.

Well, when I plugged it in, I thought I'd start with less expensive pencils, so I sharpened a Brutfuner colored pencil. These are big with a square barrel, but the sharpener did fine. I tried a PrimsamColor Premier, a couple more brands with different thicknesses. Some - like the Holbein colored pencil I sharpened next, were round and pretty thick, some were thin. I sharpened a Faber Castell Albrecht Durer followed by a Blick colored pencil, a Derwent and a Luminance, and a Polychromos. Every pencil was sharpened to a long, sharp point at which point the sharpener did automatically stop.

Since I prefer my pencils to be less sharp, I found a second or two in the sharpener and pulling them out early worked well. I happily sharpened many pencils - no leads broke and there were no issues.

It's probably worth mentioning that this is a sharpener with a large bin for shavings. Although the bin was plastic, the sharpener had no smell, and it was well boxed and there was foam around it to protect it.

I'm super happy with this AFMAT Electric Pencil Sharpener. It's strong, pretty quiet, has lots of room for shavings, and fit every pencil I have.

title: My second set of Sonnet watercolors
text:
I originally got the set of 16 Sonnet watercolors, and I liked them so much that I bought this larger set.

I've read again and again that Sonnet is the student version of White Nights and Ladoga (Ladoga is a version of White Nights without the cadmium and cobalt colors). They're all made in the same factory in Russia, and I can tell you that Sonnet watercolors are beautiful paints. They move well on paper, make great transparent washes and layer and glaze well.

I want to talk about value and comparisons. While at just over a buck a pan, that's more than many student grade paints, this paint comes in full pans, not half pans, so it's actually a better value. I find it smoother on paper and more consistent in pigmentation then my Cotman or Van Gogh watercolor sets. While there are some fugitive colors, the paints are mostly good to excellent lightfastness.

That being said, they're highly pigmented, and while that's a good thing, it can lead to unexpected results if you're used to less pigmented paints. A couple rubs of a brush on a set pan can be enough paint compared to 6 or 8 rubs on other brands; if you rub your brush as much as on most paints, you'll get a LOT of color, possibly more than you wanted. But don't panic - this paint with less paint on the brush are gorgeous and transparent.

One thing I wanted to mention. When I got the 16 color set (same seller using Prime for fulfillment), it was perfect, but my 24 color set had dust dried into the top of the pans. That must have happened in the factory since the paints were covered with a plastic film with color and lightfastness info. Just damped a brush, dampen the top of each pan, wait a couple minutes and gently remove the top layer of paint with a damp paper towel.

I love this paint for it's smoothness, beautiful colors, versatility and the fact it comes in full pans. I talked to a distributor (not the seller on Amazon, who hasn't replied to my emails) who said the ingredient list they sent him for Sonnet has no ox gall or gelatin. I haven't yet tried White Nights, but I do have a couple open stock pans on the way so I can compare them. In the meantime, this is my favorite paint set to use for my watercolor sketchbook, tutorials and doodling.
