I can see the impression of the W but it's just not on the card !  I guess I can draw a W but why?  It's useless to me now but I really was hoping it was ok because my best friends birthday is in 2 weeks and she would love this card !  Sorry...no quality control

title: perfect for a man
text: This is the perfect card to give a man.  My anniversary is coming up and I'm fully planning on giving it to my husband.  It has a nice overlay on the top and inside there is a design that matches the design on the front.  The envelope also has a design on it.  It's nice and sturdy and really, it says what I'm feeling.  It's perfect.

title: love it
text: This is just what I was looking for.  I have a small business dealing with finances and I need to shred, shred and shred.  I just got rid of my other shredder.  It just couldn't hold up to the volume of papers that I needed to shred.  It actually clogged up and then burned the motor out.  I was very excited that I could get this shredder.  First of all, it's nice looking.  It fits perfectly in my office.  It can handle a nice wad of papers.  I normally like to shred about 10 sheets at a time but this one can handle 15 with ease.  I tried 17 sheets of printer paper and it was great.  I also tried to shred my old credit cards and it ate through them no problem.  This is nice and quiet.  This is just a fantastic machine, heads above the rest or at least the ones that I owned in the past.  I love it

title: great little book
text: This is a great little notebook.  I gave it to my daughter for her journal.  The pages cannot be ripped out, which just makes it neater.  The cover is like a rubbery feeling, very nice and different.  It's embosses with a tone on tone print.  She loves it because it fits into her backpack.  IT's not thick and bulky.  It's the perfect size for journals.  I keep a book like this for notes and doctors visits and household stuff like when I pay the lawn guy etc.  I would have loved to keep this one but my daughter claimed it as soon as it came to the house.  Very nice little book

title: great quality, funny and musical
text: OMG this is hilarious !  I didn't give it to anyone yet but I had a group of friends over for lunch when this came in the mail and I was showing them the card and all 5 of us were cracking up !  This bunch wanted to know where to get them.  I have a feeling for the next few birthdays we will be getting these cards.  It's a great quality card, heavy.  I assume if you mail it you will need extra postage.  You pull the tab on the right side and it has 2 extra panels that come out and in this case, it was all these dogs.  Then there is music!  It is a riot !  I can't wait to give this for a birthday.  I have my best friends birthday in March and I think she will be getting this.  It's so adorable.  I will certainly order more of these cards.

title: love it
text: This is replacing our old shredder that lasted over 8 years.  I love this shredder.  It's basically the same as our last one, with the ability to shred credit cards, thick papers etc.  Once every couple months, I drag out the box of stuff to be shredded and just sit there and watch TV and shred.  I like the automatic stop and start feature.  Mine also had the reverse feature this one has.  That comes in handy because there are jams that happen and usually reversing it will take care of the problem.  It will clear the blades.  This is very easy to use and to figure out.  I have no problems with it and I couldn't be happier.  In my house, a shredder is a must and we use ours all the time.  We recently consolidated our credit cards so that was my first shredding project, over 20 credit cards and this chopped through it like a champ.

title: sturdy
text: This is a well made planner.  It doesn't seem like it would be important if a planner was well made but in June, when it's falling apart, you appreciate the nice hard sturdy cover.  The pages are well spaced and easy to write on.  There is plenty of room to jot down your various activities or happenings.  I like a planner that has a ring binder instead of just binded like a book.  I have a tendency to fold back the front cover alot and I won't crack the spine.  It's large enough to fit everything yet it can go in your tote or on your desk.  I carry mine with me so I definitely appreciate a well made book.  Well done !

title: perfect
text: nice little pencil sharpener.  Each of my kids have their own so they won't fight over it.  It works perfectly on the school pencils.  They love being able to sharpen their own.  It takes batteries which i love.  I didn't want a plug in sharpener.  My kids take this to their desks to do homework.  It does automatically stop when their pencils are sharpened enough.  Its small and cute.  I have an electric pencil sharpener in my office that literally chews up my pencils.  This one is perfect !

title: I love Paper Mate
text: I use my Ipad all the time so I'm going through styluses alot.  I was excited to try this since the only pens I use are Ink Joy.  The pen portion is perfect.  The stylus works great.  It's smooth, and it didn't catch or slip on my ipad.  I'm not sure how long they will last.  The puffy tip seems to be a little thin but I've used it all day and no problems.  I would like to see the pen retract.  That might be an improvement Paper Mate can implement in the future.  I carry a stylus in my purse and if I carry this one, I'm sure the inside of my purse will have scribble all over it.  This feels great in my hand.  It's not too round, or large or too small.  I have a pile of them that just don't have a good hand feel but this one does.  I normally only use paper mate products and as I said, I only write with Ink Joy pens.  They are really wonderful and smooth.  This is a great item if  you frequently are looking for a pen.  I always keep my ipad with me and lots of times, i have my stylus but no pen so this item will work out just great for me.

title: love this
text: this couldn't be any cuter and fits in perfectly with my home office.  Like most  ladies, I love shoes and this is PERFECT little gift for any lady that loves her shoes !  It staples nice and smooth and I have tried it with 20 sheets like the box says and it did  staple it fine.  I normally staple about 4 or 5  sheets and it  works perfectly.  Easy to use, easy on the eyes !  Great stocking stuffer !

title: great chairs
text:
I'm using these chairs as i sit and write this. I babysit for my niece and nephew (ages3 and 5) and i have my kid, age 4.
They are all sitting nicely in their chairs right now, doing their little homework. They each picked their favorite color, i put their name on it with a label maker and all of a sudden, we have quiet and peace ! They are sturdy chairs and fully stackable. Jelly was already dropped on one chair and it just wipes off clean. I'm taking 2 of them to my shore house where they will fit perfectly in the backyard. The colors are nice and bright and these are just great, great chairs for the little ones !

title: Colorful and Cheerful
text: I love the bright colors of these boxes! They are sturdy but lightweight. The colors make them fun and cheerful boxes to ship in the mail.

title: Sturdy
text: While I haven't had to test this in a house fire, I do like the peace of being able to store things in it and feel like they might be safe. This holds a lot of photos, or papers. It's sturdy.

title: Peace for Storage
text: I like being able to store so much in this box. Things like old photos, papers I don't want to lose, and other items I don't want to lose if there should be a fire. Thankfully, I haven't had to test and see if this box will hold up under a house fire, but just using it gives me some added peace that maybe my things will be safer. I like the double layer as you can store smaller things in the top without them getting lost in the bottom with other things.

title: Sturdy, and Perfect
text:
I really like these shelves. They are sturdy and can be used for several different shelf looks. I like how they give some extra room for things without looking cluttered or "heavy" like some shelves. These are perfect for the top of my dresser.
There weren't many instructions, but these were so simple to put together. My one complaint is that the screwdriver they gave with the set was very small. It didn't work as well for tightening the screws as a larger one did.

title: Didn't Explode
text: The idea was fun, but it didn't even up actually working. I'm not sure if the one opening the card held the wrong place or or what, but it didn't explode. Disappointing. But he did have fun putting the box back in and making it pop out again.

title: Smooth Writing
text: Love these pens! They write smoothly and well. They are easy to hold, and are just really nice.

title: Good Storage
text: Thankfully I haven't had to test this in a house fire, so I can't say for certain that it completely protects documents in it, but I can say that it looks like it would. And I like being able to store old photos and letters and such in it and feel that they might be safe if there was a fire. I like the different places for files and such. You can hold a lot of things in this box

title: A Little Loud
text: I did like this card. It was cute and fun. The lights and song made it different than other cards you find. However, the song was really loud, and after a few times of opening the card I realized that I had to open it more each time for the song to even play, which wasn't as nice.

title: A Fun Card
text: This is a fun card! It lights up and plays music which made it even more enjoyable to give someone.

title: Not Impressed
text: These might be good for doing a light sketch that you were going to darken or something, but not for writing. It writes so lightly that it's hard to read and makes you push harder which doesn't help and only makes it hard to write. And the eraser is put in the pencil case with no way to use it unless you take it completely out. And then it's hard to use because it's long and slender. I was hoping for something that I wouldn't have to sharpen all the time, but I want something I can read easily not something I have to look at closely to read it.

title: Pretty Nice
text: It was pretty easy to assemble. I didn't end of liking it as the wire mesh just collected dust in my house and it was hard to keep clean. Maybe in an office with a cleaning service instead of in an old house it would be better.

title: Love These
text: My mom really likes these kinds of cushions. They are very comfortable to sit on and always retain their height after you get up. This thicker one is great. I'm not sure yet if I like the rectangle shape. I might prefer the square ones.

title: Great Pens
text: These work great! And they actually erase which is very nice. They don't always write super smoothly, but they are not at all like other gel pens that just stop working or only work sometimes.

title: Has to be Tightened Tightly
text: This works well once it is on right. It was easy to install but it had to be tightened two or three times to make it tight enough to keep the chair from sinking.

title: Great for Packing
text: This is great for wrapping dishes or other fragile things for packing. There's a lot more paper on the roll than you would think for you can stretch it out before you wrap things.

title: Pencil Eater
text:
At first we loved this sharpener. It seemed to work great and got our pencils sharp quickly and easily. But it wasn't very long before we changed our minds. Instead of sharpening the pencils, it eats them. It starts to sharpen and then snaps off the tip, or just keeps sharpening even when it should have stopped. We threw ours away because we were tired of our pencils getting eaten.
Not fun.

title: Graet Card
text: Loved the colors of this pop-up card! So bright and pretty! It was also well made and cute. Perfect for sending to someone and brightening their day.

title: Fun Card!
text: This was a fun birthday card! And yes, you could twist the butterfly up again and again and make him fly much to the delight of my best friend's children.

title: Sturdy and Stay Sealed
text: Excellent for packaging and shipping items. These mailers are sturdy and stay sealed.

title: Great
text: Great mailers. They are sturdy and I don't have to worry about them coming open in the mail. Love the color

title: Pretty Gifts
text:
These are pretty little notepads. Perfect for gifts or personal use. I like that it's not the same verse on every single page.
Some of the edges did seem a little rough and ragged like the blade that cut them wasn't very sharp, but they weren't bad enough to keep me from using some as gifts.

title: Loved it!
text: My best friend is a photographer and she loved this card when I gave it to her. The details are incredible! Just the front is neat and then opening it up and seeing the camera pop up is really fun.

title: Not Resuable
text:
I was excited to try this reusable birthday card so I pulled the tab and let it pop out. It was great and fun! But there were no instructions for how to do it again, so I had to guess. It didn't work, so I was attempting to put it together again and the box that pops out, ripped and bent and tore.
If this is supposed to be something that can be reused, there should be instruction on how to put the box and the confetti back in the card.

title: Goes with Anything
text: Very nice looking and goes with anything. I really like that they trays aren't staggered but are straight. Sturdy.

title: Pefect for Puzzles
text: Even though this is a file box, we aren't using it for files. It works great for storing jigsaw puzzles under the bed. The box is sturdy and looks nice, and it's the prefect size.

title: Strong Magnets
text: These are very nice magnets. They look nice and are good, strong magnets with sturdy clips. They even hold our heavy calendar onto the side of the refrigerator without sliding which other magnetic clips we've tried don't.

title: Sturdy and Pretty
text: These shelves are nice and sturdy as well as pretty. They got knocked off the desk once and weren't any worse for it. They were easy to put together and are perfect for making some extra room on the desk.

title: Still Curled
text: This mat wouldn't get flat. We had it unrolled and even set some other things on top of it, but it still curled. We finally gave up.

title: Good but Not Perfect
text:
I'm using this as a bedside table because it was the right height and I wanted drawers in it. It works perfectly for that and since I can lock the wheels it doesn't roll around. I love the size of the drawers and I don't have to have a cluttered bedside table now. Also, since the bottom drawer is a file drawer, it's perfect for storing papers.
Putting it together wasn't much of a problem except that some of the screws stopped actually going in and just spun. This made the drawers very hard to open and close because they'd get stuck on the screws. I had to get someone to use a power tool to try and get them in. That helped and I can open and close the drawers now without fighting with them, but they still aren't perfectly smooth.

title: Great for Light things
text:
This isn't bad and it works well if you only want to store light weight things like yarn, or doll clothes or maybe some games. Since the drawers are fabric they don't always shut all the way and my bottom drawer is a little bent. This would be great for kids toys as the drawers are soft but I wouldn't store files in it.
It looks nice and was easy to put together.

title: So Comfy
text: Love it! So comfy. It has a nice black zippered cover with a handle for carrying. The cover is a little too big so it slides around on the cushion, but it's still a very comfortable cushion.

title: Love it!
text: I LOVE it! It's so comfy. It has a nice black zippered cover that fits snugly.

title: Makes Writing More Fun
text: These pens make writing much more fun, although they can be distracting watching the glitter. They write nicely. These make great gifts though I wouldn't recommend giving them to younger children as they will find a way to take the top off and dump the liquid and glitter. (I speak from experience.)

title: Very Nice and Sturdy
text:
This is a very nice shelf and riser. It was easy to put together and is sturdy. It looks really nice and I liked the space under the riser for a keyboard or something. It's nice to have the computer up a little higher.
If you have this on a smooth desk it might slide a bit unless you put some non-slip things on it like we did.

title: Brighten Up Someone's Day
text:
I love these! They are so bright and cheerful! Perfect for letters to brighten someone's day. I like the lines on the front as my writing tends to slant or get smaller and smaller if I don't have lines. You can also mix and match the papers which is fun.
One thing is that the envelopes are a bit small so you can't fold the paper in half and have the envelope seal properly.
Other than that, they are lovely.

title: Love the Colors
text: Love the colors of these! So fun to have colors other than the normal black, red, green, and blue. The tip isn't fine nor too fat but a nice size. They write nicely.

title: Ready. Aim, Write!
text: These are fun pens to use. Great for gifts for military and police lovers or hunters. My nephews love them. They even discovered that you could write tiny notes and hide them in the back of the rifle pen because it will open there. They are a little unbalanced for writing long, but for short notes they are fine.

title: Protecting Files
text: While I haven't, thankfully, had to try this box in a house fire, I have liked using it. It is sturdy and gives me peace of mind about storing old pictures or files that I want to protect in there. I like how the zipper pulls can be locked into place so it stays zipped.

title: Perfect Planner for Me
text:
I'm really liking this planner. It's easy to have it folded and only showing one page so you can see what you have going on without having to find the day or have it take up twice as much space.
The pages are thick enough that you can write with dark pen and probably even marker (I haven't tried that yet) and not have it bleed through. I really like the calendar at the beginning of each month as well as the place each month to write down goals for the month. I do better with monthly goals than yearly ones.

title: Not Impressed
text:
I can't say that I'm impressed by this calendar.
For one, it doesn't stand up. The front is too heavy and it falls over unless it's leaning against something.
Second, I didn't know that all I would be getting is bits of information pulled from Wikipedia and a picture.
Third, the writing is bad and doesn't even make sense all the time. I was left wondering if the FBI or the German spies were assigned to key jobs to steal information. And how one woman suddenly became the "only women to the present day."
I would not get this for anyone or get it again, and I certainly don't think it's worth the price.

title: Sturdy and Safe
text: I haven't had to try this in a fire, thankfully, but otherwise it's been great. It is sturdy and I like that the zipper pulls lock into place. I feel better about storing some old papers, photos, and family memories in these instead of just normal file boxes.

title: Christmasy Fun
text: These are cute! I love having Christmas stickers to put on our Christmas cards and these work great! They stick well and should last me quite a while.

title: Something Sticky
text: This works just fine, is easy to use in either a tape-gun, or another tape dispenser. It sticks well and is sturdy.

title: Just Like Others
text:
I was hoping that these sticky notes would be different from others I've tried, but they aren't. They are harder to peel off, but they don't stay stuck to something else very well. One corner always seems to come off.
However, they are nice and handy to have around. I like the lines and the bright colors which makes them easy to spot on a crowded desk.

title: Pretty good
text:
This was pretty easy to assemble and looks nice when it is done. Some of the hardware is cheap and you can tell. The cam locks are not that great of quality and one of the screws actually snapped off in the wood when I was screwing it down.
Other than that, I think it will work for what I want.
The instructions weren't too hard, but they weren't the best I've seen either.

title: Bigger and Easier
text: Love the bigger buttons and display. This makes it easy to use and easy to see.

title: Not Impressed
text: The "smooth non-skip" wasn't working with the pens I got. I tried using one in my journal and at first it was fairly dark but it kept skipping. Then it started writing super light and skipped and didn't write, so I went back to my other pens. Not impressed.

title: Makes Highlighting Fun
text: These are so pretty! I wasn't sure if I'd still be able to read anything after I highlighted with the darker colors, but I can. It makes the pages look so fun and shimmery. Makes highlighting fun.

title: Nice
text: Nice pads of paper. I like that there is just a small edge instead of a wide one because then I feel like I can use the whole page. The light colors are great and make it easy to see the writing but still keep it from being boring.

title: Easy to Read and See
text:
This is an easy to use calculator. I like the larger buttons and the easy to read screen. I was glad that this one has a mark for the thousand place unlike my old one.
My one problem is that I can't turn it off. It does turn off by itself, but I keep trying to turn it off and it doesn't go off.

title: Light but Sturdy
text: I remember having a little trouble assembling this shelf, but I can't remember why. Once it was put together it is nice. It is light weight and doesn't seem like it would be sturdy, but it is. It makes a nice way to keep your desk organized.

title: Cute
text:
These are cute butterfly bookmarks. I like that they are all different and each has their own little "envelope" to put it in. However, several of the envelopes were coming unglued when I got them. It shouldn't be hard to fix, but I shouldn't have to re-glue something I just got.
Otherwise, they are cute and fun, make great gifts, and make a book look cute.

title: Nice
text: Nice set of labels for Inkjet printers. I can't use because I no longer have an inkjet printer that works.

title: Really Like
text: I'm really liking these journals. The lines are nice and small which I like as I don't reach the end of the journal as quickly. While the journal doesn't stay open on it's own, it is easy to hold it open while I write. The colors are pretty and it is well made. I'll get a lot of use out of these since I journal every day.

title: Patriotic Fun
text: I love these stickers! So patriotic and bright. We used a lot of them on water rockets the kids made at a 4th of July party and they seemed to stick to the rockets well even when they got wet. And with so many of them in the box, we have enough for another year or more.

title: Perfect for Water Rocket Noses
text:
I wasn't sure if this would be useful or not when I got it, but it was. We built a lot of water rockets during a 4th of July get together, and the noses are made from a circle of cardboard. This was SO much easier to cut the cereal boxes for the noses with than trying to trace something and then cutting it out. I think we made the first blade a little dull with all the use we put it to, but it was great!
I think it would be perfect if you needed circles for anything. The only thing is it can't cut really small circles.

title: Have to Have the App
text: I realized after I had gotten it that this printer will only scan things if you use the app. There is no button to push to scan something, and since the family member who would be using it the most is not that tech savvy, I'd rather have one that doesn't require smart phones and such.

title: Perfect for Taping Boxes
text:
This is a good tape dispenser. I was so glad I had it when I had to pack a lot of boxes because it make it so much easier!
I didn't really like the 3 inch tape, but it was easy to pull that off and put a roll of normal sized tape on to use.

title: Thicker
text: This is tougher packing tape than many kinds. It's thicker and seems to be sturdier. One thing I have noticed is that it doesn't seem to tear straight as well as other packing tape does. I'm not sure if that's just me, or the dispenser or if it's the fault of the tape.

title: Festive Flags
text: These were perfect for a 4th of July gathering! I liked having two strands of flags so I could put one over the door and the other on the outside of the carport. The flags aren't great quality, but they worked well and looked patriotic.

title: Sturdy and Flexible
text: These are nice zipper bags. They are sturdy and flexible. I use one bag for my nicer colored pencils and it works well. I like that you can see in the bags so you aren't trying to just guess what is in it or having to unzip it to see. But it also has color and isn't completely clear.

title: Cute and Sturdy
text: Love these cute mailers! They are the prefect size for DVDs and make the mail so bright and cheery. They are sturdy and don't rip and they seal well. No worrying about them coming undone en-route.

title: Sturdy and Easy
text:
These are such fun mailers. I like the handles as it makes them easier to carry. They seal well and don't rip, so I can mail things with confidence.
These would also make good gift packages.

title: Cute and Handy
text: Very nice and handy little set of drawers for your desk. Great for storing pens, tape, or whatever small thing you need. They are sturdy and cute. Not sure they are really worth the price though.

title: Easy to Use
text: These are good padded shipping mailers. Easy to use, seal well, and are sturdy. It makes mailing things much easier.

title: Smooth
text: I really like how smooth the whiteout correction tape can go on. Even if it tears a little or doesn't quite stick at first, you can easily push it down with your finger without getting white on your finger. Another thing I like is that I don't have to wait for it to dry!

title: Fine Tips and Vibrant
text:
These are a delight to use. I love the fine tips and the vibrant colors. I've enjoyed coloring tiny things with them. They don't do as well coloring larger spaces, but they are perfect for small ones.
I really like the case they come in as it keeps them nice and organized and you don't have a cardboard or plastic box breaking after a few uses.

title: Great for Review or Learning
text:
I really like these flashcards. They are a quick and easy way to review the Amendments to the Constitution or to learn what they are about. I took them somewhere and my fellow workers ended up learning some new things because we either didn't understand one of the amendments, or one of them made us curious about something else.
I would recommend these.

title: Handy to Have
text: These are very handy to have around to open packages or cut down boxes for easier storage. The blades are sharp, and although the cutters are small, they are easy to hold on to. And they colors are fun too.

title: So Pretty
text:
The colors are so vibrant and pretty! They color well. I'm sure they will get lots of use.
My box arrived with some broken tips, but the company was very easy to work with and sent me replacement ones.
Recommended to art lovers of any age.

title: Wonderful Printer
text:
I love this printer. It is very easy to use and prints things so nicely. I don't get large drops of ink on a page and I don't have to plug my computer in to print something since it is wireless. We've been printing and printing things and have yet to need to get more toner. (I'm an author and I print all my stories, so I do use it a lot!)

There are a few slight problems I've had.
* At one time it stopped connecting to some of our computers. Never did figure out why, but then it connected again.
* If I print a lot of pages at once, it will sometimes have a gray smudge at the top of a few pages.
* This particular printer doesn't print dual sided.

title: Lovely Cover
text:
I love the colors of the cover. They are so bright and pretty. The pockets for pens and notepaper are perfect. My Bible fits nicely and it's easy to carry my notes for teaching Children's Church without being afraid I will lose them.
I've gotten several compliments on the cover.

title: Fun Colored and Sturdy
text: These are great mailers. The different colors make them more interesting to use than just plain white ones. They stick really well when closing the bag and they are sturdy. You don't have to worry about them ripping open in the mail.

title: Sturdy with Plenty of Room
text: I really like how sturdy these pages are. I don't have to worry about the page ripping or getting all bend up. There are lines for two names, but since there is plenty of space between the lines, you can add more names if you need to. I like the little floral and leaf designs each month. They add a touch of color to each page.

title: Beautiful Colors
text:
I love the colors of these markers! It's much more fun to write when you aren't stuck with the four basic colors. And it makes the board more interesting. They erase easily and well, and I like that you can write small.
The yellow doesn't show up well, but I wasn't really expecting it to.

title: Perfect Pockets
text: I really like these little zipper pockets. Even if you don't want to attach them to a divider, they work great for holding all the scrap papers your notes are on, or holding pens, and paper. You can easily tuck this into a pocket of your notebook so you don't lose any small papers. And the colors add more fun.

title: Pretty and Sturdy
text: These are great for mailing things. They are light but sturdy. I like how well they seal. You don't have to worry about your package opening in the mail. And the color is so pretty and cheery. It brightens up any mailbox.

title: Colorful and Sturdy
text: I love the green color of these! So pretty and much more interesting than plain white. These are sturdy, seal well, and making shipping things easy as well as fun.

title: Colorful and Sturdy
text: Excellent mailers. They seal well and are sturdy. I like the blue color too. Much more interesting and cheerful than plain white.

title: What I Wanted
text: I tried a different kind of mouse pad, but it just didn't work, so I was hoping this one would be more like I was used to. It was. My mouse moves easily, the pad stays where it is supposed to without sliding around, and the colors are bright and fun.

title: Great Wrapping
text: These are great for wrapping something small for added protection before mailing. I really like that they come in a roll that you can tear off how many you need. It makes storing them easier. And having a way to seal these before you put them in something else is so helpful.

title: Room for Personal Notes
text: These are lovely Christmas cards. The picture is pretty and there's a rather generic message inside, but there is plenty of room for you to write your own message or note to your family or friends. I like that.

title: Lovely Colors and Thin Enough
text: I really like these dividers. Instead of the paper ones that are stiff and tear, or the other plastic kind that are really thick and don't lie flat, these are perfect! They are thin enough that they don't take up much space, and you can see through to the next section, but the dividers are sturdy and thin. I love the bright colors! It makes an otherwise boring notebook look attractive.

title: Fun Folders.
text:
These are very nice expandable folders. I like the different designs on each one. They make it easier to recognize which one you need. The snap which holds the folder closed is easy to use but works well to keep it closed and the papers inside.

**Update**
I have discovered that this is not an accurate counter unless you are very careful putting the coins in. If you get it part way in and then it pops up again it will count it and, since it can be hard to push it in at times, you could get double the count of the coin. It's still a fun bank, but I would say it gives more of an estimate than an actual count unless you are super careful.

This is a fun bank for kids or adults. It counts your change as you put it in. However, if you have more than a few pieces of change to put in, it could take a little bit to put them in (kids don't mind doing it for you) since you can only put in one at a time. You can fool the counter by putting the coin in farther away from the edge so it calculates it as a larger coin. If that happens you can use the - sign to subtract the difference. The numbers will turn off the screen after a little while, but putting a new coin in will bring them back up with the correct count.

title: Where have you been all my life?...attempt #3
text:
**I received this item for free on the condition I provide an honest opinion***

I am extremely happy with this product. I have always had a bad memory and despite the level of importance, I will 9 times out of 10 probably forget about it until it's too late. I have tried multiple means of note taking, calendars, phone, email, etc.... nothing truly worked for me.
This, however, is a game changer! So long as I maintain entering a day or two in advance, I am very likely to actually complete my tasks!
I work as a counselor at a medication assisted treatment facility and we don't have an appointment based schedule, as in the only appointments that are set at a certain time are the doctor's appointments. Other than that, I enter a care plan for someone to see me on a specific day, and they arrive when they arrive.
The fact this book has boxes laid out in the way it does has been great. I write down whoever I have set to see me on whatever day and when I do, their number is crossed out. I can see who I have in two days and plan accordingly to add others or in some cases, remove.
The new week starts on Monday with the weekly layout...which is great for a work week. The notes fields on the sides of the pages are great for additional little info. I have been using Frixion pens as well as other journaling pens purchased here on Amazon and I have NOT had any bleed though... I am also able to erase the ink with the Frixion. This book started in July 2022 and runs through Dec. 23... I love the fact I can buy extra paper from Happy Planner... oh, and have I ever!
I have been using this since the last week of June 2022... today is March 14, 2023. I carry this around with me every single work day... from home to work to home again, only to repeat endlessly. I have sometimes carried it in a huge tote bag, mostly in my arm like school books..thrown on the passenger seat of my car with my huge, heavy, probably dirty purse on top. It is still in magnificent shape and I can say with all honesty, I am hard on all of my things. I cannot believe how well this planner has dealt with me and whatever I do to it.
I will probably buy inserts for next year.... it is super easy to remove and replace the paper and the plastic heart binders are sturdy! Again, I can NOT believe how well this book still looks and functions!
I know it can seem like a lot of $$$ for a lanner, but believe me.... it is worth every penny!
I will forever a be Happy Planner gal!

text: This was easily the most annoying set up ever. Not worth it for such a cheap printer. A piece from the paper holder broke off. The display kept giving me the option for A6 paper when it’s supposed to be A4 but that wasn’t an option. You can’t set this up through your iPhone as I was led to believe. I got annoyed by the whole process and dumped this back in the box and tossed it on my porch. Not worth my time and not worth your money!

title: They donate when you buy
text: This Yoobi notebook is quite similar to moleskin notebooks except the cover is more sturdy. It’s super cute and they donate 1 to a child in need for every 1 that is purchased. At least according to them.  There is no price listed so I can’t tell if it is a good buy for the money but I like their altruistic attitude. I also do not know if they come in other sizes or colors, there are none listed here currently. I certainly hope that they do as I think they would be very popular.

title: Love the color
text: This is a very pretty notebook, the bright color adds some enjoyment to using this at work. It’s a pretty standard notebook, sturdy cover, decent sized.

title: Pretty
text: This is a lovely journal, small, easy to carry. The pages are a rough unlined sepia paper. This would be good for artwork, too, though small. I love the cover with the stone and the cute clasp. Great gift idea!

title: Bold color, sturdy
text: This is a very sturdy notebook. I absolutely love the bold color and love that the edges are colorful too. It’s a perfectly sized journal/notebook to carry around. Would make a lovely gift.

title: Good notebook
text: This is a decent notebook for school. I use it at work and I’m very satisfied. I like the pocket in th front.

title: Pretty
text: This is a lovely planner and a portable size but I personally need more room for jotting notes. There are pages for notes in the back but I need them within each month’s pages.

title: Not like an electric one
text: This may be able to be plugged in but it doesn’t work like an electric sharpener. It works like an inexpensive battery operated pencil sharpener. It sharpens but it just isn’t as fast and cool. It is loud like an electric one though but not too bad. It suits my needs to have at work.

title: Lovely design
text: This is very simple, very pretty, a perfect planner without a lot of useless pages. It shows a one month spread over 2 pages then 7 days at a time over 2 pages. Plenty of room for notes. The only thing I do not like is that each day shows how many days so far in the year and how many days left in the year, i.e.  2/354. It’s a bit annoying but I can’t wait to start using my new planner!

title: Pretty covers
text: These are very pretty notebooks, slim and with lovely covers of birds and flowers. Each one is a different color and different design. Perfect for notes or a small project. Would make a nice gift or something to pretty up your work space.

title: I adore this!!
text: I love this Wonder Woman notebook! As soon as I opened it, I took pics for Instagram and people loved it, too!! It’s appropriate for work and perfect for journaling. I almost love it too much to use it. I will be buying several for gifts. This arrived at a great time,  a female superhero is needed and appreciated.  Fabulous and sure to be a big hit!

title: I like this much better than a planner because I take ...
text: I like this much better than a planner because I take a lot of notes on some days and less on others. The dates aren't filled in so I can date the pages as needed. The pages are divided so I can add addendums to anything I've written or plans scheduled. This is really great for anyone who needs more notebook than planner.

title: These are perfect for clipping to your curly hair at the roots ...
text: These are perfect for clipping to your curly hair at the roots to give volume. Don't waste your money on the expensive ones from Devocurl. Those cost more for less. The quality is the same with these of not better.

title: There isn't really anything special about this notebook. It ...
text: There isn't really anything special about this notebook. It has a place at the top of each page to fill in the date which is helpful. I can't get past the cheap plastic cover. I've had other notebooks from Mead Cambridge that are so much nicer. I also think the teal color is too bright.

title: Five Stars
text: These write very smooth and in a nice dark shade of pink.

title: Five Stars
text: I love the pretty colors. The larger size lined paper makes this more practical than regular post-its.

title: Very nice pens, they write smooth and look great
text: Very nice pens, they write smooth and look great. I like the variety of glitter, metallic, neon, and swirly. There are 12 pens per plastic flat in the container but they aren't easy to use to take out a pen and then replace it back in the flat. So I just have them all loose in the plastic box. I would have liked a better way to store them.

title: LOVE
text:
I feel down the stairs a couple of weeks ago and really injured my tailbone. After a couple of days of sitting on my desk chair at work, the pain got so much worse. This cushion is amazing. There is no pressure on my tailbone at all and I actually feel better at the end of my work day. I only wish I could use this on my couch. Nothing seems to work there except lying on my side.
I highly recommend this if you have any pain or discomfort with your back or tailbone.

title: Sturdy, handy
text: This is a great notebook because it has a spot for the date on each page and a separate section at the bottom of each page that can be helpful for making a list to follow up on or putting important information that's easy to find later. The cover is very sturdy, it looks very nice to take to meetings. I have another one with a different cover and it really holds up even though I carry it everywhere. I'm able to keep better track of things than with just a plain lined notebook.

title: Cute but the smell...
text:
This is a very cute notebook, I love the cover. I wish it laid flat, I have to push at the middle to get the most use out of it.
It had a terrible chemical smell right out of the box. It isn't as strong now, several days later, but I can still smell it.

title: actually lays flat
text: I like this notebook for meetings, since it lays flat I can take notes that are readable later. There is just the lined paper, no boxes at the bottom of the page for making follow up tasks. I use a different notebook for making to-do lists and notes from phone calls as I like having a place to put reminders at the bottom for easy reference later. But this is perfectly fine for meetings as I don't need to scribble in it, I can find important stuff when I need to. I like the two ribbons for bookmarking. It makes it easier to look back at notes from a prior meeting. Very sturdy cover with a neutral color.

title: So pretty, it would make a great gift
text: I love this notebook. It's very pretty and well made. I use it to record my tarot reads. It's too special to use for work.

title: Great idea
text:
This is a clever idea. I love having dividers in one file folder. I like things to be neat and organized. My job has several parts to it so I have found these to be very helpful. I'm going to get one of my co-workers to give one a try, she's super disorganized and it makes extra work for me.
The folders are strong and good quality, not like the usual manilla file folders.

title: Wonderful  organizer
text: I love this for the most part. It is a great organizer to have in my cubicle. The only issue is it can be a pain to put it up every morning because the part it hooks on to is not permanently attached to the part that hooks into the cubicle fabric. Probably not an issue for most but I have to take it down and lock up the folders each night because of confidential paperwork

title: very nice, though costly
text:
I love this notebook. The cover is sort of made of cloth, this makes it look very fancy. I like having the bottom section for action items. I take lots of notes while on phone calls and meetings and my to-do notes sometimes gets lost. This makes it easier to look back and see what is important information I need to follow up on. My current notebook has unlined sections on the side which hasn't worked as easily for me as I intended to keep track of stuff.
To be honest, though, as I got this for free to review, I most likely wouldn't pay $18 for a notebook. Unless it lasts me a year, then it isn't such an issue.

title: I like using pencils and I always have to have them ...
text: I like using pencils and I always have to have them sharp. This is perfect for my desk at work. It is battery operated so that is one less annoying plug in my way. It is also not too loud so I don't disturb my co-workers. This worked great for regular pencils and mostly pretty well for my colored pencils, a couple were a bit choppy. I spent about 15 minutes trying to get the top off to clean out the shavings. The directions make it seem like you are supposed to twist the whole clear top. Finally, a co-worker came over and twisted off the small plastic piece at the top that I had thought was attached. So it's easy but apparently not idiot proof. It takes 4 AA batteries. I hope they won't have to be replaced very often, otherwise the cordless aspect isn't much of a plus.

title: tabs are too small
text:
For the purpose of reviewing this product, Avery included a folder with the dividers. When the dividers are purchased, they do not include a folder.
Before receiving these for review, I had never used these classification folders. The hole punches are at the top and the pages flip up instead of like a book. They are on both sides of the folder.
These tabs are at the bottom and are small and not labeled. I have ones with side tabs that are colored and numbered, side tabs plain, and ones on the bottom but are numbered. I like the unlabeled ones better so I can print out my own labels but the bottom tabs ones like these are very small and not easy to label. These are my least favorite ones.
The dividers are reinforced with copper around the holes to prevent tearing.

title: For black and white this is awesome!!
text: I’ve already used this printer for more than I had even anticipated. For black and white printing it is pretty clear and works excellent. It is fast and the app is pretty user friendly. I’ve used some of their pre-made templates as well as printed my own pictures. So far I’ve been using the sticker printer but I also bought colored paper to make it more fun! I have already recommended to others who also like to make things easy and fast. I will continue to look for other applications where this printer will be useful (so much easier to use than a Labeler).

title: Work just like the name brand!!
text: These work just like the name brand version but cost so much less!! Definitely no need to spend more to get the same product!

title: The paper is thin, but these work great!
text: Trying to keep myself occupied while working from home includes using fun post-its! I love using glitter pens on these although they do tend to alter the colors! White gel pens also look amazing and it's a lot more fun than just using the standard and boring yellow ones. The paper is a little bit thin, so the edges seem to angle up very easily but definitely fun and something I would purchase again (if I ever use all of them because they came with quite a few!)

title: Good size and light weight
text: Good price, lightweight and decent size. It was easy to mount and working well in my home office.

title: Quite a few sets! Work well.
text: These were good! I accidentally made a mistake and put one on the wrong page and I was able to move it without wrecking the page too much which was good. This came with quite a few sets of stickers as well so I started with my calendar but I can add to another notebook or schedule if need be later.

title: Disappointing
text: The cover definitely had potential but the goo that the glitter is encased in hardened inside and cannot be moved or manipulated. The journal itself is fine but the reason I purchased it was the glitter so I’m disappointed.

title: Between a marker and a pen!
text: I love Frixion pens and prefer to use them over standard gel pens (unless they are official documents) in case I make spelling mistakes or re-word something. These pens are in between the Frixion markers, which are too thick for my liking, and the regular gel pens that seem to run out of ink very quickly. They also work great in my RocketBook which is amazing! I will definitely look at purchasing other packs with more color options.

title: Easy to use
text: This document holder was exactly what I was looking for. It’s easy to use, folds up when not in use to limit the amount of space it takes up and has a few different angle settings that make it pretty versatile and visible from different view points. I purchased it specifically to hold my cross stitch patterns and I have used it every time I have cross stitched since receiving it without fail.

title: Multi-faceted pen
text: This pen is really nice. It's a great weight, writes well and the stylus is very nice for a small tablet. It's great to always have a writing utensil around, but even better to be able to utilize the Stylus without having to worry about the pen coming out from inside of it, or needing to worry about losing some type of cap. This is a great pen!

title: Stickers as tape? Who would have thought?
text: I haven’t gotten to use this as much as how awesome it is! Who would have imagined that when they made White off in tape form that they could do the same thing with stickers! Great for bullet journaling, or any paper crafts really. The only tricky part for me is that it’s not always easy to break it off without cutting off a heart. Other than that, it’s awesome! I bought a few different ones and I am always looking for a reason to use them!

title: Ink exploded
text: This pen was neat and I loved the stylus at the end of the pen however it exploded in my bag. Thankfully, the ink did not get in my handbag but I had to throw it away much earlier than I expected it’s lifespan to be.

title: Weird size
text: I wasn’t expecting the pages to be such an odd shape but it worked for what I needed it to and was easy to carry around. Loved the pen holder, and calculator.

title: The Pastel color is very light.
text:
These highlighters are awesome when you want to erase something you accidently highlighted. My only complaint with these specific ones is that the pastel colors are difficult to see on some types of paper. If you're only using on white paper than you should be fine but don't expect anything very dark to show up.
I also made the mistake of highlighting something I had written with my Frixtion pen and when I went to erase the highlighter portion I accidentally erased the entire thing that I wrote. Lesson learned!! I still love these highlighters and will likely purchase a darker set.

title: LOVE!
text: I have purchased a few of these pens, but this was the first metal body one that I have bought. I think it feels nicer in your hands than the plastic version but I wish that it had 4 colors instead of just 3. These truly are the best pens for using in my planner because I can always erase any mistakes or changes that I want to make. If you're on the fence... don't be. Buy one of these now!!

title: Small, but mighty!
text: I love these Pilot Frixion ballpoint pens!! This pen in a little more classy for the multi-colored pens that pilot makes with this ink. It only has 2 colors, instead of the normal 3 or 4, so the width of the pen is much smaller and easy to write with. Everyone is always impressed when I make a mistake and just erase it instead of pulling the white out, out! The size of the ink os .5 which is pretty small, and I much prefer the larger .7 size. I still love it though!

title: Both sides looked fantastic!
text: What was really fun about this card stock is that the back of the paper is almost as beautiful as the top! The opalescent side is absolutely stunning when used in the right application. I used it to make different types of cards, and what was great was being able to use both sides without feeling like I had to waste more paper to get the look I was going for.

title: Super cute!
text: Bought these as a gift for my mother in law. She loves cats and immediately started putting these all over the place. They are pretty sticky and make good bookmarks, with room enough that you can write a little bit on them if you're using them in a planner or on papers, etc. Super cute!

title: Convenient! You'll never loose the cap.
text:
I really like how these click to open instead of having caps that break or get lost. I was concerned that they might dry out quickly but I have yet to see an issue with them and it's been almost 6 months since my original purchase.
I have a to do list that is made out of Stainless Steel and I bought these primarily for use with that. The orange color is difficult to read because it is not a white surface. One a white board it is still a lighter color but not as bad as some yellows that I've seen in multi-colored packs that I've purchased before. The green is also on the lighter side but is still legible. I absolutely love these!

title: Bright, fun sticky notes
text: This is a fun set of brightly-colored, standard-size sticky notes.  The package contains six pads in bright colors, like hot pink and lime green.  The notes are your standard size square post-it.  I have found the adhesion to be fine.  I love having fun, brightly-colored sticky notes, and these totally fit the bill.  I also like that each pad is packaged individually,  When you get a big cube the cube inevitably falls apart, and it's hard to write on it like a pad- you have to pull the sheet off first.  This system solves those problems.  I'm really happy with these.

title: Beautiful flower photos
text: This pack of 100 cards gives lots of pretty flower postcards, showing both flowers growing in the garden and field, and those cut and arranged in vases.  This set contains two each of fifty designs.  They come ordered in the box roughly according to season- spring through late fall.  The cardstock used is thick and high quality, and the edges are all clean cut.  The cards are small enough that they qualify for the USPS postcard rate within the USA.  I ordered these to use for postcrossing, and I'm very happy with what I received.  All cards are photos, not illustrations.  Very pleased!

title: Composition book with graph and lined paper
text: This composition book is quite useful in many ways.  As with all composition books, it has hard covers, so that you can write with the notebook in your lap.  No flopping, and no table or desk required.  The paper is printed with wide rules on the front side, and graph paper on the back.  Thus, you can use it for math problems, science, etc., as well as taking traditional notes.  If you like to use all graph paper, you can turn it around the other way and use it solely as a graph paper notebook.  I've had no problems with the binding ripping, fraying, or coming unattached.  The paper is of good quality, and there are no problems of gel pens or liquid ink leaking through the page.  This is a great notebook for many purposes, and it has been quite useful for me.

title: Glittery notebook
text: This is a cute, glittery journal.  It is a hardback journal, with pages lined on both sides.  Pages have slightly rounded edges.  The paper quality is decent, actually better than I expected.  It is smooth and easy to write on, with both ballpoint and gel ink.  Even when using a black gel pen, you can't really see through the page on the other side, so you can use both sides of the page even with darker ink.  The glittery cover is pretty, though the glitter has the tendency to get stuck in two particular corners.  This can be alleviated by rubbing a flat palm over the entirety of the front cover in a circular motion until the fluid flows and the glitter releases.  I'm a bit disappointed that only the front cover is glittery- I had been hoping the back would be too.  Still, I like this little notebook, and will enjoy using it.

title: Sharpies are great
text: I have never been disappointed in Sharpies, and this collection is no exception.  The ink colors are well-saturated and steadfast, the pens have great life, and this collection includes lots of bright, beautiful colors.  I use Sharpies for two main purposes in my life.  The first is in my adult coloring books.  This set is great for adult coloring, as it has so many bright, beautiful colors.  The second thing I use them for is in my classes (I'm a teacher).  They are great for student projects.  Again, lots of bright happy colors, but plenty of dark colors for definition.  Note:  I teach high-schoolers.  Don't give permanent markers to the little ones!  In any case, I would highly recommend this set for whatever purposes you choose.

title: Expandable folders
text: These folders may cost a little bit more, but they are very high-quality, have great capacity, and are less likely to fall apart on you than a regular paper folder.  Having grown up in the Trapper Keeper era, I never used such fancy folders for school, though I wish these had existed at the time.  These folders are made of a plastic/vinyl.  On one side the folder expands, so if you want to keep every handout from a class, you can do that.  The other side has three layered pockets, if you want to keep things separated.  I tend to just use the front one.  In any case, you get four different-colored folders in this packet.  If you like organizing, or have tons of handouts you need to keep in a single folder, these will work well!

title: Prismacolor for flowers
text: Let's begin by noting that Prismacolors are great pencils.  They have a very soft, buttery core, and they blend together flawlessly.  If you like bright, vibrant colors, you will get them from Prismacolor.  This small set is specifically selected for coloring flowers.  In here you have a good assortment of colors that will give you beautiful, bright petals, and the stems and leaves to which they are attached.  Have a coloring book full of flowers?  These are a great investment.  This set does not include a multitude of greys and browns, and it will not help you with more neutral tones.  If you want to color flowers it's a great introduction to the brand.

title: Great poster paper for teachers
text: I am generally very happy with this paper.  I am a teacher, and I needed poster-size paper for my classroom.  This pack of three pads was economically priced.  Each one has 25 sheets, and they are perforated at the top.  Each piece rips off easily and cleanly.  There's no losing the top of the page to a bad rip.  The paper quality is good, it was actually thicker paper than what I was expecting.  It's thicker than your standard copy paper.  Each pad comes with holes at the top if you wish to hang them up.  Please note, these pads are VERY heavy, and you will need heavy-duty hooks to hang them.  I tried hanging this on a hook in my office and the weight pulled the hook from the wall.  Lesson learned.  The covers are not stiff, so these pads don't stand up on their own, you will need to lay them flat.  Overall I'm happy with my purchase, and would not hesitate to buy these again.

title: Kind of like a composition book, kind of like a notebook
text: These notebooks are basically like a mashup of a composition book and a standard notebook.  Each notebook is the shape of a composition book, with the rounded edges and the sewn binding.  These are a bit bigger than composition books, however, closer in size to a standard notebook.  The paper is college ruled, and of the thickness that is standard in a regular school notebook.  The covers are water-resistant plastic.  They are not stiff, however, so unlike a composition book, you cant write on your lap.  You will need a hard surface.  I'm not a huge fan of the plastic covers, because they aren't recyclable, and unless you do some deconstruction to remove them, the notebook is not recyclable.  In general the construction is of high quality, I would just prefer stiffer covers and recyclable materials.

title: Flair for writing
text: These are great!  These are basically Amazon's version of the Papermate Flair pens- much loved by teachers everywhere (source- am teacher).  In this pack you get a whole variety of different colors, useful for all sorts of grading.  They also work nicely in adult coloring books, which is another one of my interests.  The brand name of these pens are expensive, but you know the Amazon price is going to be much, much better.  Thus far, I've been very happy with these pens, and I would definitely buy another set when  I run out of these.

title: Beautiful pineapple pen
text: This pen is seriously cute, but it is not the most comfortable thing to write with.  Let's start with aesthetics.  For this, the pen gets top marks.  The barrel is made of shiny gold, and it is topped with a faceted crystal pineapple.  The pineapple is topped with a spray of gold leaves.  The pineapple catches the light, and sometimes refracts light through it.  While it is a fairly thin pen, it has good weight to it.  Simply, this feels like a quality pen.  That said, this is not a pen that is well-suited for extensive writing.  The tip comes out of the pen with a swivel, and it feels like the tip never comes out quite far enough to be fully comfortable.  The pen is filled with regular, black ballpoint ink, and has a regular ballpoint tip.  Overall, very pretty pen, great for shopping lists and show, not so great for note-taking in class.

title: They really are extra sticky!
text: This cube of post-it notes comes in bright, cheerful colors.  You get aqua, hot pink, and fluorescent green.  This is the traditional square shape, and they come stacked in a cube.  The selling point of these post-its is that they have extra-strong adhesive.  I was not entirely sure about this when I first received the cube.  As often happens, a chunk had broken off from the larger cube, and when I tried to stick them back together, it was not especially effective.  That said, when using an individual post-it, I have found these really do have strong adhesive.  This is true for when I stick these on other papers, my desk, and book pages.  These do not leave behind residue, nor do they tear when removed.  Overall, I like the new stronger adhesive.  This is a win for Post-It.

title: Could use a sturdier back cover
text: As indicated, this is a basic set of single-subject notebooks.  Each cover is a different color, so you can easily find which one you are using for different subjects.  The notebooks are wire-bound, and have a pleasant design on the cover.  The pages flip easily on the wire binding.  The paper inside feels nice to the touch.  It is smooth and easy to write on.  The paper does feel thin, and I would only want to write on one side of the page.  Also, the back cover is made of the same material as the font.  It is not a stiffer cardboard, as you get with some notebooks.  Thus, this is not really suitable to hold in your lap for writing.  You will definitely need to have it on a desk.

title: Bright colors, good quality
text: Sharpie always produces a good pen, and this set is no exception.  In this set you get the standard Sharpie colors, plus four brights original to the Electro-Pop series.  These include a pink, a royal blue, a medium purple, and an aqua.  These are useful for art projects, and I have been using them in my adult coloring books.  As these are alcohol-based markers, they will bleed through any kind of paper, so don't use them on double-sided pages.  Also, be sure to put a piece of paper or other guard behind your page, to protect your table, or any pages behind the one you are using.  The pictures I've included with the review show the four Electro-Pop colors with swatches.

title: A cheap version of Parker
text: While this is a nice enough pen, it is most assuredly not worth the price.  The look is definitely classy, but at the end of the day, this is basically a disposable ballpoint pen.  It feels decent in the hand, and the blue ink flows nicely, but, as said, it's a ballpoint pen.  The barrel is not heavy like you often get with a nicer pen.  The click mechanism works easily, but again, it feels cheap.  Overall, while this is a nice enough pen to use, it's not going to fool anyone in to thinking that you have a super-nice, expensive pen.  It also isn't worth the price tag.

title: Too short
text: If you have really always wanted a pen attached to your keys or your backpack (rather than in your backpack) then this is probably the right set of pens for you.  If you enjoy writing with regular pens, you will probably find these to be too short to be comfortable in the hand, for anything other than very short notes.  These pens are about half the size of the regular version.  They are generally nice pens.  They write well, and you get a nice array of ink colors.  The grip is indeed comfortable.  The main problem in writing with these pens is that they are simply too short to be comfortable for any length of time.  That said, they do have a small hole in the top of the cap, if you wish to attach them to the aforementioned key chain.

title: High quality, bright card stock
text: I'm a teacher, and I got this bright yardstick for use in the classroom.  I have found this paper to be bright and colorful, as advertised, and of good quality and stiffness.  You get five bright colors in this pack: pink, orange, yellow, green, and blue.  Be advised that this cardstock was too thick to go through my school's printer (one of those big professional jobs), so printing stuff out on this paper could be questionable.  Still, I found this paper to be great for cutouts, as it is stiff enough to stay well-formed in a variety of shapes without undue folding or curling.  It's also great as background for posters or other presentation pieces.  This is not paper I bring out for everyday use, but for specific projects.  If you need bright cardstock for school usage, I would recommend this package.

title: Pencils are better than the book
text:
Prismacolor pencils are always high quality. They put down beautiful, rich color, and they put it down easily. They are great pencils for blending. They will give you vibrant, smooth results. This set includes 20 prismacolor pencils, in a good variety of colors. The colors appear to have been chosen to offer some choice in blending, and also to complement in the pictures in the enclosed coloring booklet. I'm less impressed by the coloring booklet than the pencils. The booklet contains pictures of New York City, and they are nice pictures. I think they will look nice colored. The problem is that they are not well-suited to the pencils. The book has loads of tiny spaces and will require lots of similar colors for creative layers to give it depth. Prismacolors are a very soft pencil. They don't sharpen to and hold a super sharp point. You will need a sharp point to get into the tiny spaces in this book. I think I can produce better results in this book with different pencils.

In sum, although Prismacolors are my favorite colored pencils, the book included is not well-suited to them. If you want to get a friend a coloring gift, get a set of 24 prismacolors and a book that works with them. It will come in at a similar price point, and will probably produce a better experience.

title: Decent machine, short cord
text: If you are into adding machines (as the accountant in my household is), then you will probably be happy with this machine, with one caveat.  This paperless calculator gives you a nice, big keyboard, multiple display lines on the screen, and works as expected.  The only problem we had with it is one others seem to have had too: the cord is too short.  If you're wanting to use this on your desk or table the cord will not necessarily reach your outlet.  That's a problem.  If you know you don't need much cord length, go ahead and get this.  If you know you need cord length, I'd look elsewhere.

title: Nice lines, some bleed through
text: These fine liners are great for some purposes, but I've found they don't work great for everything.  If you want fine liners for writing, drawing, adding little messages to letters and journals and whatnot, these are a great choice.  The pens are juicy with ink, and it looks like they will last for a good while.  They make crisp, clear lines, and the small tips are great for getting in small spaces.  I would not necessarily recommend these pens for adult coloring books, which is what I wanted to use them for.  While these are water-based pens, I've had noticeable bleed-through on double-sided coloring pages, which I don't get with other fine liners.  Also, this is a somewhat odd collection of colors in that there is no yellow.  That's pretty crucial for coloring.  The lack of yellow pen leads me to believe that these were designed for writing rather than coloring, and I would recommend them for that purpose.

title: Nice set of colorful gel pens
text: These are good gel pens.  The pens come in a stiff cardboard box that is printed with a mandala sort of pattern.  It's printed in black and white, so you can color the box however you like.  The box contains 36 pens.  The color assortment is focused on variations of the core colors: red/pink, orange, yellow, blue, green, and purple.  For each color you get a neon, a pastel, a metallic, and two glitters.  I like that this set doesn't have a bunch of extraneous ugly colors I'll never use.  If I was curating this collection I might have forgone the neons, because they never go well with other colors, but otherwise it's a nice collection.  All of the pens use well.  The ink generally flows well without pooling.  The neons and the pastels can be a bit scratchy, but I've found that to be the case with almost all neon and pastel gel pens.  Overall, I'm happy with the set, and have enjoyed using them in my adult coloring books.

title: Adorable pencil case
text: This pencil case is adorable.  It looks like a little blue munchy monster, and it has ample capacity to hold the pens, pencils, and highlighters necessary for daily school use.  The entire pencil case is comprised of zippers.  When you open the case you can actually keep unzipping, until this case is one long single zipper.  I didn't want to do that, just be aware that it's possible.  The "teeth" are an added white zipper on the inside.  Overall, this is a really cute soft pencil case with a bit of personality.  I'm using it to keep all the pens in my bag in one place.  As a teacher I have a variety of grading and regular pens floating around my bag.  This keeps them in one place, with a bit of flair.

title: Beautiful card
text: This is a super-fancy card.  It's beautifully constructed, and has many small details.  The card is large, much larger than I was expecting.  It's also square shaped.  This means that if you are mailing this card it will require extra postage.  I haven't gone to mail mine yet (I'll send it closer to Mother's Day), but I'm expecting the postage to be somewhere around 1.10.  The image of the elephants on the front is beautiful, and it is made of various textures and finishes of paper.  The envelope is nice and heavy.  Overall, this is a really nicely made, professional card, and your recipient will definitely know they are getting a luxury card.

title: Some bleed, bright colors
text: These markers have really good color payoff.  They offer nice, bright colors, that really pop on adult coloring pages.  The tips are small, so they can get into plenty of tight spaces (again, useful for adult coloring books).  They're not finalizers, but they are comparable to ultra-fine markers.  These markers are water-based, which means that they have some of the limitations common to water-based markers.  The main limitation is that they can cause the fibers of the paper to ball up if too much ink gets in one place.  Also, as far as I am concerned, the main benefit of water-based markers is that they don't usually bleed through.  These, however, do bleed through, so can't be used on double-sided pages.  One thing I have noticed is that these markers are not as streaky as most water-based markers, so that's a trade-off for the bleed through.  Overall, I think everyone will be happy with the color payoff of these markers, but if you prefer alcohol markers, these will seem too rough on the paper.

title: Disappointing pencils
text:
Honestly, these colored pencils are not all that great. I have a number of different pencils, from low-end to artist pencils, that I use in my adult coloring books. These are not even close to favorites. Actually, they're pretty far down the preference list.

Let's start with the positives. These pencils are attractive. The all-black look is very sleek. I like the look of the black wood. They come in a nice tin with an attached lid, so, it's easy to open and close and you don't have to worry about losing the lid. Also, these pencils do resist breakage. Even when applying heavy pressure they don't break or shatter. The pencils feel very light in the hand (some may think this is a plus, others a minus).

Now, on to the bad. The most significant problem is that they have terrible color payoff. The color is generally light and not at all vibrant. Some of the colors are not very attractive. None of the pencils blend well, and they end up looking scratchy on the page. Second problem, there is no way to know which color is which. The pencils do not have color names or numbers, and they all have black bodies. There's no stripe to show you which color is which. That means you're relying on the color of the lead, which is not especially accurate. Because these pencils have black wood, you can't even see what color the lead is on most of the darker pencils. This is a major fail that could be so easily remedied. Overall, these pencils are not really comfortable or pleasant to use. Crayola pencils are much cheaper and are better. These are more expensive, pencil for pencil, than Marco Raffines, which are far superior. My humble opinion, buy something else.

title: Classic hardback notebook
text: If you need a basic, hard-backed notebook, this is a great choice.  It's a basic black hardcover notebook, with a black elastic band to hold it closed.  There's a choice of paper- mine has graph paper (what is called "squared" here).  In future I would order lined.  You have your choice of lines, no lines, or squares.  Pages are standard notebook paper weight.  Please note, the "large" size is approximately 6x8".  That's not necessarily large for a notebook, but it is bigger than a pocket notepad.  This is the sort of basic notebook that can go anywhere.  It's classic and formal enough looking that you can easily use it for work purposes without looking like you raided your kid's school supplies.  The hard back means that you can pull it out anywhere and have a hard surface for writing.  Overall, a handy book at a good price.

title: Smooth, easy to use pens
text: These are great pens!  They are light in the hand, made of plastic.  When you look at them, you think they're going to be just another cheap ballpoint.  When you use them, though, they have gel ink that writes beautifully.  The ink makes clear, dark marks every time.  These are really smooth pens.  They're really affordable for gel pens, too.  I'm really happy with these, and I'm going to check to see if they have a non-retractable (capped) option.

title: Decent fineliner, needs more colors
text: These are pretty standard fineliners.  They have the same size point as you will get from Staedtler and Stabilo fineliners.  The pens are quite sturdy.  They feel like a well-made pen.  The Stabilos, by contrast, tend to feel too light in my hands.  These are water-based pens, and true to promise, there was no bleed-through in my adult coloring books.  I tried them on several kinds of paper, both smooth and rough.  As with all fineliners, these do not give as smooth an experience as alcohol markers.  I find all fineliners to be a bit ponderous to use.  The main drawback to these, as far as I'm concerned, is that there are only twelve colors.  That's not many, and to add to that, some of the colors come out looking quite similar, especially the two oranges.  In sum, these pens are good quality, but they desperately need to make more colors.

title: Great for earrings
text: For its low price, this is a handy little jewelry organizer (or other sort of organizer, if you choose to use it for other small things).  It has four earring compartments, one for bracelets and one for necklaces.  The earring compartments are fantastic.  It's so easy to drop earring in here at the end of the day, and they don't get lost.  The bracelet compartment is also fine.  The necklace compartment is the only one I don't find so useful.  It's not that it isn't big enough, but with no way to separate necklaces, they can easily get tangled, which does not make life easier in the morning.  If you're buying this unit mainly to store earrings, you'll be happy.  For necklaces, maybe not so much.  For me, it's worth it for the earrings, because I lose earrings, and I don't tend to lose necklaces.

title: Vibrant colors, beautiful finish
text:
I purchased these markers for use in my adult coloring books, and they have served me admirably. This 36-pack offers a good selection of colors. I think Bic does particularly good pastels, but there are plenty of brights and darks too. These are alcohol-based markers, so they will bleed through to the back of the page of a standard coloring book, thus they are not appropriate for use in books that are printed on both sides of the page. They're fine for those printed on one side of the page, just stick a piece of paper behind the page you're coloring to soak up any bleeding (without a page stuck in behind, you will bleed onto your next page).

The most important thing to be aware of with these markers (from an adult coloring standpoint) is that these are fine point, not ultra-fine. This means that while these are great markers for larger spaces, they won't get into the teeniest corners. If you can only buy one package and you want them for adult coloring, I'd get ultra-fine. If you can afford both, it's nice to have both widths, and both are generally useful in most adult coloring books. I have bought multiple packs of Bic markers since I got into coloring, and I have never regretted a purchase.
