title: Love it!
text:
Papyrus delivers more than expected and this is no exception. Excellent journal (aka continuous note pad). Small pocket inside the back cover. Built in silk book mark. Very cool.

5-star, better than expected.

title: Excellent
text:
I've been needing a variable posture stool for shop bench work. Move in, move out without changing glasses/magnifiers mainly. The Safco does the job quite well. The sidebar advantage is the posture imposing demand for sitting straight. The most important note is the positive effect in minimizing lower/middle back strain. Bench work requires some unnatural postures from time to time and the seat action here noticeably reduces strain.

5-stars.

title: Must have for project readiness
text:
Purpose: Unexpected School Projects Quick

School projects due Monday seem frequently announced Sunday night. Perhaps the student practice is unique to just us. In any case, this poster board is a quality standby for whipping up a project that looks good.

These look great as the primary poster or the source for custom cutouts. Ready kept to avoid the Sunday nite project fiasco!

title: Excellent!
text:
I quick measured advertised dimensions. All good as advertised, comparably more surface and on whole so subtly better than advertised. I’ve bought 3 VariDesk variants so this is the first non-VariDesk in the office. VariDesk has that little 'out and up' action. The Victor moves straight 'up'. Frankly not a material difference from my perspective except the Victor has more surface in right areas. Both vendors provide a professional quality product … chunky, sturdy, user adaptable, versatile. Better than expected actually.

I'll keep this updated if anything unexpected 'pops up', so to speak.

title: The tyranny of cartridges is over
text:
I picked this new Epson EcoTank for the simple reason that I was sick of running to Sam's/Walmart and doling out cash for HP cartridges priced now about the same price as the original printer. This Epson printer advertising a 2 year supply of ink will pay for itself in 6 months in my shop. I've had HP's, Epson, and Canon cartridge printers over the years.

The setup is a breeze in retrospect. I tend to press buttons too quickly. Follow the instructions screen by screen allowing the printer time to conduct it's set-up cycle. The keyboard entry of my SSID was the only painful thing but it's just like all the other non-qwerty keyboard peripherals. Alignment is accomplished with only 2 pages, one for color ... one for head alignment. The software download to the wireless network was so easy as to be a highlight for ease of use.

After printing about 100 pages, the printer is a step function faster then the printer it replaced (once comparably priced). The color quality and line registration is excellent. Some reviews take a star off for envelopes (I print Avery label templates and it works with them) and the small screen/un-backlit keyboard action (I don't much care for it) ... except these are 'trees' in context, the 'forest' here is the demonstrable savings over cartridge printers.

Epson will absolutely hammer HP's cartridge scheme pricing. Print "quality" became a generic commodity and the basic hurdle that kept the maker on the shelves a few years ago. 2 freaking years of ink is like 25,000 pages! That's a couple $K in HP print cartridges. Printer brand loyalty buyers will move. The printer biz model has always been a razor blade business model ... we have all come to be tyrannized by the ink that has to be like the most expensive material on the planet. HP ought to give their printers away given their pricing model and I think that's what they'll have to do to compete with this printer. There is simply no math that makes cartridge printers in this price range competitive with this Epson.

title: Firm and resilient
text:
The foam form is excellent. You can immediately tell that foam is going to stay in factory condition for longer than other brands. The cushion cover has slip proof rubber dots that keep it from slipping on leather seats. It's kind of the 'Rolls Royce' of coccyx seat cushions.

Much better than expected.

title: Light weight, unimpressive
text: The pen is an example of maximum cost reduction engineering branded with a once great name. The metal body is just about as thin and lightweight as might be manufactured. The chemically etched pattern hasn't been finished leaving it feel sandy to the touch. For those familiar with classic Parker pens, it's a long fall from the tradition. I was hoping to gift the pen but it's just too chintzy ... better to give 3 boxes of Gel pens.

title: Old school audio visual aid
text:
Nothing quite beats a white ruled index card frankly. I use them for story boards and flow charting with scotch tape. The don't curl up like sticky's and you can update, comment and re-pin as often as the card space holds out.

As advertised classic style and weight.

title: Value for money
text: Tough to beat on value. Turns the manila folder intensive cabinet into a rainbow. Is there a more boring color than Manila?

title: The core for avoiding the high $$$ roller ball refills
text:
Now it might take some creative effort, but the G2 refill can be made to replace virtually any rollerball ... Mont Blanc, Aurora, Visconti, DuPont, Waterman, etc.

There's no doubt to me that these are fresher and better than the slow moving high $$$ OEM refills.

title: Get a better one
text:
4-color pens have a place in design and systems review. This feels like Gel ink delivered by scratchy skipping ballpoint. It's just not a smooth writing experience.

Looks cool but comes up scratch and nasty.

title: My new favorite general pen
text:
My new favorite general pen

Smooth as silk, bold line rollerball. The smoothness is absolute 'buttha!'

Better bold performance than Gel, better than my MontBlanc Legrand (I need to experiment with the next refill).

title: Excellent but insanely expensive monopoly
text:
A point is coming very soon when it's cheaper to replace the dang printer than these refill cartridges.

I much prefer this OEM cartridge over no-name-o's.

I completely reject the insane price and short life. The value for money proposition here is turned upside down ... I feel like a sucker.

title: 5-star ... uhhh ... for packing tape.
text:
A packing tape review is unlikely, however ...

The volume, strength, lateral sheer quality with dispenser, propensity to not invisibly attach to itself on the roll plus the bulk package linear feet is worth a worth a review. Worked better than Home Depot/Lowe's similar products at a much lower price.

title: Extarordinary value for money ... assures not running of basic stuff and spending an expedited premium and sum certain inventory
text:
The Avery suite that that links seamlessly with all Inventory Control Systems is the value adding proposition. Avery print software matched to the ever improving precision cut label is simply the best solution for the $. Time is money.

We use these for the annual 'C' bin items physical inventory. The labels are a in fact the inventory and inventory control system. The simple ease of using Avery is a money making cost savings.

A stock clerk with a Sharpie long hand label is your worst enemy. For us, the value added is surprises (updated vendor stock numbers/ duplications/ short inventory, etc) is revealed when 'inventory control' prints the labels the system says are in stock and the stock clerk returns labels they can't find stock for. Inversely, a fast scan of post bin inventory immediately reveals inventory that doesn't show in the system.

This style label and barcode software supported compatibility are the cheapest, simplest means to control what you got and what you don't have and need.

title: Excellent
text: As advertised. High quality. Great solution for low volume situational use. If you laminate a lot these are too pricey.  Avery label software is fantastic.

title: Reinforce the plastic where it starts to tear and it should last
text: Plastic started tearing the third day after i got it. It is very cute though.

title: Not worth it if you’re looking for gel cover
text: Like all other reviews, there is no gel at all in the cover. It’s definitely glittery, but the glitter is dried up and does not move at all. There’s no puffiness to it at all.

title: Have not used yet, but looks great
text: Although thin, this seems sturdy and easy for children to hold. Colors are vivid and exactly like image shown. I have not used yet to determine if the chalk markers are removed/erased easily, but this seems like a great first photo prop

title: Gel dried up and glitter won’t move.
text: Like some other reviewers, the gel was all dried up and the glitter wouldn’t move. I am so sad!

title: Thick, colorful business envelopes
text:
These opaque, thick, colorful business envelopes were exactly what i needed. Sometimes when i write a special note on my employees paycheck stubs i want them to be flagged to actually open it and read, and having a colorful envelope instead of normal business envelope certainly did the job!

This would also be great if you type out letters on your computer, but print and mail them to folks who don't email. Typing paper is always hard to fold well into other size envelopes.

Overall I'm very happy with the colors and the quality. The stickum worked well.

title: So much fun for writing my to do lists each week!
text:
These adorable little pen rollers take a little getting used to - my seven and nine year olds have a little trouble working them - but in grownup hands, are a lovely addition to a bullet journal routine that you want to make pretty.

The rolling action for me was easy enough to get down with a little practice, and they disburse a good amount of ink that doesn't smear once dry. I like the colors and patterns.

title: Not as large as expected from the pictures and the price
text: This is basically a flat milk crate. It has a little lip around the top so that you could in theory build it into a table or set of shelves. After testing the first one, I was hoping to love it enough to order a few more and create a drying basket area for curing squash or storing homegrown produce, but after receiving it, I was unpleasantly surprised that it was much smaller than expected, and while the quality level is good overall, it didn't seem to warrant a luxury price.

title: Beautiful, classy, special card
text: I just love these gorgeous pop up cards! Everyone has so much "stuff" nowadays that sending a truly special card seems like the most thoughtful sort of gift that doesn't cause clutter, and this one is a marvelous and beautiful choice. The pop up works really smoothly and it makes a really special presentation when opened. I really love the styling of it, too.

title: Such a special card!
text:
My kids go bananas for these popup cards, and we love sending them to other families with kids, or to relatives to whom we know it will mean a lot to put the card on a shelf and remember they are loved.

This one is so sweet! The little brown bunny and the easter accoutrements are just adorable, and the popup action works smoothly.

Really lovely, special statement card.

title: Adorable pop up card
text:
While it is a little spendy for a card, I just love these paper wonder pop up cards, because they really make a gift and an occasion feel super special. I have found that many of my gift recipients still have their card displayed a couple weeks later after their birthday or occasion.

This one is an adorable kitty being playful with a ball of yarn. It would make a great card for a grown-up or a child who loves cats. It has a teeny tiny bit of space to write a brief message on the top of the card.

title: Just love these!
text:
While it is a little spendy for a card, I just love these paper wonder pop up cards, because they really make a gift and an occasion feel super special. I have found that many of my gift recipients still have their card displayed a couple weeks later after their birthday or occasion.

This one is an adorable dog surrounded by presents and birthday cheer. It would make a great card for a grown-up or a child who loves dogs. It has a teeny tiny bit of space to write a brief message on the top of the card.

title: Absolutely love this thing
text: I really appreciate the beautiful, slightly farmhouse gray finish on this gorgeous desk organizer. We put this on our crafting and worktable for the kids to store loose paper, coloring sheets, finished pieces of art, and some flat crafting supplies, and it works absolutely perfectly. It is very sturdy and can hold some supplies on the top of it like a little table, and really frees up a lot of space on the craft table. I couldn't ask for anything more, it is exactly what I expected and it is very well-made.

title: Incredible quality on these organizers
text:
I just love these organizers! They are absolutely beautiful quality and work well in so many different situations. I use them for desk organizers in a drawer to keep the dust off of them, for my kids to organize the tiny toys that come with a dollhouse, and on the crafting table to put parts or pens in.

They are extremely well-made and I've had some from this brand for well over a year, and they are still great. You can totally wipe them down with a warm damp cloth to refresh them as needed if they get a little dusty. I generally prefer using them in drawers.

title: So so pretty!
text: I am a landscaper, so I love floral themes for cards, and especially for my dear and much loved mother. Having something like this that you can write a little sentiment on, then have an excuse to display it for some time, is a lot of fun. My mom has a special little shelf where she puts art from the kids, cards, and other things that she feels heart warmed to look at, and I expect she is going to love this Mother's Day card. I received it a little after Mother's Day, so I am planning on gifting it to her for next year, but the quality of it is stunning, the pop up workings of it effective and easy to pull up right, and overall this is everything I'd hoped for.

title: Superduper great cards
text:
Why are these called kids cards? I have no idea. I plan on sending these to all of my Harry Potter friends and family whenever I want to check in and say hello. Of course, some of my friends and family maybe kids, yes, but this is really awesome for Harry Potter fan of any age.

The card quality is a little better-than-average for hallmarks card assortments. The colors are absolutely vibrant, print quality is great, card stock is midweight. I am really happy with these! They are so cool!

title: Solid, midrange quality, great themes on this birthday card assortment
text:
There's really something for everybody in these cute and clever cards. I love that when a crewmember or someone I know is having a birthday, I can just pop a card out to them and there's something in this set that feels appropriate.

The quality is not top-of-the-line Hallmark, but for a box assortment, is great. Better than expected.

Overall I'm really delighted with the quality level, cleverness of the cards, and selection here.

title: Very pretty, midrange quality
text:
This is a very pretty set of thank you cards for people who send out a number of them. While the quality is not top shelf hallmark, they are moderately nice quality for boxed thank you cards. This would be perfect for people who are in a business setting where they send out a lot of simple thank you cards.

I like that there is such a variety of them, and what I did is put miniature post it's on the front of each style and wrote down the name of each person I've sent that style of card to, so I don't duplicate.

title: Kids love this!
text:
My five and seven year old love decorating cards for thank you's, birthdays, etc, and this set was a perfect blend of diy and also something complete enough to make it easy for them to express themselves.

The different cut out shapes in the front let their art shine through, and make their work look extra well put together.

They were very pleased at the variety and they like how the box looks. The pip squeaks are not enough to decorate on their own, but kids love them.

Paper is nice, and not too glossy to where the markers smear. It's a hit!

title: Perfect for overflow toys
text:
These boxes arrived in perfect condition and have those nice wing lids that flap open and closed easily. I have been using them in a triple stack to house excess toys in my kids closets. We like to rotate our toy selection so that things stay fresh and new, and this is been great for that, because the boxes are a little bit smaller than the larger storage boxes that we ordinarily get from Costco. The size is really ideal for having one type of toy inside.

The boxes are sturdy, and kind of frosted so that you can see what's inside a little bit but not actually see all of the details, so they look clean and well organized and not too busy or messy visually. I really like them.

title: Really smooth upgrade from my 12-year-old model
text:
I have been a huge fan of this line of scanners for many years. I purchased a scan snap about 12 years ago, and the cost was a major investment for me at that time. However, being able to fully digitize a bunch of old files and get rid of a huge file cabinet was amazing for my sense of tidiness and productivity to have all of this stuff just backed up on hard drives instead of taking up a solid 2 x 3 area of my homes footprint. However, my old model had a few little quirks with the software integration that this one doesn't have.

This new version was extremely simple to set up. I did uninstall and reinstall the scan snap software to make sure that everything was recognizing properly and fully updated for this new model. I found that the scanning speed was hugely upgraded over my old one, the scan quality is fantastic, and all of the little niggling quirky issues that I had with the old one that would occasionally provide 10 minutes of frustration why tried to figure it out, have disappeared with this new model. I allow it to have the software start when my computer starts up, and it is always ready to go at the push of a button.

I recently scanned about 150 pages of various documents for a home refinance, and everything went through smoothly with only one paper jam, which was easily remedied by removing the paper and putting it through again more carefully. I was able to continue my scanning without having to redo the whole thing. The software just seems incredibly intelligent, straightforward, and easy to use. I couldn't be happier with my Fujitsu scan snap. Even though a dedicated scanner like this takes up a little bit of space on the desk, it's so much easier than using the scanner on my printer, and it's faster and better quality as well. I just love this thing! Perfect for digital minimalism.

title: Nice set for gift giving to different households
text:
My kids were delighted with having a unicorn stencil with the sparkly heart sidewalk chalk. The stencil is thin and flexible and a small size that is easy for small hands to manage. The glitter does actually show up when the sun shines on it and is a really cool touch.

I do wonder a little bit as to why they gave two stencils in the same package that are identical. Why not have two different stencils and then if you give them to siblings, they would each have a distinct shape to share rather than having duplicates. I guess this is probably meant for keeping one and giftgiving the other?

In any case, I have been happy with the quality of all of the items from this brand I've gotten, and this is no exception. The quality of the stencils are very nice as are the quality of the heart sidewalk chalks.

title: Never heard of this brand but thrilled with the quality
text:
It was a bit of a leap of faith to pick up something from a brand I never heard of before, but we are obsessed with scented markers in our household and the flavors/fragrances on this one were so cool! Very southern inspired cuisine, like corn pudding, sweet potato, etc. I was especially impressed with milk fragrance, and I'm not sure how they managed to capture the essence of a delicious sweet glass of fresh milk so well, but they did.

These markers are indeed highlighters, while they have a nice wetness to them and can put down a lot of ink, it is relatively transparent ink. This is great for crafting and for our bullet journals.

Overall I couldn't be happier with this set and am keen to see what else this company has in their scented marker lineup.

title: Cute carrot pens
text: I really love these cute little carrot pens! We use these as Easter basket stuffers for the kids and they were a big hit! They write just fine for the kids purposes and everybody was really pleased with how cool and cute they are. They are a nice chunky pen with a fun rubberized texture to them.

title: Decent quality pens, adorable bunnies
text:
These are just kind of normal quality pens similar to a Bic pen, but with the slightly thicker ink. And those adorable little bunnies on the top are just perfect! We used these as Easter basket stuffers and my kids were just delighted. They each wanted to have one of each color and had fun coloring with these standard black stationary pens.

These would be really fun for a gift basket.

title: Absolutely gorgeous, high-end, with vivid and beautiful coloration
text:
I absolutely adore these beautiful felt bins. While I would not use them for cosmetics or anything where they might get dirty or dusty, I have been using these inside of drawers to store things that are dry and need to be kept separated and organized. I have multiple sets, and have used one set in my daughter's drawer that keeps dollhouse items to keep all those teeny tiny little items reasonably sorted out. I've also used another set of these in my underwear and socks drawer to hold onto my sweater depilling device, and other little odds and ends that belong with those items.

The color is incredibly vivid, the felt is firm and stiff and stays in the correct shape, and these are just so classy and so beautiful. If they were less money, I would have these all over my house because they are just that beautiful. There is something so warm and inviting about their look. I'm just not sure how to clean them, so I would definitely advise keeping them somewhere where they will not get dusty.

title: Exactly as expected
text: I have a bunch of extremely boring hanging folders in my office that carry extremely boring paperwork. Purple being my favorite color, I thought I would use things up a little bit by picking up some violet purple hanging folders instead of the boring charcoal gray and basic office blue ones that I had. These were exactly what I expected, worked great, seem sturdy, and fit my hanging file folder set up. Couldn't ask for anything more!

title: Wonderful! We use these for printing off coloring pages for use with watercolor paint
text:
My kids love doing watercolor painting, but they grow tired of doing freestyle painting every single time. I have been printing out coloring pages on this watercolor paper, and it works great! While I don't think it is meant for this purpose, it works really well and absorbs the paint and has a beautiful watercolor paper look to it.

We just find free coloring pages online, like at calico critters, Lego, Hello Kitty, papyrus etc. branded stores, and download the free coloring sheets to print on my home printer. This paper goes through the printer just fine, especially if you feed it one sheet at a time so it doesn't develop a printer jam.

title: Excellent quality bubble mailers
text: I tested these out recently to return a couple of items and send something to a friend. They worked great! I don't know what brand I usually get, but these were pretty much identical, and succeeded in every way that I expected them to. They seem sturdy, had a good thick bubble wrap around everything, and the sticky part sealed well and didn't want to come open. They seemed true to the measured/specified size and everything was exactly as expected. I'm really happy with them.

title: Great little board, but the markers are a little thick tipped
text:
So I really love this little board and how it comes with such a beautiful rainbow array of markers to use. However, one side of the board has little lines on it indicating that you could use it for to do lists or task lists, yet the markers themselves do not have an ultrafine tip so it is hard to get enough detail when you are writing with the markers to actually use the lined side that they gave you. I have been using the ultrafine markers from Expo which have a very fine point that I can use much easier for text than the markers included in this set.

If you can tolerate fine rather than ultrafine markers, then the array of colors on this cute board and set is perfect.

title: Beautiful little card but the pop out part is a little rectangular
text:
This is a beautiful little card and I plan on giving it to my best friend for Valentine's Day since we both find hedgehogs adorable.

The card stock is a nice thickness, the printing is beautiful, and the overall styling on the hedgehog is very cute. The only thing I would suggest is that the honeycomb pop-up is a little bit rectangular. I kind of expected it would be a little more rounded or something to go better with the shape of the hedgehog.

title: Beautiful gold foil accents, wish there were different color envelopes to go with.
text:
I really like that Hallmark has been coming out with some midrange quality card boxes that are reasonably priced, and have a diverse array of cards inside, because I find that I end up sending cards to some of the same people in my life, so it is really nice to have a mix.

This set of cards has a good midweight card stock, the quality level on the printing is beautiful, and I really like the gold accents which definitely make everything feel elevated.

The one thing that doesn't stand up quality wise is that the envelopes are a pale yellow that seem a little thin and see-through, and also if we are going to have six different cards, could we not have at least two colors of envelope, or maybe three? It doesn't seem like that would actually increase the costs that much, but it would really mean a lot when you have six different types of cards to have different envelopes to color coordinate with.

title: What a beautiful card!
text:
During these Covid times when we don't see each other as much as we would like, little touches like cards have become all the more important for my family to express love and stay in touch. My mom's birthday is coming up and I'm really excited to have discovered this beautiful card with the nice sentiments inside. My mom and I talk about being grateful for each other a lot, so it is particularly fitting for us.

The card stock quality is beautiful, the little pop-up flowers lovely, and the gold foil accents really help it feel elevated. I'm very excited to get to gift such a beautiful card to my mother.

title: Super cute!
text:
This is super cute set of miniature cards unfolds open to a blank interior that you can write a small message on. They have a nice thickness to the paper, and the print quality is stellar. The cards look great, and the gold accenting on them really amps up the quality level and the presentation.

My kids have been obsessed with writing each other tiny cards and also drawing little pictures inside of them, and these have been perfect to encourage us sharing kind thoughts with one another during the Covid quarantine.

title: Oh my goodness, so cute!
text:
I just love the styling and the number of creative little craft projects within this cute paper lovers book!

While the whole thing is kind of random in the sense that you turn the page and you never know it's going to come next, it's also delightful. There are pages of stickers, gift tags, little punch out paper boxes and interestingly shaped gift pouches, little sheets of "gift wrap" and fancy papers, line sheets to write on, etc. It's just kind of an unusual and delightful set of fun things to sit down and play with. I often find myself at a loss when the kids are crafting because I don't necessarily want to do the exact same craft project they are doing, and this is great because I can sit with them, we can play together, and I can go through my book and make some of the little projects, all of which are fairly straightforward and simple to do.

The thickness of the paper is great and I really like the styling of everything. This would make a fantastic gift for people who love paper craft and Scandinavian style things. This is necessarily Scandinavian, but it has that general feel to it of upscale, homemade, sweet goods.

title: Amazing, awesome, sturdy paper filer
text:
I have a huge thing for office supplies, and deal with a lot of paperwork in my line of business, and so having this very sturdy file sorter is perfect! I can fit magazines, catalogs, all kinds of papers, and larger envelopes that are for mailing. I also have slid a couple of small desk organizer trays in some of the shelves to help organize my space and keep things dust free.

While it took a while to assemble, it was not actually a difficult assembly and everything made a lot of sense. The construction quality of the materials is excellent, and everything went together seamlessly without any wonky angles.

I could not be more delighted with this. I've had it set up in my office for well over a month now and I can't imagine being without it, because it is so useful and how much it holds, and so very sturdy. I can see myself owning this and being thrilled with it for a very long time.

title: Great set of metal bookends
text:
After spending an unreasonable amount of money on individual tiny sets of bookends, I was delighted to find this larger set of simple, straightforward, and extremely functional bookends that are exactly what I needed to keep my books in place on my many bookshelves.

I like the neutral tones, sleek coating, and the fact that they are strong and effective. My cookbooks are not falling over when these are used.

title: Very nice colored pencil set
text:
The packaging on these colored pencils is very appealing to receive as a gift. While my little box got mushed in shipping, even so, the beautiful rainbow array was quite visible upon arrival and my kids were very excited about how attractive the set was, and it made them want to do some detailed coloring.

This set has 100 colors and is quite ample for finding any shade you might reasonably want. The lead has a nice balance between being hard and soft, and puts down a good layer of color without feeling scratchy. Overall I'm very happy with the gift presentation and the quality of the pencils themselves. We've been enjoying using them on some high quality coloring pages from a book we have.

title: Great little gel pens set!
text:
My kids have been having an absolute blast with these gel pens! We actually picked up a stamping set of miniature stampers from the same brand, and my kids have been stamping an outline with the stamp, then using the detailed points on these gel pens to color them in really nicely. Gel pens obviously don't lay down a big watch of color at once, so their best for detail work, so using them to color in tiny stamp designs from the stamping gift set they have, was perfect for my kids.

My children are four and seven and have overall done a good job understanding that gel pens are a little bit more of an older kid craft material and that they need to be mindful how they use them.

These gel pens put down a nice layer of color, and come with a nice array of different colors and finishing effects. I'm really happy with the amount of color they put down, and the fact that there hasn't been any problem with smearing. Overall these are really nice quality set and very easy to use.

title: Thinner than expected
text:
I use a number of folders both in my work and in homeschooling my children, and so I have a mental picture in mind of how thick a folder should be to actually protect the contents. Unfortunately, while these were of acceptable quality, they are not of good quality thickness. The folders are fine for if you are going to put papers in them and put them on a bookshelf or or in a binder where they are not going to get rumpled, because it will certainly hold the papers and keep the dust off of them. However, if you are planning on putting folders inside of a backpack or having them just be out and about during family life, these folders won't protect anything from getting bent or rumpled.

While I appreciated the variety of colors and the number of folders in the set, I really wish they would have been a little bit thicker. That said, if you are looking for a thin folder to use in a binder that will not take up too much space with unnecessary bulk, these could be a really good fit for you.

title: Works great and love how child friendly they are
text:
This brand clearly thought of how children actually use their markers when designing this set. I have been wanting to share some brush tip markers with my kids for some time, but every time I pulled out my set for grown-ups, somebody would stain something or mush them too hard and I'd be cranky.

This set is perfectly tailored for kids. It is very washable, strong enough to resist overly hard pushing by young hands, and even tolerates having the caps left off for normal periods of time. It is really relaxing not to have to do a double check of the craft table every night before bed to make sure all of the caps are on things.

And the color saturation is great! I also really like that the tip has just the right amount of flexibility to give the kids a bit of a different artistic experience while also remaining easy to control.

Overall I couldn't be happier with this nice set of brush tips markers.

title: Just love this brand of felt drawer organizers!
text:
I couldn't be happier with the quality level and beauty of these felt drawer organizers. If you have a thing for fancy office supplies like I do, you will love these is much as I do. I have some office paper trays, a big stand of them that has more areas to put office paper than I need, so I've taken to putting some of my cute felt trays from this brand in there and sliding it out when needed, to hold beautiful gel pens, brush tip markers, highlighters and sharpies in a way that feels attractive and fun for bullet journaling my to do list.

These are made of felt that has been treated in some way so that it is hard, sturdy, and feels secure and long-lasting to use, yet it has that beautiful felt texture that is incredibly satisfying, and vivid coloration. The way that the tray sits and the lids fit on, are lovely. Overall I couldn't be happier with this set. The quality level is spectacular. I've had a number of other ones from this brand and they have held up well over the last year or so that I've owned them. I keep them in drawers where they don't get dusty. I'm not sure how I would wash one.

title: Finally a washable brush tip I can give to my children
text:
I love drawing with brush tip markers, but every time I bring out my midrange set and try to share with my children for craft project, somebody ends up marking up a chair or something out of careless excitement. All of the grown-up ones that I purchase are not washable, and the only ones I have found in the past have been a five pack of Crayola's, which is not enough colors to really express yourself with. This set is wonderful because there are enough that my children do not fight over who gets what color, the brush tips are flexible and fun to use, and it gives my kids enough of the different style of making art, that it makes coloring pages and ordinary activities feel freshen fun again.

Overall I'm delighted with the ink quality, vividness of the color, and the wash ability of these lovely markers.

title: Nice mouse pad, wish it were about 25% bigger around
text:
I really like the pattern on this and decided to try around mouse pad just to see if it could work for me. While this is working pretty well, I do keep running into the top and the edges of this thing, and I'm finding that I really do miss that little bit of extra room given by a rectangular mouse pad. If this thing were still round but about 25% bigger, I think it would be a lot more comfortable to use and the shape would be much more functional for me.

The other issue that I have with this is that the stitching is a little bit itchy in some areas and I keep noticing it. I think that they have a beautiful design here and overall this looks like an attractive and high quality mouse pad, however for me this feels like more of a decorative piece for a mouse that I use only sometimes rather than my standard, 10 hours a day business mouse pad.

title: beautifully made and a pleasure to use
text:
This truly feels like a high-end notebook. I use this size of notebook numerous times a day for my to do list, and have discovered a wide variety of quality levels in notebooks of this size. This Russell and Hazel variant has thicker pages than anything I've been able to find at my local target, the lines are extremely crisp, and the contrast of the beautiful gold spiral with the cream vegan leather is really gorgeous. The vegan leather feels soft and luxurious.

Overall I'm delighted with this and am pleased that the price point isn't out of line for the level of quality.

title: Clean it exceptionally well before use
text:
I have owned a number of ergonomic standing pads for my standing desk over the years, as well as a balance board, and I'm really happy with the firm sturdiness of this one, as well as the interesting variety of things to balance and massage my feet on.

After a long workday, my feet did not feel sore after standing upon this cushion. Definitely evaluate for yourself if you are a fidgeter who will appreciate the two balls and the interesting ridges, or if you just need a regular cushy mat to stand upon.

The one thing that I really disliked about this is that it comes with some kind of weird, silica like coating which clung to my socks, then my slippers, then a second pair of socks before I finally was able to find a cleaner thorough enough to get most of it off. With all of the little ridges all over, it was frankly impossible to get all of the weird silica stuff off, but is really necessary to try, because I almost hurt myself multiple times with the coating that it left on my socks and how slippery it made my feet. It's really a dangerous thing to leave on a standing mat.

title: Perfect for kids crafts!
text:
Grandma and grandpa have fridges that both take a magnet, and therefore so much of our children's crafting ends up getting a magnet stuck to the back of it so that grandma and grandpa can have a decorated fridge that makes them feel fancy and loved.

These little adhesive magnetic squares are perfect for applying to small, lightweight crafts so that they stick to a refrigerator. We have used these on foam crafts, pom-pom crafts that are stuck on popsicle sticks, and paper crafts, all to good effect.

Overall these were exactly what I expected, stick well and are of good quality.

title: Absolutely incredible quality organizers
text:
I cannot say enough about the quality level on these beautiful felt drawer organizer trays. The coloring is vivid, and the felt used to make these is incredibly sturdy and well formed. They have the tiniest amount of flexibility given the material they are made of, but are also firm and relatively sturdy.

The quality level on these is really incredible. I also have some a different shape that are purple, and they too are absolutely exquisite, well-made, and a beautiful upgrade in my office, and one of them is in my daughter's room to hold some special miniatures she owns.

Overall I just could not be happier with the elevated styling, quality, and beauty of these. I am not sure how you would wash them, so I would personally use them as directed inside of the drawer so that they don't get dusty.

title: Mine arrived broken but was easily fixed
text:
My pen holder arrived broken, and in trying to fix it I realized that it was poor manufacturing that broke it in the first place. There was a weird glob on the foot that obviously didn't belong there, so the pressure in the packaging trying to push the foot down onto the pedestal broke it. We used a small file and sanded the glob off, then glued the piece back on, and you can hardly tell there was a problem.

The break illuminated quality issues in the manufacturing given that there was a big glob hanging off the foot. Overall, aside from the quality issue that we experience personally, this is a really fun little pen holder for the right person. We love it.

title: Useful for making our own homemade stickers
text:
These full sheet sticker labels are fantastic for crafting with kids! I have printed out full pages of fun things to color and for the kids, and then we can cut it out and have our own custom stickers that we've colored ourselves. The shipping labels are perfect for this, because while they have just a little bit of gloss, it is not so much that the markers smear.

There is good adhesion on the labels, and they print really well.

Overall I'm delighted with how easily these go through my inkjet printer and how fun they are to color and craft with, with the children. Obviously these would also be great for shipping things, but that's not what I wanted to use these for.

title: Vivid colors, nice quality chalk and eraser
text:
This is a nice quality set of four packages of chalk and a chalkboard eraser. They come packaged in plain white boxes with the simple black and white label, looks very generic and bare-bones, but everything is held within a perfect box with little foam cutouts so that everything is perfectly suspended within the box, and given the quality of the packaging, I was unsurprised to find that there is zero breakage in shipping. Every other thing of chalk I've ever gotten has arrived damaged.

The chalkboard eraser works well, and the chalk itself is very vivid and exactly as hoped and expected.

title: Unfortunately the sizing listed is not accurate
text:
These are a very nice quality of self seal padded envelope. The glue on it with the self seal is incredibly sticky, almost like a thick gel, and is one of the most effective sticky material I have seen for such a use.

Unfortunately, I got these expecting them to be 8.5 x 12". These are significantly skinnier than that. They are just below 12 inches long, and about 7.75 inches wide, but this width also includes the half-inch closures on each side, so the effective mailing area is only about 6.75 inches wide. This is good enough for a cell phone or some sizes of paperback book, but not big enough for some of what I wanted to ship, which are slightly larger paperback books. It would not fit a hardcover book in here.

Overall the quality level is very good, but unfortunately the sizing on this is not listed correctly.

title: Love love love this!
text:
I run a small landscaping company and have numerous whiteboard calendars that I use for scheduling alongside my digital calendars – notes on employee availability, notes on what needs to be done for specific clients and days, and scheduling notes about which client has which day and time slot with which crewmember.

So far I have two large white boards, but those are kind of clunky to use and hard to make small notes on. This one is absolutely perfect in the sense that it fits easily on my desk, is not too overwhelming, and is good for those follow-up schedule changes that happen throughout the month. I like that it has a V shape as a possibility so that it can stay open on its own, and it can also fold perfectly flat,, though in that iteration it is, of course, to whiteboard stick.

Overall the build quality on this is as expected, and I'm very pleased with it.

title: Perfect for kids crafts!
text:
We make a lot of crafts in this household, and grandma and grandpa both have spacious refrigerators that are the repository of so many of our craft works. This magnetic tape is absolutely perfect for adhering lightweight foam or paper crafts to grandma and grandpa's fridges.

The adhesion works fairly well on foam or paper surfaces, and I haven't had to supplement with glue yet. However, if you are using this on felt, I would expect to need to add some glue to make sure it stays.

I really like the tape form factor which gives us the feeling of unlimited magnetic options for sticking this to crafts.

title: Huge stack of shipping labels worked great in my inkjet
text:
This is a substantial container of shipping labels, which have five individual bags of nearly inch thick stacks of half sheet shipping labels suitable for printing with USPS or PayPal shipping labels. I was really floored by the quantity you get, given that these are pretty much identical to the namebrand I had previously been purchasing.

I used my inkjet printer to print out two shipping labels, peel them off and put them on my package, and ran my hand over them to make sure that there was no smearing. Everything worked great, they seem to be adhering fine, and the printer printed on them clearly with no issues.

Overall this is a solid product and a great value.

title: Lovely blueberry scented slime activator with a gelatinous texture that mixes well
text:
My kids love making slime, and in recent months I have shown them the process of pouring out the glue and pouring out the activator in the proper amount so that they can have fun mixing and making their own fun slime recipes. While I didn't think they could come up with anything new in the slime world, apparently they have, scented slime activator is a great idea and my kids have been really enjoying making different colored "jellies" to play with.

This is a pretty big bottle and so if you are having kids use it on their own, you may want to decant part of it into a more manageable bottle. However, it's a perfectly reasonable size for grown-ups.

It does have a very fresh blueberry fragrance that recalls a number of candies that I remember from my youth.

title: Awesome set of children's clipboards
text:
I absolutely love these, and especially love having them for the car. We can put some paper inside the clipboard storage section, along with a couple of crayons or pencils, and it's there, protected, and ready to roll when the kids need something to do in the car.

They seem relatively sturdy and open and close smoothly and easily. In the two that we have been using frequently, I have detected no sharp edges or problems, and even when little fingers get pinched in the edges due to incaution on the part of my larger child, there have only been mild protests and not actual pain.

They come in a wide array of fun colors, and my children immediately knew which colors they wanted to start with first.

Overall I'm really pleased with the quality level on these and how practical and functional they are.

title: Nice highlighters, translucent and beautiful
text: These are really nice highlighters. They are translucent enough that you would not want to use them as normal markers, but use as highlighters, they have a beautiful glittery effect

title: A really beautiful anniversary card
text:
I actually got a handwritten thank you card for sending this beautiful pop-up anniversary card to my dad. I wrote some heartfelt sentiments on the side in nice handwriting, since there is no part of this card that won't be on display.

The card is a nice medium weight card stock sort of similar to watercolor paper inconsistency, and the 3D pop-up part opens with only a little bit of nudging. It has a really special, gift worthy effect, and would standalone as an acknowledgment of somebody's anniversary.

Overall I'm really delighted by the quality on this.

title: Really nice card for a friend
text:
I always love the high quality of hallmarks special cards, and this individual birthday card is no exception. The bubble tea detail on the front feels artistic and really cool, and brought back fond memories of having bubble tea with a friend, to whom I gave this card.

The card weight is a nice medium thickness, and the print and detail quality is on point. Overall I'm very pleased with the quality and style of this card.

title: Love the cool elephant on this!
text:
I absolutely love these fun paper wonder pop up cards, which have such special detailing to them. The card stock is a nice medium weight thickness, and feels high quality to open.

The pop up part pulls open with ease when the card is opened, and you don't need to manually fix any stuck bits, as I've had to do in the past with some cheaper brands of pop-up card.

The printing and quality is on point, and this makes a wonderful gift presentation for sending a card that will make your special somebody feel extra spiffy.

I gave this one to a little boy whose family has a cultural affiliation with elephants, and he really got a kick out of it.

title: Great Hallmark quality as usual
text:
I absolutely love these fun paper wonder pop up cards, which have such special detailing to them. The card stock is a nice medium weight thickness, and feels high quality to open.

The pop up part pulls open with ease when the card is opened, and you don't need to manually fix any stuck bits, as I've had to do in the past with some cheaper brands of pop-up card.

The printing and quality is on point, and this makes a wonderful gift presentation for sending a card that will make your special somebody feel extra spiffy.

title: Fun for the kids, the snowman is a little bulgy shaped
text:
This is a fun holiday card for the kids to decorate, you get 12 identical cards, 12 sticker sheets, and 13 envelopes, in case you messed one up.

The cards are the smaller standard card size that you would normally see for thank you cards, and they have a nice medium thick card stock and an attractive gloss to them.

The one thing that I don't love is that the snowman looks more like a triple ice cream cone than a traditional snowman, which would usually have a bigger base, a smaller medium body, and a smaller head. Even my kids who are ages four and six noticed that the snowman was a little bit of an odd shape. We still had fun decorating the snowman and sending them on their way to friends and family, but I think they could've done a slightly better job on their design.

The stickers stuck, and overall everything behaved as expected.

title: Nice set of thick, glossy cute postcards
text:
While I am not sure that I personally would frame these postcards, they are very nice quality postcards for sending to friends when you're thinking of them, or including as a cute decoration in a gift basket.

I really like the thick, high quality card stock, as well as the beautifully printed designs, and incredible gloss finish on the postcards.

The patterns are diverse and interesting, and the quality level is obviously there. Overall this is a very nice set of high-end postcards.

title: Nice economy set of "thinking of you, sorry things are hard" cards
text:
This set of cards has a pretty picture and a nice message inside, of being really sorry that somebody is going through a hard time. While they are obviously from a bulk set and not the thick card stock and incredible printing quality you would normally expect from Hallmark, this doesn't read as cheap and would definitely do to have around for sending cards to colleagues, clients, etc.

I really appreciate having sets like this so that when occasions come around for which they are appropriate, I don't have to delay in sending a card, I can just send my well wishes as soon as the thought occurs to me. I appreciate that these cards aren't full size, because sometimes I don't want to the pressure of finding a whole lot to say to fill the space, I just want the person to know I am thinking of them. This is a nice size and a good midrange quality set of cards.

title: Good economy
text:
Hallmark is known for its quality, and lately has been dabbling in a more economy market and putting out some sets of cards that are not as beautifully packaged, and not as thick of card stock or careful of design. This bulk pack of thank you cards seems to fall in the economy category, in the sense that these are perfectly nice cards, but don't have that special extra shine that Hallmark products usually have.

The card stock is a little bit thinner than usual, and while the print quality and coloration is nice, there's definitely a bulk card feel to this set.

Overall if you have to write a bunch of thank you cards for people who came to a business meeting or something, this would be a perfectly good way to do it. I'm not sure I would choose these cards for sending a handwritten and special thank you note to a personal friend or family member unless you have the kids decorate the inside with small drawings!

title: Decent set of economy cards
text:
Hallmark is known for its quality, and lately has been dabbling in a more economy market and putting out some sets of cards that are not as beautifully packaged, and not as thick of card stock or careful of design. This bulk pack of birthday cards seems to fall in the economy category, in the sense that these are perfectly nice cards, but don't have that special extra shine that Hallmark products usually have.

The card stock is a little bit thinner and even in the packaging, a couple of the cards were pushed together in a way where the edges were ever so slightly curved on two sides, and while the print quality and coloration is nice, there's definitely a bulk card feel to this set.

Overall if you have a setting where you're called to write a lot of simple birthday cards for people you only know a little bit, this would be a great way to do it. The designs are very cheerful and I like the vivid colors and fun styling.

title: Really special set of hallmark quality thank you and congrats cards
text:
Hallmark is really known for their quality, from the card stock, to the design, to the special touches like metallic details that make the cards a little bit extra special.

This card set is really fun in the sense that you get a set of 24 cards with envelopes, and you get all of these unique designs that can be easily suited to a variety of circumstances and types of people you would send them to.

Since I run a landscaping company, there are a number of times when I want to send a thank you or congratulations card to a client, employee, or colleague, and it's great to just have them at hand so that when the thought strikes me, I can get that done. This is a wonderful set because it's been easy to quickly select an appropriate card and get it mailed, and the quality level looks thoughtful and worthy of sending a handwritten note to someone you care about.

title: Beautiful set of jewel toned hanging folders
text:
I've never seen somebody offer a set of just my favorite colors before, but somehow they managed it here. This looks beautiful and classy in my office, where I have a number of open file containers holding hanging folders like this. These are exactly as expected, the right size, the sides are sturdy and reinforced, and the top has a reinforced area to put the tab. It comes with tabs and the little cardboard bits that fit inside the label, and overall is of good quality and thickness.

No surprises here, except how happy it makes me to have a beautiful array of jewel tone hanging folders.

title: Mostly decent quality except the basket dividers on top are not straight
text:
Overall, this five level metal mesh paper organizer with a pen tray at the top is just what I expected. It was relatively easy to assemble, especially once I figured out how to put the bottom on, by looking at the photo of what it is supposed to look like. I initially put it on in a way so that it would fall off every time I picked it up, but that was easily remedied.

There were no instructions inside, and given that I had to look up how it looked online to figure out why it wasn't working, I think I could've used some instructions, just a single page leaflet showing how to put things together would've been very appreciated and would've saved me 10 minutes.

The letter trays do slide out, which is not my favorite but works okay

title: Incredibly full set of colored pencils which comes arrayed in a beautiful rainbow
text:
This is probably the most complete set of colored pencils I've seen. Some of the colors are so similar that they look almost identical, but because they are arrayed in a beautiful swath of graduated colors, it's easy to see the small differences in the shades which make each of the pencils unique.

It comes with four internal trays that you can lift out with browns and silvers, blues and purples, reds and oranges, etc. the trays themselves are kind of a floppy plastic and I would've appreciated had they been a little bit sturdier, but it's hard to complain when the product itself is so nice.

The box has a lid that shuts magnetically for storage, and makes a nice gift presentation.

The colored pencils themselves are quite a bit harder than my Prisma colors, but much less hard than some of the cheap brands of colored pencils of purchased over the years when quantity was more important than quality. Overall these are a nice middle-of-the-road hardness that allow you to get some good detail with just a little bit of an ability to blend.

title: Really impressed with the precision point and non-smearing ink
text:
I've had a lot of gel pens in the past that had problems with skipping or an imprecise tip, but these pens right out the box did an amazing job of giving me the option of incredible detail. The point is very fine and has a good tactile sensation when writing with it. The ink is a rich, deep black.

I'm also super impressed that it doesn't smear, since so many gel pens do. I actively tried to smear it just so that I could test how good of a pen it is, and I was unsuccessful. My handwriting looks a lot neater for having such a clean and precise tip with a rich ink.

The one thing that is not my favorite is that the grip part where you put your fingers to hold it is not very comfortable. It has a hard crosshatched texture to it that is not my favorite. That said, I'm kind of a wuss when it comes to my pens and some of my favorites over the years have been the Japanese ones that have super squishy grips to them.

Overall, this is a really nice basic, standard pen that gives you great detail without any smearing. It would be great for left-handers.

title: Really beautiful high quality pop-up card
text: My dad absolutely loves morning glories, and I'm so looking forward to giving him this beautiful pop-up card for his birthday. I opened it up and the morning glory popped up smoothly and beautifully without any issues. Everything was intact, and the paper quality makes for a beautiful presentation. The printing is nice and overall the quality level is exactly what I would expect of a high-end card like this.

title: Power up for Valentines fun!
text:
My son and daughter are complete Mario freaks, and we all play Mario party or another Mario game together in the evening as a family for 1/2 hour each night. So you can understand my excitement when I found this awesome Mario Valentine's Day card that even includes fancy stickers!

While we have a Mario sticker book, the stickers contained in this card are four shiny, bubble stickers that are raised where the characters are. The stickers are square and feature Mario, Yoshi, Princess peach, and the gang of Mario Luigi peach and towed with the star. There are little hearts and stars in the backdrop of each sticker, and they look super high end and fancy, with a pearlescent shimmer on the stickers. These are seriously awesome stickers that your kids will want to put on a notebook or something where they can be enjoyed for a long time.

I have not yet given it to my son for Valentine's Day, but am so looking forward to doing that.

title: Low quality construction, poor welds
text:
I was really disappointed in this item. While it is generally functional and "OK", the welds that hold the baskets together are done poorly to where the baskets look uneven, bent, and not straight. It is particularly obvious on the top basket, which is the most visible, that the center weld has a distinct angle to it rather than being straight and neat.

While the welds are strong and the item functions as intended, it is hard to recommend given the lack of quality and attention to detail.

title: Super sparkly, super cool
text: I love these kinds of tabs for holding an important place in one of my books that I'm reading, or in study materials. These are great because they have this incredible sparkly shine to them, yet each of the tabs is distinctly different. They are reusable and repositionable, and they do stay put as long as you need them too, yet they are easy to peel up and reuse. I just peeled off a few that had been stuck onto a piece of paper for a week, and stuck them down on a new surface without any problems. These work exactly as expected and are a shiny and shimmery upgrade to the norm. I used a sharpie to write on them for the few that I needed labeled.

title: Cute little unicorn Christmas cards
text: I really like this cute little set of unicorn Christmas cards. There's something about the hallmark brand that adds a little extra shine to whatever it is they're doing, and this cute little set of cards is perfect. Actually really appreciate that it only has six and the package, because I find that I don't send that many cards and I prefer using all of them up so that I don't accidentally resend the same style of card the next year. This is fun because, who doesn't love a good unicorn? Overall the quality level is nice and I was happy to get to send these.

title: Really nice for my kids to make custom greeting cards
text:
Whenever there's a birthday coming, my kids want to make a custom card for whoever's birthday it is, yet most of the simple colored cards have a glossy texture that is not ideal for drawing and writing in. This set of blank greeting cards is perfect, because it accepts markers, crayons, and all of the other media my children have wanted to use. It is a lot better than folding up a piece of paper into quarters and makes a much classier presentation as a special card from them.

I feel like when my children put in over an hour of effort on making a nice card for somebody, it's worth having a beautiful piece of card stock to make it into something that grandma or grandpa could keep on a shelf for a while. In this set of blank greeting cards with envelopes does the trick.

title: Love the thick card stock and foil accents
text:
I really love that Hallmark is coming out with some more budget friendly lines of greeting cards, because it's nice to just have a simple big package of note cards that are ready for me anytime I want to send some wishes to a client or friend.

As with everything from Hallmark that I've tried, the quality level on this is fantastic. The card stock is exactly as thick as it needs to be in order to send a message that you care enough not to send a dollar store card, and the foil accents and extremely vivid coloration on these is perfect! I like that I could really send this to just about anybody, as one of the four designs seems like it would be fine for just about anyone.

Overall I'm really happy with the quality level on these nice little cards.

title: Works well but buttons are definitely not my favorite
text: This calculator works well and has a wonderful bigger view of the numbers as well as a bigger numbers pad that is easy for me to see what I want to be pushing. Unfortunately, the buttons have a weird rounded shape where when I push them, they kind of jiggle off to the side rather than pushing down cleanly, which led to me having a number of errors where it didn't properly note that I push something, and it also made it challenging because I had to be keeping my eye on the calculator to be certain it was logging my button pushes. I used it for a full week of work, hoping it might loosen up and the buttons might functional little better, but I think this is just the way it's built. I really wish that they would go back to the drawing board on those buttons and make them more obvious whether you have pushed them effectively, and easier to push effectively.

title: Fun and cute set of nice quality notecards
text:
Though I had never heard of this brand before, I'm really impressed by the thickness and finish on the card stock, the attractive design and quality printing, and the colorful lined paper envelopes. The whole presentation is quite nice and the box is sturdy enough to hold the cards safely until I use all of them up.

The pineapples are a really cute trio and are a fun multipurpose design for just sending a quick note to people. The cacti are great, I'm a landscape designer and so having things that are somewhat botanically based but simple enough to be all-purpose, are really appreciated.

Overall and really delighted with the print quality, design, thickness of the card stock, and finishing on this beautiful set of note cards.

title: Love love love love
text:
I have a completely inappropriate love of both all things rainbow and office supplies. When this arrived, I actually squealed because the rainbow array of post-its is just gorgeous! It is laid out in a way that is almost gift worthy, if you know somebody like me who squeals over rainbow sticky notes, and some of these are colors that I have never ever seen before in a sticky note.

I'm also really gratified that these are the super sticky ones, because from previous experience, I have been able to stick these to a notepad, then to my monitor, then to an item that I need to remind myself to take action on. It on sticks, sticks again, and sticks, sticks again and does a great job until I'm done with it or until I get cat hair involved.

These also are great because they fit in my little sticky note dispenser! Overall, I cannot imagine what would make this limited-edition super sticky set of post-it's any better. This is perfection for people who love office supplies.

title: Very functional and attractive simple tape dispenser with ample refills
text:
This thing is great! I own a small landscaping company and of course like any company that has an office, we go through scotch tape like nobody's business. This little dispenser is amazing, it's just heavy enough that it doesn't scoot all around, the cutter to cut the tape works perfectly, and the number of refills you get is ideal to stuff in a drawer and make sure you don't need to reorder anytime really soon.

The white tape that comes with it is of good quality and while it is not clear for certain applications, it works perfectly for all of the office applications I would ever use it for. I appreciate the professional look of the clean white dispenser and when it got smudged, it cleaned off just fine with some cleanser.

title: A really beautiful gift worthy statement
text:
I love these pop up cards! They make such an incredible gift statement and are so much fun to display. I actually plan to give this one to my child because they love having a little section of cards that have been sent to them for birthdays and holidays, and I think that the pop-up nature of it will be very much beloved.

The quality of the card stock and the activity of the pop-up is really beautifully done, and in this world of instant things and a profusion of low quality items, it's wonderful to see and appreciate items were quality is still at the forefront. This is a beautiful card and is highly recommended.

title: A beautiful set of high-quality cards with nice card stock lovely colors and sparkly glitter
text:
What a beautiful set of sweet holiday cards. I like that the message is inoffensive and friendly for everybody, and the quality level here is apparent. If you've purchased inexpensive cards recently, you'll know that sometimes the card stock is thin and floppy, there's print lines where there shouldn't be, and the overall effect is necessarily what you want when you going to take the time to send your best to somebody. These cards, by contrast, have card stock that is just the right thickness, beautiful coloration, no ink scuffing or streaking on the blank parts, and there's beautiful glitter detailing on the front which really takes it to the next level and makes it beautiful and special. It catches point lighting really nicely and glimmers.

I'm very pleased with this set of holiday cards and look forward to sending them to my landscaping clients this year.

title: A great quality and very useful gift
text:
What a cute little set! This would make such a nice little gift set for somebody that you don't know too well, like a coworker, but want to recognize and appreciate. Most people use notecards and notepads, and so it's both beautiful and practical and unlikely to cause clutter.

I'm using it myself because who doesn't love beautiful things, and the notepad just feels luxurious and lovely to use, while the notecards are have a nice card stock quality that feels very good to send. It even comes with little stickers to help seal the envelope shut.

Overall the gift presentation on this is very nice and the level of quality on the actual items themselves is great. I love hallmark quality and I'm so glad they are still keeping the quality level high after all these years.

title: A classy set of cards to send to a wide variety of people, great for a business setting
text:
The hallmark level of quality is super apparent on these beautiful, simple cards that look classy enough to send to my clients during the winter season. While I purchased cheaper cards some years back, I always keep coming back to the hallmark brand of cards because when you send a card, you want the quality level to match the level of appreciation and good feeling that you are trying to send to your recipient.

The gold detail on this is beautiful and the cards arrived with no scuffing or problems, and everything just looks so flawless and beautifully done. The card stock is a nice weight that feels good quality. Overall I'm super happy with this classy set of cards to send to people on my client list.

title: Really fun for what it is
text:
As long as your expectations are in line with what this product actually is, you will be really happy with it and have a good time using it.

I bring this out when my family is going to gather and I want my kids and relatives to participate in having fun recording the event in photos. It's really fun that if we get a special one, we can click the reprint button and have it print a second one, and it's easy enough to use that with a few reminders about how we do have to pay for these pictures and so make sure you're getting a shot that you want, my six-year-old can also participate in recording our family events and bond with family members over pictures. The fact that they are stickers adds an extra layer of charm.

We have good cameras and cell phone cameras and this one fits a niche completely different. Its about the immediacy of the moment and the sharing of special moments with family. The picture quality is perfect for the small size of pictures it creates, but it is not meant to be a high-end camera, it's much more like the old-school Polaroids, which I think all of us probably have a few precious ones in a memory box.

I really appreciate the simplicity of this and how grand parents and children alike can learn to use it and how much fun it is at a party.

title: A classy set to have around for clients and coworkers
text:
I've been noticing more and more that I have a lot of people in my life that I would like to send a birthday card to, but don't know them well enough to send a humorous card or a really personalized card. This set of birthday cards is perfect because it has 12 cards in four designs, so I can give the cards in order and know that I'm not duplicating if I still have some at the end of the year.

The cards have a nice thick card stock that doesn't feel cheap, and attractive finish to the card stock in bright, vivid colors that feel celebratory, and the overall presentation is very classy. The hallmark logo on the card goes a long way in telling people that I care enough not to just buy them a dollar store card (which always feels so flimsy and unfinished to me).

Overall this is a really nice set for sending your best to clients, coworkers, and people in your peripheral circle that you would like to recognize on their special day.

title: Everything Hallmark does looks super upgraded
text:
I guess I've been seeing too many mass-produced cards that have flimsy paper and a lack of finish to the appearance, but these Hallmark ones just really stand out as being a cut above in terms of quality. The paper quality is excellent, it has just the right amount of gloss on it, and all of the edges seem perfectly cut and like they just tended to every single detail when making these cards. Par for the course for hallmark.

These Christmas cards have a really cute puppy with a wreath and seem like the sort of thing you could give to just about anybody without offending them. I really like the style and the colors look even more vivid in person.

title: Great little set of cards to give to your own children or their friends
text:
I love this little set of encouragement cards to give to my own children or their friends when times seem to call for it. The colors are vibrant in there are little details on the cards, like raised lettering or embossed patterns, that make the cards feel elevated and special. Hallmark definitely has a way of making their cards feel a lot more special than the stuff you would get at the dollar store, they really are a cut above.

What I love most about this set is that every card is different, so I can make sure that I am not repeating giving the same card to the same person, because frankly my memory is just not that great to handle having a pack of 10 of the same card.

These are full-size cards that come with a full size envelope. My kids are absolutely stoked when I give them a card or when they received one from elsewhere, so I'm really looking forward to upping my game by being ready for special moments with a special card.

title: Perfect locker set and really attractive
text:
I just love how sleek, stylish, and well-made this simple and attractive locker set is. The mirror and whiteboard stick easily to the metal of the locker, and the little shelf and other accessories are the perfect size and sturdiness to make things work better in a locker.

Definitely feels like an upgrade to have such nice little set inside a plain and boring locker.

title: Cute little pencil case
text: I love the bright pink color, vivid zigzag design, and sturdy construction of this cute little pencil case. The fabric looks and feels as though it was made from a very sturdy backpack material, somewhat water repellent and very strong. There's a little open pouch on the outside for slipping a small notebook, a thin the zippered pouch on the exterior for putting in a couple of pencils or something slim, and then the big open area could easily fit a small notebook, and then there are divided sections on the inside for keeping miscellaneous things, racers, pens or pencils, markers, whatever. There are not individual pencil or pen slots, which is my preference given that we use awkwardly sized art materials sometimes, and overall the flexibility of the design is perfect for customizing it to carry whatever you need. What I don't love is the big fabric branded tag on the front, which doesn't go it all with the pink color and overall design. I would've really liked a less obtrusive branding on this. Other than that, this is a well constructed, attractive, and very useful little pencil case.

title: Super cute, super girly, could not possibly love it more
text: I feel like everyone in the universe should be super jealous of my adorably girly new notebook. I just love the size of notebook for my own personal use, for taking notes, writing to do lists, and generally jotting things down. This one, with the squishy watery glitter cover is amazing. My husband expressed a great deal of doubt as to the wisdom of having water in the cover of a notebook, but I remember having notebooks like this in the 80s and I don't recall ever having a problem with it. It seems to be constructed with sturdiness and care, and, did I mention how adorably glittery and girly it is? I just love this thing. I'm absolutely delighted with it. It would make a great gift.

title: Couldn't love these more!
text:
When adorable little spiral notebooks with college ruling on each page. I especially love the little pencil cases on the front, though I don't want to ruin the design by stuffing them too full, it's lovely to be able to slip a pen or two in and have that with us. I just love the avocado and the rainbow designs. My son immediately wanted the avocado, and my daughter chose the rainbow. I personally was hoping to keep both of them for myself, but unfortunately I was overruled on that.

The paper quality is as expected, and the quality of the spirals and the covers is excellent. Really happy with this lovely little two pack of notebooks.

title: Sharpens perfectly, even kids can use it!
text:
Kids seem to amass pencils like nothing else. Our only pencil sharpener was an old hand-crank one mounted on the wall of the garage. The kids couldn't reach it and didn't have the strength/coordination to turn it. I would also scrape my knuckles on the wall while turning the crank. Consequently, we had a ton of unsharpened pencils around the house.

I'd been on the lookout for an electric pencil sharpener that 1) the kids could use independently, and 2) didn't have to be emptied after every third pencil.

This pencil sharpener fits the bill! Super easy to get set up and is about the size of a water glass from your kitchen. I like that it plugs in so I don't have to deal with batteries. The pencil shavings are extremely easy to empty, but not so easy that kids are accidentally spilling them anywhere. It comes with a spare blade, and the blade was easy to remove/install without referencing instructions.

Most importantly: my kids can sharpen their own pencils! And they love doing it! Finally, after all these years, I can find a pencil that is actually sharp!

title: Just like every other white glue, mild preference for this tip
text:
This tip seems just a little bit more precise and easy to distribute the glue than the normal Elmer's, or the generic Amazon basics glue that I also use. The glue itself seems like exactly the same white school glue that we are all used to using for children's crafts, and is of good quality, exactly as I would expect from the gorilla line.

My son seems to leave slightly fewer glue puddles with this brand, and be able to direct the flow a little bit more effectively, which I really appreciate. The glue itself seems similar, so I'm thinking that it must be that the tip is a little bit more precise. It did seem a little bit more manageable to me. Overall this is a great basic school glue for crafts.

title: This is a super great little fidget stool for my five-year-old
text:
