title: Nice friendship card
text: This is a nice friendship card for an otherwise trash holiday that celebrates commercialism and obligates couples everywhere to buy junk for each other. It’s nice to have an option for people who are single or just otherwise don’t care for Valentine’s Day but still want to receive or send something. Cute, just a little bit glittery, and a nice sentiment.

title: Gorgeous journal and keepsake
text: This leather-bound journal has such an old fashioned, gorgeous, handmade elegance to it. It has decorative hand-stitching along the sides, as well as sectioned, hand-stitched pages, and the pages themselves have a rough parchment-like quality and texture and that makes this look like something out of an old apothecary or witch’s cabinet. I absolutely love the aesthetic, and think it will make a great drawing/sketch/concept book. The look inspires creativity, and whatever you put inside is automatically elevated by the mystery of the exterior.

title: Pop-up style cards that move!
text: [[VIDEOID:8e5b7a4671a2285b732b8065995a2689]] These pop-up style cards are absolutely delightful, featuring a number of designs, most of which move when you open them to reveal a gift card. This animated fun is a great way to present congratulations and a gift. You have to see the video!

title: Standard packing tape gun
text: This is your standard packing tape gun, so if you’ve used one before, this is exactly like any of those others. Dangerous when used improperly, excellent for those of you having to pack a lot of boxes. If you have a move coming up, or if you have a business that involves shipping, this is much better than the smaller plastic models.

title: Printer forgot wireless network; had to reset
text:
For no reason, and only after using it twice, the printer stopped printing wirelessly. Checking the settings, we noticed it was now saying that the connection was wired. At no point did we connect any wired Internet cables to the printer. I’m not even sure if we have one of those wires in the house, to be honest.

I looked everywhere, and there was no way to undo that. Checking the manual, which I hate doing and I believe it is a sign of a bad product that isn’t user-friendly, it informed me that you cannot have both wired and wireless Internet connected to the printer. Well, I could kind of tell that based on the fact that there was no way I could set up the wireless. I had to then hunt for how to restore factory settings, which was also not a straightforward process. I did that, reset everything, and reestablished the wireless connection. I suppose I will have the delight of doing this again at some point in the future. I don’t understand why printers are so terrible. The last several ones I’ve reviewed for Amazon have all had serious and annoying issues like these. Do better, guys.

Other notes: sleep mode activates too quickly. 30 more seconds would be a lot less stressful when trying to finish projects. Printouts look great, and printing is fast.

title: Comparable to post-it notes
text: These are great—just like the post-it brand with vibrant colors and nice stickiness without residue.

title: Christmas cards from the big guy himself!
text: These adorable, colorful cards for kids happen to be from The Santa Claus himself! Kids will love getting something from the big guy up North—so cute, and a great price for the pack (about $2.50 each). Great!

title: She LOVED it! Beautiful card for mom
text: [[VIDEOID:9be29f4a1c20a3fe221f14c49b83d396]] My mom absolutely LOVED this card. It is dynamic, beautiful, warm, and makes a cute keepsake. It is fun to view from different angles and just does a wonderful job creating a sense of “home”, no matter the house and no matter the mom. Check out the video!

title: must-have cards--covers MANY occasions/events
text:
[[VIDEOID:e02b63f1d3ca18b1f49494ee73c7db6]] This set of cards is a huge money and time saver. This covers everything from birthdays to general congratulations (graduations, successes, recovering from something, marriage, etc! All you need is to fill in details to personalize them.). You have thank you cards, a “happy retirement”, appreciation for administrative professionals…I love this.
At only $19.99 Prime, this comes to only $1.67 per card. That’s awesome. And some of them have foil or glitter, so it’s not even a cheap assortment. They look great and have a colorful assortment of matching envelopes.
See video for some of the included cards and how they shine.
Excellent—5 stars!

title: excellent value, many uses--essential cards for the home!
text: At about 63 cents per card WITH envelope (current price of $15~ for 24 cards with envelopes, Prime), this is an awesome value pack of general "congratulations" cards, and essential and versatile item for your home. The cards look just like the pics (gold is gold foil—nice shine), and you get several choices to match a variety of occasions, from graduations to weddings, births to opening a business—there are many uses for these cards, and it’s great to have something that works for this much, costs this little, and lets you stay home instead of having to go out and get something every time you want to celebrate something good in a friend or colleague’s life. Great assortment!

title: Great for regular use, laser
text:
I found some of the other (negative) reviews interesting because they were for high volume situations and different printers, which apparently caused some compatibility/performance issues. I had never thought of the finish of a paper or how it might react to different printers.
In my case, my review is positive because it works fine with my black and white laser printer and has enough thickness that I can print on both sides without any major issues. How it does with inkjets and in high volume cases? I can’t say, honestly. But as one of two students in a household with maybe 5-7 pages of printing a week total, this works fine and is a great value! If I have to make copies, I can do that at home and it doesn’t cost much and looks fine. Normal brightness, works fine, printer takes one sheet at a time without issues. (Thinner papers sometimes jam printers—this one seems to be ok!)

title: great dry erase board erasers
text: These work just as you'd expect and just like any other dry erase board erasers. Since the listing is not up yet, I can't see the price, so I can't speak to their value, but they are pretty much standard items that perform as expected.

title: Great, but the pockets are a little flimsy
text: The perforated pages make them easy for tearing, and with the hole punches, you can put them in a binder or in one of the many pockets. The dividers all have pockets so you can keep handouts, though their material is a little thin and flimsy—not sure how they’ll last over time, plus they’re rather small, so don’t plan on storing many pages. The cover is durable, as is the binding. Nice 5-subject notebooks! Not sure what the pricing is as I review this—the listing isn’t up yet (Vine reviewer), but the quality is a little less than name brands like 5-star. If the price is less, then go for it! But if it’s not, then I would go with 5-star.

title: Encouraging fitness journal!
text:
I know there are apps for this sort of thing, but there’s something uniquely satisfying about putting stuff on paper. Especially when it’s stuff that you’re planning and stuff that you’ve accomplished. It’s great to see your progress there in front of you!
The layout is terrific: you have daily stuff with easy checkmark boxes of workouts you did and what you covered, as well as some weekly calls, monthly check inns, and plenty of encouragement throughout. There’s even a bookmark that clicks into the rings with positive messages to remind you to keep working. Awesome!

title: Terrific board packaged badly; lots of dings
text:
It’s a shame how badly this otherwise perfect board was packaged. It came with So Many Dings and cracks on all sides.

Aside from that, though that is a Big problem, the board is Great! You get two writing surfaces and can easily swap between sides. The wheels make it very transportable, and the ledge at the bottom easily stores erasers and markers, with room to spare for displaying anything.

3.5 stars because of the highly damaged goods. It would have been 5 stars.

title: Compatible; great value—large size!
text:
This 4-Pack Toner box arrived well packed and sealed with easy instructions. These are the larger “High Yield” Cartridges that last longer than the ones typically provided when you first buy a printer (Black, Cyan, Magenta and Yellow).

It only took about 10 minutes to install them in my HP Color LaserJet Pro M252dw printer. The screen displayed “Non-HP supply installed” but the “Demo Page” printout and subsequent printouts look the same as the original HP Cartridge printouts. The “Supply Status Supply Level” indicates 100% on all Cartridges, so compatibility is not a problem.

This is a really good value for toner cartridges that produce the same output for about 1/4 the price!

title: Happy booty, aligned spine!
text:
Not only is this comfortable, but it is helping me stay in alignment, with better posture. The tacky beads on the bottom prevent slippage, so the cushion stays in place during a remarkably comfortable sitting experience. As you sit, you Melt into this foam cushion, and the stress on your sits bones isn’t there like it is with any regular seat. Wow!
I’m bad news, you’ll hate sitting anywhere else. I never noticed how uncomfortable literally every other seat in my house is. Yikes!

title: Cute but underwhelming
text:
For a card with such a generic and short message, there’s not a whole lot of room to write on the inside, since the confetti print covers the left. Speaking of which, for a “bring on the confetti” theme, it feels kind of meh. A pop-up element would have added a lot to this, but there’s nothing like that here. It just feels and looks kind of flat.

The card is cute, but mostly just “ok”. Nothing exciting or remarkable here.

title: Horrendous setup—still not working
text:
Initially, I tested this with a copy, which worked fine and as expected. I figured this was good for basic office applications like copies, faxing, and quick printing. Then I tried to set up the wireless. I’ve already sunk over an hour on this clunky garbage, and still no results. The instructions don’t even correspond to the 1990’s style display that takes you in circles and dead ends.

I just need to interrupt the review to say I HATE THIS PRINTER.

Ok, back to setup. The manual, which I usually don’t have to consult because most modern printers walk you through everything on the display, DOES NOT CORRESPOND TO THE PRINTER. It leads to “wireless setup wizard”. THERE IS NO WIRELESS SETUP WIZARD ON THIS JUNK. I followed the steps, and when it led to something that didn’t exist, I did everything else I could with NO RESULTS. So this junk currently has NO WIRELESS.

Fine, try hard wire connection. It’s next to the router anyway, so no problem then. THAT DIDN’T WORK EITHER.

I then tried downloading the drivers and setting up through my computer, which has not had problems with any of the last 6-7 printers I’ve used. It couldn’t find it.

So now I have an oversized black and white copy machine that literally does nothing else but that. Terrible job, HP. Terrible.

title: Beautiful, strong notebook keepsakes
text: Perfect for journaling, writing, musing, or putting down anything on paper that you plan to keep, these gorgeous but simple notebooks are a great way to elevate notes and writings. They’re dated on top, have reinforced seams and elements along the spine and covers, include two ribbon bookmarks in gray and black (to differentiate between where you left off and a place you are saving), as well as elastic to keep the journal closed. title: Shiny metallic details—nice!
text: Just like the picture, the envelopes are gold-lined and have a great shine to them, and they match perfectly with the thank you cards inside. They’re simple, elegant, and tasteful—great to have around for a variety of occasions of giving thanks. Very nice!

They look great on just about any kind of paper, dark or light, and the lines are thick, juicy, and impactful. title: easy to use for many things!
text:
This is a pretty nifty tool for a variety of applications, most of which relate to education and science. For me, I have a book of sewing patterns, and I used to have to work with a grid and then draw another on newspaper or something else to then make these into paper patterns. So glad that's over now. With this, I can project the page onto a wall, where I use painter's tape to secure the paper there, and then draw directly. For proper scale, just make sure the surface has a ruler, and the page in question has a little scale thing showing what a unit there amounts to on your wall. Example: 1/16 of an inch equals an inch. Draw a little 1/16 inch square on the page and have a little 1 inch square on the wall, and make sure it lines up correctly for the right proportion. There are other ways, but that's what worked for me. It worked fine with a projector I got on Vine a while back--no fuss!
I'm also excited at the possibility of doing some reviews or tutorials using this, since the record feature is pretty easy to use, and you can get a detailed, up-close look at items.
Very good tool for a number of applications!

title: pretty, simple, unpretentious
text: These simple cards have a rustic, unpretentious quality perfect for garden weddings. The floral motif, complete with gold embossed elements and a patterned background, is simple, colorful, and fun--not too serious or baroque--and the message is equally simple. The gray envelopes are ok for the cards, but something more pearlescent would have been nicer. Altogether very nice!

title: Good!
text:
Formulas and data on the inside covers: curve formulas, information on right triangles, leveling, probable error, minutes in decimals of a degree, inches in decimals of a foot, and trigonometric formulae.
Each double-sided page has a front with a grid (with a red center line), and a back with six columns and 25 lines.
The paper is thick enough to not show the ghost of pencil writing, or most ball point pens, the gel pens and felt tip pens me bleed through.
Good quality, strong cover!

title: Smooth, uninterrupted line; nice weight, feel, and look
text:
Pentel has excellent quality office products, and I’ve been using their mechanical pencils since I was a kid (my dad always got them for the house and is a huge fan!)
This pen, like other products by this brand, is of quality design and construction, offering a smooth, uninterrupted line of thick, black gel ink. The weight and balance feel perfect, and you can expect a comfortable and flawless writing experience. Very nice!

title: Nice quality, nice big size pack
text: These are great cards for studying and do a decent job of not letting color bleed through, as long as you write reasonably quickly. Good size package and nice quality!

title: Beautiful, but without “I”, “love you” rings a little hollow
text:
This card is so pretty and has a whimsical handcrafted look that evokes handpicked flowers or other keepsake gifts. The only criticism I have for this otherwise perfect card is the absence of “I”. The whole “love you today, love you tomorrow,” thing feels really impersonal and weirdly detached. If someone says “I love you”, it has a very different impact than “love you”.
I guess this is a good card if you’re not quite there yet in a relationship, or if you write something really touching to counter the absence of “I”.

title: 50% recycled, laser or ink, can do double sided
text:
With its 20lb thickness, this versatile paper can easily print double sided with a laser printer, or for inkjet, provided it is not an ink-heavy image but just text on draft or basic mode.
The fact that it has 50% recycled content is also great—really, 90% of paper Should be at least half recycled, if not more. The hints of slightly differently colored fibers is subtle and looks cool, adding something special to the look without being overtly rustic. The color is light enough to still show text perfectly while letting it stand out among leafs of white.
Great office and school paper!

title: Dissolves—works best with PC
text:
Fortunately, I also have a PC, so I didn’t even bother to try with my Mac (their template page and options have been consistently horrible in the past for MAC, requiring a tremendous amount of run-around, sometimes resulting in labels not being usable at all, which is really unacceptable). So rather than make myself angry by going through that process again, I used the ole PC and went to the templates page, which had plenty of options and was easy to use.

These labels definitely do dissolve. Just be cautious when filling your jars and don’t make the mistake I did the first time, which was putting the label on first, getting things a little messy, and then realizing part of the label was ruined. Haha, well that one was on me!
Good product, but they need to work on their interface with Mac.

title: Fast, efficient, handles high volume
text:
This is working out great for my small business, and while I don’t have to print a whole lot of stuff, when I do, this does great!
Compared to the laser printer I have, it is a tiny bit slower, and of course, it doesn’t have that glossy water-resistant finish. But at the same time, I don’t have to pay $300 to refill toner (?!?!?). Avoiding the nightmare of that price tag makes ink a great alternative, and I still have the laser one for the times I specifically need that.
Another plus to this not being a laser printer is the fact more things are compatible, like labels, vinyl iron-on designs, and several paper types (the laser is picky with some of my card stock I had bought a few years back).

Printing speed is very fast, and it handles large jobs quickly, including copies. I don’t have a land line, nor have I needed to fax anything, so I can’t speak to that, but setup was pretty standard.

Great printer, and suitable for high volume!

title: Plenty of features, great for small businesses and taxes!
text:
When buying a desk top calculator, there are a few different reasons to decide between a thermal printer, or an ink printer. With a thermal printer, you never have to refill any ink, which is great, and it also saves money. The downsides are the fact that thermal paper tends to fade over time or with contact, or with heat. So for long-term storage, ink might make a little more sense. And once you have chosen ink, it’s not a bad idea to pick a printer that has more than one color, because then you can separate data a little more effectively to see what you’re doing.
For small business, the cost/sell/margin feature is pretty useful, as well as the date and time to keep track of transactions, and then there’s other stuff like double checking and currency converter, which I didn’t really use, but it’s nice that it’s there.

This is Excellent for small business owners, or people with complicated taxes. Very handy little tool! And it’s portable!

title: durable and versatile
text:
This paper is awesome, and the whole thing feels super sturdy! The layout is simple but versatile, with the front showing all the months with some space to write concise notes, and then weeks are divided evenly M-F with less space for Sat/Sun (I hate that, but I'm not taking stars off since it's kind of standard...but it sucks). Next to the weeks on the left, the right has dot paper, which allows you to free-write and keep uniform spacing an lines, or draw, or do whatever you want, but the grid dot design allows for more versatility, which is nice.

Other standard features:
-holidays for 2018, as well as equinoxes, solstices, time changes, and tax day, etc.
-unit conversions in the back
-ruler on back cover

Good!

Nice card!

title: Beautiful images and quotes!

text:
This is a durable, comfortable stacking chair with light padding on the seat and back. Is it lovely to look at? No. But it is a practical choice that works for many settings and can always be covered with fabric slips to suit more formal occasions.
Good product!

Quality board for your classroom!

title: Whimsical well-wishes good for any occasion!

title: Cool toy/practical for some people
text:

title: Exactly what you'd expect!

text:

They *Can be reused, but there are limits to what that entails depending on the surface you stuck the letters to (e.g. construction paper is very pulpy and comes off, leaving fibers behind), how careful you were removing them (they're slightly thin, so be careful), and how many times you put these letters through the process.

title: Solid protection
text:
Being the thicker kind, these really do a great job protecting photos, not just from moisture, solar degradation, and fingerprints, but they also make it harder to bend them. Because of the thickness, if your machine has two settings (faster/cooler versus slower/hotter), i found the slower way worked best.

For my business, I like it to make small pricing sheets. It makes colors pop, and generally looks really professional and finished, plus the benefits I stated above.

Great product!

title: rough setup and heavy; professional results
text:
I don't like having to read instructions. Well-designed products like printers should be plug and play, and this was Not that. It had me going in circles with network issues, and there was a lot of back-and-forth with the Mac, which led to my grudgingly having to read a manual online. Not a happy camper. Of all the printers I have reviewed the last few years, this one made me jump through the most hoops.

Side note: TEAM LIFT. This thing is HEAVY.

Aside from those complaints, the printout quality is excellent, and for its multifunctionality and the fact it is a color laser printer, the price is quite reasonable. I remember how much something like this would have cost 5 years ago, so it's nice as a small business owner to have home access to something yielding professional results.

It's a pain in the butt at first, but with some patience, it is worth the hassle.

title: great standard features and size, plus US time zones and area codes
text:
Studies show that physically writing in a planner is more effective when strategizing and organizing your life (at least when it comes to setting goals), and for me, it just feels better than putting it in iCal (which I do anyway for essential appointments).

This planner is what I use for my business, and it is very helpful. It shows your month at a glance, as well as a breakdown of the week with lots of room to write and no pre-written times, which is better. After all, not everyone has their stuff from 9-5, and some times may need multiple lines where others would be blank, hence the complete uselessness of printed times.

This sort of thing is generally boilerplate, so no need to go into further detail with the usual features. Here are the things This one has that others may not:

-plastic folder in back for loose papers (2 pockets)
-US time zones and area codes (great for tracking phone calls)
-list of major holidays in back
-sections for notes in weekly breakdown as well as monthly

title: wish they were more reusable
text: At a little under $2 per label, these are pretty expensive. Having said that, the concept is pretty cool. Write and re-write on the labels with chalk or chalk pens! It works as described, even though the surface feels nothing like chalk board (probably a good thing), but they're not exactly re-usable in the larger sense. The issue is the thinness of the stickers and the adhesive. They only stick so much the first time, and each subsequent time is a little weaker. If they had made them thicker and had some other options for the backing, it would have been better. Then, instead of being a disposable item, it could be more like a gift in itself by being able to be applied in various places. Pretty cool, and if you pick a surface you are keeping, these will probably last a while!

title: pretty tight security with neat features like recording an intruder's voice!
text:
I'm not huge on reading instructions, so it was somewhat annoying to really have to read instructions here. Also, the fact you need a screwdriver to change the batteries is a little much, especially considering the "reset" button is easy to access on the outside, so there's really no need for a maximum security battery slot. Having said that, this is a pretty cool journal for those middle school years. The invisible ink pen is really neat and can only be seen with a black-light (there is a small one IN the journal, which not only makes the ink visible, but makes this a fun thing to do in bed at night, hidden under blankets!) There is also a small compartment for miscellaneous goodies like jewelry and notes from class behind the little notebook that is included.

The voice password worked pretty well, too! My girlfriend was able to get in, but she has a pretty similar voice. We tried making a much higher and much lower voice, and not only could we not get in like this, but it recorded the voice as an intruder and we could hear it when we got in using our voices later.

Also featuring a programmable idea database, it promotes self-expression with some (very) basic writing prompts. Don't expect anything like "write about your acceptance speech at your first nobel peace prize award". haha. Yes, this is a pretty gendered product. Even so, it promotes writing and self-exploration, and those are very good things! The features are cool and fairly easy to use. Great gift idea!

I really like it but for some reason it came without a legal notepad like it usually does with the other portfolios. So you might want to purchase that separately before giving it as a gift since it looks a bit empty without it. Otherwise, it's a good looking portfolio, well made and all official like. Great for first timers or any professionals who use them in their daily lives.

title: Cute bookmark
text: The bookmark came in a small plastic sleeve and slightly bent. It was easy to straighten out but it showed me how fragile it was. It's a lovely bookmark but bends under lightest of pressures, so needs to be handled with care. Good gift if you want something small sent in the envelope together with a holiday card.

title: Nice journal
text: The journal has hard cover that does not bend. The pages are regular, lined with date space. It's a good journal but the cover is a lot darker than I would have liked and gets dirty easily.

title: Funny card
text: I love this slightly goofy but fun card with a short message inside. The card is made out high grade medium thickness paper and comes with a matching envelope. It's a bit smaller than regular cards sold in the store.

title: Cute card
text: I love this slightly silly but fun card with a short message inside. The card is made out high grade medium thickness paper and comes with a matching envelope. It's a bit smaller than regular cards sold in the store.

title: Very festive holiday card
text: The front of the card states The best things in life aren't things and the sentiment continues inside with words They're are people like you. It's a very sweet message that will surely make someone out there feel special. The card is decent size, made out of high grade medium paper and comes with a matching red envelope.

title: Wonderful holiday card
text: This card is absolutely beautiful for that someone special in your life. It has a message inside but also space to leave some sentiment of your own if you so wish. It's big and has a matching envelope. It's detailed and delicate, made of high grade medium thickness paper.

title: Good for printing
text: This paper is good for everyday printing or using it however one needs at home or office. Good quality paper.

title: Good prints
text: The prints are glossy, colorful and with big letters and numbers. The subjects are varied and cover a wide range of subjects - some simple and some a bit more complex, kids have fun while learning. My girl likes them.

title: Beautiful pop up card
text: The card is made of high grade medium thickness paper. The bee is so detailed and absolutely stunning. It can be used for any occasion. There is ample space on both side for wishes or words of affection. I love it. I am keeping it for now in order to find the perfect occasion!

title: Bouquet of roses that never fades
text: The card is well made from high grade medium thickness paper and features a pop up bouquet of roses. The pages on both sides have ample space for words of affection. Suits for anyone who one feels love for. With matching envelope it can be sent anywhere.

title: A card to make one feel valued
text: In the time like this many people on front lines feel undervalued. Even a small gesture can lift one's spirits. This card is well made from high grade medium thickness paper. It's well detailed and showcases  paper figurines of essential workers. We got it for our eldest daughter's teacher as a sign of appreciation since we are doing distant learning.

title: Beautiful free standing card
text: This card is well made from thick high grade paper. It's free standing and comes with a matching envelope. It's very detailed and depicts a couple in embrace standing on the bridge with backdrop of a church and colorful trees. One drawback is that there is no place to write any words of affection but the picture itself speaks of warm feelings so it serves its purpose well. I like it.

title: Good magnetic notepad
text: The magnetic notepad sticks well to the fridge's outer surface. Every page is easy to tear off. The pages have no sticky part, just plain sheets of paper decorated with lines and Harry Potter Universe words. Good to have for household needs.

title: Good manual pencil sharpener
text: The sharpener is easy to use and empty, the pencils come out sharp. Lightweight and fits into any pencil case.

title: Decent calendar

title: Good set of bookmarks

They come separate in two bags with a small black cord that loops through a small hole on top of the bookmark. Perfect as motivator, reward or gift.

title: Good set of educational posters
text: The posters are made out of glossy medium thickness paper. The images are bright, the letters are easy to read and the pointers are easy to follow. My girl started asking questions about human body, so this was my response since I sometimes can't remember. She likes looking through them when she gets curious. Apart from general systems there are also detailed pictures of organs that are kid friendly and show their inside work. Good educational posters.

title: Cute lap desk
text: The desk is well made from light colored bamboo wood. The legs are adjustable and have silicone caps included to make sure they do not slide. The angled desk is easy to set but we didn't get the little border to keep things from sliding down, so it's pretty useless. Otherwise the desk is neat and comes in handy when one wants to be comfy on the couch and get some work done.

title: Good set of cards
text: Cute Happy Birthday cards with a bit of character and quirkiness. They are well made from thick good quality paper and have colorful watercolor designs. They have matching envelopes. They are a bit smaller in size than regular cards, so will cost a bit more in postal fees if the receiver is not local. But if you have many people to send and give wishes for, this cards set is an absolute treasure.

title: Fun Thanksgiving cards

title: Good set of journals

title: Cute!
text: This set is basically two glittery pencils with removable furry pencil toppers: kitty and unicorn. Once the pencil is all used up, the toppers can be moved onto the next pencil. Fun!

title: Good set of vintage printing paper

title: Lovely notebook

title: Good scanner for our needs
text: The scanner fits great with what we need it for. It's lightweight, compact and is very easy to set up. The touch screen is bright with letters big enough that we do not have to strain to see. We use it for household: receipts, documents, kids school papers and the like. It scans fast enough for me. I like using it.

title: Good cartirdges set
text: The ink cartridges came in a neat compact box, perfect fit for out printer and print bright pages. How long they last depends on how often you print.

text: The envelopes are well made out of high grade paper, sturdy with good adhesive that holds. The information inside can not be seen even through the light. Very satisfied. Perfect for business or household bills.

title: Good notebooks
text: The notebooks are sturdily made with medium thickness paper. The paper is smooth, the clear wrap protects the pages. It's great for school or office work. They are compact and will fit into any drawer or bag. I like them a lot.

title: Nice set of BD cards
text: The cards are made out of medium thickness high grade paper with various designs on them. They suit both adults and kids. They are very tasteful and come with suitable envelops in muted green color. The cards are packed in a box with plastic cover. We sent out one already. The recipient was happy.

text: The laminator came well packaged. There are 10 standard size pouches, edge cutter and a comprehensive instruction. We needed one since it is our first laminator. title: Good board
text: The board is compact and lightweight. It has 4 holes one on each corner, so it can be hung either vertically or horizontally. title: Good set of stickers

Always handy to have if you need to write something down.

Great for crafts, signing, coloring or anything mind can get up to.

title: Gorgeous journal

title: Cute Easter cards

title: Good scanner
text:
This is a nifty little thing. I love using it. But first, it took a long time to set up the drivers. We didn't have to do anything beyond clicking couple of buttons, but it was a long installation. The manual is confusing because it includes instructions for similar yet different models of the same product. There are small but significant differences, and at first I was baffled that I could not find the things indicated on the picture. I finally figured out it was a different model. Why did they do that?

It's very easy to use. Put the document intended for scanning face up and press the button. It scans within seconds. Then it pops up on the screen. The quality of the scan is excellent, the color is bright and everything is straight. Another thing to add, it has a paper guide so you can scan documents of smaller size i.e. A6, A5 and B5. This scanner is compact, lightweight and easily fits into any bag, purse or carry on. Wonderful product that is worth its weight in gold for how convenient and useful it is when you need something scanned urgently and you are away from home.

title: Cute cushions

title: Wonderful journal
text: Made from leather, the cover has antique look. The string that ties it closed, gives it even more character. The inside paper is rough hewn and hand stitched with nothing on the pages. It would make a wonderful gift for anyone who writes daily as well as for a themed party. I love the old-fashioned look of it. Highly recommend it.

title: Good product
text: This pen cup is sturdy and well made. It can hold plenty pens and pencils. It looks good in kids room, kitchen or office. Simple yet necessary.

title: Good pins
text: The pins are of decent quality in a pack of hundred. They will work well in classroom, in the office or anywhere you want something pinned. They hold well.

title: Cute pen
text: This pen is so cute. It works as it should and writes well. The unicorn on top is colorful and makes writing a pleasure. It would make a nice gift or a party favor. I recommend it.

title: Love it!
text:
This printer came with a comprehensive manual, CD with app install, and 4 ink cartridges. It's lightweight and very easy to put ink inside. The setting up process is not long. Once the printer was connected to WiFi, we installed the app. For newer laptops that do not have CD-ROM as was the case with one of ours, we went to control panel, chose printers and this printer was on the list of available to install, so we were all set pretty quickly.

The quality of ink is good, and it prints very distinctly and fast. It scans fast and can send the scanned document to any e-mail. There is a compartment underneath that stores paper, and when not in use, the fold out tray can be stored in so as not to take too much space. The printer itself sits low and is not bulky. We loved using it. It's a great addition to our home office. I recommend it.

title: It's ok
text:
** 3.5 stars **

The mat is long and wide and not too thick. It's comfortable on elbows, and keeps things from sliding. But it has horrible smell, very strong! I hope it airs out soon!

title: It's ok
text:
** 3.5 stars **

The calendar is ok quality. The paper is neither thick nor thin. The binding in the top looks a bit flimsy, and it's sticking out of the wall on one side while hanging. It's good for everyday use. The lettering is big enough and easy to read, and there is space on the side for notes.

title: Good enough
text:
** 3.75 stars **

It's thin and good for protecting documents, it might tear if you put too much in it. If put on the shelf for storing, it would serve well and long. Not for everyday handling. It's nice for home office.

title: Nice product
text: It takes about a minute to sharpen a pencil from scratch. You have to hold the base or it might start to spin. It's easy to clean and comes with a power cord. It's an ok product and good to have in a household with children who constantly use pencils. I recommend it.

title: Good board
text: The board is great. You use any dry erase marker, and it works like a charm. It even came with a little gift - magnetic dry erase whiteboard sheet for fridge which was cute, thanks for that. One issue though for us was how heavy it was. It's hard to balance and put it on the wall. So that was a bit of a hiccup. But as for other things, I am satisfied with it.

title: Nice addition to the home office
text: This rug comes in stylish pattern and muted color. It's sturdy and durable under the chair wheels. It does weight quite a bit though. For moving efficiency the rug can be folded in half and wouldn't take up any place while in storage.

title: My daughter loves it!

title: Item as described
