Paper quality is like cut-up ordinary A4 paper....does have a pocket in the back and some label sticker which I honestly don't know what to do with. Item as described. Nothing to complain, but nothing very impressive either. It is a pretty and elegant journal.

title: As described
text: [[VIDEOID:89cf153c5998d793f5f2e10ee7997b8]] Fairly puffy but lightweight. Some wrinkles indicating not so great layering/ patch work. Does fit standard notepad but tad tight. Works the way it should and can't complain.

title: Works the way it was advertised
text: [[VIDEOID:87cf6684ecec606be8f776d12a5a2894]] Works the way it's advertised and here are a couple facts to consider before you place order. 1. It is soft clip board made of leather (so it is said) won't be sturdy for you to do your charting. It would be more like "I have done most of my charting but just need something to draw down notes". 2. Came with 3 stickers but not enough space to stick them so they don't get in the way. Guess most of the knowledge is in your head anyway so I chose not to stick any since I hate flipped up edges or sticky residue. 3. Best used for 1 TO 5 a4 paper so you can fold it up and stick in your pocket. This won't accomodate a small notepad nor thick pack of A4. 5 star just for product as described. But after receiving I personally would not want to use it for work because it is not very convenient and I will likely just find a random piece of paper and fold and stick in my pocket.

title: Didn't meet my expectations but work
text: [[VIDEOID:98ebe244c2d4212f6953420c770e0e6a]] Yes it works. I didn't like how the magnet is only one 10cents size tiny magnet that could tolerate 1 page of paper inside. These would do great if you're using it primarily as white board for the kids to practice on. I think for homeschool parents these won't make the cut, especially considering all the frustrations from falling folder. I hope my video help express my frustration.

title: Item as described and so far the cheapest one i could find
text:
Update- really difficult to keep it on the wall with tape..../

Ordinary fancy ad paper, but big, and very curly. I imagine if you get something printed at office depot or ups or FedEx it would probably cost more- but i couldn't find out because their website made it hard to figure out the final price. This works great for me because i need something to keep track of life....also, it's just like an ordinary poster so i used tape to stick it on the wall. I didn't want to curl the other way so i laid it flat for a couple days......

title: great quality but smaller than pictured
text: Decent quality and item as described. Unfortunately, my fussy 2yo remained fussy and due to the 5lb weight, she wasn't strong enough to carry it that it actually didn't calm her down, and instead, got her more agitated that she's able to feel the heavy weight and just didn't like it. Fluffy and beautiful, a little smaller than I expected that it's really not a weighted "blanket" because it can't even cover my 2yo, but a weighted stuffed animal. Hope my children appreciate it as they grow.

title: Awesome set for you to keep your life organized
text: Came with everything pictured. It's not top quality but definitely great gift material with everything included. I especially love the stencils that it provides a lot of options to organize your life. The pricing point is decent and it's something I'd absolutely purchase if it was available before.....(the other similar set that I purchased came with an organizer bag and cost about 30 and I think this one is much more practical).

title: love this layout!
text: I think whoever came up with this chart is a genius! Came rolled up and you do need to flat it out for a while. I really like the layout and think it works perfectly for multikids family (mom of four here and I've put my husband on the chart too) that everyone should pitch in and take some responsibility being part of the family. It's worked perfectly so far and I'd recommend this to mom of multiple kids for her sanity.

title: Works as described
text: Works well and came with four nicely working pens. I was able to tear it off without tearing any part in my journal. These pages are very strong and plastic that it's hard to destroy them. I was able to also write with a pencil but of course it's not as clear. These have been working great but absolutely not an environmental friendly option.

title: ink pads can be of better quality
text: Nice complete set of stamps with a cute canvas fabric string bag. Ink is not of great quality, 2 out of the 4 are dried up, and very hard to get a good stamping. Also, it included a stack of stickers that is of better quality than the dollar store, but thinner than water bottle stickers- I tested on regular printing paper and was able to take it off without tearing the sticker so that is how I say it's a good quality sticker because I can't stand those stickers that don't stick and end up somewhere in the child's folder. The stamp result is acceptable but not as clear as how I expected them to be. Hope my feedback helps.

title: Awesome quality, big stickers!
text: These are great quality stickers! I did not disappoint. I tried it on an ordinary A4 paper and I was able to take it off slowly without tearing this sticker, and while it stuck on the paper it stays- that is big for me! I used stickers as rewards and as a way to calculate their points towards a bigger gift and it's very frustrating to see kids coming with a sheet that once was covered with stickers that now when trying to "redeem" for their gift that the stickers are all over the place, in their backpack, in their lunchbox, somewhere in the folder or stuck on the cloth. I'm very happy with the quality of these and think they are well worth the price.

title: great quality
text: Absolutely beautiful quality. It is a little smaller than what I expected- exactly an A4 size which allows it to be carried around in my opinion. It also included a sticker for days of the week that I have no idea how to use it.....other than that, this is of decent quality, very nice gift material, and I do hope with the help of this I get to help my children develop a nice habit that would be beneficial for life.

title: Smaller than expected
text: These are honestly much smaller than I expected and I am to get erasers of this size I'd get the very basic pink house topper. I think these are overpriced but I do give them credit for being special shapes and cute and work very well and leave no residue with erasing.

title: Ordinary markers, not ultra fine
text: These are "fine" markers, absolutely not "ultra fine" unless it's the brand name. Tip is much softer than sharpie but work great. For the price it's not bad and expected for ordinary markers. It's very easy to clean but I guess it has to do with the quality of your board too. Hope my feedback helps

title: decent double sided white board
text: I love the big size and all the pens and magnets that are included in this kit. Writes nicely and cleans up easily. For the quality and size I thought the pricing point is very fair. Happy with this order.

title: Work OK but quality is cheap
text: [[VIDEOID:335a3bf9de22eb8a7cf21363ac12a648]] While items as described, the quality is lower than expected. I couldn't get the easel holder to stand properly and the overall quality is just OK, as in rough edges and no cushion which leads to holder not holding up. Clips are also of cheap quality. I love the design but the clips easily break with metals out of the proper position. All led me to question the pricing point. The board work well though and if you have a spot to hang these this set is perfect.

title: item as described....didn't work for me
text: Work as described but didn't work great for my need. Great quality and appears to be silicone. Gets very warm staying on the wrist for a while and doesn't clean well with the eraser that's included. I stopped using it after 2 uses because of how uncomfortable it was but felt bad since it's used and not very clean for return so I have to keep it..... pricing point seems to be high for me.

title: Works well for Journaling
text: Beautiful colors. Colors dry up quickly. As long as you don't wipe it immediately it doesn't smear. Beautiful variety of colors. Can't complain.

title: Item as described
text: This is exactly what I wanted. I slid an A4 in so you can see the size. I'm using this as a teaching material /white board for my students, and I think the fabric hook work better than just a hole so they can hang on the wall. I do wish it's cheaper though.

title: Okay quality
text: It's ordinary, right in the middle sheet protector quality and you can easily do one of these with sheet protectors and a binder from any store. So I can't say I'm completely satisfied with the quality but I'll take it for this price.

title: These are awesome
text: These came as described. They are of thick cereal box cardboard material and the prints are just as described. If you know Chinese these are super cute and hilarious for the Chinese lunar new year. Very happy to get these for my kids to enjoy the coming new year.

title: Lovely design, great quality
text: Much bigger and lot more than I thought! Great quality. Sticks tightly onto paper while not difficult to take off-if you want to reposition it immediately. Also came with a cute bookmark. We also really enjoyed the design. It's very easy to use these for writing projects or cards for friends (compared to lots of flowers or hearts). Great purchase!

title: Beautiful set and generous gift material
text: This is a beautiful and generous set for anyone who loves calligraphy. The nibs didn't hold onto the ink as well as how I want it to, and each dip could only finish one letter or part of the letter depending on the nib you choose. Fresh out of the box I had quite some dust sticking onto my fingers. Other than that these are of quality details and weight to every little piece.

title: Great powerful magnets
text: For the price, this set is versatile and of great quality. The magnets are very powerful and was able to hold my notepad. I use these for keeping track of all the todos for my family and they work really well. Also came with felt sticker to cover your magnet - if that matters to you.

title: Great quality set
text: Like most other highlight products this set is of really good quality. I did enjoy the abundance of ideas to encourage young kids to doodle and write. I didn't like how there's no example though but I have yet found any writing book that would offer samples for young kids to kind of learn from copying. Still, a box with a ton of ideas and is very appreciated by a parent.

title: Good quality. Wish there's examples
text: Just like most highlights product, these are of high quality items. Pages are thick and would be appropriate for markers if you desire. However, I didn't like how there's only prompts in word, but no example for the kids to begin with. While I understand the goal of stimulating children's imagination, it does leave the pages very blank and my son loses interest immediately-he does enjoy seeing other's /beautiful paintings and artwork, but reading. Overall items as described, but the content didn't meet my expectations.

title: Should give more letters....
text: Very nice pencil case that could go smoothly onto a B5 sized notebook - anything bigger would be pushing it as the strap really isn't very stretchy after all. Packaged very sturdy and would work as a perfect gift for your student. My only frustration comes from the amount of letter blocks - that I simply cannot figure out what I can spell with them. Mine couldn't even make the word "love"...... So I really don't see the point of including any letter blocks if you're only giving so very few that you can hardly find words that make sense and look nice to customize your pencil case. Hope this information helps.

title: Item as described
text: Material is fairly thin but sticks nicely onto the white board and is exactly what I need for homeschooling. Considering the price this is a great buy.

title: Cute little daily planner
text: Quality made. Spacious back pocket. Pages as described, sturdily built with no perforation so you keep track of your everyday. The layout covers most of what I need with somewhat too little space for appointments but that's adjustable by using the space in to-dos. Overall satisfactory purchase.

title: back pocket doesn't work
text: Item as described. Nicely made. However, to determine from durability and sturdiness this book is okay primarily because of the perforated pages and wired binding (so I don't know why it's featured to rate according to that) otherwise this is just an ordinary pretty daily planner that has an additional tiny envelope pocket that doesn't really work because its design and an elastic bookmark.

title: No option for overview
text: Fair priced. It's of the right size, good quality, lots of note space. Some features that are lacking- a lot of space for notes but only two days for a laid-out page. Some layout is confusing. It's day planner for Monday to Friday but not such for the weekends, but some of the weekdays are crammed in a page without time schedule. There's information for address, map, yearly calendar, and daily calendar, NO MONTHLY CALENDAR. It's okay...but not perfect for my use.

title: Great cart!
text: By far THE BEST rolling utility cart that I own. I personally don't like the handle design because it takes up space and makes the cart harder to hide. I love how clean and straightforward the look is. I love how easy the installation is. In fact, my 7yo son put everything together within 30 mins. It's the metal wire shelving system that anchors the shelf with plastic caps which makes it not only very sturdy but also super easy to take apart. It rolls perfectly and was addictive to my toddlers that they kept pushing it like a shopping cart. The only downside would be the size of it- if you want your A4-sized books to stand the space would be tight. I ordered this cart for organizing virtual school supplies and all the books have to "lay down" which limited the amount of books the cart could fit. Overall still really impressed with the price and quality of this cart.

title: nice product, didn't work for my needs. Not for eraser.
text: Quality item, but 1. I'm not sure about the price point. It appears to be plastics on an oversized mouse pad. I might not want to pay more than 20 for it. 2. it's not easy to clean if you do use a pencil and eraser. Since the pandemic my son has been schooling at home on our tile/wood dinner table and I desperately want to find a surface that would provide him a flat surface to write on. I like there's a scale but it's in cm not in, so may not be appropriate for US kids? There are many pockets to put your notes in but it does require some fine motor skills ...Overall doesn't work so well for my 2nd grader. Definitely something for an adult/ teen to stay organized.

title: Colors too subtle
text: The ink stayed on the board nicely but the colors are too subtle and hard to read. Cleans easily. I would not buy again because of the colors not as bright as what's shown on the package.

title: Beware of the measurements
text: Not what I thought. Still adorable and of decent quality. Item is made of smooth, soft to touch plastic. Measurements of papers are off and are just ordinary tiny blank notepad, no glue like post-it. When stacked together the extra pad feels unnecessary, but when left with only one, you always have to pull it out to write something, then tuck it back. Not so convenient for a busy office. But really adorable and appealing for the front desk /admission that I'll say!

title: Great deal!
text: Similar to big brand at a much cheaper price! I'm happy to finally fulfill my kids school supplies list. Wipe clean as well. I'll be buying more from this seller if we run out.

title: Little tool that made scanning documents so much easier
text: Very useful little tool. I love the app. You can do video, images, PDFs....almost like a cam holder for youtuber (which I don't have and am not familiar with), and works for recording documents. This little thing made uploading my kids' homework so much easier instead of needing to refocus multiple times with my phone or scan papers one at a time. Love this useful tool.

title: Didn't meet my expectations
text:
Came with not very thorough/ confusing instruction. Consider these: 1. This device doesn't work properly when offline. You can do text translation between Chinese, English, Japanese per the website but it failed with my attempts. 2. You do have to figure out what language you are trying to translate in order to translate. I was hoping this pen would figure it out and all I have to do is to read in English. 3. Voice recognition requires wifi connection and only work 30 secs interval. My work requires me to constantly be on the run and it's very hard to ask your customer to speak and wait. Plus you have to connect to wifi.....4. The website is very confusing. I didn't find this world pen in the dropdown menu. Customer service was responsive but with very minimal response, basically sending you a link to their QnA. 5. There's other translator pen that's a lot cheaper...

Overall the translation quality also feels as if using google translator. It is just a little easier considering the fact that you are not copy and paste every single sentence. But then it oftentimes skips a word or something and you have to scan again ( there's a delay). I feel this is a fancy device but more like an app translator in a small computer that only does translation but nothing else. It still doesn't replace translator, and I feel I can just rely on my phone and google translator since it's much slower.

title: Great dry erase pens
text: Works great. May need double wipes to make the board really clean but that's all dry erase pens. Great value considering how fancy the design is.

title: Great deal
text: Some size comparison and performance comparison with the big brand marker. We go through lots of these between art, school and marking. I thought it's a great deal and can't complain.

title: Cute, tad overpriced
text: This is my second squishy cover notebook so you know how much I like this style even though it's of a higher price. This is still very cute, but I feel the price doesn't reflect what you get and it's overpriced. You can't take the squishy tiger off. The back of the tiger came slightly teared. Every single page looks almost the same, only difference is it's either lined or graphed. I couldn't find a "routine". Pen is of great quality. I love how squishy and easy to write with it. Box came dirty, thought that might make a unpleasant gift. You can't lay every page flat because the first and the last pages are stuck, the rest are fine but because you can't take the tiger off, it still won't lay flat. So price and the overall quality and design didn't match up, hence this three stars and my honest opinion...

title: works great. but pricey
text: These work great just like the big brand pouches but they are so much pricier! I actually do regret ordering it before I do my price search. I may just return it.

title: Not transparent
text: Came in a box (very nice) but definitely not transparent. Just ordinary hook with ordinary white puffy tape. Not impressed. Yes still get the job done and can tolerate light stuff like washcloth or towel , but not happy 1. Color isn't right 2. I was hoping more towards glue dots kind of adhesives. White puffy tape easily breaks off and typically leaves residue.

title: Beautiful card
text: [[VIDEOID:e2952bdd7b7dd32b71e9282949995914]] Beautiful pearl glittery paper with plenty perforated design making it look like a big cricut project but definitely a pretty card. Thick covers but bouquet is made of one layer of card stock and fairly thin. I do think the bouquet look a lot smaller in person. I'm sending the card to someone in another state and this kind of bouquet is definitely cheaper than sending real ones.

title: Thin tape. OK adhesive
text: A Lot thinner than what I got a couple years ago. Thinner, hence smaller roll? I can't check on the length of each roll, but these are easy to be broken off if you did not cut it right. Very hard to find the tape if you forgot to mark where it ended. I think it causes more trouble than it should especially if you are in a hurry to move and pack. You get what you pay for.

title: OK stickie
text: These are just OK. Not a lot of difference compared to other brands. I own a peripage and a phomemo, and I like phomemo more than this, but that is the quality of the printer.... These stickers do really well for making labels or printing out documents. These appear to be a lot stickier than phomemo brand, but the paper is just ordinary white paper which means there's little chance of sticker survival if you need to redo/restick it. You can cut the sticker with the blade on the printer - if that explains the strength of these. Some wrinkles as it prints, but I'm not sure if it's the problem of the paper or the printer. Otherwise they do what they're supposed to do, and I don't notice anything outstanding.

title: Nice three slot L shapes magazine holder
text: [[VIDEOID:a675756ac91894db27345d8524ecb92c]] Works great for my need. It's a little deeper than ordinary L shape magazine holder that you can fit a binder nicely, which allows proper organization for my son's work surface. I used label sticker to label each section and it was easy to remove without leaving residue, but I used plastic thermal stickers, which shouldn't anyway. I hope you can see how not thick and bendy it is in my video. Also it didn't clearly marked which is base and which is back, but assembly really wasn't bad. However, the bendy plastic made me worry if it's going to break any minute. It didn't, and stayed intact through my rough skills. Overall satisfactory product, but I'm not sure if I'd pay 15 for it...

title: Good quality
text: [[VIDEOID:2b1a91dfd8721646d440e2026e621700]] I was curious about how sturdy and safe this storage box is so I ordered it. Now material is definitely high quality - cover is leathery but looks as if plastic /canvas, bottom has silicone stands to let it sit nicely. However, it's not a safe nor a sealed container. While it may prevent your precious paperwork from fire by closing the lid carefully, water will definitely still creep in and damage your whatever. I don't have a firepit to toss it to check on how fireproof it is. It's definitely well made and boards are made of hard plastic that's not easily bent. I'm not so sure about the price but it's definitely a high quality foldable storage box.

title: Nice set of journal and tools
text: Flimsy package box and it cannot be reused, the inside is lovely. All are as described. Stencils are numbered and has six holes for you to organize in a B5 binder. (though I'm not sure how convenient that could be since I'm not buying a binder to store stencils) Dotted pages in the journal. Everything came packed in the pretty organizer canvas bag. Only two things I didn't like :the company icon on the back of the journal, and the flimsy box it came in. Everything else is perfect.

title: Tiny storage that rolls well. Hard to disassemble
text: While I adore how beautifully the trays and parts stack together for storage, I must disagree with "easy to disassemble". I have a bathroom that everyone has to put their clothes and towels on top of the toilet and there's no space for their own toiletries so the size and height is perfect for that purpose. However, I don't regularly have guests over and would love to store it under the sink when not needed and I found disassembly quite painful. The system requires you to click the pieces together and you do have to push pretty hard with gravity to build it. Disassembly requires you to push on the latch in order to release the "click" and that really hurts my fingers. So yes everything works perfectly and you have the sharpie for size reference, but be aware that it's not an easy go back for storage.

title: As described. Plastic trays
text: Shelf as described with very generous shelf height for storage. My 9mo was able to crawl into and fit in it. Here's a few considerations that made it not five stars : trays are made by hard plastic instead of metal. Very cute floral pattern but those are holes at the bottom of the trays just FYI. I didn't particularly like their metal rods. They came slightly rusty - can't tell from the outside but you see the rusty stain on the plastic bags. As I work my way up I kept finding rods that have something blocking the tube and needed to push hard through it, then scraping some paint (?) or metal off that looks like iron sand. I do have babies at home and these are of some concerns to me. They stay together nicely without screwing the nails in and I honestly didn't use the wrench at all. The shelf stayed together fine without nails and taking apart need quite some muscle to pull apart because the rods stay together snuggly. It is cheaper and good looking, rolls nicely and appearance is appealing.

title: I really like these
text: [[VIDEOID:2a23cb393f4299d03daebd8c48984d0f]] These are adorable and just lovely bookmarks. Came in pretty box and are individually packed inside of the box. They are made of PVC and fairly bendy. I'm not sure how easy it'd break but right now they seem to be carefully made, very detailed, very flexible so I'd assume it'd last a long time. Makes really cute gift!

title: Beautiful sturdy laptop table
text: [[VIDEOID:476a96d77d3f9ea41fe4338a8baf6213]] Light weight. Beautiful color. Easy to use. Enough for me and my son to share the space so I can read and he works on his online school. Very happy with it.

title: Fun book. Not cheap though
text: [[VIDEOID:8bd83fcb002e61e95da65bdd5fc34452]] A mix of thin designed printer paper and some card stock. Die cuts, gift tags and gift boxes are card stock, and the rest, such as a couple bookmarks, are thin. I personally felt at this price point they should all be card stock. Hope the video gives you an idea about what's included. Still a lot of fun.

title: Great value
text: These are really good value. I like these more than the mesh ones because it's softer, even though it's less colorful. All are decently made and work as described. A4 paper for size reference in the picture.

title: Work as described
text: Size comparable to a kitchen scale (pictured for reference). Reading was accurate (also pictured). Package came with a soft ruler for measurements that I really appreciate. The only thing I don't like is it's batteries or DC, but that's known in the product description.

title: Sturdy envelopes
text: These are sturdy, thick envelopes. Hard to see through. I've had other brand envelopes and these turned out to be of much better quality. I'll get more from them if I need more.

title: Nice set, probably for experienced calligrapher not novice
text: I had fun with these especially the flat tip one. The paper is of fancy printing paper quality. Came in sturdy paperbox. My only complaint is not every ink is easy to install. I had trouble getting a couple on until I could find one that wasn't difficult to install. You can also do the sucking in a tube one, which unfortunately there's no tutorial so I have no clue how to get that job done. Also there's no refilling ink in this set. Compared to what you get in a giant box from craft stores I thought this is a great gift for someone who's familiar with calligraphy and looking for different tips for fun experiences (because for novice like me I really don't know what to do when I can't install the tube and don't know how to suck my own ink in the thing included)

title: Good quality, maybe not for US kids
text: [[VIDEOID:6da80e1e07cbeee47438bb01c860ff95]] Fairly tiny box of one of each stage pencil gripper. It's very nice that there's instructions on how to work your way up. Beautiful quality. However, I don't think these are made for US students. For the very typical pencil I get from school it's too big and easily slide up and down. The cap works really well though.

title: Lovely hardcover budget planner
text: [[VIDEOID:696e27670098ff4f7cf86b6759292eee]] Very pretty and of good purse size. Great tool for budget control. I love the monthly pockets for receipts. It's fairly lose which I assume is for the receipts to be filed. Very nice design and can be an all in one planner.

title: Very sticky
text: In a sturdy paper case for storage which also make it awesome gift. Comparable to happy planner sticker, but thinner, and a lot stickier, so don't think about rearranging it. Still a lot of fun design and even have numbers for each month so you can customize your calendar. I didn't like how month stickers are on different pages though, you'll have to hunt for them. Very cute and can't complain since it's a really nice alternative than happy planer brand that's more spend.

title: Works as described, just no ink, only stamp
text: [[VIDEOID:c8187602d774ca10c47c968060c4c5d9]] Works as described, smooth and clear (I used drawing pad so like construction paper material) however, there's only the stamp in the box. No ink. So if you want to use it forever you'd have to figure out where to get ink to reink this thing.

title: Pretty holder. Really hope the tab stickers could be of better quality
text: Beautiful design. Great for organizing. But works only for file thinner than 1.5 inches. So for thin homework or one subject these work great. For each grade it'd be unrealistic. Still happy with these. Only wish the tabs could be fancier. Big let down after seeing the pretty design of the file holders.

title: Nice organizer
text: These are great organizing tool. Does shrink my 3tier office rack organizer messy area into a somewhat tidier space. However because it's thin plastic and foldable it's not very sturdy and when you take things out you have to make sure it goes straight up not sideways or it can fall apart (you see with time the top is tumbling together so you do have to make sure there's a fair amount of stuff in it) . Also the tab stickers are really thin and flimsy and I really don't see how to use it. Overall very happy for now(a week) and we'll see how long it lasts. Also it cannot contain a 1in 3ring binder but works well for school folder.

title: Great size, pretty sticker. Very sticky!
text: These are really pretty and just the right size for packaging and closure of your envelopes. Very sticky so if you want to redo it you leave a mark. I haven't tried it on granite or furniture but I'm pretty sure you'd tear the sticker and leave a mess. Really nice deal though

title: Nice giftable journal set
text: Definitely nice gift material. Everything came in a fancy sturdy cardboard box. The only thing I would have wished that's different is the pen- it's heavy, it feels quality made, but I do like fountain pen or ink pen better. A set of felt tip pens and all the stencils do get your Journaling a very colorful fancy start.

title: Beautiful undated planner
text: [[VIDEOID:8a300b9312a9f55c53bd8ce6ef7ceb46]] I really like the layout of this planner. It's well made, got pouch, pen holder, elastic for book closure. Everything is really nice except for the stickers - 3 tiny paper sheets of stickers, all of the same pattern is just lame. Also the pricing is great (since I've seen plenty others asking for over 20 and contents are pretty similar.)

title: Very nice storage solutions
text: Exactly what I am looking for! Easily fit a file folder and pencil in for storage or just running between classes . The only issue you may have is when returning to in person schooling due to the size your paper can be folded at the edge being in your backpack. Sturdy and thick plastic.

title: Dull colors.
text: Nicely packed though appears to be for kids considering the flimsy frozen sticker it included. Colors are very mild and pastel but I like how they didn't smear easily and dry quickly after application. It says water resistant at the bottom, but considering how tiny those chisels are I'm not planning on using them on anything other than paper (notebook is of college lined). Glad that my books will be colorful.

title: Works great as foldable storage
text: I am probably dumb took me a while to figure out how to assemble this because it does require quite some finger strength to get it done. It holds plenty but continues to be... Not a rectangle but an odd shape. Still works great as a foldable storage.

title: Personal planner and journal
text: [[VIDEOID:3d181b9ff0594cc145998a3b945483f4]] Very nice "planner" but I think I'd put it more in the journal category. Has six months of monthly calendar followed by daily planner/Journaling and weekly reflection every seven days. Easy to lay flat for easy writing. Stickers are very tiny. The band closure is somewhat stretched possibly for you to stick a bunch of miscellaneous in the pocket in the back. Very thoughtful planner /journal all in one.

title: Nice organizer with consideration
text: Very nice organizer with free expendable backing allowing plenty to be filed. However, looking at just one corner of restriction you should know items are limited for such organization tool since pages easily slide out of the pocket. It does work perfectly for monthly filing A4 sized pages since there's twelve tabs. For anything else that requires thick booklet storage, say, homework of each subject, or anything that's tiny tiny, say multiple checks, it'll be pushing it. At least I wouldn't consider it secured judging by how much "protection" there is.

title: Nice planner. Too thick, heavy for a goer like me
text: [[VIDEOID:bc7572e50cd48209dbd46333446a52ff]] Hard cover, wired, colored thick paper dated planner. About the size of A4 but won't fit in a portfolio because it's really thick. Perfect for an office where it just sits there and you can look at it when you work. I was curious about the price so ordered this and I can only say despite how nicely weighted, wired and colored it is I'm not going to purchase more from this company just because of the price and how it doesn't allow easy take along. I'm an android user so I couldn't find the app in my play store. For $45 and it can only get one person organized I thought it is a luxury, just not for me. I also felt they didn't give much information on their planner on their product page so people could make decision on whether to get it or not, so I hope the video helps. It's tabbed by month. Each month start by monthly calendar, priority masterlist to figure out priorities and goals. More notes then weekly planner where it's hourly planned from 5am to 10pm, also places for your daily priorities and goals. At the end there's a tiny slot for you to store pages- it's too thin and tiny and doesn't store much. My hospital bills won't fit.

title: Beautiful gift with few considerations
text: [[VIDEOID:8c6ca230c06983f7eaf6b5e725bf1500]] Definitely lovely gift and works perfect for meditation. Each card comes with a poem, also the font is super tiny and thin, so if you don't like to read, or you are looking for gift for an old lady who likely needs reading glasses, turn away. Also came in the box is a journal which is made of all glossy paper and if you use water based ink it smears that I don't like. Also it doesn't lay flat which makes Journaling difficult. Still very pretty and giftable. A lovely addition to meditation and Journaling.

title: Sturdy. No USB option. Need to be plugged in
text: [[VIDEOID:73b929ed5da452ae1501ca92da3703c6]] Very heavy and sturdy pencil Sharpener. No USB outlet option. Works really fast. Perfect for office or school. Only downside is it doesn't stop when it's done. You push your pencil in for 3 seconds and it's usually done, other it keeps going and eat up your pencil. Also it doesn't take fat pencil such as one's from ikea.

title: Decent set at a great price
text: [[VIDEOID:616596ede05943d17d1a33fd93a64ac1]] Love the color and quality. Didn't like the clipper that came in the box because how flimsy and narrow blade it is. However, I really appreciate how thoughtful the seller is that everything is included to get you going properly. Also it's of a great price considering what I've seen at other places.

title: Nice undated planner
text: [[VIDEOID:c5bd14a80fa96b3eb5e475bd2b36e633]] Nice planner. Could have been a four if not because of the bonus printable. Planner itself is okay. I like how there's different motivational quotes each day and guide questions to promote self growth. But I would appreciate tabs since there's a lot of information spreaded out in a book and to make the most out of it you'd want to go back and forth to update your status. I really like how much content there is in each of the printable booklet. A lot of guidance and samples to help you get organized.

title: Made of plastic. Not for kitchen
text: I personally think it's not kitchen mat material considering how stiff it is at the bottom and the dots are wide separated. I move a lot in the kitchen between the sink and the stove the elevated edge not only gets in the way but also seems useless for my sore feet. However, my husband who works with computer all day, loves it. He said it helps relieve pain in the sole and the calf. So apparently this is for someone who is required to not move for a long period of time. Other than that, build is nice and sturdy. Bottom is definitely not soft and morel like thick plastic material. I'm not sure about the price point. I think it's pretty steep for plastic built giant floor mat.

title: Nice colorful organizing system
text: I really like the colors. Works perfectly as budget management envelopes (12 small pouch) and for organizing miscellaneous. Material is like thick ironed tutu fabric, very sturdy, metal zipper guide with plastic zipper. Simple two fabrics skewed together, no expanded base. Very nice for keeping junk in order.

title: Clean nicely
text: Did clean my permanent marker (few weeks old) better than rubbing alcohol, but not enough to make the board look like new. It's of good size, easy to use, some leakage out of the package but doesn't affect use. Overall something nice to have and cleaned permanent marker nicely, but still you can trace your mistake if you look closely. I recommend this to whoever needs to keep your white board as spotless and long living as possible. One star off for the fact I can still see where I accidentally used my permanent marker on the white board so it's not 100% gone.

title: Nice quality journal
text: Nicely constructed journal. Other than the glittery cover, I love the texture of it. It's either there's sequin in it or I'm popping bubbles? Other than grainy texture there are some tiny bumps that I find very relaxing while using my finger chasing after bubbles. Every page can be laid flat for easy writing. I also love how thick its paper is. Very nice journal to have.

title: Good quality, just not for everyone
text: Thick (230 pages) B5 planner with quality paper. Wire bonded planner. Only 2 pages of "instructions" on goal planning and the rest are all nondated for you to fill out. Start with sample page, working towards six months goal, monthly goals and then daily goals and reflections, time tracker. Hope the photos are helpful. I was curious so ordered this. It's quality product but no yearly layout, no monthly calendar, not much room for customization. Maybe for a small business owner who can keep a thick planner on the desk? Because of the quality I give it five stars. But for it not my planner (I manage every family member's appointment and need monthly calendar) and was vague on what's inside on the product page, I take one star off.

title: paper could be thicker
text: These are good looking, great functional notebooks that not only work as notebooks but also has a pencil pouch to themselves. Though the inside is just ordinary college-ruled notebook paper and the binding was kinda loose. For the price I expected a little more.

title: Quality needs improvement
text: Packaging was lovely with quality snap on envelope. Love the desktop office signs-very entertaining. However, the quality of the kitty post it was thin and not of good quality. It's not very easy to peel off without losing a piece of it and once off it loses most of its stickiness. The paper clip is thinner than regular ones but definitely cute. These are very cute but quality could be better for 15 dollars.

title: quality set. tiny organizer.
text:
The good: quality products delivered to your door. Definitely, an easy start to get your homeschool started. The teacher's planner and day schedule chart really stand out. Everything's of bright and happy color that encourages young kids to learn.
Not so good: That organizer is a size too tiny. Can't argue with quality but still, I don't need another tiny container with an optional divider. if you've got a school-aged kid, a lot of these are kinda duplicates. There's motivational stickers (x3), planner pads, file folders...all pretty commonly seem in an office. The daily plan and calendar are of great quality and a very nice concept, however, please make sure you have the space to hang these. The daily plan requires two hangers, while the calendar requires three. I like the daily planner concept. While informing the mission of the day you are also teaching concepts of time. However, perhaps it's my marker the plastic holder is easy to be stained, which I don't like. The calendar is huge, and I just don't have a space for it. In the end, what I'm not happy about this set is probably the price. I felt these can cost a lot less than 50.
Overall really quality set.

title: Wish the layout can be less blinding
text: [[VIDEOID:e629a83ddd187d3882b9b6b4dd5b2c40]] Love how sturdy this planner is and how careful it's packed. However I ordered size small and the layout was not edited at all, leaving lot of space outside the calendar and difficult to fill things in. It's hardcovered and not very easy to stretch out each page to write in your grand ideas. The 24 pgs of guidelines are in the form of multiple narrow lines of filling in. Everything is very thick and sturdy about this planner, but I'm not a fan of the layout and how this book is binded.

title: beautiful planner
text: I love how minimalist this planner is. Simple monthly plus a page of check-ins. It's about the size of A4 and paperbacked, which is really nice because that makes this planner so much lighter and easier to carry. I recommend this to those who don't have to lay out a daily plan on a regular basis but just have to keep track of appointments and shifts.

title: Sturdy index box
text: I'm bitter from how careless it was packaged and delivered. Two out of four have scratches, one of the two has a broken corner. However, item is sturdily made and I love how thick the index card is. Definitely a lovely solution for flash cards.

title: Thin material, limited space.
text: My son brought home books from school in this kind of book bag so I wanted these for my kids as storage for different subjects. I'm not very impressed. These are of thin canvas material. It's straightforward sew two pieces of fabric together kind of bag so I don't understand why it's so expensive, considering these are for teachers who has to buy things for their students, or so I heard. This won't hold a regular usborne book nor a file holder. It does hold a small stack of A4. Very limited space but would work well for small reading or weekly /monthly writing assignments. I'm pretty disappointed on how thing it is and how little it holds so I'm giving a three stars.

title: Nice stand, has its limit.
text:
[[VIDEOID:8d815cb96bbd1cbb7adabd7d5dff630d]] Like: keep pad or book at good level for reading in order to maintain proper ergonomic posture. Special clip allows you to slide book/pad into holder with only one hand. Heavy base and somewhat sturdy.
Not like :the holder swivel (guessing so you can show your company your project but it's not a feature that's appreciated in a house with young kids) . It stays at about 30 degrees from the rod and it's unchangeable. Holder is all plastic and jiggles. Entire unit looks stylish and feel sturdy, just the holder feels flimsy.
Buttom line:does the work perfectly for book or pad. Can't hold a laptop because of the angle and how unsteady the holder is.

title: Got 23 instead of 30. Good for storage
text: Good quality and great for organizing. Bag is sturdy, but the pull on the zipper appears very flimsy. For the price it's a good deal. But I got only 23, 3 biggest, 8 A4 size, 3 purple and 3 blue about B5 size, then light blue, two green and two yellow. Nice selection of storage and sturdy, but not happy how some of the bags are shaped and sized differently even with the same color, and it says 30 but in fact give out 23. 7 difference is pretty big right?

title: Cheap quality. Need two hands to get it closed.
text:
[[VIDEOID:43f726a291e5e5d4061fa5ced6070b86]] What I like :finally somewhere to keep the lightly used mask. Hope I can utilize it as much as I should instead of sticking my mask all over the place in my car, which is gross, but I'm busy.

What I don't like :hard to get it closed. You have to use two hands to make it click (proper closure). You have to fold the mask to store it. I plan on keeping all my kids' with mine so I'd assume it would cause the nose strip to bend bad.

Overall don't think it's worth the money. Not impressed.

title: Thin, but does the job
text:
What I like :does the job. Size comparison with an A4 picture included. You can stick a stack of documents in there, even 3-4 magazines no problem at all. Sticker sticks nicely and that's really all I need. The price makes it about 70cents per five envelopes, much better than dollar store,but about the same quality.

What I don't like: really thin. The material is so thin you can totally see through the envelope and check out what you're mailing. If you do decide to purchase these, remember to add a cover paper.

title: Stiff tip. Nice color choices
text:
What I like : the colors. You don't have to panic about not finding the cap now.

What I don't like : while it's retractable pens, it's pretty stiff /hard to make the click. Somehow it doesn't feel very "juicy" and while it's nice to not bleed through the papers I wonder how long it would last. The chiseled tip is very stiff, not very smooth writing experience.

Overall okay set to have.

title: Thin but somewhat sturdy rings
text: Works perfect! The ends that close together sticks and that's why I like it because it feels reassuring that our cards won't fall out easily. We've been working on putting hundreds of words on it and so far it holds well.

title: Mediocre cards
text: Just as described ordinary cards. These would probably fall in the one dollar card category for its design and lack of design in the inside. I think it's fair priced but nothing outstanding or impressive. Just easy one stop deal to get your Thanksgiving gratitude covered.

title: Does the job
text: Not as sturdy as I'd like. Material and quality similar to what you get from one of those complimentary stencil in kids painting supply, but slightly thicker. Thin plastic hence you have to hold tight to get the lines right (or you get double or triple lined like mine) . Also because the design there's soooo many broken bars for weekly planner, habit tracker... For the price I thought it was mediocre. However very practical design (and I failed to find anything that is as useful as these templates) and gets the job done.

title: Good quality, just not for writing on paper
text: Yes it's thick and nice, sticks to the table and doesn't move all over the place. Easily rolled together and easily rolled out flat. Overall really good quality and provides a neat oversized surface for computer user. However this didn't work for us because of our needs to write on thin paper instead of in a book. Because of its silicone material and soft texture my writing keeps breaking my paper leaving the results frustrating. I won't be able to use it for my elementary kids virtual class either because he is asked to write frequently using a pencil on printed out papers. Lovely quality and protects the table and all that, but it's of higher price compared to similar products too. Hope this information helps.

title: Nice sturdy encouraging cards
text: These make very nice and quality gift messages. Lovely design on both sides. Laminated on both sides. These alone can work as encouraging cards between friends. Can work as reward cards considering they're double laminated and feel rather sturdy. Had a size comparison photo with regular business card. Hope this information helps.

title: Love the messages
text: I like the messages. Very straightforward and encouraging. However these are tiny and of regular, even lower end of business cards quality. Definitely usable for lunch note even stick it on the board for everyday encouragement, but not as reward cards or for kids to hold onto them because these can easily be destroyed. I personally feel these would make a little less nice gift tag just because of the paper quality. Otherwise everything is great

title: Came broken
text: Came broken. Box was presentable and very pretty but in the inside only inks are wrapped, the rest were protected only by a thin layer of Styrofoam. It was kind of the deal breaker because who likes to receive broken glass. On the bright side the glass didn't shatter into sharp pieces so no finger being cut, and it actually worked well. One dip could last you at least a sentence before it dried up. Can't recommend it for gifting because of the high odds of broken pens at your door.

title: Tiny stapler, powerful
text: Smaller than I imagined yet powerful. Got a size comparison with pencil Sharpener from Costco. Just an FYI those 2000 staples came in a small box. It sounds a lot but it really doesn't look like a lot. I may have false expectations lol so far no jamming and I'm happy since I always find stapling difficult for my fingers.

title: thin card
text: Thin paper, thicker than one printer paper, less than two printer paper. Quality is somewhere between printer paper and construction paper, not very smooth. Easily bled through, trialed with sharpie. Felt like just something you can cut up from printer paper. However it is plenty paper for you to work on projects and for your kids to use with school. I'm just not impressed with its quality.

title: Very thin paper, sent the wrong one
text: Ordered lined index card, received all white. Thin paper, thicker than one printer paper, less than two printer paper. Quality is somewhere between printer paper and construction paper, not very smooth. Easily bled through, trialed with sharpie. Felt like just something you can cut up from printer paper. However it is plenty paper for you to work on projects and for your kids to use with school. I'm just not impressed with its quality.

title: Quality post it notes with plenty fun colors
text: Quality just like named brand. Plenty fun colors. Perfect writing and art material. Happy with this purchase.

title: Good quality post it notes
text: These are perfect. I love how they have slightly more space for note writing yet not so big that it takes up all the space in your planner. I also love how it has almost 50% of glue in the back which makes it sturdy, not like a wind can easily take it down. Glue is good. Easy to stick on, easy to take off. Much better than those from the dollar store. Overall very happy with the purchase.

title: Sturdy file organizer
text: Thicker plastic. Fabric is slightly thinner but canvas material. Seam is good. Appears to be able to last through out k-12. Way nicer compared to the other thin plastic envelope organizers

title: Does the work, but room to improve
text: Packaging needs some serious improvement. Came wrapped in a roll. I couldn't get it to straight out right. I also got those thicker envelope organizers for your size and quality comparison. For the price point the material was as expected - thin. However, it does have a good size and contains A4 papers nicely. Also many colors so you can color code your files. No smell. They're great for personal use, but if you're using it for a class, I'd think wrinkly file holder won't look nice. Also, no card holder. You'll have to improvise to label it.

title: Very sturdy storage box
text: Very sturdy. Easy to put together. Lid is very thick and feels could be sit on- but I didn't try because I admit that I'm fat. Each edge came with a plastic anchor which I think isn't required because it's quite sturdy itself. Easy to fold down for storage. Lid is oversized. Overall I think it's of really good value and is more versatile compared to the metal mesh file holder. Only drawback is it smells funny. Entire thing smells like school glue!

title: Just a metal mesh crate
text:
Came in three pieces. You just have to install four tiny nails.
Great :has good weight to it. Easy to assemble. Came with one extra nail which is greatly appreciated.

Nay : wasn't so easy to install the nails. I imagine it from coat of paint over it. Opening at the bottom as expected, and a pencil or scrap paper can easily fall through the cracks. Rigid, which is good and bad. If you force more paper in it it will surely deform.

Overall item does what it's supposed to do, just no wow moment. Nothing really stands out.

title: Staged rewarding system and I pray it works for my naughty kids
text: Decided to get these for my naughty kids. My 6yo was excited about earning scores, but my 3yo still doesn't really get it. Very convenient size for kids to take along, but also a easy size to get lost. Small enough to fit in a school pencil case. I think the reasoning of the 21punches for 21 day is not practical especially for someone who needs reward chart to keep good behavior. But I like the blue monkey version for its stages. 21 points toward a reward means points can be given generously. Stages makes rewards easier to modify such as one m&ms for 12 scores, going out to the zoo when 21 points achieved etc. Quality is ok, puncher works well, overall a product just as described.

title: Loud, no sharpness control but great Sharpener
text:
[[VIDEOID:78234d24cffef8e215169b5a401e47d5]] Good :powerful, rechargeable, easy to use, light weight, so convenient! Much needed in homes with any school aged kids. Also this thing comes with auto stopper

To be considered :loud, no sharpness adjustment, too light weight that you have to hold onto the body to get the work done

Overall really good deal! The price is great and I love the convenience

title: Versatile organizer, 2-3 books per slot
text: Love this organizer that can be hung or stand-alone. I'm pretty excited to see this grow with our family. Used this to organize my son's homeschool table since piles keep growing and we always needed to look around for subjects that we are working on. This organizer solved the problem, especially each slot has a tab so you can easily find what you're after if you want to label it. However, few things to consider: each slot is only enough for 2-3 kids' workbooks. It's wired so book cover tends to be caught. Overall I really like how it's lightweight, versatile and look forward to kids growing up and use the hooks to organize their belongings.

title: Great labeling pockets
text: Thinner than what I got from staple. Less sticky than what I got from staple. But does the job and I like it that way because I stick it on top of storage container and the edges don't fly up like the thick ones usually do. I also like it to be less sticky so it's easier for me to take down when I don't want it anymore. Great system so far.

title: Double laminated posters that cover preschool to second grade
text: Thought it's small, turned out to be just the right size. Check the size comparison with the notebook. Thin but double laminated, and can be used with dry erase marker. Lots of information that would cover preschool (animals, color, ABC and numbers, body parts) to maybe second grade (multiplication, time, money, American map) I placed the emotions poster right by where is the busiest in hope of my kids pointing it to show me their feelings so I could understand. Overall does what it's designed for and I think for its variety it deserves five stars (saved you a lot of time searching for appropriate posters at dollar tree or many hours making your own)

title: Fair priced, good quality desk paper calendar on the wall
text: Desk calendar on the wall. Not glossy or Lustre paper like what you'd get from customized calendar, but twice the thickness of your printer paper and can write with your pencil which I really like. I didn't care for the count of days/ count down on the day of the year. Overall good quality and I like it covers all the way to Dec 2021.

title: Very sticky tapes and left no residual when taken down
text:
Update :after two months of keeping the planner on the refrigerator , I want to change the system and took it down. Didn't leave a mark on it and still very sticky. However this product is hard to be reused. It's super sticky lumps of glue and difficult to take down from my planner which is soft plastic smooth surface. I was only able to take down little pieces - lots of tears as you can see. However it remains very sticky and was able to keep my cd player on the wall no problem. Considering its price I still think it's a pretty good deal.
Works. At least worked better than the tapes /dots I used to stick frames on the wall. I still wouldn't trust hanging a shelf using this but it works better than those expensive 3M tapes.

title: Best pencil sharpener I've purchased so far
text: I've purchased several pencil sharpener in the past since my kids start school. Unfortunately they didn't last long. One was weak and didn't sharpen anything at all, so I got a replacement, and now that replacement is already dead after few months of use. Got another from Costco which you need to push hard, I'd say it's acceptable. It works, but not the sharpness I want. I came across this and decided to try it out because of school closure and now we sharpen plenty of pencils for homeschool. It's much bigger and heavier than whatever I've gotten so far, and sharpen standard 8mm pencil super fast! It didn't come with a manual, only advised you to push soft, and unlike other sharpener it doesn't stop automatically when it's done, but I really like how fast it is and don't mind checking on my pencil every time I push it in and out especially those auto shut off ones big time wouldn't sharpen when that crappy pencil just didn't align the lead right and leave lots of wood/bamboo pieces that doesn't even write. It really helps this tired mom of four since I got plenty pencils to sharpen. I give it five stars also because it didn't break any of my pencil like how my other sharpener did. Very happy with this purchase. I look forward to using this for at least 5 years. :) let's wait and see.

title: Good quality paper. Totally blank pages for your imagination, responsible seller!
text:
I love the quality of the paper, size, sturdiness, but didn't like the paper folder in the very back- because it's paper so I foresee it broken easily, also the folder is open, so honesly I don't see it doing much work as far as organizing important stuff. I love the pen holder. My biggest bummer is the elastic thing that keeps the book together came broken. Tried to contact seller but haven't heard from them. The binder is totally for you to free style everything, you start whenever you want by putting in your own month, date, three month calendar followed by weekly calendar. I'm more used to one monthly followed by weekly so I'm sure it'll take some getting used to. overall really good quality, but because it came broken I'll give it three stars for still doing the job.
Update: the seller responded the next day and sent me a new one. Because they are so responsive and standing behind their product I feel guilty for not giving them five stars because they work really hard to keep the quality of their planner.

title: oversized...you won't be able to stand your binder up nicely, but product is of good quality
text: I was really hoping to use these for organizing bills and whatever important paper work in three ring binder, but was frustrated to find how gigantic these are and has only three hole so you actually canNOT adjust the positioning of it. It's aligned to the middle of the binder which leaves about two inches outside the binder up and down (if that make any sense.....can't upload picture anymore for some reason) so I could never stand the binder up right, and whatever is put inside get folded- for me that's a total mess up. So I had to give up the thoughts of organizing stuff use these zipped ones and instead continues to use the thin protector. On the positive side these are of good quality and does host A4 papers nicely, they just don't work the way I want them to be in 3ring binder. If you are just looking to use these with rings I think it'll probably be just fine.

title: reasonable, good quality product
text: It was a pack of ordinary sheet protector, no thinner, no thicker, but at a good price point. The company was easy to work with. I was given these product and was not asked for a five star review and I really appreciate how honest they were. I'd recommend this company to buy things from.

title: Snug fit on most pencils. Different styles for your child to progress in his fine motor skills
text: I like these better than the ones I got from another company. It is snug on pencils unlike other brands of pencil gripper and also give you the opportunity to switch to higher level ones as your child progress. Happy customer right now. Package came next day but I guess that credit goes to Amazon prime.

title: Oversized gribber
text: Like others have posted these came in perfect plastic packaging. However they're a little size too big for standard pencil. It slide up after few minutes of use which requires me to readjust it for my kindergartener. (so if we're working on writing you have to stay seated with him or the letters start to fly all over) But I cannot find what I used to use when I was a kid anymore 😢 it's a great product, just not for US pencils I guess,and definitely not for little immature hands.

title: Cute pens. Sad packaging.
text: These are really cute and full size pens. Packaging can use some improvement since it came in a small bag stapled together. Still give them five start because it makes me feel better looking at it during paperwork.

title: Great value and cute designs
text: Other than two decorative parts that came off these are full size pens. Packaging was great so definitely makes the receiver feel great.

title: Flimsy pens but very bright and cheerful flowers
text: Pen itself is flimsy and with very little ink, but definitely cute to the eyes and bright up my day so I'm taking one point down for the quality of the pen.

title: amazing price
text: fast shipping. perfect condition. it was a gift for my friend who is moving and it was perfect. also I love the price for sure!

title: Gift
text: This was purchased as a gift and the girl loved it.  I thought the quality seemed really nice as well.

title: Beautiful
text: My mom absolutely loved it.  I gave it to her for Mother's Day.  It is beautifully crafted and sat up nicely on her table.

title: Cute but broke quickly.
text: The product was very cute and sparkly, it did have liquid in the cover which was super cute. The only thing I will say is the cover with the liquid broke with in 3 days of having it so there was liquid all in my purse.

title: Yup
text: I love this a lot! It works better than a few regular eraser!

title: Pricey but worth it. Great gift!
text:
I got these for my six year old who has started getting into gel pens (plus mommy wanted a sneaky way to motivate her to practice her penmanship, shhhhh lol). The package was smaller than I thought it would be, and definitely on the pricier side, but that is because you are paying for (1) VERY high quality and (2) the fact that (per each order) yoobi will donate an item to a classroom in need...which is a cause I can get behind.

This would make an awesome gift for your little doodler (mine LOVES hers!), or for a coloring book enthusiast of any age :) The presentation of the 24 pens (which are organized in rainbow order--"ROY G BIV") is pleasing to the eye. The clear box is actually a functional storage system, making it easy to stay organized. The miniature size of the kit also allows for easy travel.

Another win from yoobi!

title: Cute, for older kids
text:
Really cute notebook for adolescent girls. We encourage a lot of writing and journaling in my household, so it's always nice to have cute notebooks and stationary on hand for this! This one is particularly whimsical and textured, if a bit more pricey than I usually prefer.

Note: I would be careful with this item around younger kids though, as I imagine whatever liquid/gel inside the cover would be toxic if ingested.

title: not cheap like a lot of message boards
text: Quality product, not cheap like a lot of message boards. But I docked two stars because this product requires a lot of preparation before you can actually use it (I had to remove all the letters myself and this was not as easy as you might think).

title: Honeycomb Mousepad
text:
I have been missing out! This ergonomic mousepad is absolutely the epitome of comfort and style and something I didn’t even know existed.

I have been using this mousepad for almost a week and I can immediately tell a difference in how well it works for my long days in the office. The pad has what I would call a wrist rest built into the padding and it’s a lifesaver. It is so well designed and gives a support to my wrist for the entire day. I love the bees and honeycomb design and it’s a perfect addition to my office. I will definitely be purchasing more of these for my home office and for friends. I can’t rave about this enough! Absolutely perfect!

I would definitely recommend for any and every one who uses a computer! Your wrist and arm will thank you!

title: Glitter Journal
text:
I was so excited to see this available as it perfectly matches my phone case and I love the effect of falling glitter in most products.

This journal is pretty standard. Outside of the covering, there is nothing exceptional about it. The pages are thin and the binding is on par with similarly priced journals. The covering is oddly executed in that it feels flimsy and cheaply made. There is stapling or sealing marks along the top part of the back of the journal (which is not filled as it is in the front). The front is truly magical and beautiful but, it does give the impression of being a sturdy sandwich bag filled with water and glitter and stuck onto a standard journal.

Overall, would make a cute stocking stuffer but, as an every day journal, there is far better out there.

title: Marshmallow Pins
text:
Oh boy! This one is a doozy! I was so super excited to receive this one but, man, it was a total letdown once I received it.

I couldn’t believe it when I pulled the box out from the mail. This was just way too small to have been what I ordered. Upon opening the box - it was exactly what I had ordered but, just a super minuscule version of what was in my mind. I have put a pen in my picture to give a size comparison just so that you’re aware of what you’re purchasing. The whole set is tiny and worse yet, dainty. This could serve as a large cup of cocoa for Barbie. It’s that small. The marshmallow pins are so small and don’t hold much on a cork board.

Cute but inefficient. Would only recommend with the idea that you will probably only use it as an office prop or gag gift versus any actual efficient use.

title: Calculator
text:
I had been searching for a basic calculator for awhile and am glad that I received this one.

This calculator has a nice and large screen that is able to be seen and the keys on it are large and chunky for easy and quick work. Its very basic but works efficiently to get the job done. The size is perfect for my work from home office currently and doesn’t take up a ton of surface space. I also love that it can work in battery power or solar.

Would definitely recommend for someone looking for a basic calculator with a large reading surface.

title: Staples Set
text:
I will first say that these staples are not meant for office use staplers and are intended for more home improvement stapling jobs.

I think it’s wonderful that these heavy gauged staples come in four graduated sizes to accommodate different projects. I was able to fasten some roofing for my shed with the largest staples and they worked perfectly with no buckling or jamming. I am particularly impressed with the amount that came in the package - I will more than likely never run out of home repair staples.

I would gladly recommend this set of staples.

title: HP Printer
text:
I expected more and ended up getting less. More frustration and less quality.

This printer feels extremely poorly designed and even worse, not very user friendly. The app that you are required to print anything with this printer feels like overkill and unnecessary. If this is being marketed to the phone only crowd - it fails in ease of use. I was terribly disappointed in the overall setup and design of this printer.

The worst aspect was the ink. What??? I’ve never seen a modern printer where ink actually had to be poured in. It ended up being a disaster and my hands and floor covered in an inky mess. The printing quality is decent but not at this cost.

I definitely would not recommend this printer.

title: Key Storage
text:
I am always forgetting keys. House keys, office keys, etc and I had never thought of this idea before and it’s absolutely perfect!

I put a spare office key and house key in this holder and put it into the trunk of my car. I usually forget my office keys more than I care to admit and this box absolutely saved me this past Monday due to my putting a spare within it! It is super easy to use, set the combo and hide! This ended up being a huge time and life saver!

I would absolutely recommend!

title: Powerful Shredder
text:
I am wildly impressed with this shredder and will highly recommend it!

I’ve had a large shredder for years and years and it has seen better days. It gets jammed a lot and I had been looking to replace it for awhile. This Fellowes is absolutely incredible. It’s compact and unobtrusive but, is definitely the most powerful and consistent I’ve seen! I love the fact that it micro shreds versus just cutting into long strips. It isn’t noisy and really fits in well with my home office setup. I feel just a bit safer using this shredder due to how small it dices old bills, statements, etc. I would consider this a must have for any active family!

I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a good, safe and efficient shredder!

title: Graphite Sketch Pencils
text:
This set is a great value for the artist out there looking for mid-range quality and essentials for sketching.

I have done a lot of sketching in my life and have had various brands of graphite pencils over the years ranging from base line to professional and I would say that these are a value mid-range that are great for beginners and also more skilled drawing abilities. The dark end of the color of the graphite is great but, the lighter shading leaves something to be desired. The handle on the pencil is great and fits perfectly within my hand. The small carrying case is a nice touch and the sharpener is just above that of a traditional store bough pencil sharpener.

I would definitely recommend these pencils for someone looking for sketching pencils who are also looking for value.

title: Organizational Must
text:
I am extremely impressed by this organizer and how sturdy and heavy duty it is.

The organizer showed up in a few pieces and was very easy to assemble with the directions included. It is black and made of a metal meshy material. The first thing I noticed was how heavy it is and how durable it appears to be. It gives ample room for scissors, pens, pencils, paper clips, papers, etc. and helps organize these office supplies by their function. It has a stand up organizer on top for envelopes, folders and the like and on the bottom has a large open section and then a pull out four compartment divided tray for smaller items. The tray or drawer is very easy to pull from the main piece to gather what you may need from it.

I would absolutely recommend this mesh organizer!

title: Greatest Sharpener
text:
I wasn't anticipating being impressed with a pencil sharpener but, WOW - I couldn't believe the results!

The sharpener is compact, efficient and easy to clean. For such a small machine, the end results are amazing. I am an artist and I am always sharpening my pencils with various sharpeners and some are better than others but, this blows them all out the water. It is quick and gets the pencil sharp without a lot of lead breakage. The auto stop is really cool because it stops you from wasting your pencil inside of the sharpener. The machine feels durable and secure. Removing the shavings is super easy with just a quick tip over.

I would definitely recommend this sharpener to anyone looking for one.

title: Fantastic Organization Tool
text:
My office desk housed three cups packed full of pencils, pens, scissors, highlighters, markers, paper clips, and about a thousand other items. Once this caddy showed up, I was instantly organized. I honestly don't know how I have worked like this for so long. My boss even noticed and commended me for cleaning up my cups of random office supplies.

Now my desk is so much more efficient and I have never been happier with my desk. This piece inspired my purchased further organizational tools to compliment this one.

I would definitely recommend this caddy.

title: How Is This Going To Hold Up?
text:
I will say that I am somewhat hard on my daily planners and always have been. I live with them. They've travelled with me and have been stuffed into every kind of suitcase or briefcase you can imagine. Unfortunately, with the feel of this one, this wouldn't last more than a couple of months before it was in tatters. The front and back cover feel like very thin cardboard and the pages are extremely thin. Very dainty.

I will also say that this planner is beautiful. Its gorgeous to look at and sit on your desk and if that is all it is going to do - then this will be a great product for you. But, if you are planning to actually use it for it's intended purpose, I would look elsewhere.

title: Easy
text:
This square reader ended up being one of the easiest phone attachments I have dealt with.

The setup was extremely easy and worked pretty much straight away. I was impressed with how quick and simple the entire process has went. I was able to safely charge a friend of mine and no issues whatsoever. The hardware is lightweight and can be carried in your pocket.

I would certainly recommend for on the go selling!

title: Fast with clear print
text:
I had been in the market for a muti function printer for some time now and decided to take the plunge with the Canon Color ImageClass MF741Cdw. This printer is AMAZING!!!!

Install was moderately easy, if you just read the manual and follow the steps. The machine is constructed very well and will last. The printer features a touch screen pad, allows mobile printing, copying, scanning, basic print functions and is wireless enabled.

The printer is fast and the print is very clear. When copying the feeder is not super fast but fast enough for a home office or a small business. You are given several different options to customize copies. The paper tray is small, holding approximately 100 -150 pieces of paper. You do have the option to print in color or black and white.

I find the printer to be a value and would recommend.

title: Shimmering Notebook
text:
This planner will definitely be with me through 2020!

I love how large and beautiful this daily calendar is. It has large blocks for the days to write in as well as a Notes section for further notations. It has a nice, chic shimmery cover that reflects in the light and each month is tabbed for easy access.

The only downside I found was it is large spiral bound and is a little difficult to maneuver throughout the planner with ease. Otherwise, I definitely recommend.

title: Shimmering & Functional
text:
What a cute and practical little calendar to carry around!

This planner is great for those on the go or who don't want to carry a large planner to track of their daily tasks. This one is compact, shimmery and beautiful on the inside with it's cascading rainbow pages. Planner gives plenty of room for writing notes, plans or just jotting down ideas. Covering from August 2019 through December 2020, I can see this being by my side the entire time to keep me organized and together.

Definitely recommend for anyone looking for a smaller planner!

title: Fun and pretty notebooks!
text: I bought this notebook for one of my kids and they absolutely love it!  It's so fun, so glittery and sparkly!  :)

title: Pink notebook has no liquid in cover
text: I love these notebooks but for some reason the pink ones I have gotten have no liquid in the cover.  I tried to write to the manufacturer but they ignored me when I sent photographic evidence of the defect.

title: Love this!
text: What a great calendar...very inspirational!  I'm excited to have it on my desk for the new year.  :)

title: Great Value!
text: Selected for my school aged grand kids. They always need binders for school.  These arrived well packaged and are of good quality.

title: Great Tape!
text: Lots of tape to last awhile. This tape does what its supposed to. No more having to press and rub the tape on the box to get it to stick. This tape just adheres and does what it's supposed to.

title: Gets it Done!
text: Very similar to the 3M command strips. Holds well and can be cut to the size that you require. As of right now I have not had any issues with it damaging walls when removed.

title: Too Funny
text: Selected as a gift for my husband he will absolutely love this. They are a little bigger than I originally thought. They are about the size of a beverage coaster and are printed on a pretty thick card stock.

title: Great Value!

title: Heavy duty
