title: Great Value
text: Fits my Cannon printer just like the name brand…. On first couple of prints the ink is a little light but after that the prints are fine

title: Just Adorable!
text: selected as a stocking stuffer. The compact size is perfect for a stocking stuffer. The animals are just adorable!

title: Just as good as the name brand
text: Gets the job done just like the name brand for a fraction of the cost. I am very happy with these!

title: Great for outdoor officiating
text: Selected as a gift for my daughter. She is a track official and always talks about the difficulties with a clipboard having enough space for pole vault. She likes to have two sheets side by side. Then the added clamps seem like a perfect idea to hold those papers down in the wind.

title: Writes good
text: I am left handed so finding pens that don’t smear is a chore. This works perfectly when writing on regular paper stock. Fine point gel pens have been found to work the best for my tastes, and these fit the bill. The body is a smooth finish which makes them different. It can be an adjustment from the grip lens I have been accustomed to. The weight of the pen feels comparable as well. The price is reasonable.

title: Love these dogs!
text: This calendar us cute but it arrived with no wrapping over it. Needless to say, there are a few creases and bent corners. Normally, my wall calendars that I’ve ordered have a cardboard holing the calendar from being bent, plus they are usually wrapped in a plastic . The photos are nice. The paper stock used it a tad thin.

title: Stunning and sturdy
text: This makes a very eye catching and sturdy table decoration! My oldest grandchild absolutely loved it for his graduation open house. The card stock and quality was sturdy and perfect. I found no flaws and it is beautiful!

title: Great design!
text: This particular journal is a more practical construction. The embossed design is clear and detailed. The paper has on old world parchment tinting, but the paper stock itself is standard journal paper. It’s like a standard journal with a fantasy cover. It looks good up on a shelf but isn’t really meant to be part of an old world display. Not at top of list for a gift idea.

title: 3 pack value
text: Price is competitive with other offers. These have reusable tabs, however I tend to use label makers just because I organize and reorganize quite frequently. The pockets are a handy feature for things you want to keep in place. Between this and sheet protectors, my recipe collection is on point!

title: Love the concept!
text: Wanted this as a gift however, upon inspection, I decided not this one. The design is a good idea but the embossing appears much clearer in the product picture than in real life. Yes, the design is the same, but not very noticeable. To close thus journal , there is a notched flap under the closing mechanism. The notch isn’t sufficient. It took too much effort to force the eye over the notch, and even more effor to get the pin to secure it. Some great points, the pages are bound in by sections making them hard to fall out if binding. The pages themselves truly embrace that old world look and texture. A few diagnoses changes and this would make an amazing gift!

title: Runs great!
text: Pleasantly surprised with this! It is lighter weight than I imagined however, it runs great! This runs on an AC adapter which is fine for our home needs. It sharpens quickly. The bin is easy to empty and secures well to the unit. The price us really affordable and I hope it lasts well.

title: Seems like a great product
text: I can’t rate thus bad. We haven’t actually gotten it to work. We are not sure if it us because of the device, or our limited internet. Also, it really isn’t senior citizen friendly. Too small for our weaker eyes. Leaving the rating at 3 until one of my kids can test it out in a metro area.

title: Well made!
text: This is a nice, sturdy container for our multiple remotes! The biggest problem we have is when we don’t place our remotes back where we got them from. Having a holder such as this helps to remind us to put it back and it us working great so far. The actual holder is well made, every edge has been stitched with quality in mind. Very pleased.

title: Classic!
text: The cad stock is very sturdy and strong. The design is a classic look with a general Christmas greeting contained within. The red/green blen with gold is a sure eye catcher. With 40 cards contained within this set, it makes this a great value for Hall ark quality.

title: A stunning piece
text: A very sturdy , precision cut piece! Very happy with the rustic look! Although the edges are metal, it has been polished to deter accidental cuts, however careful use is recommended. I myself is accident prone so I have to note things from the get go. The cutout shapes are not jagged and are clear and precise! Love this stand!

title: Fit as expected.
text: The plastic feels sturdy. The card fits in with some wiggle room. The zip was hard to open without having to open like a chip bag. The only complaint is that this arrived with a fold crease about a half inch from bottom edge. Don’t understand how it was packaged like that. The crease was done within the packaging it was sealed in and not from being caught between2 objects that caused the crease.

title: Great quantity
text: Our holidays always require some amount of box shipping and I find myself always needing more packing tape. These rolls feel pretty standard. Haven’t had any unwarranted tearing and as with most tapes, always do a fold over on the end to ensure a start for next usage. Works great for our household. The quantity is good. Now all that’s left is to see if the adhesion holds up from first roll to the last.

title: Nicely boxed
text: This fanfold stack fit perfectly into my label holder for my printer! The quantity is large for our household so I am hoping that the adhesive doesn’t wear down too quickly. My printer used these labels great and I had no issues. Quantity should last us a lifetime!

title: Mine arrived stacked
text: It says it is rolled, however mine arrived stacked. The stack is around eleven inches long, which doesn’t fit into my label holder unless I restock them, or figure out a way to roll them myself. The labels itself are okay and works okay with my thermal printer. Separation from backing is always an issue for me but husband had no problems.

title: Simple operation
text: This comes with an extra blade cartridge which is pretty cool. Operates with a cord or 2 AA batteries. Recommend removing batteries if you anticipate not using very often . The lid removes with a counter clockwise twist to empty any shavings. Although small it does stay still while you sharpen your pencil. The pencil will twirl if you don’t hold onto it. I enjoy adult coloring books so this works well for my pencils.

title: Simple and easy to use
text: Set up is very easy as well as storage. I have a storage bin to keep my thermal printer and label holder in, and both fit perfectly and keeps me very organized. They don’t really take up much room however I really only have use for my printer maybe once or twice a month. In today’s environment of seeking out non contact methods of getting things done, having your own thermal printer adds to the convenience, and keeping the labels neat and orderly are an added plus!

title: Very handy
text: I was very surprised with the ease of use. At first, I didn’t get the labels aligned correctly, but I realized quickly that it was me and not the printer. I did a sample print and was very pleased with the result. This handy printer came with its own label holder, which makes this a convenient choice. The compact design is a great space saver and even fits great in most desk drawers or storage bins. I have no complaints and find this printer to be an easy recommend!

title: Great gadget
text: This label maker uses the same app as a label maker I am currently using, which made set up and usage a breeze! Slightly more compact and a more contemporary design giving thus maker a less bland look. Definitely the favorite of my visiting grandkids simply due to the cute look. This has now been adopted to my granddaughters desk ! Great gift idea that is reasonably priced.

title: Amazing!
text: Love the ease of use! Load the app onto your favorite device, Bluetooth to printer and enjoy beautiful labels! It just that easy! Love all the options available to encourage creativity. We are a family or driven organizers, so the simplicity of this device is agidsend!

title: Love the simplicity!
text: This label maker works using an app. With my visual limitations, it has actually been easier for me to use the app to make labels. I still have issues with removing the backing however my husband is good at that.. the app lets you choose exactly what you want as opposed to figuring out which keys to punch and in what order. Value priced and a nice compact size!

title: Great container
text: My granddaughters love coloring so I found this caddy the perfect solution to keep the pens and markers in. The turntable allows them to spin to find their color and selection of their choice without the spread out mess that usually occurs with two or more participating. Of course having a round table just adds to the convenience! The finish is smooth and the construction feels very durable.

title: Great labeler
text: So, I had issues figuring this out but truly it’s due to the manual being printed too small for my well aged sight. Even my readers couldn’t assist. Online manual options would be great. Got assistance from a better sighted person, and once I was shown, it is pretty simple. There is a specific order that needs to be followed. Separating the backing is also quite tedious for me but may not be for others. Prints beautiful labels though. Very happy to have such a handy gadget.

title: It takes a bit to get used to
text: Long car rides reek havoc on aging bodies and so we tried these braces to help support. We attached them to our front seats easily. Once seated, it was easy to move grace up or down to adjust a comfortable spot. We haven’t taken a long trip yet however we both could feel how this may actually help ease the stiffness and back aches. Our next trip won’t be until fall however we are quite optimistic about these.

title: Easy to use
text: A definite peel and stick. I ran into my normal issue, separating the backing in order to get to sticky. This is a normal “me” issue so I don’t consider it flaw. Little “ separate here” tabs would be nice though. Pro: stuck on easily and stayed on. Con: lost some paint when I had to remove because I placed it wrong. ( again…walls need painting anyways) fortunately, the adjustment was minimal and still covered my oops.

title: Cutest door stop
text: It took 3days to convince my Shepard this cute hedgehog was not his newest addition to his stuffed toys. Absolutely my favorite door jam in my house. He seems very well constructed considering he survived my dog carrying him off a few times. Just relieved he was not used as a chew toy!. Made with care, I love the details in the face! Very cheery!

title: Always a hit
text: Very well made pop up cards that are always a hit with loved ones. The pop up bouquets makes it simple and easy for them to display the card for lasting memories. The card stock is nice and strong and the sentiment is very heartfelt and warm.

title: The ballpoint pen works.
text: Medium point ballpoint pen works like any pen. Takes a bit to get the ink flowing, then us okay. Very light, easily broken if you tried. The stylus side does not work at all on my iPad Pro or my husbands XSMAX.. may be okay for non apple products maybe.

title: All occasion
text: For the avid pet lover, this makes a great all occasion assortment! The cards are blank and therefore can be used for most well wishes. The cards are solid and fit the envelopes well. Great value by a good company.

title: Great wrist rest
text: I’ve never actually had a pad before with a wrist rest. As a first timer, it took just a tad to find that comfort spot, and I am almost lazy now. We use a mini mouse ( magic) so manipulating the mouse can really be done with very minimal movements. This pad looks enormous comparatively but truly works wonderfully. Between this an our oversized gaming pad, our desk looks complete!

title: Perfect!
text: Canning season will be upon us in a blink of an eye and these stickers will add that personal touch I have been craving. The size is perfect for either the side of a jar or on the top of a lid! Also great for use when gifting homemade cookies, candies, etc. very clear and well made design!

title: Perfect fit!
text: Very pleased with this oversized mouse pad! It is much more pliable than I pictured and thinner than most pads, however it lays smoothly and my Magic Mouse just loves it! I enjoy the freedom of movement thus oversized pad gives me and the print blends well the nook where we use our iMac. Make sure your space is free of even the slightest debri for you will be able to feel it through this pad. For us, that is still a plus. We aren’t the greatest at keeping thing up.

title: Beautiful!
text: The card stock is exceptional. Nice and sturdy and very well printed. The illustration is very vibrant and festive. Hallmark definitely maintained its reputation for quality cards. The wreath is very beautiful and every detail shows quality work.

title: Stunning
text: The card stock is truly hallmark quality and the card is visually stunning. The message of course is very thoughtful and applicable to a general audience. There is peace of mind when you can’t count on quality standards being upheld!

title: Organization
text: As a presentation binder, this is a tad bit stiff and would take a bit to flatten to a more pleasing binder shape. I actually found this binder perfect for organizing the many household manuals and warranties we accumulate! The see through pages allow for easy storage and I create an easy to skim overview page for purchase dates, warranty expirations and even model numbers and replacement part numbers. Wish I used this years ago!

title: Very sturdy
text: This staple gun is very solidly constructed and allows for 3 different stapling methods. It was very easy to load and we have used it to staple in the backing for a wall hanging. It wasn’t hard to squeeze and it is just a matter of learning the right pressure to use to ensure the staple secures firmly. Comes with enough staple to make it through several small home projects.

title: Heavy
text: The construction of this table is solid and not easily tipped over. The legs haven’t collapsed in on itself as yet ( which was a problem with another lap table). Adjusting the angle is a tad awkward. You have to reach around the back and tilt up and brace it, or completely spin it around, then angle and brace. Both these actions can be awkward. The angles available are still quite a bit low as well.

title: This size is most convenient.
text: With a growing number of grandchildren, i have found myself running to the post office quite frequently to pick up bubble mailers more and more often. Stumbling upon this through amazon basics was a definite plus!  The box of mailers actually arrived in a box protecting the box! Actually quite smart considering having punctured bubble mailers would be pointless. This sure does make my life a step easier having the handy!

title: The perfect organizer
text: Sturdy and strong with non slip grips on the bottom. I have this mounted on my kitchen cupboard door and am using this to store folks of kitchen cling wrap, parchment, and wax papers. Works perfectly!

title: Great for a quick grab
text: I enjoy having notebooks and journals near by to grab and write down my thoughts in. This one has done great features that I enjoy. The elastic to mark my place. There is a content page which allows me to notate anything I want to find quickly. The pages of course are conveniently numbered. And you always have the ability to use the corner tear offs to mark particular pages or sections. All useful organizational tools. My senior eyes wish thus was slightly larger than the 5 by 8 size but this does make it quite compact and convenient for traveling.

title: Super fast
text: I have been wanting just a monochrome printer for so very long, this is a dream. This arrived perfectly packaged and was very simple to get up and running. Important note...the enclosed instructions are not very helpful. We ended up googling assistance for getting our printer to print....and wer e happily directed to an app that set us up in less than a minute. Seems very odd that this wasn’t not put in or even on the box. That, along with how I can’t find any replacement toner cartridges...well...I hope Lexmark corrects that soon. This cartridge is supposed to be high yield so hopefully I won’t need the replacement soon.

title: Out in open convenience
text: The nice thing about having a combo lock, is that no one will see you grabbing a key. It’s only a 3 digit combo and is easy to set. text: I love the 3M removable strips. I have shelves and hooks and other things using those. I recently acquired a ring screwless mounting plate, and it uses this particular product. But life changes, and I wanted to use it, so I used this to stick it to the back of my TV again. I was afraid that it would detach because of the heat from the TV, like the tape that came with the mount. But that’s not been the case. I let it cure for 12 hours before I place the Apple TV on it; it’s been three weeks and it’s still there, no problems. I also used it to replace the adhesive on a lid mount where I keep my instant pot lid and it has also not giving up at all, whereas the original adhesive fell within two weeks. The most important part about 3M adhesives is that you have to press it for at least 30 seconds, evenly through the whole surface, and let it cure for several hours. The heavier it is, the more hours. I love their stuff. I’ll pretty much buy anything 3M puts out there. They never let me down.

They say they have now corrected the date issue, but it will take a while for them to make changes to formats regarding different countries and areas. They are perfect for taking along to church or the doctor's office or anywhere where a kid needs to keep quiet, but needs something to occupy them.  You can use any colored pencils, markers, or pens on them.

title: Such a nice pencil
text: This pencil is one of the nicest I've ever used.  It's comfortable to hold and just the perfect weight.  It writes very nicely.  The quality is excellent.  I'm a fan.

title: Post-It Notes on Steroids
text: These post-it notes are kind of wild.  They stand up to the weather and have adhesive that will pretty much never let go.  They are like regular post-it notes on steroids.  While they are kind of gimmicky, I am sure you'll be able to find plenty of uses for them!

title: Nice weight
text: These 1/2 cut manila folders are very sturdy and useful.  The price is very good.  They will last a while!

title: Great binders
text: I go through a lot of binders.  These are great ones and they come in a 12-pack so I have plenty.  It's easy to slide paper into the view slots.  If you need binders, these are a great, well priced option!

title: Elegant
text: These cards are very elegant.  They are good quality and pretty.  They come with an extra envelope which is great because there always seems to be at least one mistake while addressing holiday cards.  If you send cards at Christmas, this is a great set to get.

title: Excellent Printer!
text: The included software makes it easy to scan across the network.  The printing is nice and crisp and pretty fast.  The copy function works well.  It does duplexing which is a huge plus.  It is huge and takes up a lot of desk space.  I'm quite happy with it.

title: Very durable
text: The braided steel makes these badge holders a lot more durable than others I have used.  The design is good.  I feel like they will last a long time.  They very securely hold IDs and make them easy to hold them up to a reader or to show to a guard.

title: Great for Bullet Journaling
text: This is a great dotted notebook for bullet journaling.  The pages are a good thickness so bleed through is minimal.  The size is perfect.  The price is decent for what you get, too.

title: Little basic binders
text: Sometimes you just need a basic binder and getting a half dozen at one time makes it so you can have them on hand for whenever you need one.  The rings are not in the spine, but rather to the side, so it holds a good number of pages and they lay flat to close rather than getting all balled up like happens with binders with rings mounted in the spine.

title: Everything you need to write to Santa
text: This is a fun little kit full of everything your children need for writing to Santa Claus.  Can you do it without all this stuff?  Of course!  But this is totally worth it because the price is great, everything is right where you need it, and it's fun and cute, too.

title: Love that they can be repositioned
text: I love that you can reposition these clips.  Sometimes I just don't get them in the right place the first time.  They stay up on my very textured walls very well.  Each clip does not hold very much weight so keep that in mind before buying.

title: Decorate your walls
text: I love that these hooks can be repositioned for the first bit of time.  Where I put something the first time isn't always where it would be best.  Only lightweight things can be hung up with the hooks so keep that in mind.  They really make decorating a breeze.

title: When you need a little binder...
text: I go through so many binders.  I use one for each of my foster children and then I homeschool my biological children.  So I'm always needing binders.  Having a set of a dozen identical small binders available at once is excellent.  These are basic, cheap binders that do their job.  Exactly what I want in a binder.

title: The most gorgeous card I have ever seen
text: This card is the most gorgeous one I have ever seen.  The snowflake cutouts are amazing with an incredible attention to detail.  If you have a special Frozen fan on your card list, this is a must have.

title: Gorgeous
text: This Christmas card is just right for a very important person on your card list.  The pop up is beautiful and detailed.  The colors are lovely.  It's really one of the nicest Christmas cards I've ever seen.

title: So nice!
text: I was pleasantly surprised when these bullet journals arrived.  I didn't expect them to be quite so high quality for the price.  They are as good as ones that cost $20 or more each!  The dots are perfect and I love that the pages are numbered so I don't have to do that myself.  They are attractive and make a nice set to put on the shelf when they are full.  The ribbon is secure as is the elastic band to keep it closed.  If you are a bullet journaler, these are perfect notebooks!

title: Cheap and Easy to Install!
text: For some reason door stops seem to sprout legs and walk away.  It doesn't make sense since they are attached to the wall, but they do.  These door stops are excellent replacements for those that have somehow gotten lost.  They take about ten seconds to install.  Just find where it attaches and turn until it's firmly in place.  They stop doors before they hit the wall just like they are supposed to.  I highly recommend them!

title: Nice, Large Whiteboard
text: This whiteboard is very nice.  It hangs easily on the wall and has plenty of space to draw or write whatever you need to.  It erases easily.  I highly recommend it.

title: Lightweight and Very Clear
text: These sheet protectors are thin and lightweight so they only add a little bit of extra bulk to your notebook.  They are very clear which is a big plus.  I really like them and highly recommend them.

title: Nice board!
text: We got this board installed on our wall in just a few minutes.  It is easy to write on and also erases easily.  It's huge so there is plenty of space to draw diagrams or anything else you can imagine.  It comes with a dry erase pen that has the best eraser I have ever used.  With an easy swipe, it left absolutely nothing behind on the board.  I highly recommend this whiteboard!

title: Good for lots of daily to do's
text: There is plenty of space in this agenda book to write down appointments and things to do.  The cover is pretty and feels durable.  It is pretty big making it a little more difficult to carry around with you.  It's been super useful to keep track of my responsibilities.  I just keep it on my desk, though, because of the size.

title: Works with any pin
text: These cork boards work with any pin.  The cork is pretty deep so I've been able to use even bigger pins that you wear.  It was super easy to install.  I put it on the back of my door so it is constantly being jostled around and it hasn't even budged.  It is a good size, too. I have put eight or nine things on it so far and I still have space for more.  I highly recommend these cork boards!

title: Perfect for Homeschooling, too!
text: I love these dry erase pockets.  The colors are fun and I tried them with every brand dry erase marker we have and they all erased super easily.  The plastic on the front is very clear making it easy to see what's on the worksheet underneath.  They are in landscape format so keep that in mind when printing worksheets to go in them.  The backs are very sturdy so they can be used on a desk or on a lap, either one no problem.  These are perfect for homeschooling, too, for things like math drills and handwriting practice.  I highly recommend them!

title: Index cards for whatever you need
text: I love index cards.  They are just so useful.  These cases hold about 100 index cards (included) and dividers (also included).  The snap-closure keeps them nice and tightly closed making sure your cards don't fall out.  The small size lets you toss them in a backpack and take them along without taking up too much space.  The cases have doodles all over so they are very cute.  I highly recommend these cases and card sets for whatever you need index cards for whether that's organizing your cleaning a la Side-Tracked Home Executives or studying vocabulary words for school!

title: I love this cart
text: The instructions weren't the easiest to decipher, but once we got it put together, I have to say I am absolutely thrilled with this cart.  It's got three shelves with plenty of space between them and is on wheels so it can be moved wherever we need it to go.  My boys put some of their favorite toys on it so we can keep them easily accessible, but also nice and neat.  The color of the wood is very pretty.  It really is quite attractive overall.  I very highly recommend this cart!

title: Very useful
text: These moving boxes are nice and sturdy.  They stack easily making them useful for moving or just for storage.  They are super easy to put together.  My 13-year-old put one together very quickly without any help.  They are a good size and so hold quite a bit.  If you need boxes, these are great ones!

title: Quick install to save space and get organized
text:
Once I switched to screws and anchors that I already had it took less than five minutes to install. The included anchors tended to spin in the hole when I turned the screws. The other two easily connected to the installed one.

Each is identical so you can have 3 singles, 2+1 or as I did with all 3 stacked. Or if you order a second set, 6 tall. That would be my recommended max.

They can hold a good amount of weight. I had some random stuff in there like a metal clip board, cables plus about half a ream of paper.

title: So cute!
text: As far as lined notebooks or journals go, this one is pretty typical.  There are 120 pages, they are lined (college-ruled), and the binding seems nice and tight.  What isn't typical is the cover.  It's pink and filled with liquid and glitter.  Not only does this make it super cute, it makes it super fun to squish around.  It feels like it would be hard to break the plastic holding the liquid in.  I highly recommend this notebook to anyone who likes pink and likes glitter.  It is totally awesome and the perfect size for using as a bullet journal if you prefer them with lines!

title: Great for locking up medication

title: Smooth Operators
text: These pens write smoothly with not skipping. They are comfortable and glide across the paper. They are so quiet. There is no loud click. Nice selection of red and black ink.

title: Write Right
text: These Bic pens are reliable. The style is classic with a clear body to gauge the amount of ink.  They are comfortable to use. They write smoothly with no skips or bleeding or smudging.  While they may not impress like a solid gold Montblanc they are classics you can count on. Good value for the number received.

title: Convenient Features
text: Once assembled this desk is attractive and convenient. Assembly was more of a hassle than it should have been due to the poor instructions. It goes up and down smoothly. Like the power, usb ports and mouse pads. The casters are convenient. They lock so the desk stays in place. It loojs nice and has helpful features.

title: Pretty Pastel Colors
text: I received a set of these pens with the pastel ink. They are retractable. Be sure to remove the wax protector on the nib before first use. They are comfortable to use and the ink flows easily without smearing or being too wet. However the ink is very light. The colors are pretty but not vivid. Still well made and fun to use.

title: Basic Binder
text: This is a basic binder with a cute cover. The rings open easily and close securely.  Capacity is good. It is not heavy duty but more than adequate for home or school use.

title: Pretty
text: This is a pretty calendar. The blocks have lines. The lines are faint but usable. Each month has a different floral rendering. I liked the small monthly blocks at the bottom. Let's you see the prior and future dates. The paper is adequate and it is easy to hang. Nice.

title: Decent Cable
text: This is a decent cable. The length pool provides room to run. The clasps are okay. I have German shepherds. They are large, strong and energetic. So far everything has held. The cable is sturdy.The blue stands out against the lawn, leaves, and snow. So far so good.

title: Organization Made Easy
text: This binder makes organization easy. It contains folders that close securely. The plastic folders are impervious to liquid. There are two sizes included, large, and smaller. The binder is sturdy and large. It opens easily and closes tightly. It is a space saver . Mine did not include the labels. Great system.

title: Stellar Performance
text: This is a great phone. Set up was simple. Feature laden it comes with the usual features including voice mail and a comprehensive system to block spam and robo calls. The display is bright and easy to read. Sound quality is excellent and the battery lasts. It easily pairs with bluetooth head phones. The sleek modern look is ideal for either home or office. So far it has been problem free with stellar performance. Very pleased.

title: Santa's Popping Up
text: This card is adorable. Santa is very cute. The pop up is slightly different on each side. It is fun and festive. The envelope is plain white with the brand on the back. A nice way to send seasons greetings.

title: So Pretty
text: Who said binders have to be bland and boring? These well made binders are beautiful. The floral prints are just so pretty. They open and shut easily. No inner pockets or plastic protectors. Lovely and useful.

title: All Together
text: This is a good set of small staplers. They are handy and work well. The set includes the needed accessories including staples and staple removers. The blue color is bright and cheery. Easy to use this set is great for kids and classes.

title: Smooth
text: This is an excellent set of gel pens. There are ten black, one red and one blue. There is a protective nib over the point that is easy to remove. The pens write smoothly with no smearing, smudging or bleeding. Good value.

title: Calendar for Shepherd Fans
text: I have German shepherds and love the breed. So this calendar appealed to me. It is large and well made. It includes a sheet of stickers. The paper is thick enough to prevent bleed through of ink. The photos are nice. Would have liked more variety.Most of the dogs are black and tan. Still a lovely calendar that will delight shepherd fans.

title: The Write One
text: This pen is gorgeous. It comes beautifully packed. Included is a case that snaps shut and a refill. The pen itself writes smoothly without smudging or smearing. Gold tone it is impressive in appearance and performance.

title: Surface Marred
text: This bell is attractive. It has a cool nautical look and a good ring. It is solidly constructed and simple to install. Unfortunately the surface of mine was marred with chips exposing the underlying metal and other flaws to the finish. Fun piece that I will have to refinish.

title: Like the Portability
text: I do a lot of research so the portability of this unit appealed to me. It is easy to use with thick books. Quality is okay, not great but acceptable. My year old laptop does not recognize the device though my desktop does. The software was hard ti install and at times glitchy.

title: Quick & Easy
text: This machine is super easy to use. It heats,up quickly and the results are consistently good. The  built in cutter with grid is helpful as are the puncher and rounder. It comes with pouches. Operation is fast and quiet. No problems.

title: World on zyour Desk
text: This globe fashioned pencil holder is adorable. Surprisingly sturdy it is heavy. Capacity is generous and it hold a lot of pens and pencils. The detailing is lively. It comes nicely boxed and makes a fun and useful ornament for a traveller.

title: Colorful
text: This set makes note taking colorful if not fun. It includes colored fine tipped pens, highlighters, stickers, indes cards that can be used as flash cards and binder clips. Thought it was a bit juvenile for college and  better suited to high school. Still if it helps a student study and retain material it is worth the price.

title: Uncomfortable
text: I have lower back issues. This hard plastic support is designed to align posture while sitting. It was usable for short periods of time but it was u,ncomfortable. Better on cushiony seats like sofas than firmer office chairs. Not practical in cars. Realky did not help.

title: Garden of Good Wishes
text: This pop up card is very pretty. Truly a keepsake for the recipient. It is sturdy, easy to set up and has space for a personal greeting on the back. The envelope is pink. Thoughtful and bright.

title: Dieter's Delight
text: This book proves that dieting does not mean you are confined to bland, boring food. The recipes are flavorful and appealing. They don't shy away from spice. I liked that they avoided using artificial sweeteners. Even novi,ces will have no difficulty preparing these recipes. The instructions are clear, ingredients easily sourced. No tricky techniques or expensive equipment required. The recipes run the gamut from breakfast through dinner and include snacks and desserts. Physicalky the book is beautiful. It has a hard cover and each recipe is accompanied by a lovely color pgotograph. Not a diet plan per se but a collection of low cal recipes that are flavorful and healthy.

title: The Write Stuff
text: These pens are basic but good. They are comfortable to hold and use. They cone with blue ink. The tip is medium. They write smoothly and clearly with no noticeable smudging or bleeding. The four boxes are a terrific value.

title: Smooth Writing, Classy Look
text: These pens look professional. Comfortable to hold they write smoothly. Experienced no bleed through, skippingor smudging. The ink is black. They are fine but not extra fine tipped. Look classy..

title: Solid
text: I use binders at work and home. These are gooid quality. Reasonably sturdy they open and close with ease. Three are white and three are black. Completely satisfied.

title: Disappointing
text: I was attracted to the versatility of this scale. It could handle everything from packages to pets to produce. But unfortunately it is cheap, poorly packed and made. The metal sheet is flimsy and bent. There were no instructions. The led screen is nice and bright but the buttons are hard to read. It is inaccurate cox with weight being off significantly and expensively. It was over on average eight ounces. That is expensive if you print out labels.

title: Organization Made Easy
text: Although I have accumulated a number of planners over the years, I rarely used them consistently. Most were too time consuming and complicated. It was like a second unpaid job to use them. This one is straightforward and simple to use. It includes tips. It gets you focused without being too cumbersome or confusing. Nice.

title: Nice Pens But No Refills
text: I liked the pens but no refills were included in my pack. Half the pens have black ink, the other five have blue. The points are extended and retracted by pushing on the clip. There is a small eraser on the top. I was impressed at how well it worked. I wrote "eraseable" and erased the last three letters. They were gone without a trace. The ink flow s smoothly. They are comfortable to use. But alas, no refills.

title: The Write Stuff
text: These pens are very comfortable to hold and use. The pastels stand out. The ink in all is black. The gel ink flows smoothly without smearing, smudging or bleeding through. The one thong I did not like was the red protector on the nib that you must remove before use. The ones on mine were very hard to removes, sticky like chewed gum. Otherwise nice set of pets.

title: Impressive
text: This is an impressive planner. If you are serious about goals this will help so long as you do the work required. The planner slides into a case. Mine was dented and dinged. The planner itself was flawless. The purple faux leather cover is striking. It comes with stickers. The planning covers pretty much everything. It is undated so you can start whenever you want.

title: Plain
text: The best thing about this,character is that the blocks provide plenty of room to write. It is easy to hang. There are diagrams of leaves in green. They are okay, not especially vibrant or interesting. It is plain with a slight rustic feel. The paper is average, not heavyweight. If you just want basic this is for you.

title: Safe Mailing
text: These are decent envelopes. The bubble wrapping is protective and the adhesion is good. They are reasonably sturdy and are ideal for thinner objects. I've used them multiple times with no issues.

title: Iridescent Upgrade
text: This is an attractive set. The iridescence is striking. I am impressed by the quality. These are premium pieces. Each works well, feels sturdy and durable.The set comes nicely packaged in a cardboard box. Definitely an easy desk upgrade.

title: Classics
text: This set of six notebooks is a good value. The style is classic with a secure binding. The lines are clear and the spacing adequate. The paper is decent, bright white with weight sufficient to prevent bleed through. The different color covers are helpful.

title: Step by Step
text: This planner is designed to help you reach goals. Undated, it can be started any time.  It comes with a planner poster and user guide.They help identify objectives and break them down into small actionable steps. The planner covers twelve weeks. The paper is decent and the exterior is vegan leather. There is a back pocket for notes and miscellany. It is light and small enough to tuck in a bag or briefcase. Nice.

title: Focus on Photos
text: If your primary focus is printing photos, graphics or craft projects this printer will serve you well. If you are looking for all in one productivity and document printing, copying and scanning, there are better options. Set up was okay. I like the concept of the eco tank although without care it can be messy. Printing is slow. Photo printing is very good. Regular document printing is acceptable but not outstanding. There is duplex printing but scanning g has to be done manually, no batch feed. So if your focus is art and photos it is worth it.

title: All Around Hassle
text: This printer is a disappointment. I thought it would be perfect for wireless household use but it is not. Set up is a hassle and once it is connected it is slow. It also disconnects from the internet without rhyme or reason. I like the compact size but performance is sub par.

title: Cumbersome Set Up
text: I thought this compact printer would work well for those in my household wedded to their mobile devices. I was wrong.set up was unnecessarily cumbersome and the app is annoying. Finally got it connected and it is slow. Print quality is good but speed is poor and set up eas a hassle. Better options out there.

title: Simple Assembly
text: Assembly of this chair is super simple. It is a nice chair. The casters roll smoothly. It is comfortable and would be ideal for a student. It is lightweight. There is some support but not the best choice for an office jockey who spends most of the day in a chair.  The bonded leather seat looks nice and there is sufgicient foam for comfort and support. The chrome legs are sturdy. I was not impressed with the faux woodgrain back. Does fool anyone and reminds me of the stuff they used to put on car consoles. Notwithstanding it is a nice chsir.

title: Versatile
text: These highlighters are versatile. One side provides a fine line while the other is thick. The ink dries quickly and they are comfortable to use. I like the variety of colors. Good product.

title: Appropriate for All
text: These cards depict attractive nature scenes. They contain a generic, inoffensive, pleasant sentiment. There is plenty of room for a personal note. They come with plain greige envelopes. Appropriate for anyone.

title: Office Helper
text: This is an excelkent filing cabinet. It is fully assembled save for attaching the handles and drawers. It locks and comes with two keys. The drawrs glude open and the wheels run smoothly. The black is basic but chic. Helpful at home or office.

title: Sturdy
text: These are nice sturdy kraft envelopes. The adhesive is strong and they seem well made and durable. I've used them to mail manuals and documents with no problem.

title: Big but Thin
text: These large black envelopes are large but thin. I would not mail anything other than documents, maybe. The adhesive sticks but is peculiarly placed. The black is impressive. You do need labels. Not bad but not as sturdy or durable as I was hoping.

title: Electronic Research Assistant
text: If you do a lot of research this scanner is indispensable. It sets up quickly and is easy to use. The interface is clunky and not especially intuitive. But once you've become familiar  it is straightforward. Performance is reliable. It works quietly and is an amazing time saver. So far I've encountered no problems. Wish it would accommodate legal sized pages but it works with most materials.

title: Plenty of Ink
text: The price of ink is usually a deal breaker but this one comes with a year's supply. Set up was simple. It has a sleek appearance and performs well. There are some shortcomings though. It is wireless only. Not a deal breaker but alternatives are not. There is no auto feed or more annoyingly no duplex printing. There is no manual feed. Speed and noise are average. Print quality is good and it copies and scans in addition to printing. Nice machine for the home.

title: Pretty
text: This is a pretty planner. I like the colorful cover and the smaller size is easy to tuck in a bag or backpack. Otherwise layout and quality are standard. It is an academic planner so it starts in July. So far no issues. It works well.

title: Everywhere Essentials
text: This is a terrific selection of office essentials. Included are scissors, two varieties of post its, the notes and memos, flags to mark pages, two tapes, invisible and super strong. All come nicely packaged in a cardboard box. Not just for the office they are ideal for home and school too.

title: Brighten Someone's Day
text: These cute cards will brighten anyone's day. The colors are vivid and come with coordinating envelopes. There are two general purpose designs, one for birthdays and one thank you. They are small. The caddy is a joke. It is just a piece of card stock. The cards also come with little dividers. Nice is you had a card store but overkill otherwise. Nice cheerful selection.

title: Think Ink
text: I got this copier primarily for the mega tank of ink. It's gotten to the point where it is sometimes cheaper to get a whole new printer than refills. The printer itself is reasonably compact. Set up wad issue free and it comes with lots of ink. An all in one it prints, scans, copies and faxes.It functions well and print copy is good. Paper capacity is also good .I was surprised and rather annoyed that neither of the trays accommodated legal sized paper. You can use the back feed but it is inconvenient. Printing time is average as is the noise level. It is performing reliably and I have run out of ink.

title: Cons Outweigh Pros
text: The printer itself is fine. Like most lasers it produces crisp black and white documents. I like the auto duplex. What I don't like is the need to set up an HP account and use the app to get the printer running. Every company claims great care and concern over customer info until they get hacked and let the poor customers know eight months down the road. The proprietary ink/toner rankles. I have seen inknprices skyrocket until it is cheaper to buy a whole new vomputer than refills. The ink subscription plan looks appealing but I have privacy concerns. It is also my experience that after the trial periods the companies make up the lost profits and it is a nightmare to cancel. Equally good printers out there without the oneroys requirements.

title: Pretty
text: These pens are pretty. The plastic barrels are pastel. They look a bit different, stand out and appeal to kids. The ink flows smoothly and they write just fine.  They are durable and long lasting.

title: Save on Ink
text:
I got this printer largely because of the large ink capacity. A few years ago I switched all my office printers to lasers because the cost of ink refills made it cheaper to buy a new printer than the refills. While the lasers can't be beaten in black and white printing ink jets still excel with photos and color.

Set up was straightforward. The design is unique. It is a double decker with the paper in the middle. An all in one it scans, copies, prints, and has fax capabilities. Alk seem to work. The print quality is very good with the colors clean and pure. It is reasonably fast. My one complaint is the touchscreen is not especially responsive. It takes a few taps. Otherwise a nice printer with the promise of substantial savings.

title: Shorty
text: This is a cute little stand, the operative word being little. It was smaller and shorter than expected. Assembly was easy, under ten minutes. It is still useful and attractive. It rolls smoothly and can even fit under a desk. It need not be limited to printers and computer supplies. It is sturdy and does not wobble.

title: Reliable
text: I live in an area where cell reception is poor and blackouts occur fairly frequently. This phone system is a godsend. Set up was simple. It can be used during a blackout and is expandable. It has all the features I need including call block, caller id and answering service. It comes with two cordless phones. Sound quality is acceptable. I am pleased with this system. It has performed reliably.

title: Sleek Metal Barrels
text: These are attractive pens. Perfect for everyday they are retractable. The ink flows smoothly. The metal barrels look sleekband are sturdier than plastic. The fine point performs as expected. They are ideal for home, school or office.

title: Smooth Writing
text: These are terrific pens. Refillable they feature a nice selection of colors. The gel ink flows smoothly without smudging or streaking. The points are protected by little plastic nibs that should be removed before use. Nice set.

title: Attractive, Compact & Useful
text: This is such a cute little calendar. The floral motif is cheerful. The easel design is steady and stable. There is room to write notes. Two sheets of stickers are included to help mark specific dates including birthdays, paydays, medical and dental appointments, etc. Attractive and useful it deserves a place in your home or office.

title: Smart Choice
text: This is a nice, basic, expandable office system. Set up was simple. Quality is adequate. The digital receptionist is terrific and reliable. There is battery bc backup. Storage is decent and it works with standard caller id subscription. The only thing missing is call block. Otherwise a smart choice for a small ofgice.

title: Noteworthy
text: These are nice durable notebooks. There are three. The colors are vivid. The coil is strong and the pockets handy. The pre-punched holes and page perforations  make transfer to a binder simple. Good quality notebooks.

title: Helpful
text: This bamboo stand is attractive and well made. The perforations make it pretty. The angle easily adjusts and there are clips in the front. It won't do for large, thick books but is fine for all others, tablets, magazines and single pages. It stands steadily and folds flat for storage. Nice snd helpful.

title: More than a Maintenance Log
text:
This is so much more than a maintenance log. It is really a hybrid journal with room for goals, daily planning as well as maintenance details and advice on dealing with mechanics. Designed for women it includes affirmations and pink accents. It has a black and pink pen.

It is very nice and beautifully packaged. However, in truth, it was not what I expected. I was hoping for something limited to maintenance with envelopes or storage for receipts. If my car was a Bentley it would probably need a journal of its own. But it is a Subaru. I was going to give it to my brother who just purchased a new (to him) care and is notorious for losing receipts. But the feminine touches turn him off. I like it and am using it. Nice gift for young women

title: Compact Performer
text: This is a terrific all in one ink jet printer. Set up was straight forward and I encountered no problems.  I used wi-fi to connect. Simple. The unit is compact and I like the more economical ink cartridge design. It performs well. It is reasonably fast and reasonably quiet. Print quality is good. It also can handle copying and faxes. Good machine for students, homes and small offices.

title: Dream Setter, Goal Getter
text: This lovely  journal is well made and well designed. It aids in goal setting and gently guides the user to remove limitations, take steps to realize the dream and check in an assess progress. There are tips and techniques. The prompt s are helpful not heavy handed or intrusive. Handsome and useful.

title: Basic But Nice
text: These notebooks are basic but nice. The covers are pretty pastel covers. Paper quality is good. The wide lines are helpful. My mother, who had a stroke, is using them to practice her penmanship. No bleed through and she can see her work. Convenient to have on hand.

title: Decent
text: This is decent paper. It is pre-punched. The lines are clear. Thickness is average but it should be fine for school. I did not receive five packs of a hundred each; just a single pack of five hundred. Not a deal breaker for me but something to be aware of.

title: Good for Crafts
text: This rubber cement is ideal for crafts. The two pack feature bottles with relatively wide mouths. The brush applicator works well. The glue is not odiferous like some. Adhesion is good with paper, photos, thin fabric, felt, card stock and board. Nice for home, school or office.

title: Gold Print Grid
text: This thin wood round has the flower of life with the seven chakras running down the center printed in gold. The back is just plain. It is at most 1/4 inch thick. It can be use as a grid (or a template). No instructions or crystals or hanging hardware included. Easy enough to secure any of those three. Instructions on making crystal grids are easily found online. The quality is decent, no raw edges, splinters, etc.

title: The Write Stuff
text: Calligraphy is beautiful. The process of learning it can be relaxing and meditative. This set has what you need to get started. There is a small instruction manual and a larger workbook for practice. There are four double sided markers and some paper. The markers are much easier than pens for beginners. The directions are clear and easy to follow. Practice makes perfect. The workbook is slim andcit makes sense to make copies of the pages. The paper supply is a little skimpy. Still it is axnice set to get started.

title: Easy to Read
text: This calendar is basic and functional. It is super easy to read. There is sufficient space for notes. It forgoes frivolity for function. Wirebound it can be easily hung or used on a desk or table. It runs from July 21 to June 22.

title: Nice
text: This is a pretty planner. The colorful cover is cheery.  The inside is standard. It includes a chart of the scientific method and s map of the US with states and their capitols. Although marketed to teachers it would be appropriate for just about anyone. The front cover doubles as a clear pocket. It seems reasonably sturdy and I like the large size. Some of the print is in white script. Hard to read. Otherwise a useful planner.

title: Decent Monthly Planner
text: There are people who like detail, lists and comprehensive planners. And there are those who don't. This monthly planner is perfect for the latter category. If you just want to jot down appointments and important dates and see what the month holds at a glance, this is ideal. It is compact and fairly thin. The cover is attractive and it is reasonably sturdy.

title: All That You Need
text: This is a utilitarian planner that has everything you need with none of the silliness. It is plain and functional. Although marketed to teachrrs it would work for anyone who needs to keep  track of things. Full sized, it provides plenty of room. It is sturdy and durable. Good value.

title: Pens Plus
text: This is a generous supply of quality pens. The black ink flows smoothly and the pens write clearlybwithovut smudgingnor smearing. The plastic Contains an anti microbial agent. Can't say I've noticed anything but it does hurt to have an extra layer of protection during these pandemic days. Great pens with extra protection.

title: Decent But Dated
text: This phone is decent but dated. It is a landline with a cordless handset.  Installation was straightforward. II put this in our greenhouse. I liked that there are indoor and outdoor profiles. Sound quality is acceptable and the answering function works. The display is clear. But it really needs call block. The rest of the features are fairly standard. Additional handsets may be purchased separately. 3.5 stars

title: Compact & Attractive
text: This is a very pretty organizer. The metal is sturdy and the rose gold is lovely. The little drawer slides out easily. It is not super large but has room enough to keep essentials at hand. I like it.

title: Attractive But Small
text: This is an attractive set. It includes a small binder, twelve envelopes with different colorful patterns, twelve two sided budget sheets and twenty four stickers. Made from PU leather the binder has card pockets, regular pockets, pen loops and a magnetic closure. The mint green is attractive. The binder opens easily and closes securely.  It is small measuring 7.48" x 5.2". The envelopes have a coating that suggests they are water resistant. The budget shhets are tgick enough to prevent bleed through. That being said this is best fir beginners or fod tracking expenses while travelking. It is small . the envelopes are fine for things the size of a US bill, but nothing wider or longer. It is portable, perfect to slip in a bag, briefcase or glove compartment. No instructions are provided. Refills are available.

title: Compact
text: This compact calendar features attractive shots of national parks. There is room enough to jot appointment info. The calendar is retro style with Monday leading the week. Different but not a deal breaker. There was a time when Sunday was considered the last day of the week, the proverbial day of rest and Monday was and is still the beginning of the work week. If that does not bother you this is a nicely made attractive calender, ideal for small spaces.

title: Cute
text: This pretty calendar can be used on the desk or hung on a wall. There is room sufficient to jot a note or appointment. It cones with stickers that make planning simple. Cute way to keep track of days.

title: A Pen for Your Thoughts
text: This is a set of retractable pens and includes two flight pens. They all write smoothly. Retraction is smooth and without fault. The blue ink and medium point are ideal for everyday. The ink dries quickly and I've had no issue with smearing or smudging. Nice value set for home, school or office.

title: Adorable Holiday Greetings
text: These pop up cards are adorable. The pop ups open and shut easily and automatically. When opened, they stay put making a cute decoration.  There are four cards each with a different front and pop up. The enveloped are plain, off white with "signature"  and the Hallmark crown embossed on the back. A fun way to send holiday wishes.

title: Noteworthy
text: Pretty and practical this notebook is a keeper. The hard cover is lovely with an attractive floral print. The elastic coordinates color wise and is securely attached by grommets. There are ribbon placeholders and a folder style pocket in the back. The lined paper is good quality, thick enough to resist bleed through. The book is small enough to tuck in a bag or briefcase.

title: The Perfect Planner
text: This is the perfect planner. Well designed, it has nice high quality paper. Each month is preceded by pages for goal setting, evaluation and notes. The layout is practical and easy to use. There is a pocket in the back to corral loose papers, cards and mementos. The elastic band closure is securely affixed. This planner is practical, pretty and fun.

title: Well Made & Designed
text: This planner is well made and thoughtfully designed. The copper accents are attractive on the mint green cover. There are pages preceding each month for goal listing, assessment and review. The paper has a good weight, nice look and feel. An elastic strap keeps it closed and there is a pocket in the back. The compact size is perfect for tucking in a bag or briefcase.  Electronic calendars are en vogue but it is nice to have written back-up. Lovely.

title: Well Made
text: This is a beautiful planner. The navy blue cover is splashed with vivid tropical flowers. There is an elastic for closure, three ribbon place keepers and a picket in the back. Each month begins with two pages for journaling. It includes sections for wellness, gratitude, and a place to evaluate the previous month's goals and accomplishment. The second page focuses on the current month including things to get started, quit and to keep up and an area for notes. The remainder of the month consista of lined vertical sections. The paper is a good weight abd the 8" x 11" size is ideal for business or personal use. Attractive in appearance this planner is fun and easy to use.

title: Vintage Style
text: This well made journal has a vintage style cover. It looks weathered with lovely gold leaf. It is bound by elastic and has three ribbon place marks. The paper is lined with impressive weight. The pages have very fine perforations for page removal. The corners also have micro perforations for place marking. There is a pocket in the back that is iseful for storing loose items like photos cards and notes. Very nice.

title: Fun
text: The front cover is what makes this journal fun. It has glitter suspended in liquid. The fluid moves around and the glitter sparkles and shines. The interior contains lined paper of average weight. It has a lot of appeal and is reasonably sturdy. Bleed through of ink from gel pens and liners is minimal. But the big draw is the cover which makes an average journal special.

title: Pretty & Useful
text: This journal is nicely made. The cover is hard and flecked with foil and other speckles. The paper is a nice weight and resistant to bleeds. The lines make it easy to write. I liked the perforations. They are very fine making it unlikely that pages will come loose but easy enough to remove a page cleanly. The corners are also perforated.  There are place marker ribbons and an elastic closure. Compact it is small enough to tuck into a bag or briefcase. A couple of the pages in the back were stuck together.  The back storage pocket is fine for stowing loose notes and cards. Pretty and useful.

title: Decent
text: I live in a mountainous area. Cell phone reception is sketchy at best and we are prone to power outages. I selected this system largely because of the battery option which makes it workable even during an outage. Set up was straightforward. The battery compartment is hard to open. Although it has many desirable features it lacks call block, something I find indispensable. The caller idea works fine. Quality overall is good CD and you can easily add on if need be.

title: Impressive
text: This laminator is impressive in performance and appearance. It is smartly designed and easy to use. It has an intuitive touchscreen. It heats up quickly and can accommodate even larger projects. I loved the fan that cools and the no jam feature. everything came out perfectly with no curling, bubbles or flaws. the laminator is large. Heavy-duty it is ideal for the office, school or home.  It comes with a starter pack of pouches.

title: form & Function
text: This filing cabinet is functional and attractive. It has an appealing contemporary look but could blend easily with most decors. Assemb ly is simply a matter of affixing the casters. But don't be fooled by its good looks. Well designed it is an office workhorse. The three drawers have plenty of room. The cabinet locks providing security and privacy. The gliders are very smooth. Quality is superb and this is an excellent addition to any busy office.

title: Handy
text: This cart is simple to set up and collapse. It folds flat. The handle telescopes. The wheels roll smoothly. While not enormous capacity is good. The cover pulls down. While this protects the contents it would have been nice had there been someway to secure it. The cloth basket if not removable. Spot clean. The directions are largely pictorial. Very handy especially since plastic grocery bags have been banned in my state. This is much easier than lugging three or four resuseable bags.

title: Sturdy Storage
text: These are nice sturdy boxes. Stackable they are made of translucent plastic. I liked that you could use them for legal as well as regular sized folders. I was less enthused with the lids. Once you muscle them on they are secure. There are no instructions for those who are not mechanically inclined or worried about breaking something. The three boxes are separate from the fovers. Good storage, perfect for folders or anything else.

title: Useful & Practical
text: My state has banned plastic groceries. The COVID restrictions have heightened concerns about safety. This cart is genius. Super simple to set up it holds a total of seventy pounds. Assembly was really just a matter of unfolding and attaching the wheels. The basket is removable. It rolls smoothly, more like a luxury stroller than a shopping cart. The brakes work well. It folds nicely in the car. Took it out for a test run at Price Chopper and BJ's. Worked well and we didn't have to wonder what unseen meanies were lurking on the store carts. When I was a kid growing up in NYC I remember my grandmother and her metal  shopping cart (still have it BTW). Guess it isctrue: everything old is new again. This cart is useful and practical.

title: Cure for a Weak Blotter-
text: this glass planner is great. I am a scribbler, a doodler and a random jotter. All these make for a messy planner/blotter. This glass planner is non-absorbent. It comes with a dry erase marker. You can scribble to your heart's content, jot down numbers, etc, book appointments and then wipe them clean. Although it is glass it is strong and so far hasn't scratched, chipped or broken. The marble looks professional. A clever idea, well-executed.

title: Satisfaction Sealed Up
text: These envelopes area business staple. They come in a cardboard box. The 24 pound paper is sturdy and heavy. These are not the cheap flimsy bargain envelopes. The peel off adhesive is easy to use and sticks securely. The interior security pattern provides privacy. An excellent value high quality envelopes.

title: Good Printer, Awful Instructions and  Annoying Set Up
text: Despite poor directions and installation hassles, this printer performs well. It has many useful functions. It is reasonably fast and has automatic duplex printing. It is fairly heavy and somewhat noisy but otherwise efficient and economical. Set up was a royal pain. I opted to do wi-fi set up and it would not connect. The screen is very small. I would up using a stylus. It took hours before it connected. It comes with a useless CD. I used it and it apparently contained no driver. I wound up downloading and after a few false starts go it up and running. The included directions are worthless, essentially multiple pages of illustrations showing how to remove tape and packing materials. The website has videos demonstrating the same. But now that it is set u  I have no complaints about the performance or print qualiity. Nice once you overcome the initial irritation.

title: Super Sized Post It Pads
text: Whether you use them for meetings, messages or teaching these super-sized Post It pads are excelkent. Each pad contains thirty white lined pages. Adhesion is excellent. It stays in place until removed, no slipping or sliding. The lines are fairly light but make it simple to have a neat chart. They remove without leaving behind damage or residue. Great product.

title: Good Value
text: This is a good alternative to the name brand. The adhesion is good. They work well in both my laser and inkjet printers. If you do a lot of mailing, these are excellent.

title: Small But Secure
text: These protective mailers are small but useful. There is sufficient protection inside and the exterior is smooth and easy to write. Adhesion is good. Perfect for small items and samples they seem secure.

title: Big & Basic
text: This is a big, basic table. Assembly was straightforward. Due to the size and weight it takes at least two people to put it together. Once completed it looks nice. There are feet that screw in. They are adjustable and a help on uneven surfaces. There is a modesty panel but no drawers or holes for  wires or tech stations. It is a handsome piece, sturdy and steady.

title: Compact and Easy to Read
text: This scale is easy to set up and use. The three required triple-A batteries were included. it is compact and small capacity. The weight limit is five pounds. So it is not ideal for mailing large packages but works well for smaller items and office mail. The display is easy to read and its accuracy matched a larger more expensive scale I own. Very handing especially for those items that are just on the cusp of needing more postage.

title: Great Adhesion
text: These labels have good adhesion. No templates are available but my secretary created one. They work in both the laser and ink jet printers. So far they haven't jammed but we haven't run large quantities either. Good labels.

title: Make the Mark
text: These markers are the best. They write clearly on a variety of surfaces. The ink is bright royal blue.  The chisel tips are strong and show no signs of wear, even after repeated use. The twelve pack is a good value. They are comfortable in the hand and have little discernible odor.

title: Excellent Adhesion
text: If you do a lot of mailing you will be impressed by both the quality and quantity of these labels. They work well with both my laser and inkjet printers. They adhere well to a variety of surfaces including paper, cardboard and those slippery poly envelopes. They look good and are easy to work with. Very impressed.

title: Smartcastic
text: These smooth writing pens have hilarious faux ads on them. The ink in all of them is black. They write well and are sure to put a smile on your face.

title: Great Print Quality
text: If the cost of ink is getting you down and you primarily print in black and white a laser printer is the solution. This one is excellent. The instructions are awful, pictorial and hard to follow. However, once the app is downloaded it is simple and straightforward. Wireless connectivity is reliable. Print quality is excellent, clear and sharp. The printer is fast and the span and copy functions work well. The supplied toner is supposed for up to five thousand pages, which is pretty darn good. I haven't had any problems with this printer and am satisfied with its performance.

title: Fine for Personal or Commercial Use
text: This is a good basic bubble mailer. The bubbles add protection and the size is smaller. The adhesive is strong and it stays sealed. The smooth surface is easy to write on. Adhesive labels also stick well to it. They are plain and simple, fine for personal or commercial use.

title: The World is my Canvas
text:
Paint markets are a cool concept. They can used in a variety of surfaces. Varnishing or baking can make the color permanent on porous surfaces. They are fairly easy to use. Shake twenty times and then press the tip at least five times to prime. The ink flows well and the marker is easy to control. There is a nice variety of colirs. Mine included silver, gold, white, black, red, green, blue and yellow. The colors are vivid. Low odor they dry quickly. The fine tip is ideal for detail.
N

title: Desk Top Hero
text: These stackable trays are helpful. The mesh is attractive and they are reasonably sturdy. Legal sized documents fit. Capacity is adequate. Good buy.

title: Sturdy & Atractive
text: These sturdy polypropylene chairs can be used indoors or out. They should accommodate most people. UV treated they resist fading and sun damage. They are fairly comfortable and very durable. They have a contemporary style that is attractive. The arms are great. Even better they are stackable and easy to wipe clean.

title: Needs Better Instructions
text: This phone has a clear  easy to read screen. Sound is okay. Both the answering machine and the call block worked. However the instructions are poor. The battery compartment is almost impossible to open and it beeps continually until messages are answered. I wanted this for my mother. Although she can grip it with her arthritic fingers it is not as simple to use as I anticipated. It functions as a phone should. But if you are not going to provide clear instructions you better make it intuitive.

title: Limited
text: This is a serviceable little phone. It is compact. The screen is very bright and easy to read. However it is quite limited. Call block is a necessity. The process is somewhat cumbersome and only ten numbers can be blocked at any time. There is voicemail with only two options: accept all calls or refuse them. Playback is a bit soft. The speakerphone works well as does the mute button. Volume and ringtones are adjustable. It is an attractive phone and simple to use but limited.

title: Impressed
text: A shredder is essential in home and ofgice. This one is impresdive. It shreds like a beast whether it be paper or plastic. What I like best is the ease. of use. The controls are foolproof, intelligent and clear.  It runs longer and cooler than similarly sized models. Impressed.

title: Perfect for Students
text: Great for students these highlighters illuminate the text. The chisel tips permit a variety of thicknesses. The yellow color is bright and eyecatching. They are comfortable to hold. Even better they don't dry out (for up to eight hours) if you forget to recap. Great for home, school or office.

title: Excellent
text: This is a terrific assortment of pens. They write smoothly and reliably . The gel ink literally glides across the page without smudging or smearing. There are three colors: red, black and blue. Each one is true. Comfortable to hold they are retractable. Excellent.

title: Works Well
text: This cordless phone works pretty well indoors and out. It is convenient to have when you are working outside. Set up is simple. The screen is clear and readable and the battery life is pretty good. The handset is sturdy and has survived a,couple of drops without isdue. It is not too heavy or bulky though it lacks the sleek aesthetic. Reception is good. Overall a decent phone.

title: King of the Mouse Pads
text: The lion graphic is beautiful. The pad itself is smaller than I anticipated. It works well. The base has grip and doesn't slip and slide. My mouse glides smoothly over the surface. It seems durable and is attractive.

title: Strong
text: These are nice sturdy envelopes for mailing or storage. The paper is strong enough to resist tears. The adhesive is more than adequate. The metal clasp is flimsy but okay for most applications.

title: For Smsll Jobs
text: These small rollers of adhesive tape do work. Simply uncap and roll the tape across the surface and you will get a thin line of glue. It does stick. It is fine on small projects or for adding some extra grip to envelopes. There really should be instructions included. The dispensers are small and tuck in a bag or bavkpack. The cover is secure. I don't find them superior to glue sticks. There really is not much in them and the amount dispensed is small.

title: Horrid
text: As I've used corrector pens before the lack of instructions did not concern me. Until I wasted an hour trying to get them to work. They come in plastic cases. I could not get the tape to cover anything. Back to the reliable liquids.

title: Helpful & Versatile
text: This is a handy cart. It is literally a snap to put together. The instructions are clear. The casters run smoothly. Two of them lock, a nice feature. It is versatile!e and can be used pretty much anywhere. I do wish the trays were flat instead of sectioned but not a deal breaker.

title: Professional Appearance
text: l Iike this padfolio. The black material looks professional and feels nice. The interior has slots for five cards, a pen holder that will accommodate most writing implements and a pad. There is a pocket on the back exterior in which you could slide a resume or other letter sized document. It seems nicely made and has met expectations.

title: Write Right
text: These are great pens. Comfortable to hold they write smoothly with no smudging or leaking. The black ink looks professional and the medium is satisfactory for most uses. The 120 count is a good value.Satisfied.

title: Nice Starter Kit
text: This is a nice starter kit for anyone interested in mastering the art of calligraphy. The set includes three fountain oens, fine, medium and thick nibs and a box of cartridges in a good assortment of colors. The instructions are about filling and maintaining the pens rather than calligraphy instructions. There are plenty of books about that available but it would have been nice to have some direction. Just tried the blue pen. It has not leaked thus far. Good for beginbers.

title: Strong
text: These folders are well made and perfect for organizing my civil fikes. The recycled pressboard is sturdy and the metal fasteners are secure. The tabs are in different poitions for easy viewing. I am impressed by the quality. Good value.

title: Colorful and Convenient
text: These stretch bracelets are a fun way to keep keys and id at hand. The colors are pretty and will appeal to kids ad well as adults. The bands are soft and stretch sufficiently to fit most wrists. The key ring is decent and stays secure. I wear one when walking the dogs.

title: Colorful Collection
text: These are nice cards to have on hand. The interiors are blank, perfect for jotting a note. There are four patterns:cacti, fruit, a mix of geometric shapes and geometric rain drops. The colors are cheerful. The envelopes are plain white and unlined. There was no presentation or box. Mine were just in a split cellophane wrapper.

title: Good Value
text: These colored folder are great. I use them to organize my civil files. There is a nice assortment of colors:red, yellow, green and blue. The tabs are in different positions which is helpful. They are well made, decent weight and the metal prongs work as expected. Good value.

title: Efficient & Versatile
text: This stapler scores high in versati!ity. Powered by either batteries or the included ac adaptor it has a sleek, modern appearance. But performance is crucial. This stapler is quiet, efficient and strong enough to staple twenty pages (standard copier papr). To date I have had no issues with jamming. It comes with a small box of staples.

title: Well Made, Small Binder Required
text: The protectors are nicely made. Designed for 4" x 6" cards they provide protection from moisture, splashes and spills. They do not fit a standard sized binder but a small mini one. Not hard to secure. You do not have to use them for recipes and actually other items work better. The recipes I need to refer to are more complex and I usually put them on a standard sized sheet of paper then laminate.  These are nice. Cards are easy to insert and remove and they stay in place.

title: Office Helper
text: You can't go wrong with black mesh. This desk organizer looks pretty good. It is larger than I anticipated due to the hanging file inthe back. The little drawer is useful. Assembly is required but involves screwing the screws and popping on the protective feet. Quality is acceptable, not outstanding. It looks nice once assembled and functions as expected.

title: Genuinely Weatherproof
text: Rain, snow sleet or hail, these post it notes are better than mail. Large and vivid they are truly impervious to weatjer. If you have to leave a message or directions for delivery people, contractors, friends or relatives and will not be home these are the ticket. Great adhesion and weather proof.

title: Sturdy, Stable, & Useful
text: What office can survive without Post-its? This dispenser is nicely made. Easy to fill it takes the acvodian style post-its. It is filled with sand that you can hear if you move or shale it. There is an integrated holder for pens and the like. It has a pleasing contemporary look that should fit in with just about any office.

title: Nice Light Duty Shredder
text: This is an ideal shredder for light home or office use. It is compact and easy to use. The microcut is excellent and it handles pretty much everything you can put into it, plastic as well as paper. The bin is light but easy to remove. It does not lock in place. It is not overly noisy. The biggest aggravation is that it runs for five minutes and needs a half hour bresk. Hence it is not designed for major shredding jobs. But it is terrific for light duty.

title: Teacher's Aide
