text: If you give presentations this is a great tool. It was easy to assemble. It adjusts and is steady. The casters roll smoothly on hard surfaces and hold their own on carpets.  It is simple to use with flipcharts. The accessories include markers and erasers. All hardware is included. Good piece of equipment for business, school or home.

title: Solid Performance
text: This is a nice solid staple gun. It is sturdy. Easy to load and simple to use it performs as expected. It comes with a small stapler sampler. Three different types of staples are included but not six hundred of them The gun seems durable and I have no complaints.

title: Attractive
text: This board is attractive and useful. Installation was simple. The royal blue is a nice change or pace and the fabric is, as promised, self healing. The aluminum border is a tad flimsy but does the job. The large size makes it ideal for the office but it would be a fun addition to a kid's room.

title: Quick, quiet & Compact
text: Quick, quiet and compact this is a terrific laminator for home or office. Set up is simple and it is easy to use. It heats up fast. For best results trim  the laminate pouches to size. The accompanying starter pack consists of five letter sized sheets. Iam pleased with this product. I am using it at home. I frequently laminate recipes and this works well.

title: Compact
text: This is a useful calculator. It is fairly compact and straightforward to use. It includes tax, percent and square root keys. It is solar powered with battery back up. I have not yet had to change the battery.  The display is large and clear. Sturdy it has survived some drops, bangs and bumps and still works.

title: Love the Backspace
text: This is the perfect calculator for a business. Large, it us both easy to read and easy to use. It has useful features like backspace as well as tax, percentage and currency conversions. My favorite is the backspace, something rarely seen on small calculators. It runs on solar and battery power. Durable it withstands heavy use. Ideal for the office.

title: Dinosaur Markers
text: Collectible figures camouflage markers in this fun set for kids. My set contained dinosaurs. Made of hard plastic they have removable heads. Once the head is off the marker is exposed. Marker color is the same as the figure's base. The markers feature bright, vivid colors.  They write smoothly. The chunky base provides grip for little hands. There is a sheet of stickers containing two for each figure. It is too bad the marker portion is not replaceable but the figures make sturdy toys. Fun set.

title: Simple Set up and Use
text: This is a nice, solid lock box. It comes with a dust cover that removes to reveal the combination lock. It comes with straightforward directions and all necessary hardware. It is an easy enterprise to set up and hang. The interior provides enough room for a couple of keys. It seems sturdy and secure. The design is understated and does not draw attention.

title: Apple for the Teacher
text: This adorable post it filled apple would make a nice gift for a teacher. The apple is weighted. You can hear the sand or whatever the filling is sloshing arond. It is simple to fill.It comes with twelve cheerfully colored packs of pop up notes. They differ from the regular style in that they dispense in accordion like pleats. The apple is hard plastic and pictorial directions for filling are on the box.

title: Lightweight
text: It is lightweight and simple to use. But performance is marginal. The blades dull quickly and cuts get ragged fast. It comes with a pictorial instruction sheet. Since its big selling point is its portability it should have come with a carrying case.

title: Coming Up Roses
text: Roses are a traditional way to express love on Valentine's Day. This pop up card makes a lasting rememberance. The exterior is simple. The bouquet unfolds beautifully and holds its shape and position. No adjustments or attachments necessary. The bouquet is pretty; rich red with shine and a little sparkle. The bouquet even includes greenery and a white vase. It folds back up simply though the top rose may need a little assistance.  It comes with a white envelope lined with shiny red.

title: Good Quality
text: These are nice index cards. A thousand total they come divided in plastic wrapped packages of one hundred. Quality is good: they are not the flimsy more paper than card ones. Perfect for home, school and office they are a good value.

title: Sticky Mechanism
text: A lockbox can be a time and money saver. I live in an isolated area and forgetting a key or accidentally locking oneself out can be an expensive, time consuming inconvenience. This little lock box is easily mounted on the wall. The directions are clear and the necessary hardware is included. The capacity is sufficient for a few keys. The combination is simple enough to set and change if need be. It come with a waterproof cover and is discreet. I did find the mechanism sticky and finicky. It did not open as easily as other designs. This is inconvenient and annoying especially in inclement weather.

title: Lock Out Insurance
text: Anyone who has ever been locked out or forgotten a key knows what a hassle it is. This portable combination lock box is the solution. The directions are straightforward. It is simple to set and change the combination. It has a waterproof cover. The interior has sufficient space for a couple of keys. It is very easy to use and we keep it in the glove box of one of our vehicles.

title: Handy Lock Box
text: I live in an isolated area so forgetting a key or getting locked out means a long, cold wait. This little lock box is the ideal solution. The directions are clear and installation and setting the combination are simple. The necessary mounting hardware is contained in the interior of the box. It is not super large but a number of keys, three or four, will fit comfortably, depending, of course, on the size and thickness of the key. It is easy to use. The mechanisms are not sticky. When placed discreetly it is a great help. It also is easy (and advisable) to change the combination. This permits access for guests, maid or other service providers. It seems reasonably sturdy. Very handy.

title: Sturdy
text: These standard wardrobe boxes are a moving staple. They come with a hanging bar. They are easy to assemble, sturdy and stable. There is plenty of room and they seem well made. They are also provide a convenient place to store seasonal clothes or costumes. Very helpful.

title: Delightful
text: This adorable note card set features two pleasing designs with coordinated lined envelopes. The note cards open and are blank. The one design is off cacti. Although I live in the cold Northeast I have a small but robust indoor cacti garden.  The illustration perfectly captures the beauty and fun of these plants. The second card is illustrated with three pineapples. Pineapples symbolize hospitality, generosity and friendship. The colors are pretty. The envelopes are nicely made. One has a pale green lining, the other a soft coral. Truly a delightful set.

title: Cute
text: Th is book contains  six 5 x 7 postcards. They are nice quality. I don't think they are unique enough to warrant framing but they are cute to send.  The individual cards separated while I was thumbing through the book.

title: Basic Binders
text: These are nice sturdy binders. Basic black makes them appropriate for any venue. They open easily and close securely. Capacity is generous.. No complaints.

title: Love the Auto Duplex
text: This is a nice compact black and white laser  printer for a small or home office. Set up was relatively easy. It is wireless though you can use a cable if need be. It is quick and quiet. Print quality is good. I was thrilled with the auto duplex function. It is something I use frequently and a feature often missing from smaller, less expensive printers. The most annoying thing is stopping the automatic, unwanted cover page. This is something that can sour a user fast. You have to go on-line to do it and use the machine's serial number ax a password. Should be straightforward but it is not. Otherwise a great little printer.

title: Quick and Quiet
text: This is a capable little printer. It is compact and easy to set up. It performs competently. Print quality is good. It is quick and quiet. I love the wifi direct. Mobil printing could not be easier. It comes with a starter cartridge. This is the perfect printer for a small space.

title: Vintage Style
text: This is a lovely selection of stationery. There are six designs with coordinating envelopes. Three are flat cards and three are folded. They are all sepia colored. The style is vintage. The designs are whimsical. The card with a bee has a honeycomb pattern lining the envelope. The card with the manual typewriter has an envelope lined with what looks like old stamps from different destinations. The snail mail card has a snail and lines on the front kf the envelope instead of an interior pattern.Quality is excellent. Terrific set with fun vintage style.

title: Convenient
text: These cups are so convenient for home or office. I can never find a pen when I really need one. These solve that problem  Capacity is good. The black mesh is attractive. The base is smooth and won't mar the underlying surface. The cups are sturdy and steady. Great way to corral your pens. They neaten your desk and insure a pen will be there when you need it.

title: Sturdy
text: I use these classification folders in my civil files. They are decently constructed and durable. The metal portions are sturdy. Light blue outside they have a brown cardboard divider. While it would have been nice had the tabs been staggered it does not really make a difference in my usage.

title: Well Made
text: This office staple is well made of black metal mesh. It comes with the hardware to hang and mounting is simple. I was impressed that it also stands steady  by itself. Capacity is good and it performs as expected. Excellent product.

title: Well Made
text: This is a well made letter tray. Made of black metal mesh it is sturdy, attractive and functional. It comes with hardware for mounting. I was impressed that it stood steadily by itself. Mounting is straight forward. It is solid and perfect for any office.

title: Love the Small Size
text: This is a terrific little calculator. a solar hybrid, it is easy to use and easy to read. the compact size is perfect. It has basic functions. Ideal for school, home or the office, this calculator is handy.

title: Well Designed and Well Made
text: these folders are a terrific tool for organization. Essential in the office they are also great for home and school. They are sturdy and well made.  the fasteners are well placed and remain secure. The material is sturdy so you don't have to worry about tearing and breakage. great product.

title: Just Not Write
text: Parker is a name synonymous with fine writing instruments so I was looking forward to this rollerball pen. I like the idea of refillable pens, notwithstanding the leaky cartridge nightmares of my youth. This one arrived with a blue and silvertone pen. It has a clip and looks attractive. Expensive? No, but decent looking. The roller has a fine tip point. It started easily and the ink flowed nicely. My penmanship has always been bad, but the roller tip worked fine. My biggest problem was there were no direction and no matter how hard I tried I couldn't get it together in any sensible matter. I don't claim to be mechanically inclined but simple assemblies are within my abilities. Not this though. so essentially I have a pen casing and a refill. at least the refill portion writes.

title: Stack Well
text: These stackable trays are great. Made of light, coloured plastic they are letter-sized. They are easy to stack and just as simple to separate. I don't know an office that doesn't need a batch of these.

title: Cute
text: This cute card can serve as a decoration. It is nicely made and comes with a big, bright, red envelope. The detachable card is really nothing to get excited about. It is small and blank inside. It looks cuter on the main card. It took some doing to get my card to stand without falling over. It wasn't automatic. Still it is a cute card and fun once it is opened.

title: Art Deco Style
text: These New Years cards are quite lovely. the black, gold and cream are chic. The geometric pattern reminds me of the twenties and art deco It is stylized but approachable. The sentiment is nice without being overdone. the plain cream coloured envelope matches the cream of the cards perfectly. A thoughtful way to connect during the holiday season.

title: Standard files
text: These letter-size folders are standard office fare. they are light with tabs. You can write on the tabs or use labels (not included). Pale beige they adequately contain letter-sized documents. They perform satisfactorily.  They are a little thin and the tabs are prone to slight bends but they haven't torn. Decent for a pack of thirty-six.

title: Kissy Fishy
text: This card is sweet fun. The colors are pretty and the set up is simple. It is stable when standing and looks adorable. The sentiment, which is appropriately short and sweet, is one the back of the card. It is accompanied by a grey envelope. Lovely

title: Toast another Year
text: anyone who needs a good stiff drink to appreciate another year will get a kick out of this card. It is beautifully done with bright gold foil and a paper cutout drink that adds depth. The sentiment is light and appropriate. coIt comes with a grey envelope. Very Cute

title: Good for Storage
text: while not premium quality binders,s they will handle the job. Plain white they have clear pockets on the inside covers. The rings open smoothly and close securely. Lightweight, they seem a bit flimsy but the bindings hold. the covers are no completely smooth; they are not warped or bubbled but the plastic covering is not smooth and taut. It is like if you were pasting a piece of paper to something  and didn't do it evenly.  The lightness and covers don't impact my use which is primarily storage. Not a bad value for twelve. Don't know that they would hold up to heavy use but they are good for storage or lighter applications.  3.5 stars

title: For all Your Organizational Needs
text: this is a nice set of numeric index binders. the paper is a good weight and the pre-punched holes are reinforced. the colors are bright and vivid. Numbers go up to 31. They look attractive and are perfect for your organizational needs, whether for business, home or school.

title: Well Made
text: If you have a binder you should have these dividers. They are well made and should last with regular use. the tabs are brightly colored and it comes with two narrow sheets of plain white labels. The gold binding edge provides extra reinforcement while looking great. These will work well in any venue, school, home or office.

title: Great Organizational Tool
text: These tabs are well made. a great organizational tool, they feature reinforced holes, decent weight and bright colors. They are heavy enough to last without ripping or tearing.  the six-pack is a good way to have plenty on hand. These are terrific for school, home or office. Very pleased.

title: Hold It
text: Made of sturdy black plastic this pocket will hold documents securely. It provides two ways to hang: screws or double-sided tape. it is nice to have options. The tape will allow mounting without the permanence of screws. It is a help to corral papers in the office or use at home to hold incoming/outgoing mail. It hangs securely is sturdy and relatively unobtrusive. Nice product.

title: Ideal for HOme Use
text: This is a very pretty desk calendar/blotter. The small, slim size makes it ideal for home or office. It works well on smaller desks. The lined boxes enhance neatness and provide economical use of space. the floral border is attractive. The pages are perforated and easily removed. There are plastic pieces which hold the pages securely. There are two holes at the top permitting the calendar to be hung or tacked up if desired. Mine was not missing any pages.  Nice for a smaller calendar.

title: Keeps Cards Handy
text: who hasn't gone to a networking event and come away with a slew of cards? but then when you need one you can't find it. this convenient book is the solution. (The copy says it is a two-pack; I received only one.)( The inside front has pockets. There are plastic holders for cards. the cards slide in easily and remain in place until you remove them. The cover is durable PU. It isn't especially impressive to look at but it is adequately constructed and does the job.

title: Good for Business
text: This planner is perfect for business. the cover is a sober black. It has tabs and the layout is clear and easy to follow. The smaller size makes it simple to tuck in a bag or briefcase. while there is not quite as much room as a full-sized binder it is sufficient to jot down dates, notes and whatnot. There are three pages in the back for notes. Good quality with a good spiral binding. No complaints.

title: good Planner, Bad Binding
text: Had the binding been good this would have easily been a four or five-star product. the layout is terrific and it is perfect for business. However, the spiral binding on mine arrived unattached at the bottom. I squeezed it in only to have it pop back out. It is virtually impossible to repair and as is the wires catch on everything. too bad because it ruins an otherwise well-designed planner.

title: Chic Cover
text: If you are looking for a full-featured compact planner you won't go wrong with this one. the cover is chic and it is easy to use. while it doesn't have the space of a full-sized planner there is sufficient room to jot down dates and notes. There is a plastic pocket. the layout is nice and includes weekly and monthly views and five pages in the back for notes. Great little planner.

title: Pretty way to stay Organized
text: This pretty planner makes it easy to stay organized. the vibrant floral cover is protected by a sheet of plastic. there are no pockets. The layout is easy to navigate. There is plenty of room to write in. The spiral binding is secure. No pockets, but otherwise a perfect planner.

title: Good for School or Clubs
text: If you are expecting a full-sized planner you will be disappointed. this is a slim binder insert. As such it is fine but that should have been made clear in the copy. It is just over thirty pages if you include the cover.  Each month has a two-page layout with unlined blocks. At the back are three lined pages for notes. In the front is a yearly overview consisting of 2020 and 2021 calendars. There is a page for contacts, important dates and weekly goals. The cover is pleasant if innocuous. It is a multi-coloured geometric design that is unisex. It is nice (if overpriced) for what it is. Helpful as an insert for school or clubs but a disappointment if you are looking for a traditional planner.

title: Well Made & Attractive
text: This pretty planner is easy to use. the layout is sensible and easy to follow. There are monthly tabs and a separate plastic pocket. Holidays are duly noted and lines make writing easy. the paper is decent and there are places for contacts and notes. There are reference calendars. well made and attractive this is a useful planner.

title: Pretty Personal Planner
text:
this is a nice personal planner. There is a clear plastic cover that protects the cardboard one with pretty patterned tile design. spiral bound it will lie flat when you need it to. It begins with a section on setting goals .therre are about seven pages in the back for note-taking. It contains the usual information: holidays, etc. and provides nicely defined weekly and monthly spreads.

It seems to be well made but the inclusion of inspirational quotes, goal setting and checklists, make it more appropriate as a personal planner, something for a student or home worker. The paper is nice and it seems reasonably durable. there are no pockets or lunar phases but overall it is an attractive way to keep on track.

title: Pretty & Practical
text: This is a very pretty calendar. The smaller size is perfect for home use. The rose border is lovely. The perforated. pages are held in place by plastic corners. There are two holes so you could hang the planner up if so desired. The squares are lightly lined which makes for a neater, more efficient use of space. Pretty, practical and nice quality desk calendar.

title: Old School Elegance
text: Penmanship was never my strong suit in elementary school and I was more than happy to discard my leaky fountain pens for ballpoints and my ballpoints for keyboards. being left-handed in a right-handed world didn't help either. but since then I've developed an appreciation for the elegance and style of a good fountain pen. Parker is a name synonymous with fine writing utensils. this kit has everything you need to renew or begin a love affair with fountain pens. the pen itself is handsome; it looks elegant. The instructions were helpful. Initially, I had some difficulty getting it going and flowing but after a couple of rough starts, everything came together. It is still fussy and my initial efforts rather smudgy.  My preference is still for the keyboard but you can't beat the style and old-time elegance of signing legal documents with a fountain pen.

title: All-Occasion Cuteness
text: Your favorite bubble tea fanatic will be thrilled with this card. The sentiment is sweet and it really can serve as an all-occasion greeting. There is enough room to write a personal note if desired. The stock is nice and it is very cute. It is accompanied by a plain white envelope

title: Magical Indeed
text: these are cute and cheery cards perfect for a general holiday greeting. the unicorn is adorable. The glitter on the horn stays secure: it does not scatter all over. the cards are small. The envelopes are white with branding on the back. A cute way to remember acquaintances during the holidays.

title: Smiles Guaranteed
text: If these cards dot put a smile on someone's face I don't know what will. The graphics are adorable and the situations funny. my favorite was the one with the glass of red wine arguing with a cup of coffee about who was the favorite. the other three are the cat treadmill (cats shredding rolls of tp), unicorns missing Noah's ark and a pug trying to hide his excitement at a good hand at cards. The cards are made of decent stock. the envelopes are plain white and rather thin. Fun collection.

title: Excellent Magnets
text: The magnets in this kit are the best. They are powerful and stay put. The badges when completed are sealed. they are impossible to alter or amend so keep that in mind if you are hoping to reuse. The paper is standard and templates are available. They don't look professional but they don't look homemade or amateurish either. The plastic is clear and depending on your design/layout skills, they can be fairly striking. Pricey for what you get but overall a satisfactory product.

title: Smart Design
text: Smartly designed this clipboard features tiers for easy storage. The bottlm tier has a compartment which will hold pens and pencils. The upper tier can hold forms. I love that it can accomodate legal sized papers. The clip is sturdy and hold paper securely. It is lightweight and constructed of very thin metal. Not sure how long it will ladt but I am impressed with the design.

title: Brand Name Quality
text: I love my Brother laser printers but i hate paying a premium for brand name toner. This is an affordable option. It installs simply and performs well. Print quality is excellent virtually identical to the brand name. Completely satisfied.

title: Cheers
text: This is a cute card for the right person. The interior is a pretty pink. The interior of the envelope has gold lines. Not the most clever or witty but a fun way to toast your vino loving pal.

title: Beautfiul cover, Damaged Box, Dirty Pages
text: I love journals and use them frequently. I was so looking forward to this one but was highly disappointed. Crafty is one thing; dirty is another. The box it came in was damaged with splitting seams. both the exterior and the interior were dirty. My hopes were buoyed as the cover of the journal is beautiful. It is leather and features a nice rendition of the tree of life. there is a rawhide strap which serves both as a bookmark and a tie to keep the book shut. The pages are thick unlined paper. Construction for the book is odd. It is like booklets of blank pages were sewn into the cover. this makes it somewhat difficult to use and impossible for the book to stay open. Unfortunately, many of the pages were also dirty. The journal is accompanied by a kind of cool beaded pen. it writes and has purple ink. There is also a sheet about the company. They donate a percentage of their profits to a charity in India. The pages are not refillable.

title: Great Set
text: this is a terrific set. It includes two lanyards, two retractable holders with a clip on the back for keys or id, two faux leather id holders and a black velveteen drawstring pouch. The components are well made and sturdy. I have gone through many lanyards/holders/keyrings and this one is clearly superior in quality.  Nice set that looks like it will last.

title: We Three Kings
text: this lovely card is perfect for Christmas or for celebrating Little Christmas (feast of the Epiphany). It is dramatic with gold metallic Wiseman accented with gold glitter against a rich dark blue background., The sentiment is meaningful and focuses on the religious significance of the holiday. The envelope is white with the flap decorated with gold stars., The front has an italicized "To" in gold. The card has plenty of interior white space with which the giver can write a note. It is nicely made with stock that feels good in the hands. However, the glitter sheds and gets all over the place. Other than that a wonderful religious card.

title: Makes Fillign Forms Easier
text: This is a six-pack of nice lightweight clipboards. The silver-grey surface is smooth and easy to write on. The clip is adequate. It holds securely and is easy to open and close. It is easy for clients to fill out forms and light enough to transport to a work site. They come nicely packaged to prevent marring and are covered with a thin plastic that peels off. good product.

title: Office Essentials
text: this is a handy set for the office. It contains three hard white plastic trays. Two are letter-sized; the smaller is for accessories. There are ridges on the bottom which will probably attach to other items in this line. You can place them on top of each other so technically they do stack but they don't lock in place or attach. Still a necessity. They can be used in a drawer or on the desk itself. They seem reasonably sturdy and well made.

title: Great for a Co-worker
text: This card is especially appropriate for a co-worker. the colors are vivid and the sentiment apropos. The inside of the envelope has gold lines, a fun and thoughtful effect. It is well made of high-quality stock. Great way to say happy birthday.

title: Nice Except for Scratched Mirror
text: this is a nice little locker kit. It includes a metal mesh shelf, a magnetic mesh cup, a magnetic memo board with a magnetic pen, 6 decorative magnets and a magnetic mirror. all the pieces were well made and attractive except for the mirror. It was badly scratched and for all intents and purposes useless. My favourite piece is the cup. It is convenient, holds well and has good capacity. Great set for school or even work. Just get another mirror.

title: Pretty Card with Sweet Sentiment
text: This is a lovely card with an appropriate sentiment. The paper feels nice and the red glitter adds a special touch of sparkle. Although it is deemed "religious" and does make reference to the Lord, it does not pummel you with belief. It is actually very sweet. The reference to the Lord puts ii squarely in Christian camp but I can't imagine anyone being offended by the mild reference and charming sentiment. In any event, it is accompanied by a red envelope. Pretty card with an equally lovely sentiment.

title: Thank You For Being a Friend
text: What a great way to give a friend a boost. These five cards are contemporary but fun. Each is well made with some crafty touches. The styles range from bold to sweet. The fox and hedgehog have a touch of sparkle, the peanut butter and jelly jars are raised. The interior sentiments are appropriate. The set comes with five bright aqua envelopes. Well made and thoughtful.

title: Good Things Come in Small(er Packages
text: I love this compact laser printer. Set up was a snap. It comes with an old school cd. I set it up wirelessly and had no issues. It can also be set up via USB or ethernet. It is fast and includes duplex printing. Multifunction it also scans and copies. I do wish it had the automatic Document feed for copying and scanning but it is not a deal-breaker. Balck and white copies are, as expected, clear and sharp. color copies are quite good also. They are not the professional high-resolution photos you get with a  photo inkjet printer but for purposes more than acceptable. The quality of laser printing has advanced over the year. It still is not as good as black and white but is certainly acceptable. It comes with starter toner' regular toner cartridges are priced on a par with competitors. This printer is speedy and relatively quiet. I am quite pleased with the quality and performance of this unit. Well done.

title: for the Single Ladies
text: Don't have a honey? that's okay. Send a thoughtful card to your gal pals the day before Valentine's Day. This card is very pretty with just a touch of sparkle. The sentiment is appropriate and a nice way to remind someone they matter, paired or not.

title: Easy to Assemble
text: I am picky with chairs. I have lower back issues and uncomfortable chair makes me a grump. This one immediately got on my good side with the ease of assembly. While I prefer directions with words or words and pictures, this one came with pictorial directions. Easy enough to follow and I got it assembled in about forty minutes. The chair adjusts easily and glides smoothly. The seat cushion is adequately padded and firm The ventilated back is cooling. overall this is an attractive, functioning and comfortable office chair.

title: Puts the Fun in Functional
text: These felt tip pens are boon for kids or anyone with hand issues. the triangle barrel is easy to hold and comfortable to grip. It permits decent control. The felt tip rights clearly. the colors are fun. Very helpful for kids who are learning penmanship. These have also become my mother's favorites. she suffered a stroke which impacted her ability to write. she is slowly developing enough strength and control thanks to these. Nicely made, write smoothly and easy to handle.

title: No Problems
text: the price of brand name toner is outrageous., This one works well with My Brother L2550. It has the chip and installs just like the original. Prints fine and has been working well.

title: Weird Luvs Crazy
text: these are cheap keychains. I guess if you find your partner weird or crazy and they feel the same about you, this will amuse. It is not well made, like something you find in the dollar store. The piece that holds the puzzle piece already came loose. Not impressed.

title: Support & Comfort
text: I go through office chairs at an alarming rate. although I wasn't excited about the prospect of assembling yet another one, this one is actually far better than I expected. Assembly was straightforward and completed in less than an hour. I detest assembly but everything need was included and the pictorial directions was simple to follow. The chair itself is easy to manipulate and the adjustments are hassle-free. It is comfortable and provides superlative support. I have lower back issues as a result of a serious motor vehicle accident. I can sit in this chair pain-free for hours. In addition to being supportive, the mesh back keeps you cool and dry. Overall an impressive office chair at an exceedingly reasonable price.

title: Great Performance Affordably
text: I love my Brother laser printer but the cost of a single cartridge is more than what I paid for the printer. this is an affordable option that works as well as the pricey brand name toner. It works exactly the same and I have encountered no problems with use. the print quality is on a par with the more expensive version. I'ms happy and my budget is too.

title: Excellent in the Kitchen
text: I didn't know how much I needed these until I used them. the cards are a good size so you are not squinting to see. They are resistant to splatters, spills and greasy fingers. They are sturdy. I, personally, do not like to use a tablet in a kitchen. It is one thing to have to replace a book or sheet or paper, far more expensive and annoying to replace electronics. These work well and are an ingenious way of saving favourite recipes.

title: Filedwork Essential
text: Compact and sturdy this belt bag is a must-have if you do fieldwork for school or work. the zippers are strong but function smoothly without catching or snagging. It stows the necessities safely and securely. It has a loop to attach to belts or may be clipped on gear. It stows easily in a glove compartment or bag when not in use. Very helpful and well made.

title: Super Fun Stool
text: when I don't want to use my standing desk I rely on this wobble stool to strengthen the core. It is easy to adjust and is surprisingly comfortable. it is not slippery. the bright green color is fun. It does need weight to depress so it is perfect for older kids and adults. the whole stool swivels, not just the top part. that is unlike many stools it is not the top /seat that rotates independently. The whole stool turns. that being said they are stable and don't skid around. surprisingly sturdy they are very well made and a sneaky way to make sitting healthier.

title: Good Organizational Tool
text: This is a terrific way to keep track of schedules. It has sufficient room to write, is reversible and erasable. It comes with a wet erase marker. do not substitute a dry erase one when the original dry out. Easy enough to clean, just wipe with Windex. so far I am pleased with this calendar.

title: Good & Sturdy
text: Perfect for on-site jobs this book is sturdy and durable. The yellow cover makes it visible and the blue and red lines are excellent. The paper is strong and waterproof. it is handy and small enough to carry in a pocket or bag. Great book if you have to do filed work.

title: Ideal for Business or School
text: This is the perfect binder for business or school. It is plain and sturdy. well made, the design of the rings allow s the pages to lie flat. capacity is up to 350 pages. the rings open easily and close securely. There are transparent pockets inside It is sturdy and can withstand bumps and drops without damage. Not flashy but does the job and does it well.

title: Streamlines the Process
text: If your business is required to give FMLA ( Family and Medical Leave Act ) notices, this kit streamlines the process. it includes 10 of each of mandatory employee notice, employee FMLA leave request form, company response - eligibility, company response - designation, medical Certification - employee, medical Certification - family member, military Certification - exigency, military Certification - injury/illness, and FMLA leave tracker. the instructions are adequate and they are simple enough to complete. the penalties can be harsh for failing to comply with these regulations. Have your attorney/HR director double check for any mandated changes. but overal this kit is a time saver. it helps make the process understandable for employees and employers.

title: Decent Set
text: Whether training is required by insurance or you just want a safety refresher, this CD set should do the trick. One Cd contains reproducible materials including a training manual, quiz and answer key, log and certificate.  The training Cd covers the basics clearly and is only a bit over a half hour long. Experienced workers will engage in some eye rolling but cutting corners can lead to costly accidents. Overall a decent set.

title: Practical Fun
text: trolls lovers, rejoice. This fun binder is a colorful change from basic black. the cover is fun with vivid colors and an engaging sentiment. The binder itself is very nice. It seems sturdy. The rings open easily and shut securely. It holds a maximum of 175 pages and has interior pockets for additional storage. Practical and fun.

title: Encouraging Message; Standard Binder
text: This binder is distinguished by the bright and colorful cover and the encouraging sentiment. Otherwise, it is a fairly standard binder, fine for regular use. It opens easily and closes securely. It holds a maximum of 175 pages. It is not heavy duty but should be fine for average uses. The sentiment is delightful, encouraging and positive and it functions as expected. 3.5 stars

title: Year At A Glance
text: This great big calendar lets you view the whole year. It is erasable and reasonably durable. I like to keep paper copies of schedules at work and at home. digital calendars are great but it is nice to have something like this. Makes scheduling simple. the price point gives me pause but it is a worthwhile way to keep track of everyone and everything.

title: Tight Fit
text: this would be perfect for the right person. but unfortunately, that isn't me. It is nicely made and I love the purple color. It is different but still appropriate for both business and personal use. My difficulty is that the dimensions are just a little too small for my devices and needs. My phone and tablet can be squeezed in but it tight takes effort to insert and remove. Similarly, it doesn't easily accommodate the paper sizes I commonly use US letter or legal. Legal is out fo the question but letter should fit. Still, it appears to be reasonably durable.  the magnetic closure works securely; the clip and pen loops are adequate. 3.5 stars

title: How Santa Gon on the Naughty List
text: as a seasonal novelty, this twerking Santa is silly fun. His movements are definitely giggle-inducing. Larger than expected he is made of fleece and plastic. His expression is goofy but the movement is hysterical. a few things I wasn't crazy about. First, batteries are NOT included. this is one of my pet peeves. Secondly, the battery compartment is a screw on which adds a level of unnecessary inconvenience. Finally the song. Why? It is not a Christmas song, it is in Spanish, Santa's movements do not much the rhythm. Finally, the switch is a bit finicky. Still it is entertaining enough to take its place next to the pet dog antlers, light up Christmas ball necklaces, ugly Christmas sweaters and singing grinches. 3.5 stars

title: Resistance is Futile
text: Who can resist Snoopy and Woodstock? This is a cute card, the perfect way for kids to remember their grandparents on Valentine's Day. the card is nicely made with appropriate colors and recognizable characters. the sentiment is appropriate without being schmaltzy or syrupy. a coordinating envelope is included.

title: Love The Lever
text: I love the lever arch oopening. It is smooth and intuitive. Easy to open it closes securely. The binder is sturdy and looks professional. an adhesive lable is included for the spine. Capacity is generous and the reinforced edges enhance durability. Great binder.

title: Pineapple Pen
text: This actually is a lovely pen. It writes well and is comfortable to hold. But it is the style that sets it apart. goldtone, it is topped with a crystal pineapple. Very pretty, very different and fun. I especially liked that there are refills. The pen is easy to fill and it writ4es smoothly without skipping or hesitating. Lovely pen that adds a touch of elegance and makes the writer feel special.

title: Homespun Charm
text: this board has loads of rustic charm. The rough hewn wood looks great. The blackboard portion is also quite rough. This contriubtes to a rather homey print, that, in my opinion, limits its usefulness. You have to go over the letters/numbers etc multiple times. The writing,d espite best efforts doesn't look polished. Goes a bit smoother with liquid chalk than with the standard. If that homey look is what you are going for this is a terrific board. But if you were looking for something smoother and more sophisticated, look elsewhere. Assembly is easy and straightforward. I wold have liked it better had the slate been smooth. But it does have a lot of homespun charm.

title: Heartwarming Snowman
text: This is the type of card you send to a collector. It is equal parts keepsake and Christmas card. the graphic is fun with a cheery snowman. It sets up easily and more importantly it stays standing and stable. Fun and festive it can be displayed all season long.  Well made it comes with a coordinating envelope and does require extra postage if mailing. Perfect for a person who loves the holidays and saves christmas cards.

title: Fun Frame
text: This is a fun frame of a kid's room or a dorm room. You can display both pictures and messages making for an interesting collage. The photo overlays are plastic not glassand the overaqll quality does not impress. the finish looks weathered though not necessarily intentiionally so. Even so it is easy to use and hang. It is a fun memory display that encourages creativity and versatility. 3.5 stars

title: Perfect Planner
text: This planner is terric. well made it features generous writing space and an intelligent layout. The cover is strong and the white floral pattern is striking against the black. The paper is strong and it is well designed the monthly tabs are convenient and the sprial binding is secure with no wires coming loose.. Would have been nice if there were pockets on the front and back covers but that is not a deal breaker. This is the perfect planner for personal or professional use.

title: Heavy Duty
text: These heavy duty sharpies work on a number of surfaces making them great for construction projects and other outdoor/exposed activities. The rectangular barrel is comfortable and the point writes clearly. There are two black, on e blue and  one red in the set. the colors are true and the ink is permanent. I appreciated the lanyard loop on the cap. It makes it easy to keep track of the pen.Great porduct for home or work.

title: Mailer with a Tropoical Motif
text: Who can resist pink flamingoes? Or Zebras? Or tropical greenery? Not me for sure. These mailers are fun. The plastic is strong as is the self seal adhesive strip. there is no padding so they are best used for non breakable items or as an interior wrap. A sure way to brighten up one's day.

title: Stunning
text: These Christmas cards are gorgeous. the stock is lovely. the Christmas tree is studded with faux gems and the base has well affixed glitter. the saying is appropriate. The enveloopes are exquisite: red exterioir lined with gold foil. Truly an exceptional box of cards.

title: Perfect Planner
text: The best laid plans will come to fruition with ths beautiful planner. It is large and intelligently designed. Easy to use there is plenty of room to write and convenient . The paper is high quality with good weight. Spiral bound, this planners wires seem secure and unlikely to come loose. It is attractive without being overdone. Ideal for either personal or professional use it is the perfect planner.

title: Big Plans Require a Big Planner
text: got plans? You need this planner. It is oversized with plenty of room to write . the paper is nice and the graphics are pretty without being too much. The layout is terrific. There is no skimping on sapce. the only thing I wasn't in love with was the stock from which the cover was created. Not all that durable and doesn't feel nice to the touch. Stil and attractive, oversized planner.4.5 stars

title: Made Me Happy
text: Thi s is a fun card for the right person. The mesage is succinct and ure to turn a frown upide down. It is a small card and doen't look or feel expensive. But it is cute nonetheles and a usre way to brighten someone's day.

title: Love the Tabs
text: I've always been a fan of At-A -Glance planners for their organizational quality. it is easy to use, follow and plan without being unduly fussy. This planner is much like a spiral bound notebook. The striped cover looks at home both in the office and at home. There is a lastic pocket in the front which is useful and conenient. I love the tabs; they make kthings super siimpel and accessible. I really hae no complaints about this planner and expect it will get me through the upcoming year.

title: Basic & Good
text: These are basic composition books. they are satisfactory in all respects. The binding is secure so pages coming loose and falling out is not a worry. The pages are lined and the spacing is comfortable.The front inside cover hasa schedule and the back inside cover has the usual convrsion tables. I do wish the coers were a tad firmer but they are more than adequate. Good books at fair price.

title: contemporary Cards for Old Fashioned Thoughtfulness
text: Writing a thank you note may seem old fashioned in this digital age but it is sure to strike a chord with the recipient. This box of ten notes and coordinating envelopes is contemporary and stylish. The gold accents are lovely and add to a crisp, chic appeasrance. The cards are blank inside. Made of quality stock, they look and feel impressive. Perfect for both business and personal use, this is a nice set to have on hand.

title: Celebrating Baby's First Holidays
text: these are dorable cards that commemorate holidays occuring through a baby's first year. the graphics are bright and pretty and the sentiments are cute and affectionate. Een though the baby won't remember the card at that tender age it will be a wonderfl addition to a memory book or box.The cards are nicely made of quality stock, cleer design and thoughtful sayings. Coordinating enelopes are included.

title: Cards of Encouragement
text: thi sis as fun collection of cards with messages of encouragement. they are hip and uplifting. The graphics are fun nd the sayings do the job without being sappy or saccharin.That being said these aren't college specific. They would be terrific for anyone who needs a piock me up, a pat on the back, a pep talk or some reassurance. The cards are constructed from nice quality stock and coordinaating colored envelopes are included.

title: Lovely Acknowledgment in Times of Grief
text: these are loely thank you notes designed for expressions of appreciation during sad times. the bouquet is soft and beautiful. The stock has a high quality look and feel. The inside is bland with space for a personal message. Attractive and considerateway to acknowledge throughfulness druing times of loss and grief. Envelopes included. Set of twenty.

title: Understasted Elegance
text: In this digital world letter writing is a lost art. But rally who doesn't love getting a short personal note in the mail? these notecards are made of nice quality paper. The gold accents contribute a luxurious feel.they are understated but elegant. A lovely way to drop a few lines of appreciation to a friend.

title: From Duels to Duets
text: this is a simple way to keep track of two people's schedules. It has the standard At A Glance format that is easy to use and read. You can use it for two people or for one person with two schedules, i.e., work and school, job and home. the paper is decent quality and there is adequate room. The book is heavy so it is likely it will be kept at a location as opposed to being lugged around. I do wishs the weekend days were not abbreviated. Weekends can be as busy as weekdays and this planner focuses on the classic workdays. Other than that it is a sturdy book and a good way to transform dueling schedules into duets.

title: Excellent for Small Offices
text: thi sis an excellent way to keep track of multiple schedules for home or office. It expands the classic At A Glance format for  four people. there is plenty of room, the format is straightforward and the paper is decent. It is a sturdy book. However it is thick nd best left in the office  . Helps keep track of everyone.

title: Monkey Do
text: This is a fun way to prop open a lighter door. the monkey seems well made and is weighted. No so successful on heavier doors but is fine for most of the doors inside my home. He is adorable although people frequently think he is a bear. In any event he is full of impish charm and does get the job done.

title: Key to My Sanity
text: With an active household someone is always misplacing a key. This box is quickly proving to be the key to my sanity. Small but sturdy it is easy to mount. It has spaces for twenty keys nd includes colored tags for identification. the box itself locks making it ideal for business or commercial use. I installed it at home and it is a stress buster for sure making rushed ornings drama free. I like it enough that I am getting one  for my office.

title: Handy
text: This is a handy book. It is small but large enough to transport and use with ease. The hard cover helps with storage and I especially appreciated the water re sistant paper. One side  contains columns; the other graphs. They don't have much capacity but overall are a help.

title: Celebrating the Person & The Pet
text: This is a fun way to welcome a friend's new canine companion. The card stock is nice. The design is cute and the colors bright and cheerful. I loed the pawprints on the inside of the envelope. The sentiment is appropriate and overalal it is a thoughtful way to celebrate both the person and the pet.

title: Small But Adequate
text: This binder is lightweight. It's capacity is small but the rings oopen and shut easily. It does lie flat. It is customizable but the lastic that covered mine was wrinkled and bubbled. Additionally the back cover was slightly bent. It functions as esxpected and is good for small storage or at times when only a small capacity is needed.

title: Fun Collection
text: This cute collection of cards need not be limited to kids. The designs and sayings are appropriate for all age groups. The designs are coorful and the sentiments light and sweet. My fasvorite was the line up of dachshunds on wheels. the qulaity is more than adequate and these cards asre uniformly charming. Easy way to convey birthday greetings.

title: Quality Notebook for Sports Fans
text: This is a good quality all around notebook with a sports motif. My cover was the football. the notebook itself has everything you need. There is a two sided manilla folder in the front with a pocket on each side. The ruled pages are perforated for easy tearing. The three holes make it easy to place in a binder. Quality is consistently good and the cover makes it fun for sports fans of all ages.

title: Like the Gold Border
text: I really like the look of the gold border. It does asdd a luxurious stouch although it limits the space for printing. Ifind it best to handwrite on these. The border shape also lends itself to more social and casual functions. The adhesive is good. It remains on clothes and removes easily without leaving behind residue or damage. Obviosuly these hsould not be used on delicate fabrics. Oerall, reallynice name tags.

title: Large & Light
text: This is a decent laptop table. It is versatile and can be used for other things. The asdjustable description pertains to the tilt of the table not to any ability to vary the length of the legs. They are either upright or folded. That being said it is wide enough to accomodate my 17 inch laptop. It is comfortable to use in bed. Well made it seems reasonably sturdy and I am liking it more and more.

text: As a phone, this one is impressive. it is easy to set up and the clarity is excellent. the controls are not only easy to read but easy to use.I liked that this system is expandable. you can have up to five handsets and up to 500 sensors. and therein lies the rub. this phone does not come with any of the sensors. I was most interested in the motion sensor but unwilling to pay the price. the sensor alone ranges from $46.-$69. If you are interested in the wired monitoring it is far most cost efficient to buy the phone bundled with the sensors.As of this writing you can get a bundled system for ten or twenty dollars more than the price of this one. so it strikes me as sily to purchase this and then have to pay more than half the asking price for a simple sensor. I will be waiting until the sensor prices go down and will update my review accordingly. If you are just looking for a phone system, this one works well in all respects. I've had V-tech systems before and they have been reliable. the voice mail, caller id, etc all function well. It is a solid system. But if you want to use it for home monitoring and don't have money to burn, get one of the bundled systems. .

title: Makes the Pint and Makes It Well
text: A laser pointer should not be more complicated than your presentation. this one is terrific.  Small and portable, it is easy to set up. Insert the two AAA batteries (included). Insert the dongle into your laptop and you are good to go. No fussy installation or downloads required. The controls are easy to use. There is a laser indicator, a battery indicator, The laser pointer button, a forward/back button,  blank/dark screen and launch slide show. the dongle stores on the pointer when not in use. The pointer produces a strong, rich red light that is easy to see. The package includes a convenient little drawstring bag to carry the pointer. it is light enough to tuck in a pocket the user's guide is fairly useless, just a four page leaflet with illustrations and text in English and Spanish. But the pointer is terrific and a real help when using PowerPoint and making presentations. There is a one year limited warranty.

title: Visual Deterrent
text: These plastic seals serves a visual deterrents. the red is quite vivid, impossible to miss. they are relatively thin. the six inch stem threads through the cap to lock . there are nine different positions so you can accommodate different sizes. They are very easy to break off so these will not stop an even mildly motivated thief. However you will notice immediately if they have been tampered with. We are using them as a "hands off"marker on some of the wheeled carts that everyone wants to grab in the greenhouse. They also work well to secure cabinets.

title: Robo Cop
text:
This phone is like Robo cop to robocalls. the set includes three phones, two charging bases and answering base, quick start guide, abridged owner's manual and a wall mount. the keypad is backlit, the screen and buttons easy to read and to use. However in order to get the full benefit of this system you really have toread the directions. and that can be daunting. I downloaded the complete manual and the block call pdf from the website and am glad I did. It is not complicated but the volume of material is daunting. I am using this system at home where my mother is recuperating from a stroke. There are some automated calls like her medical reminders and pharmacy notifications that I wanted to come through. this is possible .I do think they could streamline the instructions. This is really one system where you really have to use the instructions.

That being said, the system works well. Unwanted calls don't get through.sound quality is good and battery life is about average. The phones can be used as walkie talkies which is helpful on those days my mother remains in bed. I do wish there was a message indicator light and sometimes the answering system records dead air (no one talking). But overall it is a good system that has terminated those pesky robocalls.

title: Plastic Beats Paper
text: I work in a law office and although we do't do much civil work, we do some. Folder organization varies and our civil documents are hole punched from the top. These dividers are terrific. Made of sturdy polyethylene they have five pre-punched holes on top. At the base are tabs. One side is preprinted with medical labels. But the other side is blank. You can with paste a label over the pre-printed portion or do what I did and just reverse them.(The reverse side also does not have the logo square in the middle of the page.) The poly material wipes clean. The colors are vivid and make it easy to locate what you need when you are in court. They are wellmade and can be re-used. They are standard sized 8.5 x 11. They come with a three year warranty.I am very impressed  by their attractive appearance and how well they withstand frequent handling. Although more expensive they are of significantly  higher quality than their paper counterparts and provide extended use. I am a convert.

title: Notebook Done Better
text: You can tell this notebook is special at first glance. The gold edged pages suggest something special inside. There is a tonal elastic to keep it securely shut and an attached cloth bookmark. There is a pen/pencil holder attached. It is a relatively small and slim volume measuring 8.3 x 5. 8 ".It contains only 160 lined pages. On the top of each page is a black and white picture which may be colored. There are twenty different illustrations ranging from cacti to a citiscape. If you enjoy coloring, these will provide you with a relaxation break. I am actually a doodler and am not polite enough to color nicely and stay in the margins. My doodles are my own, not some one else's.That being said this is a fun notebook. it has plenty of special touches and i am especially enamoured of the gold edged pages. The cover is vegan leather and I for one am glad that no cows died for this notebook. I do wish there was variety in the paper, perhaps some blank pages as well as the lined ones. the pages are not perforated although I supposed you could tear them out if you wanted. A delightful journal with a fun twist.

title: Basic Printer with Super Sized Ink Tanks
text:
Frustrated with the high price of ink, I replaced my office ink jets with a few inexpensive laser printers. They represented a major savings with actually a slight improvement in black and white printing. But I must admit I did miss color printing and photos but really couldn't justify the cost. Enter the era of the EcoTank all in one. Two years of ink up front? Yes, please.

The printer itself is a fairly plain cube. Nothing wrong with that. When it comes to office machinery I prefer function over form. Set up was hassle free. You can opt to do it with a USB cable (not included) or wirelessly. I did wireless and encountered no problems. I was concerned that filling up the ink tanks would be messy but it wasn't. The bottles are designed well and you won't be able to put the wrong colored ink in the wrong tank. They also have a valve system which doesn't let the ink flow until it is attached to the printer. the tanks take a good ten minutes to charge. The software is okay and the instructions are easy enough to follow. Print quality is good. black and white was crisp and colors came out nicely. While photos were not shop quality, they were as good as pretty much any other ink jet printer. for standard printing speed was average. I did think photo printing was slow though. Copying and scanning however were excellent. although during regular printing the machine was noisy, scanning and copy was both quiet and fast. It can fax but since I do all my faxing via the internet I did not try this feature.

That being said, there are some things I don't like. first off there are no paper trays. You load paper in a chute. Standard paper drawers not only provide protection but also greater capacity than this chute system. The printer itself is very basic and I have come to value the ADF and automatic duplex printing..

Essentially this is a basic printer with big ink capacity. And for my purposes that is enough. It is not something I would use for work where speed matters and advanced features are essential. Itis a cost effective way to print in color and I do that primarily at home and for my hobbies and smaller hobby business. Hopefully the supersized ink tans will convert into super sized savings. I

title: Capable
text:
this all in one is a good solution for small to medium offices. set up was relatively simple and the printer is a compact cube that is neither to heavy nor too big. I liked the generous capacity. The two trays hold 250 pages each for a total of 500. It can accommodate specialty stock and up to ten number ten envelopes at any given time. Print quality is very good. The colors are vibrant and the black sharp. Printing is pretty quick and somewhat noisy. It supports wif-fi and NFC.

There are, however, some things I don't like. First, the AFd is not capable of duplex scanning. That means you have to manually scan two sided documents. this is annoying and can be time consuming when you need to scan, copy or fax multi page documents. I don't like the four cartridge system. It is outdated and expensive. If you run out of black ink the printer will mix the colors for a short period so you can still print in black. They do have high capacity cartridges. They are worth the extra expense as the output is significantly more than the regular ones. Still the price of ink is ridiculous. finally the warranty is only a year. You can purchase an extended warranty but usually it is cheaper and easier just to buy a whole new printer.

If you have moderate output, this is a capable printer with some nice features. I appreciated the ease of set up, the speed and capacity. The printing was uniformly good and I had not problems with the performance of the machine. But the cartridges are pricey and the warranty is only a year. The lack of an automatic duplex function is annoying. but overall, it is a welcome tool in my small office.

title: Flock to these Posters
text: These bird posters are arresting. the clarity and color are absolutely stunning and make for an eye catching presentation in a classroom. the stock is heavy and the finish glossy..  They are sturdy and work well as both a teaching aid and  as decoration.  Included are chicken,  duck, eagle,flamingo,  gull, ostrich, owl, parakeet,parrot,  pelican, and quail.

title: Nicely Made, thoughtfully Desinged
text: this is a terrific board for commercial, educational or even residential use. I like the sturdy aluminum frame. It comes with a mounting kit. depending on your space limitations  you can mount it vertically or horizontally. Putting it up is not a hassle and it has a nice, clean, streamlined appearance. It also has a tray  to keep pens and erasers handy. When the first surface becomes worn, you can extend its life by switching it over and using the other side. It is nicely made and thoughtfully designed.

title: Perfect for Your One Of  A Kind
text: What a terrific card. the expression on the dog's face is priceless and the saying funny. It is appropriately pink for a feminine live wire. The stock is nice and it is accompanied with a bright pink envelope. Perfect for your one of a kind daughter.

title: A Card A Mother Will Love
text: This is a pretty card that is sweet without being saccharin. The cover design is pretty with a rhinestone and a touch of glitter. It is definitely not overdone and the restraint  is refreshing. The purple ribbon is pretty especially if you r mom likes purples. I thought it was a tad dark but certainly not a deal breaker.  It is traditional with contemporary touches that make it less formal. It comes with a lavender colored envelope.

title: Oddly Awesome
text: The paper is nice and heavy. The photo of the sloth is clear and oddly intense. The hot pink interior brightens the whole enterprise and the sentiment is fun. You could use this for pretty much any occasion not just a birthday.The envelope is plain white. Due to the unique square shape extra postage is required. It is odd but awesome.

title: Craftsy Look and Feel
text: this card as a definite homemade craftsy look and feel. that being said it is pretty especially if you like that style. There is some subtle glitter than doesn't fall all over the place on the front. The pinks in the card and accompanying envelope are feminine without being too frou frou. The sentiment is lovely and overall this would be a sweet tribute to that special teenage girl.

title: A CARd for the Speedy Set
text: Boys do love their toys. this pop up card featuring Lightening McQueen is perfect for any car lover. The colors are bright and vivid. the characters are accurately depicted. The card opens to depict an airborne McQueen flying off a ramp. The saying is appropriate and the card is lots of fun for car lovers of all ages. The stock is quality and it is accompanied by a blue envelope.

title: They Really Do Dissolve
text:
Labelling is great but who likes pulling off stubborn labels. You can rub them peanut butter, scrub til your hands bleed and they still don't completely budge. These labels are the answer. Made of a thin paper that reminds me of rice paper, they adhere well to glass and plastic. I had no problems writing on them with a sharpie. They do have templates if you are giving something or a gift or just want a prettier look. I am not a fan of Avery's website but it is manageable. As promised these dissolve quickly when hand washing. They leave behind absolutely no residue and it only takes seconds for them to dissolve. They are also safe in the dishwasher. since my mother is fairly limited, I make big batches of food and freeze them in portions. These labels are great measuring 1 1/4" x 2 3/8 " they are not huge but are large enough to jot down dates and the like. these are terrific for anything where you might want to reuse the container. They are safe in the microwave and freezer. for best results store in the plastic bag they come in. Keep flat in a cool, dry place.

This product is impressive.It provided me with the motivation to start preserving summer's bounty instead of letting things go to waste.

title: Right As Rain
text: this paper is wonderful if you have to take notes in the field or work in a humid or wet environment. the paper is truly water resistant. to write on it use pencils or a specialty all weather pen. The paper is the standard 8.4 x 11 with holes punched. Iall hundred pages fit in a one inch binder. the paper is lined with quarter inch squares. We use this paper in our greenhouse and kennel. It works well , Moisture and spills are no longer a worry. Archival quality, it will hold up in storage.

title: Attractive and Useful
text: This is a competent desk calendar with a subtle seascape background. Measuring 22" x 7 ", it runs from January  2018- December 2018. The paper is adequate and faux leather binding and corners enhance durability. The pages are perforated for easy removal. The unlined blocks provide plenty of room to jot down appointments , phone numbers and notes. I live and work in an area where cell phone service and wifi is not reliable so having hard copies of times, dates and phone numbers is essential. It is convenient to jot them down and then transfer them to the electronic calendars.  This is an attractive office essential.

title: Sweet and Simple
text: this card is sweet and simple. the attached angel ornament consists of gold doily like wings and a paper cut out robe. The "gemstone" head is really just a faceted plastic bead complete with a gold halo. The interior feature gold foil embellishments that match the pattern in the angel's robe. The sentiment is short but appropriate. This card contains no other colors than white and gold. Angel collectors will appreciate the ornament.It has a homemade look and feel.The envelope is plain white and this will require extra postage if mailed. Sweet and simple, it conveys the message of the season and provides a reminder of your thoughtfulness.

title: More Than Sufficient
text: these envelopes are terrific for mailings. the brown cratt paper is a decent weight. It is neither too heavy nor too thin It looks official and provides sufficient privacy. My first mailing was a bound document of 148 pages. It fit comfortably without causing the envelope to strain or split. The adhesive band was adequate and the pull off strip a convenience. depending on the contents you may with to fortify the band with some tape. I am satisfied with this product  and find it an affordable substitute for pricier office store envelopes.

title: Fussy Assembly, Unimpressive Result
text: If they read my mind they would know I don't need more aggravation in my life. Especially from an office product. fussy assembly and inadequate instructions make this product an annoying hassle. Put away the screwdriver and pull out the power tools for this one. and even after doing all that you are left with a tray that wobbles and slides. the feet do =not have rubberized caps, a nicety that is standard even on the cheapest of organizers. I could relly use a good desk organizer but his one was worth neither the time nor effort.

title: Good For Gaming and Everyday
text:
If you 've shelled out a lot for a gaming computer, mechanical keyboard and gaming mouse, you might be tempted to pass on the mousepad. After all, most mice work on all surfaces. But a quality mousepad can give you an edge. this one by Amazon Basics is good for gaming and also excellent for non-gaming use.

the cloth surface is nice and smooth and allows the mouse to glide easily . It is larger than the average office mouse and the rubber base does not skid. The edges have a plastic like coating to prevent fraying. It hits the happy medium with thickness. It is neither too thick nor too thin. it works admirably when gaming but also functions nicely when performing routine tasks. It is black with a small unobtrusive logo on the right lower corner. although the copy says that it is machine washable the included instructions say to hand wash only. Overall a mouse pad that might just give you the edge.

title: Easy Writers
text: What great pens. They write smoothly without skipping or smudging. Both left handed and right handed people found the comfortable to use even for extended periods of time. They feel like gel pens as they glide across the page. This set includes one black, one red and one blue. The colors are true. They are retractable which minimizes mess and the chance for them to dry out. Excellent.

title: Desk Jockeys Rejoice
text: Desk jockeys rejoice. Finally an affordable chair with a massage option. The chair itself is attractive and reasonably comfortable. As I enjoy assembling furniture slightly more than I do undergoing  a root canal, I am happy to report it is fairly easy to assemble. The cushioning is generous and it is a snap to adjust. the massage feature is controlled by a remote that attaches to the side of the chair when not in use. While I do wish there was greater intensity and more options, it is relaxing and does take the edge off. Of the two settings I prefer the higher ones. I do have back issues and have been known to slip a massage pad over the back of my regular chair. It does need to be near an electrical outlet for use. The wire factors into positioning and obviously excludes it from the annual office chair race. It is a good chair with thoughtful features. a comfortable work station enhances productivity and this chair possesses many thoughtful features.

title: All That Glitters
text: These are nice money holder cards. The six cards total contain three of each decoration. The sayings are appropriately inoffensive and the colors are pleasingly bright.  The glitter provides just enough sparkle to make the cards feel special. They are accompanied by plain white  envelopes. These are an attractive way to celebrate a graduation by gifting money or gift cards.

title: Flowers for Mom
text: This lovely floral card has crafty touches including a ribbon with a dimensional tag asking "what makes  a mom amazing?". The photograph of the flowers is beautiful and their are foil embellishments. It would have been more elegant without the ribbon and tag but they do impart a handmade look and feel. The sentiment is appropriate without being too gushy or saccharin. the paper quality is good and it comes carefully packaged to avoid damage. It is large and oversized so extra postage would be a good idea. This card hits all the marks. It is attractive, has some sparkle and shine and an appropriately sweet message. Good choice to show mom you care.

title: Pearlescent Paper and 3-D Flourishes
text: If your mom is the crafty type she will appreciate this carde. It has aI love the pearlescent paper and envelope. The 3-D elements add interest. The rhinestone studded butterfly is very pretty but the sequined lace flowers look a bit unfinished. The sentiment is lovely and appropriate. It is a heavy card that comes with thoughtful protectors. You will have to attache additional postage to the silver envelope if mailing. It is a pricey card. If like my mother, yours saves the cars she gets, it is worth the investment. All in all, a pretty card with a delightful sentiment.

title: Keyboarding Comfort
text: Designed for higher gaming or mechanical keyboards, this rest provides comfort and support. It is large. The rubberized base keeps it from sliding around but does not mar the finish of desks. The gel filling is perfect. It is not hard like some or too squishy like others. The black exterior looks professional and would work well in an office. It is a good product that delivers.

title: Simple and To The Point
text: I'd like this card better if it had some color. The gold foil, gold and gray stones dotting the front ampersand are rather drab. The silver glitter adds some sparkle. There is gold foil inside and the white envelope is foil lined. Paper quality is nice. It is a heavy card and extra postage is required.The sentiment is succinct and will appeal to a minimalist. It is contemporary avoiding completely the overdone design and florid prose so frequently found on anniversary cards.  One could use it for any occasion. Though simple and understated, it gets the message across.

title: Attractive Option
text: This office chair is a nice combination of comfort and durability. It is easy to assemble. i am not a handy person and was able to get it done in about twenty minutes. The leather fabric looks nice and the black color and traditional style should blend with virtually any decor. the casters run smoothly and the chair adjusts without issue. However, the recline is minimal. Cushioning is adequate. I have back issues so for extended periods at the desk or computer I utilize an additional cushion. The arms are fixed. Attractive and affordable, this chair is a welcome addition to my office.

title: Old School Charm
text: This is the type of card a grandparent would give to a granddaughter on her fifteenth birthday. The card itself is nicely made, oversized and of heavy stock. The heart is accented with a foam backed butterfly and some faux "jewels". The sentiment is all in Spanish and appropriate for the occasion. The violet envelop is pretty but extra postage is required if mailing.  Although I thought the style was old fashioned, it will undoubtedly charm the young lady celebrating her coming of age.

title: Dulce
text: This is a very sweet card celebrating the birth of a baby. The picture is cute and the quality is good. All the text is in Spanish and  the sentiment is heartfelt and sincere. The red envelope is cheerful and no extra postage is required. It is a lovely way to welcome the new addition.

title: Picture Perfect
text:
Frustrated by the high cost of ink, I switched to laser printers for my home and office. The savings were amazing and the black and white quality was superior. Unfortunately color and photo printing was significantly less than stellar. Luckily printer companies took the hint and took steps to address the exorbitant cost of ink. Epson's eco tank provides up to two years of ink, a significant savings.

Set up took some time. It wasn't hard but filling the ink tanks is a messy enterprise and charging the tanks is time consuming. the controls are basic and it behooves you to study the guide. I found the controls actually restrictive and thought they could be both more comprehensive and user friendly. That being said, the performance is good. Printing and copying are fast and the quality is good. Photos and color printing are impressive. Photos are easily on a par with what is produced at local office and drug stores. I think the laser is crisper with black and white but my interest in this product was really for the photos. And in that I am completely satisfied.

title: Fun
text: These pens have an ultra fine point and come in a variety of pretty colors. They write smoothly and as promised the line is ultra fine. They are okay for coloring small portions and fine details in adult coloring books.They add some variety to journal writing.  There is no bleed through and they do not smear. I am left handed and smearing is usually an issue. Not so with these. A fun selection with colors that make it enjoyable to write by hand again.

title: Amazing Indeed.
text: Amazing, indeed. This bright bold card  is a terrific way to get the message across. There is plenty of glitter that sparkles and shines. I didn't observe any shedding but  on the other hand I am in the camp that believes glitter goes with everything. the stock is decent and message succinct. A fun way to congratulate.

title: Old School Style
text: This is an old school card. the front is a soft coral accented with gold. The sentiment is succinct and appropriate for a wide variety of people in a wide variety of settings. The paper inlay is pretty if a tad grandmotherish. The accompanying envelope is curiously a bright blue. Everyone appreciates a sincere expression of gratitude and to this end, the card delivers. I doubt it would be saved and cherished but it is a pretty gesture. 3.5 stars

title: For a Bud's B-Day
text: This is the perfect card for your self effacing buddy. It is bright and bold and packed with cheer. I love the look of it. It is modern but fun with a sentiment that will most definitely be appreciated. The card itself is made of quality stock and comes with a bright blue envelope. Terrific.

title: Simple and Stylish
text: The bride's dress is amazing, full of feathers and sparkles. The 3-D effect adds impact and the card is simple but stylish. The sentiment is short, simple but sums it all up. A very classy card sure to delight the happy couple.

title: Suitable for Display
text: This card opens to a long chart of qualities from a to z that will help a marriage flourish. The card stock is nice and heavy and the chart is suitable for hanging or framing. It is decorated with hearts that have geometric designs. There is no greeting per se, just the list. The list does not rhyme and some of the suggestions are a tad inane. However it is cute and would be appropriate for a wedding or, for that matter, an anniversary. Extra postage is required if mailing.

title: Fun
text: Get your snark on. This is a great card for someone with a sense of humor. The bright blue envelope adds some color. Unfortunately mine came ben (really curled like it was rolled up like a poster)t, something that is attributable to the post office. But setting under a stack of books eventually straightened it out.
