Mine was mailed in a padded envelope. Probably sending it in cardboard would have prevented the curling. But still a fun card.

title: Keepsake Card
text: This sweet card sends wedding wishes as well as an ornament. Frankly, I liked the idea of the ornament better than the actual on e included. It is made of wood and looks like they used some wood burning on it. The burnt portions on mine looked like an afterthought. But the design with the scrolls and lovebirds is quite pretty. Sans ornament, it is a plain card made of decent stock but dull colors.  But the keepsake is a nice touch. that will undoubtedly trigger wonderful memories of the wedding and sender.

title: Fast and Light
text: I was surprised at the speed of this lightweight scanner. I travel frequently and my vehicle has, by default, become a mobile office. Set up is easy and while I found the software clunky, I liked the overall performance. truly portable, it is fast and can handle everything including easy to lose receipts and business cards. My favorite feature is the two sided scanning, completed in a single pass. It's terrific on the road and would also work well in a cramped office. My experience with Epson products has generally been favorable and I expect to enjoy much use from this device.

title: Sweet Sentiment
text: This card is perfect for a person of faith. The verse is quite sweet. the card itself is multi-colored and accented with a little glitter. The inside part of the card is shiny aqua and a verse sheet is affixed on one side. The accompanying envelope is bright blue. I thought the colors were a bit murky and wold have preferred purer tones but overall it is attractive.Although this is apart of the Mahogany line which is geared to African Americans, it is appropriate for anyone who does not mind being termed a gift from God. Probably not the best choice for the grumpy atheist in your life but fine for just about everyone else.

title: Nice Scanner, Clunky Software
text: This is a nice scanner with clunky software. The scanner itself works well. It is large making the flatbed ideal for books, delicate manuscripts and photos. The ADF is good as we scan a lot of documents at a single time and the auto duplex is a help. Quality and resolution are good. The colors are clear and while not perhaps as vivid as a dedicated photo scanner, certainly acceptable. However I do't much care for the interface and the Abby Reader is frustrating and inefficient. Overall it has some nice features and gets the job done although not as easily or efficiently as it should.

title: Organize in Style
text:
Organize in style with this lovely life planner. Measuring 7" x 9", it features a large sturdy coil . The cover is a vibrant paisley. Other covers featuring seasonal designs, motivational sayings, different color and patterns, are available. The covers are interchangeable and at this time range from $8 - $13. The interior is equally nice. The neutral colors are easy on the eye. You can purchase this item with different colored coils and a colored interior.
The layout is easy and the tabs are secure. the interior of the cover is perfect for sticky notes or you can use it as a mini dry erase board. It has a folder and storage pouch as well as four sheets of stickers to commemorate important dates. They are generous with additional note pages. Designed and assembled in the US, it is an impressive organizer that will delight the user.. However at the end of the day it is a calendar and the price point is a bit high. But if organizing is your thing, this well made and thoughtfully designed attractive planner may be well worth the investment.

title: Impressive
text: I have not used a fountain pen since elementary school. My penmanship was (and still is) awful and memories of leaky pens and blue hands should have deterred me. but fountain pens have come a long way. Notwithstanding, the retro elegance of this pen is irresistible. It is a beautiful piece with rich black lacquer accented by gold. It comes beautifully boxed with a blue ink cartridge. the pictorial directions are included on the warranty sheet. The cartridge is easy to install.The nib is fine and the ink flows smoothly. The pen feels remarkably balanced and writes smoothly. The quink ink cartridges are considered safe for the pens, dry rapidly and don't clog. Replacements are available on amazon [[ASIN:B0017DAAUO Parker Quink Large Cartridges for Fountain Pens, Black ink, 5 units per pack (3011031PP)]] for less than five dollars for a multi pack. The overall cost is less than what I pay for the countless ball points I purchase throughout the year. Once you get the hang of it, it is fun to write with. do not share your fountain pen, it becomes acclimated to y our style. You don't need to apply as much pressure as with ball points and the writing looks as good.. This pen would make an elegant gift or serve as an impressive statement piece.

title: Super Indeed
text:
The high cost and incoveninece of ink cartridges led me to switch all my black and white printing to laser printers. The output was great and the cost was less. However for color printing and photos, lasers can't hold a candle to the quality of a good ink jet. It seems some manufacturer's are finally getting the message and more economical options are being made available through subscription services like HPs and these super tankers.

I was pleased by the relatively compact size of this printer. Greater ink capacity luckily does not require a monster sized printer. Set up was incident free. The major difference is filling the ink bottles as opposed to inserting a cartridge. It can be wired or operates wireless and has the same functions as most good all in ones. It prints, scans and copies. It is pretty quick and the quality of both black and white and colored output is good. The colors are bright and strong with crisp resolution and detail. I do wish the paper tray had a larger capacity. It only holds 150 pages, a small amount for heavy users. but that is merely a quibble. It is early still but assuming it continues to work well and I realize the savings on ink, this is an excellent addition for home, school or small office.

title: Nice Pens But
text: I actually really liked these pens. the ink flows smoothly and the blue color is perfect for school or office. They are comfortable to hold with a gray rubber cushion above the point. They are tapered and retractable. There is a small plastic ball on the tip to keep the ink fresh and liquid until use. However out of a pack of twelve, three were completely and irreparably disassembled. I couldn't get them back to working condition. That is a quarter of the box which is not good. Otherwise the pens are terrific, write smoothly and attractively. I have not experienced leaking, even with the broken ones. They are not refillable.

title: Clear Message, Good Adhesion
text: Interesting and effective, this tape gets the message across. The graphic and print are clear and it adheres securely. There are perforations every four inches or so for easy tearing. It is eye catching and easy to use. It is ideal for small businesses as well as home shipping. the roll is compact enough to store easily. a good product that performs.

title: A Can't Miss Message
text: This  tape is perfect when you are moving or mailing delicate items. The roll is large with perforations every eight inches. Really more a printed tape than a label perse, it adheres securely. The print is clear and easy to read. There is no backing to peel as you might expect with labels. The generous sized roll should last. all in all a tape that does what it is designed to do.

title: Good Adhesion
text: This tape gets the message across. The graphic is clear and the adhesion good. It is a large roll with perforations for easy tearing every three inches. It is ideal for movers and mailing delicate items.

title: Clear Caution
text: After having a number of items arrive broken, I decided to invest in these labels. They come on a roll and have no backing. There is a perforation every three inches or so for easier tearing. Once started be sure to bend back or stick something in to make it easy to locate and peel where you left off. the labels themselves are fine, easy to read with adequate adhesion. No guarantee but the polite thank you is a nice touch.

title: Office on the Road
text:
I travel frequently and have often dreamed of having the ability to easily print, copy and scan from the road. but all in ones are generally heavy and cumbersome so I was excited to see how this one operated. It is a compact device.It measures 3.6 by 15 by 7.8 inches when closed. However when the two document feeders are extended, it grows to 10.6 by 15 by 15.8. although lighter than a desktop all in one, it weighs just under 7 pounds with ink and battery. Not bad but still heftier than my laptop.

Set up is simple. As promised the rechargeable battery powers up in about 90 minutes. The paper capacity of the rear document feeder is 50 sheets while the ADF holds ten. although duplex printing is not automatic, you can do it manually. Scanning and copying is a one page at a time operation. However the output quality rivals a desktop model. It can scan and save to PDF, JPEG and TIFF as well as other options. The touch screen tilts and makes it possible to scan connectivity options include Wi-Fi, Wi-FI Direct, Bluetooth, and USB. Printing is possible from both Android and Apple phones.

Print speed is a tad slower than the desktop versions but not bad for a battery. It comes with two cartridges, one color and one
black. Text printing was acceptable with no problems. Photos came out surprisingly well, with excellent color saturation. Charts and powerpoint print outs were adequate but not impressive. I would suggest investing in the high capacity cartridges. The boost in capacity justifies the cost.

This is a good product. The convenience of reliable on road printing, scanning and copying offsets lugging around an extra seven
pounds. My field (law) is document driven and this all in one is like taking the office on the road. There is a one year limited warranty.

title: Subscription Savings
text:
Ink is to printers as gas is to cars. If you run out, you are not going anywhere. Frustrated with the high price of in I switched over my office printer to a more affordable, productive black and white printer. Still for color printing, an ink jet can't be beat. This subscription plan is affordable, especially if you have a good handle on just how much printing you do in a month.

The first step is to determine whether your printer is one of the models included in the plan. After you get your card, you access the website and sign up for an account. You then print out a page from the printer which provides a code. The code should then be added to your sign up. HP then is able to monitor the number of pages you are printing and send you the necessary ink as needed postage paid.

Although I am not a fan of subscription programs, this one does make sense. I liked that unused pages roll over. A nominal fee is charged for overages. The fees are on a par with what you pay if you went to an office store for printing. .Supposedly you can change plans or cancel as need be without any penalty. If you have more than one printer, each one must have its own account. Sign up isn't quite as seamless as I had hoped and you may have to input your code more than once. As I just started, I have yet to evaluate the mailing service and will update if there are any problems.

So far I am satisfied with this plan. I am hopiong to realize savings on ink and am looking forward to regularly using my color printer.

title: Handy
text: These postcards are made from a good quality card stock. They go through the US mail without issue or requiring excess postage. They are easy to dress up and templates are available at the Avery website. I belong to a group that meets monthly. At the end of the meeting everyone fills the next meeting information on the post card and addresses it. This has been a successful back up to email and social media and is less time consuming than phone calls. The ivory color is pleasing and they convenient to have on hand.

title: Clever and Convenient
text: Featuring a super useful ruler, these plastic bookmarks are clever and convenient. Easy to use, they slip into most spiral notebooks with ease. The colors are bright and cheerful and the plastic seems sturdy. You can write, erase and reuse but only if you use pencils. This is the one thing I don't like about this product. I never have pencils only pens or markers. a marker would be ideal if you could just wipe it off. Still, they work well and the ruler is tremendously handy.

title: Adhersion Issues
text: Glitter is always fun. that is until the labels that are supposed to stick don't. Luckily these dividers are reversible with plain colors on the back. The colors are bright and cheerful but the glitter was the selling point. Made of fairly sturdy card stock, they feature reinforced holes. The glitter side seems to be coated or laminated, hence the adhesion issues. Still fun but less appealing when you can't stick the label.

title: Easy Organization
text: Whether it is a school, home or work project, these sturdy dividers will make organizing a snap. They look professional and the tabs can be customized without  considerable effort. The double reinforced holes hold up to frequent use. The paper is heavy, a definite plus. If you use binders to organized , these will serve you well.

title: Handy and Dandy
text: This bulletin board is attractive and handy especially where space is at  a premium. The black scroll frame provides a finished look. and adds some panache. Mounting hardware is included and the board itself functions as expected. It is not a huge bulletin board but is ideal for pinning small memos and mementos. It is perfect for a small space.

title: Economical
text: Economical in size and in cost if you sign up for one of their auto-ink program, this little printer does work well. Set up was easy if somewhat slow and tedious. It is accompanied by a CD or you can use the website. Wireless connection was seamless and performance for printing and scanning  was good if a tad slow. It comes with black and color starter cartridges and you can choose to order ink automatically by estimating the number of pages. The prices range from $2.99 for 50 pages.$ 4.99 for 100 pages to $ 9.99 for 300 pages. There is a roll over for the pages you don't use in a given month. Generally I am not a fan of subscription programs but this one does not require a contact and it does constitute a considerable savings on ink. It is my intent to use this at home for light color printing and photos.  ( I use a laser printer for black and white printing at home and at work.)although it seems a little flimsy, this printer is cute with the white accented by blue and performs admirably.

title: My Marvelous Memo-Mouse Pad
text: This is a non-caffeinated mood booster and a great way to start your day. Essentially a memo pad attached to a mouse pad it is bright and fun.the paper is decent quality and there is enough room to create lists, jot notes and messages. While the mouse pad is not impressive, it functions. My mouse worked on it although perhaps not as smoothly as with designated mouse pads. This would be a great gift for a student or office drone.

title: Perfect for the Principled Outdoors Man
text: This is a handsome card for the principled outdoors man. The front has a rustic field with a wood like pattern and picture of fishermen on a lake. the foil accents are sophisticated an neither frou frou nor silly. The sentiment is appropriate without being gushy. I especially liked the vivid blue envelope which complemented the graphic. this card will make a thoughtful remembrance of that special man's birthday.

title: Perfect for Girly Girls
text: Girly girls will love these books. Each features an exceedingly feminine girl and her fluffy pet on a flower, fruit and Eiffel tower embellished background. The colors are bright and the overall quality of the notebooks is good. they come with a double sided pocket, and a sheet of stickers, the lines of the paper are purple and there iare pink accents. The spiral wire is also pink. The personal information is in Spanish and Portuguese. There is no English. ranted it is easy to figure out, i.e., nombre, etc, but  it would have been nice if English was also included. tom boys will roll their eyes, but little girls who favor pink and the traditionally feminine, soft, fluffy and floral, will adore these notebooks.

title: Fussy
text: Although I really like the end result, the ends did not justify the means. It looked like it would be a simple enterprise, print, slip and fold. but instead it is time consuming and fussy. I have neither patience nor time to fuss with these labels. Plus they are expensive for a do it yourself product. If you are a crafty person, you might enjoy this process. I didn't. Even though the end result was appealing, it was just too much work for me.

title: A Good Label Maeks a Good IMpression
text: these labels are ideal for times when a receipt is desired. they work in both laser and ink jet. I've tried them in both and have encountered no difficulties. The end result looks professional. The label peels from the backing easily and it adheres securely to the package. The process is fast and they are accepted by all major carriers. Much of business is about perception and good labels, like these, make good impressions.

title: Fine For Storage
text: Although I generally like Mead products this one looks and feels cheap. Although the heavy weight of the cover is impressive, the flimsy spine and paper flaps do not. Thereis an elastic bind to hold the portfolio closed. One can store up to fifty pages inside. It is fine for storage but not something I would use professionally.

title: Meaningful Tribute
text: This card pays homage to the man by remembering the boy he once was. it is a lovely tribute to a son from a parent or guardian. . The aqua and green enliven the black and white photos. The sentiment is sincere and appropriate without being overly gooey or effusive. It is a meaningful tribute that will be cherished.

title: Cute Card
text: This is such a cute card for the modern couple. the cartoon couple is adorable, dressed up with bright foil touches. the sentiment is sweet without being gushy or overdone. the blue and white cord and the brown paper stock contribute to the homey vibe. It is accompanied by a plain and disappointing white envelope. Other than that, it is a delightful card that hits all the right notes.

title: Ain't No Mountain High enough
text: the stunning mountain vista is accompanied by positive and uplifting birthday wishes. This  is a lovely card that would be appropriate for just about anyone. It comes with a matching blue envelope. Free of snark, dubious humor and not overdone, it would work well in either a personal or professional setting. It looks and feels nice and the interior is as attractive as the exterior. The writing on the front appears to be in foil. Similarly, the script on the inside is also metallic. It is a classy way to send birthday greetings.

title: Sharp Look, Iffy Adhesion
text: These labels are a good idea. When completed they look professional and the receipt is a nice touch. I had no problems printing them and they seemed to work equally well with both the laser and ink jet printers. Similarly, there were no issues with stamps.com. However, teh adhesion is not good. I had to tape down the labels to insure they would stay put. One did not stick at all and the remainder seemed to have issues around the corner.  Other than that, they are a convenience that help parcels look sharp.

title: To The Letter
text: This is a nice set of vinyl letters. They have adhesive on one side. They stick securely and provide clean, clear lettering. I don't know that I would use them outdoors for extended periods but they are great for indoor projects. If using on glass, make sure the surface is clean. They can be repositioned, a definite plus. a little tricky to remove from their sheets, they do the job, plain and simple.

title: Good Quality, Convenient Size
text: The 11 x 17 size of these sheet protectors makes them ideal for legal documents. Of archival quality, the sheets are 3.5 mil thick. They come with pre-punched, reinforced holes. they have o creases or markings and are glare free. These are excellent for storing cherished souvenirs,art work or important documents.

title: Happy Burp Day
text: This is a great card for anyone who prefers beer to cake. When opened it lights up and renders an inebriated version of Happy Birthday, belches included. While not for everyone, it is funny for the beer guzzling birthday boy or girl.  It comes with a plain rather boring envelope and extra postage will insure delivery.

title: Happy Birthday, Smiley!
text: The smiley face's grin is irresistible and the high quality stock and glitter make it special. the greeting is pleasant if a tad generic but appropriate for most. It is fun without being overdone or excessive. Light-hearted but free of snark, it is a nice card. It is accompanied by a plain white envelope.

title: Juvenile But Fun
text: Despite the rather juvenile saying, this is a cute card that would be great for a college kid. Pizza, beer, and stale Pop tarts. Well that explains the belches and farts. The interior pop out of the two brothers is fun. the graphics are good and the stock good quality. It comes with an attractive bright blue card. Not for everyone but a loads of fun for the right brother.

title: Dramatic
text: This is a dramatic card with silver foil script on a background of silver glitter. The inside sentiment is delightful without being silly or overstated. I did detract a star for the "Love Conquers All"  on the front. Who is this couple? Romeo and Juliet? Most couples don't encounter barriers to their coupling and from their HoneyFund accounts it seems that money conquers all. But notwithstanding, this is a stunning card sure to impress the happy couple.

title: Oh  Christmas Tree
text: The gold star tree topper and foil and glitter accents give this pine green card panache. It is simply designed with tremendous eye appeal. the sentiment is appropriate without being overdone. the card  looks and feels expensive. It comes with a plain white envelope. A beautiful way to transmit Christmas greetings to a dear friend.

title: Celebrates Friendship Not Christams
text: although this is an attractive albleit understated it card, it celebrates friendship far more than Christmas. the stock is good and the sentiment is meaningful without being overdone or excessively sweet. Despite the glitter, there is really nothing about this card's appearance that indicates a seasonal celebration. It does come with a red envelope and is of good quality. However, the glitter does shed. Probably fine for secular pals butit would have been nice if it gave more of a nod to the season.

title: For a Princess With Attitude
text: Despite the pink, glitter and shine, this is a card with attitude. The saying is snarky and sure to get a laugh. It is definitely designed for a warrior princess (think Xena or Merida as opposed to Cinderella or Belle). It comes with justWink's unique side opening  envelope. A fun Card for the Right person.

title: Simply Sweet
text: Beautifully crafted, this card is a sweet and simple way to convey birthday greetings to that special someone. The card stock looks and feels elegant and the rhinestones and foil embellishments are not overdone. Although I am not a fan of the "you complete me" type cards, the sentiment here is charming without being sickeningly sweet. It is accompanied by a coordinating envelope.

title: Celebrate Your Love
text: This is a lovely way to celebrate your love. The laser cut hearts are striking against the light blue background. The foil accents add  shine. The card stock excellent and the effect is relaxed but classy. The sentiment is meaningful without being saccharin or over the top. Anniversaries are the perfect time for remembering the past and planning for the future. This card means you wold do it all again. If mailing, additional postage is required.

title: Upbeat
text: This is a lovely card with an inspiring message. The colors are bright and pleasing. The glitter adds sparkle and shine and the hot pink envelope is the perfect complement. The message is upbeat, a vote of confidence from the ones who know her best. This card seems designed for a teen and is a cheery and meaningful way to celebrate her birthday.

title: Birthday Card Thing
text: This  card is attractive with a glittery flower and a complementary pink envelope. I found the verse inane, just a list of things that demonstrate the recipient's mastery of the "mom thing".  There seems to be a disconnect between the prose and the traditional design of the card (they don't mention growing things, or sparkly things). The interior is very pretty with another flower and more foil accents. Not bad and I am sure every mom appreciates being remembered on her birthday.

title: Wonderful
text: What a terrific card! It captures the sentiment perfectly with no undo gooiness or schmaltz. The mountain vista is lovely and the saying is meaningful and succinct. Accompanied by a white envelope with justwink's unique side opening, this card is a wonderful way to say just what is needed.

title: For Your Favorite Dinosaur
text: This is a cool card with the silhouette of a dinosaur on a bed of light green glitter. The glitter is well affixed. It doesn't shed and get over everything. the slightly snarky sentiment will bring a smile to your favorite T Rex. It comes with a white envelope. A fun card for the right person.

title: Lucky to Get this Card
text: The first thought that came to my mind when seeing this vivid card was Christmas in Vegas. Marquis styled signs generously embellished with glitter hang on a grey ribbon. The red foil background is lovely. It doesn't scream Christmas. The interior is lovely with a meaningful verse that is sweet and refreshingly restrained. It is accompanied by a gold envelope and will require extra postage if mailing. I liked the sentiment and the overall design. However one of the signs on mine was markedly askew and was impossible to adjust without removing and re-gluing.. Otherwise this is a wonderful greeting for a sweetheart.

title: Shine On Birthday Girl
text: This card is both bold and beautiful. the glitter is securely affixed and the message empowering. The card stock itself is good and visually it is most appealing. the interior message also sparkles. There is a vaguely chemical odor that might be attributable to the adhesive. It dissipates after being exposed to air for awhile. The card is accompanied by a white envelope with justWink's unique side opening.

title: Birds of A Feather
text: This is a very pretty card for a dear friend. The birds have just enough sparkle to make it special and the colors are lovely. The card stock is good and it looks and feels expensive. The sentiment is sweet without being excessively saccharin. Unfortunately mine came curved, like it was positioned around a cylinder. Even after spending the better part of a week under a stack of heavy books it still curves. ?Still is is a nice card that requires extra postage if mailing.

title: Vivid Retro Vibe
text: this colorful card has a distinct retro vibe. The vibrant bouquet is sprinkled with glitter and the flocked letting adds visual and textural interest. The message is short and sweet. One side f the interior is super bright Pepto Bismol pink while the other is a muted green. It comes with a plain white envelope with justWink's unique side open envelope. If Mom thinks fondly of days when avocado appliances and orange shag rugs were in vogue, this is most definitely the card for her.

title: Lovely Gesture of Gratitude
text: Even with a jewel embellished fabric flower, crystal, pearl and foil embellishments, this card exudes understated elegance.  the silver exterior is classy. Lest yo think the cardis dull and drab, the interior is bright with satin finished cream colored paper. foil and bright pinkish flowers further enliven the interior. The sentiment is appropriate and sincere. It is no overly sweet  or gushy. The card comes with a boring white envelope. Still it makes a lovely gesture for a good and helpful friend.

title: Stars in Their Eyes
text: This is a classy way to send birthday greetings. the embossed foil border at the base adds visual intrigue while the rhinestones and foil stars shine and sparkle. The card stock is heavy and impressive to touch. the sentiment is appropriate for just about anyone. Happily free of misguided humor or schmaltz, it is meaningful and sincere. Tall and slim, the card is accompanied by a cream colored envelope. Additional postage is not required. I cold envision giving this card to a work colleague or friend.

title: A Garden of Good Wishes
text: Send a garden of good wishes with this feminine card. The lacy laser cut overlay features flowers and a butterfly The sentiment is nice without being too sugary. the stock is good quality and the card looks and feels expensive. It is pink inside and out. I like pink  but do find it a tad cliched especially for women. The card comes with an uninspired white envelope. It is a pretty way to send birthday greetings.

title: Dramatic
text: A dramatic snowflake bedecked with glitter and studded with rhinestones is the focal point of this impressive card. Designed to impress, it is over sized and comes with a silver envelope. The sentiment is sweet although I found the first part somewhat inane. The card is beautiful .and will be received with enthusiasm. Extra postage is required if mailing.

title: Cheerful and Appropriate
text: This pretty card would be appropriate for just about anyone. The colors are vivid and cheerful. Thanks to glitter and prismatic foil, it provides plenty of sparkle and shine. The sentiment is appropriate without being excessive  or silly. It feels expensive and looks good. accompanied by a pale blue envelope. Attractive and appropriate, it is a cheerful way to commemorate someone's special day.

title: Pretty Card, Mixed Message
text: While I love the look of this card, I don't care for the sappy put upon saying. the card itself is physically exquisite. The red glitter bordering the rich red roses is stunning and the gold foil is lovely. However, the focus on how the giver loves the needy and trying mate was a turn off. Suffice it to say s/he will love the receiver for ever through thick and thin without affixing blame or specifying the apparently perplexing and aggravating acts of the receiver. It seems like the giver is looking for a thnk you card for being so supportive. I am not a fan of passive aggression and would not be happy getting this for my birthday. Too bad, because the design is beautiful. It comes with a white envelope. Extra postage is required if mailing.

title: Cheerful Birthday Greeting
text: The bright foil and glitter embellishments make this a festive card. The sentiment is sweet without and being overblown and this card wold be appropriate for most. It comes with a light gold/beige envelope which coordinates nicely with the card. the bright gold cord is fun and the card has a quality look and feel. It is a thoughtful car that will uplift and delight.

title: Artisitic
text: This is a sweet card that appeals to the artistic . The glittery flowers and water coloring is delicate and elegant. The sentiment is beautiful. It is sincere without being sappy. accented by a lavender  ribbon, it is a graceful card made from high quality stock. The envelope is white. It will touch the recipient with its beauty and message.

title: Up, Up and Away
text: What's not to love about a card with a pop out plane and stickers to decorate? This is a fun card. The colors are rich and vibrant and the interactive aspect will stimulate the child's imagination and creativity. while I wold have preferred a more unisex message, this is a card that will delight little boys. The stock is heavy and the stickers bright and colorful. It is accompanied by a blue envelope. This card requires extra postage if mailing.

title: Breathtaking
text: This card is breathtakingly beautiful. The textured cover looks like leather and is accented with a rhinestone, foil accents and a velveteen ribbon. the style is traditional but luxurious.  the stock looks and feels expensive and the it reads like a love letter. The expression of love and commitment is effusive but not sickeningly sweet. It comes with a white envelope. this is a card that will impress a spouse or swetheart. Stunning in appearance and moving in sentiment, it is a card to cherish.

title: Celebrate Their Love
text: This card is a celebration of love. The silver intertwined hearts add a contemporary vibe while the prismatic foil stars and hearts have a luxe feel. The blue card stock has a lovely look and feel while the light blue ribbon is the perfect accent. The saying is sweet and appropriate. The only let down is the plain white envelope pales in comparison. . But the  card is a beautiful way to communicate well wishes.

title: Traditional Beauty
text: This is a beautiful traditional card celebrating the warmth and love that accompanies Christmas. The card is large and the picture is charming, exuding warmth in a Thomas Kincaide-ish fashion. The sentiment is meaningful and appropriate for just about anyone. It comes with a matching red envelope. It is a lovely way to celebrate the spirit of the season.

title: Very Vanilla
text: This is a perfectly inoffensive card. The sentiment is sweet without being too saccharin or gushy. the tonal white on white design is rather bland. The three D flowers cascading down the cake look a bit arts and crafty to me. The satin accents add a touch of luxury as do the two little pearls in the center of two of the flowers. It comes with an inexplicably blue envelope. It is appropriate but forgettable.

title: Bold But Bent
text: I really like this card. The bold graphic is eye catching and the stars, including some foil and one red rhinestone are attractive highlights. The sentiment is appropriate for a wide variety of people. the stock has a good weight and feel. the card comes with a plain, uninspired envelope. But don't judge a book by its cover. The card inside will brighten anyone's day. Unfortunately the sample I received had a substantial bend in the lower right hand corner. after placing it under some very heavy books, the bend eased but there was an ugly wrinkle. I've gotten many other cards from amazon and they arrived undamaged in a padded envelope. But this one is unusable due to the marred front.

title: Fun B-day for Son
text: Bright and cheerful, this is a fun card. Peeking through the open picture frame on the front is a cake carrying bear attached to a spring. The glitter stars generate a celebratory air. the colors are vivid and it comes with a bright blue envelope. It is a very cute card, sure to delight young and old alike.

title: Impressive
text: This is an impressive card with a meaningful sentiment. Dark gray, it has both flocking and glitter. A tonal jacquard pattern embellishes the front and it is adorned with a cream colored iridescent ribbon. Accompanied by an off white envelope, it requires extra postage if mailing. although it is a beautiful card, the color choice is dark and dreary. I thin the general murkiness of the gray detracts from the beauty of the card. still a handsome way to congratulate the newly wedded couple.

title: For the Budding Buccaneer
text: This is an adorable interactive card for the budding buccaneer. The front is flocked and fun to touch. the inside features stickers and a scene to be colored. The stock is sturdy and the pirate theme will thrill a young child. It comes with a bright blue envelope. It has a fun sentiment and is a gift in itself.

title: Didn't Send Me Soaring
text: Despite some nice touches, this card failed to impress. the embossed foil is lovely. It adds some holographic shine. the sentiment is sweet. However three of the balloons have no words on them. The words are simple. Surely they could have come up with three more. The elastic cord looks cheap and is too casual for the card. The paper has good weight and feels nice. It comes with a plain white envelope and requires extra postage if mailing.

title: Simple and Subtle
text: This is the perfect card for a stressed out friend. The beach scene on the front is placid and the soft colors relaxing. the sentiment is sweet without being saccharin. the foil and glitter add subtle sparkle and the overall effect is one of approachable sophistication.  The stock is high quality and it is accompanied by a matching a blue envelope.

title: Charming
text: I thought the saying was delightful and the card quite cute. The baby unicorn has shiny holographic hooves and birthday hat. the main is flocked and soft to the touch. The unique is cartoonist, not unlike the My Little Pony characters. Inside the card is green with foil embellished flowers.The unicorn figure extends beyond the card proper making it a bit hard to open.  It would delight a little girl (or other unicorn aficionado) and comes with a pretty deep pink envelope.

title: Elegance, Plain and Simple
text: This is a simple but elegant way to celebrate dad on his birthday. The stock is heavy and has a great feel while the gold print contributes some celebratory shine. A leather look embossed sheet is attached by maroon ribbons on the front with "Dad" written in matching burgundy. The sentiment is nice without being overdone. It comes with a plain white envelope. Due to the size and weight, extra postage may be needed.

title: Handsome
text: This is a handsome card with some classy touches. the trifold design is unique. The card stock has a nice look and feel . the embossing is lovely and the foil touches add shine. The black ribbon is an eye catching. The sentiment is appropriate without being too schmaltzy. I think this card is best suited for adults. It is accompanied by a pale green envelope. It is a lovely tribute, sophisticated and sincere.

title: Stunning But Saying Not Especially Seasonal
text: This is a beautiful card. Adorned with rhinestones glitter and foil, it is over sized and impressive. Unfortunately the sappy sentiment has little to do with Christmas. It is sweet and pleasant but more a statement of general devotion than a holiday greeting. While it does wish the recipient a merry Christmas, it is not seasonal. The saying seems more appropriate for an anniversary. It is accompanied by a silver envelope and extra postage will be required if mailing. It is a luxurious card for sure. Too bad the sentiment was not more seasonal.

title: Goofy Fun
text: Silly and juvenile, this card is giggle provoking fun. The waistband and googly eyes  vibrate while an operatic male voice sings the Underwear Song. The lyrics are on the back. The provocatively placed button activates the music and motion. The front of the card is fairly thick foam which opens to  a message on regular card stock. It comes with a sturdy white envelope for mailing.The envelope is still and reinforced to prevent damage. Extra postage is required if mailing.  It would appeal to both actual ten year olds and innner ten year olds alike. Goofy fun.

title: Have a Good birthday or Else!
text: According to the ninja hamster, not having a great birthday could have serious consequences. The hamster is cute and when the card opens this nunchucks spin  while the song Kung Fu Fighting plays.  The sticks rotate rapidly. The song is clear and understandable, decent quality for a card.  while ninjas don't practice kung fu, I doubt it will make any difference to the recipient. a white envelope accompanies the card and extra postage is necessary if mailing.

title: Delivering Christmas Cheer
text: These stylish cards holds gift cards, cash or checks with ease. The Christmas tree is attractive with red foil embellishments. The saying is short and sweet. I especially like the red envelope. It  captures the spirit of the season. . The stock is nice and it feels good in the hand. An attractive way to deliver Christmas cheer.

title: Let the Cat Out Of The Basket
text: This is a cleverly designed card that features a kitten in a basket. Pulling the card up triggers a musical rendition of Happy Birthday sung by cats. It won't be winning any Grammies but it is sure to delight feline fans. The pull up cat is a card that opens and includes a written greeting. It is cute and kitschy but certain to delight the cat fancier in your life. Extra postage is required if mailing.

title: Sister Act
text: If your sister is also your friend, this is the perfect card to celebrate her birthday. It is very attractive with some glitter and a single rhinestone. Despite the floral motif it is not too girly. The sentiment is nice and sincere without being ooey gooey or excessively sweet. It comes with a pumpkin colored envelope that complements  despite it being a rather dark and dull color. Overall, it is a joyful, happy card to send to a wonderful woman.

title: Hamster Love
text: It may be your birthday ,but the hamster wants some love. The colors are bright and appealing and the hamster is cute for a rodent. The sound quality is excellent, loud, clear and easy to understand. Upon opening the card, Snuggles asks for a tummy rub and makes all sorts of appreciative comments  while being massaged. the sounds are not too suggestive and this card is appropriate for all ages. It comes with a white envelope and extra postage is required.

title: Shower Snark
text: This card depicts a modern bride on a glitter background. It is much brighter and prettier than depicted. The saying is full of shower snark so be selective when giving to the bride. as one who has suffered through countless rounds of Bridal Bingo, bun warmer jokes and cheap chardonnay, I thought it was funny. However, the past few showers I've attended have been elaborate affairs at swank venues with nary a pink cupcake or male stripper in sight. The most recent bridezillas probably would not have appreciated the humor but there are plenty who will. the quality is good and the accompanying envelope white.

title: Great Glitter Background
text: A nicely rendered pink unicorn looks out from a glitter background. The glitter is very well done with no loose particles. the saying is suggestive so this card is most definitely not for everyone. the stock is nice although not particularly impressive. It is definitely a cut above drugstore variety cards. A fun cad for the right person.

title: Sweet Way to Remember the Day
text: Flocking and a unique side opening envelope elevate this rather pedestrian card. The sentiment is sweet, perhaps most appropriate for someone who is coming through difficult times. The design is pleasant and the saying inoffensive and snark free. The card stock is good. It has weight and a nice feel. this is a thoughtful conservative card that is a lovely way to commemorate a birthday.

title: Corny Fun
text: If you know someone who gets a kick out of those old why did the chicken cross the road" jokes, then you know someone who will love this card. The chicken is appropriately goofy looking. When the card opens "I Like to Move It" plays. This is a card, not an i-pod so it is tinny but decipherable. The chicken wiggles, flapping its wings and provoking giggles from fans and groans from others. It is corny but fun. The card is nicely made with vivid colors. Extra postage is required for mailing. The envelope is plain white with the rose log embossed on the back.

title: Delightful
text: It is hard to go wrong with a red car and a golden retriever puppy and this card hits all the mark. the color is breathtaking with the red and gold vivid and rich. A decorative black and white ribbon elevates it while adding a rustic, almost homespun appeal. The sentiment is simple but heartfelt and the interior design is as charming as the exterior.It comes in a plain and uninspiring white envelope. This is a delightful card that will convey your wishes while capturing the heart of the recipient.

title: Lovely
text: If you are getting snow blindness from navigating the great white tundra of wedding cards, this one will be a welcome deviation. Featuring a lovely sky blue classic car bedecked with two pink bouquets and a just married sign, it has plenty of color. The sign features two rhinestones and the border has plenty of glitter to sparkle and shine.The photo has a scalloped edge and is layered over light blue card stock.The envelope is plain and white.  The saying celebrates both the marriage and the road ahead. This is a lovely card, joyful and bright.

title: Plain
text:
This tonal white on white card is elegant but plain. It is embellished by a pearlized white ribbon that imparts a subtle shine. a small heart shaped rhinestone sits ins the center of the "O" of Today at the top. It's someone staid appearance is enlivened by a contemporary rendering of a wedding cake topped with two hearts and the different fonts of the prose. The print and design are raised, satin in texture and almost look silver in the light. although the sentiment is lovely, the interior print is standard in a silver grey ink. The word congratulations is in large script and darker the other print. this cad is accompanied by an unexciting white envelope.

If you think white when you think wedding and prefer simple to embellished you will ike this card. the stock is nice and it has its appeal. But the interior is a disappointment. A more elegant font and dressier ink would have made a world of difference. And the envelope is is what you wold expect with a cheap dollar store card. 3.5 stars

title: Making a Mark
text: This two pack of dry erase markers provide two colors per marker. there is a pretty green and a dark red and a black with orange. The orange was brownish and not quite as vivid as I hoped. Similarly the red is deep but lacking a certain vibrancy. the green is rather pretty and the black is, of course, functional. The markers work well on whiteboards. I use them to mark containers for the freezer as well as noting mileage and dates on the car windows. As promised, these are low odor and wipe easily. The variety of colors make them ideal for business and academic presentations as well as home use.

title: Convenient
text: these pouches are super convenient. I travel fro business and am on the road frequently. It is so easy to forget things or misplace receipts and the like. Unlike some self adhesive products this one actually stays put. The zipper operates smoothly and the clear poly material lets you quickly assess the contents. These are excellent for business , home and school use.

title: Precious
text: This sweet card features an adorable picture and is accented with glitter, ribbon and a small heart shaped stone. The black and white picture is brightened by the pink bouquet. It captures the innocence and delight of  love. It is the perfect way to tell someone special how much you love them on their birthday. It is appropriate for either sex to give or receive. the accompanying envelope is nothing special. but otherwise this card is most charming.

title: Good As Gold
text: Classy and sophisticated, this card is casually elegant. The gold  adds a luxurious touch elevating the rather generic sentiment. it is gender neutral and appropriate for most any individual. Th card stock is impressive, heavy with a nice feel. It will make the recipient feel as good as gold.

title: Shine On Sister
text: It's got glitter, shine and a humorous rhyming verse that captures the special relationship between sisters. The paper has a quality feel and the ink is vivid and bright. A matching tan envelope is included.  If your sister is also your friend, this card will make her smile.

title: Pretty Card Silly Sentiment
text: This is a pretty card with a photo of a little boy playing in the ocean. There is a white cord holding an overlay with foil printing. The stock is nice and the first impression is good. the accompanying envelope is blue. but the message is something inspired by a bad episode of Dr. Phil.  "Did I make you feel important?.Did we find enough time for the little things - like laughter, and hugs, and "just-between-us" moments? And, even when we disagreed, did you always know I loved you?" Ugh, talk about needy. " Of all the things I've done in my life, one thing I'd never change, is having you for a son. If I didn't always say it, I hope I always showed it - I'm proud to be your parent, and I love you, Son. Happy Birthday" Really makes me wonder what else she/he did in  life. the message is more about her/him than the son. What ever happened to just saying "Happy Birthday" without the complex inducing sentiments? So although this card itself is lovely I would pass unless the son in question is named Oedipus or in therapy.

title: Very Feminine
text: This pretty card is perfect for a book loving mom. The card stock has a luxurious feel and the art is appealing without being too formal. The sentiment is sweet without being saccharin. It comes with a book mark which will be appreciated if Mom is not wedded to her Kindle. The book mark is not of the same caliber as the card but it is rather pretty. The card comes with a pink envelope. The pink is very feminine and this card is a great way to honor and thank mom on her birthday.

title: Gilt and a Guilt Trip
text: This is a handsome  card decorated in brown, rust and gold. The metallic ink adds both shine and sophistication. Part birthday greeting, part apology for not staying in touch and part gentle guilt trip, it is designed for a sibling one rarely sees. It comes with a white envelope.

title: For a Fine Friend
text: Bedecked with a bright pink ribbon and a touch of glitter, this card is designed for a dear friend. The message is sweet without being cloying. I thought the vivid ribbone detracted from the muted flowers though. It is decidedly feminine. It comes with a plain envelope which is disappointing. Still, it is a lovely gesture for a close confidant.

title: A Bright Delight
text: This is a really cute card with glitter and vibrant colors. The message is short and sweet. The paper has a nice texture and weight with a sturdy dark green envelope. It is appropriate for just about anyone. The cheerful ice cream cone is fun and sure to delight the recipient.

title: Nice Basic Binders
text: These binders are basic but ideal for office or home use. The O rings function and the maximum capacity is 175 pages. The cover and spine are customizable  and the inside features the standard pockets. It is designed to lie flat when opened. I think they are ideal for storage but probably not sturdy enough to withstand the rigors of daily use. Overall, these are ice basic binders.

title: Plain and Simple
text: This is a basic binder with a customizable cover and spine. the rings open and shut with ease. the binder itself is a bit flimsy. While fine for storage or light home use, it probably not withstand the the daily jostling in a backpack or the rigors of heavy use. It probably would last for a semester or so. If you like your binders plain and simple, this one is a good value.

title: Unimpressive
text: While this is a perfectly adequate binder, it is not what I wold call heavy duty. It is very light. The rings open and shut securely and easily. However the front of mine was warped and the cover had large bubbles that were not only noticeable but unattractive. It does not seem especially sturdy. It is adequate for light use but I doubt it would hold up to the rigors of daily use. The blue is pretty but  overall, this binder is unimpressive.

title: Good Choice for Small Business
text:
A number of years ago I invested in a small black and white Brother laser print to handle my office's heavy printing needs economically. I have been pleased but needed to expand to a more comprehensive unit. This Canon laser printer is multi-function with scanning, printing, copying, wireless, and faxing capabilities.

This is a large and heavy unit. I have a Windows system and set up was not unduly cumbersome. The touch LCD panel is responsive and easy to navigate. Print and color quality are good and operation is pretty quick. The duplex mode is terrific and works with all functions. However,the capacity is limited. The front loading drawer has a capacity of just 250 sheets. You can purchase and additional 250 sheet capacity cartridge.the automatic document feeder has a 50 sheet capacity and there is a 50 sheet multi purpose tray. It does come with starter toner . The replacement
toner is expensive but hopefully it will last longer.

So far performance has been satisfactory. I wish it had greater paper capacity but overall it is easy to use and the end product looks polished and professional.

title: Dancing Dachshunds
text: What could be more fun than dancing dachshunds? Maybe dancing dachshunds with music. This card is sure to delight fansof the breed. Featuring multiple panels that pull up,it is giggle inducing. the photograph is funny and the music is cute. Yes, it is pricier than a standard card and you have to add extra postage but it is a card a dachshund lover will love.

title: Easy to Apply Labels
text: These dividers come with clear labels. They work well for any purpose, business, home or school. Although I am no fan of the Avery webiste, I was able to complete the labels without any issue. The practice sheet was appreciated.The labels are easy to apply and lend a professional look to the binder. The demo was helpful. Overall, another excellent product from Avery.

title: Lovely
text: Polished and pretty this planner is a pleasant deviation from the standard black. The lavender cover is lovely. Faux leather, it has a matte appearance and is smooth to the touch. The pages are different colors per quarter and have an attractive  but subtle floral motif. There are appointment pages  with times as well as those with the standard blocks. The wire spiral binding seems secure and the paper is ink bleed resistant. This is a lovely way to keep organized.

title: Good Quality
text: You can't go wrong with At A Glance planners. Nicely designed and executed, it provides adequate space to note monthly and weekly appointments. The rather bland beige is accented by cheerful  red binding, ink, pages and ribbons. It contains a three year (2015-2017) calendar, a four year (2016 -2019) holiday list and a US map with time zones and area codes. It is small enough to tuck in a bag or briefcase  and neutral enough to be used for home, school or business. The book lies flat and is nicely constructed. Overall a good value and a great way to keep on top of appointments and occasions.

title: A Step Above
text: This is a light and easy to maneuver step ladder. It is sturdy and the mechanisms for opening and closing work smoothly. The rubber handle provides grip and the top step is surprisingly sturdy. Easy to store, this has quickly become a piece of equipment I rely on almost daily.

title: Super Stapler
text: This is a super stapler. Strong and sturdy, it handles office tasks with ease. Versatile, it can be opened for stapling on bulletin boards. The magazine holds 210 staples (not included) and comes with a thoughtful low staple window indicator. It is easy to load and I have yet to encounter any jamming or misfeeds. I love the red color. It stands out in an office filled with black and gray staplers. The 49ers logo will please any fan but I doubt it will withstand the rubbing that comes with constant use. It is slightly rounded and comfortable to use.  This is an attractive stapler that works well and is designed to delight any SF fan.

title: Electronic Backup
text: Planners may seem old school but having weathered many mobile failures, I, for one, still rely on them. This is a handsome book that slips perfectly into a  briefcase. Weeks are featured on two pages with lined spaces. Months are also featured on two pages with unlined blocks. There are no times stamped in, a feature usually found in professional planners. This is a twelve month planner, running from January 2016 through December 2016. Spiral bound, it lies flat and can even be folded back. It has the usual lists of holidays, time zone maps, area codes, 3 year reference and room for personal information, and contacts. There is a plastic pocket in the back. this is a competent planner, with adequate room and a sober appearance. It is perfect for the busy professional seeking electronic backup.

title: Takes Patience and Practice
text:
I loved the concept of this device. I do a lot of research. Frequently I don't need a complete document, just a portion. This device promises to free me from the copier or unwieldy emails. It provides real time scanning and instant editing in Word and Excel and translation. The videos make it look super simple. If only that were so.

It took two attempts before I got it working on my laptop (Windows 7). I am currently using an older android phone (new one was mistaken for a squeaky toy) and it is not compatible. The scanner itself is quite appealing. About the size of a desktop mouse, it is light and tucks perfectly in a purse, pocket or briefcase.the look is clean and modern. It came with a little velvet sleeve and a USB charging cable.Although it seemed from the video easy to use, it takes practice and patience. The software is slow and it took awhile before a got an image I deemed almost satisfactory.The editing seemed cumbersome but that could be attributable to my impatience and inexperience with it. I imagine as I become more familiar with the device, I will attain more pleasing results. I do like its versatility and that it functions in low light situations. It is rather fun when you get the hang of it but it still is a slow go.

This scanner has plenty of potential. Hopefully with patience and practice, it will realize it and become an indispensable accessory. I do like the scanner but am no so sure about the software. Time will tell. 3.5 stars

title: Generous Capacity But Awkward to Use
text: Lured by the large paper capacity, I ultimately found that this zipper binder did not quite meet expectations. On the positive side the vivid blue color is attractive and appealing. Water resistant, it features a zipper that works smoothly. It has a binder and an expandable folder. The binder rings on mine wee not aligned and had to be manipulated by hand. They seemed flimsy and I question their long term durability. The vertical expanding file extends at the top and not the bottom. There are tabs and dividers but the tabs are not aligned and the tabs are short and don't reach the bottom of the folder. It is clumsy to manipulate. That being said, it is not bad, especially since it comes with a year guarantee. It does hold a lot  and the zipper keeps things secure.While it may be more convenient than a backpack, it is awkward to use and the binder is unimpressive. .

title: Divide and Conquer
text: Avery takes it to the next level with these cleverly designed dividers. Made of thick durable plastic, they feature colorful borders and tabs and a translucent window in the center of each.  They are sturdy and promise to hold up to significant wear and tear. I especially like the window which allows a peek at the underlying page. They put some verve into organization and are appropriate for school, business and home.

title: Handy
text:
This is a handy little notebook with some thoughtful features. Measuring 9.5 x 6 inches, it has a sturdy plastic cover and a cloth shielded spiral. The two plastic dividers are movable and can be snapped in and out. The dividers are in different colors (bright blue and herbal green) and come with thin translucent pockets. There are a hundred sheets of standard, thin ruled paper.

Overall I liked this notebook. The smaller size makes it ideal for travel or for small children. The red color is attractive and movable dividers are very helpful. The clothed covered spiral is a plus as it protects against snags and cuts. I do wish it was refillable since the hundred page capacity won't last too long. This book comes with one year limited warranty.

title: Feature Laden
text: This attractive five subject notebook combines form and function. What I liked best were the movable plastic dividers. They are cleverly designed and easy to use. The front and back covers are plastic, promising durability and the cloth protected spine guards against those annoying snags. The two hundred sheets of paper are three hole punched and perforated for quick and clean removal. there is a convenient pen/pencil holder located on the front. Overall this book is impressive in terms of features. However it is heavy and frankly, the price is off putting. As much as I enjoyed the design, I am not sure I can justify the expense. At its heart, it is still just a 200 page notebook, albeit one thoughtfully designed and well made.

title: Good For Professional Offices
text: These versatile dividers are useful in professional offices where top hole folders are the norm. The narrow bottom tabs are extremely helpful and lessen the cumbersome task of file organization. The tabs are erasable, a definite plus. I especially appreciated the copper reinforced holes. They keep the papers neat and secure. Although I am not a big fan of folders with the holes on the top, in my line of work they are the norm. This product helps with organization.

title: Clever Idea
text: These door hangers with tear away cards are a clever idea for small business promotion. They look and feel nice although I would prefer a little more weight and a glossy finish. But they do the job and the tear away cards break away easily. As usual I am less than impressed with the Avery website but after fiddling around I was able to print out an acceptable product. Although they didn't look professional, they did not look amateurish either. They will probably turn out better once I master the design and printing procedures. 3.5 stars

title: Sturdy and Versatile
text: These Avery dividers make organization a snap. They are sturdy and the expandable pockets hold papers securely. The holes are thoughtfully reinforced. The erasable write on tabs are great. You can erase ball point pen. No need to print off a label or fool around with white out. Versatile and durable, they are a great addition at home, office or school.

title: Taking Memories Out of the Box
text:
I have boxes of old negatives and transparencies from times long past. This clever device converts them to digital, giving them new life. The set is surprisingly compact. In addition tot he converter, it contains four adapters (one for 35 mm slides, 35 mm negatives, Super 8 film and 110 negatives), USB power adapter, USB cable, cleaning brush and user manual.At the top of the bright green adapter are the control buttons. There is a screen for viewing and a side slot for an SD/SDHC card. The device has memory so a card is not absolutely necessary. Do not use a MicroSD or SDXC. Be sure to dust off the film you will be using. From there it is a matter of powering on the adapter, selecting the appropriate adapter to feed the film. There are options to adjust the color and to brighten or darken. Then you convert. There is a playback button so you can review and edit the converted images. The converted product can easily be uploaded to a computer. You can also view the images on a tv if it is "equipped with RCA composite ports that accept video-in signal". I have not tried that as the contained screen on the device works well. Remove the card after powering off the device. the warranty is one year.

I liked the device and was satisfied with its capabilities. Once you get the hang of it, it is quite easy and fun to use. I don't often have the luxury of walking down memory lane and this enterprise brought back many fond memories of people and times past. It is nice to be able to preserve them to enjoy in the future.

title: Adequate
text: The rounded corners make these unique and the soft ivory color is appealing. The paper however, lacks heft and that luxurious feel expensive cards provide. I did like that they were printable on both sides.  The biggest challenge though is the Avery website. The process is clumsy and more difficult than it has to be. The selection-of templates is limited and dated. The end result was okay but not a show stopper.

title: Adequate But Not Impressive
text: the rounded corners are different and make these cards somewhat unique. that beings said the cards are otherwise unimpressive. They look and feel okay and I like having the option of printing on both sides. They don't have much heft or a luxe feel but they are adequate. The biggest disappointment is is the Avery website. Options are limited and look dated. The process itself is unnecessarily ponderous. The end result did not justify the investment of my time and energy. It was adequate but not impressive.

title: Post a Note
text:
These are nice white postcards. Appropriate for meeting and club notifications, they printed up nicely on my Brother laser printer. They detached cleanly and I experienced no curling or tearing. I am not a fan of the Avery website however. The template choices are limited and dated. It is much better to upload your own design. The process itself is clumsy and time consuming and the edges don't line up.

In the final analysis, these are fine for casual or personal use. The card stock while adequate is not impressive in weight, feel or appearance. It is fine for everyday mailings but really doesn't stand out. For those reasons, if printing for business or professional use I would rely on a printer where you can get a more polished result at an affordable price.

Bought several of these binders for a huge business project I was completing. 2 arrived torn on seams. 2 more could not withstand my opening the rings more than a dozen times. Another’s rings became offset with steady use. End brackets broke off. It actually slowed down my productiveness because I spent so much time being gentle with binder mechanisms when loading and moving through pages already inserted. Perhaps I just received several duds .... but I eventually became frustrated enough that I returned all 9 of the Averys for cheaper generics binders .... Which to this day have held up.

If you are going to spend hundreds of dollars on binders .... they need to bring their A game to the table.

I am 60. Been using Avery products almost exclusively since the 80s. Very disappointed in quality and seemingly standards lowering its quality control.

Torn binder covers. Brackets that break off. Rings that break off. Rings that bend easily and no longer meet. It is what it is. I chose to return all 9.

title: Wonderful meetings notebook
text:
I love this notebook. I already knew that I liked the design of the meeting pages, that’s why I ordered it (obviously…lol) but it was a nice surprise to see that the paper is very high quality and it has a pleasant vintage beige color that gives it a more mature yet ageless elegance, not your typical white/pink/blue notebook you would use for school. I also love that it has a table of content, although I wish it didn’t have the graphics on the front page, it kind of defeats the purpose of having such a beautifully designed notebook, I’m tempted to rip the table of contents because of that. I would either move that page to the end or at least separate it from the table of contents. It does have some good info though.
The cover is kind of see through, so I thought it was going to be all flimsy but it turned out to be the complete opposite, this cover is made to withstand a variety of harsh conditions, I can also guarantee it is waterproof (I spilled my drink when I was cleaning my office), which makes it so easy to wipe clean. You can even use all purpose spray cleaner on it, you have no idea how much I appreciate that little fact. I also love the gold lettering and binding.
Overall I am really happy with this purchase and will continue to use this product.
I do wish they changed the cover so it’s not see-through and that they added a neutral gold/beige color to their options, so it matches my office :)

Also, apparently they regularly have giveaways too! So I’m already following this store on Amazon and will follow on IG, FB and youtube as soon as I’m done writing this review.

title: Terrible quality - doesn't print well!!
text:
DON'T BUY THIS PRODUCT! I've been using Avery products for decades and have never had a problem or been disappointed until now. First of all, the paper is really poor quality and looks and feels cheap. It is not even good-quality "heavyweight" paper. I would NOT be impressed if I received a company's brochure on this paper.
THEN... the score marks are very poorly made. They are difficult to see and/or to detect by gentle folding in their expected position.
But the WORST aspect of these is that I had MAJOR problems printing with them. They wouldn't feed properly, thus causing my printer to constantly generate an out-of-paper error. If I was lucky, I could print 2 sheets before the printer choked, but for the most part it was slogging through one sheet at a time, having to pull the tray and pull out the offending sheet one page at a time. And then it screwed up my paper tray so much that the tray jammed on me.
Now, this was NOT a problem with my printer. For one thing, I had been successfully printing on plain paper (20- and 24-lb) and 60-lb card stock both BEFORE and AFTER using this product. Secondly, when I got frustrated with my printer, I took the print job to another printer and had the same results. And both of these printers have never had performance issues with any other paper product...until now.
It wasted hours of my time and I am very disappointed!!

I would recommend these for adult coloring.

title: Ultr-fine point for adult coloring
text: I just took up adult coloring and have a package of the fine point markers.  I got a set of the ultra-fine when I discovered that the fine points were a little too hefty for fine detailing or coloring small spaces.  I really love how the color goes on so smoothly in both sets.  The colors are consistent set to set and are nice and bold.  There is a fairly good range of color for most projects.  The reason I rated this a 4 was because the caps on the ultra-fine set are difficult to remove and go back on tightly.  If someone had arthritis in their hands this might be difficult for them.  Also the package is a little flimsy for long-term use.  For coloring though, I would highly recommend them for detail work and small spaces.  I would definitely purchase them again.

I have stored it on its side, maybe I just got a bad one? It's sad because I could of purchased another brand with what I paid for this one. ☹️

title: Love it!!!

title: Glad to find a refill for my journal!

title: This package was sub-par

No matter what configuration I used, the headset (the REASON I bought) always sounded tinny. Like the other person was in the bottom of a well. And it felt flimsy on my head.

The handset was better sound quality but uncomfortable to hold.

Returned.
