title: Inconsistent - Only four of the six pens work well
text:
This is an interesting set of markers and highlighters. The theme is purple, although only four of the six pens have purple ink. I am happy with four of the pens, but the other two aren’t usable. My set consists of:
1. A fine-tipped pink ballpoint pen that writes so faintly and poorly I can’t use it
2. A lavender double-tipped highlighter with one side that seems to already be dried up and the other is too pale of a color to be seen so I won’t be using this one.
3. A black fine-tip gel pen that writes very smoothly. I don’t usually like fine-tipped pens, but I like this one.
4. A purple fine-tipped ballpoint pen that writes pretty well.
5. A double-tipped purple marker that I like. One side is very fine tipped and is a very light purple, the other is a little thicker and the ink is a darker shade of purple. The finer point writes smoother than the medium point.
6. A glitter marker which is my favorite of the set. The color is a really pretty purple, shimmery color that I really like.

If all of the pens wrote consistently well, this could have been a five-star set, but as it is, I could only give it three stars since I’ll only be using part of the pens.

title: Looks nice and works well
text: This is a great journal that looks nice and works well. The faux leather cover is sturdy and looks good. The blank pages are easy to write on with either a ballpoint or gel pen. It has several features that add to its usability. There is a loop to store a pen, an expandable envelope in the back to store small notes, receipts, etc., and has an elastic band that can be placed around the whole journal or inside to mark a page. All in all, this is a nice journal/notebook that I’m happy to have.

title: Hold your badge or keys for easy access and to hold them securely
text: Good for holding something you need constant access to, but don't want to keep digging into your pockets for. Retractable function means these are always at the ready and available. Cable is string and the caribiner makes it easy to hook to a belt loop, no more losing your badge when the clip fails. Easy to use and to find different uses for.

title: Love this card
text: I really love this card! I was so happy that it was cute in person as it is in the photo. I pops up easily and looks good to keep on a shelf or dresser afterwards.

title: Not as cute as pictured, disappointing 2.5/3 stars
text:
I was a little confused by the description of this item, but note that you will receive ONE bookmark. The design itself and the stitching is very cute. I would have been happy if the rest of the bookmark was as nice as the stitched felt part.

I thought the entire bookmark would be made from felt, but it wasn’t. Unfortunately, the stitched felt part is attached to an unattractive piece of plain brown cardboard to form the bookmark. I first thought the cardboard was in the package so the felt part would keep its shape during shipping, so I was disappointed when I realized it was part of the bookmark. I had planned to give this as a gift, but I don’t think it looks good enough for that. The way it’s made it is also too large to work as a bookmark on a typical paperback book. This would be cute to decorate the front of a plain looking cover, but doesn’t work well as a bookmark.

title: Well-made set of birthday cards
text: Who can resist Snoopy? I love this set of birthday cards with four different designs. The cards are cute and well-made and I look forward to sending them to friends and family members.

title: 4.5 stars, nice set of three Easter cards
text: I like the cute, old-fashioned illustrations on the cover of the cards as well as the smaller ones inside the card. I really like the basic messages inside two of the cards, but wish one was a little better. I like that the cards are made from sturdy, glossy cardstock. I look forward to sending these cards at Eastertime.

title: Attractive journal with several useful features
text: I am very happy with this dot grid journal for myself and it would also make a cute gift. I like the pink color and the texture of the imitation leather cover. The dots give me a guideline to write without rigid lines. I’m not an artist, but it’s good for making doodles or for notes when you don’t necessarily want to stay in the lines. It has added features that I appreciate, including a ribbon bookmark, elastic band to keep notebook closed or to mark a page, and a pouch in the back to hold papers or miscellaneous items. It works well and looks nice, too.

title: Attractive card with a positive message
text:
This card is pretty with some of the letters on the front really standing out because they have bright blue glitter. The message is positive and encouraging, without being too sappy. I’m happy with this card.

Note: The envelope was in fairly bad shape when it arrived with the corners bent because of the way it was packaged.

title: Well made and sturdy, no more losing badges due to broken cords
text:
Liugx retractable key chain is strong and well made to last. The hardware and construction is first rate everything is made from heavy duty components from the carabiner clip to the coated metal cable. Reach is very good the working distance is around 27 inches from the body of the key chain, good fro just about everyone.
The cord extends and retracts smoothly each time and the carabienr clip allows you to connect it to just about anything. Great for badges where the constant extension and retraction causes normal cables to break. Hopefully this means no more lost badges at work.

title: 4.5 stars - Versatile, easy-to-use budget/bill paying organizer
text:
This is a versatile budget/bill paying organizer. First of all, I like the look and the feel of the cover. Then I love all the accessories that come with it. There are budget sheets, lined sheets for notes, tabbed dividers, and zippered storage bags that can be placed inside the binder. There are also stickers that can be used on the bags or the pages to help organize it and just to make it more fun to use. There are also slots in the front of the binder that would hold cards and loops for holding pens.

On the negative side, there are so many accessories that there is no way they could all fit into the binder. The rings would have to be large to hold all of the items, especially the zipper bags. From the description of the item, I think the bags are meant to hold cash for people who use that type of budgeting system. I would prefer using them for receipts or reference information I need for budgeting or bill-paying. Overall, this is a useful and easy-to-use tool to help with organizing your budget and/or bills.

title: Really cute Thanksgiving cards
text: These are really cute Thanksgiving cards. The quality is good and for cuteness, you can't go wrong with Snoopy and Woodstock!

title: Everything you need to seal your boxes
text: This set contains quality tape that is strong and sticks well to your boxes. It’s nice that it comes with a dispenser and extra rolls to have on hand. This would work well for moving or to have for shipping items. This gives you everything you need to easily seal a box.

title: Love this handy item
text: I love this add-on accessory for my Erin Condren journal. It can be used as a bookmark and can be easily relocated wherever you want within your journal or you can leave it at the front for easy reference. I love that both sides can be written on with a wet erase marker to keep track of to-do lists in an overall list format on one side or by day of the week on the other. I am so happy with this item!

title: Cute set of four floral, spiral notebooks
text: I am happy with this set of four notebooks. They are smaller than the average spiral notebook, and would work well as a journal or to keep handy for note-taking. The notebooks have sturdy spiral wires and hard covers. I like the pretty floral patterns but the colors aren’t quite as bright as what they appear in the photo. The pages are lined and easy to write on with either ballpoint or gel pens. The set allows you to treat yourself to a cute set of notebooks or split up and use some or all as gifts.

title: Fun set of novelty pens
text: I like that this set of colorful pens includes a variety of different designs. Most have a cactus design, but some have a flower, while others are designed like a blade of grass or an ear of corn. A few of the cactus pens have silly sayings on them like “Sunny Day” or “Don’t Touch Me”, but those would be cute for kids. This set would be great to get and split up for stocking stuffers or party favors. The pens seem fairly sturdy for this type of novelty pen. I was also pleasantly surprised with how well these fine tip markers write. Overall, I’m pleased with this set of pens.

title: Good quality cartridge replacement for your HP printer
text: Good replacement ink cartridge that snaps right in and connects quickly. Snap them in and run the maintenance head alignment program and you are good to go. My only issue was having to run the alignment program more than once to get it working right, but that is probably more of a HP issue than a cartridge issue.

title: Great set of well-made Christmas cards
text: I love having a variety of cards to send and in this set of 30 cards, each card has a different design. The card stock is sturdy and the designs are cute. 15 stickers are included which is nice for putting on the envelopes, but it would be better if there was one sticker for every card. The envelopes are plain white, nothing fancy, but are sturdy. I am happy with this set and am looking forward to sending them to family and friends this Christmas.

title: Nice to have for your home office
text: Since tabs for hanging files can get lost, bent, or broken, it's nice to have extra tabs to use for replacing old tabs or if you just need additional tabs. They are easy to use and since they are clear, it's easy to read your labels through them.

title: Cute set of holiday photo frame cards
text: These paper frames are great for using as holiday cards. A 4x6 photo slides into the front of the card fairly easily and stays in the card securely. I think the frames will work best for horizontal photos. They would work well as stocking stuffers or a card to go along with a Christmas present. The holly design is cute and I look forward to using them this holiday season.

title: 2.5 stars - Disappointed in this set of pens - only has three different colors
text:
I am disappointed in this set of pens. It is described as a set of twelve medium point pens, with “thick vibrant gel ink” in assorted colors. However, the pens write like a fine-point pen with a thin line of writing.
In addition, my set didn’t come with anywhere near the colors that are shown in the picture. I received three different colors - Pink, Blue, and Green (four pens in each of these three colors.)

The green is a nice shade and is a little darker than the outside color of the pen. The blue is a medium shade that is lighter than the typical blue ballpoint pen but the ink is easy to read. Pink is usually my favorite color, but this ink is a little too light and bright, more like a highlighter. It was hard to read notes I had taken using the pink pen. The green and the blue are okay and I will probably use them, but I prefer a thicker point and wanted a larger variety of colors than just pink, blue, and green.

title: 3.5 stars - Great cards but envelopes are flimsy and don’t have glue
text:
I love this set of six birthday cards, but am disappointed in the envelopes. Each card has a different design including gold foil and/or glitter. All are blank inside and have a green insert made of lightweight paper. It makes the card look nice, but is loose inside the card and needs to be glued down if you use it.

The best thing about this set is the cute designs of the cards and the nice quality of the card stock. It’s the envelopes that bring my overall rating down. I like the pearly finish of the envelopes, but unfortunately they’re flimsy. The worst part is there is no glue on the envelopes! I will have to figure out a way to easily glue them when I want to mail one of the cards. For hand-delivering, they’re fine because you can just tuck in the flap to close it.

title: Really cute set of Snoopy Easter Cards
text: I couldn't be happier with this set of Easter cards! The design with Snoopy is adorable and the simple messsage makes is suitable for both friends and family. The quality of the cardstock is also nice. so I was pleased to send these cards this year.

title: I love this set of pens!
text: I really like the way this type of BiC pen writes, but could only find it in red, black, or blue. I was so excited to set of pens with so many fun colors. My favorites are the purple, pink, and teal. I like writing with different colored ink and these pens are fantastic.

title: Cute collection of Valentines
text: I love this basic, but cute set of Valentines. I like that there are four designs making it easier to find the ideal card for each person I want to send one to. The card stock quality is nice and the colors are pretty and bright.

title: 3.5 stars - Cute organizer, but not as sturdy as I thought it would be
text: This is an expandable, accordion-style organizer. It can be used to organize files, paperwork, clippings, or other items. I’m using it to temporarily sort some old photos before putting them in separate containers for storage. I like the black and pink color. This works fine for what I’m using this for, but it’s much thinner than I expected. I don’t think it’s sturdy enough to hold up for frequent use, though.

title: Attractive hard-covered journal
text: This spiral journal has a hardcover with an attractive floral pattern. The paper is heavier than average notebook paper and is college ruled to make it easier to write in. The spiral also makes it easier to use. It has an elastic band that can be used as a bookmark. My favorite feature is a pocket in the back for keeping papers handy within the journal. It is sturdy, yet lightweight enough to make it easy to carry with you whenever you want.

title: Versatile set of four notebooks/journals
text: I am always looking for notebooks to have around the house and love this set of four. They are simple and lightweight enough that they can be used as regular notebooks, but also with nice enough covers and paper quality that they can also be used as journals. I like the four different colors - pastel pink, green, blue, and tan with a complementary-colored well-made spiral ring. I’m already using one and I love it.

title: Beautiful birthday card
text:
This is a beautiful deluxe birthday card that looks handcrafted, but is so much nicer than I could do myself! The paper quality is very sturdy and nice. There is even a lining inside the envelope to match the wood look on the front of the card, as well as a matching sticker for the outside of the envelope.

The card is blank inside so you can write your own greeting. There is a separate paper inside to add to the homemade look of the card, but I wish it would have been attached to the front part of the card somehow and not just folded and included loose inside the card. It takes away from the overall look of the card, so I would really rate the card 4.5 stars. I gave the card to someone in person, but due to the weight, it might require extra postage to mail.

title: Cute floral Christmas cards, but wish they came in a box or even a bag for safe storage
text:
I really like the floral design of these holiday cards. They aren’t deluxe, but are of above average quality. The cardstock is nice and the envelopes are average, but I like that they are red. The front of the card is pretty and inside is a simple, sincere greeting.

I knocked my rating down ½ star, though, because of the way they are packaged. When I opened the shipping box, I expected to find another smaller box, which is the way most greetings cards are packaged. Instead, cards and envelopes started falling from the box onto the floor, There wasn’t even a bag inside to keep them together. I had to put the into a bag to keep until I’m ready to start sending my Christmas cards this year.

title: Basic planner that does the job well
text:
I really like the format of this planner. I have been using one that is the same brand and style in 2021 and I love it. The pattern on the cover is different from last year, but the layout inside is the same. There is a large calendar for each month that covers two pages, so there is lots of room to write notes for each today . There is also extra room in the margin for additional notes, and I’ve been using that for Monthly To-Do items or notes that are specific to a certain date. Before each month’s calendar, there are also two pages for other notes. It is divided into sections for Checking In Wellness, Gratitude, Items to start doing, keep doing, or stop doing and then a general note section.You can use these items as labeled or in other ways. There are also several blank pages at the back of the planner for free form notes.

I’m pleased with the quality of the paper and how thin the overall planner is because it makes it easy to carry with me in a tote bag or computer bag. It may not be fancy, but it is perfect for my needs and I’m so glad I will have the same kind of planner for 2022, as well!

title: Nice pen, notepad, sticky note set for taking notes when you're on-the-go
text: I really like this mini notebook set. When you open the item, inside is a small plastic ruler, small pen, lined memo pads, small envelope, and sticky notes. All these great writing accessories are inside a compact notebook that has an elastic band to keep it closed. The memo pad has smooth quality paper and the small envelope is great for storing completed notes or would also hold business cards. This is a great little writing set that fits well in a purse, tote bag, backpack, or to keep in a car. It would make a nice stocking stuffer, too.

title: Beautiful bookmark that readers will love
text:
Such a pleasing presentation with the bookmark secured inside a gift box. The main part of the book is wooden with a beautiful design that has the appearance of being painted on. The wood is thick enough that the bookmark isn’t flimsy, but thin enough to fit well inside a book.

There is a short cord at the top with beads. I have to admit I was skeptical by the description that said the beads glow in the dark. However, after leaving it out in natural or artificial light for about 20 minutes,I brought it into a dark part of the house and little specks inside the two beads were glowing! It looked so pretty, but it didn’t remain glowing for very long. I got this for myself, but this would be great for a smaller gift or to give to someone along with a book for a present.

title: Journal with gorgeous, colorful pages
text:
Journal - 5 stars - Journal with gorgeous, colorful pages 7/25
The soft padded cover is satisfactory and closes with a magnetic clasp. The butterfly on the clasp detracts from the look of the journal and looks a little juvenile. There is a ribbon bookmark that is attached that would be better if it was a little wider.

However, it’s the pages of the journal itself that make this product such a gem. The colorful pages in this journal are ALMOST too beautiful to write on, but when you do you’ll find a smooth surface for both pens and markers. The beautiful illustrations will inspire you to fill the pages with writing or drawings of your own. The journal is perfect to treat yourself or to give as a gift to an aspiring writer or artist.

title: Bafial silicone tags are great for tagging your bags.
text: These silicone bag tags are a great way to tag your bags. The metallic connector wont break or fail losing your tag and these show enough info to identify  your bag but not give too much information. If you are needing a set of great looking highly functional bag tags these are it.

title: Perfect accessory for my Erin Condren journal
text: I had been using some inexpensive magnetic bookmarks to mark my place in my journal and then I found this product. The bookmarks are cute and go well with several of the Erin Condren journal covers. They are easy to insert, remove, and reposition in the journal and are made to fit perfectly with the size of the spiral rings of an Erin Condren journal. I am so glad I found and purchased these bookmarks.

title: Versatile clips for office, home office, or the kitchen
text: These clips are versatile and can be used in the office to help organize and to clip papers together. I had to squeeze the clip fairly hard to get them to open, but what’s good about that is that they hold items securely. I have also used them to clip a small chip bag closed and it worked well for that, too. They seem like they’re sturdy and I know they won’t break if I drop them the way plastic clips often do. If they were magnetic they would be even better, but even without magnets, they do the job.

title: Cute set of two bookmarks for book lovers
text: I’m very pleased with how cute these feather bookmarks are. Both bookmarks are a shiny gold metallic color and each has a different charm on a chain. One charm is an oyster with a pearl-colored bead inside. The other charm is my favorite and is a pretty turquoise-colored scallop seashell. The bookmarks work well in books of various sizes. I got the bookmarks for myself and love them, but they would make a great gift for any book lover.

title: Cute Valentines for teens and adults
text: The description of these cards say they’re for kids. However, the designs and cute sayings make these cards more suited for both teens and adults to send. There are four different designs and you get two of each, for a total of eight cards.  I’m happy with the high quality of both the card stock and the envelopes and can’t wait to send these cards to my family and friends for the upcoming Valentine’s holiday.

title: Attractive pop-up card to send to golf-lovers
text: The first thing I noticed about this card is the nice, bright colors. The fact that it’s a pop-up card makes it even better. There is a golfer on the front of the card and then when you open it, the ball moves into the hole on the inside of the card. The card stock is a nice quality. The envelope is a bright lime green. It may have been better if it were a different shade of green, but it is bright and cheery. The saying in the card is a little corny but this is still a fun birthday card to send to anyone who loves golf.

title: Getting organized has never been so fun!
text:
I love this planner notepad! I have tried calendars and monthly planners to get organized in past year’s, but something about this type of weekly notepad really works for me. Each page has a cute, floral border and then a grid for each day of the week and an extra lined section to the right of the grid. The days of the week are pre-printed but not dates so this can be used whenever you want. Monday through Thursday are at the top and Friday through Sunday are at the bottom with the extra space for general “to-dos” for the week. You can either tear the current week’s sheet off for quick reference or use it on the pad so you can make notes on the next week if you want. I plan to write in the dates two weeks at a time.

It’s obviously early in the year, but so far I am loving the format and the pad itself. There is plenty of space to write for each day and the extra blank spaces are great for notes for the week as a whole. Once an item is done, I get the satisfaction of physically marking it off my list. The paper is good quality and smooth to write on with either an ink pen or gel pen. Getting organized has never been so fun!

title: Adorable wall calendar for cat lovers
text: I purchased this wall calendar for a gift. The recipient really liked it and said each picture is adorable. This is a nice item for yourself for work or home and also makes a great gift for cat lovers.

title: Great idea! Love these dual-tipped highlighters
text: Sometimes you want to highlight a book or document in different colors and these dual-tipped highlighters make it easy to do. Instead of having to juggle two different highlights, this pen has yellow on one end and pink on the other. This makes it so convenient to have both colors handy in one pen. Both work well, but the pink goes on a little easier and it brighter than the yellow. These are great for home, school, or office.

title: Icasso mouse pad helps my workstation maintain ergonomic assistance when using my mouse
text: Icasso mouse pad is a good looking mouse pad that helps maintain proper ergonomic position when using my mouse. The mouse pad has a nice looking design that reminds me of an ocean scene, both bright and clear in the design. The wrist rest helps keep proper alignment when using a mouse helping to relive any carpel tunnel issues or strain. A great addition to any workspace.

title: 4.5 stars - Magnetic bookmarks with beautiful designs
text: I was looking for a way to keep my place in books while reading outside and am happy to have found it with these magnetic bookmarks. Paper bookmarks slip out or blow away and paper clips can bend the pages. These magnetic bookmarks hold well onto the pages of my book, both in and outdoors without bending, creasing, or damaging the pages in any way. I love that there is a large variety of colors and floral designs. Many of them look like miniature watercolor paintings and all are very pretty. I am not sure how they will hold up over time, but there are plenty in the package for extras and enough to share with others as stocking stuffers are to go with the gift of a book.

title: These legal-sized pages protectors do the job
text: These legal size page protectors are made so they can be inserted into a binder for work, school, or home documents. I have used some in a binder but also outside a binder to keep documents I refer to often, such as phone numbers and they work well for that, too. The sheets are clear so you can easily read the papers inside. Great for protecting. Storing, or transporting important and/or frequently used documents.

title: Classic, elegant holiday cards
text: This is a cute set of six holiday cards, three each of two designs. I like the subtle colors mixed with the gold foil in the design on the front of the cards. The messages are simple and sincere, one referencing a Merry Christmas and the other Happy Holidays. The card stock is very nice and paired with the plain red envelope results in a classic, elegant look that I will be proud to send my friends and family.

title: Nice 3D Spongebob card that could be a little brighter
text: This is a fun birthday card for kids or anyone who is a Spongebob fan. I really like the 3D Spongebob on the front. I like the bright yellow envelope, but wish the colors on the card popped a little bit more. There were faint gray marks on part of the outside of the card and inside the card. It almost looked like some of the black print from the card had not dried correctly and partially smeared on the card, but maybe it was supposed to be part of the design. Either way, I didn’t care for it. It detracted from the look of the card, but the marks were light enough that I was still able to send the card. It is going to a child, so I think it will be okay.

title: Beautiful set of four pop-up holiday cards
text: I really love this set of pop-up cards and can’t wait to send them. Three of the cards are definitely Christmas cards and the red and green colors are very vivid. One of these cards has a pop-up Christmas tree, one has Santa, and another opens to reveal a sleigh full of presents. I'm glad one of the cards is light blue and white and has a pop-up snowman inside with a general “Happy Holidays” message. I really appreciate the variety of the fours cards. The envelopes are nice, too. They are white and are lined with gold foil inside and provide a nice touch with the beautiful cards.

title: Perfect Pop-up card for the Star Wars fan
text: This pop-up card with R2-D2 is adorable. It’s easy to pop up and has designs on both the front and the back with R2-D2, wearing a Santa hat, surrounded by colorful packages. It is cute just to look at, but then it gets even better. As indicated on the front of the card, if you press a button, “R2-D2” plays “We Wish you a Merry Christmas”. As the song is playing, red and green lights flash. This is the perfect Christmas card for the Star Wars fan in your life. You can use it to share your holiday message and then the recipient will have a cute decoration to display for the holidays.

title: Beautiful pop-up poinsettia card for Christmas
text: This is a very pretty pop-up card for Christmas. The card folds out to make a 3D poinsettia arrangement which makes a cute decoration as well as sharing holiday greetings. I like the rich red and greens on the card, and there is glitter on the flowers to make them look even prettier. My only complaint is the envelope is an entirely different shade of green than those on the card and really clashes. I don’t care for that, but still really like the card and will be sending it to a special family member this Christmas.

title: Cute set of eight Christmas cards with four different designs
text: This is a set of eight Christmas cards with two each of four different designs. There is a card with Christmas lights on the front, one that says “Happy Holidays” in bright letters, one with a snowman, and one with penguins. The card that just says “Happy Holidays” has a Christmas tree as the “A” and an ornament as the “O”. The card stock is fairly sturdy and although the envelopes are plain, I like that they are a bright red color. They will be great for sending to either friends or family

title: Great looking keychains only issue is they run a bit small
text: These expandable key chains look good. The colors are deep and well done. The material is good quality and I do not see any inconsistencies in the material in color or thickness. The issue is these are really small. They would be good for children and small frame adults but most adults would not be comfortable with these on their wrist.

title: These look good but are a bit on the small side.
text: These expandable key chains look good, bright and colorful. The material is good quality and I do not see any inconsistencies in the material in color or thickness. They are well made, but the issue is they are really small. They would be good for children and small frame adults, but my husband has to almost pull these apart to get them over his hand due to their size.

title: Four basic sets of index cards and holders do the job
text: This item consists of four identical sets of index cards and holders. The holders have a basic design and an elastic band that loops over a snap to keep the holder closed and your cards secure. Each holder also includes a set of white, lined index cards. In addition, there are five thin plastic cards with tabs to separate and categorize your cards. There are tiny stickers that can be used to label the tabs. These sets are great for organizing recipes, school research notes, flash cards, business projects, or other notes you keep on index cards. I have names and addresses on cards, so this is a compact way to store them and keep them organized.

title: I like the variety of designs and sizes of these sticky notes
text: This set includes a nice variety of different colors, designs, and sizes of sticky notes. The sizes range from smaller flags to a large pad that could be used for a daily to-do list. Each individual note is easy to remove from the pad without tearing. The pads are all placed on a piece of cardboard. The whole thing would fit nicely in a desk drawer for easy access. If you don’t have that kind of space, then each pad could be removed from the cardboard and used individually. I like that option because then I can keep a pad or two in different places to keep them handy and leave others on the cardboard to keep them organized. They stick fairly well and have a smooth writing surface, so I’m happy with this set.

title: Cute designs and quality card stock makes this an excellent set of Halloween cards
text: These are described as children’s cards, but the set I received is suitable for anyone. I love the variety and the quality of the cards. There are six different card designs:  an orange pumpkin, a black cat, a haunted house, a witch, a black pumpkin filled with words, and a spider web. All except the spider web cards have a short message on the front and all are blank inside. The card stock is a very nice quality. It is not at all flimsy and looks like a much more expensive card. The plain white envelopes are very basic, but are sturdy and do the job. I love this set and can’t wait to start sending them to my friends and family.

title: Basic, but cute and versatile calendar
text:
This is a small calendar that is designed to be hung on a work cubicle. It has a clever design to make it easy to hang up. I got it for the small size because I can carry it with me if needed but the squares for each day are large enough to write small notes. Each month has a morder of different graphics that correspond to the month, such as white snowflakes on a blue background for January and pastel flowers for April. The calendar runs from July 2020 through December 2021.

There is a list of major holidays in the U.S. and Canada for 2020 through 2022 at the front of the calendar. The reverse side of each month has a place for notes and a to-do list. However, it would be hard to access this feature if you had the calendar hanging up. A nice bonus is the two sheets of small stickers that can be used on the calendar for events such as a birthday, doctor’s appointment, meeting, deadline, and more. They’re fun to use and save space, allowing additional things to be written in for that day. Overall, this is a basic, but cute, versatile calendar for your home, office, or home office.

title: Pretty planner for 2021 that also includes space for journaling each month
text:
This is a soft-covered planner that has a few unique features. I was hoping for something small enough to carry with me in my larger sized purse. It’s my fault for not looking closer at the dimensions of this planner, which are 8 ½ by 11 inches. This planner would be great if you have a desk in your office or home office or if you are carrying a tote bag to and from work, but isn’t going to work for what I had intended. That being said, the planner itself is pretty nice and is made of sturdy paper. It could be used as a combination planner/journal. It has attractive pink and green floral pictures on each page. There is a large grid spread out over two opposite pages for each month in 2021 with plenty of room to write notes in for each day and overall notes for the month.

Before the grid for the month, there are two pages that can be used for planning and journaling. I like that this planner combines a place to write in important dates and appointments with room for simple journaling. Since it’s all together, it is more likely that I will keep up with the journaling aspect. There is a place to record highlights or accomplishments from the previous month, a section for wellness goals, a place to record things you are currently grateful for, priorities for the month on things to start, stop, and continue as well as room for free form notes. There are several blank pages at the end of the planner that can be used however you want.

I wish the soft cover was a little less prone to bending and creasing. I’m not sure how it will wear over the coming year. I am starting off with a couple of small creases because the planner was sent in a thinner mailing envelope and had some damage in transit. However, as a whole I’m pleased with the planner. It’s a simple planner, yet it has some unique features that make it stand out from others that are similar.

title: Nice set of gel pens with a variety of colors
text: This set of fourteen gel pens has a nice variety of colors. The color of the pen lets you know the ink color. The pens are easy to grip and write smoothly. They are described as medium point, but I think they’re closer to fine. The pen set includes several colors including different shades of pink, purple, blue, and green in addition to the standard black, blue, and red. The yellow and lime green ink are too light for my purposes, writing in planners and journals that have white paper, but the other colors are great. I think this set is better suited for writing and possibly sketching as opposed to coloring.

title: Pretty Christmas cards with a sincere greeting inside
text: These Christmas cards have a pretty picture on the front and a nice, sincere greeting inside the card. The card stock is sturdy so I like that I’ll be sending something nice to friends and family. I like that the envelopes are red but considering this is a Hallmark product, I think they’re a little flimsy. However, overall I’m pleased with the cards and look forward to using them this holiday season.

title: Colorful plastic envelopes to help you get organized
text: This item includes four plastic envelopes, each a different color. They won’t hold a large quantity, but work well for organizing magazine clippings,photographs, or other papers. They would also work well for storing or transporting documents to prevent them from being wrinkled or torn. I like that the envelopes are plastic since they won’t bend or tear over time. The snap helps to make sure smaller items don’t fall out of the envelope. I have found them useful for sorting photographs that I haven’t yet put in albums or scrapbooks.

title: Good set of mechanical pencils with #2 lead
text:
The lead in these pencils is stronger than in some mechanical pencils I’ve used and that is the best thing about them. The eraser works, but could do a better job of completely erasing what you’ve written. I like the variety of colors that comes with this package of pencils.

The grip near the bottom of the pencil makes it easy to hold. The pencil is light, but feels substantial in your hand when you’re writing with it.I like having pencils for puzzle books and these work well. The pencils would be good for school as well since they have #2 lead.

title: Cute journal with several nice features making it a good choice for yourself or a gift
text:
I like that this journal has a hard cover to protect the pages but is still lightweight enough to slip in a larger purse or tote bag. The bright floral pattern on the front and back covers is cherry and the paper inside is good quality. The spiral rings are doubled up to make the journal more sturdy, and I like that it lays flat making it easier to write in. The pages have dots to help you if using it to write in but don’t overpower the page if you’re using the journal for sketching.

The journal has a couple of extras that make it especially nice. There is a plastic rule/bookmark that can be moved throughout the journal to mark your place. There is a pocket on the back cover for holding notes, clippings, and other items. It also includes one sheet of small stickers to decorate your journal pages. Some of the stickers seem more suited for use in a planner, like the reminders for a doctor’s or vet appointment, but I will definitely use some of the others. Finally, there is an elastic band that fits around the entire journal to keep in closed when storing or transporting. This is a cute and useful journal that would also make a nice gift, especially if paired with more stickers or a nice pen or marker set.

title: 4.5 stars, Cute journal with lots of extras
text:
This journal is well made with wide spiral rings and a hard cover. Each page opens flat, making it easy to write in the journal. The paper is smooth and of what I would consider medium weight and has a nice surface for writing, especially with a gel pen.

I like the extra touches included with the journal. There is an elastic band that goes around the journal to keep it closed. There is also a pocket in the back for keeping notes or other papers. The journal comes with a plastic ruler/bookmark that can be moved to different locations within the journal. It also comes with stickers. Some are fun graphics such as smiley faces and balloons. Others, such as reminders about appointments, would be more suitable for a planner instead of a journal.

One thing that could be improved is the writing on the cover. I love the cacti graphics, and It’s fine that it says “Journal” in gold. However, I would have preferred if the words “Dot Grid” weren’t also included on the cover.

title: I really like this set of six plastic folders
text: This item consists of a set of six 2-pocket plastic folders. Each of the folders in the set is a different color, and I like how bright the colors are. Plastic folders are great because they don’t tear like a traditional paper folder and don’t wear out as easily. I am using the folders to organize miscellaneous papers and magazine clippings, but they are also perfect for school or a home office. The folders have a pocket on each side and slots for a card or label on one of the pockets. The folders do NOT have the brads in the center for holding papers. This is the type of folder I wanted so it would be flatter when closed, but it all depends on what you need.

title: Great way to get organized
text:
I was looking for a way to organize various magazine articles, clippings, and recipes I have, and these pouches work perfectly. This is a set of three and all are different colors. Each is a letter sized pouch that is made like a folder, except with an opening only at the top. I like the bright colors of the back and tabs that make them stand out in my file cabinet. The front is clear so you can see what is in each one.

There is an additional pocket on the front as well as a smaller zipper pouch. This gives you even more flexibility to organize the contents by size or type of item/topic. The zipper pouch could also be used to keep small keepsakes like ticket stubs. You could also put an index card in the very front to list the contents. This is a very helpful product in my constant battle to declutter and keep things organized.

title: Clips do the job and love that there are so many colors
text: I am happy with this set of eight clips. I love that each one is different color and that there are three different designs. All of the designs work equally well. The magnet on the back is small, but it holds well on the refrigerator to use to hold photos or notes or just for storage when not in use on a chip bag.The clips are easy to open and close and work well to secure chip bags or cereal bags to keep the contents from getting stale after the bag has been opened. They seem sturdy so I’m pleased with these clips.

title: Truly unique and beautiful journal for writing or sketching
text:
The inside pages have different designs and are like miniature works of art. It’s almost too pretty to use, but I am using it and it makes me smile each time I do. I am an avid reader, so I am using it to list favorite books, characters, meaningful quotes I come across, and other things. I am not an artist but the pages would be inspiring for those who do to add their own sketches. I think it would be perfect for poetry as well.

This journal has a hard cover on the outside that has an embossed deer. (The description says it glows in the dark, but mine doesn’t even remotely glow.) There is an attached ribbon bookmark to keep your place in the book. Inside, the paper is excellent quality and provides a smooth surface on which to write. Some of the pages are mostly blank with just a deer and different types of flowers in the corner. Other pages have a colorful nature scene that includes a deer. I’ve never seen a journal like this one and am so pleased to have it.

This journal is perfect to treat yourself or would make a wonderful gift for a birthday, graduation, or other special occasion.

title: Cute card, but arrived slightly damaged
text:
Pop-up cards are fun and this is a cute card. It isn’t as elaborate as some of the pop-up cards that are out there, but the airplane is made to look three-dimensional and the smoke coming out of the plane is what pops up when you open the card. The card reminds me of a well-made home-made card. The graphics and message are basic, and the card is gender neutral and would work well for all ages.

I wish the packaging would have been sturdier because the card and envelope arrived somewhat bent in one corner. It was still okay to send, but it needed more protection than the mailing envelope provided in transit.

title: Great set of versatile markers
text:
This set has twelve different colored markers ranging from yellow to black. The colors are true to the cap color so you can easily select the color you like. I like the versatility of the chisel tips. You can write legibly with them and also create bold lines. The pink, yellow, and bright green markers also work well as highlighters.Even the darker colors don’t bleed through the page. The variety of colors and the versatile tip make these markers perfect for planners or journals, but could also be used for coloring.

The markers are odor-free when using. When I think of the Sharpie brand, I think of markers that have permanent ink. However, nowhere on the package or in the description does it say that these markers are permanent and from what I’ve read, I don’t think they are. As long as that isn’t what you’re looking for, this is a nice set of markers.

title: Good quality, good-looking blank inside birthday cards
text:
The set includes six different “Happy Birthday” designs, all using attractive pastel colors, on the front of the card and blank inside so you can customize with your own greeting. They are made from nice, heavy card stock. They are thick enough that markers work well for writing a greeting or adding a drawing or sketch. I’m no artist, so I used stickers that I already had for some color and fun on the inside of the card. I was pleased to see that there are several different color envelopes that complement all the various colors on the cards. The cards are suitable to be sent to all ages and are gender neutral.

I like having different cards on hand for friends and family and this set is perfect. A couple of the cards have a colorful background and then the “Happy Birthday” greeting inside a square in the center. I think crafty people could customize this with card stock or a large sticker and actually use the card for another occasion especially since they are completely blank inside. All in all, this is a great set of cards to have. The sturdy box they come in makes it easy to store them until they’re needed.

title: Nice variety of stickers for greeting cards or crafts
text: This product consists of five sheets of stickers bound together like a memo pad. Each sheet is different and there are a little over ninety stickers in all. The stickers are good quality and very colorful. There is a wide selection of different types of stickers, from birthday and holiday theme stickers with some with phrases such as “Smile” and “Be the Change.” There is also a page that would be cute for borders in a small scrapbook or custom greeting card. Some would also work well to decorate a school or personal planner. They also look cute inside a greeting card and outside on the envelope. These stickers have just the variety I was looking for to help personalize the greeting cards I send.

title: Door stops don’t have to be boring!
text: This is an adorable door stop that is a much cuter alternative to a plain wedge-shaped door stop. The door stop isn’t that heavy but does the job holding the door. I’m glad to have this doorstop - no more scrambling to find a heavy box or something to prop the door open. This doorstop looks cute sitting by the door when not in use and then looks nice while holding the door open as well.

title: Great set of four dry erase markers work well in my Erin Condren journal
text: I received an Erin Condren journal as a gift and needed some fine-tipped dry erase markers to use on a checklist inside the front cover. I looked at a few different types, but decided on getting the Erin Condren brand markers. I trusted the brand to work best with their journal and I'm not disappointed. I like the four different colors in this set. They work well in my journal and I can use the different colors to call attention to various items on my list. It takes a tissue and a little bit of effort to erase but they do erase cleanly. I'm happy with my purchase of these markers.

title: Versatile, quality cards that let you get creative
text: I'm very happy with this set of cards. The card stock and envelopes are a good quality. The basic design is there on the front of the card for you. Stickers are provided to customize the card. I have used the cards so far for Mother's Day, a birthday, and a "thinking of you" card. I've used the stickers provided and added some of my own on the inside to further customize the card. I've also used markers both in and out to add some color to the cards. I have had fun customizing and sending cards from this set.

title: Fun to see the colors change, works well for coloring books for adults
text:
I love markers and couldn’t resist trying these color-changing markers. The markers are double-tipped and the main colors include brown, orange, and yellow, as well as different shades of purple, blue, green, and pink. The other end looks white but when you go over part or all of what you wrote, drew, or colored using the other side, it will change the color. For example, the purple changes to a neon green and the brown changes to a bright yellow-green. Most will get lighter, but things written or drawn with the yellow marker will change to purple. I’ve not seen anything like this before and I had fun experimenting with the different colors.

Depending on the color, when you go over writing, it can be hard to read the lighter color, so that was a little disappointing. I had the best results when using them in coloring books for adults for an easy way to get different colors using the same marker and enjoyed using them.

title: 4.5 stars, cute and useful set of sticky notes in an attractive portfolio
text:
This is a really cute flowered portfolio that contains a variety of different sticky notes. I really like the variety of colors and sizes. First of all, I like that the cover of the portfolio has a floral design. There are six different colors of “flag” sticky notes and there are two different designs of small notes. There are also two medium-sized notepads, both with different pastel colors and with tabs. One of these pads has polka-dots and the other solid colors. There is also one tablet of larger notes that have tabs and are lined. These notes will be great for writing to-do lists or other types of lists. They even have boxes that can be used to write in dates, priorities, or to check off completed items.

This is a versatile set of sticky notes and would be cute to go in a gift basket or as a stocking stuffer. The only downside is the medium and large sized notes can be hard to cleanly remove from the tablet without tearing them, especially if you want one of the colors toward the back of the pad. I’m still very happy with this set of sticky notes.

title: Perfect paper clips for dog lovers
text: This is an adorable set of paper clips for home, school, or your home office. There are two designs - dogs and bones. The clips come in a variety of colors including silver, black, metallic orange, neon green, metallic purple, and metallic hot pink. They are really cute, and I was pleasantly surprised at how well they hold papers. This is a fun alternative to ordinary paper clips. They even come with a metal tin with an easy to remove lid for easy storage. I recommend these clips for any dog lovers.

title: Good set of markers for crafting
text:
This is a nice set of markers for making greeting cards and other crafts. Press down on the pen once and then start writing. Most have a hint of color on the outside with a shiny silver in the middle. My favorites are the dark blue and the purple because I like the contrast of those colors with the silver the best. The yellow looks more like a highlighter with a little silver and the writing is hard to read. The pink didn’t have any silver at all, but I don’t know if it was supposed to.

I first tried the markers on some fairly heavy paper in a journal but they bled through to the other side of the page. They worked better on card stock, but you still need to have a light touch or there will still be some bleed-through. They won’t work for every project, but I’m glad to have this set of markers as part of my craft supplies.

title: Nice set of eight unique birthday cards
text:
I’m happy with this set of eight birthday cards, each of which has a different design and message. The designs are cute and the card stock is a substantial thickness. The cards are described as birthday cards for women. This is true for the majority of the cards, but there are a couple that could be sent to anyone. The envelopes aren’t fancy, but are sturdy and are easy to seal.

What I really like about the cards is how colorful the insides are. Most of the inside messages are in color. In addition, there are some color graphics inside that coordinate with the outside. The cute designs, simple messages, and colors inside make these cards unique. I’m happy to have these cards available to send to friends and family for their special day.

title: Smead hanging folders holds tons of documents and are sturdy to last for years
text:
Smead hanging folders are sturdy enough to handle a full file without failing. These are expandable to about a half inch across the bottom giving lots of room for documents. The hanger assembly is sturdy enough to support a full file without pulling apart.
The folders allow you to organize your documents for quick access. This system makes for a sturdy and efficient filing system.

title: Nice journal with numbered pages
text:
This journal has a sturdy leather-like cover. I like the blue color with the white band at the bottom. HoweverI wish the front didn’t have “Elite Notebook Dotted” and a sketch of what the pages look like embossed in the front. In spite of that, the item has many other features I like. It has a loop on the side in which you can place a pen. There is also an elastic band that goes around the whole journal. There are two thin ribbons that can be used for bookmarks in the journal. The pages are smooth and easy to write on and have faint dots in the background to help keep your writing aligned.

One unique feature of this journal is that the pages are numbered. In addition, there is a blank page at the front of the journal for a table of contents and you can write in items you’ve added to your journal with the corresponding page numbers. I don’t know if I’ll have a reason to use that, but I appreciate that unique feature. Another helpful feature is the pouch/envelope in the back for storage. All in all, this is a nice journal I look forward to using.

title: Excellent set of gel pens
text: This set comes with twelve gel pens, four black, four red, and four blue. I’ve always had good results from permanent markers made by Sharpie and like these gel pens equally well. Each of the pens have a medium point and write very smoothly. The grip at the bottom of each pen makes them comfortable to hold and easy to write with. They are click pens, so you don’t have to worry about losing a cap and your pen drying up. I’m glad I have this nice set of pens.

title: Great pens for drawing, or sketching in a handy carry case for easy access.
text: These pens have good color, line consistency, and weight of the line drawn. These pens come in a handy carry case that keeps the pens together and accessible. The quality of these for drawing or sketching are top notch, these would make a great gift for the artist in you house.

title: Large whiteboard that is great for home, school, or office
text: This is a large, dry erase white board. I love that it is magnetic so you can post notes or important papers on it. We got it for a home office, but would be great at a school, office, or a playroom. As large as it is, it was still pretty easy to hang up. As expected, it’s easy to write on and erase, so I’m happy with this item.

title: Cute Thanksgiving cards for a great price
text: I ordered these cards to send to close family members I wouldn't be able to see for Thanksgiving. The card quality is excellent, the size is great, and the price is perfect. I would highly recommend these cards.

title: Clever idea, product works well
text: This product is a combination Post-it dispenser and pen/pencil holder. I have also been keeping a stylus for tablet in the holder as well. The pencil holder is weighted so it doesn’t topple over when you put a pen or pencil in it. This is a great way to keep post-its and pens handy at home, in the office, or in a dorm room. I appreciate the clever design of this product. It could be a little more attractive, but it’s fine for my home office.

title: Beautiful blank-inside notecards for all occasions
text:
This set of 24 notecards has twelve each of two different designs. Both designs are blank inside so they can be used for multiple purposes. My favorite of the two designs is the one with the three cacti on the front. The colors are pretty but subtle and suitable for sending many types of notes or birthday greetings. The other design is three pineapples and is also cute.

The quality of the card stock and envelopes is excellent. Both are sturdy and the envelopes are lined with either a light blue or light coral color on the flap that do a great job of complementing the cards. I’m really happy with this notecard set and look forward to sending them to family and friends.

title: A Badge-holder with some bling
text: These aren’t the typical boring badge-holders. These badge-holders are shiny and sparkly and allow you to show a little personality while displaying your badge. They don’t only look good, but they work well, too. The clips easily slip onto your belt or waistband and stays on securely throughout the day. This product also includes some plastic sleeves to insert your badge or ID. The items would also make good stocking stuffers or a small gift for a co-worker.

title: Cute Halloween cards for a great price
text: I love this set of six Halloween cards. The description says they're for kids, but they are great for sending to friend or family members of all ages. These are quality cards, as expected with the Hallmark brand. I enjoyed sending these cards this year to let friends know I was thinking of them on Halloween.

title: Basic but cute set of small blank inside Christmas cards
text:
This set of Christmas cards has eight each of six different designs, for a total of 48 cards. I received the “Vintage Holidays” collection that has subtle messages and cute artwork and look the way they are pictured. All of the designs include a little bit of glitter.

Each card is blank inside to write your own message. The cards are made from sturdy cardstock and come with plain white envelopes. The background of the card is more creme colored, so I wish the envelopes were, too. Please be aware that the cards are small - about the same size or even a bit smaller than a thank you card.

The cute but simple designs, along with the blank inside makes these cards versatile for sending to family and close friends as well as co-workers and acquaintances. I like having the choice of a few similar designs when sending cards to my friends and family.

title: Well-made and cute holiday cards
text: These cards are both attractive and well-made. The card stock is thick and sturdy.  The design of the card is simple, but pretty. The cards have a homemade, crafty look without having to do the work! I like how well the red envelopes complement the cards. The cards have a basic message suitable for sending to friends as well as family. I am looking forward to sending these cards this holiday season.

title: Unique journal with handmade paper and an old-fashioned look
text: This journal has an attractive cover with the tree of life design and an old-fashioned clasp. The pages are actually made of hand-made paper which is so unusual. The paper resembles parchment, but is easier to write on. Because of its uniqueness, this journal would make a great gift. However, the box mine came in was dirty and torn so if I had planned to give this as a gift, I would have had to repackage it first. It spite of this, I’m pleased with the item. The journal is too large to carry in a purse, but would fit in a tote bag if you’re interested in bringing this with you somewhere to write or sketch.

title: FEELSO heavy duty belt ring key holder is up to any task.
text:
The FEELSO heavy duty retractable badge holder, key ring is stout and well made. The case and belt clip is metal that is heavy duty and finished in a dark grey and looks very nice. The finish is even, the edges have been rounded to make this comfortable, no stabbing in your side when you sit down. The cable is a coated metal cable that should last a long time, as well as the hardware used. The belt clip is heavy duty and is not a weak point as on some retractable holders.
In all this retractable holder will last a long time due to its heavy duty construction.

title: Simple, but elegant Christmas cards
text: I am very happy with these embossed cards. I like the simple but unique design. I also like that they are made from sturdy card stock. The envelopes are lined and go very well with the cards. The message inside is also short and to the point. I like the cards and can’t wait to send them this holiday season.

title: Adorable pop-up birthday card good for all ages
text: This pop-up birthday card is so cute! It has a dog with brightly colored balloons and has a quaint, old-fashioned look to it. It is perfect for sending to friends and family members of all ages. The card is small and is made of the quality card stock I expect from the Hallmark brand. I love this card and already have someone in mind to receive it.

title: Very cute multi-occasion card for the one you love
text: This is a cute multi-occasion card for the one you love. It would be ideal for a birthday, anniversary, Valentine’s Day, or just a “Thinking of You” card for your significant other. The card is sturdy and even cuter in person than in the photo. I’m a little disappointed in the envelope, though. It’s a little flimsy but has a cute lining. Unfortunately, it was shipped with the flap folded over and didn’t look that great even when I straightened it out. I would rate the card a 5 and the envelope a 3, so I averaged my rating to a 4.

title: Erasable markers that worked even better than I expected
text:
I have had good results with erasable pens, but I was a little skeptical about the idea of an erasable marker. I was pleasantly surprised with how well they worked. There are darks, pastels, and bright colors included in the set and each marker has an eraser on the top. I had equally good results erasing both the light and the dark colors, but all require a fair amount of pressure to completely erase what you’ve written. I use the markers for writing more than drawing, and was happy with how well the erasers worked.

Being erasable didn’t hurt the quality of how the markers write. The markers are fine-tipped, but thick enough that they write smoothly on different types of paper. I used them on a standard-weight notepad and they colors were dark enough to read, but didn’t bleed through to the other side of the paper. They also didn’t smear, which being left-handed, can be an issue for me with other markers.

title: Cute, well-made birthday card
text:
I love this birthday card that is suitable for both friends and family. I like the confetti design with just enough glitter to make it look good without being too gaudy. The message inside just says “Happy Birthday” which makes it versatile. As I would expect from the Hallmark brand, the cardstock is heavy and the card is well-made.

Note: The card isn’t overly heavy but perhaps because of the square shape, the envelope indicates it may require extra postage.

title: Attractive notebook with perforated sheets
text:
The notebook has a hard, chambray cover and back that flips open. The pages are edged gold to make the notebook look nice on desk, counter , or table. The front side of each page is lined and has a place to fill in the date. The pages are perforated making them easy to remove.

I have written in the notebook using both gel pens and ballpoint pens and had equally good results with each type of pen. I love having notepads around and this one is especially nice because it works well for to-do lists and looks good, too.

title: Great set of sticky notes
text:
I like having sticky notes handy and this portfolio is a convenient way to keep them someplace nearby and in good condition. The portfolio includes three different sizes of notes. The largest is lined and has six different colors. The other two are very close in size and each have four different colors. Each sheet has a tab, staggered according to size. The pages are are easy to remove from the pad and stick well to other pieces of paper, desktops, etc.

There is one unique thing about this set of sticky notes that I haven’t seen in others. It comes with a tablet of clear stickers that can be placed on the back of the tab portion of each sheet as you use it to keep it from tearing. I don’t need this with every note I use, but it has been useful on a few notes that I keep and refer to frequently.

title: Excellent portfolio filled with a variety of sticky notes
text:
I like sticky notes and love this portfolio filled with sticky notes. The cover is nice for imitation leather and when you open the portfolio, there are different types and sizes of sticky notes on both sides. There are six different sizes and several different bright colors. Some are tabbed, some are lined, and some have small dots in the background, and others are plain. I love having a variety of notes in one place making them easy to find. This is great for anyone who loves using sticky notes and would be a great item to give to a student.

As a bonus, there is also a cute pen with pink polka-dots and a large, imitation "diamond" on top in a rose gold setting. It's very cute and the pen writes pretty well, too.

title: I love these Snoopy and Woodstock Christmas cards
text: The cards in this set of Snoopy and Woodstock Christmas cards are adorable. There are three cards each of two different designs. Each card features Snoopy and Woodstock with glitter in the snow. and a foil border. The card with a Christmas tree on the front also has glitter in the star and the ornaments. The card stock is sturdy and the envelopes are plain, but are red which looks good with either card design. This set of cards is perfect if you only have a couple of cards to send or if you want an extra cute card for a few special people on your list.

title: This organizer has become an important part of my tote bag
text:
I didn't realize how much I needed this organizer until I got it. The description says it's for backpacks, but it works well in my tote bag and would also fit well in a laptop case. It's lightweight so it doesn't add a lot of extra weight to my already overloaded tote bag. It's perfect to keep papers and files organized and safe from wrinkles and creases while in my bag with everything else I carry.

I like the purple color of the organizer. It looks good with my floral bag but would work equally well with a black or other solid-colored laptop bag or backpack. The seven pockets lets me keep different types of papers separate and I have used some of the tabs to label the different sections so it's easy to find the paperwork I've put inside the organizer. There are two small pockets right inside the organizer that can hold business cards, but I use them for important notes to make sure I see them. The organizer closes with an elastic band that is long enough to allow for the organizer to expand when it's more full. I love the product and it would be great for students or anyone who has to bring papers back and forth to work.

title: I like this smaller sized planner for 2019
text:
I usually use a larger sized planner for my home office, but wanted to try a smaller one that is more portable. I think this planner (4 7/8 x 8 inches) is going to work well for 2019. It's small enough I can keep it handy whenever I want to make a note, but large enough to give me plenty of room to write in notes for each day. The outside cover has a basic, but attractive design.

The planner has several features I really like. In the front is a clear page that has a pocket on each side for keeping loose notes or receipts. There is a tab for each month to make it easy to find the location your looking for within the planner. My favorite part if the two-page month at a glance, in a traditional calendar format, at the beginning of each month. After that, there are two pages for every week with room to make more detailed notes.

After the December tab, there are also weekly pages for the month of January 2020, which is handy when things come up at the end of the year that you want to note for the new year before starting a separate planner for the new year. After that pages that can be used for contacts, notes, and events, such as birthdays and/or anniversaries. The last page is a list of holidays and their dates for 2019 through 2022. This planner has all the features I look for in a planner, in a smaller size. I'm looking forward to using it to get better organized in 2019!

title: 4.5 stars - Excellent gel pen set with a variety of colors
text:
I love colored pens and own several ballpoint pens by InkJoy, so I was eager to try these InkJoy gel pens. I am very happy with these pens. They write smoothly and I like the variety of colors. The description says the ink dries quickly and that is a true statement. I didn't experience any smearing when writing and as a lefty who has been dealing with smeared ink for as long as I could write, that's saying something.

I deducted 1/2 star because the barrel is just a little bigger around that I prefer. A smaller barrel or a little better grip would have been perfect, but the pens are still easy to hold and fun to write with.

title: Attractive and functional planner for home or office
text: This planner begins with January 2019 and starts with a two-page calendar for each month, followed by pages for each week. The paper is good quality and is a pretty color. The front has a clear, two-side page with a pocket on each side. The back has blank pages for notes and contacts. I like that the planner is functional, but also attractive. I like the planner a lot and can't wait to start using it.

title: Clever design - three-color, erasable pen
text:
I remember using four-color pens when I was younger and I was eager to try this pen. It has three colors (Blue, Black, and Red) and all three colors are erasable. There is a small eraser at the tip of the pen and then a larger, separate eraser that is included. The set also comes with two sets of ink refills (one with three blank ink refills and one with a red, blue, and black refill.) The ink can be erased immediately after writing and even after the ink has set for a while. The separate eraser works a little better than the one at the tip of the pen, but both do the job much better than other erasable pens I've tried in the past.

The pen is a little larger than the average pen, but especially with the grip at the bottom is easy to hold and write with. I'm really pleased with the clip on the pen and wish more pens were made like this. This clip has a spring so that it clips better without breaking off.

title: Clever way to dispense post-its for home, office, or school
text: What a clever idea for the office, home office, or dorm! This post-it cube has 6 different colors, with 30 sheets per color. When all the sheets of one color have been used, it can be refilled with a new pad. I use post-its often and this makes it easy to get to several different colors from one tidy dispenser on my desk. I love it!

title: Well-made college ruled 5-subject sprial notebooks
text:
I am very pleased with this set of two multi-subject notebooks. I like that you get two different colors and appreciate the oversized spiral rings. Each are sturdy with coated covers to give some protection against rain. Each have 200 sheets that are perforated for easy removal from the notebook. The five sections are divided by a double-sided plastic/vinyl page that has pockets on both sides.

These college-ruled notebooks are perfect for students and also to keep around the house or office for organizing various notes.

title: Unique card that looks handcrafted
text: This deluxe card is both unique and beautiful. The flower and flower pot on the front of the card look like they're handcrafted but didn't require any work on my part! The envelope is lined with gold foil to match the high quality of the card itself. I also appreciate the fact that the verse is sweet without being too sappy. I love this card, but please be aware the envelope says the card may require extra postage for mailing.

title: Smooth-writing mini-pens that can be attached to a key ring so you always have pen handy
text:
I'm really happy with this set of eight mini-pens. The ink color is the color of the pen, which is fun. The colors are nice and even the orange ink looks good and isn't too light. The pens write smoothly on a variety of paper textures.

These pens are a little different than the typical pen because of the hole in the cap which allows it to be placed on a key ring. One key ring is included for convenience. The cap is fairly easy to slide onto the key ring. I think this is a clever idea which allows pens to be kept handy in your purse, key ring, or work ID badge lanyard. I'm happy with these pens.

title: Beautiful pop-up cherry blossom in this all-occasion card
text: As pretty in person as it is in the picture. Suitable for Valentine's, a birthday, Mother's Day, or just because. I'm very happy with my purchase of this pop-up card.

title: Cute set of birthday cards with a nice variety to send to family and friends
text:
I really like this “Birthday Icons” set of birthday cards from Hallmark. The set comes with 12 cards, 3 each of 4 different designs. Each card has bright colors with a little bit of glitter to make them even cuter.

The cards are made of a thinner card stock than I would expect from Hallmark, but are still a nice quality. The variety in the designs and the messages make this a versatile set of cards to keep on hand for the birthdays of family and friends.

Outside design and messages are listed below:
1.) Happy Birthday on outside – Inside message: “You already have the birthday – this wishes you the happy!”
2.) Package on outside – Inside message: “Unwrap another year!”
3.) Cupcake on outside – Inside message: “Wishing you the most delicious birthday!”
4.) “Eat Cake” banner on outside – Inside message: “Have an awesome day!”

The cupcake card is my favorite, but I am pleased with all of the cards in this set.

title: Basic 2018 planner with some great features such as monthly tabs and photos on each page
text:
This 2018 Planner has some very useful features. I like the tabs that it has for each month which brings you to a two-page overview for the month with space to write on each day and a small notes section for the month. Following that, there are two pages for each week with plenty of space to write for each day. I love the fact that every page has a scenic photo and quote, which elevates the product from the usual basic planner.

The paper is recycled so it wasn't the smoothest for writing, but was adequate. I wish there was a choice in colors for the cover other than black, but the color does make it appealing to both men and women and is a basic color so that the planner can be used in the office.

title: Handy tabs in a clever reusable carrier
text:
I love using tabs to mark my place in books and notebooks and this set of tabs by Avery is excellent. It's a clever idea putting the tabs in a refillable carrier than has holes so it can be placed in a binder as well as a clip so it can be attached to a planner or spiral notebook, like a clippable bookmark.

This set comes with 40 mini tabs in neon green, pink, orange, and yellow and 16 larger "multi-use" tabs in neon green and pink. I really like that the "sticky" part of the tab is clear and that both sides of the colored part can be written on. I was pleased to see the ink didn't smear, either. The tabs are easily repositioned or removed without doing any damage to the page. I am very happy with this product.The tabs are easy to use and it's even better that they come in the "clip and go" carrier.

title: Markers are great for coloring and would make an excellent gift
text:
This is a nice set of 20 markers with an excellent variety of vibrant colors. The markers write and color smoothly. The markers are fine-tipped, but porous, so they work well when coloring in larger areas but aren't quite fine enough for the most detailed parts of a given coloring page. The colors do have some bleed through on even heavier paper, so the markers are best suited to one-sided coloring pages.

The markers come in a hinged, tin container and would be a wonderful gift, especially if paired with a coloring book for adults.

title: Lightweight, comfortable, and functional lap desk
text:
This lap desk by LapGear is small and lightweight, which makes it comfortable on my lap, as well as easy to store. I like using my netbook small PC to type in Word documents, respond to E-mails, and surf the Internet while sitting on the couch, and this lap desk has become invaluable. It’s perfect for holding my PC and the wrist rests make it comfortable to type.

The media slot holds a variety of sizes of tablets. The Kindle Fire HD fits well for watching videos. I have a large smart phone (LG Vista), and it fits well, too, and would also be great for watching videos.
In addition, there is a no slip area on the surface of the right-hand side of the lap desk to place your phone so you can keep it handy and keep it from sliding down the desk.

I am very pleased with this lap desk. It has been a while since I’ve used one, but the compact size of this one makes it more useful and more comfortable to use. I definitely recommend this product.
